en.description: All segments strongly mark the uppercase letter sequence SA. It appears in varied positions, including email addresses and headers, parenthetical abbreviations, and organization or company names; surrounding characters and semantic domains are not fixed.

patterns.name: SA uppercase sequence
patterns.context: The letter sequence SA itself is strongly marked, often appearing as an uppercase sequence in abbreviations, proper names, or addresses; adjacent characters are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Across email, web, legal documents, encyclopedias, and academic texts

patterns.name: SA in email headers
patterns.context: Appears in recipient, CC, or organization-path fields in Enron email metadata.

patterns.name: SA in abbreviations
patterns.context: SA is part of a longer abbreviation, adjacent to Q, EC, or FTA; parenthetical or abbreviation-definition contexts are prominent.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, encyclopedia entries, academic discussion

patterns.name: SA in company or organization names
patterns.context: SA occurs within the name of a company, organization, or entity; surrounding characters can cross word boundaries, and spellings and meanings vary.
patterns.domain: Business email, news, case law, encyclopedias

4_49.description: 所有段都强烈标记大写字母序列 SA；它出现在邮件地址与抬头、括号缩写、机构或公司名称等多种位置，前后字符和语义领域不固定。

patterns.name: SA 大写序列
patterns.context: 字母序列 SA 本身被强烈标记，常处于缩写、专名或地址中的大写字符序列；相邻字符并非固定。
patterns.domain: 跨邮件、网页、法律文书、百科及学术文本

patterns.name: 邮件抬头中的 SA
patterns.trigger: «SA»10 位于邮件地址/抄送字段，如 «/SA»10«/»1«Enron»、«@»1«west»1lb；以及 «Luiz Maurer/«SA»9/»
patterns.context: 出现在 Enron 邮件元数据中的收件人、抄送人或组织路径内。

patterns.name: 缩写中的 SA
patterns.context: SA 是较长缩写的一部分，分别与 Q、EC、FTA 相邻；括号或缩写定义语境较明显。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、百科条目、学术论述

patterns.name: 公司或机构名称中的 SA
patterns.context: SA 出现在公司、机构或实体名称的内部；周围字符可跨词边界，拼写与词义各异。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、新闻、判例、百科

en.description: A strong shared trigger across segments is the uppercase substring “SA”, embedded in various abbreviations, proper names, and common words. Text domains and contexts vary widely, with no stable semantic theme evident.

patterns.name: String “SA” and within abbreviations
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the uppercase letter sequence SA. It may be part of an abbreviation or a component of a common word or company or organization name; surrounding meanings are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Email headers, technical discussions, academic texts, news, encyclopedias, and legal cases

4_49.description: 各段共同的强触发是大写子串“SA”，嵌在多种缩写、专名及普通词中；文本领域和上下文差异很大，未见稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 字符串“SA”及其缩写内部
patterns.context: 激活集中于大写字母序列 SA；它可能是缩写的一部分，也可能是普通词或公司、组织名称的组成部分，周边含义不统一。
patterns.domain: 邮件头、技术讨论、学术文本、新闻、百科和法律判例

en.description: Primarily activates on the consecutive letters SA in uppercase abbreviations, especially in email addresses/paths and abbreviation formats involving parentheses or hyphens; also appears in PDVSA. Segment 10 has no obvious SA and is difficult to explain.

patterns.name: SA string (email/organization path)
patterns.context: SA appears in recipient, CC, or institutional paths, often adjacent to Enron email headers, email addresses, or abbreviations; it is not necessarily an independent word.

patterns.name: SA as part of an abbreviation
patterns.context: SA occurs inside an uppercase-letter abbreviation or at its boundary, followed by other uppercase letters; formats include parentheses, hyphens, or abbreviation expansions.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, academic papers, encyclopedia entries, legal cases, business emails

patterns.name: SA at the end of the name PDVSA
patterns.context: SA is at the end of the name of Venezuelan oil company PDVSA and occurs in news sentences.

patterns.name: executive in a business-social context
patterns.context: Phrases about business executives socializing and networking; the shown segment contains no SA string, so the trigger is unclear.

4_49.description: 主要对大写缩写中的连续字母 SA 激活，尤其是邮件地址/路径及括号、连字符等缩写格式；也见于 PDVSA。第10段无明显 SA，难以解释。

patterns.name: SA 字符串（邮箱/组织路径）
patterns.context: SA 出现在收件人、抄送或机构路径中，常与 Enron 邮件头、邮箱或缩写相邻；未必是独立词。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、电子邮件地址

patterns.name: SA 作为缩写的一部分
patterns.context: SA 位于大写字母缩写内部或缩写边界，后接其他大写字母；含括号、连字符或缩写释义等格式。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、学术论文、百科条目、法律判例、商务邮件

patterns.name: PDVSA 名称中的 SA
patterns.context: SA 是委内瑞拉石油公司 PDVSA 名称的末尾，出现在新闻语句中。

patterns.name: 商务社交语境中的 executive
patterns.trigger: «Business»3« exec»9«s»5« hoping»2« to»3« connect»1« and»2« network»2« with»1« other»6
patterns.context: 商务高管社交与建立联系的短语；所示片段没有 SA 字符串，触发原因不明。

en.description: Primarily activates on the uppercase letter sequence SA, found in organization abbreviations, name/email fields, academic abbreviations, and QSA; there are also sporadic activations on quoted sentence-initial We, exec in execs, and a subword fragment in Stray.

patterns.name: SA letter sequence
patterns.context: SA appears as a contiguous uppercase substring in abbreviations, name/address fields, or parenthetical labels; in segment 10, it follows Q.
patterns.domain: Organization names and abbreviations, email metadata, academic texts, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Sentence-initial We
patterns.context: A direct quote in quotation marks begins with We, followed by an abbreviation or auxiliary-verb construction.
patterns.domain: Quotes in news or web text

patterns.name: In-word fragment in execs
patterns.context: In business execs, execs is segmented into exec and a plural suffix.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in a word for light
patterns.context: The word Stray is split into two tokens, appearing sentence-initially and modifying light.

4_49.description: 主要对大写字母序列 SA 激活，见于组织缩写、姓名/邮件字段、学术缩写和 QSA；另对引语句首 We、execs 的 exec、Stray 的分词片段有零星激活。

patterns.name: SA 字母序列
patterns.context: SA 作为连续大写字母子串出现在缩写、姓名/地址字段或括号内标记中；段 10 中位于 Q 后。
patterns.domain: 机构名称与缩写、邮件元数据、学术文本、技术问答

patterns.name: 句首 We
patterns.context: 引号中的直接引语以 We 起始，后接缩写或助动词结构。

patterns.name: execs 词内片段
patterns.context: business execs 中的 execs 被拆分为 exec 与复数词尾。

patterns.name: 光线词内片段
patterns.context: 单词 Stray 被拆分为两个 token，位于句首并修饰 light。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，光学说明

en.concept: Local word forms and proper-name fragments
en.description: Activation falls on various local word forms: sentence-initial We in quotations, the letter string ray, exec, probability, the proper name Tom, and SA at the end of the abbreviation ECSA. Apart from a few repeated word forms, meanings and registers vary widely.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial We
patterns.context: A sentence in quotation marks begins with We; activation concentrates on We, which may be followed by an abbreviation or a full verb.
patterns.domain: Direct quotations in news and online text

patterns.name: ray substring
patterns.context: ray occurs inside words, without requiring a specific meaning; it appears in stray and Brayer.

patterns.name: exec in execs
patterns.context: exec is followed by the plural suffix s and refers to business executives.

patterns.name: probability
patterns.context: The full word probability; here it describes probability in contact lens treatment.

patterns.name: Tom
patterns.context: Tom as a person's name or the beginning of a name; it may be followed by a date heading, surname, or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Webpage titles, email, and encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Ending of the abbreviation ECSA
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the abbreviation ECSA in parentheses, after the full name European Composer and Songwriter Alliance has been given.

4_49.description: 激活落在多种局部词形：引语句首 We、ray 字母串、exec、probability、专名 Tom，以及缩写 ECSA 的 SA；除少数词形重复外，语义与语域差异很大。

patterns.name: 句首 We
patterns.context: 引号中的句子以 We 开头；激活集中在 We，左右可接缩写或完整动词。
patterns.domain: 新闻、网络文本中的直接引语

patterns.name: ray 子串
patterns.context: ray 出现在单词内部，不要求特定语义；分别位于 stray、Brayer 中。

patterns.name: execs 中的 exec
patterns.context: exec 后接复数词尾 s，指商业高管。
patterns.domain: 商业社交与职场网络文本

patterns.name: probability
patterns.context: 完整单词 probability；此处描述接触镜诊疗中的概率。

patterns.name: Tom
patterns.context: Tom 作为人名或名称开头；可跟随日期标题、姓氏或标点。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、邮件及百科文本

patterns.name: ECSA 缩写末尾
patterns.context: 出现在括号内缩写 ECSA 的末尾，前文已给出 European Composer and Songwriter Alliance 全称。

en.description: The most prominent recurring trigger is the uppercase character sequence SA, appearing across email routing fields, organization proper names, and medical abbreviations; there are also two quotes beginning with We and a one-off ray in stray. Other highlights are sporadic and difficult to summarize.

patterns.name: SA substring/character sequence
patterns.context: The uppercase character sequence SA; in email addresses it is often a routing or department field, while in proper names or abbreviations it is simply part of a name. It triggers across different contexts.
patterns.domain: Enron email, encyclopedia entries, medical texts

patterns.name: Quotes beginning with We
patterns.context: First-person plural conversational quotes in quotation marks beginning with We; the two examples are followed by different predicate constructions.
patterns.domain: Direct quotes in news or online text

patterns.name: ray substring
patterns.context: Appears in the word “stray,” followed by light, describing stray light entering a lens.

patterns.name: Word activations in other fragments
patterns.context: Common words adjacent to the quotes in segments 6 and 7; these two segments alone do not reveal which words form stable trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Other sporadic highlights
patterns.context: Occur separately in email timestamps, encyclopedia entries, medical phrases, and business email, without a consistent cross-segment context pattern.
patterns.domain: Email, encyclopedias, medical and business texts

4_49.concept: 包含 SA 字符序列
4_49.description: 最明显的重复触发是大写 SA 字符序列，跨邮件路由字段、组织专名和医学缩写出现；另有 We 开头的两条引语及单例 stray 中的 ray。其他高亮分散，难以归纳。

patterns.name: SA 子串／字符序列
patterns.trigger: «SA»，尤其出现在人名、邮箱或组织名中，如“/«SA»10/”“(EC«SA»10)”“(«N»2«SA»9«IDs»2)”
patterns.context: 大写 SA 字符序列；在邮件地址中常为路由或部门字段，在专名或缩写中则只是名称的一部分。不同上下文中均会触发。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、百科条目、医学文本

patterns.name: We 开头的引语
patterns.context: 引号中以 We 开始的第一人称复数口语引语；两个例子紧接不同的谓语结构。
patterns.domain: 新闻或网络文本中的直接引语

patterns.name: ray 子串
patterns.context: 出现在单词“stray”中，词后接 light，描述进入镜片的杂散光。

patterns.name: 其他片段中的字词激活
patterns.context: 与第6、7段引语相邻的常见词；仅凭这两段难以判断哪些词构成稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 网络文本中的口语引语

patterns.name: 其他零散高亮
patterns.context: 分别散见于邮件时间戳、百科条目、医学短语及商务邮件，缺乏跨段一致的上下文模式。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科、医学与商务文本

en.description: All segments activate on the same token “Though” at the beginning of a sentence or new sentence; the following content and domains vary, with no stable topic or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial concessive/contrastive connective Though
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a sentence or new sentence, followed by varied concessive, supplementary, or contrastive content; what follows is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: email, encyclopedias, forums, news, literature, Q&A, and web text

4_49.description: 所有段都在句首或新句开头激活同一 token“Though”；其后内容和领域多样，没有稳定的主题或语义条件。

patterns.name: 句首让步/转折连接词 Though
patterns.context: 在句首或新句开头，后接不同类型的让步、补充或转折内容；后续内容不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：邮件、百科、论坛、新闻、文学、问答及网页文本

en.concept: Sentence-initial They after a plural subject (local main pattern)
en.description: The main visible trigger is sentence-initial They after an introduction of a plural subject; there are also mon in a medical long word, Immun/ost fragments, and scattered activations on line breaks, words, and punctuation, with no condition that unifies all local triggers.

patterns.name: Consonant-cluster fragments at the beginning or within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on specific subword fragments in English compounds or longer technical terms; visible fragments include word-initial mon and Immun/ost in a word for immunostaining.

patterns.name: They at the beginning of a paragraph
patterns.context: The preceding text introduces a plural subject (a sports team, band, fruit-picking messengers, or people/institutions under discussion), then a new sentence or paragraph begins with They; the marked token is the pronoun They.

patterns.name: Other locally highlighted fragments
patterns.context: These trigger points are scattered across different text positions; some are adjacent to line breaks or paragraph boundaries, while others are proper names, common words, or punctuation, with no shared and stable local semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including encyclopedias, medical texts, email, and forums

4_49.concept: 复数主体后的句首 They（局部主模式）
4_49.description: 主要可见触发是复数主体介绍后句首的 They；另有医疗长词中的 mon、Immun/ost 片段，以及分散的换行、词语和标点激活，未见能统一解释所有局部触发的条件。

patterns.name: 英文词首或词内的辅音簇片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文复合词或较长专业词的特定子词片段上；可见片段包括词首 mon 和免疫染色词中的 Immun/ost。

patterns.name: 段落句首的 They
patterns.context: 前文先介绍一个复数主体（球队、乐队、果品信使，或讨论中的人/机构），随后以 They 开始新句或新段；标记落在代词 They。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、论坛讨论、邮件

patterns.name: 其他局部高亮片段
patterns.context: 这些触发点分散在不同文本位置；有的紧邻换行或段落边界，有的是专名、普通词或标点，缺乏共同且稳定的局部语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学、邮件、论坛等多种文体

en.description: Activations are scattered across in-word substrings in multilingual text: medical terms and names, Italian word forms, Latin scientific names, and personal or place names; there is no stable shared meaning, word-initial position, or genre condition.

patterns.name: Split fragments within medical proper names
patterns.context: Activation often falls within English medical terms, drug names, disease names, or experimental subjects; some fragments are word-initial and others medial, and they cannot be reduced to a common root.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and medical-related encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: In-word Italian fragments
patterns.context: Falls within words in Italian parliamentary speeches or formal statements, occurring at different positions in word forms; the fragments themselves have no clear unified meaning.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Italian IRC conversations
patterns.context: Appears within words in Italian IRC logs containing usernames, line breaks, and informal conversation; trigger points are distributed within words.

patterns.name: Fragments in encyclopedia titles or proper names
patterns.context: Activates on fragments of Latin scientific names in encyclopedia article titles and repeated names in the body text.

patterns.name: Name fragment in a biography
patterns.context: Falls within the name Hanneli, near a fashion blogger biography.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments for people and places
patterns.context: Falls within the Indian place name Doddaballapur, near a narrative about a theater and business career.

4_49.description: 激活分散在多语种文本中的词内子串：医学术语与名称、意大利语词形、拉丁学名及人物或地点专名；没有稳定共享的词义、词首位置或文体条件。

patterns.name: 医学专名内部的切分片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在英文医学术语、药名、疾病名或实验对象的词内；部分片段是词首，部分是词中，无法归结为一个共同词根。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要及医学相关百科条目

patterns.name: 意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 落在意大利语议会发言或正式陈述的词内，跨词形位置出现；片段本身没有明显统一词义。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语议会文本

patterns.name: 意大利语 IRC 对话中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在带用户名、换行和非正式交谈的意大利语 IRC 记录中，触发点分布于词内。

patterns.name: 百科词条名或专名片段
patterns.context: 在百科条目标题及其重复的正文名称中，对拉丁学名片段激活。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的名字片段
patterns.context: 落在人物姓名 Hanneli 的词内，附近是时尚博主简介。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 人物传记/网络简介

patterns.name: 人物与地点专名片段
patterns.context: 落在印度地点名 Doddaballapur 内，附近为剧院与商业经历叙述。

en.description: The most stable pattern is we all, especially followed by know or have, often expressing collective consensus or shared experience; there are also uses of all modifying a noun. Several sporadic activations on words, subword fragments, line breaks, punctuation, and numbers lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Collective-consensus phrase
patterns.context: We is followed by all, often continuing to express shared agreement, knowledge, or experience; all is the main trigger, and subsequent words sometimes also activate.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, parliamentary text, web articles, etc.

patterns.name: General use of the quantifier all
patterns.context: All modifies a plural or uncountable noun without we as the subject and without clearly expressing collective consensus.

patterns.name: Weak triggers other than “all”
patterns.context: Activation falls on nearby function words or subword fragments, with no stable independent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Residual activations across token boundaries
patterns.context: Activation occurs on split subword fragments or near line breaks and code formatting; its relation to the main clause meaning is unclear.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, forum posts, code snippets

patterns.name: Sporadic word activations beyond all
patterns.context: Individual words activate in specific contexts, but these examples do not establish a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: News commentary, entertainment news, parliamentary text, forums, and web pages

patterns.name: Number and punctuation activations
patterns.context: Low-intensity activations occur near numbers, percent signs, hyphens, or periods, with no stable cross-segment pattern.

4_49.description: 最稳定的模式是 we all，尤其接 know、have 等，常用于集体共识或共同经历；另有 all 修饰名词的用法。若干零散词、词片、换行、标点及数字激活缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: 集体共识短语
patterns.context: we 后接 all，常继续表达共同认同、已知或共同经历；all 是主要触发词，后续词有时也激活
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、议会文本、网页文章等

patterns.name: 数量词 all 的一般用法
patterns.context: all 修饰复数名词或不可数名词，不需要 we 作主语，也未明显表达集体共识

patterns.name: “all”以外的弱触发
patterns.trigger: “«As» we all know”“«even» if”“«for» my group chats”等
patterns.context: 激活落在邻近的功能词或分词片段上，未见稳定的独立语义条件

patterns.name: 跨 token 边界的残片激活
patterns.context: 激活出现在被切分的词片段或换行、代码格式附近；与主体句意关系不明确
patterns.domain: 议会文本、论坛帖子、代码片段

patterns.name: all 之外的零散词语激活
patterns.context: 个别上下文中的独立词语激活，无法从这些例子确定共同触发条件
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、娱乐新闻、议会文本、论坛及网页

patterns.name: 数字与标点激活
patterns.context: 数字、百分号、连字符或句号附近出现低强度激活，缺少跨段稳定规律

en.description: The strongest reproducible pattern is “more” modifying degree or manner in research contexts, often followed by an adverb or adjective; the remaining activations are scattered across name, terminology, and citation fragments in philosophy, medicine, law, and physics texts, without a shared context.

patterns.name: Degree/manner supplement introduced by “more”
patterns.context: Often appears after to, meaning to a greater degree or more effectively; also appears in “more extensive.”
patterns.domain: Research papers, medical/biological studies, and project descriptions

patterns.name: Word fragment in a philosophical citation
patterns.context: Embedded in book titles, philosophers’ names, and editor citations, with no evident shared syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Academic philosophy texts and bibliographic citations

patterns.name: Fragment in an author name
patterns.context: Appears in an author byline after an algorithm discussion in a paper.

patterns.name: Fragment in a medical term/name
patterns.context: Appears in a person’s name or a subtype name after a statistical analysis description.

patterns.name: Name and place fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in dates, lawyers’ names, and location information in bankruptcy court rulings.

patterns.name: Name fragment in a physics literature citation
patterns.context: Appears in a literature citation in a quantum magnetism research paper.

4_49.description: 最强且可复现的模式是科研语境中“more”修饰程度或方式，常接副词或形容词；其余激活分散在哲学、医学、法律和物理文本的人名、术语及引文词片中，缺乏共同语境。

patterns.name: “more”引出的程度/方式补充
patterns.context: 常出现在 to 后，表示以更高程度或更有效的方式；也出现于“more extensive”中
patterns.domain: 科研论文、医学/生物学研究及项目说明

patterns.name: 哲学引文中的词片
patterns.context: 嵌在专著标题、哲学家姓名及编者引文中，没有明显共同句法条件
patterns.domain: 哲学学术文本及书目引文

patterns.name: 作者姓名中的词片
patterns.context: 出现在论文算法讨论后的作者署名行

patterns.name: 医学术语/名称中的词片
patterns.context: 出现在统计分析描述后的人名或分型名称中

patterns.name: 法律引文中的姓名与地名词片
patterns.context: 出现在破产法院判决的日期、律师姓名及地点信息中

patterns.name: 物理文献引文中的姓名词片
patterns.context: 出现在量子磁性研究论文的文献引用中

en.description: One strong and relatively clear pattern is a degree expression following more (definitively, fully, extensive); there are also purpose or analysis phrases introduced by for. Other activations mostly fall on foreign names, proper names, within-word fragments, and a few punctuation formats, making them difficult to group into a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Degree or manner adverbs following more
patterns.context: In scientific writing, more is followed by an adverb or adjective indicating greater completeness, clarity, or breadth; activation mainly falls on more and extends to subsequent subword fragments.

patterns.name: Analysis or purpose phrases introduced by for
patterns.context: for introduces an analytical method, use of materials, or detection purpose, followed by a noun/gerund phrase.

patterns.name: Foreign names and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized foreign proper names or their subword fragments, including personal names, surnames, and quantum gate names; no unified semantic or positional pattern is evident.
patterns.domain: Philosophy bibliographies, patents, code comments, quantum computing papers

patterns.name: Sporadic within-word subfragments
patterns.context: Activation hits tokenized fragments of names, abbreviations, common words, or formatted text; the specific trigger cannot be determined from these examples.
patterns.domain: Medicine, research references, and crystallographic text

patterns.name: Punctuation, spaces, and code formatting
patterns.context: A few activations fall on hyphens, tokens near periods, or line-break/comment formatting, with no stable contextual conditions evident.
patterns.domain: Medical statistics text, quantum computing papers, code

patterns.name: Referential use of such
patterns.context: In patent narrative, such modifies a noun and refers back to technology or methods mentioned earlier.

patterns.name: utilizing to indicate use of a method
patterns.context: In a research plan, the present participle indicates the intervention or research method being used.

patterns.name: Degree adverb fully
patterns.context: fully modifies represent, expressing that a model or annotation does not adequately represent an object; similar to the example with more fully, but without more here.

patterns.name: Hyphen in a time range
patterns.context: A connector in a source-code copyright year range, occurring in isolation.

4_49.description: 强而较清楚的一类是 more 后接程度表达（definitively、fully、extensive）；另有 for 引出的用途或分析短语。其余激活多落在外文姓名、专名、词内片段及少量标点格式，难以归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: more 后接程度或方式副词
patterns.trigger: « more»10 defin«itively»2；« more»9« fully»2；« more»9« extensive»1
patterns.context: 科学论述中，more 后接副词或形容词，表示更充分、更明确或更广泛；激活主要落在 more，也延伸至后续词片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、科研项目文本

patterns.name: for 分析或用途短语
patterns.trigger: « for»2« multivariate»3；sources« for»3 electron and ion microscopy；« for»2« detecting»1 edges
patterns.context: for 引出分析方法、资料用途或检测目的，后接名词/动名词短语。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、物理文献、专利

patterns.name: 外文姓名及词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的外文专名或其子词片段上，涉及人名、姓氏及量子门名称；未见统一语义或位置规律。
patterns.domain: 哲学书目、专利、代码注释、量子计算论文

patterns.name: 零散词内子片段
patterns.context: 激活命中被分词切开的姓名、缩写、普通词或格式化文本片段，具体触发条件无法由这些例子确定。
patterns.domain: 医学、科研参考文献与晶体学文本

patterns.name: 标点、空格及代码格式
patterns.context: 少量激活落在连字符、句点邻近 token 或换行/注释格式上，未显示稳定的上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 医学统计文本、量子计算论文、代码

patterns.name: such 的指代性用法
patterns.context: 在专利叙述中 such 修饰名词，回指前文提及的技术或方法。

patterns.name: utilizing 表示采用方法
patterns.context: 科研计划中用现在分词说明采用的干预手段或研究方法。

patterns.name: 程度副词 fully
patterns.context: fully 修饰 represent，表达某模型或注释未能充分表示对象；与 more fully 的例子相近但此处没有 more。

patterns.name: 时间范围中的连字符
patterns.context: 代码版权年份范围中的连接符，孤立出现。

en.description: Activations occur on in-word subword fragments, words within common words and phrases, “Imitation” in two work titles, and a line break after a forum quote; these patterns span domains and have no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: In-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subwords or fragments within words, often in proper names, technical terms, citation identifiers, and segmented words; the fragments themselves have no obvious unified meaning.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: philosophy, forums, mathematics papers, music reviews, biomedicine, culinary history, etc.

patterns.name: Common words in phrases
patterns.context: The marked token is a word in a common word or phrase, especially in collocations and sentence-pattern fragments; the examples lack stable specific semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, forum dialogue, and academic writing

patterns.name: Title The Imitation Game
patterns.context: Appears in a work title; the two examples are an album title and a film title.

patterns.name: Marked line break
patterns.context: Activation is marked at a line break after a forum quote separator, following “------”.

4_49.description: 激活分布在词内子词片段、普通词和短语中的词，以及两个作品标题里的“Imitation”和论坛引用后的换行；这些模式跨领域，未见统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的子词或片段上，常见于专名、术语、引文标识符及被切分的词；片段本身没有明显统一语义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：哲学、论坛、数学论文、音乐评论、生物医学、餐饮史等

patterns.name: 短语中的常见词
patterns.context: 标记落在普通词或短语中的词上，尤其是搭配与句式片段；各例之间缺少稳定的特定语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、论坛对话及学术写作

patterns.name: 《模仿游戏》标题
patterns.trigger: «Imitation»（“Imitation of Life”与“The Imitation Game”中的词）
patterns.context: 出现在作品标题中；两例分别是专辑名和电影名。

patterns.name: 标记换行符
patterns.context: 激活标在论坛引用分隔线后的换行处，出现在“------”之后。

en.concept: Within-word substrings and local string patterns
en.description: Activation is scattered across within-word substrings in multilingual, multi-domain text, often in word endings, roots, proper names, and quotations. There are also German fragments, work titles, the strings toenails/signatures, and one line-break trigger, with no unified semantic theme evident.

patterns.name: Within-word English suffix/root fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments inside English or German words, often part of a word ending or root; surrounding contexts and specific word meanings vary widely.
patterns.domain: Various genres including code comments, parliamentary records, papers, forums, medical abstracts, encyclopedias, poetry catalogs, and patents

patterns.name: Within-word German fragments
patterns.context: Trigger fragments are embedded in German sentences, including within-word splits as well as common short words or word-form fragments; the sentences concern agendas and replies.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in proper names and quotations
patterns.context: Activation is distributed within personal names, paper citations, or work titles; split positions vary, and many adjacent characters are not marked.
patterns.domain: Code metadata, academic citations, encyclopedia biographies, and music reviews

patterns.name: Fragments in repeated word forms or work titles
patterns.context: Occur within words in work titles, catalog entries, or body text. Some fragments also appear in words from other domains, with no stable title-related semantics evident.

patterns.name: Specific string to(en)
patterns.context: Appears in a HackerNews signature after a separator line and inside the word “toenails” in a patent; trigger positions and meanings differ.

patterns.name: Punctuation and line breaks
patterns.context: In a HackerNews segment, a newline is marked on its own between the body text and separator line; other segments provide no similar evidence.

4_49.concept: 词内子串与局部字符串模式
4_49.description: 激活散布于多语种、多领域文本的词内子串，常见于词尾、词根、专名和引文；另有德语片段、作品标题、toenails/署名字符串及一次换行触发，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 词内英文后缀/词根片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文或德文词语内部的子词片段上，常是词尾或词根的一部分；周围语境与具体词义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 代码注释、议会记录、论文、论坛、医学摘要、百科、诗歌目录、专利等多种文体

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在德语句子中，包含词内切分，也有常见短词或词形片段；句子谈及议程及答复。

patterns.name: 专名及引文中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在人物姓名、论文引用或作品名的内部；切分位置不固定，且许多相邻字符未标记。
patterns.domain: 代码元数据、学术引文、百科人物与音乐评论

patterns.name: 重复词形或作品标题中的片段
patterns.context: 在作品名、目录条目或正文中的词汇内部出现，部分片段也见于其他领域词语，未显示稳定的标题语义。

patterns.name: 特定字符串 to(en)
patterns.context: 出现于 HackerNews 的分隔线后署名，以及专利中 “toenails” 一词内部；触发位置及语义不同。

patterns.name: 标点与换行
patterns.context: 在 HackerNews 片段中换行符被单独标记，位于正文与分隔线之间；其他段并无相同证据。

en.description: Activations concentrate on local in-word fragments, often in long words, proper names, and segmented words; they occur across interdisciplinary texts, with no stable topic or semantic category.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on token fragments within words; word forms and positions are not fixed, and fragments occur across technical terms, names, and common words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including papers, parliamentary records, email, patents, medical literature, literary texts, and legal texts.

patterns.name: Fragments in names or proper nouns
patterns.context: Appears in author, person, or company names, or case names, often adjacent to punctuation and citation formatting.
patterns.domain: Academic citations, contact lists, literary catalogs, legal cases.

patterns.name: Word fragments near line breaks or text boundaries
patterns.context: Words are split or marked, or affected by line breaks and citation punctuation; the activated fragments do not necessarily correspond to complete words.
patterns.domain: Patent, medical abstract, list, and citation-formatted texts.

patterns.name: Fragments in German word forms
patterns.context: Fragments are embedded in German words, surrounded by German grammar and parliamentary discussion context.

4_49.description: 激活集中于词内局部片段，常见于长词、专名及被切分的词；跨学科文本均出现，未见稳定的主题或语义类别。

patterns.name: 英文词内部的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的 token 片段；词形和位置并不固定，片段可跨专业术语、姓名及普通词出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括论文、议会记录、邮件、专利、医学文献、文学和法律文本。

patterns.name: 姓名或专名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在作者、人物、公司或判例名称中，常与标点及引文格式相邻。
patterns.domain: 学术引文、联系人名单、文学目录、法律判例。

patterns.name: 断行或文本边界附近的词片段
patterns.context: 词被拆分、标记或受换行和引文标点影响；激活片段未必对应完整词。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学摘要、名单及引文排版文本。

patterns.name: 德语词形中的片段
patterns.context: 片段嵌在德语词中，周围有德语语法和议会讨论语境。

en.concept: Local fragments of words and proper names
en.description: Activation is distributed across within-word fragments, proper names, and a few common words in multilingual text from different domains. Name fragments such as Chebyshev, Brook/Petersburg are visible, along with Breitbart, German word fragments, and common English words across contexts; there are no stable semantic or syntactic conditions.

patterns.name: Fragment within the name Chebyshev
patterns.context: Activates when the surname Chebyshev is split into multiple subwords or fragments; it may occur in personal names, organization names, or quoted text.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, personal names, and proper names

patterns.name: Fragment within the name Brook
patterns.context: Occurs when proper names contain fragments such as Brook or Petersburg; activation concentrates on partial subwords in the name and does not require a specific sentence meaning.
patterns.domain: Organizations, places, and personal names in scientific papers

patterns.name: Token fragments with specific prefixes
patterns.context: Activation falls on short within-word fragments or near punctuation; these examples span different words, with no stable shared semantic condition evident.
patterns.domain: Forum text, mailing lists, and academic text

patterns.name: Short fragments at the beginning or within words
patterns.context: Occurs in tokenized fragments of German words, English words, or names; these are mostly parts of words, and a unified meaning or positional condition cannot be determined from the examples alone.
patterns.domain: German parliamentary text, mailing lists, and academic text

patterns.name: Proper name Breitbart
patterns.context: Activation occurs on a middle fragment of the media name Breitbart; the segment discusses conservative media.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments of common words
patterns.context: Occur in common English words in different syntactic positions; topics vary, with insufficient evidence that these words share semantics or syntactic functions.
patterns.domain: Forums, academic papers, and social science text

patterns.name: Rare fragments in proper names or abbreviations
patterns.context: Organizations, author citations, and reference markers in physics papers; these may reflect proper names or tokenization boundaries rather than a shared topic.

4_49.concept: 词语与专名的局部片段
4_49.description: 激活分布于多语种、不同领域文本的词内片段、专名和少数普通词上。可见 Chebyshev、Brook/Petersburg 等名称片段，也有 Breitbart、德语词片段及跨语境普通英语词；没有稳定的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: Chebyshev 名称内部片段
patterns.context: 姓名 Chebyshev 被拆成多个子词或片段时激活；可出现在人名、机构名或引用文字中。

patterns.name: Brook 名称内部片段
patterns.context: 专名中包含 Brook 或 Petersburg 等片段时；激活集中在名称的部分子词，不要求句子有特定语义。
patterns.domain: 科学论文中的机构、地名和人名

patterns.name: 带特定前缀的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在短小的词内片段或标点附近；这些例子跨越不同词语，未见稳定的共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、邮件名单及学术文本

patterns.name: 词首或词中短片段
patterns.context: 出现在德语词、英语词或姓名的分词片段中；多为词的一部分，不能仅凭这些例子确定统一词义或位置条件。
patterns.domain: 德语议会文本、邮件名单及学术文本

patterns.name: Breitbart 专名
patterns.context: 在 Breitbart 这个媒体名称的词中间片段激活；该段讨论保守派媒体。

patterns.name: 常见词的词内片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在不同句法位置的普通英语词中；上下文主题各异，没有足够证据表明这些词共享语义或句法功能。
patterns.domain: 论坛、学术论文及社会科学文本

patterns.name: 专名或缩写中的稀有片段
patterns.context: 物理学论文中的机构、作者引用及参考文献标记；可能反映专名或分词边界，而非同一主题。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文及引用格式

en.description: Activations mostly fall on subword fragments of cross-lingual proper names, German words, and English words, but the fragments vary widely in meaning and position. Sporadic activations also occur on line breaks and common words, with no stable shared condition observed.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Trigger fragments are embedded within proper names, especially Chebyshev (including variant tokenizations); some activations fall on different subword fragments of the name.

patterns.name: Fragments within German words
patterns.context: Fragments occur inside continuous German words or near affix boundaries; they do not have a fixed meaning in isolation, and activation positions are scattered.

patterns.name: Fragments within English words
patterns.context: English personal names or common words are split into subwords, and the fragments themselves have no clear shared semantics.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, papers, medical literature, and forum posts

patterns.name: Fragments in other names or labels
patterns.context: Occur near people’s names, album layout labels, or usernames/URLs; there is no stable lexical or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia music production credits, HackerNews posts, and links

patterns.name: Sporadic subwords in technical terms
patterns.context: Occur in technical texts such as quantum experiments or microscopy; activations are distributed across common words, abbreviations, and place names, with no unified semantics.
patterns.domain: Physics and biomedical papers (ArXiv, PubMed Central)

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic subword activations
patterns.context: Occur in acknowledgments, paper body text, or title separators; context does not suggest a stable connection to other patterns.

4_49.description: 激活多落在跨语言专名、德语词及英文词的子词片段上，但片段语义与位置差异大；另有换行及普通词的零散激活，未见稳定共同条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在专名内部，尤其是 Chebyshev（及变体分词拼写）中；部分激活落在名字的不同子词片段上。

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在连续德语词的内部或词缀边界附近；单独看并非固定词义，且激活位置分散。

patterns.name: 英文词内片段
patterns.context: 英文人名或普通词被切分成子词，片段本身没有明显共同语义。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、论文、医学文献与论坛帖子

patterns.name: 其他名称或标签中的片段
patterns.context: 在人员姓名、专辑版面标签或用户名/网址附近出现；缺少稳定的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 音乐制作名单、HackerNews 帖子及链接

patterns.name: 技术词语中的零散子词
patterns.context: 出现在量子实验或显微成像等技术文本中；激活分布于普通词、缩写和地名，未见统一语义。
patterns.domain: 物理与生物医学论文（ArXiv、PubMed Central）

patterns.name: 未解释的零散子词激活
patterns.context: 出现在致谢、论文正文或标题分隔处，无法从上下文推断与其他模式有稳定联系。

en.description: Activation mostly falls on within-word fragments of names, proper names, or technical terms across emails, encyclopedias, papers, and technical discussions. A few fragments relate to “toenails” and “steganography”, but trigger forms and meanings are not consistent.

patterns.name: Specific character fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Activation falls on consecutive or adjacent subword fragments inside personal names or surnames; these occur in various positions, including authors, public figures, band members, and email recipient lists.

patterns.name: Words related to toenails
patterns.context: One instance is a within-word fragment in “ripping off his toenails”; another appears in “Tokenex”, which superficially contains the same character fragment but has a different meaning and context.

patterns.name: Character fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs inside company names or personal names, and does not always correspond to the same meaning or context.
patterns.domain: Biomedical methods sections, email recipient lists

patterns.name: Fragment within a radiation term
patterns.context: The fragment is embedded in the high-energy physics term bremsstrahlung; surrounding text discusses finite-order calculations and radiation contributions.

patterns.name: Spelling and morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls inside various proper names or technical terms; these fragments and the provided context alone are insufficient to group them into the same semantic category.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia album personnel lists, paper references, or technical text

patterns.name: GAN at the end of a word
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the GAN string at the beginning of “steganography”; the discussion concerns steganography detection in image data.

4_49.description: 激活多落在姓名、专名或术语的词内片段，跨邮件、百科、论文和技术讨论；其中少数片段与“toenails”“steganography”有关，但触发形式和语义并不统一。

patterns.name: 人名中的特定字符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人名或姓氏内部的连续或相邻子词片段；出现于作者、人物、乐队成员、邮件收件人名单等多种位置。
patterns.domain: 邮件、百科、论文及参考文献

patterns.name: 脚趾甲相关词
patterns.context: 一处是“ripping off his toenails”中的词内片段；另一处在“Tokenex”中，表面上也包含相同字符片段，但语义和上下文不同。

patterns.name: 专名中的字符片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在公司名或姓名内部，且并非都对应同一种词义或语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法段、邮件收件人名单

patterns.name: 辐射术语内部片段
patterns.context: 片段嵌在高能物理术语 bremsstrahlung 中，周围是关于有限阶计算和辐射贡献的论文表述。

patterns.name: 拼写与形态碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在多个不同专名或术语内部，单凭这些片段及所给上下文难以归为同一语义类别。
patterns.domain: 百科唱片人员表、论文参考文献或技术文本

patterns.name: GAN 词尾
patterns.context: 激活位于“steganography”开头的 GAN 字符串；讨论的是图像数据隐写检测。

en.concept: Responses to specific within-word subword fragments
en.description: Most activations fall on within-word fragments of Weibull, involving surnames or distribution terms; the rest are scattered across internal, initial, or boundary fragments of different words, with no consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments of Weibull
patterns.context: Activations fall on letter fragments of the proper name or term Weibull; the word is split by tokenization, and fragment positions vary.
patterns.domain: Personal surnames, probability distributions, and failure distributions; encyclopedias, academic papers, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Other within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on internal subword fragments of common words, personal names, place names, or compounds, with no stable lexical meaning or positional condition.
patterns.domain: Folk musician profiles, banking news, railway encyclopedias, album credits, parliamentary speeches, medical papers

patterns.name: Possible word-initial or boundary fragments
patterns.context: Marked fragments occur in incomplete text or text that may cross word boundaries; the fragments alone do not establish a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions and other general text

4_49.concept: 对特定词内子词片段的反应
4_49.description: 多数段在 Weibull 的词内片段上激活，涉及姓氏或分布术语；其余激活散落于不同词的内部、词首或边界片段，未显示一致语义模式。

patterns.name: Weibull 词内片段
patterns.trigger: «We»«ib»«ull»（跨段呈现为 «We»、«ib»、«ull» 等被标记的词内片段）
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或术语 Weibull 的字母片段上；词被分词拆开，片段位置不固定。
patterns.domain: 人物姓氏、概率分布与失效分布等；百科、学术论文及医学摘要

patterns.name: 其他词内片段
patterns.trigger: «Houghton»中的 «H»«a»«vers»；«Sheop»中的 «op»；«Gemünd»中的 «ünd»；«Henszel»中的 «ens»；以及 «Fr»«ab»、«K»、«Gill»«mor»、«Wack»、«H»«ens»«el»、«T»«ages» 等
patterns.context: 激活出现在普通词、人名、地名或复合词的内部子词片段中，未见稳定的词义或位置条件。
patterns.domain: 民谣人物介绍、银行新闻、铁路百科、专辑署名、议会发言、医学论文

patterns.name: 疑似词首或边界片段
patterns.context: 标记片段分别出现在不完整或可能跨词边界的文本中；仅凭片段无法确定共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论及其他一般文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across within-word fragments in various languages, proper names, and common words. English ens/en fragments occur relatively often, but German words, fragments of physics and mathematician names, and other sporadic subwords also appear; there is no unified semantic or stable morphological pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names such as Hensel/Hensley
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter fragment ens inside a name or statistical term; surrounding letters and tokenization are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia bylines, legal cases, medical papers

patterns.name: English word fragments containing en
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words, especially toenails; a HackerNews post also contains the name “Toenex”.

patterns.name: Weakly corresponding fragments at the end of or within English words
patterns.context: Appears in the spelling of the proper name Houghton Weavers; this is a single example, making it difficult to establish an independent rule.

patterns.name: Within-word German fragment
patterns.context: Located inside the German word weiter, meaning “continue” in the sentence; other German word fragments are also marked in the same segment.

patterns.name: Fragment in a physics proper name
patterns.context: Activation falls inside the compound proper name Wegner-Wilson; the context is a theoretical physics discussion of the Polyakov loop.

patterns.name: Fragment in a mathematician's surname
patterns.context: Falls inside the surname Chebyshev; other sporadic marks occur in the same segment, but they do not form a clear shared morphological pattern.

4_49.description: 激活分散在多种语言、专名和普通词的词内片段上；英语 ens/en 片段较常见，但也出现德语词、物理学与数学家姓名片段及其他零散子词，缺乏统一语义或稳定词形规律。

patterns.name: Hensel/Hensley 等专名中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名或统计术语内部的 ens 字母片段；前后字母与切分不固定。
patterns.domain: 百科署名、法律判例、医学论文

patterns.name: 含 en 的英语词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部，尤其是 toenails；另有 HackerNews 帖中“Toenex”名称。

patterns.name: 英语词尾或词内的弱对应片段

patterns.name: 德语词内片段
patterns.context: 位于德语 weiter 的词内，句中意为“继续”；同时该段其他德语词片段也被标记。

patterns.name: 物理学专名词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Wegner-Wilson 复合专名内部；上下文为 Polyakov loop 的理论物理论述。

patterns.name: 数学家姓氏片段
patterns.context: 落在数学家 Chebyshev 的姓氏内部；同段另有零散标记，无法归为同一清晰词形规律。

en.description: High activations fall on within-word fragments in several languages: biomedical hemostasis, Dutch toekomst, German weiterhin, and English co- compounds; two proper-name fragments also appear. The trigger conditions are not uniform.

patterns.name: English hemostasis ending
patterns.context: In NIH biomedical text, activation falls on the within-word fragment «most» in hemostasis; the context concerns normal hemostasis, thrombosis, or coagulation mechanisms.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Dutch toekomst
patterns.context: In Dutch parliamentary text, activation falls on the within-word fragment «ek» in toekomst (future), near expressions such as plannen and vooruitzichten that discuss future plans or prospects.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in German weiterhin
patterns.context: In German parliamentary speeches, activation falls on the middle segment «iter» of weiterhin; here it means that a topic remains on the agenda.

patterns.name: Hyphen in English co- compounds
patterns.context: The hyphen occurs in English co- compounds; one example concerns a film co-director, and another concerns co-evolutionary optimization.
patterns.domain: Online reviews and computational materials science papers

patterns.name: Fragment «ens» in a proper name
patterns.context: Activation falls within the surname of photographer Scott Hensel; no ordinary-word trigger condition can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Fragment «bys» in a proper name
patterns.context: Activation falls within the surname of mathematician Chebyshev; no ordinary-word trigger condition can be confirmed.

4_49.description: 高激活落在若干不同语言的词内片段：生物医学 hemostasis、荷兰语 toekomst、德语 weiterhin，以及英文 co-复合词；另见两个专名片段。触发条件不统一。

patterns.name: 英语 hemostasis 词尾
patterns.context: 在 NIH 生物医学文本中，激活落在 hemostasis 的词内片段 «most»；语境涉及正常止血、血栓或凝血机制。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与资助申请

patterns.name: 荷兰语 toekomst 词内片段
patterns.context: 在荷兰语议会文本中，激活落在 toekomst（未来）的词内片段 «ek»，与 plannen、vooruitzichten 等谈论未来计划或展望的表达相邻。

patterns.name: 德语 weiterhin 词内片段
patterns.context: 在德语议会发言中，激活落在 weiterhin 的中段 «iter»；此处表示某主题仍在议程上。

patterns.name: 英文 co- 复合词连字符
patterns.context: 连字符位于英文 co- 复合词中；一例是电影共同导演，另一例是共进化优化。
patterns.domain: 网络评论与计算材料科学论文

patterns.name: 专名中的片段 «ens»
patterns.context: 激活落在摄影师姓名 Scott Hensel 的姓氏中；缺少可确认的普通词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的片段 «bys»
patterns.context: 激活落在数学家 Chebyshev 的姓氏中；缺少可确认的普通词义触发条件。

en.description: Activation is scattered across «ur» in heuristic(s)/heuristically, «ř» in Hořava, «pt» in heptamer/hepatocytes, and sporadic fragments in colloquial quotations, place names, and personal names. Apart from «ur», little shared meaning or context is evident.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in heuristic
patterns.context: Trigger words are heuristic(s)/heuristically, appearing in technical discussions of methods, estimates, algorithms, and the like. Segment 1 also contains the marked «or», but its context is a colloquial quotation and cannot be grouped with this pattern.

patterns.name: Rare spelling fragment in a name
patterns.context: The diacritic-bearing letter in the proper name Hořava; nearby text discusses gravitational theory.

patterns.name: Fragments in biomedical terms
patterns.context: Occurs in biomedical terms such as heptamer and hepatocytes; the two spellings differ and the trigger positions also differ.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and research text

patterns.name: Fragment in a colloquial quotation
patterns.context: Located in a colloquial expression in a quotation; the context concerns cheat day and is not clearly related to technical terms in other segments.

patterns.name: Fragment in a place name
patterns.context: Occurs in the Indian place name Sheopur, part of a bank branch name in a news report.

patterns.name: Fragment in a personal name
patterns.context: Occurs in a fragment of a name spelling in a byline or production credits; multiple adjacent fragments in the same name are also marked.

4_49.description: 激活散布于 heuristic(s)/heuristically 的 «ur»、Hořava 的 «ř»、heptamer/hepatocytes 的 «pt»，以及口语引语、地名和人名中的零散片段；除 «ur» 外难见共同语义或上下文。

patterns.name: heuristic 词内片段
patterns.context: 触发词为 heuristic(s)/heuristically，出现在方法、估计、算法等技术性论述中；第1段也出现被标注的 «or»，但上下文是口语引语，不能并入此模式。

patterns.name: 名字中的稀有拼写片段
patterns.context: 专名 Hořava 中的带变音符号字母；同段附近讨论引力理论。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在 heptamer 和 hepatocytes 这类生物医学术语中；两处拼写并不相同，触发位置也不同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要与研究文本

patterns.name: 口语引语中的片段
patterns.context: 位于引语中的口语表达，语境谈及 cheat day；与其他段落的技术术语不明显相关。

patterns.name: 地名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在印度地名 Sheopur 中，属于新闻报道中的银行分行名称。

patterns.name: 姓名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在署名或制作人员名单中的人名拼写片段；同一姓名还标注了相邻的多个片段。

en.concept: Within-word fragments with no shared semantics
en.description: Activations are scattered across internal fragments of various English words: pt, or, gem, ens, en, etc. They occur in medical terms, personal names, statistical methods, social science terms, and colloquial words, with no consistent semantic or domain condition.

patterns.name: English subword fragment hept
patterns.context: Embedded in the medical term heptamer, describing apoptosome structure.

patterns.name: Instrument word ending or
patterns.context: Occurs in spindle whorls, describing handcrafted objects.

patterns.name: Liver-related word fragment pt
patterns.context: Embedded in hepatocytes, in a context discussing alcohol, liver iron storage, and oxidative environments.

patterns.name: Word-stem fragment in hegemony
patterns.context: Occurs in a discussion of social order and the power of industrial leaders.

patterns.name: Variant of hegemony
patterns.context: Occurs in a discussion of masculinity and its cultural dominance.

patterns.name: Statistical term fragment ens
patterns.context: Occurs in the Mantel-Haenszel test or method name; used in survival analysis or meta-analysis.

patterns.name: Name fragment in a legal citation
patterns.context: Embedded in the case-citation name Hensley, near references to courts and case-citation formats.

patterns.name: or in an interjection
patterns.context: Embedded in the colloquial exclamation hooray, in social-media-style text.

patterns.name: Taxonomic name fragment en
patterns.context: Embedded in the name of the author Guénée in a moth taxonomy entry.

4_49.concept: 无共同语义的词内片段
4_49.description: 激活分散在多种英语词的内部片段：pt、or、gem、ens、en等；分别见医学术语、人名、统计方法、社会科学词及口语词，未显示一致语义或领域条件。

patterns.name: 英语子词片段 hept

patterns.name: hegemony 变体

patterns.name: 法律引文中的人名片段
patterns.context: 嵌在判例引用的人名 Hensley 中，附近还有法院与判例引文格式。

patterns.name: 感叹语中的 or

patterns.name: 分类学名称片段 en

en.description: Activation is distributed across various within-word fragments and formatting markers: surnames and personal names, the hegemony word family, interjections, sports and aerospace terms, k in toolkits, and punctuation in email fields. Apart from the same word family, there are no stable shared semantic or contextual conditions.

patterns.name: k in a compound for a toolkit

en.description: Activations mainly fall on short within-word letter fragments (ens, gem, or), and also on hyphens in different formats and a colon in an email field; contexts span legal, medical, social, code, font-description, and email text, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.context: A code comment describes the zombie field's protection from concurrent access; activation falls on and near the field name and its explanation.

4_238.concept: muddy 与 breast 词项及少数专名/字段
4_238.description: 激活主要集中在字面词 muddy（泥泞、浑浊或混淆）和医学语境中的 breast；另有邮件称呼 Ellen 与代码注释中的 zombie 字段。后两者难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: muddy 词项
patterns.context: 词项本身被直接标记；语义与上下文不固定，指泥泞、浑浊或使意见混乱。

patterns.name: 乳腺相关词项
patterns.context: 出现在乳腺癌、乳腺筛查或相关医学术语中；激活标记紧邻 breast。

patterns.name: Ellen 称呼
patterns.context: 邮件开头的感谢语“Thanks Ellen!!!”中，Ellen 是收件人或称呼。

patterns.name: 僵尸字段名
patterns.context: 代码注释描述并发访问保护的 zombie 字段；激活落在字段名及其说明附近。

en.description: Strong activations are distributed across “muddy,” several words beginning with Gl- (names, enzyme names, disease names), as well as email salutations/headers and the medical term “breast.” Apart from muddy, there is no apparent shared semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: Lexical trigger “muddy”
patterns.context: The word itself is marked, but surrounding contexts differ: it appears in pornographic descriptions, hiking conditions, political opinion, patent text about soil stains on cleaners, and river environments.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; includes online text, political commentary, patent text, and nature descriptions

patterns.name: Glen in a personal name
patterns.context: The beginning of a name is split and marked, followed by Duffie Shriver.

patterns.name: Glu in a biochemical term
patterns.context: The beginning of the term Gluco- is split and marked, followed by amylases.

patterns.name: Glau in a disease name
patterns.context: The beginning of the disease name glaucoma is marked in a sentence describing its ranking as a cause of blindness.

patterns.name: Email salutation and original header
patterns.context: An email begins with Thanks and addresses Ellen, followed by the original-message separator and email header.

patterns.name: breast in a medical phrase
patterns.context: The word appears in a quality-assurance phrase for a high-frequency ultrasound screening device.

4_238.description: 强激活分散于“muddy”、若干 Gl- 开头词（人名、酶名、疾病名），以及邮件称呼/邮件头和医学短语“breast”；除 muddy 外看不出统一语义或文体规律。

patterns.name: “muddy”的词汇触发
patterns.context: 该词本身被标记，前后语境不同；分别出现在色情描写、徒步路况、政治舆论、专利清洁剂土污、河流环境中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；含网络文本、政治评论、专利文本及自然描述

patterns.name: 人名中的 Glen
patterns.context: 姓名开头被拆分标记，后接 Duffie Shriver。

patterns.name: 生化术语中的 Glu
patterns.context: 术语开头 Gluco- 被拆分标记，后接 amylases。

patterns.name: 疾病名称中的 Glau
patterns.context: 疾病名 glaucoma 的开头被标记，句子说明其致盲原因排名。

patterns.name: 邮件称呼及原邮件头
patterns.context: 邮件以 Thanks 开头并称呼 Ellen，随后出现原邮件分隔线及邮件头。

patterns.name: 医学短语中的 breast
patterns.context: 词语出现在高频超声筛查设备的质量保证短语中。

en.concept: Initial subword tokens of capitalized words
en.description: Activations fall mainly on the initial subwords Wire and Gl of capitalized words; the Ellen salutation in an email and Similar at the beginning of a medical abstract sentence also trigger. The examples span domains, but the initial-word pattern is relatively clear.

patterns.name: Initial subword Wire
patterns.context: Begins with a capital W, followed by bonding or combined with less to form wireless; activation is concentrated on the initial subword.

patterns.name: Initial subword Gl
patterns.context: Begins with a capital G and is followed by text forming proper names, enzyme names, glaucoma, or glossary; all trigger positions are at the beginning of the word.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, patents, Pile-CC, and NIH text

patterns.name: Ellen in an email salutation
patterns.context: A name used as a salutation after “Thanks” and before the exclamation marks and email-forwarding marker.

patterns.name: Similar in a medical comparison phrase
patterns.context: A comparative statement at the beginning of a sentence, followed by mention of blood glucose control.

4_238.description: 激活主要落在大写词首子词元 Wire 和 Gl；此外，邮件中的 Ellen 称呼及医学摘要句首 Similar 也触发。样例跨领域，词首模式较明确。

patterns.name: 词首 Wire 子词元
patterns.context: 大写 W 开头，后接 bonding 或与 less 拼成 wireless；激活集中在词首子词元。

patterns.name: 词首 Gl 子词元
patterns.context: 大写 G 开头，后续组成专名、酶名、glaucoma 或 glossary；触发位置均在词首。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、专利、Pile-CC、NIH 文本

patterns.name: 邮件称呼中的 Ellen
patterns.context: 感谢语“Thanks”之后、感叹号和邮件转发标记之前的人名称呼。

patterns.name: 医学比较短语 Similar
patterns.context: 句首比较性表述，随后提及血糖控制。

en.description: Responds to local formatting and fragments across multiple text types: ASCII art, code comments and macros, JSON/Notebook content, license boilerplate, email openings, dialogue, and unusually segmented Polish. No single semantic theme covers them all.

patterns.name: ASCII art and vertical-bar borders
patterns.context: Large figures or borders made of multiple lines of monospaced characters; activations concentrate on vertical bars, backslashes, underscores, and figure edges

patterns.name: Code comments and field descriptions
patterns.context: Consecutive code comments and field descriptions explaining control flow or item counts

patterns.name: Macro definitions and hexadecimal constants
patterns.context: Consecutive definitions of command identifiers and their constant values

patterns.name: Notebook JSON and natural-language source text
patterns.context: Markdown cells and their English content within a JSON structure

patterns.name: License disclaimers
patterns.context: Capitalized disclaimers, license names, and standard legal phrasing in license text

patterns.name: Dialogue text in chat corpora
patterns.context: Second-person conversational dialogue embedded in the JSON field dynamic_line

patterns.name: Email greeting and forwarded-message separator
patterns.context: A greeting and thanks at the beginning of an email, immediately followed by the original-message separator

patterns.name: Unusually segmented Polish text
patterns.context: Words are split into unnatural fragments, possibly at tokenization or encoding boundaries; context is insufficient

4_238.concept: 局部格式与文本片段特征
4_238.description: 响应多类文本中的局部格式与片段：ASCII图形、代码注释和宏、JSON/Notebook内容、许可证套语、邮件开头、对话及异常切分的波兰语。没有单一语义主题可涵盖全部。

patterns.name: ASCII图形与竖线边框
patterns.context: 多行等宽字符构成大型图形或边框；激活集中在竖线、反斜杠、下划线和图形边缘

patterns.name: 代码注释与字段说明
patterns.context: 代码中的连续注释和字段说明，注释解释流程控制或条目数量

patterns.name: 宏定义与十六进制常量
patterns.context: 连续定义命令标识符及其常量值

patterns.name: Notebook JSON及自然语言源文本
patterns.trigger: “cell_type”: “markdown”“source”: [“You can test and deploy new models”
patterns.context: JSON结构中的Markdown单元及其英文正文

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明
patterns.trigger: “MERCHANTABILITY”“FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE”“GNU General Public License”
patterns.context: 许可证正文中的大写免责声明、许可名称及标准法律措辞

patterns.name: 聊天语料中的对话文本
patterns.trigger: “You’re new here, who the hell put”
patterns.context: JSON字段 dynamic_line 内嵌的第二人称口语对话

patterns.name: 邮件致意及转发分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件开头的称呼感谢语，紧接原始邮件分隔标记

patterns.name: 异常切分的波兰语文本
patterns.trigger: “Otw arc ie pos ied zen ia”“Pr z ew od”
patterns.context: 词被切成不自然的片段，可能是分词或编码边界；缺乏足够语境

en.description: Activations are distributed across local fragments in heterogeneous text: email contacts, fixed-width country-number tables, source-code identifiers and demuxer code, encoded strings, medical titles, and English titles and formatting boundaries in novels, legal documents, and emails; no stable unifying semantics are apparent.

patterns.name: English fragments and paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Words, punctuation, and newline combinations in English titles, notices, emails, and similar text; trigger positions vary and do not form a stable lexical theme.
patterns.domain: Email, novel text/table of contents, legal documents

patterns.name: Email addresses and contact fields
patterns.context: Email recipients, names, email addresses, and other contact information; activations fall on local substrings of addresses or names.

patterns.name: Aligned country and number tables
patterns.context: Country names and numeric columns appear side by side in multiple lines of space-padded, fixed-width data; activations also fall on short substrings within rows.

patterns.name: C/C++ identifiers and bitwise code
patterns.context: Source-code statements composed of variables, macros, function names, and shift operations.

patterns.name: Demux errors and return values in code
patterns.context: Error formatting, object initialization, and Boolean return statements; demuxer-related substrings recur.

patterns.name: Encoded random strings
patterns.context: Long strings made up of hard-to-read alphanumeric fragments, likely encoded or serialized data; only local character combinations stand out.

patterns.name: Medical implant title
patterns.context: Clinical terminology in a medical paper title; activations concentrate on several split word fragments.

4_238.description: 激活分布在异质文本的局部片段：邮件联系人、定宽国家数字表、源码标识符与 demuxer 代码、编码字符串、医学标题，以及小说/法律/邮件中的英文标题和格式边界；未见稳定统一语义。

patterns.name: 英语片段及段落边界
patterns.trigger: “Thanks Ellen!!!↵↵ -----Original Message-----”“CHAPTER XXX.”“RECOMMENDED FOR FULL-TEXT PUBLICATION”
patterns.context: 英文标题、通知或邮件等文本中的词语、标点与换行组合；触发位置并不一致，也未形成稳定词汇主题。
patterns.domain: 邮件、小说正文/目录、法律文档

patterns.name: 邮件地址与联系人字段
patterns.context: 邮件收件人、姓名及邮箱地址等联系人信息；激活落在地址/姓名的局部子串上。

patterns.name: 对齐的国家与数字表格
patterns.context: 空格填充的多行定宽数据中，国家名称与数字列并排出现；激活也落在行内短子串上。

patterns.name: C/C++ 标识符与位运算代码
patterns.context: 变量、宏、函数名与移位运算组成的源代码语句。

patterns.name: 代码中的 demux 错误与返回值
patterns.context: 错误格式化、对象初始化和布尔式返回语句；demuxer 相关子串反复出现。

patterns.name: 编码后的随机字符串
patterns.context: 由不易读的字母数字片段构成、疑似编码或序列化数据的长字符串；仅局部字符组合显著。

patterns.name: 医学植入物标题
patterns.trigger: “Three-piece Penile Prosthesis Implantation in Refractory Ischemic Priapism”
patterns.context: 医学论文题名中的临床术语；激活集中于若干被切分的词片段。

en.description: Activations often fall on within-word letter fragments, word endings, or proper-name fragments, commonly in French word forms but also in random letter strings, English titles, email salutations, and academic names and formulas. Trigger positions vary across domains and are unstable; some strong fragments cannot be explained by a shared semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: French word endings and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations often fall on letter strings or subword fragments within words; sometimes they cross word boundaries or connect with adjacent words. They are especially prominent in French contexts, but also occur in English, random letter sequences, and names.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains; [2][3][6] are mathematics problems, [4] product text, [9] news headlines, [10] French parliamentary text

patterns.name: Salutations, names, and email openings
patterns.context: Strong activations occur near names or salutations; [1] is an email recipient salutation after a thank-you, and [10] is the name of a parliamentary speaker.

patterns.name: Letter strings and strings in sampling problems
patterns.context: Sequences of random letters and probability-problem descriptions about them; activations fall on letters, letter strings, and a few words in the problem statements, but do not cover all strings or mathematical terms in the problems.

patterns.name: Within-word or title fragments in English
patterns.context: Activations occur in English titles, word fragments, or hyphenated expressions. Positions vary, and the two news headlines do not show a consistent pattern.
patterns.domain: HackerNews news headlines and link text

patterns.name: Academic proper names and formula symbols
patterns.context: Activations fall on author names in references, text near years, and proper names or formula symbols in mathematics papers; not every symbol within either passage triggers.

4_238.concept: 词内及跨边界字母片段
4_238.description: 激活多落在词内字母片段、词尾或专名片段，常见于法语词形，也出现在随机字母串、英语标题、邮件称呼及学术姓名和公式中；触发位置跨领域且不稳定，部分强片段无法由统一语义或文体解释。

patterns.name: 法语词尾及词内片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在词内的字母串或子词片段上；有时跨越词边界或与前后词连在一起。法语语境中尤其显著，但也出现在英语、随机字母序列和名字中。
patterns.domain: 多领域；[2][3][6]为数学题，[4]产品文本，[9]新闻标题，[10]法语议会文本

patterns.name: 称呼姓名与邮件开头
patterns.context: 姓名或称呼附近出现较强激活；[1]是感谢语后的邮件收件人称呼，[10]是议会发言人的姓名。

patterns.name: 字母串与抽样题中的字符串
patterns.context: 随机字母组成的序列及其概率题描述中，激活落在字母、字母串和少量题干词上；但不覆盖题目中的所有字母串或数学词。

patterns.name: 英语词内或标题片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在英语标题、词语片段或连字符构成的表达中，位置不固定，也没有在两个新闻标题间一致出现。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 新闻标题与链接文本

patterns.name: 学术专名与公式符号
patterns.context: 激活落在参考文献中的作者名、年份相邻文本，以及数学论文中的专名或公式符号；两段内部也并非每个符号都触发。

en.description: High activations are distributed across local fragments in multilingual word forms, proper names, and code identifiers: adi, mat, op, pare, Mir, É, B, Dr, etc. Apart from pare recurring in two contexts expressing opinions, there is no shared semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: adi in a compound name
patterns.context: Appears in the proper name “Imam Sadiq University,” where the characters are tokenized as “S” and “adi”; Imam, q, University, and other fragments are also marked.

patterns.name: Maturity-related word fragment
patterns.context: Occurs within the Italian word “maturata” (matured, accumulated over time); the surrounding text discusses revising practices based on implementation experience.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Require
patterns.context: In JavaScript code, it is within the identifier “_interopRequireWildcard,” surrounded by module exports and an interoperability helper function.

patterns.name: pare word form
patterns.context: Appears in Italian “Mi pare che…” (I think that…) and Spanish “nos parecía que…” (we thought that…); both contexts express an opinion or an appearance.
patterns.domain: European Parliament Italian text, PhilPapers Spanish philosophy text

patterns.name: Name fragment Miró
patterns.context: In the Spanish proper name “Joan Miró,” the word is split into Mir and ó; the same name is repeated in the passage.

patterns.name: mat fragment related to enrollment size
patterns.context: At the beginning of “matrícula” (enrollment, student count) in a Spanish institutional history, followed by the historical maximum number of students.

patterns.name: Place name Étraye
patterns.context: The French place name “Étraye” appears twice at the beginning of the passage, followed by an English Wikipedia-style description identifying it as a commune.

patterns.name: Place name Biqueley
patterns.context: The French place name “Biqueley” appears at the beginning of the passage, followed by an English Wikipedia-style description identifying it as a commune.

patterns.name: Drinfeld name fragment
patterns.context: At the beginning of the proper name “Drinfeld” in a mathematics paper; the context discusses quantum algebras and their current realizations.

4_238.description: 高激活分散在多语种词形、专名及代码标识符的局部片段中：adi、mat、op、pare、Mir、É、B、Dr 等；除 pare 在两段表达看法的语境重复外，没有统一的语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 复合词中的 adi
patterns.context: 出现在专名 “Imam Sadiq University” 中，字符被分词为 “S” 与 “adi”；前后还标记了 Imam、q、University 等片段。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科机构条目

patterns.name: 成熟相关词片段
patterns.context: 意大利语政策句中，出现在 “maturata”（成熟、积累而成）内部；附近谈到基于实施经验修订做法。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语文本

patterns.name: Require 的内部片段
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中，位于标识符 “_interopRequireWildcard” 内，周围是模块导出与互操作辅助函数。

patterns.name: pare 词形
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语 “Mi pare che…”（我认为……）及西班牙语 “nos parecía que…”（我们觉得……）中；都是表达看法或显得如此的语境。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语文本、PhilPapers 西班牙语哲学文本

patterns.name: 艺术家姓氏 Miró
patterns.context: 西班牙语专名 “Joan Miró” 中，词被切分为 Mir 与 ó；同一名字在段内重复出现。
patterns.domain: 维基百科艺术家基金会条目

patterns.name: 招生规模相关 mat 片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语机构史叙述中，位于 “matrícula”（注册人数、招生规模）一词开头，随后给出历史最高人数。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 西班牙语机构介绍

patterns.name: 地名 Étraye
patterns.context: 法国地名 “Étraye” 在段首出现两次，随后以英文维基百科句式介绍其为 commune。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科地理条目

patterns.name: 地名 Biqueley
patterns.context: 法国地名 “Biqueley” 在段首出现，随后以英文维基百科句式介绍其为 commune。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科地理条目

patterns.name: Drinfeld 名称片段
patterns.context: 数学论文中，位于专名 “Drinfeld” 的开头；上下文讨论量子代数及其 current realizations。

en.description: Markers are scattered across the string man in multiple languages, English function words, code identifiers, and numbers and punctuation; French word forms, place names, and isolated webpage words also occur. There is no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: man string and its word forms
patterns.context: The character sequence man is marked; in paragraphs 5 and 7 it occurs within Italian words, in paragraph 8 at the beginning of maniera, and in paragraph 10 at the beginning of mano.

patterns.name: English noun phrases
patterns.context: English function words are marked in ordinary English sentences across paper abstracts, forum help posts, and code comments; the marked words do not always belong to the same category.
patterns.domain: Academic text, forum text, code comments

patterns.name: Code identifiers and API names
patterns.context: Some tokens in camelCase class names, function names, or API identifiers are marked.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in structured sequences or proper names
patterns.context: Numbers, slashes, commas, or separators are marked near formulas, version strings, or text boundaries.

patterns.name: Possible word-final fragments
patterns.context: Two adjacent line-initial words are marked, but there is not enough context to determine their semantics or shared lexical condition.

patterns.name: French word-form fragments
patterns.context: In continuous French prose, markers fall on split word-form fragments; no broader semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: English proper names and place names
patterns.context: A place-name fragment is marked in an encyclopedia account of Sonoma, California, and its wine industry.

patterns.name: Fragments without a clear shared trigger
patterns.context: Multiple markers occur near the identifier FakeAutoscalingV2beta1, but the fragment does not reveal how it relates to other patterns.

4_238.description: 标记散落于跨语种的 man 字符串、英文功能词、代码标识符及数字标点；另见法语词形、地名和孤立网页词。没有单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: man 字符串及其词形
patterns.context: 字符序列 man 被标记；在第5、7段出现在意大利语单词内部，在第8段位于 maniera 的开头，在第10段位于 mano 的开头。
patterns.domain: 意大利语及其他多语种文本

patterns.name: 英文名词短语
patterns.context: 英文功能词在普通英文句子中被标记，分布于论文摘要、论坛求助帖和代码注释；标记并不总是出现在同一类词上。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、论坛文本、代码注释

patterns.name: 代码标识符与 API 名称
patterns.context: 驼峰命名的类名、函数名或 API 标识符中部分 token 被标记。

patterns.name: 结构化序列或专名中的数字/标点
patterns.context: 数字、斜线、逗号或分隔符处于公式、版本字符串或文本边界附近时出现标记。

patterns.name: 疑似词尾片段
patterns.context: 两个相邻行首词被标记，缺少足够上下文判断其语义或共同词法条件。

patterns.name: 法语词形片段
patterns.context: 法语连续散文中，标记落在被分词拆开的词形片段上；更广的语义触发条件不明显。

patterns.name: 英语专名与地名
patterns.context: 加州索诺玛及其葡萄酒产业的百科叙述中，地名片段被标记。

patterns.name: 未见清晰共同触发的片段
patterns.context: FakeAutoscalingV2beta1 标识符附近出现多个标记，但无法从片段确定其与其他模式的关系。

en.description: Responds to Python import statements and code identifiers, as well as Laravel authentication symbols, LaTeX coordinate notation, HTTP API names, and webpage links; no single surface trigger form explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Python import statements

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematics and coordinate symbols

patterns.name: External blog link

Only URL-related activations appear in segment 5, insufficient to identify a more specific pattern.

patterns.name: Suffix fragments within words
patterns.context: Activations often fall within or at the end of words rather than on whole words; they occur across ordinary text, code, and proper names.

patterns.name: URL and domain components

patterns.domain: Web pages, HackerNews, and command-line text

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax fragments
patterns.context: Class names, identifiers, and punctuation in code examples; also includes protocol headers and their values in command-line requests.

patterns.name: GBS letter sequence
patterns.context: The uppercase abbreviation GBS; one instance is a disease abbreviation and another is a sequencing-method abbreviation.

patterns.name: Cookery/cooking word forms

patterns.name: Patent and trademark terms

patterns.name: Scattered triggers such as connectives and forms of address

en.description: Activations occur at local positions in various code identifiers, URL domain fragments, and verb complements or prepositional phrases in natural language, and are often near punctuation and tokenization boundaries; the examples lack a single clear semantic interpretation.

patterns.name: Sentence-final source or complement

patterns.name: Code identifiers and attribute access

patterns.name: Postposed prepositions and structural boundaries

4_238.concept: 局部结构边界与补足语
4_238.description: 激活见于多种代码标识符、URL 域名片段及自然语言中动词补足语或介词短语的局部位置，也常靠近标点和分词边界；各例缺乏单一明确语义。

patterns.name: 句末来源或补足成分
patterns.trigger: “got it”后面的 “from”（2、3）；“get it”后面的 “from”（8）；“expect him to”附近的 “him”；以及 “him to”
patterns.context: 句子中出现动词后接代词或名词补足语，尤其是介词短语或不定式延续；这些例子中较强激活常落在局部短语末尾。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 版权条款、StackExchange 技术说明、Pile-CC 叙事文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符及属性访问
patterns.context: 代码片段中的类、方法、异常、变量或模块名；部分激活落在标识符内部的子词或标点边界，未见统一的语义角色。
patterns.domain: GitHub、StackExchange 中的 C#/Python 等代码

patterns.name: URL 与域名片段

patterns.context: 词语或表达式边界附近；可能反映局部句法/分词边界，但跨自然语言和代码，证据不足以确定具体规律。

en.description: Activations occur in heterogeneous text about refund permissions, legal proceedings, novels, private emails, code, mathematics papers, medical disclaimers, and user complaints. Common markers include pronouns, articles, and relative clauses; local semantics involving requesting or providing things and procedural remedies also appear. There is no sufficiently consistent single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Function words and personal pronouns
patterns.context: Common function words appear in sentences or clauses; these words are marked in multiple passages, but neighboring words and syntactic positions vary

patterns.name: Relative clauses and reference
patterns.context: Refers to a person or thing mentioned earlier, or links events through relative or conditional clauses

patterns.name: Obtaining, providing, or requesting something
patterns.context: Describes asking for, obtaining, providing, or applying for an item, assistance, refund, or legal remedy; the specific trigger words vary across examples
patterns.domain: E-book license text, novels, legal documents, online discussions

patterns.name: Rights and procedures in legal or license text
patterns.context: Involves refund conditions, court applications, injunctions, or procedural rights; common function words such as “the” and “her” are also marked

patterns.name: Technical names and code structure
patterns.context: An example URL is followed by ASP.NET route attributes and a controller class definition; activations fall on code markers and identifier fragments

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions and the Dirichlet problem
patterns.context: A weak-form or test-function formula is followed by the introduction of a harmonic-function boundary-value problem; marked words include “C,” “Dirichlet,” “problem,” and “functions”

patterns.name: Family visits and personal relationships
patterns.context: An email discusses spending time with the recipient, visiting parents, and family news

patterns.name: Medical disclaimer and seeking professional advice
patterns.context: A website states that its information is not intended for diagnosis or treatment and recommends consulting a doctor; markers concentrate on words such as “information” and “advice”

patterns.name: Magical objects in a narrative
patterns.context: In a fantasy plot, a character hands over a magic spell or an old wand; “her” and narrative connectives also activate

patterns.name: Warranty service and credit-card documents

patterns.name: 虚词与人称代词

en.description: Activations do not reflect a single semantic category: they are concentrated mainly on Controller class names and getter declarations in framework code; other examples include expect/results in a technical explanation, you/got and refund vocabulary in an ebook refund clause, and JNI's GetMethodID.

patterns.name: Controller class names
patterns.context: controller occurs in web framework examples, class names, or class references, often with framework, function, or language markers; activations are concentrated on Controller and nearby class-name fragments.

patterns.name: get methods and method names

patterns.name: Results/expectations expressions

patterns.name: Pronouns and acquisition verb in ebook refund clauses

patterns.name: JNI method ID code
patterns.context: JNI/C++ code obtains a Java method ID through env, near class/global reference operations.

4_238.concept: 代码标识符与方法名片段

en.description: Strong activation appears in Controller, routes, and function parentheses in Web code, as well as the internal m in the Dutch word “sommige”; isolated words and phrases such as it, probable cause, and effect also trigger activation across programming, dialogue, legal, and patent contexts.

patterns.name: Controller class names and routes

patterns.domain: Web development code and programming Q&A

patterns.name: Method-call parentheses

patterns.name: Miscellaneous code structures and punctuation
patterns.context: Near braces, semicolons, or angle brackets in code snippets; these local triggers show no shared condition more specific than code context.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a Dutch word
patterns.context: In continuous Dutch text, the subword fragment m occurs inside “sommige” (some); the word appears in both passages, but the surrounding topics differ.

patterns.name: Local context for English it
patterns.context: In English dialogue, the pronoun it occurs between got and right, expressing a colloquial confirmation of “whether I understand correctly.”

patterns.name: Legal term cause
patterns.context: Paired with probable in legal discussion to form probable cause; the passages also discuss searches and evidence.

patterns.name: Repeated occurrence of effect

4_238.description: 强激活见于 Web 代码中的 Controller、路由与函数括号，也见于荷兰语“sommige”的词内 m；另有 it、probable cause、effect 等孤立词句触发，覆盖多种编程、对话、法律和专利语境。

en.concept: The string get and getter declarations
en.description: Most code excerpts highlight parameterless methods beginning with get in PHP/Java, along with their method names, parentheses, and accessor structure; there are also the letter sequence get inside ordinary French words, get right in an insurance context, and scattered activations on platform macros and code identifiers, which do not all fit the same pattern.

patterns.name: PHP getter method declarations

patterns.name: Class members and accessor structure around getters

patterns.name: The letter sequence get in French words

patterns.name: The English collocation get right
patterns.context: get means to obtain or choose when advising readers to compare insurance quotes and choose insurance suited to their circumstances.
