patterns.name: Java-style getter
patterns.context: A parameterless public static method in a Java class, with a name beginning with get and returning a default-type list.

patterns.name: PHP getArgumentCount/getMargin naming
patterns.context: Parameterless methods beginning with get in a PHP class, retrieving the argument count and margin, respectively; activation highlights the method declarations.

patterns.name: Identifiers and code words that deviate from the main pattern
patterns.context: Platform macros or words related to enums/return values occur in code snippets; activations are scattered outside method declarations, with no clear relationship to getters.

4_238.concept: get 字符串与 getter 声明
4_238.description: 多数代码段突出 PHP/Java 中 get 开头的无参方法声明及其方法名、括号和访问器结构；另有法语普通词中的 get 字母序列、保险语境的 get right，以及少量平台宏和代码标识符激活，不能完全归入同一模式。

patterns.name: PHP getter 方法声明
patterns.context: PHP 类中声明无参数、通常以 get 开头的方法；激活集中在 get 与方法名、空括号及声明附近。
patterns.domain: Github/StackExchange 上的 PHP 源码

patterns.name: getter 周边的类成员与访问器结构
patterns.context: getter 方法体或相邻代码中出现对象属性访问、返回语句、方法边界；这些标记也可能是主模式的代码结构背景。
patterns.domain: 面向对象源码（以 PHP 为主，也有 Java）

patterns.name: 法语词中的 get 字母序列
patterns.context: 法语医学或学术文本中，get 字母序列出现在普通词内部，并非英文 get 方法。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学文本、法语学术论文

patterns.name: 英语 get right 搭配
patterns.context: 劝告读者比较保险报价、选择适合自身情况的保险时，get 表示取得或选到。

patterns.name: 其他代码中 get 的方法名用法
patterns.context: PHP 方法声明中，get 后接 TabUrl，形式与 getter 相近，但片段不足以确认其返回属性。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的 PHP 代码

patterns.name: 代码中的 get 名称与语言框架约定
patterns.context: PHP 类方法名采用 GetName、getAction 等访问器式命名；片段分别涉及表单名称和 action 属性。

patterns.name: Java 风格 getter
patterns.context: Java 类中的 public static 无参方法，名称以 get 开头并返回默认类型列表。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Java 源码

patterns.name: PHP getArgumentCount/getMargin 命名
patterns.context: PHP 类内以 get 开头的无参方法，分别取得参数数量和 margin；激活突出方法声明。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 PHP 源码

patterns.name: 偏离主模式的标识符与代码词
patterns.context: 代码片段中出现平台宏或枚举/返回值相关词；激活分散于方法声明之外，无法确定与 getter 的关系。

en.concept: Understanding expressions and code method structures
en.description: Activation is most prominent in “get the idea” and similar expressions of understanding, and also appears in code method names, empty parameter lists, and braces. Other sporadic activations include pronouns, punctuation, place names, and code snippets, with no single unifying rule.

patterns.name: “get the idea” expression
patterns.context: In English narratives or discussions, the precedes idea, often expressing understanding, explanation, or an example; idea itself and neighboring words are marked.
patterns.domain: Forums, comments, and general English text

patterns.name: Pronouns such as it / this and syntactic elements
patterns.context: Pronouns, determiners, and ordinary syntactic elements are distributed across English sentences; some occur near phrases such as get and customer decisions, but not consistently.

patterns.name: PHP method definitions, parentheses, and braces
patterns.context: In class method declarations, the get method name and the immediately following empty parameter list, newline/indentation, or left brace are activated.

patterns.name: Java empty-object construction and methods
patterns.context: Java code constructing the EMPTY constant and the getEmpty() method; marking spans identifier fragments, parentheses, and braces.

patterns.name: Other code symbols and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Semicolons, newlines, object properties, types, and method-name fragments in code are marked; they do not fully overlap with the specific method patterns above.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on word fragments and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation falls on place names, subword fragments within words, or parentheses, without sufficiently consistent semantic context.
patterns.domain: Template text, place-name lists, and forum text

patterns.name: right / got it in conversational contexts
patterns.context: In forum replies, it/right are activated next to each other when confirming whether something was understood correctly; semantically similar to “get the idea” but worded differently.

4_238.concept: 理解表达及代码方法结构
4_238.description: 激活最显著地出现在“get the idea”及相近的理解表达，也出现在代码方法名、空参数括号和花括号；另有代词、标点、地名与代码片段等零散激活，不能归为单一规则。

patterns.name: “get the idea”表达
patterns.context: 在英语叙述或讨论中，idea 前有 the，常表达理解、说明或举例；idea 本身及其前后词被标记。
patterns.domain: 论坛、评论和一般英语文本

patterns.name: it / this 等代词及句法成分
patterns.context: 代词、限定词和普通句法成分散布于英语句子中；部分与 get、客户决策等短语相邻，但并不总是如此。

patterns.name: PHP 方法定义及括号、花括号
patterns.context: 类方法声明中，get 方法名及紧随其后的空参数括号、换行/缩进或左花括号受到激活。

patterns.name: Java 空对象构造与方法
patterns.context: Java 代码中 EMPTY 常量的构造和 getEmpty() 方法；标记横跨标识符片段、括号和花括号。

patterns.name: 其他代码符号和标识符片段
patterns.context: 代码中分号、换行、对象属性、类型及方法名片段被标记；与上述特定方法模式不完全重合。

patterns.name: 单词片段及标点的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活落在地名、单词内部子词片段或括号等局部 token 上，没有足够一致的语义上下文。
patterns.domain: 模板文本、地名列表及论坛文本

patterns.name: 会话语境中的 right / got it
patterns.context: 论坛回复中，表达确认是否正确理解时，it/right 相邻受激活；与“get the idea”语义相近但措辞不同。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across local strings such as get the idea, questions about reasonable, mathematical terminology, Controller class names, right + noun, and Sobolev spaces; no single semantic category covers all examples.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “get the idea”
patterns.context: get is followed by the idea, with idea at the end of a sentence or clause; in the two examples, the surrounding text expresses understanding or evaluation.

patterns.name: Reasonableness and scope with reasonable
patterns.context: Asks whether a situation is reasonable or asks about reasonable equity ranges; surrounding context includes questions such as “or not” and “for this situation”.

patterns.name: Equation terms in mathematical equation names
patterns.context: Occurs after mathematical equation names such as Korteweg-de Vries; the same passage also lists other equations and their solutions.

patterns.name: Controller class identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs in PHP/Symfony or Java controller class names, annotations, or inheritance declarations; may be a suffix within an identifier or a standalone class-name component.

patterns.name: Nearby variants of getting an idea
patterns.context: One occurs in a comment about hardware inference; another occurs in an explanation of calculating displayed frames by the number of functional dishes. Both have a get the + noun structure but different meanings.
patterns.domain: HackerNews and GitHub technical discussions/code comments

patterns.name: right collocating with nouns
patterns.context: right modifies a following noun, referring respectively to correctly displayed frames and insurance suited to an individual's circumstances; the latter also occurs in a recommendation to compare quotes.
patterns.domain: GitHub code comments and Pile-CC insurance text

patterns.name: Sobolev spaces in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Academic reference to higher-order Sobolev spaces, near formulas and function-space notation.

4_238.description: 强激活分散在 get the idea、reasonable 提问、数学术语、Controller 类名、right+名词及 Sobolev spaces 等局部词串中；没有一个单一语义能覆盖全部例子。

patterns.name: “get the idea”固定短语
patterns.trigger: “get»2« the»6« idea»10”（第1段）；“get»1« the»5« idea»9”（第2段）
patterns.context: get 后接 the idea，idea 为句尾或小句末尾；两例中短语前后分别出现表达理解或评价的内容。

patterns.name: 合理性与范围的 reasonable
patterns.context: 询问某情形是否合理，或询问合理的 equity ranges；周围出现“or not”“for this situation”等提问语境。

patterns.name: 数学方程名称中的方程词
patterns.context: 出现在 Korteweg-de Vries 等数学方程名称之后；同段还列出其他方程及其解。

patterns.name: Controller 类标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP/Symfony 或 Java 控制器类名、注解或继承声明中；可能是标识符内部后缀或独立类名部分。

patterns.name: 得到想法的相邻变体
patterns.context: 前者位于对硬件推断的评论中；后者位于按功能 dish 数量计算显示帧的说明中，均有 get the + 名词结构，但含义不同。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、GitHub 技术讨论/代码注释

patterns.name: right 搭配名词
patterns.context: right 修饰后续名词，分别指正确显示帧、适合个人情况的保险；后者还处于建议比较报价的语境。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码注释、Pile-CC 保险说明

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 Sobolev spaces
patterns.context: 公式及函数空间符号附近，作为高阶 Sobolev 空间的学术表述。

en.description: Activation covers several local patterns: bron/chi subwords in pulmonary terminology; the hn’s spelling fragment in Crohn’s; mathematical equation names and equation; C# empty parameter lists, keywords, and test markers; as well as s in Results markers and EE in sample code HEE.

patterns.name: Bronchial / pulmonary terminology
patterns.context: Trigger words occur in contexts involving lung-lobe anatomy, airways, pulmonary examinations, or ventilation; token boundaries may fall within subwords such as bron and chi.
patterns.domain: Medicine, pulmonary anatomy, and respiratory physiology

patterns.name: Crohn’s disease spelling fragment
patterns.context: In the name Crohn’s disease, activation concentrates on the cross-subword spelling fragment hn’s; the same passage may mention inflammatory disease or transcription-factor associations.

patterns.name: Periodic solutions and equation names
patterns.context: Occurs in discussion of equations such as Korteweg–de Vries, Sine-Gordon, and nonlinear Schrödinger, and their periodic or quasi-periodic solutions.

patterns.name: C# method-call parentheses
patterns.context: An empty parameter list immediately follows a method name; code may also contain a method body, return value, or thrown exception.

patterns.name: Test attributes and test class names
patterns.context: Occurs in Angular integration test class names and test fixture attributes.

patterns.name: Capital S in results headings
patterns.context: Occurs in section-like anchors or formatting markers following a paper’s Results heading; the marker itself contains several numbers.

patterns.name: Code keywords and structural symbols
patterns.context: Occurs in C# method definitions and method bodies; these markers also appear alongside the empty parameter list in segment 3.

patterns.name: Fragment in the name of a reporting institution
patterns.context: Occurs in a sample-code prefix, near PCR, BAL, and public-health institution information.

4_238.concept: 局部子词与代码标记触发
4_238.description: 激活覆盖多个局部模式：肺部术语中的 bron/chi 子词；Crohn’s 的 hn’s 拼写片段；数学方程名与 equation；C# 空参数列表、关键字及测试标记；另有 Results 标记中的 s 和样本号 HEE 中的 EE。

patterns.name: 支气管／肺部术语
patterns.context: 触发词出现在肺叶解剖、气道、肺部检查或通气等上下文；分词边界会落在 bron、chi 等子词上。
patterns.domain: 医学、肺部解剖与呼吸生理

patterns.name: Crohn’s disease 拼写片段
patterns.trigger: «hn»«s»，位于 Cro«hn»’«s» 或 Cro«hn»"«s» 中
patterns.context: Crohn’s disease 名称中，激活集中在 hn’s 的跨子词拼写片段；同段还出现炎症性疾病或转录因子关联语境。

patterns.name: 周期解及方程名称
patterns.context: 出现在 Korteweg–de Vries、Sine-Gordon、非线性 Schrödinger 等方程及其周期或准周期解的讨论中。

patterns.name: C# 方法调用括号
patterns.context: 方法名后紧接空参数列表括号；代码中还可见方法体、返回值或异常抛出。

patterns.name: 测试属性与测试类名
patterns.context: 出现在 Angular 集成测试类名和测试夹具属性中。

patterns.name: 结果标题中的大写 S
patterns.trigger: «s»，位于大写 Results 后的花括号标题标记中
patterns.context: 出现在论文 Results 标题后的类似章节锚点或格式标记里，标记本身含有多个数字。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文排版文本

patterns.name: 代码关键字与结构符号
patterns.context: 出现在 C# 方法定义及方法体中；这些标记也与段3的空参数列表共同出现。

patterns.name: 报告机构名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在样本编号前缀中，邻近 PCR、BAL 和公共卫生机构信息。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on tokenized fragments of bronchial-related words, and also occur in fragments of proper names such as Chagas and Aguascalientes; there are also scattered activations on code class names, mathematical terminology, and biographical text, with no unified semantics covering all fragments.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in bronchial terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on stems or tokenized fragments of bronchus, bronchioles, and related medical terms; these occur in contexts involving anatomy, ventilation, infection, and pneumonia.

patterns.name: Chagas fragment in proper names
patterns.context: Activations occur on tokenized fragments of the disease name Chagas and the Mexican place name Aguascalientes; the former appears in an infectious-disease medical context, the latter as an automobile assembly location.

patterns.name: Priority queue code
patterns.context: Fragments of a C# generic class name and adjacent symbols are activated in the class name and its instantiation code.

patterns.name: Mathematical equations and function-space expressions
patterns.context: Activations occur around discussions and formulas concerning partial differential equations, periodic solutions, and Sobolev spaces.

patterns.name: Fragment activations in proper names and word forms
patterns.context: Activations occur on a surname fragment and nearby descriptions of a music career in a biography; no clear shared semantics with the other patterns.

4_238.concept: 词语内部片段与术语片段
4_238.description: 激活主要集中在支气管相关词的分词片段，也出现在 Chagas 与 Aguascalientes 等专名片段；另有代码类名、数学术语和人物传记中的零散激活，未见统一语义能覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: 支气管词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在支气管、细支气管及相关医学术语的词干或分词片段上；出现在解剖描述、通气、感染和肺炎等上下文。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Chagas 片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 Chagas 病名以及墨西哥地名 Aguascalientes 的分词片段上；前者是感染病医学语境，后者是汽车装配地点。

patterns.name: 优先队列代码
patterns.context: C# 泛型类名及其实例化代码中，类名各片段和相邻符号均有激活。

patterns.name: 数学方程与函数空间表达
patterns.context: 激活出现在偏微分方程、周期解和 Sobolev 空间的数学论述及公式周围。
patterns.domain: 数学与 ArXiv 学术文本

patterns.name: 专名及词形中的片段激活
patterns.context: 激活出现在人物简介中的姓氏片段和音乐职业描述附近；与其他模式没有明确共同语义。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to internal fragments of bronchi, Sobolev, and Chagas; also activates on Ecuadorian, Mugabe, the digit 1, and various sporadic words. Some triggers may depend on subword boundaries or incidental context.

patterns.name: bronchi segmentation fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls inside the segmented word bronchi; occurs in respiratory contexts involving bronchoalveolar lavage samples, RSV/bronchiolitis, bronchi, and bronchioles.
patterns.domain: Biomedical text, respiratory physiology, and patent background

patterns.name: Sobolev terminology fragment
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on Sobolev and the immediately following space(s), in mathematical formulas and definitions of function spaces.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, especially analysis and partial differential equations

patterns.name: Internal fragment in Chagas
patterns.context: Activation is an internal suffix fragment of the disease name Chagas, occurring in antigen detection or infection research contexts.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a personal name
patterns.context: Occurs only in the name of former Zimbabwean leader Robert Mugabe; there is no evidence of a general response to the person or political context.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in Ecuadorian
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of the nationality adjective Ecuadorian, next to the name of a public-health institution.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbol fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the number 1 in a mathematical formula; its trigger differs from the other activated word fragments and may be due to symbol form or local formula context.

patterns.name: Isolated marker at the beginning
patterns.context: Occurs only at the beginning of a passage, marking the letter a and a period; visible context is insufficient to determine its meaning or a stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: Other sporadic fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across institution abbreviations, common function words, general narrative, and project descriptions; no consistent local word-form or contextual pattern is evident.

4_238.concept: 词片段与局部词形探测器
4_238.description: 主要对被拆分的 bronchi、Sobolev 和 Chagas 词内片段强响应；另在 Ecuadorian、Mugabe、数字1及多种零散词上激活，部分触发可能依赖词片段边界或偶然上下文。

patterns.name: bronchi 分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的 bronchi 词内部；出现于肺泡灌洗样本、RSV/细支气管炎、支气管和细支气管等呼吸道语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、呼吸生理学与专利背景

patterns.name: Sobolev 术语片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于 Sobolev 一词及其后紧邻的 space(s)，位于数学公式和函数空间定义中。
patterns.domain: 数学论文，偏分析与偏微分方程

patterns.name: Chagas 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活是疾病名称 Chagas 的词内后缀片段，出现在抗原检测或感染研究语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、寄生虫病研究

patterns.name: 人名词内片段
patterns.context: 仅在 Zimbabwe 前领导人 Robert Mugabe 的姓名中触发；没有证据表明对该人物或政治语境普遍响应。

patterns.name: Ecuadorian 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在国籍形容词 Ecuadorian 的词尾，紧邻公共卫生机构名称。

patterns.name: 数学符号片段
patterns.trigger: «1»，出现在“floor”定义中的“√{1 + |x|²}”及积分表达式“1/p”中
patterns.context: 激活落在数学公式里的数字 1；触发条件和其他激活词片段不同，可能是符号形态或局部公式上下文。

patterns.name: 开头孤立标记
patterns.context: 只出现在片段开头，标记对象是字母 a 和句点；可见上下文不足以判断其语义或稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 其他零散片段
patterns.trigger: «P»、«and»、«was»、«evaluated»、«patients»、«writer»、«in»、«are»、«the»、«goals» 等原文中带标记的片段
patterns.context: 分别散见于机构缩写、常用功能词、一般叙述及项目介绍；未显示一致的局部词形或上下文模式。

en.description: Activations fall mainly on short subword tokens in word forms across languages: as in Chagas, Portuguese endings as/ão, and chi in the medical term bronchi; there are also m within French words, the ending of English mamas, the proper name Vindas, and fragments of citation markers.

patterns.name: Tokenized suffix in Chagas
patterns.context: The stem Chag is joined to the suffix as, referring to Chagas disease or related patients; activation falls on the within-word as subword token

patterns.name: Portuguese ending as
patterns.context: The Portuguese suffix -as occurs in the greeting Boas-vindas

patterns.name: Portuguese ending ão
patterns.context: The ending of the Portuguese noun Irão (Iran)

patterns.name: Within-word syllable chi
patterns.context: The medical term bronchial is split into within-word subword tokens, with activation on chi

patterns.name: Within-word letter fragment m
patterns.context: A within-word fragment in a French sphygmomanometer term, not an independent word

patterns.name: Word-final mam-as
patterns.context: The activation falls on the ending as of mamas, an informal or nonstandard spelling in an English passage

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a proper name
patterns.context: Occurs within the proper name Vindas in an author list

patterns.name: Fragment in a number or marker
patterns.context: A string fragment inside a citation marker; its lexical function cannot be determined from context

4_238.description: 激活主要落在跨语言词形中的短子词元：Chagas 的 as、葡语词尾 as/ão，以及医学术语 bronchi 中的 chi；另见法语词内 m、英语 mamas 词尾、专名 Vindas 和引用标记片段。

patterns.name: Chagas 词的分词后缀
patterns.context: 词干 Chag 与后缀 as 连写，指 Chagas 病或相关患者；激活落在词内的 as 子词元上

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词尾 as
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语词尾 -as，位于问候语 Boas-vindas 内
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词尾 ão
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语名词 Irão（伊朗）的词尾
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

patterns.name: 词内音节 chi
patterns.context: 医学术语 bronchial 被分成词内子词元，激活落在 chi

patterns.name: 词内字母片段 m
patterns.context: 法语血压计术语的词内片段，并非独立词

patterns.name: 词尾 mam-as
patterns.context: 英语段落中的口语或非标准拼写 mamas，激活落在词尾 as

patterns.name: 人名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在作者名单中的专名 Vindas 内

patterns.name: 编号与标记中的片段
patterns.context: 引用标记内部的字符串片段，无法从上下文确定其词法功能

en.concept: Recognition of terminology and internal word fragments
en.description: Activation is mainly on internal fragments of terms in medicine and biology, especially disease names, anatomical terms, and enzyme names; sporadic patterns also include code punctuation/identifiers, function words in license text, and fragments of author names.

patterns.name: Word endings in disease or medical terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal or ending fragments of medical terms, disease names, or anatomical terms; most words are split at subword boundaries.
patterns.domain: Medical and biomedical text, and disease names

patterns.name: Internal fragments of biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in biomolecules, enzyme names, or medical-device terms; activation concentrates on internal subword fragments rather than stable whole words.
patterns.domain: Biomedical text, experimental research, and medical technology text

patterns.name: Code punctuation and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs near Java import statements, their newlines and semicolons, and class names.

patterns.name: Function words in e-book license text
patterns.context: Pronouns, demonstratives, and related words are marked in license terms describing refunds, time limits, and how to obtain text.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in names or proper nouns
patterns.context: A fragment at the end of a name in an author list is activated; a single instance does not establish a more specific condition.

4_238.description: 激活以医学、生物学术语中的词内片段为主，尤其疾病名、解剖词及酶名；另有代码标点/标识符、许可文本功能词和作者姓名片段等零散模式。

patterns.name: 疾病或医学术语中的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在医学、疾病名称或解剖术语的词内/词尾片段；多数词在子词边界处被拆分。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物医学文本及疾病名称

patterns.name: 生物医学术语的内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在生物分子、酶名或医疗器械词中，激活集中于术语内部的子词片段，而非稳定的完整词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、实验研究及医学技术文本

patterns.name: 代码标点与标识符片段
patterns.context: Java 导入语句及其换行、分号和类名附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 电子书许可文本中的功能词
patterns.context: 说明退款、期限及获取文本方式的许可条款中，代词、指示词和相关词语被标记。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 电子书许可/法律说明

patterns.name: 姓名或专名内部片段
patterns.context: 作者名单中的人名末尾片段被激活；无法从单例判断更具体条件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across subword fragments: place names, short uppercase abbreviations and mathematical symbols, the ending of Chagas, medical terminology, and fictional proper names; ordinary word fragments also occur. The main commonality is local spelling fragments, while semantics and domains vary substantially.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of place names
patterns.context: Activates when place names are split into subword fragments, especially internal fragments of place-name proper nouns; the sentence itself need not describe a location.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic texts about place names, buildings, and biographies, as well as business news

patterns.name: Short letter strings in proper names
patterns.context: Activates when uppercase letters or short letter strings occur within mathematical symbols, abbreviations, or proper names; [3] is especially concentrated in group symbols in formulas.
patterns.domain: Engineering, mathematics papers, and technical texts

patterns.name: Chagas-related word-final fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in “Chagas” and the compound “Chagas'disease”; the passage also mentions T. cruzi infection, antigens, or patients.

patterns.name: Fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in the name of the staining method “Prussian blue staining,” surrounded by discussion of cells, micelles, and drug concentrations.

patterns.name: Fragments in fictional proper names
patterns.context: Occurs as a word-final fragment of “Hogwarts”; the same passage also includes terms from the Harry Potter universe, such as Horcrux and Voldemort.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in common words
patterns.context: In “there are a number of options,” activation falls on fragments of common, high-frequency English words; no clear proper-name or specialist-context condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Web technical documentation or Q&A text

4_238.description: 激活分散在词内片段：地名、短大写缩写与数学符号、Chagas词尾、医学术语及虚构专名；另有普通词片段。共同点主要是局部拼写片段，语义与领域差异较大。

patterns.name: 地点名内部片段
patterns.context: 地名被拆分成子词片段时激活，尤其是地点专名中的内部片段；所处句子本身不必描述地点。
patterns.domain: 地名、建筑与人物传记等百科文本，以及商业新闻

patterns.name: 专名中的短字母串
patterns.context: 大写字母或短字母串嵌在数学符号、缩写或专名中时激活；[3]尤其集中于公式中的群符号。
patterns.domain: 工程、数学论文及技术文本

patterns.name: Chagas相关词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Chagas”及复合词“Chagas'disease”中；段落同时提及 T. cruzi 感染、抗原或患者。
patterns.domain: 医学研究与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 医学术语中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Prussian blue staining”这一染色方法名称中，周围谈及细胞、胶束及药物浓度。

patterns.name: 虚构专名中的片段
patterns.context: 作为“Hogwarts”的词尾片段出现；同段另有 Harry Potter 世界观中的 Horcrux、Voldemort 等词。

patterns.name: 常见词内的字母片段
patterns.context: 在“there are a number of options”中，激活落在普通英语高频词片段；未见明显专名或专业语境条件。
patterns.domain: 网页技术说明或问答文本

en.concept: Poincaré and varied local word fragments
en.description: Most passages mention Poincaré in mathematical papers; two other passages activate on the phrase there are, while the rest involve local fragments in Sharpe, Prussian blue, and federal trademarks, with no unified meaning.

patterns.name: Poincaré terminology
patterns.context: The name occurs in mathematical papers, especially near mathematical terms such as “-Hopf Theorem,” “disk model,” “exponent,” and “polynomial”

patterns.name: English there are construction
patterns.context: “There are ...” introduces a quantity or options in prose or documentation; activation falls on are

patterns.name: Sharpe name
patterns.context: In the title or introductory text for the person or work Sharpe’s Rifles

patterns.name: Prussian blue staining
patterns.context: Appears as a detection method in a description of cellular uptake experiments; activation concentrates on “ian”

patterns.name: Federal trademarks in a registered-trademark context
patterns.context: In a narrative describing a product or trademark registration history, activation falls on “federal”

4_238.description: 多数段落在数学论文中提及 Poincaré；另有两段激活于 there are 句式，其余分别落在 Sharpe、Prussian blue 的局部词片及 federal trademarks，缺少统一词义。

patterns.name: Poincaré 术语
patterns.context: 数学论文中出现该人名，尤其与“-Hopf Theorem”“disk model”“exponent”“polynomial”等数学术语相邻

patterns.name: 英文 there are 句式
patterns.context: 正文或文档中使用“there are ...”引出数量或选项；激活落在 are 上
patterns.domain: 网页说明文字、代码文档

patterns.name: Sharp(e) 名称
patterns.context: 人名或作品名 Sharpe’s Rifles 的标题、介绍文字中
patterns.domain: 百科条目／电视节目介绍

patterns.name: Prussian blue 染色
patterns.context: 细胞摄取实验描述中，作为检测方法出现；激活集中在“ian”

patterns.name: 注册商标语境中的联邦商标
patterns.context: 介绍产品或商标注册历史的叙述中，激活落在“federal”

en.concept: “first of” constructions and several local phrases
en.description: Activations occur mainly in “first of” and its set complements, covering narratives about sporting events, series, dynasties, meetings, ships, and trademarks; there are also activations on you in electronic-text refund clauses, the conversational rhetorical question “Don’t you get it?”, and reporting on financial hardship from litigation.

patterns.name: “first of” after an ordinal
patterns.context: After the definite article the and ordinal first, followed by a set or subsequent object introduced by of; this often includes a quantity or pronoun modifier, such as “the first of the 10,” “the first of several,” or “the first of his dynasty.”
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic entries, news reports, and general narrative

patterns.name: Electronic-text license and refund clauses
patterns.context: The second-person pronoun you occurs with legalistic wording about conditions, deadlines, and the source of receipt in electronic-text refund instructions; the same passage is repeated in the corpus.

patterns.name: get it in a rhetorical question
patterns.context: A conversational rhetorical question addressed to you, immediately followed by commentary on capitalism and work.

patterns.name: Narratives about cases and financial hardship
patterns.context: Reports that a female litigant faces an adverse court outcome and financial consequences, with her salon business and location described earlier.

4_238.description: 主要在“first of”及其集合补语中激活，涵盖赛事、剧集、王朝、会议、船只和商标等叙述；另对电子文本退款条款中的you、口语反问“Don’t you get it?”及诉讼经济困境报道有激活。

patterns.name: 序数后的“first of”结构
patterns.context: 在定冠词 the 与序数 first 之后，后接 of 引出的集合或后续对象；此处常带数量词或代词限定，如“the first of the 10”“the first of several”“the first of his dynasty”。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、新闻报道及一般叙述

patterns.name: 电子文本许可与退款条款
patterns.trigger: “do not, you can receive a refund”及“you got it from”
patterns.context: 第二人称 you 与电子文本退款说明中的条件、期限及收件来源等法律式措辞共同出现；同一段内容在语料中重复。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 电子书许可/版权声明

patterns.name: 反问中的 get it
patterns.context: 以第二人称 you 构成口语反问，紧接关于资本主义与工作的评论。

patterns.name: 案件与经济困境叙述
patterns.trigger: “financial ruin if she loses the case”
patterns.context: 报道女性当事人面临诉讼败诉及财务后果，前文交代其经营沙龙和地点。

en.concept: case and contexts introducing the first item
en.description: Activations concentrate on “case” and its judgment boilerplate in legal documents, and also occur in series introduced by “the first of,” covering cases, works, ships, sporting events, and trademarks; there are also contexts involving an adverse court outcome and financial loss.

patterns.name: Standard legal judgment phrasing
patterns.context: Procedural notice at the end of a federal appellate court decision or disposition; nearby phrases often include “not precedent” and “not appropriate for publication.”
patterns.domain: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit legal documents

patterns.name: “the first of” series
patterns.context: Introduces an object as the first in a series, followed by a plural category or quantity; depending on context, the object may be a case, work, ship, sporting event, or trademark.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, medical, and legal texts

patterns.name: case and its collocations
patterns.context: Refers to a lawsuit or a confirmed patient case; the meaning varies by context, occurring in court conclusions, outbreak reports, and news reports.

patterns.name: Adverse court outcome and financial loss
patterns.context: Reports that a party will face financial loss if they lose a lawsuit; this is not the procedural usage found in judgment boilerplate.

4_238.description: 激活集中于法律文书中的“case”及其判决套语，也见“the first of”引出的系列首项，涵盖病例、作品、船只、赛事、商标；另见败诉与财务损失语境。

patterns.name: 法律判决固定措辞
patterns.trigger: “this case suitable for decision without oral argument”“the panel unanimously concludes/finds”
patterns.context: 联邦上诉法院判决或处置意见末尾的程序性说明；附近常见“not precedent”“not appropriate for publication”等措辞。
patterns.domain: 美国第九巡回上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: “the first of”序列
patterns.context: 介绍某个对象属于一系列事物中的首个，后接复数类别或数量；在上下文中对象可能是病例、作品、船只、赛事或商标。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、医学及法律文本

patterns.name: case及其搭配
patterns.context: 指诉讼案件或确诊病例；词义依语境而变，分别出现于法院结论、疫情报道和新闻报道。

patterns.name: 案件败诉与财务损失
patterns.context: 报道当事人若诉讼败诉将面临经济损失；并非判决模板中的程序性用法。

en.description: Most passages mark the first item in a sequence, set, or dynasty after “first of.” Other examples include a first case and an initial difficult instance. Some activations fall on classification terms, proper nouns, and fragments of medical terminology, and are difficult to incorporate into the main pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinal first of followed by a set
patterns.context: “first of” indicates the first item in a series, set, or succession; often preceded by an article or determiner.

patterns.name: Ordinal in a classification template
patterns.context: An entry introduction uses a fixed template to specify an item’s position in a series of works, competitions, or products.

patterns.name: Person categories and entity names
patterns.context: Occurs near category lists, titles, or proper nouns at the end of biographical entries; aside from “of,” there is no clear shared first of construction.

patterns.name: Dynasties and rulers
patterns.context: Describes a ruler’s order within a dynasty; nearby text mentions dynastic succession and royal titles.

patterns.name: First case in a disease context
patterns.context: Describes the first confirmed case in a location; first modifies case rather than a series of works or objects.

patterns.name: Proper nouns or technical fragments in medical text
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented fragments of proper nouns or technical terms, with no direct syntactic connection to the first of series expression.

patterns.name: First instance of a ship-design difficulty
patterns.context: first refers to the beginning of a series of similar difficulties; preceding text discusses ship gun design and displacement.

patterns.name: Other isolated fragments
patterns.context: Occurs only in local passages, with insufficient evidence that these form an independent, stable pattern.

4_238.description: 多数段落在“first of”后标记序列、集合或王朝中的首个；另有首例病例和首个困难实例。若干激活落在分类、专名及医学术语碎片上，难以并入主模式。

patterns.name: 序数 first of 后接集合
patterns.trigger: «first»、«of»及后续数量或集合，如“first of «10»”“first of «9»”
patterns.context: “first of”表示某系列、集合或一连串事物中的首个；周围常有冠词或限定词。

patterns.name: 分类模板中的序数词
patterns.context: 条目导语中以固定模板说明作品、赛事或产品在某个系列中的位置。

patterns.name: 人物分类与实体名称
patterns.trigger: «Earl»、«Earls»等头衔及其附近的分类标记
patterns.context: 出现在人物条目末尾的类别列表、头衔或专名附近；除“of”外没有明显共享的 first of 结构。

patterns.name: 王朝与统治者叙述
patterns.context: 描述统治者在某王朝中的先后地位，附近提及王朝更替和王室称号。

patterns.name: 疾病病例中的首例
patterns.context: 说明某地首次确认的病例，first 修饰病例而非系列作品或物件。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的专名或术语碎片
patterns.trigger: «No»、«Fall»附近的医学专名，以及«LT»、«C»附近的生化术语
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的专名或技术词片段上，未见与 first of 系列表达直接相连的句法关系。

patterns.name: 船舶设计困难的首个实例
patterns.context: first 指一连串类似困难中的开端；前文谈船舶火炮设计与位移。

patterns.name: 其他孤立词片段
patterns.context: 只在局部文本中出现，缺乏足够证据表明它们构成独立稳定模式。

en.concept: The first item in a series
en.description: Activations occur mainly in the “the first of” construction, used to identify the first item in a series of sporting events, episodes, trademarks, cases, meetings, difficulties, or transport connections; they also occur on nationality/occupation labels for people and fragments of a fish's scientific name.

patterns.name: “the first of” followed by a quantity
patterns.context: Describes an object as the first in a series, group, or sequence of subsequent events; the quantity may immediately follow of or appear later.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic narrative, news, or general narrative

patterns.name: Nationality and occupation labels in biographies
patterns.context: Lists briefly classify people by nationality, political stance, or occupation; this passage does not contain an activating “the first of” construction.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a biological proper name
patterns.context: The scientific name of a freshwater fish appears in the title of a reproductive-cycle study; activation falls within the scientific name rather than a visible “the first of” construction.

4_238.description: 主要在“the first of”结构中激活，结构用于指出某赛事、剧集、商标、病例、会议、困难或交通联结序列的首项；另见人物国籍/职业标签及鱼类学名片段。

patterns.name: “the first of” 后接数量
patterns.context: 叙述某对象是某系列、群体或后续事件中的第一个；数量词可紧随 of，也可稍后出现。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、新闻或一般叙事

patterns.name: 人物条目中的国籍与职业标签
patterns.context: 人物列表中用国籍、政治立场或职业作简短分类；此段未见“the first of”激活结构。

patterns.name: 生物学专名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 淡水鱼学名出现在生殖周期研究标题中；激活落在学名内部，而非可见的“the first of”结构。

en.concept: Phrasing for the first item in a series in encyclopedic narrative
en.description: Several passages highlight encyclopedic “first of …” series phrasing; other activations involve case and imaging terminology in medical reports, reader address in refund clauses and technical documentation, and scattered name or sports-narrative fragments. Triggers are not uniform.

patterns.name: Noun phrase after “first of”
patterns.context: In the phrase “the first of the …,” first is followed by of, which introduces a category, series, or set; similar “the … first of the …” phrasing also appears in several passages.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic entries, product or work descriptions, statistical notes

patterns.name: Function words in a refund conditional
patterns.context: A conditional clause in refund instructions about requesting a refund from the provider after receiving the text; activation is distributed across pronouns, predicates, and sentence-final phrases, without a single clear part-of-speech trigger.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg electronic-text license or refund clauses

patterns.name: “case” in case narratives
patterns.context: Epidemiological narrative describing a patient transferred to the ICU, the first confirmed case, and subsequent sampling.

patterns.name: Names or terms around “H”
patterns.context: Occurs in the name of a snooker event, an ICU name, and a personal name spelling; the contexts and trigger fragments are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic sports entries, medical texts, personal names

patterns.name: Medical imaging and examination terms
patterns.context: Lists imaging and endoscopic examination methods used for tumor staging or assessment.

patterns.name: “Fernandes” name fragment
patterns.context: Part of the name of a Portuguese maritime figure, appearing in a fleet roster.

patterns.name: “first of these” in a trademark description
patterns.context: Identifies a product as the earliest registered in a series of federal trademarks; it resembles the “first of” construction, but these intervenes.

patterns.name: Second-person explanations and suggestions
patterns.context: Explains the purpose of software to the reader, then introduces optional solutions with an affirmative response; overlap of you with refund clauses may simply reflect a common function word.

patterns.name: Local terms in a sports-results narrative
patterns.context: Occurs in a narrative about an athlete winning medals and a team pursuit event, with insufficient evidence for a stable local trigger pattern.

4_238.concept: 百科叙述中的系列首项表述
4_238.description: 多段突出百科式“first of …”系列表述；另有医学病例中的 case 与影像术语、退款条款及技术说明中的读者指称，以及分散的人名或体育叙述片段。触发并不统一。

patterns.name: “first of” 后接名词短语
patterns.context: 短语 “the first of the …” 中，first 后接 of，并引出一个类别、系列或集合；多处还出现 “the … first of the …” 的相似句式。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、产品或作品介绍、统计说明

patterns.name: 退款条件句中的功能词
patterns.context: 退款说明中，围绕“收到文本后向提供者申请退款”的条件句；激活分布在代词、谓语和句末短语，未呈现出单一明确的词类触发。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 电子文本许可或退款条款

patterns.name: 病例叙述中的“case”
patterns.context: 描述病人转入 ICU、首次确诊病例及后续采样的流行病学叙述。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、COVID-19 病例报告

patterns.name: “H”附近的名称或词项
patterns.context: 分别出现在斯诺克赛事名称、ICU 名称和人名拼写中；上下文与触发片段并不一致。
patterns.domain: 百科体育条目、医学文本、人名

patterns.name: 医学影像与检查术语
patterns.context: 列举肿瘤分期或评估所用的成像和内镜检查方法。

patterns.name: “Fernandes”人名片段
patterns.context: 作为葡萄牙航海人物名字的一部分，出现在舰队成员名单中。

patterns.name: 商标描述中的“first of these”
patterns.context: 在一系列联邦商标中指出某产品是最早登记的一项；与“first of”句式相似，但中间夹有 these。

patterns.name: 第二人称说明与建议
patterns.context: 面向读者解释软件用途，随后以肯定回应引出可选方案；与退款条款中的 you 可能只是常见功能词重合。
patterns.domain: 网络技术说明、用户指南

patterns.name: 体育成绩叙述中的局部词项
patterns.context: 在运动员获得奖牌及团队追逐赛的成绩叙述中出现，缺少足够证据证明有稳定的局部触发模式。

en.concept: Specific subword-fragment activations in heterogeneous texts
en.description: Patterns focus mainly on leukotrienes and related inflammatory mediators, and also include lipid chemical nomenclature; other activations involve physical-model terminology, clinical-case fragments, and tokenization of place names in Iran and the Balkans.

patterns.name: Leukotrienes and arachidonic-acid metabolites
patterns.context: Involves the names, production, expression, antagonism, or measurement of leukotrienes or related arachidonic-acid metabolites; often occurs alongside inflammatory mediators, pharmacological effects, or experimental assays.

patterns.name: Specific fragments in scientific terminology
patterns.context: Introduces models, formulas, or section contents in a physics paper; triggers appear to fall on common connectives and model terminology, not the leukotriene topic.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in numbers and biochemical names
patterns.context: Lists dihydroxyeicosatetraenoic acid isomers with specific position numbers and related lipid mediators; highlights are scattered within chemical names and numbers.

patterns.name: Phrase fragments in disease-case narratives
patterns.context: Describes patient symptoms, referrals, and confirmed COVID-19 cases; activations mainly fall on common words in case narratives and disease names.

patterns.name: Clinical neurological symptoms and visit records
patterns.context: Chronologically narrates a patient's neurological symptoms, care location, and emergency imaging; highlights include place-name fragments and examination names.

patterns.name: Iranian place names and administrative divisions
patterns.context: Place names are split into multiple highlighted fragments in geographical descriptions of villages and their rural districts, counties, and provinces.

patterns.name: Country-name fragments in Balkan place names
patterns.context: A country name appears in lists of locations where animal-disease cases originated or were reported; highlights concentrate within the name Bosnia and Herzegovina.

4_238.concept: 异质文本中的特定词片段激活
4_238.description: 模式主要围绕白三烯及相关炎症介质，也包括脂质化学命名；另有物理模型术语、临床病例词片段，以及伊朗和巴尔干地名中的分词激活。

patterns.name: 白三烯及花生四烯酸代谢物
patterns.context: 涉及白三烯或相关花生四烯酸代谢物的名称、生成、表达、拮抗或测量；常与炎症介质、药理作用或实验测定一同出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、药理学与实验研究

patterns.name: 科学术语中的特定词片段
patterns.context: 物理学论文中介绍模型、公式或章节内容；触发看起来落在常见连接词及模型术语上，并非白三烯主题。

patterns.name: 数字与生化名称中的分词片段
patterns.context: 列举具有特定位点编号的二羟基二十碳四烯酸异构体及相关脂质介质；高亮分散在化学名和数字内部。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、生化命名

patterns.name: 疾病病例叙述中的短语片段
patterns.trigger: « symptoms»、« intensive»« care»« unit»、« first»« confirmed»« COVID»«-»«19»« case»
patterns.context: 描述患者症状、转诊及新冠确诊病例；主要激活集中在病例叙述的普通词和疾病名称。

patterns.name: 临床神经症状与就诊记录
patterns.context: 病例按时间叙述患者神经系统症状、就诊地点及急诊影像检查；高亮包括地名片段和检查名称。

patterns.name: 伊朗地名与行政区划名称
patterns.context: 地名词被拆成多个高亮片段，出现在村庄及其乡村区、县、省的地理介绍中。

patterns.name: 巴尔干地名中的国家名称片段
patterns.context: 国家名称出现在动物疾病病例来源地或报道地区的列表中；高亮集中于波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那名称内部。
patterns.domain: 生物医学文献中的病例地点列表

en.concept: Leukotriene-related word fragments with heterogeneous triggers
en.description: Primarily responds to fragments of proper names for leukotrienes and related inflammatory lipid mediators; also activates on rare proper-name spellings, mathematical symbols, Portuguese word forms, and timeline entries in several texts, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Leukotrienes and lipid mediators
patterns.context: Names of leukotrienes, arachidonic acid metabolites, or other lipid mediators, often appearing with inflammation, antagonism, measurement, or enumeration

patterns.name: Rare spelling fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Rare letter combinations in personal or place names; the specific semantic connection is unclear

patterns.name: Function words and surrounding mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Symbols, formulas, and adjacent connectives in mathematical or physics texts; no clear connection to the biomedical pattern

patterns.name: Portuguese word-form fragments
patterns.context: Internal substrings of words and common short words in Portuguese parliamentary text; trigger locations are scattered

patterns.name: English dates and occupation entries
patterns.context: Entries in historical timelines listing people, nationalities, occupations, and birth/death years in parentheses

4_238.concept: 白三烯相关词片段，兼有异质触发
4_238.description: 主要响应白三烯及相关炎症脂质介质的专名片段；另在若干文本中激活于罕见专名拼写、数学符号、葡萄牙语词形和年表条目，彼此缺少明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 白三烯及脂质介质
patterns.context: 白三烯、花生四烯酸代谢物或其他脂质介质的名称，常与炎症、拮抗作用、测量或列举并现

patterns.name: 专名中的稀有拼写片段
patterns.context: 人名或地名中包含罕见字母组合；具体语义联系不明
patterns.domain: 医学病例叙述、百科年表

patterns.name: 形式词及数学符号周边
patterns.context: 数学或物理文本中的符号、公式以及相邻连接词；未见与生物医学模式的明确联系

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词形片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会文本中的词内子串及常见短词，触发位置分散

patterns.name: 英语日期与职业条目
patterns.context: 历史年表中人物、国籍、职业及括号内生卒年份的条目

en.description: Activations occur mainly on English it (often referring to an object) and reader-directed you; they also appear consistently in leukotriene-related medical terms. Dutch and Greek fragments and highlighted words in case-report sentences are difficult to assign to these patterns.

patterns.name: “it” and its referent
patterns.context: In English sentences, it functions as an object, often referring to something mentioned earlier or something that can be purchased or received; it also occurs in questions and news reports.

patterns.name: “you” pronoun
patterns.context: Addresses the reader or conversation partner directly, often adjacent to verbs such as got, paid, received, and buy; overlaps with activations on it.

patterns.name: Leukotriene-related medical terminology
patterns.context: Split across subwords within terms referring to leukotrienes or specific forms; occurs in contexts involving allergy mediators, drug effects, and experimental measurement.

patterns.name: Other highlighted word fragments
patterns.context: Occur in a Dutch aviation-agency name, Greek parliamentary text, and COVID-19 case reports; the available fragments do not establish a shared trigger condition.

4_238.concept: it 指代与 leukotriene 词片段
4_238.description: 激活主要出现在英语 it（常指代物品）及面向读者的 you；另在白三烯相关医学术语中稳定出现。荷兰语、希腊语片段和病例句中的高亮词难以归入这些模式。

patterns.name: “it”及其指代对象
patterns.context: 英语句中 it 作宾语，常指前文提到或可购买、接收的物品；也出现在问句和新闻报道中。
patterns.domain: 英语小说、法律文本、新闻

patterns.name: “you”人称代词
patterns.context: 直接对读者或对话对象说话，常与 got、paid、received、buy 等动词相邻；与 it 的激活有重叠。

patterns.name: leukotriene 相关医学术语
patterns.context: 术语内部跨子词切分，指白三烯或其具体形式；出现在过敏介质、药物作用及实验测量语境。

patterns.name: 其他高亮词片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在荷兰语航空机构名称、希腊语议会文本及 COVID-19 病例报道中；现有片段不足以确定共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本、医学报道

en.concept: Various subword fragments and proper names
en.description: Primarily responds to the “ot…ri…ene” fragments within leukotriene; there are also sporadic activations on the place name Bosnia and Herzegovina, receive in license text, NMR terminology, German compound fragments, breaststroke, and a chemical fragment.

patterns.name: Internal substring “ot” followed by “rien”
patterns.context: The key trigger appears within “leukotriene(s)”; word forms or tokenization may differ, while the surrounding contexts vary, including scientific texts and classification entries.
patterns.domain: Medical, biomedical, and related texts; also Wikipedia categories

patterns.name: Place name Bosnia and Herzegovina
patterns.context: The place name “Bosnia and Herzegovina” is split into multiple subword fragments; it occurs in animal-case location lists or person-category labels.

patterns.name: receive in refund license text
patterns.context: Occurs in electronic-text license clauses explaining that a request to the provider within a given period may result in a refund; the two passages are highly similar repetitions.

patterns.name: NMR terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in a description of analytical methods following preparation of a chemical product, immediately after “^1H-nuclear,” and mentions NMR spectroscopy.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in German compounds
patterns.context: A German sentence mentions European foreign ministers and a draft constitution; strong activation falls on the final fragment of “Verfassungsentwurf.”

patterns.name: Breaststroke event terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in a swimmer's biography describing the 50-meter breaststroke event; the passage also mentions the European Junior Championships.

patterns.name: Source fragment “anal”
patterns.context: Occurs at the start of a chemical synthesis step, followed by the names of aminopropanal and its derivatives; the fragment itself has no independently identifiable meaning from the provided context.

4_238.description: 主要对leukotriene词内的“ot…ri…ene”片段反应；另对波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那地名、许可文本中的receive、NMR术语、德语长词片段、蛙泳及化学残片有零散激活。

patterns.name: 单词内部子串“ot”后接“rien”
patterns.context: 关键触发片段出现在“leukotriene(s)”一词内部；词形或分词方式不同，但该词周围可有科学文本或分类条目等不同语境。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物医学及相关文本；也有维基百科分类

patterns.name: 波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那地名
patterns.context: 地名“Bosnia and Herzegovina”被分成多个子词片段；出现在动物病例地点列表或人物分类标签中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学病例报告、维基百科人物条目

patterns.name: 退款许可文本中的 receive
patterns.context: 出现在电子文本许可条款中，说明在一定期限内向提供者提出请求可获得退款；两段是高度相似的重复文本。

patterns.name: NMR术语
patterns.context: 出现在化学实验产物制备后的分析方法描述中，紧接“^1H-nuclear”，并提到NMR spectroscopy。
patterns.domain: 化学专利或实验方法文本

patterns.name: 德语构词中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 德语句中提及欧洲外交部长及宪法草案；强激活落在“Verfassungsentwurf”的末尾片段。

patterns.name: 蛙泳赛事用语
patterns.context: 出现在游泳运动员履历中，描述50米蛙泳项目；同段还含欧洲青年锦标赛信息。
patterns.domain: 维基百科体育人物条目

patterns.name: 原文残片“anal”
patterns.context: 出现在化学合成步骤开头，后接氨基丙醛及其衍生物名称；该触发片段本身无法从给出的上下文确定独立语义。

en.description: Activations are distributed across the title Governor, leukotriene pharmacology terms, and place-name/administrative-area narratives; scattered internal-word activations also occur in taxonomic, physics, and mathematics texts. The passages show no unified, stable semantic or syntactic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Governor in titles
patterns.context: The word occurs after a person's name as a title or administrative designation, especially alongside “Lieutenant,” “of,” or “India”; activation falls on Governor or its tokenization.

patterns.name: Leukotriene and related pharmacological terms
patterns.context: Occurs in pharmacological or biochemical descriptions of arachidonic-acid metabolites, hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acids, antagonists, and related terms; activation concentrates within leukotriene.
patterns.domain: Pharmacological patent background, PubMed biochemical abstracts

patterns.name: Administrative place names and lists of places
patterns.context: Occurs in narratives about countries, regions, provinces, or administrative areas; activation points vary and include immigration-status contexts, administrative history, and the geographic distribution of animal cases.
patterns.domain: News, historical encyclopedias, medical cases, and distribution reports

patterns.name: Internal fragments in formal numbering, classifications, or entries
patterns.context: Activation occurs in specific internal fragments around lists of scientific names, physical model symbols, or mathematical formulas; there is no clear shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic classifications, physics and mathematics papers

patterns.name: Scattered subword fragments
patterns.context: Some activations appear only as subword fragments within common words or proper names and cannot be explained by the same stable semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, papers, and medical literature

4_238.description: 激活分散在官职 Governor、leukotriene 药理术语及地名/行政辖区叙述中；另有分类学、物理与数学文本里的零散词内激活。各段未呈现统一、稳定的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 史衔中的 Governor
patterns.context: 词语出现在人名后的官职或行政区称谓中，尤其与“Lieutenant”“of”“India”等相连；激活落在 Governor 或其分词上。
patterns.domain: 历史人物传记、百科条目

patterns.name: leukotriene及相关药理词
patterns.context: 出现在花生四烯酸代谢物、羟基二十碳四烯酸、拮抗剂等药理或生化描述中；激活集中在 leukotriene 的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 专利药理背景、PubMed 生化摘要

patterns.name: 行政地名与地名列表
patterns.context: 处于国家、地区、省份或行政辖区的叙述中；激活点各异，包含移民身份语境、行政历史及动物病例地理分布。
patterns.domain: 新闻、历史百科、医学病例与分布报告

patterns.name: 正式编号、分类或条目中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在学名列表、物理模型符号或数学公式周边的若干特定词内片段；没有明显共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科分类、物理学和数学论文

patterns.name: 零散词内片段
patterns.context: 若干激活只表现为普通词或专名内部的子词片段，且无法由同一稳定语义或句法条件解释。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、论文及医学文献

en.concept: Scattered internal word fragments and terminology
en.description: Activation falls on internal fragments of various proper nouns or domain terms, and also appears in titles, identity terms, and code resource words. The Heisenberg model recurs across passages; other triggers are scattered and difficult to group under a single semantic or word-form rule.

patterns.name: Specific endings within names or entities
patterns.context: Activation falls on endings or subword fragments of proper nouns or their components, often in personal names, place names, ethnic names, or taxonomic names; many words are segmented into subwords in the corpus.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic, news, medical, and taxonomic text

patterns.name: Titles and identity terms
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of a person’s position or identity, such as “Lieutenant Governor” and “green card”; the trigger words themselves do not share a meaning.

patterns.name: Heisenberg model terminology
patterns.context: In mathematical physics contexts involving matrices, quantum many-body systems, or the Heisenberg model; related terminology recurs in two passages.

patterns.name: Bond proper noun
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper noun James Bond, appearing twice in the same passage, which discusses Q Branch, agents, and equipment.

patterns.name: Article, route, and editing code
patterns.context: Occurs in URL routes and Python/Django-style code, referring to article resources and their editing operations.

patterns.name: Julia linear algebra context
patterns.context: Julia REPL code involves LinearAlgebra, matrices, and the identity matrix; «Al» and «gebra» jointly segment Algebra.

patterns.name: Group noun in a title
patterns.context: Occurs in the title of a paper about teacher tobacco use in a region; no clear repeated cue is evident in the same passage.

4_238.concept: 分散的词内片段与术语
4_238.description: 激活落在多类专名或领域术语的词内片段上，也出现在职衔、身份词及代码资源词中。Heisenberg 模型跨段复现；其余触发分散，难以归为单一语义或词形规则。

patterns.name: 姓名或实体词内部的特定词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或专名构成部分的词尾、子词片段上，常见于人名、地名、族名或分类学名称；其中不少词在语料里被拆成子词。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、医学及分类学文本

patterns.name: 职衔与身份词
patterns.context: 出现在人物职务或身份描述中，如“Lieutenant Governor”和“green card”；触发词本身语义并不相同。

patterns.name: Heisenberg 模型术语
patterns.context: 处于矩阵、量子多体系统或 Heisenberg 模型的数学物理语境；相关术语在两个片段中重复出现。

patterns.name: Bond 专名
patterns.context: 出现在 James Bond 这一专名中，两次出现于同一段，周围谈及 Q Branch、特工及装备。

patterns.name: 文章、路由与编辑代码
patterns.context: 出现在 URL 路由和 Python/Django 风格代码中，指文章资源及其编辑操作。

patterns.name: Julia 线性代数语境
patterns.context: Julia REPL 代码涉及 LinearAlgebra、矩阵及单位矩阵；«Al»和«gebra»共同拆出 Algebra。

patterns.name: 标题中的人群名词
patterns.context: 出现在关于某地区教师烟草使用的论文标题中；未见同段的明确重复线索。

en.description: Activations are distributed across code angle brackets, subword fragments in proper names and specialist terms, medical terminology, mathematical notation, Portuguese word forms, and words in news or chat; the passages lack a stable shared semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Angle brackets and code markup in English technical text
patterns.context: In generic types, HTML/XML-style markup, or IRC usernames, angle brackets and their contents are marked as separate fragments; passage 2 also contains code structures and markers such as «container» and «Register».

patterns.name: Subword fragments in technical terms or proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal substrings of proper names or terms, often in rare spellings, at tokenization boundaries, or within word forms; there is no unified semantic category.
patterns.domain: News, history, place names, and biological classification texts

patterns.name: English medical and biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in medical contexts involving clinical cases or experimental results, with activation on disease, care-unit, or biochemical-substance names.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula notation
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematical definitions and formulas for binary Markov sources; activation is adjacent to LaTeX symbols, variables, and probability notation.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in Portuguese
patterns.context: Activation occurs within Portuguese words concerning citizens, justice, and Greece; no clear semantics are shared with the English subword fragments.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in taxonomic names
patterns.context: Repeatedly occurs in lists of species' scientific names, with activation concentrated in fragments within Latinized names.

patterns.name: Identity- and immigration-related phrases in reporting
patterns.context: A U.S. news report describes a veteran facing deportation; strong activation falls on words in identity/immigration-related phrases.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in English place and title names
patterns.context: Narrates historical political figures and their titles; activation falls on titles and office names.

patterns.name: Geographic-entity fragments in headlines or news pages
patterns.context: A news page reports the sale of land in an irrigation district and neighbors' concerns; activation falls on institution/geography-related words and common nouns.

patterns.name: Emphasis and request words in dialogue
patterns.context: An IRC conversation discusses server and client connections and asks for help making a demo application run more smoothly; strong activation falls on colloquial pronouns and similar words.

4_238.description: 激活分散在代码尖括号、专名与专业词的词内片段、医学术语、数学记号、葡萄牙语词形及新闻/聊天用词；各段缺少稳定的共同语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 英文技术文本中的尖括号及代码标记
patterns.context: 在泛型类型、HTML/XML 样式标记或 IRC 用户名中，尖括号与内部字符串被拆分标记；第2段还出现代码结构和 «container»、«Register» 等标记。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、在线技术交流

patterns.name: 专业名词或专名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或术语的词内子串上，常见于罕见拼写、分词边界或词形内部；没有统一语义类别。
patterns.domain: 新闻、历史、地名及生物分类文本

patterns.name: 英语医学与生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在临床病例或实验结果的医学语境中，激活落在疾病、照护单位或生化物质名称上。
patterns.domain: 医学新闻、生命科学论文

patterns.name: 数学符号及公式标记
patterns.context: 出现在二元马尔可夫源的数学定义和公式中，激活与 LaTeX 符号、变量及概率记号相邻。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语中的词形片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在葡萄牙语正文的词内，涉及公民、司法及希腊等词；未见与英语词内片段共享的明确语义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

patterns.name: 分类学名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 重复出现在物种学名列表中，激活集中于拉丁化学名的词内片段。

patterns.name: 报道中的身份及移民相关短语
patterns.context: 美国新闻报道描述一名退伍军人面临遣返，强激活落在身份/移民相关短语中的词。

patterns.name: 英文地名与官职名中的专名片段
patterns.context: 叙述历史政治人物及其官职，激活落在称谓和官职名称上。

patterns.name: 标题或新闻页面中的地理实体片段
patterns.context: 新闻页面报道灌溉区出售土地及邻里担忧，激活落在机构/地理相关词及普通名词上。

patterns.name: 对话中的强调及请求词
patterns.context: IRC 对话讨论服务器与客户端连接，并请求帮助使演示应用更流畅；强激活落在口语代词等词上。

en.description: Activation is scattered across code, mathematical formulas, chemical and medical terminology, Dutch word forms, and news proper nouns. Apart from some local recurrence among medical and chemical fragments, the passages show no clear shared semantic or stylistic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments of the number 1/1.5
patterns.context: The number 1 occurs in mathematical formulas, expressions, or decimals/ranges; sometimes nearby punctuation or formula syntax contributes to the trigger.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, formulas, and technical text

patterns.name: Article-related word forms
patterns.context: article(s) appears as a model/route name in code; surrounding text concerns Django URL configuration and a question about editing articles.

patterns.name: Fragments in chemical names
patterns.context: A complex chemical name is split into multiple tokens, followed by descriptions of precipitation, filtration, and NMR characterization.

patterns.name: COVID-19 case description
patterns.context: Describes patient referral, ICU admission, and confirmed cases.

patterns.name: Medicinal chemistry and leukotrienes

en.description: Activation is clearest on declaration (including medical declarations and function declarations) and the in-word ust fragment; the rest is scattered across medical terms, code, email names, news headlines, and patient ages, with no shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “declaration of”
patterns.context: Appears in expressions such as “St. Vincent declaration,” “declaration of Helsinki,” and “The declaration was…”; it does not require any particular following content.

patterns.name: In-word fragment -ust-
patterns.context: The trigger occurs inside a word; [6] is the English adjective Robust, and [8] is the Slovenian word ustavni.

patterns.name: Local fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on specific word fragments in medical titles or abstracts, but these terms have no shared root or clear common meaning.

patterns.name: Word structure and code syntax declarations
patterns.context: In a code template description, the phrase “generator function declaration” refers to a function declaration; activation concentrates on the abbreviated fragment decl in declaration.

patterns.name: Near the English letter sequence «...ar...»
patterns.context: Located in the word parental in a genetics abstract; this segment has no clear contextual correspondence to the other patterns.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in English news terms
patterns.context: Appears in the headline “... Has Deadly Consequences”; declaration also appears in the same passage, but this fragment itself is an in-word activation.

patterns.name: Age-word fragment in a title

patterns.name: Character fragment in an email address name
patterns.context: Located in Gustafson in an email forwarding header; the content concerns urging payment, but the activated characters have no clear connection to the topic.

4_705.description: 激活最清楚地落在 declaration（含医学宣言与函数声明）及词内 ust 片段；其余分散于医学词、代码、邮件姓名、新闻标题和病例年龄等，缺少共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 固定短语“declaration of”

patterns.name: 词内片段 -ust-

en.description: Activations occur across multiple genres: notably declaration, subwords of complex terms, and function declaration in code; they also include email phrases and age phrases in case titles. No single stable semantic pattern is evident.

patterns.name: declaration in medical or research titles
patterns.context: A longer word with fixed spelling appears in a title or body text; declaration refers variously to a research question, ethical standards, or a political statement, while robust appears in methodological descriptions.

patterns.name: Subword fragments of complex proper names or technical terms
patterns.context: Long, rare disease names or non-English words are split into multiple tokens; they lack shared semantics and may be associated with rare word forms or subword spellings.

patterns.name: declaration in code documentation
patterns.context: In code comments describing JavaScript syntax features, declaration refers to a function declaration; the same passage also contains a template file path and descriptive comments.

patterns.name: Account of concealed money in an informal email
patterns.context: Urges Fuller to pay and claims the other party hid money somewhere; the email has an informal tone.

patterns.name: Age description in a medical case title
patterns.context: A case title beginning with “Visual diagnosis” highlights the patient's age and gender.

4_705.description: 激活分布于多种文体：显著涉及 declaration、复杂术语子词及代码中的 function declaration，也包括邮件语句和病例标题的年龄短语；未见单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 医学或研究标题中的 declaration

patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、医学论文、新闻

patterns.name: 复杂专名或技术术语的子词片段
patterns.context: 长而罕见的疾病名或非英语词被拆分为多个 token；缺乏共同语义，可能与罕见词形或子词拼写有关。
patterns.domain: 医学术语、斯洛文尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 代码文档中的 declaration
patterns.context: 描述 JavaScript 语法特性的代码注释中，declaration 指函数声明；同段另有模板文件路径和描述性注释。

patterns.name: 非正式邮件中的隐藏钱款叙述

patterns.name: 医学病例标题中的年龄描述

en.concept: declaration word forms and split fragments
en.description: The most salient activations center on different uses of declaration, alongside fragments of split medical words, words in medical titles, and thanks and name fragments in emails; these span domains and contexts, with no unified semantics evident.

patterns.name: declaration and related collocations
patterns.context: Used in medical corpora for formally named ethical or research declarations; also occurs in news statements, legal testimony, and function declarations in code. The trigger word appears across contexts, not just in one sense.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in diseases or medical terminology
patterns.context: Activations may fall within medical words split by tokenization or on words in medical titles; there is no stable shared medical semantics, and the pattern may be related to word-form fragments or title formatting.

patterns.name: Name fragments and polite sign-offs in emails
patterns.context: Names in email closings and headers are split into subwords; their connection to trigger forms in other passages is unclear.

4_705.description: 显著触发主要集中于 declaration 的不同用法，也散见于拆分的医学词、医学标题词，以及邮件中的 thanks 和人名片段；跨领域、跨语境，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: declaration及相关搭配
patterns.context: 医学语料中用于正式命名的伦理宣言或研究宣言；新闻中的声明；法律证词；代码中的函数声明。触发词本身跨语境出现，并非只限某一义项。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、新闻、法律、编程

patterns.name: 疾病或医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活可落在被分词拆开的医学词内部或医学标题中的词上；没有稳定的共同医学语义，可能与词形片段或标题格式有关。

patterns.name: 邮件中的姓名片段及礼貌收尾
patterns.context: 邮件正文收尾及邮件头中的人名被拆分成子词；与其他段的触发形式没有清楚联系。

en.description: Activation is distributed across multiple domains and word classes: in-word fragments (especially ust), disease and age terms, proper nouns and Path, as well as declaration, technical terms, and common email words; no stable semantic pattern covers all fragments.

patterns.name: In-word subword fragment ust
patterns.context: Activation falls on the contiguous subword fragment ust within words; word beginnings, endings, and surrounding meanings vary, with no consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, email, Slovenian parliamentary texts

patterns.name: In-word fragment in a disease name
patterns.context: In the medical term neurocysticercosis, activation is located on an in-word fragment.

patterns.name: Age word in a pediatric title
patterns.context: The case title describes a six-month-old boy; activation concentrates on old, and related words also activate.

patterns.name: Name ending in a headline
patterns.context: Activation appears in names of people and places in a news dispatch lead, especially strongly on Delhi.

patterns.name: Path in a name or term
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the name “Pathology Core” in institutional funding text.

patterns.name: Medical ethics declaration names
patterns.context: Refers to St. Vincent declaration and Declaration of Helsinki, respectively; the same word also appears in a political news context.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and main text of medical papers

patterns.name: declaration in political text
patterns.context: Refers to a condemned statement and appears in political reporting about the Islamization of Europe and the Turkish president.

patterns.name: has and thanks in email
patterns.context: An informal payment-chasing email mentions someone hiding money and ends with thanks; activation is scattered across ordinary words.

patterns.name: Inverse-problem expression
patterns.context: A technical expression in the title of an optical scattering study.

4_705.description: 激活分布在多种领域与词类上：既有词内片段（尤其 ust）、疾病与年龄词、专名和 Path，也有 declaration、技术术语及邮件常用词；未见能覆盖全部片段的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段 ust

patterns.name: 儿科标题中的年龄词

patterns.name: 标题中的专名词尾

en.description: Activations are distributed across in-word subword fragments, the email acknowledgment “OK,” and a few common function words and punctuation marks, across domains and inconsistent contexts.

patterns.name: Initial and subsequent subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments within split words or on initial fragments; subsequent fragments may not activate. The specific word forms and positions are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including medicine, organization names, news, place names, and email names

patterns.name: Brief acknowledgment
patterns.context: “OK” appears alone at the beginning of an email body, sometimes followed immediately by a period.

patterns.name: Common function words and punctuation
patterns.context: These words or punctuation marks occur in different syntactic positions, with no clear shared context.

4_705.description: 激活分散在词内子词片段、邮件确认语“OK”以及少量常见功能词和标点上，跨领域且上下文不一致。

patterns.name: 词首与后续子词片段

patterns.name: 常见功能词及标点
patterns.context: 这些词或标点在不同句法位置出现，缺乏共同的明显语境

en.description: Activation concentrates on emphatic expressions, especially “remarkably” modifying a following description; the rest is distributed across phrases being discussed or highlighted and one rhetorical question at the end of a quotation, with no unified lexical category.

patterns.name: Emphatic use of remarkably
patterns.context: Used as a degree adverb modifying a subsequent evaluative or descriptive expression; sometimes activates together with the following text.

patterns.name: Highlighted words in quotations or discussions
patterns.context: In dialogue or technical text, marks locally emphasized, explained, or discussed phrases; trigger words vary.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, Q&A, and academic texts

patterns.name: Rhetorical question punctuation at the end of a quotation
patterns.context: A quotation of a saying ends with a question mark, with activation near the end of the quotation; may relate to a rhetorical question or quotation boundary.

4_705.description: 激活集中于强调性表达，尤其是修饰后续描述的“remarkably”；其余分布在被讨论或突出的词组，以及一处引语反问末尾，未显示统一词汇类别。

patterns.name: remarkably 的强调用法

patterns.name: 引述或讨论中的突出词语

patterns.name: 引语末尾的反问标点
patterns.context: 引用一句格言后以问号收尾，激活落在引语末端附近；可能与反问或引语边界有关。

en.description: The most stable trigger is because, often in causal or explanatory clauses and across multiple genres. There is also email header formatting and a few contexts describing differences, asymptomatic disease, or concern; passage topics are not consistent.

patterns.name: Causal conjunction because
patterns.context: Appears in clauses explaining causes, motives, or system errors; its local syntactic position varies, and it often introduces a reason or condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: email, academic abstracts, news discussions, forums, and software error text

patterns.name: Describing differences and variation
patterns.context: Discusses differences in results, characteristics, or group conditions, or expresses concern about something; passage 2 is clearest, and passage 7 may also be related.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts; quotes in news reports

patterns.name: Email formatting and recipient fields
patterns.context: Appears near email headers and body boundaries; the body concerns requests, correspondence, or personal communication.

patterns.name: Other uses in causal explanations
patterns.context: Explains preceding text by citing a specific event or state; topics vary and cannot be grouped into a more specific common topic.
patterns.domain: Work emails, personal emails, historical discussions, trading emails, and software error messages

4_705.description: 最稳定的触发是 because，常出现在原因或解释从句中，横跨多种文体。另有邮件头格式，以及少量描述差异、疾病无症状或担忧的语境；各段主题并不统一。

patterns.name: 因果连词 because

patterns.name: 邮件格式与收件人字段

en.concept: Electrostatic-related vocabulary and miscellaneous academic text

patterns.name: Introduction or abstract structure marker

patterns.name: civil rights and historical period

patterns.name: Chemical structures and molecular-change terms

patterns.name: General academic argumentation and theoretical language

patterns.name: Degree or effect verbs in research abstracts
patterns.context: Each appears in a different context, describing increased interaction, tumor nutritional status, and social concern, respectively; they cannot currently be grouped under a common trigger condition.

patterns.name: Food compliance and religious dietary practices

4_705.concept: 静电相关词汇及杂项学术文本
