patterns.context: 代码中拼接字符串、构造正则表达式或处理函数定义；激活落在字符串边界和相关代码片段上。

patterns.name: 引号中的连字符选项
patterns.context: 代码将单个连字符作为命令行参数或字符串值进行比较。

patterns.name: 引号中的实验符号
patterns.context: 实验图表说明中，将减号与实验条件标签并列比较。

patterns.name: 加减号分量
patterns.context: 理论物理公式中讨论演化所包含的正、负分量，符号带引号强调。

patterns.name: ID 字符集合中的连字符
patterns.context: 代码错误提示描述 ID 可含数字、连字符和小写字母，连字符作为字面字符列举。

patterns.name: 字符解析中的括号与连字符
patterns.context: 代码逐字符解析字符串，检查开头的大括号或连字符。

patterns.name: 专利叙述中的方向观察
patterns.context: 描述输送物从上方观察时与螺旋输送机纵轴对齐。

patterns.name: 脂质术语与年份短语
patterns.context: 图注或科学叙述中出现脂质代谢术语及年份短语；触发原因不明显。

en.concept: Local text fragments and symbol boundaries
en.description: Activations are scattered across in-word fragments and around quotation marks and proper nouns; they also occur in code/math symbols, measurement parameters, structured encoding, and scientific text. The fragments lack a stable shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Short fragments within letters or words
patterns.context: Activations fall within complete words or proper nouns, at word endings, or on short fragments adjacent to words; contextual requirements are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language, including encyclopedias, forums, religious narratives, papers, and research abstracts

patterns.name: Quotation marks and quotation boundaries
patterns.context: Direct quotations inside or outside quotation marks, or discussion of whether quoted content is verbatim; activations also occur near proper nouns and honorifics in quotations.

patterns.name: Mathematical and logical symbols
patterns.context: Activations occur near symbols, numbers, and type names in code comparisons, mathematical object definitions, or numerical calculations.
patterns.domain: Programming discussions and math papers, math-solving Q&A

patterns.name: Structured parameters and measurement units
patterns.context: Multi-spin-echo imaging parameters are introduced by a colon and followed by fields for values, units, ranges, and matrices.

patterns.name: Highly structured encoded strings
patterns.context: Activations occur in dense alphanumeric identifiers, asterisks, and split field text, rather than ordinary sentence structure.
patterns.domain: Biomedical databases or structured laboratory records

patterns.name: Parentheses, quotation marks, and repeated headwords after titles or names
patterns.context: Short titles or proper nouns are introduced, parenthesized, or repeated; there are also code fences, log snippets, and operator examples.

patterns.name: LAI-PrEP-related wording and anomalous question marks
patterns.context: Discusses social and sexual networks among young Black MSM in Chicago’s South Side, and whether willingness to use LAI-PrEP is influenced by network position; the text contains an anomalous question-mark form.

patterns.name: Local numerical activation that does not fit a stable theme
patterns.context: Appears only in one solution process and does not show a clear semantic trigger shared with other patterns.

patterns.name: Arabic historical and geographical proper nouns and transliteration characters
patterns.context: Place names, deity names, and ancient characters appear in an ancient South Arabian context; character sequences contain inactive markers.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia history and ancient script entries

4_864.concept: 局部文本片段与符号边界
4_864.description: 激活分散在词内片段、引号和专名附近，也见于代码/数学符号、计量参数、结构化编码及科研文本；不同片段间缺少稳定共享的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 字母或词内部的短片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整单词或专名内部、词尾，或与词相邻的短片段上；上下文要求并不一致。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言，包括百科、论坛、宗教叙述、论文和科研摘要

patterns.name: 引号及引述边界
patterns.context: 引号内外的直接引语或对引述内容是否为逐字复述的讨论；激活也出现在引文中的专名、敬称附近。

patterns.name: 数学及逻辑符号
patterns.context: 代码比较运算、数学对象定义或数值计算中，符号、数字及类型名称附近出现激活。
patterns.domain: 编程讨论与数学论文、数学求解问答

patterns.name: 结构化参数与计量单位
patterns.context: 多自旋回波成像参数以冒号引出，后接数值、单位、范围与矩阵等字段。

patterns.name: 高度结构化的编码串
patterns.context: 激活出现在密集的字母数字标识、星号和被拆分的字段文本中，而非普通句子结构。
patterns.domain: 生物医学数据库或实验室结构化记录

patterns.name: 标题或名称后的括号、引号及重复词头
patterns.context: 短标题或专名被引出、括注或重复；另有代码围栏、日志片段及运算符示例。

patterns.name: LAI-PrEP相关措辞及问号异常
patterns.context: 讨论芝加哥南区年轻非裔MSM的社会与性网络，以及使用LAI-PrEP意愿是否受网络位置影响；文本中出现异常的问号形式。

patterns.name: 无法归入稳定主题的局部数值激活
patterns.context: 仅见于一次解题过程中的算式，未显现与其他模式共有的明确语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 阿拉伯史地专名与转写字符
patterns.context: 古代南阿拉伯背景中出现地名、神名及古文字字符，字符序列混有未激活标记。

en.description: Primarily responds to operators, delimiters, and dense symbols in code, as well as numbers, units, and specialized notation in scientific text; also appears in wording for material preparation steps and discussion of verbatim quotations.

patterns.name: Code operators and punctuation
patterns.context: Operators, delimiters, brackets, and parameter assignments appear densely in code or regular expressions.

patterns.name: Scientific data and parameter notation
patterns.context: Numbers occur alongside specialized symbols, units, or terms in chemistry, experimental parameters, or mathematical definitions.

patterns.name: Process steps and material terminology
patterns.context: Describes sample treatment or preparation procedures, including step order and material names.

patterns.name: Paraphrase and quotation wording
patterns.context: Discusses whether transmitted content is quoted verbatim and the distinction between quotation and paraphrase.
patterns.domain: Religious historical sources or discussions of transmission

4_864.concept: 结构化技术文本中的标记
4_864.description: 主要对代码中的运算符、分隔符和密集符号，以及科学文本中的数值、单位与专门记法起反应；另见材料制备步骤措辞和讨论逐字引述的表达。

patterns.name: 代码运算符与标点
patterns.context: 代码或正则表达式中，运算符、分隔符、括号及参数赋值等符号密集出现

patterns.name: 科学数据与参数记法
patterns.context: 化学、实验参数或数学定义中，数字与专门符号、单位或术语并列

patterns.name: 工艺步骤与材料术语
patterns.context: 描述样品处理或制备流程，出现步骤顺序和材料名称

patterns.name: 转述与引文措辞
patterns.context: 讨论传述内容是否逐字引用，以及引文与转述的区别

en.description: Activations are scattered across code and text: quotation marks, hyphens, equals signs, and other boundary symbols stand out; percent encoding, dotted version handling, and comparison errors also appear, alongside isolated items such as believe, material symbols, and grown.

patterns.name: Hyphens and quotation boundaries
patterns.context: A hyphen enclosed in single quotes, an equals sign, or quotation marks adjacent to punctuation appears in code or text; activations often fall on the hyphen, quotation marks, equals sign, or neighboring punctuation.

patterns.name: Percent-encoded strings
patterns.context: A percent sign followed by hexadecimal characters forms a URL-encoded or similar long string.
patterns.domain: Encoded strings/suspected email address processing code

patterns.name: Dotted version numbers and join
patterns.context: A period acts as a delimiter in code that splits version strings or joins segments with periods.

patterns.name: Python comparison operator error
patterns.context: An error message reports that <= comparison is unsupported between instances of different types; activation falls on the comparison expression.

patterns.name: The word believe
patterns.context: In the English rhetorical question “Don’t believe me?”, followed by a search result description.

patterns.name: Materials chemistry symbols and wavelength-shift word
patterns.context: A chemical formula/composition notation in a materials paper is followed by a description of the sample and blueshift.

4_864.concept: 标点与特殊字符串片段
4_864.description: 激活分散于代码和文本：突出引号、连字符、等号等边界符号，也见百分号编码、点分版本处理、比较错误；另有 believe、材料符号及 grown 等孤立词项。

patterns.name: 连字符与引号边界
patterns.context: 代码或文本中出现单引号包围的连字符、等号，或引号与标点相邻；激活常落在连字符、引号、等号或邻接标点上。

patterns.name: 百分号编码串
patterns.context: 百分号后接十六进制字符，形成 URL 编码或类似编码的长串。
patterns.domain: 编码字符串/疑似邮件地址处理代码

patterns.name: 点分版本号与 join
patterns.context: 点号作为分隔符，出现在版本字符串切分或以点连接片段的代码中。

patterns.name: Python 比较符报错
patterns.context: 错误信息指出不同类型实例之间不支持 <= 比较；触发落在比较符表达式。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答/异常文本

patterns.name: 单词 believe
patterns.context: 英语叙述中的反问句“Don’t believe me?”，紧接搜索结果说明。

patterns.name: 材料化学符号与波长位移词
patterns.context: 材料论文语境中的化学式/组分记号，之后描述样品和 blueshift。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple formats: medical thresholds, numbers and units, Objective-C format strings, MRI echo/section terminology, and regular expressions and LaTeX. A possible commonality is sensitivity to structured symbols, delimiters, and nearby content, but the patterns are not fully unified.

patterns.name: Inequality and comparison symbols
patterns.context: Comparison symbols express thresholds for age, years, number of ribs, and similar quantities; numbers and units often occur nearby, though not every instance is fully marked.

patterns.name: Numbers, measurement units, and statistical values
patterns.context: Values occur near units, demographic data, or parameters, often in abstracts describing methods, results, and thresholds.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and medical imaging methods

patterns.name: Objective-C format strings and object output
patterns.context: Activations occur near format specifiers, string formatting, and printing object information in Objective-C code.

patterns.name: Section and echo in medical terminology
patterns.context: In MRI acquisition parameter contexts, terminology appears alongside colons, commas, units, and values.

patterns.name: Punctuation-dense regular-expression symbol sequences
patterns.context: Multiple escape characters, quantifiers, parentheses, and vertical bars appear consecutively, forming regular expressions or similar pattern text.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical expressions and typesetting commands
patterns.context: Alignment symbols at line beginnings, superscript and subscript variables, and spacing/typesetting commands appear in equation environments.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics or technical paper source

4_864.concept: 结构化符号与格式文本
4_864.description: 激活分散在多种格式中：医学阈值、数字和单位，Objective-C 格式字符串，MRI 的 echo/section 术语，以及正则表达式和 LaTeX。共同点可能是对结构化符号、分隔符及其邻近内容敏感，但各模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 不等号与比较关系符号
patterns.context: 比较符号用于表达年龄、年限、肋骨数量等阈值；符号附近常有数字和单位，但不是每处都完整标记。

patterns.name: 数字、计量单位与统计数值
patterns.context: 数值和单位、人口统计资料或参数相邻，常见于摘要中的方法、结果及阈值描述。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要及医学影像方法

patterns.name: Objective-C 格式化字符串及对象输出
patterns.context: Objective-C 代码中，格式占位符、字符串格式化及打印对象信息附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 section 与 echo
patterns.trigger: “single-section multispin echo”“stepped echo time”“echo spacing”“acquisition matrix”
patterns.context: MRI 采集参数语境，术语与冒号、逗号、单位及数值并列。

patterns.name: 标点密集的正则表达式符号序列
patterns.context: 多个转义符、量词、括号和竖线连续排列，构成正则表达式或类似模式的文本。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学表达式与排版命令
patterns.context: 行首对齐符号、上标下标变量及间距/排版命令出现在公式环境中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学或技术论文源码

en.concept: Text and symbol fragments across domains
en.description: Activations are distributed across several different features: expressions of disbelief or reservation in comments; academic citations and discussions of model performance; mathematical formulas, programming code, and medical descriptions of diseases and clinical trial information.

patterns.name: “believe” and negation
patterns.context: Appears in response to a preceding claim, inference, or suggestion; often follows first-person expressions such as I or I think, indicating disagreement or reservation.
patterns.domain: HackerNews dialogue and online comments; informal Pile-CC text

patterns.name: English academic citations and evidence statements
patterns.context: Cites authors or literature and states observations or research conclusions; includes author names, citation markers, and technical terms.

patterns.name: Bayes model condition comparisons
patterns.context: Discusses differences in performance relative to the standard Bayes method when models are correct or incorrect.

patterns.name: Scientific symbols and formula typesetting
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX mathematical formulas containing variables, integrals, radicals, and equation labels.

patterns.name: Gene therapy and disease names
patterns.context: Introduces rare diseases, treatments, and their full names or abbreviations.

patterns.name: Objective-C formatting code
patterns.context: Format strings and object placeholders in code examples.

patterns.name: Clinical trial enrollment and numerical criteria
patterns.context: Abstracts report patients’ prior treatments, sample sizes, and clinical or laboratory enrollment criteria.

4_864.concept: 多领域文本与符号片段
4_864.description: 激活分布在数种不同特征上：评论中表达不相信或保留判断；学术引文与模型表现论述；数学公式、编程代码，以及医学中的疾病介绍和临床试验信息。

patterns.name: “believe”及否定表达
patterns.context: 出现在对前述主张、推断或建议的回应中；常跟随 I、I think 等第一人称表达，表示不认同或保留判断。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 对话及网络评论；Pile-CC 非正式文字

patterns.name: 英文学术引文与证据陈述
patterns.context: 引述作者或文献，并陈述观测结果或研究结论；包含作者名、引用标记和专业术语。

patterns.name: Bayes 模型条件比较
patterns.context: 讨论模型正确或不正确时，相对标准 Bayes 方法的表现差异。

patterns.name: 科学符号与公式排版
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学公式中，含变量、积分、根号和方程标签。

patterns.name: 基因治疗与疾病名称
patterns.trigger: “ex-vivo stem cell gene therapy”“ADA-SCID”“Adenosine Deaminase deficiency”
patterns.context: 介绍罕见病、治疗方式及其全称或缩写。

patterns.name: Objective-C 格式化代码
patterns.context: 代码示例中的格式化字符串及对象占位符。

patterns.name: 临床试验入组与数值标准
patterns.trigger: “little or no previous therapy”“Six hundred seventeen patients”“CD4 cell count”
patterns.context: 摘要报告患者既往治疗情况、样本人数及临床或实验室入组指标。

en.concept: Structural and syntactic cues across domains
en.description: Activations are scattered across papers and code, often on punctuation, function words, and formal research prose. Specific content includes astrophysics, biophysics, paper cross-references, and Markdown, Shell, Python, and Objective-C code; no unified specialized topic is apparent.

patterns.name: Quotation marks, parentheses, and marker symbols
patterns.context: Appear at text boundaries, in code syntax, citations, or mathematical expressions; both symbols and neighboring tokens are activated in multiple excerpts.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; paper typesetting, code, and mathematical text

patterns.name: English function words and syntactic connections
patterns.context: Often occur in English phrases, clauses, or coordination structures, suggesting sporadic responses to local syntax and frequent function words, but with substantial variation across contexts.
patterns.domain: English text in papers, code comments, and other sources

patterns.name: Methods, reporting, and research statements in academic papers
patterns.context: Formal statements in research papers describing objectives, prior findings, samples, or analytical steps.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, biophysics, and dust-radiation research papers

patterns.name: Galaxies, celestial objects, and astronomical observation terms
patterns.context: Contexts involving galaxies, celestial object classes, observational samples, or astronomical catalogs.

patterns.name: Segmented citations and section/table references
patterns.context: Cross-references to sections, tables, or bibliography labels in papers, often accompanied by numbers and parentheses.

patterns.name: Thick- versus thin-shell model comparison
patterns.context: Repeatedly compares thick-shell and thin-shell models and reports the corresponding electron density.

patterns.name: Ion and cell-membrane transport mechanisms
patterns.context: Diffusion of ions and water across the cell wall, and mechanisms by which cells expel NaCl.
patterns.domain: Biophysics and cell physiology research plan

patterns.name: Markdown paragraph-processing code
patterns.context: Code defines or modifies GitHub-flavored Markdown paragraph parsing rules, including regular expressions.

patterns.name: Command-line arguments and path handling
patterns.context: Shell startup scripts or Python methods branch based on arguments, paths, and file status.
patterns.domain: Github source code and command-line tools

patterns.name: Objective-C image object operations
patterns.context: Code reads the number of images, shuffles them, and prints the result.

patterns.name: Dust spinning and radiative transfer
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of gas ionization state, dust grain spinning, and radiative transfer on dust emission.

4_864.concept: 多领域文本中的结构与语法线索
4_864.description: 激活分散于论文和代码，常落在标点、功能词及正式研究表述；具体内容涵盖天体物理、生物物理、论文交叉引用，以及 Markdown、Shell、Python、Objective-C 代码，未见统一专门主题。

patterns.name: 引号、括号及标记符号
patterns.context: 在文本边界、代码语法、引用或数学表达式中出现；多个片段中符号与邻近 token 都有激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；论文排版、代码及数学文本

patterns.name: 英文功能词与句法连接
patterns.context: 常见于英文短语、从句或并列结构中，似乎对局部句法和高频功能词有零散响应，但不同语境差异较大。
patterns.domain: 论文 prose 与代码注释等英文文本

patterns.name: 学术论文中的方法、报告与研究表述
patterns.context: 研究论文中描述研究目的、既有发现、样本或分析步骤的正式表述。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、生物物理及尘埃辐射研究论文

patterns.name: 星系、天体与天文观测术语
patterns.context: 围绕星系、天体类别、观测样本或天文目录的语境。

patterns.name: 分段引用及章节、表格指引
patterns.context: 论文中指向章节、表格或文献标签的交叉引用，常伴随数字和括号符号。

patterns.name: shell 厚薄模型对照
patterns.context: 重复比较厚壳与薄壳模型，并报告相应电子密度。

patterns.name: 离子与细胞膜转运机制
patterns.context: 细胞壁内外离子和水的扩散，以及细胞排出 NaCl 的机制。
patterns.domain: 生物物理与细胞生理研究计划

patterns.name: Markdown 段落处理代码
patterns.context: 代码中定义或修改 GitHub-flavored Markdown 段落解析规则，包含正则表达式。

patterns.name: 命令行参数与路径处理
patterns.context: Shell 启动脚本或 Python 方法根据参数、路径和文件状态分支处理。
patterns.domain: Github 源代码与命令行工具

patterns.name: Objective-C 图像对象操作
patterns.context: 读取图像数量、打乱图像并打印结果的代码片段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 Objective-C 编程问答

patterns.name: 尘埃自旋与辐射转移
patterns.trigger: «spinning motion»、«grains»、«gas ionisation state»、«radiative transfer»、«spinning dust emission»
patterns.context: 讨论气体电离状态、尘埃粒子自旋及辐射转移对尘埃发射的影响。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: academic paper organization, reviews, and discussion are relatively concentrated; others involve research surveys, legal evidence, code editing, and various biomedical and astronomy topics. No shared semantic trigger accounts for all passages.

patterns.name: Paper structure and section reviews
patterns.context: An academic paper introduces its section structure or says that it will review or present a part of the content; common trigger words include briefly, review, section.

patterns.name: Review or discussion of prior work
patterns.context: Mentions prior discussions, existing research, or a review of methods; may also appear alongside an introduction to paper structure.

patterns.name: Research, survey, or experimental activity
patterns.context: Describes proposed research or completed surveys, analyses, and experimental procedures.

patterns.name: edit calls in paragraph-editing code
patterns.context: Code edits or replaces GFM paragraph content; activation falls on edit and nearby syntax fragments.

patterns.name: Legal evidence and discrediting
patterns.context: A court reasons that the factfinder may have a legitimate reason, based on the evidence, to disbelieve an employer’s statements.

patterns.name: Local release and debridement in medical materials
patterns.context: Describes an antibiotic carrier locally releasing a drug at an infection site and filling the dead space caused by debridement.

patterns.name: Supernova bursts and astronomical observations
patterns.context: Discusses giant flares in local galaxies, searches for rare astronomical objects, and observation catalogs.

patterns.name: Ion efflux mechanism
patterns.context: Explains that cells must expel salt and water due to osmosis, and proposes studying the mechanism.

patterns.name: Animal tissue staining and markers
patterns.context: Uses immunofluorescence and glial and neuronal markers to analyze bovine tissue samples.

patterns.name: Fragmented or difficult-to-interpret text
patterns.context: Context includes split words, markup, or code regex fragments, making it difficult to determine whether activation corresponds to a specific semantic feature.

4_864.concept: 论文结构与研究叙述（局部）
4_864.description: 激活模式分散：学术论文的章节安排、回顾和讨论较集中；其余涉及研究调查、法律证据、代码编辑及多类生物医学和天文学内容。没有足以覆盖全部段落的共同语义触发。

patterns.name: 论文结构与章节回顾
patterns.trigger: “This paper is organized as follows”“in section”“briefly review”“conclusions and discussions”
patterns.context: 学术论文中介绍章节安排，或说明将回顾、呈现某部分内容；常见触发词包括 briefly、review、section。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，主要为 ArXiv；段 1、2、7、9

patterns.name: 回顾或讨论既有工作
patterns.trigger: “see discussion above”“as it is discussed”“briefly review”
patterns.context: 提及先前讨论、已有研究或方法回顾；也可能与论文结构介绍同时出现。

patterns.name: 研究、调查或实验活动
patterns.trigger: “is proposed to investigate”“was investigated”“analysis was conducted”
patterns.context: 描述拟开展的研究或已实施的调查、分析及实验流程。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与项目摘要

patterns.name: 段落编辑代码中的 edit 调用
patterns.context: 代码对 GFM 段落内容进行编辑、替换；激活落在 edit 及邻近语法片段。

patterns.name: 法律证据与不采信
patterns.context: 法院论证事实认定者可基于证据不相信雇主陈述的合法理由。

patterns.name: 医学材料中的局部释放与清创
patterns.context: 描述抗生素载体在感染局部释放药物，并填补清创造成的死腔。

patterns.name: 超新星爆发与天文观测
patterns.context: 讨论局部星系中的巨耀发、稀有天体搜寻及观测目录。

patterns.name: 离子外排机制
patterns.trigger: “pump out the NaCl and water”“ionic mechanism for NaCl extrusion”
patterns.context: 解释细胞因渗透作用而需外排盐和水，并提出研究其机制。

patterns.name: 动物组织染色与标记物
patterns.context: 用免疫荧光和神经胶质、神经元标记物分析牛组织样本。

patterns.name: 碎片化或难以判定的文本
patterns.context: 上下文包含词语被切分、标记或代码正则片段，难以判断激活是否对应具体语义。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 排版/OCR 碎片及代码

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical subword fragments, code punctuation and line breaks, academic paper structure terms, mathematical logic symbols, and threshold comparisons; there is no single stable semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Medical text concerning infection, osteomyelitis, or joint replacement treatment; strongest activation is on «brid» in de«brid»ement.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax tokens in code
patterns.context: Appears in code, regular expressions, or code comments; trigger points are often line breaks, operators, quotation marks, and punctuation. Also includes variable fragments «numbers», «At».
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A and GitHub code

patterns.name: Paper structure and discourse terms
patterns.context: Academic paper body or conclusion discussing models, structure, results, discussion, and section organization.

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and logical symbols
patterns.context: Functions, distance axioms, or definitional conditions expressed with mathematical symbols.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers or formalized philosophical text

patterns.name: Threshold comparisons
patterns.context: Age or duration categories expressed as comparison conditions such as “> or = 9 years”.

4_864.concept: 异质文本结构与符号
4_864.description: 激活分散于医学词片段、代码标点与换行、学术论文结构用语、数学逻辑符号及阈值比较表达；没有单一稳定的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 感染、骨髓炎或关节置换治疗相关的医学文本；其中尤以 de«brid»ement（清创）中的 «brid» 激活最强。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与语法 token
patterns.context: 出现在代码、正则表达式或代码注释中，触发点多为换行、运算符、引号及标点；也包括变量片段 «numbers»、«At»。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答与 GitHub 代码

patterns.name: 论文结构与论述用语
patterns.trigger: « discussions»、« section»、« conclusions»、« models»、« pattern»、« show»、« evolutions»
patterns.context: 学术论文正文或结尾，涉及模型、结构、结果、讨论和章节安排。

patterns.name: 数学定义与逻辑符号
patterns.context: 用数学符号表述函数、距离公理或定义条件。
patterns.domain: 数学论文或哲学形式化文本

patterns.name: 阈值比较表达
patterns.context: 年龄或年限类别以“> or = 9 years”一类比较条件呈现。

en.description: Activations are scattered across clauses describing research goals or inquiry, proposals or suggestions, as well as formula symbols, physical thresholds, legal “disbelieve,” and cross-references to discussion in papers; they span domains and have no unified meaning.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial research intent or proposal
patterns.context: When describing research plans, hypotheses, or explanations, a relevant word is followed by a that-clause; examples include “proposed that” in [3], “hoped that” in [7], and “suggested that” in [8].

patterns.name: Research goals and inquiry verbs
patterns.context: In research objectives or plans, markers indicate research aims, mechanistic inquiry, or follow-up analysis; examples include STUDY OBJECTIVE / explore in [1], Specific Aims / examine in [6], aim / investigate in [7], and Investigation of in [10].
patterns.domain: Medical and natural science abstracts, grant applications, and papers

patterns.name: Local formulas and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Inside mathematical expressions, formula symbols and typesetting markers occur adjacent to one another; there is no natural-language research-intent context.

patterns.name: Evidence and employment rationale in legal decisions
patterns.context: In litigation arguments, describes how a factfinder may disbelieve the legitimate reason offered by an employer; co-occurs with “evidence” and “factfinder.”

patterns.name: Mathematical notation for a numerical threshold
patterns.context: In astrophysics texts, denotes a possible MeV energy threshold, embedded in a list of observed phenomena.

patterns.name: Specific terms in results or methods discussion
patterns.context: In “see discussion above,” refers to an earlier discussion; no clearly matching context with other trigger patterns is evident.

4_864.concept: 学术文本中的显著标记
4_864.description: 激活分散于研究目标/探究、提出或建议的从句，也包括公式符号、物理阈值、法律中的disbelieve及论文交叉引用discussion；跨领域且无统一词义。

patterns.name: 句首研究意图或提议
patterns.context: 在描述研究计划、推测或解释时，相关词后接 that 从句；[3] 中 proposed that，[7] 中 hoped that，[8] 中 suggested that。

patterns.name: 研究目标与调查动词
patterns.context: 研究目标或计划中，标记研究目的、机制探究或后续分析；[1] 中 STUDY OBJECTIVE / explore，[6] 中 Specific Aims / examine，[7] 中 aim / investigate，[10] 中 Investigation of。
patterns.domain: 医学与自然科学摘要、基金申请及论文

patterns.name: 局部公式与数学符号
patterns.context: 数学表达式内部，公式符号和排版标记邻接；无自然语言研究意图语境。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的证据与雇佣理由
patterns.context: 在诉讼论述中，说明事实审理者可能不相信雇主提出的正当理由；与 evidence、factfinder 同现。

patterns.name: 数量阈值的数学记号
patterns.context: 天体物理文本中表示可能的 MeV 能量阈值，嵌在观测现象的列举中。

patterns.name: 结果或方法讨论中的特定术语
patterns.context: 在“see discussion above”中指向前文讨论；未见与其他触发模式明确相同的上下文。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: “It is hoped” in research plans, verbs of academic argument, legal dispute terms, patent description terms, numerical symbols, and several internal word fragments and heading markers; no unified semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: “It is hoped” after expectations, arguments, or plans
patterns.context: The preceding text describes research objectives, experimental plans, or mechanisms, followed by “It is hoped” to express an expected outcome; activation is concentrated on hoped.
patterns.domain: Research grant abstracts, biomedical research plans

patterns.name: Claim verbs in argumentative or debate text
patterns.context: Introduces an argument or claim made by another party or the author; argued/claimed are the most strongly activated tokens in two paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, including physics and signal processing

patterns.name: Disputed status in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in a federal civil litigation opinion, referring to a matter disputed by the parties; the word happens to be a strongly activated token near a paragraph boundary.

patterns.name: Step markers in procedural descriptions
patterns.context: Patent background text describes a programming pulse verification process and introduces a figure; activation is concentrated in an internal word fragment.

patterns.name: Numbers and comparison symbols in numerical or symbolic expressions
patterns.context: Astrophysics text describes possible observed radiation, with strong activation on a mathematical/numerical expression.

patterns.name: Internal word fragment in a Dutch parliamentary heading
patterns.context: Appears in a Dutch heading about gender equality in the European Parliament, followed by a line break and speaker marker; no local semantic cue shared with the other excerpts is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-final or terminological fragments in general academic text
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of sparsity and comparisons of constitutive relations; activation is scattered across word endings, abbreviations, or internal term fragments, with no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Terminological fragments about perception and conceptual content
patterns.context: Discusses proprioception, perception, and nonconceptual content; multiple perception-related words are marked, but activation is especially concentrated on an internal fragment in “nonconceptual”.
patterns.domain: Philosophy papers, perception and consciousness research

4_864.concept: none
4_864.description: 激活模式分散：研究计划中的“It is hoped”、学术论证动词、法律争议词、专利说明词、数值符号，以及若干词内片段和标题标记；尚无统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 预期、论证或计划之后的「It is hoped」
patterns.context: 前文说明研究目标、实验方案或机制，随后用“It is hoped”表达预期结果；标记集中在 hoped。
patterns.domain: 科研资助摘要、生物医学研究计划

patterns.name: 争论或论证文本中的主张动词
patterns.context: 引出对方或作者提出的论点、主张；两个段落中 argued/claimed 为最强激活 token。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，涉及物理学与信号处理

patterns.name: 法律文书中的争议状态
patterns.context: 出现在联邦民事诉讼判决叙述中，指当事人争议的事项；该词恰是段落切分处附近的强激活 token。

patterns.name: 程序说明中的步骤标记
patterns.context: 专利背景中说明编程脉冲验证过程，并引出附图；激活集中在词内分段。

patterns.name: 数值或符号表达中的数字与比较符号
patterns.context: 天体物理文本描述观测到的可能辐射，强激活落在数学/数值表达中。

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在欧洲议会关于男女平等的荷兰语标题，随后接换行与发言人标记；未见与其他段一致的局部语义线索。

patterns.name: 一般学术文本中的词尾或术语片段
patterns.trigger: «ity»（“sparsity”）；«ma»（文献标记中的片段）；«relations»相关片段
patterns.context: 分别见稀疏性讨论与 constitutive relations 比较；激活分散在词尾、缩写或术语内部，未形成明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 感知与概念内容的术语片段
patterns.context: 讨论本体感觉、知觉及非概念内容，多个感知相关词有标记，但强度尤其集中于“nonconceptual”中的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文，知觉与意识研究

en.concept: Expressions of expectation and argumentation in academic research
en.description: The strongest shared pattern is the non-personal academic phrasing “It is hoped” in research plans and “It is shown/proved” in papers; other activations are scattered across research goals, scientific terminology, title subword fragments, and astrophysical values.

patterns.name: Hope phrasing in research plans
patterns.context: Appears after descriptions of research objectives, experimental designs, or research plans, introducing an expected contribution or result; “hoped” is the salient activation point.
patterns.domain: NIH grant applications and life sciences research plans

patterns.name: Proof or demonstration phrasing in papers
patterns.context: Uses passive or impersonal phrasing to state a proof of a mathematical relation or a result demonstrated in a paper.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially theoretical physics, mathematics, and scientific computing

patterns.name: Carbohydrate-probe title terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a paper title describing the identification of dextrans using glycan oligosaccharide microarrays and novel glycolipid probes.

patterns.name: Numerical thresholds in astrophysics
patterns.context: Embedded in scientific text discussing potentially observable radiation or particle energies; the numbers, comparison symbols, and units all activate.

patterns.name: Research-plan and research-goal vocabulary
patterns.context: Introduces research aims, proposed research, or specific goals in grant applications; these words do not form a fixed phrase shared across passages.
patterns.domain: NIH research plans and life sciences application text

patterns.name: Individual scientific terms and general paper language
patterns.context: Appears in passages discussing particle heating, accretion disks, and related observations; activations are scattered across words and subword fragments, with no obvious shared sentence pattern.

patterns.name: Subword-fragment activations in carbohydrate titles
patterns.context: Adjacent to titles of papers on carbohydrate recognition; activations fall on multiple title words and subword fragments, but there is no clear unified trigger beyond the title topic.

patterns.name: Sporadic terminology in research-plan descriptions
patterns.context: Appears when describing experimental subjects, research methods, protein processing, or expected contributions; beyond the research-plan register, there is no shared local trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic terminology in theoretical papers
patterns.context: Appears in relational expressions, comparative arguments, and waveguide scattering problems; the commonality is academic discourse, but the activated words do not form a clear unified pattern.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics and mathematical physics papers

patterns.name: Auditory neuroscience terminology
patterns.context: Describes the role of inhibitory neurotransmitters and auditory brainstem pathways, then turns to specific research aims at the end of the passage.

4_864.concept: 学术研究中的预期与论证表述
4_864.description: 最强共同模式是科研计划中的“It is hoped”及论文中的“It is shown/proved”等非人称学术表述；其余激活分散于研究目标、科研术语、标题词片和天体物理数值。

patterns.name: 研究计划中的希望句式
patterns.context: 出现在研究目标、实验方案或研究计划的描述之后，作为预期贡献或结果的引入句；“hoped”是显著激活点。
patterns.domain: NIH资助申请、生命科学研究计划

patterns.name: 论文中的证明或展示句式
patterns.context: 用被动或非人称句式陈述数学关系的证明，或论文所展示的结果。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤其是理论物理、数学和科学计算

patterns.name: 糖类探针标题术语
patterns.context: 出现在论文标题中，描述用糖寡糖微阵列和新糖脂探针识别葡聚糖。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、糖生物学论文标题

patterns.name: 天体物理中的数值阈值
patterns.context: 嵌在讨论可能观测到的辐射或粒子能量的科学文本中；数字、比较符号和单位均有激活。

patterns.name: 研究计划与研究目标词汇
patterns.context: 在资助申请中介绍研究目的、拟议研究或具体目标；这些词并非各段共同出现的固定短语。
patterns.domain: NIH研究计划、生命科学申请文本

patterns.name: 个别科研词汇与通用论文用语
patterns.context: 出现在讨论粒子加热、吸积盘及相关观测的段落中，激活分散在词汇和词片上，没有明显共同句式。

patterns.name: 糖类标题中的词片激活
patterns.context: 与糖类识别论文标题相邻；激活落在多个标题词及词片上，但除标题主题外没有清楚的统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 科研计划描述中的零散术语
patterns.context: 在描述实验对象、研究方法、蛋白质加工或预期贡献时出现；除科研计划语体外，缺乏共同的局部触发模式。

patterns.name: 理论论文中的零散术语
patterns.context: 分别出现在关系式、比较论述和波导散射问题中；共同点是学术论述语体，但激活词本身不构成明确统一模式。
patterns.domain: 理论物理、数学物理论文

patterns.name: 听觉神经科学术语
patterns.context: 描述抑制性神经递质与听觉脑干通路的作用，段末转入具体研究目标。

en.description: Repeated activations occur at “It is hoped that” across multiple NIH research plans; other activations occur in some that-clauses, title colons, within-word subword fragments, and near formulas. The shared mechanism is uncertain, and the available evidence is insufficient to explain all activations.

patterns.name: “It is hoped” phrasing in research plans
patterns.context: In research plans or descriptions of research goals, introduces expected outcomes, research value, or subsequent understanding using a passive expression; this is a consistently repeated local phrase in these passages.

patterns.name: Judgments or explanations introduced by “that”
patterns.context: Introduces a proposition, argument, or legal factual judgment; it need not occur in a research-plan context.
patterns.domain: Philosophy papers, legal texts, and academic writing

patterns.name: That-clauses in other academic sentences
patterns.context: Introduces a subordinate clause about research results or an argument, often in reporting results or theoretical explanations; may overlap with the that-clause pattern above.

patterns.name: Subword fragments inside non-English words
patterns.context: The activation falls inside a word split by tokenization, rather than on an obvious independent semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Colons and title openings
patterns.context: In paper titles, an abbreviation is followed by a colon introducing the main title; there is no obvious connection to the sentence patterns in other passages.

patterns.name: Local features in technical text with formulas
patterns.context: Activations appear near formula symbols in theoretical physics text; this short passage does not reveal a stable lexical or syntactic pattern.

4_864.concept: 科研文本中的从句引入表达
4_864.description: 多段 NIH 研究计划在“It is hoped that”处反复激活；另有若干 that 从句、标题冒号、分词词内及公式附近激活。共同机制不确定，现有线索不足以解释所有激活。

patterns.name: 科研计划中的“希望”句式
patterns.context: 科研计划或研究目标介绍中，以被动表达引出预期成果、研究价值或后续理解；在这些片段中是稳定重复的局部句式。

patterns.name: “that”引出的判断或说明
patterns.context: 引出命题、论证内容或法律事实判断；不要求出现科研计划语境。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文、法律文本及学术写作

patterns.name: 其他学术句中的 that 从句
patterns.context: 以研究结果或论述引出从句，常见于结果报告或理论说明；可能与上面的 that 从句模式重叠。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、物理学论文

patterns.name: 非英语词内的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词切开的单词内部，并非明显独立的语义或句法触发项。

patterns.name: 标题中的冒号及标题开头
patterns.context: 论文标题中，缩写后接冒号并引出标题主体；与其他片段的句式缺乏明显联系。

patterns.name: 带公式的技术文本局部
patterns.context: 理论物理文本中，公式符号附近出现激活；无法从这一小段确定稳定的词汇或句法模式。

en.description: Most paragraphs use “It is hoped that” after describing research objectives or expected outcomes in research proposals. Another philosophy paragraph discusses the nonconceptual first-person content of perception and proprioception, and marks “argued”.

patterns.name: “It is hoped” research proposal construction
patterns.context: Introduces a hoped-for result after stating research objectives, experiments, analyses, or expected contributions; the phrase is marked in multiple instances, and the strongest example also includes that after hoped.
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter biomedical research proposals, involving experimental animals, cells, molecular mechanisms, neuroscience, and language disorders

patterns.name: Philosophical argument about nonconceptual first-person content
patterns.context: Discusses whether perception and proprioception provide nonconceptual first-person content; “argued” appears in an argumentative statement.

4_864.concept: 表达希望的学术论述标记
4_864.description: 多数段落在科研计划书描述研究目标或预期成果后出现“It is hoped that”；另有哲学段落讨论知觉与本体感觉的非概念性第一人称内容，并标记“argued”。

patterns.name: “It is hoped”科研提案句式
patterns.context: 在陈述研究目标、实验、分析或预期贡献后，引出希望得到的结果；该短语在多个实例中被标记，强度最高的一例还包括 hoped 后的 that。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 生物医学研究计划书，涉及实验动物、细胞、分子机制、神经科学与语言障碍

patterns.name: 非概念性第一人称内容的哲学论述
patterns.context: 讨论知觉和本体感觉是否提供非概念性的第一人称内容；“argued”出现在论证性陈述中。

en.description: Primarily responds to the expected-outcome formula “(It) is hoped” in research proposals, especially “hoped”; one exception responds to “^*^ represented” in a description of cellular signaling.

patterns.name: “It is hoped” research-proposal formula
patterns.context: Appears after statements of research objectives, planned work, or expected contributions, typically introducing anticipated research outcomes; activations concentrate on “hoped.”
patterns.domain: NIH grant applications and research-plan writing

patterns.name: “represented” and its preceding marker
patterns.context: “represented” follows the ^*^ marker in a sentence, which then describes intracellular signaling; this does not match the “hoped” formula in the other passages.

4_864.concept: 预期成果套语（另有异例）
4_864.description: 主要响应研究提案中“(It) is hoped”这一预期成果套语，尤其 hoped；另有一例响应“^*^ represented”，上下文为细胞信号描述。

patterns.name: “It is hoped”研究提案套语
patterns.trigger: «It» is« hoped»（第 1 段为“It is hoped”前有句点；第 2、3 段为“It is hoped”）
patterns.context: 出现在研究目标、拟开展工作或预期贡献的陈述之后，通常引出研究的预期成果；激活集中于 hoped。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助申请及研究计划文体

patterns.name: “represented”及其前置标记
patterns.context: 句中 ^*^ 标记后接 represented，之后描述细胞内信号；与其他段落的 hoped 套语不一致。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及通路分析

en.description: In most passages, activations are associated with “hoped” or “claimed” in research plans or academic argumentation; a few fall on biochemical or philosophical terms and an anomalous numerical punctuation sequence. There is no unified trigger, and not all activations can be explained.

patterns.name: Expected research outcomes after “hoped”
patterns.context: In research-plan or research-goal descriptions, “hoped” introduces anticipated research, results, or improved understanding.

patterns.name: Academic claims with “claimed that”
patterns.context: Reports a claim in academic argumentation; examples include “it is claimed that” and “it is claimed … perception … qualify as.”

patterns.name: “amide” in a biomedical term
patterns.context: Occurs within the biochemical name “5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide”; the activation falls on the term’s suffix.

patterns.name: “proprioception” in terminology about perception
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between proprioception, perception, and self-identity; the activation falls within the term.

patterns.name: Decimal point in a numerical expression
patterns.context: Near the value “>0.5.9 MeV” in astrophysics text; activations concentrate on the numerical fragment formed by digits and punctuation, whose formatting is unusual.

4_864.concept: 报告预期或主张？
4_864.description: 多数段落中，激活与科研计划或学术论证里的“hoped”或“claimed”相关；少数落在生化、哲学术语及异常数值标点上。触发条件不统一，不能解释全部激活。

patterns.name: “hoped”后的预期研究成果
patterns.context: 科研计划或研究目标的叙述中，以“hoped”引出预期研究、研究结果或理解的提升。

patterns.name: “claimed that”学术主张
patterns.context: 学术论证中转述某个主张；一例是“it is claimed that”，另一例是“it is claimed … perception … qualify as”。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的 amide
patterns.context: 生化名称“5-amino-4-imidazolecarboxamide”内部；激活落在术语后缀。

patterns.name: 感知术语中的 proprioception
patterns.context: 讨论本体感觉与感知、自我认同的关系；激活落在术语内部。

patterns.name: 数值表达中的小数点
patterns.context: 天体物理文本中，数值“>0.5.9 MeV”附近；激活集中在数字和标点构成的数值片段，数值格式本身不寻常。

en.description: Primarily responds to proposition-framing expressions in academic contexts of the form “It is + passive epistemic or evaluative verb”: research plans often use “It is hoped” to state expectations, while variants include thought, claimed, and argued/important; spans biomedical, philosophical, and social science texts.

patterns.name: “It is hoped” research-goal phrasing
patterns.context: Appears in research proposals or papers, usually introducing the contribution expected from research, experiments, or mechanistic investigation; [1]–[7] and [10] contain strong trigger words
patterns.domain: NIH research plans and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Passive epistemic/judgment expression
patterns.context: Uses “It is thought to be” to introduce an inference about a biological fact or its importance

patterns.name: Claim markers in argumentation
patterns.context: Uses a passive construction after discussing or presenting evidence to mark a claim; in [2], it is also followed by a comma, continuing the argument across sentences

patterns.name: Importance judgments in argumentation
patterns.context: After presenting comparative results, the author makes an argument and judges its importance; this is not an expected result in a research plan

4_864.concept: 学术被动认知评价句式
4_864.description: 主要响应学术语境中以“It is + 被动认知或评价动词”引出的命题框架：研究计划常用“It is hoped”陈述预期，另见 thought、claimed 及 argued/important 等变体；跨生物医学、哲学和社会科学文本。

patterns.name: “It is hoped”研究目标句式
patterns.context: 出现在科研申请或论文中，通常引出研究、实验或机制研究预期带来的贡献；[1]–[7]、[10] 中均为强触发词
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划及生物医学论文

patterns.name: 被动认识/判断表达
patterns.context: 以“It is thought to be”引出对生物学事实或重要性的推测

patterns.name: 论证中的主张标记
patterns.context: 在讨论或证据陈述后，以被动结构标记某项主张；[2]中还紧接逗号，延续句间论述

patterns.name: 论证中的重要性判断
patterns.trigger: it is argued that it is important
patterns.context: 作者陈述比较结果后提出论点与重要性判断，不是科研计划中的预期结果

en.description: Activations concentrate on passive reporting of judgments and effects in academic or legal contexts; also includes “as described/approved” in methods, use of experimental materials, and scoring. Overall, the pattern favors predicates or participles in formal prose.

patterns.name: Passive or subjectless reporting of judgments
patterns.context: Common constructions include “it is argued/thought/claimed that…”, introducing an argument, hypothesis, or evidential claim.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, especially philosophy, physics, biomedicine, and mathematics

patterns.name: Basis and approval of standards, protocols, or methods
patterns.context: States that a classification or procedure followed an established method, or that an operation was institutionally approved; may also occur when citing research methods.

patterns.name: Status or outcomes being affected
patterns.context: Describes a right being adversely affected, or an intention being influenced by social network position.
patterns.domain: Legal texts and public health research

patterns.name: Simple past passive action
patterns.context: Uses be + used to describe the use of experimental materials or procedures; the example is “were used”.

patterns.name: Descriptive passive action or scoring
patterns.context: Explains how researchers assessed or recorded cell characteristics.

4_864.concept: 正式文体中的被动谓语
4_864.description: 激活集中于学术或法律语境中的被动报告判断与结果影响，也包括方法描述中的“按…说明/批准”、实验材料使用及评分。整体偏向正式文体中的谓语或分词。

patterns.name: 被动或无主语的报告判断
patterns.context: 常见结构为“it is argued/thought/claimed that…”，引出论点、假设或证据主张。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，尤见哲学、物理、生物医学与数学文献

patterns.name: 规范、方案或方法的依据与认可
patterns.context: 说明分类或操作按既定方法进行，或某项操作经过机构批准；也可能出现在引用研究方法时。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与实验方法

patterns.name: 状态或结果受到影响
patterns.context: 描述某种权益受到不利影响，或某种意愿受到社会网络位置影响。
patterns.domain: 法律文本与公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 一般过去时被动动作
patterns.context: 以 be + used 描述实验材料或程序的使用；样例中为“were used”。

patterns.name: 描述性被动动作或评分
patterns.context: 说明研究人员如何评估或记录细胞特征。

en.concept: Local lexical and formatting features in technical texts
en.description: Activations are distributed across English function words, numerical units, and formatting markers in technical texts; they also involve local specialized expressions in biomedical experimental procedures, research terminology, code syntax, legal argumentation, and instrument and tissue measurements.

patterns.name: English function words and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Function words occur in continuous English prose or technical descriptions; they can trigger across different semantic content, with no specific shared collocation evident.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and symbol formatting
patterns.context: Numbers, measurement units, mathematical relation symbols, or formatted values appear in scientific methods, results, or observations.

patterns.name: Experimental methods and reagent handling
patterns.context: Describes animal treatment, reagent formulations, immunoassays, or detection procedures, often with specific concentrations, durations, and reagent names.

patterns.name: Research subjects, models, and mechanistic terminology
patterns.context: Papers introduce a research question, physical system, or model, using technical terms to describe a mechanism or theoretical account.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics and condensed matter physics papers

patterns.name: Code syntax, declarations, and comments
patterns.context: Operators, module relationships, and line-break formatting appear in code or code comments.

patterns.name: Legal arguments about rights and validity
patterns.context: Legal argumentation discusses standing to challenge a statute’s validity and the statute’s effects on individual or property rights.

patterns.name: CCD row regions and scanning
patterns.context: Describes active and overscan regions and offsets by CCD row number.

patterns.name: Tumor-region classification and distance
patterns.context: A results passage classifies regions between tumor and adjacent liver tissue by distance in micrometers.

patterns.name: Neural tissue observation and quantitative assessment
patterns.context: Assesses the presence and number of immunostained fibers or terminals around cell bodies.

4_864.concept: 技术文本中的局部词法与格式特征
4_864.description: 激活分布于技术文本中的英语功能词、数值单位与格式标记；同时涉及生物医学实验流程、科研术语、代码语法、法律论证及仪器和组织测量等局部专门表达。

patterns.name: 英语功能词与句法片段
patterns.trigger: «of»、«the»、«for»、«and»、«with»、«in» 等常见功能词及邻近词
patterns.context: 功能词出现在连续英文叙述或技术说明中；不同语义内容下都可触发，未见统一的特定搭配。

patterns.name: 数值与单位、符号格式
patterns.context: 数字、测量单位、数学关系符号或格式化数值出现在科学方法、结果或观测描述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与物理/天文论文

patterns.name: 实验方法与试剂操作
patterns.context: 描述动物处理、试剂配方、免疫实验或检测流程，常伴随具体浓度、时间和试剂名称。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文方法部分

patterns.name: 科研对象、模型与机制术语
patterns.context: 论文中介绍研究问题、物理系统或模型，并用技术名词说明机制或理论描述。
patterns.domain: 天体物理与凝聚态物理论文

patterns.name: 代码语法、声明与注释
patterns.context: 代码或代码注释中出现运算符声明、模块关系与换行格式。

patterns.name: 法律权利与效力论述
patterns.context: 法律论证中讨论质疑法规效力的资格，以及法规对个人或财产权利的影响。

patterns.name: 图像传感器行区与扫描
patterns.context: 按 CCD 行号描述有效区域、过扫描区域及偏移量。

patterns.name: 肿瘤区域分类与距离
patterns.context: 结果段落按微米距离对肿瘤与邻近肝组织间区域分类。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文结果部分

patterns.name: 神经组织观察与定量判读
patterns.context: 对细胞体周围免疫染色纤维或末梢的存在和数量进行判读。

en.concept: Scientific and technical text and local word-form features
en.description: Activations are scattered across numbers and technical notation, experimental methods, terminology, and paper citations in scientific texts; they also involve particle/domain descriptions, a philosophical term for perception, and a forum subword fragment, making them difficult to group into a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Numbers, counts, and measurements
patterns.context: Numbers occur in physical quantities, experimental groups/sample sizes, age ranges, formulas, or measurement descriptions; sometimes the numbers and adjacent punctuation also activate.

patterns.name: Structured scientific terminology and technical notation
patterns.context: Technical terms or multi-subword terms occur in specialized descriptions; activations may fall on subword fragments or adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, laser physics, imaging, chemistry, and particle physics

patterns.name: Methods and experimental materials
patterns.context: Describes experimental grouping of animals, treatment, sample preparation, or analysis procedures, often with passive voice and methodological details.

patterns.name: Internal paper references and argumentation language
patterns.context: Cites literature, points to other parts of a paper, or summarizes arguments and distinctions in the literature.

patterns.name: Distribution, propagation, and domain structures
patterns.context: Describes particle propagation/distribution in a field or domain structures in physical materials.

patterns.name: Perception, self, and bodily sensation
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship between proprioception when crossing the legs, perception, and self-recognition.

patterns.name: Subword activation in evaluative words
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal fragment of a negative evaluative word; the sentence concerns service providers potentially having to perform unpleasant tasks.

4_864.concept: 科学技术文本与局部词形特征
4_864.description: 激活分散于科学文本中的数字与技术记号、实验方法、术语及论文引用，也涉及粒子/磁域描述；另有哲学中的知觉术语和论坛词语子片段，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 数字、计数与测量值
patterns.context: 数字出现在物理量、实验分组/样本量、年龄范围、公式或测量描述中；有时数字及邻近标点都激活。

patterns.name: 结构化科学术语与技术记号
patterns.context: 技术名词或由多个子词构成的术语处于专业说明语境，激活分布可能落在词片段或相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、激光物理、成像、化学及粒子物理

patterns.name: 方法步骤与实验材料表述
patterns.trigger: «were»« used»1；«divided into»« 4»1« groups»1；«Mice were»« sacrificed»5；«analysis»4；«obtained by slow evaporation»
patterns.context: 描述动物实验分组、处理、样品制备或分析流程，常含被动语态和方法细节。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验与化学实验方法

patterns.name: 论文内部指引与论证用语
patterns.context: 引用文献、指向论文其他部分，或概述文献中的论证与区别。

patterns.name: 分布、传播与领域结构
patterns.context: 描述粒子在场中的传播/分布，或物理材料中的域结构。

patterns.name: 感知、自我与身体感觉
patterns.context: 讨论腿部交叉的本体感觉、知觉与自我识别之间的关系。

patterns.name: 评价性词语中的子词激活
patterns.context: 激活落在负面评价词的词内片段，句子谈服务提供者可能需要承担令人不快的任务。

en.concept: Claims and explanations in academic argumentation
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions used to state researchers’ hopes, claims, arguments, or inferences in academic texts, especially “It is …” and “We point out.” A few local responses also occur: a physical decimal threshold, LaTeX equation formatting, CCD row-scanning terminology, and a fixed phrase referring to a later section.

patterns.name: “It is … that/to …” argumentation frame
patterns.context: States researchers’ hopes, claims, arguments, inferences, or emphasis; a common structure is an evaluative/epistemic expression followed by a that/to-clause. The trigger in passage 6 is “point out,” which does not fully fit the It is construction.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, research plans, and scientific argumentation

patterns.name: Decimal threshold and numerical symbols
patterns.context: A numerical threshold is embedded in a description of observed high-energy particle emission; activations concentrate on the decimal point and adjacent numerical symbols.

patterns.name: Equation formatting and line-break indentation
patterns.context: After introducing a system’s Hamiltonian, the text proceeds to a LaTeX math block displaying an equation; activations fall on equation markers, line breaks, and indentation.

patterns.name: CCD row-range markers for scanning
patterns.context: Describes the row-number boundary between active and overscan regions in a CCD; triggers occur on numerical values and the term “y overscan.”

patterns.name: “as discussed below” introducing a later section
patterns.context: After introducing particle propagation and secondary-particle production, this phrase points to a later discussion of cross sections and multiplicity.

4_864.concept: 学术论述中的主张与说明
4_864.description: 主要响应学术文本中用于陈述研究者希望、主张、论证或推测的表达，尤其是“It is …”和“We point out”。另有少数局部反应：物理小数阈值、LaTeX 公式排版、CCD 行号扫描术语及引向后文的固定短语。

patterns.name: “It is … that/to …” 论述句式
patterns.trigger: «It is» / «it is» 后接 «hoped», «claimed», «argued», «thought»，或 «We point out»
patterns.context: 陈述研究者的希望、主张、论点、推测或强调；常见结构为评价/认知表达后接 that/to 从句。第 6 段的触发是 «point out»，不完全符合 It is 结构。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、研究计划及科学论述

patterns.name: 小数阈值及数字符号
patterns.context: 数字阈值嵌在高能粒子发射的观测描述中；激活集中于小数点和相邻数值符号。

patterns.name: 方程排版与换行缩进
patterns.context: 在介绍系统的哈密顿量后进入展示公式的 LaTeX 数学块，激活落在公式标记、换行和缩进。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文及 LaTeX 排版

patterns.name: CCD 行号扫描区间标记
patterns.context: 描述 CCD 中活动区域与过扫描区域的行号分界，触发于数值及 y overscan 术语。
patterns.domain: 天文学仪器/图像处理论文

patterns.name: “as discussed below” 引导后文
patterns.context: 介绍粒子传播和次级粒子产生后，以该短语指向后文对截面和多重性的讨论。

en.concept: Local tokens in formatted technical text
en.description: Activations span papers, code, and webpages, often on punctuation, line breaks, numbers, and specialized terms or formatted tokens; however, triggers vary greatly across excerpts, with no consistent lexical or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Punctuation or delimiters between adjacent symbols
patterns.context: In formatted text, punctuation, line breaks, or code delimiters themselves are marked; different markers occur in different corpus types.

patterns.name: Numbers and relational symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Numbers, comparison symbols, and surrounding spaces are marked token by token in mathematical or scientific notation.

patterns.name: Common function or narrative words in technical text
patterns.context: Ordinary words in academic prose or methods descriptions; there is no single stable lexical trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Papers, medical literature, and philosophical discussion

patterns.name: Scientific terms, abbreviations, and proper names
patterns.context: Specialized terms, abbreviations, or technical names occur in scientific descriptions, with activations scattered across different tokens within the words.
patterns.domain: Chemistry, particle physics, bioinformatics, and astronomy

patterns.name: Formatted identifiers and operators in code
patterns.context: Identifiers, operators, or HTML/PHP elements in code snippets are marked; specific triggers vary across code excerpts.

patterns.name: The philosophical term proprioception
patterns.context: Specialized terms and related words are marked in discussions of bodily proprioception, perception, and identity.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and experimental parameters
patterns.context: Tokens near numbers and units activate when measurements, units, or reagent parameters appear in experimental methods.

patterns.name: Irregular token-level markers
patterns.context: LaTeX mathematical markers or special-format tokens activate sporadically and cannot be consistently grouped with other excerpts.

4_864.concept: 格式化科技文本中的局部 token
4_864.description: 激活横跨论文、代码和网页，常落在标点、换行、数字及专业词或格式化 token 上；但各段触发项差异很大，没有一致的词汇或语义条件。

patterns.name: 相邻符号间的标点或分隔符
patterns.context: 格式化文本中，标点、换行或代码分隔符本身被标记；不同标记出现在不同语料类型中。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与关系符
patterns.context: 数学或科学记号中，数字、比较符号及其周围空格被逐 token 标记。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文及科学文本

patterns.name: 科技文本中的常见功能词或叙述词
patterns.context: 学术叙述或方法描述中出现的普通词语；并无单一稳定的词汇触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论文、医学文献及哲学论述

patterns.name: 科学术语及缩写、专名
patterns.context: 专业术语、缩写或技术名词出现在科学描述中，激活分散在词内不同 token。
patterns.domain: 化学、粒子物理、生物信息学及天文学

patterns.name: 代码中的格式化标识符与操作符
patterns.context: 代码片段中的标识符、运算符或 HTML/PHP 元素被标记；不同代码段具体触发项不同。

patterns.name: 哲学术语 proprioception
patterns.context: 讨论身体本体感觉与知觉、身份认同的论述中，专业词及相关词被标记。

patterns.name: 数值与单位、实验参数
patterns.context: 实验方法中出现测量数值、单位或试剂参数时，数字与单位附近 token 激活。

patterns.name: 不规则 token 级标记
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学标记或特殊格式 token 偶发激活，无法与其他段稳定归并。

en.description: Activations occur in research or technical texts across multiple fields, covering paper prose, experimental and results terms, specialized terminology, formulas and numbers, table labels, and code attributes; there is no single stable trigger, and activations often fall on meaningful words or structured symbols.

patterns.name: Content words and specialized terminology in scientific texts
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across meaningful English words in scientific papers, experimental methods, results discussions, and administrative research texts; triggers are not uniform and often occur in ordinary prose or specialized descriptions.

patterns.name: Astrophysical values and symbols
patterns.context: Physical quantities, values, units, or variables occur in specialized descriptions, especially those about astrophysics and detectors; activations fall on numerical symbols and adjacent words.

patterns.name: Chemistry experiments and spectroscopy formatting
patterns.context: Specialized vocabulary occurs adjacent to structured chemical-shift and peak-shape formats in chemistry results or spectroscopic characterization.

patterns.name: Complex formulas and error values in physical measurements
patterns.context: Formulas, units, and values with asymmetric errors express experimental or astronomical observations; activations concentrate on punctuation, numerical fragments, and symbols.

patterns.name: Perception and claims in philosophy
patterns.context: Conceptual arguments discuss proprioception, perception, and self-identity; “claimed” activates strongly near an argumentative conclusion.

patterns.name: Paper titles and section structures
patterns.context: Formatted structures appear near paper titles, section headings, or literature-review citations; ordinary academic prose also occurs in the body text.

patterns.name: Research-funding form labels
patterns.context: Uppercase field labels, institutional terminology, and fixed explanatory text appear in forms or templates.

patterns.name: Experimental procedures and antibody-detection terminology
patterns.context: Experimental methods describe sample incubation, antibody treatment, and protein colorimetric detection.

patterns.name: SVG attributes and layout in code
patterns.context: JavaScript/D3-style code sets SVG graphic attributes, axis class names, and transform strings; activations span code identifiers, strings, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Electrochemical measurement results
patterns.context: Reports the consistency of salt solutions, electrode liquid junctions, and measurement results, including experimental conditions and assessment of results.

4_864.concept: 科研技术文本片段
4_864.description: 激活出现在多领域科研或技术文本中，覆盖论文叙述、实验与结果词、专业术语、公式数字、表格标签及代码属性；没有单一稳定触发词，常落在有意义的词或结构化符号上。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的内容词与专业术语
patterns.context: 激活分布在科学论文、实验方法、结果讨论及行政科研文本中的有意义英文词；触发词并不统一，常出现在普通叙述或专业描述中。
patterns.domain: 跨学科科学与科研文本

patterns.name: 天文物理数值与符号
patterns.context: 专业叙述中出现物理量、数值、单位或变量，尤其是天体物理和探测器描述；激活落在数字符号及邻近词。

patterns.name: 化学实验与光谱格式
patterns.context: 化学实验结果或谱学表征中，专业词汇与结构化的化学位移、峰形等格式相邻。

patterns.name: 物理测量的复杂公式与误差
patterns.context: 以公式、单位及带不对称误差的数值表达实验或天文观测结果；激活集中在标点、数值片段和符号。
patterns.domain: 物理观测结果与定量报告

patterns.name: 哲学中的感知与主张
patterns.context: 讨论本体感受、感知与自我认同的概念论证；“claimed”在论证结论附近激活较强。

patterns.name: 论文标题和章节结构
patterns.context: 论文标题、章节标题或综述引用附近出现格式化结构；同时有正文中的普通学术表达。

patterns.name: 科研资助表格标签
patterns.context: 表单或模板中的大写栏名、机构术语及固定说明文字。

patterns.name: 实验流程与抗体检测术语
patterns.context: 实验方法中描述样品孵育、抗体处理及蛋白显色检测。

patterns.name: 代码中的 SVG 属性与布局
patterns.context: JavaScript/D3 风格代码中设置 SVG 图形属性、坐标轴类名和变换字符串；激活跨代码标识符、字符串与标点。
patterns.domain: 编程问答与数据可视化代码

patterns.name: 电化学测量结果
patterns.context: 报告盐溶液、电极液接界及测量结果的一致性，包含实验条件和结果评价。

en.description: Activations are distributed across domains: two excerpts hit “visualized” in protein band visualization methods; the rest are mostly isolated word fragments, numbers, or symbols in grant tables, scientific formulas, philosophical discussion, and experimental/instrument descriptions, with little shared semantics.

patterns.name: visualized/visualized results
patterns.context: Experimental methods describe how protein bands or measurements are displayed; this word is the strongest activated token in both excerpts

patterns.name: Text or table structure markers
patterns.context: In a table-of-contents heading, internal fragments RESE«ARCH», CONT«ENTS» are activated

patterns.name: High-energy radiation values
patterns.context: MeV emission quantities in an accretion disk particle-heating context; the number occurs in the threshold expression $>0.95$

patterns.name: Ontological predicate
patterns.context: Philosophical discussion asserts whether perception and proprioception satisfy a condition; activation falls on the sentence-final “claimed”

patterns.name: Digits after the decimal point
patterns.context: A digit fragment after the decimal point is activated in an NMR chemical shift value from spectral analysis

patterns.name: Physiological process judgment
patterns.context: A conjecture about the energy-consuming role of Na,K-ATPase is introduced with “It is thought to be”

patterns.name: Geometric boundary value
patterns.context: The final digit of the threshold 0.78 is activated in an expression restricting the region of a particle trajectory's polar angle

patterns.name: Perceptual threshold
patterns.context: An approximation marker after Δ*E* is activated in a formula for the perceptual threshold of tooth color differences

patterns.name: Overscan region
patterns.context: Describes the y-direction overscan region in CCD row indexing; activation falls on the end of the word

4_864.concept: none
4_864.description: 激活分布于多领域：两段在蛋白条带可视化方法中命中“visualized”；其余多为孤立的词片段、数字或符号，分别出现在资助表格、科学公式、哲学论述及实验/仪器描述中，难见共同语义。

patterns.name: visualized/可视化结果
patterns.context: 实验方法中描述蛋白条带或测量结果如何被显示；两段中该词本身均为最强激活 token

patterns.name: 文本或表格结构标记
patterns.context: 表格目录标题中，词内片段 RESE«ARCH»、CONT«ENTS»被激活

patterns.name: 高能辐射数值
patterns.context: 吸积盘粒子加热语境中的 MeV 发射量；数字出现在阈值表达式 $>0.95$ 中

patterns.name: 本体论谓词
patterns.context: 哲学论述中对感知与本体感受是否满足某条件作断言；激活落在句末“claimed”

patterns.name: 小数点后的数字
patterns.context: 光谱分析的 NMR 化学位移数值中，小数点后的数字片段被激活

patterns.name: 生理过程判断
patterns.context: 陈述 Na,K-ATPase 能量消耗作用时，以“It is thought to be”引出推测

patterns.name: 几何边界数值
patterns.context: 粒子轨迹极角的区域限制表达式中，阈值 0.78 的末位数字被激活

patterns.name: 可感知阈值
patterns.context: 牙色差异的感知阈值公式中，Δ*E* 后的近似标记被激活

patterns.name: 过扫描区域
patterns.context: CCD 行号划分中，描述 y 方向 overscan 区域；激活落在该词末尾
patterns.domain: 天文仪器/CCD 数据分析

en.description: Primarily activates on the ör letter sequence containing ö/ő in cross-lingual text, usually inside words; the activation on “Yes” in segment 8 cannot be explained by this pattern.

patterns.name: ör substring containing ö/ő
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter sequence ör inside complete words; it does not depend on specific syntax or position.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary speeches and academic texts in Swedish, Estonian, Hungarian, personal names, and other languages

4_1246.concept: 多语种 ör 子串特征
4_1246.description: 主要对跨语言文本中含 ö/ő 的 ör 字母子串激活，常位于单词内部；第8段的“Yes”激活无法由此模式解释。

patterns.name: 含 ö/ő 的 ör 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在字母序列 ör 上；出现在完整单词内部，不依赖特定句法或位置。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语、爱沙尼亚语、匈牙利语及人名等多语种议会发言与学术文本

en.description: The strongest activations cluster around the short sequence «ör»: mainly in Swedish words, but also in Estonian and Hungarian words, names, and English Yes. Across languages and genres, no stable syntactic or semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: gör embedded in a word
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary speech, near «att jag drar slutsatsen»; other activations occur in different languages and English texts, so a shared trigger word cannot be established

patterns.name: Sentence-initial För
patterns.context: In a Swedish sentence, it begins a continuation of «eller avviker från huvudfåran», followed by «inte alls så länge sedan»

patterns.name: början within a word
patterns.context: Inside the Swedish word «början» (beginning), after «före sammanträdets»

patterns.name: Estonian pöör
patterns.context: Inside the Estonian word «pöörata», in a sentence about sustained attention; followed by a period and a line break

patterns.name: Hungarian kör
patterns.context: Inside the Hungarian word «körülmények», after «az EU a»

patterns.name: Swedish stör
patterns.context: Inside the Swedish word «större» (larger), modifying the development gap

patterns.name: Name-initial Jör
patterns.context: In Estonian parliamentary speech, inside the name «Jörg Leichtfried», used to address a person

patterns.name: English Yes
patterns.context: After an entertainment-news headline/URL in a webpage snippet, following «Getty Images» and before content related to ABC and Roseanne

patterns.name: Swedish rör
patterns.context: Inside the Swedish word «rör» (concerns), followed by «skäl H som en kollega»

patterns.name: Tör within a name
patterns.context: Inside the author surname Törőcsik in a mathematical-paper citation, before a theorem statement

4_1246.description: 最强激活都落在短子串「ör」附近：主要是瑞典语词中，也见于爱沙尼亚语词、匈牙利语词、姓名及英文 Yes；跨多语种和文体，缺少稳定句法或语义条件。

patterns.name: 词中嵌入的 gör
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会发言中，出现在「att jag drar slutsatsen」附近；另有其他语言、英文文本中的不同激活，无法据此确立共同触发词

patterns.name: 句首 För
patterns.context: 瑞典语句子中，句首承接前文「eller avviker från huvudfåran」，之后接「inte alls så länge sedan」

patterns.name: 词内 början
patterns.context: 瑞典语「början」（开始）一词内部，位于「före sammanträdets」之后

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语 pöör
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语词「pöörata」内部，句中表示持续关注；后接句号和换行

patterns.name: 匈牙利语 kör
patterns.context: 匈牙利语「körülmények」内部，位于「az EU a」之后

patterns.name: 瑞典语 stör
patterns.context: 瑞典语「större」（更大）内部，修饰发展差距

patterns.name: 姓名首部 Jör
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语议会发言中，出现在称呼人物「Jörg Leichtfried」的姓名内

patterns.name: 英文 Yes
patterns.context: 网页片段中的娱乐新闻标题/URL之后，出现在「Getty Images」之后、ABC 和 Roseanne 相关内容之前

patterns.name: 瑞典语 rör
patterns.context: 瑞典语「rör」（涉及）一词内部，后接「skäl H som en kollega」

patterns.name: 姓名内部 Tör
patterns.context: 数学论文引文中的作者姓 Törőcsik 内，位于定理陈述之前

en.description: All segments activate on fragments within words containing ö, spanning Swedish stems and personal names; most are from parliamentary records, with one author name from a mathematics paper.

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal stems/spelling fragments
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on fragments within Swedish spellings containing ö; these are often stems split by subword boundaries and do not necessarily correspond to complete words.
patterns.domain: Swedish parliamentary speech; [8] is the name Törőcsik in a mathematics paper

patterns.name: Meeting procedures in EU parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Presiding-officer remarks, applause annotations, meeting procedure, or legislative discussion; the trigger word is not necessarily the peak fragment.

patterns.name: Name fragments in a mathematics paper
patterns.context: Appears when citing an author’s name before a theorem; unrelated to the surrounding mathematical text.

4_1246.concept: 含 ö 的词内片段
4_1246.description: 所有段都在词中含有 ö 的片段处激活，覆盖瑞典语词干及人名；多数来自议会记录，另有数学论文作者名。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词中词干/拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在瑞典语拼写中含 ö 的词内片段；常是分词边界切开的词干，未必对应完整词。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语议会发言；[8]为数学论文中的人名 Törőcsik

patterns.name: 欧盟议会发言中的会议程序
patterns.context: 主席发言、掌声标注、会议程序或立法讨论；触发词未必就是峰值片段。

patterns.name: 数学论文中的姓名片段
patterns.context: 定理前引用作者姓名时出现；与周围数学文本无关。

en.description: All ten segments activate on the contiguous letter sequence “ör” inside Swedish or Norwegian words; word meanings and syntactic positions vary, and all examples come from European Parliament records.

patterns.name: “ör” inside Scandinavian-language words
patterns.context: Activation falls inside Swedish or Norwegian words, sometimes near diacritic letters or segmented affixes; “ör” alone is insufficient to determine the word’s meaning.
patterns.domain: Multilingual European Parliament debates, speeches, and procedural records

4_1246.concept: 瑞典语/挪威语词内「ör」子串
4_1246.description: 全部十段都在瑞典语或挪威语词内激活于连续字母子串「ör」；词义和句法位置多样，语料均为欧洲议会记录。

patterns.name: 斯堪的纳维亚语词内的「ör」
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语或挪威语的词内，周围可能带变音字母或被切分的词缀；单看「ör」本身不足以确定词义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种辩论、发言记录及程序记录

en.description: Activations concentrate on the continuous letter sequence “ör”, found in various Swedish words, Estonian “pöörata”, Hungarian “körülményeket”, and the name “Jörg”; the semantic and syntactic contexts vary widely.

patterns.name: ör within Swedish words
patterns.context: The sequence occurs within words without requiring a particular syntactic position; it appears in several parts of speech and inflected forms.
patterns.domain: Swedish European Parliament speeches and proceedings

patterns.name: Estonian öör/ör
patterns.context: In the Estonian word “pöörata”, the activation marker covers the consecutive ö and ör.

patterns.name: ör within Hungarian words
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a Hungarian word.

patterns.name: ör in a personal name
patterns.context: The sequence occurs inside a personal name.

4_1246.description: 激活集中于连续字母串“ör”，可见于瑞典语多种词、爱沙尼亚语“pöörata”、匈牙利语“körülményeket”和人名“Jörg”；各例的语义与句法环境差异很大。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内 ör
patterns.context: 该字母串位于词内，不要求特定句法位置；出现于多种词类和词形。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语欧洲议会发言及议事记录

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语 öör/ör
patterns.context: 在爱沙尼亚语词“pöörata”中，激活标记覆盖连续的 ö 和 ör。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内 ör
patterns.context: 出现在匈牙利语词的词首部分。

patterns.name: 人名中的 ör
patterns.context: 该字母串出现在人名内部。
patterns.domain: 爱沙尼亚语议会发言中的人名

en.description: Activation is especially prominent on fragments inside multilingual words (e.g., reckon, gör, hör, bör), and also on an internal fragment of asterisk; there are additional sporadic activations on code, line breaks, and short string fragments. No unified semantic interpretation applies across these cases.

patterns.name: Intra-word suffixes/subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation often falls on subword fragments rather than complete words; examples span English, Swedish, Portuguese, and German, with no confirmed shared semantics or stable morphological function.
patterns.domain: Forum speech, philosophical texts, and multilingual European Parliament records

patterns.name: Asterisk and asterisk annotations
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated inside the word asterisk; [2] is an asterisk annotation in an image caption, while [4] uses “*” in an API parameter to indicate a wildcard request.
patterns.domain: Biomedical figure captions, software API documentation

patterns.name: Code and punctuation structures
patterns.context: In code snippets, assignment symbols, method calls, parentheses, and line breaks occur frequently; the marker covers many tokens, with no single semantic trigger point.

patterns.name: Broken or formatted string fragments
patterns.context: Path-like titles, possible scraping/encoding noise, and character sequences in HackerNews page excerpts; strong activation falls on short string fragments for unclear reasons.

4_1246.description: 激活较突出地落在多语种词内片段（如 reckon、gör、hör、bör），也在 asterisk 的内部片段出现；另有代码、换行和短字符串片段的零散激活。各处缺乏统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 词内后缀/子词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在词语内部的子词片段，而非完整词；涉及英语、瑞典语、葡萄牙语和德语，尚无共同语义或稳定词法功能可确认。
patterns.domain: 论坛口语、哲学文本及欧洲议会多语种记录

patterns.name: 星号及星号标注
patterns.context: 激活集中于 asterisk 一词内部；[2]是图像说明中的星号标注，[4]是 API 参数中用「*」表示通配请求。
patterns.domain: 生物医学图注、软件 API 文档

patterns.name: 代码与标点结构
patterns.trigger: 「:=」后的「SecretList」9（[7]）；多处换行「↵」及其相邻结构也带有激活
patterns.context: 代码片段中，赋值符号、方法调用、括号及换行频繁出现；标记覆盖大量 token，未见单一语义触发点。
patterns.domain: Go 代码及格式化文本

patterns.name: 断词或格式化的字符串片段
patterns.trigger: 「wx」9（[8]）；同段含「a」19，且周围有字母串与分隔符
patterns.context: HackerNews 页面摘录中的路径式标题、疑似抓取/编码噪声和字符序列；强激活落在短字符串片段，原因不明。

en.description: The main salient pattern is lexical activation on reckon (1–3); other activations are distributed across email fields and capacity, code formatting, technical discussions, legal titles, image placeholders, and paper captions, with several activations at line-break boundaries. Most patterns are local word-form or formatting cues.

patterns.name: reckon vocabulary
patterns.context: reckon is used in a sentence to express judgment, belief, or expectation; surrounding subjects and content vary.
patterns.domain: Philosophical texts, online discussions, and Q&A

patterns.name: Email headers and metadata fields
patterns.context: Formatted fields such as email headers, date and time, recipient, and subject.

patterns.name: capacity wording
patterns.context: The word Capacity is tokenized and appears in contract subjects or economic calendar fields.

patterns.name: Code markers and line endings
patterns.context: Identifiers, assignments, parentheses, and nearby line breaks in code or configuration files; activation falls on many different tokens.

patterns.name: API and screen-related discussions
patterns.context: Discussion of how a product or software API adapts to screens, including titles, line breaks, and questions.

patterns.name: Layout/image placeholders in documents
patterns.context: Image placeholders, table fields, and calendar data occur consecutively.
patterns.domain: Embedded webpage or calendar content in Enron emails

patterns.name: Litigant labels
patterns.context: Legal document excerpts listing plaintiffs, defendants, and third-party litigants.

patterns.name: Line breaks and whitespace formatting
patterns.context: Activation often falls on line breaks or layout boundaries, with no clear consistent relationship to paragraph topics.

patterns.name: Size/asterisk markers in image captions
patterns.context: Describes cell-size categories in immunostaining images, indicated by color or asterisks.

4_1246.description: 主要显著规律是 reckon 的词汇激活（1–3）；其余激活分散于邮件字段与 capacity、代码格式、技术讨论、法律称谓、图像占位符及论文图注，并有若干换行边界激活。各模式多为局部词形或格式线索。

patterns.name: reckon 词汇
patterns.context: 句中以 reckon 表示判断、相信或预计；周围主语和内容不固定
patterns.domain: 哲学文本、网络对话与问答

patterns.name: 邮件头部与元数据字段
patterns.context: 邮件抬头、日期时间、收件人及主题等格式化字段

patterns.name: capacity 字样
patterns.context: 词语 Capacity 被分词标记，出现于合同主题或经济日历字段

patterns.name: 代码标记与行尾
patterns.context: 代码或配置文件中的标识符、赋值、括号及换行附近；激活落在多种不同 token 上

patterns.name: API 与屏幕相关讨论
patterns.context: 讨论产品或软件 API 如何适配屏幕，含标题、换行与问句

patterns.name: 文档中的版式／图像占位符
patterns.context: 图像占位符、表格字段和日历数据连续出现
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的嵌入式网页或日历内容

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人称谓
patterns.context: 列出原告、被告及第三方当事人的法律文书片段

patterns.name: 换行与空白格式
patterns.context: 激活常落在换行或排版边界；与段落主题没有明显统一关系

patterns.name: 图像说明中的尺寸／星号标记
patterns.context: 描述免疫染色图像中以颜色或星号标示的细胞大小类别

en.description: Activations are distributed across encyclopedia headings and ordinal suffixes, code identifiers and APIs, various uses of home, descriptions of request initiators, and ethical discussions of human/nonhuman entities; there is no clear shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Entry structure and century categories
patterns.context: Wikipedia entry headings separated by line breaks and category paths; activation also falls on whitespace and numbers near headings.

patterns.name: Description of request initiator
patterns.context: A code comment explains the purpose of caller ID and how the principal is populated, emphasizing the person initiating the request.

patterns.name: home in a filename
patterns.context: The selector and templateUrl in an Angular component configuration, where home is part of a page or template name.

patterns.name: home in a family-role compound
patterns.context: Describes a comic creator’s self-described role as a stay-at-home father; home occurs in a hyphenated compound.

patterns.name: home meaning residence
patterns.context: Facts of a legal case describing a house being sold after mortgage default.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: Ordinal suffix after a number, used for season or century numbering; both examples are embedded in a name or category expression.

patterns.name: Swift controller name
patterns.context: A filename or class name in a code comment, with Send at the start of a camel-case identifier.

patterns.name: Human and nonhuman natural environments
patterns.context: An ethical discussion distinguishing human and nonhuman environments.

patterns.name: home as a navigation label
patterns.context: A webpage navigation menu label alongside news and search.

patterns.name: SecretListOptions call
patterns.context: Go test code calling a client list API and passing an empty list-options struct.

4_1246.description: 激活分散于百科标题与序数后缀、代码标识符及 API、home 的多种用法、请求发起者说明和伦理学人类/非人类表述；没有共同的明确语义触发点。

patterns.name: 条目结构与世纪分类
