en.description: Activations are distributed across different corpora, often falling on hyphenated compounds or adjacent word fragments (all-time, and-compounds, 200-mg), and also on news time expressions, case titles, and email content; there is no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: all-time compounds
patterns.context: “all-” is followed by a hyphen and another element, especially in expressions such as “all-time leader/record”; one example also uses “all-white officer complement.”
patterns.domain: Sports figures and records, military history

patterns.name: and compound expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls on “and” and its neighboring hyphen or element in hyphenated compounds; examples express “three-and-a-half days,” “solid and experienced,” and “ordinary rank-and-file members.”

patterns.name: Time markers in sports reporting
patterns.context: The possessive time expression “Tuesday night's” is followed by a game and postponement news; the excerpt also includes teams, game coverage, and a “--”-style news lead.

patterns.name: Legal judgment titles and case citations
patterns.context: In case titles, “v” is followed by party names, and the case name is repeated in the text; court, evidence, and legal procedure terms also occur.

patterns.name: Email address and attachment
patterns.context: After the sender, address, and subject in the email header, the body mentions “homework” in quotation marks; activation is concentrated on that word and fragments of the email address.

patterns.name: Hyphenated medical dosage expression
patterns.context: A treatment-group dose consists of a number, hyphen, and mg, appearing in a clinical trial results description.

4_1246.description: 激活分散于不同语料，常落在连字符复合词或相邻词片段（all-time、and-复合表达、200-mg），也包括新闻时间表达、案件标题及邮件内容；没有单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: all-time 复合词
patterns.context: “all-”后接连字符及后续成分，尤其出现在“all-time leader/record”一类表达中；也有一次用于“all-white officer complement”。
patterns.domain: 体育人物与纪录、军事历史

patterns.name: and 复合表达
patterns.context: 在连字符连接的复合表达中，对“and”及其邻近连字符或成分激活；覆盖“三天半”“稳健且有经验”“基层普通成员”等表达。

patterns.name: 体育赛事报道中的时间标记
patterns.context: 所有格时间表达“Tuesday night's”后接比赛及延期消息；片段还出现球队、比赛报道和“--”式新闻导语。

patterns.name: 法律判决标题与案件引用
patterns.trigger: « v»5« Western»6« Australia»2；« v»4« Western»7« Australia»2
patterns.context: 案件标题中“v”后接当事方名称，且在正文重复案件名称；同时可见法院、证据或法律程序词汇。

patterns.name: 电子邮件地址及附件
patterns.context: 邮件头中的发件人、地址和主题之后，正文提到带引号的“homework”；激活集中在该词及邮件地址碎片。

patterns.name: 医学剂量连字符表达
patterns.context: 治疗组剂量以数字、连字符和 mg 构成，位于临床试验结果描述中。

en.concept: Word fragments expressing currency and novelty
en.description: High activation often falls on present (incumbent, current version, or up to the present) and ever with comparatives/novelty expressions, as well as on several segmented word fragments and parts of proper names; across news, religion, encyclopedias, formatting, and academic texts, word forms and local contexts vary.

patterns.name: present as a temporal or version endpoint
patterns.context: present indicates the current version, an incumbent position, or a temporal endpoint extending to the present; it is preceded by a definite article and followed by a noun or period.

patterns.name: ever introducing escalation or novelty
patterns.context: ever modifies a comparative or combines with a hyphen to emphasize novelty or unpredictability.
patterns.domain: Game news, religious discussions, academic papers

patterns.name: Highlighted fragments inside proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls inside segmented words or proper names; examples include doodles, enigmatic, the oe ligature, possessives, and Erase Me.
patterns.domain: Interviews, game reviews, typography notes, music encyclopedias

patterns.name: General present/edition wording
patterns.context: Used with edition to refer to this edition; distinct from uses describing an incumbent or the present time.
patterns.domain: Prefaces or edition notes in older books

4_1246.concept: 当前性与新颖表达的词片段
4_1246.description: 高激活常落在 present（现任、当前版本或至今）和 ever 加比较级/新颖表达，也落在若干分词拆开的词片段及专名内部；跨新闻、宗教、百科、排版与学术文本，词形和局部语境并不完全一致。

patterns.name: present 作时间或版本终点
patterns.context: present 表示当前版本、现任职位或延伸至今的时间终点；前有定冠词，后接名词或句号。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、书籍版本说明

patterns.name: ever 引出的递增或新颖表达
patterns.context: ever 修饰比较级，或与连字符组合强调新颖、不可预测。
patterns.domain: 游戏新闻、宗教论述、学术论文

patterns.name: 专名内部的高亮片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词拆开的单词或专名内部；分别见 doodles、enigmatic、oe 连字、所有格及 Erase Me。
patterns.domain: 采访、游戏评论、排版说明、音乐百科

patterns.name: 一般 present／出版措辞
patterns.context: 与 edition 搭配，指本版；区别于描述现任或至今的用法。

en.description: Activations are distributed across different words and intra-word fragments: use/used, take-home, sitting-room, deformable, and various words in surveys, interviews, and program promotions. There is no stable semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Noun prefix or intra-word fragment “use”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word use, followed by “of” and introducing the use of a material, technology, or organism; examples are mostly patent or academic technical descriptions.

patterns.name: take in a compound
patterns.context: Activation falls on take in take-home; the context describes a patient’s home treatment arrangement.

patterns.name: sitting in a compound
patterns.context: Activation falls on sitting in sitting-room, describing a residential or lodging space.

patterns.name: deform in a compound
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial fragment of deformable; it refers to a deformable fastener component and its function.

patterns.name: Complex prefixes or subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on ordinary words or intra-word fragments in an organizational inclusion survey, interview content, and television program introduction; these words occur in unrelated contexts.
patterns.domain: Corporate surveys, entertainment interviews, television program promotions

patterns.name: used in technical prose
patterns.context: Activation falls on used in a sentence explaining how a beam is generated; unlike the noun use in segments 6 and 7.

patterns.name: doubled in technical prose
patterns.context: Activation falls on doubled, describing the doubling of amplifier circuit quantity subject to cost and space constraints.

4_1246.description: 激活分散在不同词及词内片段：use/used、take-home、sitting-room、deformable，以及调查、访谈和节目宣传中的多种词。没有稳定的语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 名词前缀或词内片段“use”
patterns.context: 激活落在 use 一词，后接 “of” 并引出某种材料、技术或生物的用途；多为专利或学术技术描述。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景、PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 复合词中的 take
patterns.context: 激活在 take-home 的 take 部分；语境描述患者的居家治疗安排。

patterns.name: 复合词中的 sitting
patterns.context: 激活在 sitting-room 一词中，描述住宅或住宿空间。

patterns.name: 复合词中的 deform
patterns.context: 激活在 deformable 一词的词首片段；指可变形的紧固件部件及其作用。

patterns.name: 复杂前缀或子词片段
patterns.trigger: “« slow»3”、“« usually»3”、“« surveyed»10”、“« book»5”、“« critically»7”、“« acclaimed»5”
patterns.context: 激活分别落在组织包容性调查、访谈内容和电视节目介绍中的普通词或词内片段；这些词所处语境彼此不同。
patterns.domain: 企业调查、娱乐访谈、电视节目宣传

patterns.name: 技术文句中的 used
patterns.context: 激活在 used，所在句说明选择波束的生成方式；不同于第6、7段的 use 名词用法。

patterns.name: 技术文句中的 doubled
patterns.context: 激活在 doubled，描述放大器电路数量加倍但受成本和空间限制。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several words and word-internal fragments: used, worn, hit, do/odles, try/pomastigote, piece, use, and others. Some cluster around descriptions of wear or popular works; the rest span entertainment, biomedicine, and patent texts, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Common word “used”
patterns.context: Appears in sentences such as technical descriptions and news commentary, usually before a noun or in a prepositional phrase

patterns.name: “worn” and wear-related contexts
patterns.context: Describes worn bushings or chairs, or old and damaged items; worn is repeated in [1]

patterns.name: “hit” and successful works
patterns.context: Describes songs or theatrical works as popular

patterns.name: “do” followed by “odles”
patterns.context: Appears in an informal description of a person’s habits

patterns.name: “try” followed by “pomastigote”
patterns.context: Word-internal fragment of the name of a parasite life-cycle stage

patterns.name: “piece”
patterns.context: Refers to a theatrical work

patterns.name: “use”
patterns.context: Appears in the “the use of ...” construction, discussing experimental materials or methods

patterns.name: Unclassified sporadic triggers
patterns.context: Each occurs within a different word or proper name, with no stable shared condition

4_1246.description: 激活散布于若干词及词内片段：used、worn、hit、do/odles、try/pomastigote、piece、use 等。部分集中在磨损描述或热门作品语境，其余分属娱乐、生物医学和专利文本，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 常见词“used”
patterns.context: 在技术说明、新闻评论等句中出现，通常位于名词前或介词短语中

patterns.name: “worn”及磨损语境
patterns.context: 描述衬套或椅子磨损、旧损；[1]中 worn 重复出现

patterns.name: “hit”与成功作品
patterns.context: 形容歌曲或戏剧作品受欢迎

patterns.name: “do”后接“odles”
patterns.context: 出现在对人物习惯的非正式描述中

patterns.name: “try”后接“pomastigote”
patterns.context: 寄生虫生活史阶段名称的词内片段

patterns.name: “piece”
patterns.context: 指一部戏剧作品

patterns.name: “use”
patterns.context: 出现在“the use of ...”结构中，谈论实验材料或方法

patterns.name: 未归入的零散触发
patterns.context: 各自出现在不同词或专名的词内片段中，未显示稳定共同条件

en.description: Activations are distributed across multiple words or word fragments, including worn, do, know, and piece, spanning conversational, proper-name, work-description, and technical contexts; beyond their local collocations, there is no clear shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: worn
patterns.context: “worn” modifies an object or component, especially when introducing old items, wear, or replacement/refurbishment; segment 1 also contains “worn out”.

patterns.name: do string
patterns.context: Activation falls on the token fragment do: in segment 2, the quote “do what you want”; in segment 5, inside “doodles”; in segment 6, inside the software name “Dozer”.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, entertainment reporting, technical Q&A

patterns.name: know string
patterns.context: Activation falls on the token fragment know: “I know” in segment 2 and the proper name “know protein (KP)” in segment 3.

patterns.name: piece
patterns.context: “piece” refers to a work or musical composition; examples occur in descriptions of a theatrical work and a concert performance.

patterns.name: malfunction
patterns.context: Refers to equipment failure, with the cause explained later.

patterns.name: spent
patterns.context: “spent liquor” refers to waste liquor produced after the preceding cooking cycle and reused in the process description.

4_1246.description: 激活分散在 worn、do、know、piece 等多个词或词片段上，涵盖口语、专名、作品描述及技术语境；除各自局部搭配外，没有清晰共同触发条件。

patterns.name: worn
patterns.context: “worn”修饰物件或部件，尤其是在介绍旧物、磨损状态或更换/翻新的情境中；第1段还出现“worn out”

patterns.name: do 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在 do 这一 token 片段：第2段为引语“do what you want”，第5段位于单词“doodles”内部，第6段位于软件名“Dozer”内部
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、娱乐报道、技术问答

patterns.name: know 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在 know 这一 token 片段：第2段是“I know”，第3段是专名“know protein (KP)”
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、生物医学论文

patterns.name: piece
patterns.context: “piece”指一部作品或乐曲；分别处于戏剧作品介绍和音乐会演出叙述中
patterns.domain: 百科全书式艺术与音乐介绍

patterns.name: malfunction
patterns.context: 指设备故障，并在后文说明故障原因

patterns.name: spent
patterns.context: “spent liquor”指前一轮蒸煮后产生、再用于工艺说明的废液
patterns.domain: 专利背景、工业制浆工艺

en.concept: English past participles and fragments in medical and technical terminology
en.description: Activations often fall on fragments such as worn/worn out, spent, expressed, and acquired; know protein also appears. There are additional sporadic punctuation marks and split fragments, with no shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “worn out” at a contrast
patterns.context: Describes an item as worn or used up; activation falls on worn, not out.

patterns.name: spent liquor
patterns.context: In a wood-chip digestion process, refers to the liquid remaining after a prior cooking stage.

patterns.name: expressed isozymes
patterns.context: Describes isozymes expressed after stable transfection of cells and used to compare properties.

patterns.name: Boundary of an expressed product name
patterns.context: In a recombinant protein production process, activation occurs on expressed and the beginning of the name that follows.

patterns.name: acquired disease
patterns.context: acquired modifies a disease name or medical process; the sentences in the two instances differ.

patterns.name: know protein
patterns.context: The proper name Know protein (KP) appears in research on malaria parasite physiology and immunity.

patterns.name: Worn components in a patent citation
patterns.context: Describes high-chromium liners and replacement costs; worn modifies liners.

patterns.name: Unexplained word fragments
patterns.context: These activations fall respectively on a delimiter, ordinal suffix, possessive fragment, or split word fragment, without consistent semantic context.

4_1246.concept: 英语过去分词及医学、技术术语中的词片段
4_1246.description: 激活多落在 worn/worn out、spent、expressed、acquired 等词片段上，也见 know protein；另有零散标点和切分片段，无法归入共同语义模式。

patterns.name: 转折处的“worn out”
patterns.context: 形容已磨损、用旧的物品；激活落在 worn，而非 out。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论；专利技术说明

patterns.name: spent liquor
patterns.context: 木片消化工艺中指先前蒸煮后剩下的液体。

patterns.name: expressed isozymes
patterns.context: 描述细胞稳定转染后表达、并用于比较性质的同工酶。

patterns.name: 表达产物名称边界
patterns.context: 重组蛋白生产流程中，激活出现在 expressed 一词及其后名称开头。

patterns.name: acquired disease
patterns.trigger: « acquired»10 immunodeficiency syndrome；« acquired»9 vitamin K
patterns.context: acquired 修饰疾病名称或医学过程；两处所在句子并不相同。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术；生物医学摘要

patterns.name: know protein
patterns.context: 疟原虫相关生理与免疫研究中，出现专名 Know protein (KP)。

patterns.name: 专利引文中的磨损部件
patterns.context: 描述高铬衬板及其更换成本，worn 修饰 liners。

patterns.name: 未解释的词片段
patterns.context: 这些激活分别落在分隔符、序数后缀、所有格片段或被切分的词片段上，缺少一致的语义上下文。

en.description: Strong activations are distributed across local fragments of different words: do, worn, move, be, and several sporadic word fragments and punctuation marks. They span domains and contexts, with no stable semantic or syntactic pattern beyond a few repeated words.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment “do”
patterns.context: The trigger occurs inside English words or phrases, such as “do what,” “doodles,” and “hadith”; contexts are not consistent.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, video descriptions, religious Q&A

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment “worn out”
patterns.context: Triggered by worn in “worn out” or “worn liners,” referring respectively to a worn chair or liners.

patterns.name: move before a noun
patterns.context: Triggered by move meaning an action or measure, followed by predicate structures such as has been made or was a gamble.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment “be”
patterns.context: Triggered by the initial intra-word fragment, as in “beigoma”; adjacent words show no stable semantic relationship.

patterns.name: Local word fragments and markers
patterns.context: A few anomalous activations are scattered across word fragments, punctuation, and common words in technical texts or sentences; no shared contextual condition is evident.
patterns.domain: Astronomy papers, patent text, forum comments

4_1246.description: 强激活分散在不同词的局部片段：do、worn、move、be，以及若干零散词片段和标点。跨领域、跨语境，除少数重复词外没有稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 词内片段「do」
patterns.context: 触发点出现在英语词或短语内部：如“do what”“doodles”“hadith”等；上下文并不统一。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、视频介绍、宗教问答

patterns.name: 词内片段「worn out」
patterns.context: 触发于“worn out”或“worn liners”中的 worn，分别表示磨损的椅子或衬板。

patterns.name: 名词前的 move
patterns.context: 触发于表示行动或举措的 move，后接 has been made 或 was a gamble 等谓语结构。

patterns.name: 词内片段「be」
patterns.context: 触发于词内开头片段，如“beigoma”；其余邻近词未显示稳定语义关系。

patterns.name: 局部词片段与标记
patterns.context: 少量异常激活散落于技术文本或句子中的词片段、标点和常见词；未见共同上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 天文学论文、专利文本、论坛评论

en.concept: English local word forms and function words
en.description: Activations occur across multiple domains: common function words such as be verbs and the, as well as word-internal fragments, hyphens, and punctuation. Other local topics include biotechnology, plant breeding, worn materials, religious transmission, astronomy, law, and music, making it difficult to identify a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments and word-form completion
patterns.context: Activation fragments occur inside words or across punctuation and hyphenated word forms; they are not simply complete word boundaries.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including patents, legal citations, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Be verbs and following word forms
patterns.context: Activations occur on copular or auxiliary forms, often connecting subjects and complements, describing states, or forming legal conditions; many other activations also occur, so this is not a unique trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Technical texts, forums, papers, legal texts

patterns.name: Definite article and common function words
patterns.context: Common function words are marked in different syntactic positions, especially articles in noun phrases and function words in infinitive or prepositional constructions; triggers are weak and do not occur every time.
patterns.domain: English prose and technical texts across domains

patterns.name: Recombinant expression and recovery in a patent
patterns.context: Patent sentences describe transforming host cells, expressing LERK-5 polypeptides, and recovering the product; biotechnology terms and their word-internal fragments occur.

patterns.name: Reliability of hadith transmission
patterns.context: Discusses insufficient records of transmitters and hadith mursal (interrupted transmission); marked words include both semantically related terms and ordinary function words.

patterns.name: Astronomical regions and density comparisons
patterns.context: Compares a local analog near the center of the Virgo Cluster with a target region and matches their densities.

patterns.name: Industrial liner materials and wear
patterns.context: Describes chromium content, abrasion-resistant advanced liners, and their wear quantities, in the context of maintenance costs and material recovery.

patterns.name: Anecdote about a worn chair
patterns.context: Mentions a worn-out chair in a doctor’s waiting room and links it to an original finding; there is no clear shared theme with the other fragments.

patterns.name: Plant breeding and selection
patterns.context: Describes identifying or constructing a heterozygous population, selecting plants for superiority, and crossing them.

patterns.name: Conditions and citation formatting in legal arguments
patterns.context: Supreme Court case citations, indented legal passages, and conditional arguments about whether a rule is effective; markings cluster around citation punctuation and terms in the argument.

patterns.name: Hyphenated age numbers
patterns.context: A biographical entry spells an age with a hyphen, showing a compound-adjective format across a word boundary.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in an instrument name
patterns.context: When describing the history of the Japanese instrument biwa, activation concentrates on an internal fragment of its name; the surrounding text also discusses casting and weighting.

patterns.name: Band and music-style narrative
patterns.context: Discusses a band’s hiatus, members’ commitments, style, and albums; activations occur on both music vocabulary and ordinary syntactic words.

4_1246.concept: 英文局部词形与功能词
4_1246.description: 激活分布在多领域文本：既有 be 动词、the 等常见功能词，也有词内片段、连字符和标点；另见生物技术、育种、磨损材料、宗教传述、天文学、法律及音乐等局部主题，难归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 词内片段与词尾补全
patterns.context: 激活片段出现在词内部或跨标点、连字符的词形片段中；不是单纯完整词边界。
patterns.domain: 专利、法律引文、百科条目等多种文体

patterns.name: be 动词及其后续词形
patterns.context: 对系词或助动词形式有激活，常出现在句中连接主语与补语、描述状态或构成法律条件的位置；同时存在不少其他激活，不能解释为唯一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 技术文本、论坛、论文、法律文本

patterns.name: 定冠词及常见功能词
patterns.context: 常见虚词在不同句法位置被标记，尤其是名词短语中的冠词及不定式或介词结构中的功能词；触发较弱且并非每次出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文与技术文本

patterns.name: 专利中重组表达与回收
patterns.context: 描述转化宿主细胞、表达 LERK-5 多肽及回收产物的专利句子；出现生物技术术语及其词内片段。

patterns.name: 圣训传述可靠性
patterns.context: 讨论传述者记录不足、圣训 mursal（中断传述）时；被标记的词既包括语义相关词，也包括普通功能词。

patterns.name: 天文学区域与密度比较
patterns.context: 比较室女座星团中心附近区域与目标区域的局部类比及密度匹配。

patterns.name: 工业衬里材料与磨损
patterns.context: 描述铬含量、刮损的高级衬里及其磨损数量，处于维护费用与材料回收语境。

patterns.name: 磨损椅子逸闻
patterns.context: 提及医生接待室里磨坏的椅子，并将其联系到某项原始发现；与其他片段没有明显共同主题。

patterns.name: 植物育种与选择
patterns.context: 描述杂合群体的识别或构建、按优势筛选植株并进行杂交。
patterns.domain: USPTO 农业/植物育种专利

patterns.name: 法律论证中的条件与引文格式
patterns.context: 最高法院判例引文、法律缩进段落及关于规则是否有效的条件论证；标记集中在引文标点和论证词附近。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决或诉讼文书

patterns.name: 年龄数字的连字符格式
patterns.context: 人物传记中以连字符拼写年龄，呈现跨词边界的复合形容词格式。

patterns.name: 乐器名称的词内片段
patterns.context: 介绍日本乐器 biwa 的历史时，激活集中在名称的内部片段；周围还谈及铸造与配重。

patterns.name: 乐队及音乐风格叙述
patterns.context: 谈论乐队暂停活动、成员承诺及风格和专辑；激活同时落在音乐词汇和普通句法词上。

en.concept: Local word segments and markers in English text
en.description: Activations are scattered across English text from many domains, often on common grammatical words, subword fragments, and punctuation. Other contexts include source-code markers, patent terminology, legal and medical text, astronomy, elections, music, and software configuration, making it difficult to identify a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Common words and grammatical fragments across domains
patterns.context: Appears in English explanations, narratives, or arguments, often alongside syntactic function words and nearby phrase boundaries; triggering is not limited to a particular topic.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose and technical text

patterns.name: had better phrase
patterns.context: One instance is a word-internal fragment of the religious term hadith; another is the fixed phrase “had better” in quotation marks, preceded by “the” and followed by “phrase”. It is difficult to determine whether the two contexts reflect the same lexical pattern.

patterns.name: HTML/CSS tags and attribute markers
patterns.context: In an HTML snippet, tags, attribute syntax, and instructions in comments appear in sequence.

patterns.name: Technical terms in recombinant expression constructs
patterns.context: Appears around the production of the LERK-5 polypeptide, host-cell transformation, and expression; activation also falls on hyphens and subword fragments.

patterns.name: Technical terms and numerical descriptions
patterns.context: Describes wear, replacement costs, and material composition of blast-furnace linings; “scrapped” is split into fragments.

patterns.name: Medical care and legal rights statements
patterns.context: A summary sentence states that detainees are entitled to necessary medical care.

patterns.name: Place names and astronomical region names
patterns.context: When comparing local analog regions, the Virgo Cluster name is split into fragments and appears alongside descriptions of angular distance and density.

patterns.name: Election term and subword splits
patterns.context: The hyphenated compound “by-election” recurs in the title and body, especially its split parts.

patterns.name: Touring and album information
patterns.context: Introduces CNCO’s tour and the album it supported; Más is split into fragments.

patterns.name: Negation/removal instruction word
patterns.context: A source-code comment instructs not to remove a div; this overlaps with common English word patterns and code contexts.

patterns.name: Configuration documentation and dependency injection
patterns.context: Asks about the Dozer mapper and Spring bean dependency injection; the tool name Dozer is split into fragments.

4_1246.concept: 英文文本中的局部词段与标记
4_1246.description: 激活分散于多领域英文文本，常落在常见语法词、词内片段和标点上；另涉及源码标记、专利术语、法律医疗、天文、选举、音乐及软件配置，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 跨领域的常见词与语法片段
patterns.context: 出现在英文说明、叙述或论证中，常与句法功能词及相邻的短语边界共同出现；触发并不局限于某一主题。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文与技术文本

patterns.name: had better 词组
patterns.context: 一处是宗教术语 hadith 的词内片段；另一处在引号中的固定短语 “had better”，前有 “the”，后接 “phrase”。两种语境难以确认是同一词义模式。
patterns.domain: 伊斯兰学术讨论；小说叙述

patterns.name: HTML/CSS 标签与属性标记
patterns.context: 在 HTML 片段中，标签、属性语法及注释里的指令连续出现。

patterns.name: 重组表达构造中的技术词
patterns.context: 围绕 LERK-5 多肽的生产、宿主细胞转化及表达过程出现；激活也落在连字符及词内片段上。

patterns.name: 专业名词与数值描述
patterns.context: 描述高炉衬板的磨损、更换成本及材料成分；“scrapped”被拆为片段。

patterns.name: 医疗救治与法律权利表述
patterns.context: 在总结句中说明被拘留者有权获得所需医疗救治。

patterns.name: 地名及天文区域名称
patterns.context: 在比较局部类比区域时，Virgo 星团名称拆分为词段，并与角距离和密度描述共现。

patterns.name: 选举词与词内拆分
patterns.context: 在标题和正文中反复出现连字符复合词 “by-election”，尤其是其拆分部分。

patterns.name: 旅游与专辑信息
patterns.context: 介绍 CNCO 的巡演及其支持的专辑；Más 被拆分为词段。

patterns.name: 否定/移除指令词
patterns.context: 源码注释要求不要移除某个 div；此处与一般英文常见词模式及代码语境重叠。

patterns.name: 配置文档与依赖注入
patterns.context: 询问 Dozer 转换器及 Spring bean 依赖注入，工具名 Dozer 被拆分。

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-internal fragments of had, do, are, and other words, as well as legal-document line breaks, XML entities, encyclopedia category colons, and quotation ellipses. No unified semantics or stable domain is apparent; some triggers may come from subword segmentation and formatting markers.

patterns.name: Subword fragments around had
patterns.context: Especially prominent when had occurs; [1] is the «had» fragment split from hadith, while [2] is «had» in the quotation “had better”; their contexts differ

patterns.name: Legal document structure and formatting markers
patterns.context: Near line breaks, headings, abbreviations, and possessives in court opinions or pleadings

patterns.name: XML/HTML tags and attribute boundaries
patterns.context: At boundaries between XML/HTML tags, escaped entities, and attribute text in code documentation

patterns.name: Category: category labels
patterns.context: Wikipedia category entries beginning with Category:, containing nationality, region, or occupation categories

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in dozer
patterns.context: In Java/Spring configuration documentation, the name Dozer is tokenized as dozer and appears again in later sentences

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in areal
patterns.context: In a scientific paper, areal density is split in a quantitative comparison context

patterns.name: do fragment in a spoken transcript
patterns.context: In a person’s interview introduction, doodles is split into do and a following fragment

patterns.name: Ellipsis punctuation
patterns.context: In quotations or paraphrases, an ellipsis is followed by quoted content

4_1246.description: 激活分散于 had、do、are 等词内片段，以及法律格式换行、XML 实体、百科分类冒号和引语省略号；未见统一语义或稳定领域，部分触发可能来自子词切分与格式标记。

patterns.name: had 前后的子词片段
patterns.trigger: «had»，以及紧邻的« he»、« just»、« better»等片段
patterns.context: 出现 had 时尤其明显；[1] 为 hadith 的切分片段 «had»， [2] 为引语 “had better” 中的 «had»，二者上下文不同

patterns.name: 法律文书结构与格式标记
patterns.context: 法院意见或诉状文本的换行、标题、缩写和所有格附近

patterns.name: XML/HTML 标记与属性边界
patterns.context: 代码文档中的 XML/HTML 标签、转义实体及属性文本交界处
patterns.domain: 软件代码与 API 文档

patterns.name: Category: 分类标签
patterns.context: 维基百科分类条目，以 Category: 开头，包含国籍、地域或职业类别

patterns.name: dozer 词内片段
patterns.context: Java/Spring 配置说明中，Dozer 名称被分词为 dozer，并在后续文句中再次出现

patterns.name: areal 的词内片段
patterns.context: 科学论文中 areal density 一词被切分，处于定量比较语境

patterns.name: 口语转录中的 do 片段
patterns.context: 人物采访介绍中，doodles 被切分为 do 与后续片段

patterns.name: 省略号标点
patterns.context: 引语或转述中，省略号后接引文内容

en.concept: Word fragments and common word forms
en.description: The most consistent clue is activation on the substring had in had better and hadith. Other activations are scattered across word-internal fragments, common function words, and punctuation; one passage clusters around plant-breeding terminology. Overall, there is no unified semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: had / had better fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls directly on the full form had or the split substring had; [1] is a had better conversation, and [2] is inside the word hadith. The trigger does not require a consistent meaning or syntactic role.

patterns.name: Word-internal substrings and token boundaries
patterns.context: Activation appears on subword fragments inside words or punctuation, rather than on complete semantic units; token boundaries and spelling positions vary, with no common contextual condition.
patterns.domain: News commentary, physics papers, biomedical text, poetry, encyclopedia entries, legal documents

patterns.name: Local function words and common collocations
patterns.context: These common function words or pronouns are marked in different syntactic positions; there is no consistent neighboring word or specific syntactic frame, so they may be sporadic co-occurring activations.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, papers, legal text, and literary text

patterns.name: Plant breeding and selection process
patterns.context: Describes identifying or creating heterozygous populations, selecting superior plants, and crossing; multiple activated words cluster in the breeding-process context.

patterns.name: Sentence-final/paragraph line-break markers
patterns.context: Appears near paragraph or sentence boundaries; seen in only a few passages and alongside other activation content, so it cannot be identified as an independent, stable pattern.

4_1246.description: 最稳定线索是 had 子串在 had better 与 hadith 中的激活。其余激活分散于词内片段、常见虚词及标点；另有一段集中于植物育种术语，整体缺乏统一语义或文体规律。

patterns.name: had／had better 片段
patterns.trigger: «had»10；[1] 中还有 “«had»10« better»2”，[2] 中为 “the« had»10ith”
patterns.context: 激活直接落在 had 的完整形式或被切分的子串 had 上；[1] 是 had better 的对话，[2] 是 hadith 一词内部。触发条件并不要求统一词义或句法。

patterns.name: 词内子串与分词边界
patterns.context: 激活出现在词语或标点内部的子词片段，而非完整语义单位；分词边界和拼写位置多样，缺少共同上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、物理学论文、生物医学文本、诗歌、百科条目、法律文书

patterns.name: 局部功能词与常见搭配
patterns.context: 这些常见虚词或代词在不同句法位置被标记；没有一致的邻接词或特定句法框架，可能是零散伴随激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、论文、法律文本及文学文本

patterns.name: 植物育种与选择流程
patterns.context: 描述杂合群体的识别或创建、优良植株筛选及杂交；多个激活词集中在育种流程语境中。
patterns.domain: 专利背景／农业育种技术

patterns.name: 句末／段落换行标记
patterns.context: 出现在段落或句子边界附近；仅见于少数片段，且与其他激活内容并存，不能确定是独立稳定模式。
patterns.domain: 文学文本及学术文本的排版

en.concept: Various local collocations and formatting fragments
en.description: Activations concentrate mainly on formulaic headings, court names, spacing, and case numbers in U.S. court decisions. Sporadic responses also occur for had better, hadith, selected/best/intercross in plant breeding, and &:hover/focus in CSS.

patterns.name: “had better” collocation
patterns.context: The fixed phrase “had better” appears in English dialogue; activation falls mainly on had, with weaker activations on neighboring words.

patterns.name: Court decision headings and case-number formatting
patterns.context: Formatted headings, party names, and case numbers in U.S. appellate or state-court decisions; the formulaic phrase “Appeal from” appears repeatedly.

patterns.name: Islamic transmitter terminology
patterns.context: When discussing tabi'i, companions, transmitter reliability, and chains of transmission, hadith terminology appears; activation falls on the subword fragment had.

patterns.name: Breeding selection and propagation
patterns.context: Describes crossing between heterozygous populations and parents, selecting plants based on individual or progeny performance, and continuing to cross them.

patterns.name: CSS pseudo-class selectors
patterns.context: In SCSS/CSS code, & and a colon together form hover and focus pseudo-class selectors.

patterns.name: Court/courtroom name fragments in legal documents
patterns.context: Court-heading formatting, but this segment is the Court of International Trade heading rather than an appellate decision heading; it lacks the “Appeal from” phrasing common in other segments.

4_1246.concept: 多种局部固定搭配与格式片段
4_1246.description: 激活主要集中于美国法院判决的程式化标题、法院名称、空格对齐与案号；另对 had better、hadith、植物育种中的 selected/best/intercross，以及 CSS 的 &:hover/focus 有零散响应。

patterns.name: “had better”搭配
patterns.context: 英语对话中出现固定搭配“had better”；激活主要落在 had，前后搭配词也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 法院判决标题与案号排版
patterns.trigger: «Appeal» «from» «the» United States District «Court» «for» the District «of» [州/地区]；以及法院名称、案号、冒号和对齐空格
patterns.context: 美国上诉法院或州法院判决的标题、当事人栏及案号等格式化文本；多次出现“Appeal from”程式化表述。

patterns.name: 伊斯兰传述者术语
patterns.context: 讨论 tabi'i、companions、传述者可信度及传述链时，出现 hadith 术语；激活落在 had 的子词片段。

patterns.name: 育种选择与繁殖
patterns.context: 描述杂合群体、亲本间杂交、依据个体或后代表现选株并继续杂交的过程。

patterns.name: CSS伪类选择器
patterns.context: SCSS/CSS代码中，& 与冒号共同构成 hover、focus 伪类选择器。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的法院/法庭名称残片
patterns.trigger: “COURT« OF» INTER…TRADE”等法院名称中的“COURT OF”及大写标题残片
patterns.context: 法院标题排版，但此段是国际贸易法院抬头而非上诉判决标题，缺少其他段常见的 Appeal from 句式。

en.description: Activations occur across varied vocabulary and formatting: especially the opening lines of federal appellate cases, as well as procedural language in pleadings. Other local fragments include had better, hadith, built up, existence, and would-be; no unified semantic or syntactic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Federal appellate case titles and court-source lines
patterns.context: The title or caption format of U.S. federal appellate opinions; often followed by district, state, city, judge, and case number.

patterns.name: Procedural language in legal pleadings
patterns.context: Pleadings or judicial opinions describing plaintiffs, defendants, and motions to dismiss complaints.

patterns.name: Fixed expression had better
patterns.context: Used in English sentences to express advice or obligation; one instance explicitly discusses the phrase.

patterns.name: hadith terminology
patterns.context: When discussing chains of transmission and classifications such as mursal, the fragment containing had inside the word is activated.

patterns.name: Land-cover proportion description
patterns.context: A land-use statistics passage mentions a built up area and then describes the proportion of housing and buildings.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment of existence
patterns.context: A research abstract discusses the existence of a certain gradient; activation falls on a fragment within existence.

patterns.name: would-be construction
patterns.context: A philosophy discussion uses would-be as a premodifier to describe a possible defiant party.

4_1246.description: 激活分布于多种词汇和格式：尤见联邦上诉案首行，另有诉状程序用语；其余是 had better、hadith、built up、existence、would-be 等局部片段，未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 联邦上诉案标题与法院来源行
patterns.trigger: «Appeal»« from»« the»« United»« States» District« Court»« for»，以及 Defendant/Respondent - Appellee/Appellant
patterns.context: 美国联邦上诉判决的标题或案首格式；常接地区、州、城市、法官和案号

patterns.name: 法律诉状的程序性措辞
patterns.context: 描述原告、被告及驳回诉状动议的诉状或裁判文本

patterns.name: had better 固定表达
patterns.context: 英语句中作为建议或义务表达；一处还明确讨论该短语

patterns.name: hadith 术语
patterns.context: 讨论传述链及 mursal 等分类时，词内 had 所在片段激活

patterns.name: 地表覆盖比例描述
patterns.context: 土地利用统计段落中，出现 built up area 后描述住房和建筑占比

patterns.name: existence 的词内片段
patterns.context: 科研摘要中谈到某种梯度的存在；激活落在 existence 的词内片段

patterns.name: would-be 构词形式
patterns.context: 哲学论述中将 would-be 用作名词前修饰语，描述可能的违抗者

en.concept: Various fixed text fragments and formatting
en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: they include would in a philosophical sentence, fixed appellate templates and motions to dismiss in legal documents, nuclear-physics terms isoscalar/isovector, hadith reliability assessments, land-proportion statistics, and navigation categories in encyclopedia music entries.

patterns.name: would in a modal construction
patterns.context: When explaining whether an action constitutes defiance, would lead to expresses a general rule or expectation; activation concentrates on would, especially repeated instances.

patterns.name: Appellate case-page headers in court decisions
patterns.context: An appellate case document lists the court of origin, location, judge, and case number in a fixed template; blank layout also activates.

patterns.name: Procedural language in legal pleadings
patterns.context: In a civil pleading or order, describes a plaintiff proceeding pro se and the defendant’s motion to dismiss and grounds for it.

patterns.name: Nuclear physics terms isoscalar/isovector
patterns.context: When discussing nuclear magnetic moments, RMF theory, and effective interactions, isoscalar and isovector are split into fragments beginning with is.

patterns.name: Hadith transmitter reliability assessment
patterns.context: When discussing tabi'i transmitters and mursal hadith, describes their reliability or insufficient documentation.

patterns.name: Proportions and categories in land-use statistics
patterns.context: Lists land-cover categories such as built-up areas, water bodies, and unused land as percentages.

patterns.name: Section navigation and category links in encyclopedia entries
patterns.context: Section headings, references, external links, and categories appear at the end of an entry or in its table of contents; the colon after Category, years, and labels also activate strongly.

4_1246.concept: 多种固定文本片段与格式
4_1246.description: 激活模式分散：包括哲学句中的 would、法律文书固定上诉模板及驳回动议、核物理 isoscalar/isovector、圣训可靠性判断、土地比例统计和百科音乐条目导航分类。

patterns.name: 情态结构中的 would
patterns.context: 解释某行为是否构成 defiance 时，出现 would lead to 的一般规则或预期；激活集中在 would，尤其重复的 would。

patterns.name: 法院判决书的上诉案页眉
patterns.trigger: «Appeal»« from»« the» United States District« Court»« for»« the» ...« at» ...；以及法院人员和案号
patterns.context: 上诉案文书中，按固定模板列出上诉来源法院、地点、法官和案号；对空白排版也有激活。

patterns.name: 法律诉状中的程序性用语
patterns.trigger: «pro se»；«has»« moved»« to» dismiss« the» Complaint« for» lack
patterns.context: 民事诉状或裁定中，描述原告自诉及被告提出驳回动议和理由。

patterns.name: 核物理术语 isoscalar/isovector
patterns.context: 讨论核磁矩、RMF 理论及有效相互作用时，术语 isoscalar、isovector 被拆分成以 is 开头的片段。

patterns.name: 圣训传述者可靠性判断
patterns.trigger: «is» not« known» to« be» trusted；« just» not well documented
patterns.context: 讨论 tabi'i 传述者及 mursal 圣训时，说明其可信度或资料记录不足。

patterns.name: 土地利用统计中的比例与类别
patterns.trigger: «is»« settled»；« is» either rivers or lakes；« is» unproductive land
patterns.context: 以百分比列举建成区、水域和未利用土地等土地覆盖类别。

patterns.name: 百科条目的章节导航与分类链接
patterns.context: 条目末尾或目录区域出现章节标题、参考资料、外部链接和分类；Category 后的冒号及年份、标签也有较强激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across varied contexts, often on English function words, modal/linking verbs, and numerical or mathematical markers. Other local patterns include project reorganization, Islamic transmission, legal procedure and evidence, land proportions, and astronomical terminology, making it difficult to identify a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Modal qualification and expectation
patterns.context: Modal verbs occur alongside be, passive, or compound-adjective structures, expressing conditions, necessity, or matters yet to be completed.

patterns.name: Approximate quantities and mathematical markers
patterns.context: Near values, percentages, or order-of-magnitude estimates, often with LaTeX math markers.

patterns.name: Sequences of English function words
patterns.context: Function words occur adjacently or consecutively in ordinary sentences; activation falls on several different function words, with no stable semantic collocation.

patterns.name: Institution names and modifiers
patterns.context: An institution or project description introduces a name change, reorganization, and current needs.

patterns.name: Islamic transmission terminology
patterns.context: Discusses generations of transmitters and the reliability of a transmission chain or whether it is interrupted.

patterns.name: Legal documents and procedural language
patterns.context: Pleadings or rulings describe party identities and motions to dismiss.

patterns.name: Case evidence narrative
patterns.context: Describes items found or seized during a search or investigation.

patterns.name: Area proportions and land categories
patterns.context: Land cover or land-use categories are divided by percentage.

patterns.name: Astronomical observation results
patterns.context: Reports observations of astronomical sources, brightness selection, or periodicity analysis.

patterns.name: Galaxy-density subheading
patterns.context: A paper figure or section heading and the subsequent definition of galaxy density.

4_1246.description: 激活分散于多种语境，常落在英文功能词、情态/系动词及数值数学标记上；另见项目改组、伊斯兰传述、法律程序与证物、土地比例和天文术语等局部模式，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 限定情态与预期
patterns.trigger: “would-be defiant party”“must also be the case”“must be completed”
patterns.context: 情态动词与 be、被动或复合形容词结构相邻；表达条件、必要性或尚待完成的事项

patterns.name: 近似数量与数学标记
patterns.context: 数值、百分比或量级估算附近，常带 LaTeX 数学标记
patterns.domain: 天体物理、统计或地理描述

patterns.name: 英文功能词连续结构
patterns.context: 普通句子中相邻或连续出现功能词；激活落在多个不同功能词上，未见稳定单一语义搭配

patterns.name: 机构名称及修饰语
patterns.trigger: “Molecular Genetics and Epigenetics”“formerly called”“has been transformed”
patterns.context: 机构或项目说明中，介绍名称变更、改组及当前需求

patterns.name: 伊斯兰传述术语
patterns.context: 讨论传述者世代及传述链可靠性或是否中断

patterns.name: 法律文书与程序用语
patterns.context: 诉状或裁定中描述当事人身份及驳回动议

patterns.name: 案件证物叙述
patterns.context: 陈述搜查或案件中发现、扣押的物品

patterns.name: 面积比例与土地类别
patterns.trigger: “is settled”“rivers or lakes”“unproductive land”“built up area”
patterns.context: 按百分比划分土地覆盖或用地类别

patterns.name: 天文观测结果描述
patterns.context: 报告天体源观测、亮度筛选或周期性分析

patterns.name: 星系密度小标题
patterns.context: 论文图表或小节标题及其后对星系密度的定义

en.description: Activations are distributed across heterogeneous corpora: mathematical phrases, function words and formatting in legal documents, geographic proportions, property records, academic institution names, music encyclopedias, and machine-translation terminology. Some triggers arise from formatting, short words, or proper-name contexts, with no unified stable meaning or theme.

patterns.name: partially ordered
patterns.context: Describes a set or structure in mathematical text, especially the phrase partially ordered set; parentheses and nearby mathematical symbols are not necessary.

patterns.name: Function words in legal documents
patterns.context: Formatted fragments of legal pleadings, decisions, or appeals, often near headings, citations, procedural wording, and line breaks; trigger positions vary.

patterns.name: Land-use proportions
patterns.context: Words occur within continuous lists of categories, numbers, and proportions in descriptions of land or regional classifications.

patterns.name: Property listing status and delimiters
patterns.context: A property description is followed by a transaction-status update and date, with line breaks and date-like numbering around a dash.

patterns.name: Small words in institution names
patterns.context: Lists universities, research institutions, and foundations in conference or funding acknowledgments.
patterns.domain: Academic paper acknowledgments or conference information

patterns.name: Relational terms in music entries
patterns.context: Relational words connect people and works when describing musicians, record labels, releases, or remix collaborations.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia navigation and category formatting
patterns.context: Section headings, category links, and year categories at the end of an entry, accompanied by many line breaks.

patterns.name: Synthetic data and parallel corpora
patterns.context: Explains the effects of data augmentation in machine-translation research, with numbered reasons and parenthetical lists.

4_1246.description: 激活分布于异质语料：数学短语、法律文书功能词与版式、地理比例、房产记录、学术机构名、音乐百科及机器翻译术语。部分触发来自格式、短词或专名上下文，未见统一稳定的词义或主题。

patterns.name: partially ordered
patterns.context: 数学文本中描述集合或结构时，尤其是短语 partially ordered set；括号和邻近数学符号不是必要条件。

patterns.name: 法律文书功能词
patterns.trigger: « to»、« the»、« for»、« of»、«from» 等短功能词；多处还包括换行或破折号标记
patterns.context: 法律诉状、判决或上诉文书的格式化片段，常靠近标题、引文、程序性措辞及版面换行；触发位置并不固定。

patterns.name: 土地利用比例表述
patterns.context: 土地或区域分类的百分比描述中，词语位于类别、数字和比例的连续列举里。

patterns.name: 房产广告状态与分隔符
patterns.context: 房产介绍后接交易状态变更记录及日期，破折号周围出现换行和编号式日期。

patterns.name: 机构名称中的小词
patterns.context: 会议或资助说明中列举大学、研究机构及基金会名称。
patterns.domain: 学术论文致谢或会议信息

patterns.name: 音乐条目中的专名关系词
patterns.context: 介绍音乐人、唱片厂牌、作品发行或混音合作时，关系词连接人物与作品。

patterns.name: 百科条目导航与分类格式
patterns.context: 条目末尾的分节标题、分类链接和年份类别，伴随大量换行。

patterns.name: 伪数据与平行语料
patterns.context: 机器翻译研究中解释数据增强效果，包含编号理由和括号内列举。

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-form fragments, symbols, and syntactic positions: a word-internal fragment of foothills, legal abbreviations, numbers, mathematical approximation/chain symbols, passive sentences, and specific English word forms. No unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-internal foothills fragment
patterns.context: When the same word is split into multiple tokens, activation concentrates on the middle «ooth»; appears in descriptions of terrain or climate.

patterns.name: Abbreviated possessive in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in a court ruling quoting a motion by the defendant, where a possessive abbreviation is split; high activation falls on the abbreviation punctuation and following s.

patterns.name: Numeric fragments in place names and proportion data
patterns.context: Several decimal-number tokens are activated in a list of land-use proportions; no single number or numerical meaning stands out.

patterns.name: Approximation symbols in astronomy
patterns.context: An approximation symbol is activated when adjacent to a following value in mathematical typesetting; both astronomy passages have such expressions, but the highest activation falls on different tokens.

patterns.name: Chain structure in mathematical objects
patterns.context: In a formal mathematics context, a symbol is linked to an in-chain structure; activation falls mainly on «in».

patterns.name: Word-internal ingested past-tense fragment
patterns.context: In a biomedical sentence, the verb ingested is split, and the final «ed» is activated.

patterns.name: Passive-voice found
patterns.context: found is activated in passive sentences about evidence or items being discovered; the sentence also contains descriptions of items that were stolen/seized.

patterns.name: defiant word form and syntactic frame
patterns.context: When discussing the general definition of defiance, peak activation falls on would, with be also activated; the preceding text contains a conditional about rules or expectations.

4_1246.description: 激活分散在若干词形片段、符号和句法位置：foothills 的词内片段、法律缩写、数值、数学近似／链符号，以及被动句和特定英语词形；看不出统一语义触发器。

patterns.name: 词内 foothills 片段
patterns.context: 同一个词被拆成多个 token 时，激活集中在中间的 «ooth»；出现于地形或气候叙述中。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的缩写所有格
patterns.context: 出现在法院裁定对被告动议的引用中，所有格缩写被拆分；高激活落在缩写标点及后续 s。

patterns.name: 地名与比例数据中的数字片段
patterns.context: 列举土地利用比例时，若干小数数字 token 有激活；并无明显单一数字或数值含义。

patterns.name: 天文学近似符号
patterns.context: 数学排版中近似符号与后续数值相邻时激活；两个天文学片段都有此类表达，但最高点落在不同 token。

patterns.name: 数学对象中的链结构
patterns.context: 形式化数学语境中，符号与 in-chain 结构相连；激活主要落在 «in»。

patterns.name: 单词内部的 ing 过去分词片段
patterns.context: 生物医学句子中，动词 ingested 被拆分，词尾 «ed» 激活。

patterns.name: 被动语态中的 found
patterns.context: 证据或物品被发现的被动句中，found 获得激活；句子还出现 stolen/seized 等物品描述。

patterns.name: defiant 词形与句法框架
patterns.context: 讨论 defiance 的一般定义时，最高激活落在 would，be 也激活；前文有关于规则或预期的条件句。

en.concept: Mixed local formatting and numerical features
en.description: Activations span approximate values, timescales, and astronomical terminology in astrophysics papers, and also occur in annotation formats, biographical accounts of theatrical careers, and performance blogs. A weak commonality may be numbers, punctuation, or adjacent formatting fragments, but this does not explain all activations.

patterns.name: Approximate quantities or scale markers
patterns.context: Near numerical values, approximation symbols, or units; most occur in scientific papers, but the markers are distributed inconsistently and often activate on the numerical fragments themselves.
patterns.domain: Numerical values, orders of magnitude, and units in ArXiv scientific papers

patterns.name: Time and duration
patterns.context: Describes elapsed time, periods, or duration in accounts of astrophysics or star formation; often paired with approximate quantities.

patterns.name: Galaxy, star-formation, and astronomical-observation terminology
patterns.context: Activations occur near terms and observables in scientific texts about galaxies, star formation, supernova echoes, AGN, or neutron stars.

patterns.name: Punctuation and whitespace annotation sequences in parentheses
patterns.context: Structured fragments consisting of punctuation, whitespace attributes, and tab-separated fields in dependency or corpus annotation formats.
patterns.domain: Github code or linguistic annotation data

patterns.name: Education and theatrical experience in biographies
patterns.context: Biographical sentences describing professional or stage experience during a person's studies; activations are scattered across ordinary narrative words and punctuation.

patterns.name: Socializing after performances
patterns.context: Blog-style event recaps describing audiences staying at the theater to socialize; activations fall on line breaks and adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC blogs and performance event records

4_1246.concept: 混合局部格式与数值特征
4_1246.description: 激活跨越天体物理论文中的近似数值、时间尺度和天文术语，也出现在标注格式、人物戏剧经历及演出博客中；弱共同点可能是数字、标点或相邻格式片段，但无法解释所有激活。

patterns.name: 近似数量或尺度标记
patterns.context: 数值、近似符号或单位相邻处；多数位于科学论文中，但标记分布并不一致，也常激活数字片段本身
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科学论文中的数值、数量级与单位

patterns.name: 时间与持续时长
patterns.context: 天体物理或恒星形成叙述中描述经过的时间、周期或持续时长；常与近似数量搭配

patterns.name: 星系、恒星形成与天体观测术语
patterns.context: 在关于星系、恒星形成、超新星回声、AGN 或中子星的科技文本中，术语和观测量附近出现激活

patterns.name: 括号中的标点与空格标注序列
patterns.context: 依存或语料标注格式中，标点、空格属性及制表符分隔字段组成的结构化片段
patterns.domain: Github 代码或语言标注数据

patterns.name: 人物生平中的学习和戏剧经历
patterns.context: 人物传记句子中叙述学习期间的职业或舞台经历；激活散落在普通叙述词及标点上

patterns.name: 演出后的社交活动
patterns.trigger: “Last night’s house”“People stayed”“talked about the show”
patterns.context: 博客式活动回顾中描述观众留在剧场交流；激活落在换行及邻近词语上
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 博客、演出活动记录

en.concept: Multicontext English fragments and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activations are scattered across many contexts: ordinary English conjunctions and line-break boundaries, scientific text dense with numbers and punctuation, websites and legal narratives, open-source commentary, geographic statistics, and structured markup. No stable, single semantic trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: to at a token boundary
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence in an infinitive or purpose construction, followed by a verb phrase.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in X-ray observations
patterns.context: Values, symbols, and astronomical terms intermingle in descriptions of X-ray sources and observation samples.

patterns.name: Website privacy-policy language
patterns.context: A cookie notice lists website purposes and directs readers to view the policy.

patterns.name: Seizures and physical evidence in law-enforcement narratives
patterns.context: Describes items such as credit cards being found or seized at a suspect’s residence or in a briefcase.

patterns.name: Timescales and star formation in astrophysics
patterns.context: Discusses the star-formation rate and its changes over cosmic history.

patterns.name: Commentary on group behavior in FOSS communities
patterns.context: Forum comments discuss the behavior of certain people or groups among independent developers and in open-source communities.

patterns.name: Statistical expression of land-area proportions
patterns.context: Lists built-up areas, water, and unused land by percentage, then further describes built-up areas.

patterns.name: Punctuation labels in annotated data
patterns.context: Punctuation tokens alternate with grammatical categories and attribute fields.
patterns.domain: Structured annotation or code data on Github

patterns.name: Brightness and distance of supernova echoes
patterns.context: Compares the spatial scale and brightness of supernova echoes and involves imaging observations.

4_1246.concept: 多语境英文片段与格式边界
4_1246.description: 激活分散于多种语境：普通英文连接词和换行边界、数字与标点密集的科学文本、网站及法律叙述、开源评论、地理统计和结构化标注；未见稳定的单一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 分词边界处的 to
patterns.context: 出现在句中，用于不定式或目的结构；后续接动词短语

patterns.name: X射线观测中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 数值、符号和天文学术语交错，描述X射线源及观测样本

patterns.name: 网站隐私政策用语
patterns.trigger: « and»、« social»、« media»、« our»、« traffic»、« see»
patterns.context: Cookie提示中列举网站用途并引导读者查看政策

patterns.name: 执法叙述中的扣押与物证
patterns.context: 叙述信用卡等物品在嫌疑人住所或公文包中被发现、扣押

patterns.name: 天体物理中的时间尺度与恒星形成
patterns.trigger: « our»、« H»、« star»、« last»、« sim»、« Gyrs»
patterns.context: 讨论恒星形成率及其在宇宙历史中的变化

patterns.name: FOSS社区中的群体行为评论
patterns.context: 论坛评论讨论独立开发者及开源社区中某些人或群体的行为

patterns.name: 土地面积比例的统计表达
patterns.context: 用百分比列出建成区、水域和未利用土地，并进一步描述建成区

patterns.name: 标注数据中的标点符号标签
patterns.context: 标点 token 与语法类别及属性字段交替出现
patterns.domain: Github上的结构化标注或代码数据

patterns.name: 超新星回声的亮度与距离
patterns.trigger: « resolved»、« LE»、« sim»、« pc»、« SN»、« echo»、« luminous»
patterns.context: 比较超新星回声的空间尺度和亮度，并涉及成像观测

en.description: The response pattern is mixed: several hits fall on an internal fragment of partially; some scientific passages hit approximation symbols, numbers, and orders of magnitude; others concern seizure language in a case, vaccine terminology, and punctuation in annotated text. No single semantic pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of partially
patterns.context: Occurs at a suffix position within partially; preceding text varies among Part, part, part, and part, with different capitalization and initial-word contexts.

patterns.name: Approximation symbols and numerical expressions
patterns.context: In mathematical or scientific text, activations fall on approximation symbols and adjacent values or formula markers; the numbers and formatting vary across examples.

patterns.name: Numbers and orders of magnitude
patterns.context: Numbers, counts, percentages, or formula magnitudes in scientific discussion; some numbers occur in approximate expressions.

patterns.name: Seizure terms in credit-card case narratives
patterns.context: Criminal case facts describing credit cards found or seized in a briefcase and apartment.

patterns.name: Vaccine types and platform terminology
patterns.context: Comparisons of the development, testing, and platforms of mRNA, saRNA, and viral-vector vaccines.

patterns.name: Punctuation in annotated corpora
patterns.context: Tab-separated corpus annotation records; high activations concentrate on punctuation characters and underscores rather than natural-language semantics.

4_1246.concept: 混合词片段与格式特征
4_1246.description: 响应模式混杂：多处命中 partially 的词内片段；若干科学段命中近似符号、数字和数量级；其余分别涉及案件查获用语、疫苗术语及标注文本中的标点。没有单一语义模式覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: partially 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在单词 partially 的后缀位置；前文分别为 Part、part、part、part，大小写和词首上下文不同。

patterns.name: 近似符号与数值表达
patterns.context: 数学或科学文本中，激活落在近似符号及其相邻数值、公式标记上；各处数字和格式不完全相同。

patterns.name: 数字及数量级
patterns.context: 科学论述中的数字、计数、百分比或公式数量级；部分数字出现在近似表达中。

patterns.name: 信用卡案件叙述中的查获词
patterns.context: 描述信用卡在 briefcase 和 apartment 中被发现、查获的刑事案件事实。

patterns.name: 疫苗类型与平台术语
patterns.context: 比较 mRNA、saRNA 与病毒载体疫苗的研发、测试及平台。

patterns.name: 标注语料中的标点符号
patterns.context: 以制表符分隔的语料标注记录；高激活集中于标点字符和下划线，而不是自然语言语义。
patterns.domain: GitHub，格式化的语言学标注数据

en.description: Activations are scattered across diverse styles and topics: modal verbs, approximate mathematical notation, legal evidence terms, quantifiers, code-attribute symbols, punctuation, compounds, webpage copy, and category names. No stable semantic or syntactic pattern explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Modal auxiliary would
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences describing general rules or expectations and their possible consequences, involving “would-be defiant party”.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbol sim
patterns.context: Appears in scientific notation and approximate expressions for the number or brightness of X-ray sources.

patterns.name: seized in legal evidence narratives
patterns.context: Follows “The” and modifies credit cards seized by police; nearby are evidence-narrative terms such as briefcase and apartment.

patterns.name: Quantifier more
patterns.context: Expresses the quantity “two or more parental lines” in plant breeding; the sentence also contains repeated and crosses.

patterns.name: Android attribute-value boundary
patterns.context: Immediately follows the Android XML attribute-value introducer “?”, followed by android:attr/textAppearanceMedium.

patterns.name: Comma punctuation
patterns.context: A comma in a biographical narrative, after the article the and before a where clause; the local syntax is unusual.

patterns.name: draft compound
patterns.context: A hyphen joins draft in pre-draft, describing a basketball professional's training camp before the draft.

patterns.name: Web control text near our
patterns.context: Webpage introducing a social-network sharing widget; our modifies pages, and the same passage includes interface text such as Add This.

patterns.name: Numerical approximation notation

patterns.context: Patent number 372 occurs in a quoted patent reference; it is unclear whether this relates to numbers or patent formatting.

patterns.name: Whitespace and line break after a period
patterns.context: Whitespace and a line break follow a period, then a new sentence begins with same; activation falls on whitespace/line break rather than a clear content word.

patterns.name: Whitespace at list numbering and line breaks

patterns.name: Whitespace near paragraph openings

patterns.name: Emphatic whitespace after a line break

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: clearer local cues include would/would-be, consecutive closing tags, lists of purpose infinitives with to, patent quotation marks, footnote asterisks, and specific line-break boundaries. patterns.name: Postposed would / would-be construction

patterns.name: XML/plist closing tags
patterns.context: In serialized configuration text, slash-prefixed closing tags appear consecutively, especially for array and dict, plist.

patterns.name: List of purpose infinitives with to
patterns.context: Research aims or tasks are listed by number; several parallel items begin with to plus a verb, and the final item repeats to.

patterns.name: Quotation marks introducing entity names
patterns.context: A patent narrative uses single quotes to introduce a patent identified by number; high activation falls on the opening single quote and the following number.

patterns.name: Table footnote asterisk
patterns.context: After list or table content, an asterisk serves as a footnote marker introducing explanatory text.

patterns.name: Line breaks at text-region boundaries
patterns.context: Two consecutive newline characters occur at the boundary between the end of one passage and the start of the next heading or body text.

patterns.name: Line break before a possessive pronoun
patterns.context: After a line break in a sentence, a new line begins with American and continues with descriptive prose; only this example activates the adjacent boundary marker.

patterns.name: Uppercase separation in a disclaimer heading
patterns.context: A disclaimer heading is presented as an all-caps phrase; LIMITED is split within the word, with activation on the final part.

patterns.name: Scattered conjunctions and word-form fragments
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across plant breeding, web promotion, and biomedical text; some are common prepositions or conjunctions, others nouns. The available passages show no shared specific syntactic or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; possibly generalized word items or incidental contextual activations

patterns.name: Other local activations without a clear pattern
patterns.context: Occur separately in damage disclaimers, argumentative text, tables, or historical narratives; an individual local trigger is insufficient to establish a stable shared condition.

en.description: Activations are scattered across different text and token types: prominent local patterns include “would-be”, XML closing tags, chemical reaction notation, and approximate numerical values in scientific text using LaTeX; there are also line breaks, internal subwords, and sporadic ordinary words, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: XML/markup-language closing tags

patterns.name: Chemical reaction notation

patterns.name: Approximation symbols and numerical values
patterns.context: Mathematical or scientific text uses a LaTeX-formatted approximation symbol followed by a number or physical quantity.

patterns.name: Paragraph line breaks
patterns.context: A line break or blank line occurs at the end of the body, between a heading and section, or between webpage contents; activation strength varies.

patterns.name: Subwords split within words
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of English words split by the tokenizer, rather than on complete word boundaries.
patterns.domain: Patent text and local news webpages

patterns.name: Other local words and punctuation
patterns.context: These activations fall respectively on words in a legal disclaimer, phrases in narrative text, and ordinary grammatical words; they share no clear local semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Common function words and collocations
patterns.context: Sporadic activations are distributed across articles, prepositions, conjunctions, and neighboring content words in descriptive sentences, with no stable specialized-domain condition.
