patterns.name: ISO in scheduling files
patterns.context: Appears near a filename in a scheduling file path, which contains wording such as California Scheduling.
patterns.domain: Business logs or file paths in Enron emails

patterns.name: research in a webpage URL
patterns.context: Appears in the domain portion of a URL (research.swtch.com).

patterns.name: Historically
patterns.context: Appears as a sentence-initial adverb in a medical abstract, introducing an overview of personalized medicine.

4_1271.concept: January 日期及少数词形
4_1271.description: 主要对日期中的“January”强烈激活，横跨百科、新闻、书籍和法律文本；另对排程路径中的“ISO”、URL 中的“research”及医学摘要中的“Historically”有局部激活。

patterns.name: January 日期
patterns.context: 出现在标题、人物生卒日期、出版日期或案件日期等日期表达中；有时后接具体日、年份。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、新闻网页、书籍扉页、法律文书

patterns.name: 排程文件中的 ISO
patterns.context: 出现在排程文件路径的文件名附近，路径包含 California Scheduling 等字样。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的业务日志或文件路径

patterns.name: 网页 URL 中的 research
patterns.context: 出现在 URL 的域名部分（research.swtch.com）。

patterns.name: Historically
patterns.context: 出现在医学摘要中，作为句首副词，引出对个体化医疗的概述。

en.description: The most stable strong trigger is the month name January, usually in dates or publication information. There are also sporadic activations on document titles and line-break formatting, plus isolated cases involving ISO in a file path, research in a URL, and the initial word fragment of Historically; the latter cases are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Month name January
patterns.context: The English month January appears, especially before a date, a person's birth or death dates, or a publication date; often accompanied by a year, day, and line breaks.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia date entries, news pages, book title pages, legal documents, etc.

patterns.name: Title or page-opening layout structure
patterns.context: A page or document begins with a title, section heading, or repeated title, often with consecutive line breaks; these structures are not consistent across all passages.
patterns.domain: Web pages, book title pages, email logs

patterns.name: ISO in a file path
patterns.context: Appears in a parsed file path, near directory names related to scheduling and energy systems; there is no obvious January date trigger.

patterns.name: research in a URL
patterns.context: Appears as part of a URL hostname, surrounded by URL punctuation and domain text.

patterns.name: Initial fragment of Historically
patterns.context: Appears in the sentence-initial adverb Historically, followed by “ically”; no clear date or title condition.

4_1271.concept: January 日期文本
4_1271.description: 最稳定的强触发是月份词 January，通常位于日期或出版信息中；此外有文档标题与换行排版的零散激活，以及 ISO、URL 中 research 和 Historically 词首等孤例，后几者难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 月份名称 January
patterns.context: 出现英文月份 January，尤其处于日期、人名生卒日期或出版日期之前；常伴随年份、日号及换行。
patterns.domain: 百科日期条目、新闻页面、书籍标题页、法律文书等

patterns.name: 标题或页面开头的排版结构
patterns.trigger: «↵»及其附近的标题、栏目文字，如«Our» « Story»、«IAN» « CH» «UR» «CH»
patterns.context: 页面或文档开头以标题、栏目名或重复标题呈现，常有连续换行；未见这些结构在所有段中都一致。
patterns.domain: 网页、书籍标题页、邮件日志

patterns.name: 文件路径中的 ISO
patterns.context: 出现在解析文件路径中，邻近调度、能源系统相关目录名；没有明显的 January 日期触发。

patterns.name: URL 中的 research
patterns.context: 作为网址主机名的一部分，前后有 URL 标点和域名文本。

patterns.name: Historically 的词首片段
patterns.context: 出现在句首副词 Historically 中，后接«ically»；无明确日期或标题条件。

en.description: The most stable shared cue is “January” in date formats, especially at the beginning of a date; “ISO” in Enron scheduling paths also triggers strongly. Other activations are scattered across specific passages involving sports, web headings, promotional copy, book title pages, and legal formatting.

patterns.name: January dates
patterns.context: Date-format content following “January,” such as a day, year, or comma; January activates most strongly across different passages.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedias, legal documents, books, web articles, and email

patterns.name: ISO marker in logs
patterns.context: Appears in an Enron email file path near scheduling filenames such as “California Scheduling” and “Final”.

patterns.name: Volleyball event title
patterns.context: Appears in the repeated title “2018 Netball Quad Series” and its entry description.

patterns.name: Drug-policy article title
patterns.context: A web page title followed by author and date information.

patterns.name: Website promotional slogan
patterns.context: Company website story/promotional content, including company history and business sections.

patterns.name: Book title-page format
patterns.context: A title-page layout comprising an uppercase book title, lecture description, location, and date.

patterns.name: Person's name and birth/death dates
patterns.context: An entry begins with a person's name, followed by birth and death dates in parentheses.

patterns.name: Bankruptcy case citation
patterns.context: A legal-document passage comprising a case name, docket number, court, and decision date.

patterns.name: Case citation and decision
patterns.context: A citation, case name, date, and outcome from a state appellate court case.

4_1271.concept: 日期与格式标记
4_1271.description: 最稳定的共同线索是日期格式中的“January”，尤其日期开头；另有 Enron 调度路径中的“ISO”强激活。其余激活分散于赛事、网页标题、宣传文案、书籍标题页及法律格式等特定片段。

patterns.name: January日期
patterns.context: “January”之后的日、年份或逗号等日期格式内容；不同文段中 January 的激活最强
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、书籍、网页文章及邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 日志中 ISO 标记
patterns.context: 出现在 Enron 邮件的文件路径中，邻近“California Scheduling”“Final”等调度文件名

patterns.name: 排球赛事标题
patterns.context: 出现在重复的“2018 Netball Quad Series”标题及条目说明中

patterns.name: 吸毒政策文章标题
patterns.trigger: “So Marijuana Use is Now ‘No Big Deal’ - What About MDMA?”
patterns.context: 网页标题及其后作者、日期信息

patterns.name: 网站宣传语
patterns.trigger: “Our Story”“Exponential year over year development”“Advertising Network Operations”
patterns.context: 公司网站的故事/宣传内容，含发展历程与业务栏目

patterns.name: 书籍标题页格式
patterns.trigger: “CHURCH IN THESE ISLANDS BEFORE THE COMING OF AUGUSTINE.”及“Three Lectures”
patterns.context: 大写书名、讲座说明、地点与日期构成的标题页排版

patterns.name: 人物姓名与生卒日期
patterns.context: 条目以人名开头，随后给出括号中的出生与死亡日期

patterns.name: 破产案件引证
patterns.context: 案件名称、案号、法院与裁判日期组成的法律文书片段

patterns.name: 判例引证与裁判结果
patterns.trigger: “P.3d”“Or. App.”、“Court of Appeals of Oregon”及“Affirmed without opinion”
patterns.context: 州上诉法院判例的引证、案名、日期和结果

en.concept: Proper names and scheduling logs in structured text
en.description: Responds primarily to schedule, variances detected, and parsing-path formats in power scheduling logs; also activates on the Netball Quad Series title and a cannabis-policy article title and date.

patterns.name: Netball event name and year
patterns.context: The year is adjacent to the name Netball Quad Series; the text appears as a title, repeated title, or disambiguation entry in the form “may refer to”.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia article titles and disambiguation pages

patterns.name: Power scheduling variance log
patterns.context: In power scheduling plan logs, reports whether variances were detected for a given plan type; often accompanied by parsing file paths and plan names.
patterns.domain: Machine-generated logs in Enron power trading and scheduling emails

patterns.name: Scheduling plan file path
patterns.context: Appears after “PARSING FILE -->>” as part of a power grid scheduling file path or filename; often co-occurs with variance detection logs.
patterns.domain: File paths and power scheduling data in Enron emails

patterns.name: Cannabis policy title and date
patterns.context: An article title discusses state drug policy and cannabis use, accompanied by a date and author information.

4_1271.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与调度日志
4_1271.description: 主要响应电力调度日志中的 schedule、variances detected 及解析路径格式；另对 Netball Quad Series 标题和大麻政策文章标题、日期有激活。

patterns.name: 网球赛事名称与年份
patterns.context: 年份紧邻 Netball Quad Series 名称；文本以标题、重复标题或“may refer to”消歧条目形式出现。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题与消歧页面

patterns.name: 电力调度差异日志
patterns.context: 电力调度计划日志中，报告某类计划检测到或未检测到差异；常伴随解析文件路径和计划名称。
patterns.domain: Enron 电力交易与调度邮件中的机器生成日志

patterns.name: 调度计划文件路径
patterns.context: 出现在“PARSING FILE -->>”之后，作为电网调度文件路径或文件名的一部分；多与差异检测日志共现。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的文件路径及电力调度数据

patterns.name: 大麻政策标题与日期
patterns.context: 文章标题谈论州内毒品政策及大麻使用，并附有日期和作者信息。

en.concept: Event names and electricity scheduling log features in text
en.description: A Wikipedia-style sports event name triggers in one passage; the remaining activations mainly respond to electricity scheduling logs, especially log/file paths, schedules, and deviation-detection status, as well as one download-failure alert.

patterns.name: Tennis Quad Series name and date
patterns.context: Appears in Wikipedia-style text that repeats the event name and then introduces an entry with “may refer to:”; activations cluster around the event name and date.

patterns.name: Electricity scheduling log parsing path
patterns.context: Follows an uppercase log heading and a PARSING FILE marker, followed by an electricity scheduling file path and filename; multiple passages repeat nearly identical path templates.
patterns.domain: Electricity system operations logs in Enron emails

patterns.name: Scheduling plans and deviation-detection status
patterns.context: Electricity scheduling logs report deviations, auxiliary schedules, or no-deviation status for Generation, Load, or SC Trades schedules; often adjacent to path-parsing logs.
patterns.domain: Electricity scheduling status reports in Enron emails

patterns.name: Schedule download failure and manual intervention
patterns.context: A short error alert describing a failed schedule download one hour in advance and requesting manual intervention, followed by a log parsing path.

4_1271.concept: 文本中的赛事名与电力调度日志特征
4_1271.description: 一段百科体育赛事名称触发；其余主要响应电力调度日志，尤其是日志/文件路径、schedule 与偏差检测状态，另含一次下载失败告警。

patterns.name: 网球 Quad Series 名称及日期
patterns.context: 出现在 Wikipedia 条目式文字中，先重复赛事名称，再以“may refer to:”引出条目；触发集中在赛事名及日期附近。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、体育赛事条目

patterns.name: 电力调度日志解析路径
patterns.context: 位于大写日志标题和 PARSING FILE 标记之后，随后是电力调度相关文件路径及文件名；多个片段重复几乎相同的路径模板。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的电力系统运维日志

patterns.name: 调度计划与偏差检测状态
patterns.context: 在电力调度日志中报告 Generation、Load 或 SC Trades schedule 的偏差、辅助计划或无偏差状态；常与路径解析日志相邻。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的电力调度状态报告

patterns.name: 计划下载失败与人工干预
patterns.context: 作为简短错误告警，描述提前一小时计划下载失败并要求人工介入，后接日志解析路径。

en.concept: Power scheduling log formats and a few title texts
en.description: Responds primarily to ISO file parsing formats, scheduling variance statuses, and error messages in Enron power scheduling logs; also appears in a sports event title and a drug policy article title, neither of which has an evident connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: ISO scheduling file log
patterns.context: In automated processing logs in Enron emails, lists file paths and parsing results; often accompanied by leading indentation, line breaks, and numeric filenames.
patterns.domain: Power trading and scheduling system logs

patterns.name: Scheduling variance detection status
patterns.context: Appears as the processing status or result of a scheduling file, often adjacent to scheduling types such as Load, Generation, SC Trades, and Energy Import/Export.

patterns.name: Scheduling download failure alert
patterns.context: A parsing file log immediately follows an error status message; activation covers the alert and subsequent log format.

patterns.name: Sports event name
patterns.context: The opening of a Wikipedia entry repeats the event name and explains what it refers to and the competition dates; no clear semantic connection to Enron logs.

patterns.name: Drug policy article title and introduction
patterns.context: A share marker and byline date appear after the article title and subtitle; no clear semantic connection to the scheduling logs in other snippets.

4_1271.concept: 电力调度日志格式及少量标题文本
4_1271.description: 主要响应 Enron 电力调度日志中的 ISO 文件解析格式、调度差异状态及错误提示；另见网球赛事标题和药物政策文章标题，后两者与主模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: ISO 调度文件日志
patterns.context: 在 Enron 邮件中的自动化处理日志里，列出文件路径及解析结果；常伴随行首缩进、换行和数字文件名。
patterns.domain: 电力交易与调度系统日志

patterns.name: 调度差异检测状态
patterns.trigger: “Variances detected”及其变体“Variance(s) detected”；也包括“No variances detected”
patterns.context: 作为调度文件处理状态或结果出现，常与 Load、Generation、SC Trades、Energy Import/Export 等调度类型相邻。
patterns.domain: 电力调度系统状态消息

patterns.name: 调度下载失败警报
patterns.trigger: “HourAhead schedule download failed. Manual intervention required.”
patterns.context: 异常状态消息后紧接解析文件日志；激活落在该警报及后续日志格式中。
patterns.domain: 电力调度系统错误日志

patterns.name: 网球赛事名称
patterns.context: Wikipedia 条目开头重复赛事名称，并说明其指代及比赛日期；与 Enron 日志无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 药物政策文章标题与导语
patterns.trigger: “Drug policy in my state”, “Marijuana Use is Now ‘No Big Deal’ - What About MDMA?”
patterns.context: 文章标题及副标题之后出现分享标记和署名日期；与其他片段的调度日志无明显语义联系。

en.description: Responds primarily to the -odal fragment in words (amodal, multimodal, antipodal) and a subword fragment in the legal word forfeited; also activates on less and a URL string. Other strong activations are sporadic.

patterns.name: Word-final -odal (multimodal)
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the -odal part of English word forms; the context includes amodal or multimodal.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in forfeited
patterns.context: In a legal context, describes allegations or appeals as forfeited; activation falls on the latter part of the word’s segmentation.

patterns.name: less
patterns.context: Appears in comparative or degree expressions such as “care less”, “less than”, and “less problems”; these contexts differ from one another.
patterns.domain: Forums, emails, legal texts, Q&A, etc.

patterns.name: antipodal
patterns.context: In the geometric definition “antipodal map”, activation concentrates on the intra-word -odal fragment; it shares a spelling fragment with amodal/multimodal but has a different meaning.

patterns.name: String fragment in a code link
patterns.context: Activation appears near a Markdown link and URL in a Hacker News post, with no clear semantic or recurring cross-snippet trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Unexplained high activations
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across sports commentary and business emails and do not match the recurring word-form patterns above.

4_1271.concept: 英语词内片段检测
4_1271.description: 主要响应词内的 -odal 片段（amodal、multimodal、antipodal）及法律词 forfeited 的切分片段；另对 less 和一处网址字符串激活。其余强激活较零散。

patterns.name: 词尾 -odal（多模态）
patterns.context: 触发点落在英语词形的 -odal 部分；语境中形成 amodal 或 multimodal。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、医学/护理文本

patterns.name: forfeited 的词内片段
patterns.context: 法律语境中描述指控或上诉主张被 forfeited；激活落在词内切分的后半部分。

patterns.name: less
patterns.context: 出现在比较或程度表达中，如 “care less”“less than”“less problems”；这些语境彼此不同。

patterns.name: antipodal
patterns.context: 几何定义中的 “antipodal map”，激活集中于词内 -odal 部分；与 amodal/multimodal 共享字形片段，但语义不同。

patterns.name: 代码链接中的字符串片段
patterns.trigger: 链接路径中的 «12» «92»（整体 URL 后接 «»10）
patterns.context: 激活出现在 HackerNews 帖子的 Markdown 链接及网址附近，没有明显语义或跨段重复的触发模式。

patterns.name: 未解释的高激活
patterns.trigger: 无明确共同触发词；可见 «class» «championship» «enormous» «Corporation» «perfect» «execution» 等
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在体育评论和商务邮件中，与上述重复词形模式不吻合。

en.concept: Recognition of the forfeit word form
en.description: Every snippet contains the word form forfeited/forfeit, with activation concentrated on the stem forfe-; contexts include forfeiture of rights or claims in law, property confiscation, and forfeiture of corporate status or a match result.

patterns.name: forfeited in judicial contexts
patterns.context: In legal opinions or rulings, indicates that a right, argument, objection, or claim was lost because it was not raised or preserved in time; may also refer generally to property being confiscated.

patterns.name: General waiver of rights
patterns.context: In informal discussion, uses forfeiture to refer to giving up an entitlement, such as the right to free medical care.

patterns.name: Entity or team disqualified / forfeits
patterns.context: Describes a company losing its status for failing to file documents, or a match being forfeited because the opposing team did not appear; this is not procedural forfeiture of a legal argument.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw administrative/corporate law materials; Wikipedia sports entries

4_1271.concept: forfeit词形识别
4_1271.description: 各段都含 forfeited/forfeit 词形，激活集中在词干 forfe-，涵盖法律上的权利或主张失权、财产没收，以及公司资格或比赛结果的 forfeiture。

patterns.name: 司法语境中的 forfeited
patterns.context: 法律意见书或判决中，表示权利、论点、异议或主张因未及时提出、未保留等而丧失；也可能泛指财产被没收。

patterns.name: 一般性放弃权利
patterns.context: 在非正式讨论中把 forfeiture 用于放弃某项权益，例如放弃免费医疗权。

patterns.name: 实体或球队被判没收／失去
patterns.context: 描述公司因未提交申报而被撤销资格，或比赛因对手缺席而判为没收；并非法律论点的程序性失权。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 行政／公司法材料；Wikipedia 体育条目

en.description: Activations are scattered across code and license comments, Objective-C declarations, a Wikipedia list of Cardiff music, three different Hacker News discussions, and a medical term; no single shared meaning is evident.

patterns.name: Objective-C header import and interface declaration
patterns.context: After a code comment ends, an AppDelegate header is imported and an interface declaration begins.

patterns.name: Software license text and code boundary
patterns.context: Fixed legal wording in a license or copyright comment, often adjacent to a comment terminator and subsequent code.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, licenses, and copyright comments

patterns.name: Strong activation marker in code: backslash
patterns.context: Appears near file comments, type declarations, or namespace identifiers; the specific code snippets are not identical.

patterns.name: Cardiff music performance list title
patterns.context: The title and category entries concern Cardiff and music venues.

patterns.name: Volos Kayak and “Explore” text
patterns.context: After discussion of machines needing to experiment and handle possibilities, a separator, a name, and the phrase Go-Explore appear.

patterns.name: Russian profanity and comparison with English profanity
patterns.context: Explains the meaning of a Russian expression and compares Russian and English three-letter swear words.

patterns.name: Sarcastic response about the abbreviation J2ME
patterns.context: Quotes or responds to a joke about J2ME, mentioning that one need not learn its abbreviation anymore.

patterns.name: Diffuse astrocytoma terminology
patterns.context: The disease name appears in the introduction of a medical article.

4_1271.concept: 无统一概念
4_1271.description: 激活分散在代码与许可证注释、Objective-C 声明、维基百科卡迪夫音乐列表，以及三段不同的 Hacker News 讨论和一处医学术语；未见单一共同词义。

patterns.name: Objective-C 头文件导入与接口声明
patterns.context: 代码注释结束后，紧接着导入 AppDelegate 头文件并开始接口声明。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Objective-C 源代码

patterns.name: 软件许可证文本及代码边界
patterns.trigger: "WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND"、"All rights reserved"、"*/"
patterns.context: 许可证或版权注释中的固定法律措辞，常与注释结束符及后续代码相邻。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码、许可证与版权注释

patterns.name: 代码中的强激活标记：反斜杠
patterns.context: 出现在文件注释、类型声明或命名空间标识符附近；这些具体代码片段并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 卡迪夫音乐演出列表标题
patterns.context: 标题及分类条目以 Cardiff 和音乐演出场馆为主题。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科列表页面

patterns.name: Volos Kayak 与“探索”文本
patterns.context: 讨论机器需要实验和处理可能性之后，出现分隔线、名称及短语 Go-Explore。

patterns.name: 俄语粗口及英语脏话比较
patterns.context: 解释俄语表达的含义，并比较俄语与英语三字母脏话。

patterns.name: J2ME 缩写的讽刺回应
patterns.context: 引用或回应对 J2ME 的调侃，提到不必再学习其缩写。

patterns.name: 弥散性星形细胞瘤术语

en.description: Activates strongly primarily on http in URLs or network code, commonly in email links, webpage links, and net/http and aiohttp; Enron emails also contain a receipt confirmation template and a fixed IP. A forum title and a medical journal listing are also present and are difficult to explain through the main pattern.

patterns.name: http in HTTP protocols or links
patterns.context: Appears in the protocol portion of a URL or in code as a network package path / HTTP client identifier; linked domains and surrounding text vary widely.
patterns.domain: Emails, code, forum links, webpage scrape text

patterns.name: Email notification template
patterns.context: An email asks the recipient to click a link to confirm receipt, often with horizontal separators and a URL nearby.

patterns.name: Importing network-related libraries in code
patterns.context: Go code imports net/http or net/url; another Python async function uses an aiohttp client.

patterns.name: Specific address prefix in an HTTP link
patterns.context: A URL in an email body points to the same numeric IP address and appears after an email confirmation notification.

patterns.name: http in other webpage links
patterns.context: Ordinary webpage links surrounded by forum titles, article titles, or scraped webpage text; domains vary.

patterns.name: Meta filter in a webpage title
patterns.context: Part of a title, immediately followed by YouTube comments and a URL; unrelated to code or email notifications.

patterns.name: Journal name in publication information
patterns.context: A sentence lists the journals in which the same paper was co-published; the neuron marker falls within a journal name.

4_1271.concept: HTTP 字符串
4_1271.description: 主要对 URL 或网络代码中的 http 强烈激活，常见于邮件链接、网页链接及 net/http、aiohttp；Enron 邮件还含确认收件模板和固定 IP。另有论坛标题及医学期刊列举，难以由主模式解释。

patterns.name: HTTP 协议或链接中的 http
patterns.context: 在 URL 的协议部分，或代码中的网络包路径 / HTTP 客户端标识中出现；链接域名和周围文本差异很大。
patterns.domain: 邮件、代码、论坛链接、网页抓取文本

patterns.name: 邮件通知模板

patterns.name: 代码导入网络相关库
patterns.context: Go 代码导入 net/http 或 net/url；另一段 Python 异步函数使用 aiohttp 客户端。

patterns.name: HTTP 链接中的特定地址前缀

patterns.name: 其他网页链接中的 http

patterns.name: 网页标题中的 Meta filter
patterns.context: 作为标题文本的一部分，紧接 YouTube comments 与网址；和代码或邮件通知无关。

patterns.name: 论文发表信息中的期刊名
patterns.trigger: «An»«nals»« of»« Internal»« Medicine»，以及后续多个期刊名

en.description: Activations occur mainly in software code and configuration, covering member access, assignment, comments, paths, Android, and localization syntax; also responds to fragments of legal names, tool questions, and proper names in music entries.

patterns.name: Dot-notation member access in code identifiers
patterns.context: Punctuation or call chains connect objects, members, methods, paths, and other identifiers; examples include Scala, JavaScript, Java, and Java/Kotlin-style code.

patterns.name: Assignment and configuration syntax in code
patterns.context: In build configuration, dependency declarations, or program statements, symbols and identifiers occur in assignments, parameters, or XML configuration structures.

patterns.name: Code and documentation comments
patterns.context: Line or block comments with brief explanations appear near code and alongside code syntax.

patterns.name: Names and abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: In U.S. case citations, names appear in segmented capitalization, initials, and periods, followed by the format for opposing litigants.

patterns.name: Android UI and event-handling code
patterns.context: An XML layout snippet is followed by an Android Java example involving an Activity, view text, or Intent.

patterns.name: Proper names in software dependency or tool configuration
patterns.context: A question or YAML configuration mentions a browser automation tool and its extension; activation falls on proper names and configuration identifiers.

patterns.name: Fields and translations in localized strings
patterns.context: In a gettext-style resource file, English keys correspond to Chinese translations and include field names, quotation marks, and translated text.

patterns.name: Person names and name spelling fragments
patterns.context: Names are split into tokens or initials; they occur in code file author credits and song personnel lists, respectively.

patterns.name: Paths and slash separators
patterns.context: A separator is adjacent to path components in file paths, directories, or URL module paths.

patterns.name: Phrase in a user-agent question
patterns.context: A natural-language technical question asks how to set the user agent for PhantomJS/Mink; the trigger word itself is an ordinary English word.

patterns.name: Music tracks and personnel fields
patterns.context: Song titles and personnel names appear in a track list, with metadata such as quotation marks, parentheses, and durations.

4_1271.concept: 代码标识符与专名片段
4_1271.description: 激活主要出现在软件代码及配置中，覆盖成员访问、赋值、注释、路径、Android 与本地化语法；也对法律姓名、工具问答和音乐条目中的专名片段有反应。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的点号成员访问
patterns.context: 标点或调用链连接对象、成员、方法、路径等标识符；包括 Scala、JavaScript、Java 和 Java/Kotlin 风格代码。

patterns.name: 代码中的赋值与配置语法
patterns.context: 构建配置、依赖声明或程序语句中，符号及标识符位于赋值、参数或 XML 配置结构内。

patterns.name: 代码注释与文档注释
patterns.context: 代码附近出现行注释或块注释，常含简短说明；与代码语法共同出现。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的姓名与缩写
patterns.context: 美国判例引文中，姓名以分段大写、首字母和句点呈现，后接诉讼双方格式。

patterns.name: Android 界面与事件处理代码
patterns.context: XML 布局片段后接 Android Java 示例，涉及 Activity、视图文本或 Intent。

patterns.name: 软件依赖或工具配置中的专名
patterns.context: 问题或 YAML 配置提及浏览器自动化工具及其扩展；激活落在专名和配置标识符上。

patterns.name: 本地化字符串中的字段与翻译
patterns.context: gettext 风格资源文件中，英文键对应中文译文，含字段名、引号与翻译文本。

patterns.name: 人名及姓名拼写片段
patterns.context: 人名被拆成词片或首字母；分别出现在代码文件作者署名和歌曲人员名单中。

patterns.name: 路径与斜杠分隔符
patterns.context: 文件路径、目录或 URL 模块路径中，分隔符与路径成分相邻。

patterns.name: 用户代理相关提问中的短语
patterns.context: 自然语言技术问题询问如何设置 PhantomJS/Mink 的 user agent；触发词本身是普通英语词。

patterns.name: 音乐曲目与人员字段
patterns.context: 歌曲列表中的曲名及人员姓名，含引号、括号和时长等元数据。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple genres: Android/regex code calls, competitors, health-information sharing, rational behavior, legal conduct or practice, tumor immunology, and meeting records; there is no single stable trigger semantics.

patterns.name: Intent value and parentheses
patterns.context: Android Java code calls Intent's getStringExtra to retrieve string extra data; passage 9 contains a similar call.

patterns.name: Parentheses in method arguments
patterns.context: A function call in an R regular-expression example; activations cluster around split and its opening parenthesis.

patterns.name: Potential competitors becoming actual competitors

patterns.name: Willingness to share sensitive health information

patterns.name: Rational calculation of behavior

patterns.domain: Traffic policy or criminal behavior research abstract

patterns.name: Legal phrasing for engaging in conduct
patterns.context: A statute defines a misdemeanor as “engaging in prostitution”.

patterns.name: Engaging in a profession
patterns.context: A court disciplines attorneys practicing before it; like passage 6, this uses practices, but refers to a different activity.
patterns.domain: U.S. court rules or legal text

patterns.name: Immune checkpoint inhibition
patterns.context: In a tumor immunology context, inhibitory molecules are related to immune responses and checkpoint blockade.

patterns.name: Meeting records
patterns.context: A legal discussion lists legislative or administrative history materials, including minutes of decision-making body meetings.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions or case citations

4_1271.concept: none
4_1271.description: 激活分散于多种文体：Android/正则代码调用、竞争者、健康信息分享、理性行为、法律中的行为或执业，以及肿瘤免疫和会议记录；没有单一稳定触发语义。

patterns.name: Intent 取值与括号

patterns.name: 方法参数中的括号

patterns.name: 理性计算行为

patterns.name: 从事特定行为的法律表述

patterns.name: 从事某项执业

patterns.name: 免疫检查点抑制

patterns.name: 会议记录

patterns.domain: 美国法律意见或判例引文

en.concept: Structural and boundary features across domains
en.description: Activations cover code punctuation, HTML forms, Ajax/URLs, string and link handling; they also appear in legal provisions, accommodations and legal arguments in rulings, service copy, and public cultural policy. No single semantic theme explains all snippets.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax boundaries in code
patterns.context: In code, HTML, JavaScript, or URLs, punctuation appears at structural boundaries such as calls, assignments, attributes, and tags; triggers are not limited to one language.

patterns.name: HTTP requests and cross-origin Ajax
patterns.context: Code or problem descriptions involving Ajax requests, cross-origin access, and request URLs.

patterns.name: Forms and HTML attributes
patterns.context: HTML form and control tags, and link attribute syntax.

patterns.name: Conventional collocations in legal texts
patterns.context: Wording describing actors and their actions in statutory or judicial contexts.

patterns.name: Legal arguments and record materials
patterns.context: Discusses legislative or administrative history, records of decision-making bodies, and their relevance to legal determinations.

patterns.name: Sleeping and accommodation contexts
patterns.context: Describes a party staying overnight at a police station, accommodation arrangements, and whether they asked to leave.
patterns.domain: Factual account in a judicial opinion

patterns.name: Terms of service and customer interactions
patterns.context: Customer-facing service descriptions or website terms describing warranties, repairs, and user interactions with service channels.

patterns.name: Public cultural resources and policy
patterns.context: Discusses museum admission fees, public learning spaces, and the weakening of public funding for libraries.

patterns.name: String splitting and link extraction
patterns.context: Uses string processing to extract links from a result object and displays HTML link output.

4_1271.concept: 多领域结构与边界特征
4_1271.description: 激活覆盖代码标点、HTML 表单、Ajax/URL、字符串与链接处理，也出现法律条文、判决中的住宿和法律论证，以及服务文案、公共文化政策；没有单一语义主题能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与语法边界
patterns.context: 在代码、HTML、JavaScript 或 URL 中，标点出现在调用、赋值、属性和标签等结构边界；触发并不局限于某一种语言。

patterns.name: HTTP 请求与跨域 Ajax
patterns.context: 围绕 Ajax 请求、跨域访问和请求 URL 的代码或问题描述。

patterns.name: 表单与 HTML 属性
patterns.context: HTML 表单、控件及链接的标签和属性语法。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的惯用搭配
patterns.context: 法律条文或判决语境中，描述行为主体及其行为的措辞。

patterns.name: 法律论证与记录材料
patterns.trigger: « legislative» « administrative» « members» « decision» « meetings» « reports»
patterns.context: 讨论立法或行政历史、决策机构记录及其对法律判断的相关性。

patterns.name: 睡眠与住宿情境
patterns.trigger: « slept» « arrange» « lod» « requested» « to» « leave»

patterns.name: 公共文化资源与政策
patterns.context: 讨论博物馆收费、公共学习空间及图书馆公共资助受到削弱。

patterns.name: 字符串拆分与链接抽取
patterns.context: 用字符串处理从结果对象中提取链接，并展示 HTML 链接输出。

en.concept: Local fragments in code and text
en.description: Most activation samples come from code, configuration, and technical Q&A, often falling on syntax punctuation, escape characters, template boundaries, and API/configuration subword fragments. There are also policy commentary and legal discussion, primarily activating on whittled and legal phrases; they are difficult to group under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Intent extra data retrieval
patterns.context: Android Java code reads a string extra through Intent; another passage shows it being sent and read in a second Activity.

patterns.name: Punctuation/boundaries in structured code and configuration
patterns.context: Activations fall on syntax punctuation, escape characters, and adjacent code fragments in code, templates, or configuration text; languages and semantics vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Various programming languages and configuration formats

patterns.name: PHP form delete control
patterns.context: PHP/HTML snippet outputs a POST form and a delete submit button, followed by an image link.

patterns.name: try statement in Python Notebook
patterns.context: In a Notebook JSON code source field, Python code begins with try and a newline escape sequence.

patterns.name: Regular expressions and split examples
patterns.context: Documentation or Q&A about R regular expressions includes string splitting and an escaped HTML-matching pattern.

patterns.name: AWS MQ Terraform configuration
patterns.context: A Terraform resource block configures an AWS MQ broker and references variables.

patterns.name: Museum fees and public learning spaces

patterns.name: Legislative history evidence in legal interpretation

patterns.name: Helm/Kubernetes security configuration template

patterns.name: Mink/PhantomJS user-agent configuration
patterns.context: StackExchange Q&A asks how to set the user agent when using Mink with PhantomJS and shows an extension configuration.

4_1271.concept: 代码与文本中的局部片段
4_1271.description: 激活样本多数来自代码、配置和技术问答，常落在语法标点、转义符、模板边界及 API/配置词片段；另有政策评论与法律论述，主要激活在 whittled 及法律词句，难以归入同一语义主题。

patterns.name: Intent 附加数据读取

patterns.name: 结构化代码与配置中的标点/边界

patterns.name: PHP 表单删除控件

patterns.name: 博物馆收费与公共学习空间

patterns.name: 法律解释中的立法史证据

patterns.context: StackExchange 问答询问 Mink 配合 PhantomJS 时如何设置 user agent，展示扩展配置。

en.concept: Entities and code operations in technical text
en.description: Activations are scattered across Android view binding, search and string code, item lists, an analytics article, automotive engineering, and user-agent configuration; there is no single clear trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Android view binding and resource IDs
patterns.context: Android Java code looks up, initializes, or sets UI views; activation often falls near resource references, control declarations, and assignment symbols.

patterns.name: Retrieval or search operations

patterns.domain: 学术论文，组织或工作场所心理相关论述

patterns.name: 药物强化与刺激行为术语
patterns.context: 讨论阿片类药物的强化或欣快效应及其与自我刺激行为通路的关系。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 问答标题中的交互词
patterns.context: 问题标题描述点击“View All”后重置词汇表条目。

patterns.name: 序列化配置键值
patterns.context: JSON 风格配置中键、值、布尔量和嵌套字段相邻出现。
patterns.domain: 监控面板或图表配置文本

patterns.name: Unity 序列化字段
patterns.context: 冒号分隔字段及对象引用标识符构成的序列化记录。

en.description: Activations appear in split URLs (especially Meetup), code punctuation and syntax, UI clicks and control terms, and several technical or common words; there are also scattered activations in prayer text, with no single stable semantics.

patterns.name: URL and Meetup link fragments
patterns.context: Domain and path in URLs are split into consecutive subwords, especially in meetup.com links.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and syntax fragments
patterns.context: Punctuation, operators, and adjacent syntax tokens activate in code or configuration text; this occurs across different languages and structures.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, code, and serialized configuration

patterns.name: UI interactions and control-related words
patterns.context: Describes clicking, button events, UI controls, or interface text; some activations occur on control properties and event-handler code.
patterns.domain: Software development Q&A and UI code

patterns.name: Technical words and technical-context fragments
patterns.context: Scattered words in technical topics or beginner questions, without clear trigger conditions shared with the code punctuation or interaction terms above.

patterns.name: Scattered words in ordinary prose
patterns.context: Appears in general natural-language sentences without a stable nearby code, URL, or UI pattern.

patterns.name: Action words in prayer contexts
patterns.context: Religious personal writing about memory, writing, and prayer; it has no obvious shared trigger condition with the other passages.

4_1271.concept: 技术文本片段及标点
4_1271.description: 激活分布在拆分的网址（尤其 Meetup）、代码标点与语法、UI 点击和控件词，以及若干技术或普通文本词；另有祈祷文字中的零散激活，未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 网址与 Meetup 链接片段
patterns.context: 网址中域名和路径被拆分成连续子词；尤其是 meetup.com 链接。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 帖子、社区活动邀请

patterns.name: 代码标点与语法片段
patterns.context: 代码或配置文本中，标点、运算符及其邻近语法 token 被激活；不同语言和结构均出现。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、代码与序列化配置

patterns.name: 界面交互及控件相关词
patterns.context: 描述点击、按钮事件、UI 控件或界面文本；部分激活落在控件属性及事件处理代码中。
patterns.domain: 软件开发问答与 UI 代码

patterns.name: 技术词与技术语境碎片
patterns.context: 技术话题或新手提问中的零散词语，未显示与前述代码标点或交互词一致的明确触发条件。
patterns.domain: 技术社区文字、数据库问答

patterns.name: 普通叙述中的零散词语
patterns.context: 一般自然语言句子中出现，附近没有稳定的代码、网址或 UI 模式。

patterns.name: 祈祷语境中的动作词
patterns.context: 关于回忆、写作与祈祷的宗教性个人文字；与其他片段缺少明显共同触发条件。

en.concept: Concatenation operators and markup text in code
en.description: Activations are mainly scattered across code, configuration, and markup text, especially plus signs in string concatenation and text near tags/attributes; there are also sporadic PHP, identifier, and technical-word fragments, as well as customer-service phone snippets, with no clear unified explanation.

patterns.name: Plus signs in string concatenation
patterns.context: Plus signs appear in code expressions or HTML/JavaScript attribute strings to concatenate values, variables, or strings; sometimes they are adjacent to variables or string fragments.

patterns.name: Markup-language attributes and attribute values
patterns.context: Tags, attributes, or key-value fields appear in XML/XAML, HTML, or Unity serialized text; activations often occur near attribute names, quotation marks, and colons.

patterns.name: Proper-name or keyword fragments in code
patterns.context: Language names, field names, and identifier fragments in code or configuration text, with no consistent semantic role.

patterns.name: Technical terms and discussion words
patterns.context: Ordinary words embedded in question descriptions or URLs in technical Q&A or discussions; the contexts vary.

patterns.name: Toll-free in customer-service phone numbers
patterns.context: A webpage message about hotel search being unavailable presents a phone number in toll-free format.

patterns.name: Punctuation or phrase fragments
patterns.context: Natural language contains comparison-, assistance-, or action-related phrases, with no stable shared semantics; some fragments may also reflect code/text boundary effects.

4_1271.concept: 代码中的拼接符与标记文本
4_1271.description: 激活主要散布于代码、配置与标记文本，尤其字符串拼接的加号及标签/属性附近；另有少量 PHP、标识符、技术词和客服电话片段，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 字符串拼接中的加号
patterns.context: 加号出现在代码表达式或 HTML/JavaScript 属性字符串中，用于拼接值、变量或字符串；有时紧邻变量或字符串片段。

patterns.name: 标记语言属性与属性值
patterns.context: XML/XAML、HTML 或 Unity 序列化文本中出现标签、属性或键值字段；激活点常在属性名、引号、冒号附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的专名或关键字片段
patterns.context: 代码或配置文本中的语言名、字段名及标识符片段，未见统一的语义角色。

patterns.name: 技术术语及技术讨论词
patterns.context: 技术问答或技术讨论中，普通词嵌在问题描述或 URL 中；各自上下文不同。

patterns.name: 客服电话号码中的 toll-free
patterns.context: 酒店搜索不可用的网页提示中，电话号码以 toll-free 形式呈现。

patterns.name: 标点或短语片段
patterns.context: 自然语言中出现比较、助人或行动相关短语，未发现稳定的共同语义；部分片段也可能只是代码/文本边界效应。

en.description: The most stable commonality is the ArXiv record structure: author/title/bibliography fields, colons, line breaks, and field boundaries. Some activations occur on title punctuation, bib filenames, and sporadic domain words, name fragments, or address fragments; no unified semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Paper metadata boundaries and field markers
patterns.context: In ArXiv paper records, especially near author, title, and reference fields and their separators; markers often occur on field names, colons, or line-break boundaries.
patterns.domain: ArXiv metadata, web pages, or corpus serialization formats

patterns.name: Paper title opening and quotation marks/separators
patterns.context: Quotation marks, vertical bars, spaces, or the title start immediately after the title-field colon; multiple segments activate on title markers and adjacent punctuation, not necessarily on title semantics.

patterns.name: Author fields and numbering/hyphen formats
patterns.context: In author fields and subsequent line breaks, author numbers, or list-like hyphen structures; some instances also contain author names.

patterns.name: Bibliography fields and .bib filenames
patterns.context: Bibliography fields near author information, and quoted filenames referring to bib files; some activations occur on field markers, others on filename fragments.
patterns.domain: Paper source files or metadata serialization

patterns.name: English words and term fragments in titles
patterns.context: Words in the abstract’s final text or in paper titles; meanings and fields vary widely, and evidence is insufficient to treat them as a distinct, unified semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary academic papers (recommender systems, social networks, machine learning, mathematics, quantum information, etc.)

patterns.name: Address, institution, and name fragments
patterns.context: Near author addresses, institutions, author names, or titles; activation markers are sporadic, and many address/name words are unmarked, making it difficult to confirm a stable trigger pattern.

4_1271.concept: ArXiv论文元数据边界
4_1271.description: 最稳定的共同点是ArXiv记录结构：author/title/bibliography字段、冒号换行及字段边界；部分激活落在标题标点、bib文件名和零散的领域词、姓名或地址片段上，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 论文元数据边界与字段标记
patterns.context: ArXiv 论文记录中，尤其作者、标题、参考文献等字段及其分隔符附近；标记常出现在字段名、冒号或换行边界。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 元数据、网页或语料序列化格式

patterns.name: 论文标题起始及引号/分隔符
patterns.context: 标题字段冒号之后的引号、竖线、空格或标题起始位置；多段在标题标记及其紧随的标点处激活，未必依赖标题语义。

patterns.name: 作者字段和编号/连字符格式
patterns.context: 作者字段及其后的换行、作者编号或类似列表的连字符结构；部分实例也包含作者姓名。

patterns.name: 参考文献字段与 .bib 文件名
patterns.context: 作者信息附近的 bibliography 字段，以及指向 bib 文件的引号内文件名；有些激活落在字段标记，有些落在文件名片段。
patterns.domain: 论文源文件或元数据序列化

patterns.name: 标题中的英文词与术语片段
patterns.context: 正文摘要尾部或论文标题中的词语；不同词义和领域差异很大，现有证据不足以将其视为独立、统一的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域学术论文（推荐系统、社交网络、机器学习、数学、量子信息等）

patterns.name: 地址、机构及人名片段
patterns.context: 作者地址、机构、作者姓名或标题周边；激活标记零散，且不少地址/姓名词本身未标记，难以确认其为稳定触发模式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 作者与机构元数据

en.description: The most stable pattern is the title and author fields in ArXiv metadata; there are also responses to GitHub JSON keys and fields such as title and name. Other highlighted words are scattered across disciplines and lack unified semantics.

patterns.name: Paper title field
patterns.context: Appears in bibliographic metadata, followed by a paper title; this field marker recurs in multiple ArXiv snippets.

patterns.name: Author field
patterns.context: Author metadata field after a paper abstract or main text, often adjacent to a newline and the title field.

patterns.name: Structured key-value punctuation
patterns.context: In JSON or similar configuration text, a key is followed by a colon, quotation marks, and a value; occurs alongside highlighted field names and punctuation.

patterns.name: Title key and value
patterns.context: The title or text field in a configuration object, followed by a string value; in passage 8, the value is Max cpu_temp_avg.

patterns.name: Name and application description fields
patterns.context: Key-value pairs in an application manifest or sample configuration describing a project name and summary.

patterns.name: General English phrases and paper topic words
patterns.context: Appear separately in papers on recommender systems, social networks, algorithm analysis, cryptography, and mathematics; these phrases are scattered, with no stable shared semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Other paper title content
patterns.context: Located near the title field, but the title topics vary apart from sharing the paper metadata format.

4_1271.concept: 结构化文档字段标记
4_1271.description: 最稳定的模式是ArXiv元数据中的title与author字段；另对Github JSON键值及标题、名称等字段有反应。其余高亮词分散于不同学科，缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: 论文标题字段
patterns.context: 出现在文献元数据中，后接论文标题；此字段标记在多个 ArXiv 片段反复出现。

patterns.name: 作者字段
patterns.context: 论文摘要或正文之后的作者元数据字段，常与换行及标题字段相邻。

patterns.name: 结构化键值标点
patterns.context: JSON 或类似配置文本中，键名后接冒号、引号和值；与高亮的字段名及标点共同出现。

patterns.name: 标题键及值
patterns.context: 配置对象中的 title 或 text 字段，后接字符串值；第 8 段值为 Max cpu_temp_avg。

patterns.name: 名称及应用描述字段
patterns.context: 应用清单或示例配置中，以键值对描述项目名称与简介。

patterns.name: 一般英文词组及论文主题词
patterns.context: 分别出现在推荐系统、社交网络、算法分析、密码学和数学论文内容中；这些词组分散，未见稳定共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 其他论文标题内容
patterns.context: 位于标题字段附近，但除共享论文元数据格式外，标题主题各异。

en.description: All segments are ArXiv paper metadata. Activations concentrate on field boundaries and labels such as author and title, and also occur on author-name formatting, dates, addresses, and word fragments and symbols in titles; title meanings are diverse.

patterns.name: ArXiv title field marker
patterns.context: A title field appears in paper metadata; activation primarily falls on the field marker and the beginning of the title that follows, with strength varying by sample

patterns.name: Author field marker
patterns.context: An author field appears before the title or in paper metadata; author numbering often has a format such as «1»-«4»

patterns.name: Author names and name-format markers
patterns.context: Author names occur in the author field; some names are marked with HTML small-caps tags, and activation falls on name fragments or tags
patterns.domain: Paper author metadata and its HTML formatting

patterns.name: Date field
patterns.context: The date appears as a paper metadata field, and the field marker itself is activated

patterns.name: Institution address field
patterns.context: Author institution addresses are given in an address field; some listed department names are also activated

patterns.name: Special characters and formatting symbols in titles
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical expressions, separators, quotation marks, or title formatting; occurs in only a few segments, so it is unclear whether it is an independent semantic trigger

patterns.name: Local word fragments in titles
patterns.context: Word fragments occur in title text and are often subword fragments of longer title words; the specific meanings and disciplines differ across segments

4_1271.concept: ArXiv论文元数据格式
4_1271.description: 所有片段均为ArXiv论文元数据，激活集中于作者、标题等字段边界与标签，也落在作者姓名格式、日期、地址及标题中的词片段和符号上；各标题词义分散。

patterns.name: ArXiv 标题字段标记
patterns.context: 论文元数据中出现 title 字段；激活主要落在字段标记及紧随其后的标题开头，强度随样本有所不同

patterns.name: 作者字段标记
patterns.context: 标题之前或论文元数据中出现作者字段，作者编号常呈现如«1»-«4»的格式

patterns.name: 作者姓名与姓名格式标记
patterns.trigger: 姓名中的局部片段，如«W»、«Beck»、«Zar»；以及«span style="font-variant:»、«small»、«-caps»
patterns.context: 作者名处在作者字段中；部分名字以 HTML 小型大写字母标签标注，激活落在名字片段或标签上
patterns.domain: 论文作者元数据及其 HTML 格式

patterns.name: 日期字段
patterns.context: 日期作为论文元数据字段出现，字段标记本身被激活

patterns.name: 机构地址字段
patterns.context: 作者机构地址以 address 字段给出，所列院系名称中也有激活

patterns.name: 标题中的特殊字符与格式符号
patterns.context: 出现在标题的数学表达、分隔符、引号或标题格式中；仅个别段落出现，不能确定是否为独立语义触发
patterns.domain: 数学化标题及元数据排版

patterns.name: 标题中的局部词片段
patterns.context: 词片段出现在标题文本中，常是较长标题词的部分子词；各段具体词义和学科不同

en.description: Activations are distributed across syntax boundaries, fields, and values in various code and structured text, and also involve UI, requests, event handling, and academic terminology; the common feature is unclear and may lean toward local structures or common word fragments in code/markup.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: In code, configuration, or serialized text, activations fall on punctuation and immediately adjacent structural boundaries; the specific punctuation varies with the syntax.

patterns.name: UI- and control-related words
patterns.context: In layout or control declarations, activation occurs on UI elements, layout directions, and alignment option names.

patterns.name: Numeric labels and plotting configuration
patterns.context: Near JSON fields and values in chart or plotting configuration, especially label display and title text.

patterns.name: Credentials and encoded request parameters
patterns.context: User credential fields and encoding calls appear when constructing request bodies or URL parameters.

patterns.name: Physics terminology and formulas
patterns.context: In physics discussion and formulas concerning vortices, transport current, and current density; names are split into marked fragments.

patterns.name: Randomization and event-handling code
patterns.context: Involves random selection/randomization and appears in GUI button events or Java imports.

patterns.name: HTTP method and request body
patterns.context: A structured request example specifies the POST method and provides a JSON request body.

patterns.name: Ruby path concatenation
patterns.context: In a Ruby file, a relative path is concatenated with the current file location.

patterns.name: Kolmogorov complexity and author metadata
patterns.context: A paper abstract/bibliographic information discusses the concept of complexity and its comparison object, then lists the authors.

4_1271.concept: 代码与结构化文本片段
4_1271.description: 激活分布于多种代码与结构化文本的语法边界、字段和值，也涉及UI、请求、事件处理及学术术语；共同特征不明确，可能偏向代码/标记中的局部结构或常见词片段。

patterns.name: 代码标点与结构边界
patterns.context: 在代码、配置或序列化文本中，激活落在标点及其紧邻的结构边界；具体标点随语法而变。

patterns.name: UI与控件相关词
patterns.context: 布局或控件声明中，激活于界面元素、布局方向及对齐选项名称。

patterns.name: 数值标签与绘图配置
patterns.context: 图表或绘图配置的 JSON 字段和值附近，尤其是标签显示和标题文本。

patterns.name: 凭据与编码请求参数
patterns.context: 构造请求体或 URL 参数时，出现用户凭据字段及编码调用。

patterns.name: 物理学术语与公式
patterns.context: 涡旋、输运电流和电流密度的物理学论述及公式中；姓名被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 随机化与事件处理代码
patterns.context: 涉及随机选择/随机化，并在 GUI 按钮事件或 Java 导入中出现。

patterns.name: HTTP 方法与请求体
patterns.context: 结构化请求示例中指定 POST 方法并提供 JSON 请求体。

patterns.name: Ruby 路径拼接
patterns.context: Ruby 文件中基于当前文件位置拼接相对路径。

patterns.name: Kolmogorov 复杂度与作者元数据
patterns.context: 论文摘要/书目信息讨论复杂度概念及其比较对象，随后列出作者。
patterns.domain: 计算机科学论文元数据

en.concept: Title/display markers in structured fields or UI text
en.description: Activations are concentrated in the title field of paper metadata and its title content; there are also sporadic responses to GUI message-box calls, booking inquiries in business emails, tablet input and application descriptions, and HTML title tags.

patterns.name: MessageBox display call
patterns.context: Code calls a GUI dialog/message box to display content, often alongside System.Windows.Forms or input-box-related variables

patterns.name: Booking-related contact and information
patterns.context: Business email explains what information to prepare before booking and mentions travel arrangements for business and personal travelers

patterns.name: Paper metadata title field
patterns.context: The title field begins in paper or academic-document metadata/export text and introduces the paper title

patterns.name: Input methods and lightweight applications
patterns.context: Discusses lightweight applications suitable for tablet devices due to their limited keyboard input

patterns.name: Webpage title tag
patterns.context: An HTML example uses a title tag to set the webpage title, whose content describes drawing a circle

4_1271.concept: 结构化字段或界面文本的标题/显示标记
4_1271.description: 激活集中出现在论文元数据的 title 字段及其标题内容；另对 GUI 消息框调用、商务邮件中的预订联系、平板输入与应用描述、HTML 标题标签有零散响应。

patterns.name: MessageBox 显示调用
patterns.context: 代码中调用 GUI 对话框/消息框显示内容，常伴随 System.Windows.Forms 或输入框相关变量

patterns.name: 预订行程联系与信息
patterns.context: 商务邮件中说明预订前应准备信息，并提及商务与个人旅客的行程安排

patterns.name: 论文元数据标题字段
patterns.trigger: «title»«:»« |» 或 «title»«:» 后接论文标题；常邻近 bibliography 和 .bib 文件名
patterns.context: 论文或学术文档的元数据/导出文本中，标题字段开始并引出论文标题

patterns.name: 输入方式及轻量应用
patterns.context: 讨论平板设备因键盘输入受限而适合运行的轻量应用

patterns.name: 网页标题标签
patterns.context: HTML 示例中用 title 标签设置网页标题，内容描述绘制圆形

en.concept: Boundaries and markers in structured text
en.description: Activations are distributed across code, email, patents, and paper metadata. They include punctuation/assignment and field boundaries, code identifiers, title and author formatting markers, as well as travel arrangements and keyboard text-input contexts.

patterns.name: File extensions and path concatenation
patterns.context: Code calls dirname to obtain the current file’s directory, then uses a plus sign to concatenate a relative path; activation concentrates on the plus sign and the following path string.

patterns.name: Phrases in travel-arrangement emails
patterns.context: A business travel booking email says a passenger may be upgraded or have their departure time changed, and advises them to have information ready when contacting the sender; activation is mainly on contacting.

patterns.name: Small-caps markers and title fields
patterns.context: Paper metadata uses HTML small-caps styling for author names and introduces a title field; activation occurs on the colon and title-field marker.

patterns.name: Target variables and selectors in code
patterns.context: JavaScript/jQuery code finds a page element based on the URL hash and scrolls to it; activation involves scroll, the assignment operator, and the beginning of the selector.

patterns.name: Text processing and input for keyboard operation
patterns.context: A patent background describes tablet devices, word processing, and keyboard input, and lists uses such as web browsing, email, and text entry.

patterns.name: Program identifiers and member access
patterns.context: C#-style code accesses table fields, text boxes, and message box members, including identifiers, assignments, and periods.

patterns.name: YAML title field
patterns.context: A document begins with YAML front-matter delimiters and a title field; the title content is in English, Chinese, or Vietnamese.

4_1271.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与标记
4_1271.description: 激活分布于代码、邮件、专利和论文元数据；包括标点/赋值与字段边界、代码标识符、标题与作者格式标记，以及旅行安排和键盘文本输入语境。

patterns.name: 文件扩展名与路径拼接
patterns.context: 代码中调用 dirname 获取当前文件目录，再用加号拼接相对路径；激活集中在加号及其后的路径字符串。

patterns.name: 旅行安排邮件中的短语
patterns.trigger: being« bump»1«ed»2« up»2；« schedule»1；« information»1« available»1 when« contacting»10
patterns.context: 商务旅行预订邮件中，说明乘客可能被升舱或调整出发时间，并提示联系预订时准备信息；主要激活在 contacting。

patterns.name: 小型大写标记及标题字段
patterns.context: 论文元数据中用 HTML small-caps 样式标记作者姓名，并引出 title 字段；激活在冒号及标题字段标记。

patterns.name: 代码中的目标变量与选择器
patterns.trigger: « out»1 element to« scroll»2 to；var« target»1« =»2« $(»4this.«hash»3)
patterns.context: JavaScript/jQuery 代码里依据 URL hash 查找页面元素并滚动到目标；激活涉及 scroll、赋值符及选择器开头。

patterns.name: 面向键盘操作的文本处理与输入
patterns.context: 专利背景描述平板设备、文字处理和键盘输入，并列举网页浏览、邮件、文本输入等用途。

patterns.name: 程序标识符与成员访问
patterns.context: C# 风格代码中访问表格字段、文本框和消息框成员，包含标识符、赋值和点号。

patterns.name: YAML 标题字段
patterns.context: 文档开头以 YAML 前置区分隔符和 title 字段起始；标题内容分别是英文、中文及越南语文本。

en.description: Primarily responds to separators in the title field and the title’s starting position in Markdown front matter; title content spans languages and topics. It responds more weakly to adjacent bibliography/author metadata; another segment activates in Flutter button callback code.

patterns.name: Title field in YAML/front matter
patterns.context: In the `---` metadata block at the beginning of a Markdown document, the title value after `: ` activates strongly; titles often begin with quotation marks or contain them.
patterns.domain: Markdown/YAML front matter in GitHub documentation and ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Proper names and technical phrases in title content
patterns.context: Occurs in title-field values, which may be in English, Vietnamese, or mixed languages, or may be command text; the content itself has no clear shared meaning.
patterns.domain: GitHub repository titles and project documentation titles

patterns.name: Quotation marks and Markdown emphasis markers at the start of title values
patterns.context: Quotation marks, bold markers, square brackets, or vertical bars occur at the very start of metadata title values; activation may fall on these symbols rather than semantic title words.

patterns.name: Bibliography metadata near titles
patterns.context: In front matter adjacent to the title field, the bibliography field and its BibTeX filename also show activation, but weaker than the title field.

patterns.name: Author metadata and list formatting
patterns.context: An author list appears before title or bibliography metadata; author-field markers and list symbols show weaker activation.

patterns.name: UI buttons and callback identifiers in code
patterns.context: Near button construction, onPressed callbacks, and enabled-state expressions in Flutter/Dart-style UI code; this is not a front-matter title pattern.

4_1271.concept: Markdown 元数据字段边界
4_1271.description: 主要响应 Markdown 前置元数据里 title 字段的分隔符及标题起始位置；标题内容跨语言且主题多样。较弱地响应相邻的 bibliography/author 元数据；另有一段 Flutter 按钮回调代码激活。

patterns.name: YAML/前置元数据中的 title 字段
patterns.context: Markdown 文档开头的 `---` 元数据块中，`: `后的标题值位置强烈激活；标题常以引号开头或包含引号。
patterns.domain: GitHub 文档及 ArXiv 论文的 Markdown/YAML 前置元数据

patterns.name: 标题内容中的专名与技术短语
patterns.trigger: « B»2ands、« »3浏«览»1器同、« C»1ác phiên« b»1ản、«Command»1 -« devspace list teams
patterns.context: 出现在 title 字段值中，标题可以是英文、越南语或混合语言，也可以是命令文本；这些内容本身并没有共同的明显词义。
patterns.domain: GitHub 仓库标题及项目文档标题

patterns.name: 标题值开头的引号与 Markdown 强调符
patterns.context: 元数据标题值刚开始处出现引号、粗体标记、方括号或竖线等格式符号；激活可落在这些符号而非标题语义词上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的 Markdown/元数据文本

patterns.name: 标题附近的 bibliography 元数据
patterns.context: 与标题字段相邻的前置元数据中，bibliography 字段及其 BibTeX 文件名附近也有激活，但强度低于 title 字段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的 Markdown 元数据

patterns.name: 作者元数据与列表格式
patterns.context: 标题或 bibliography 元数据之前出现 author 列表；作者字段标记及列表符号有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 代码中 UI 按钮与回调标识符
patterns.context: Flutter/Dart 风格的界面代码中，按钮构造、onPressed 回调及启用状态表达式附近激活；不是前置元数据标题模式。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答中的代码

en.concept: Expression concatenation and boundaries in code
en.description: Primarily responds to expression boundaries in source code and templates, especially plus-sign concatenation of strings, variables, and property values; also shows sporadic activation on member access, HTML/ERB structures, and newline punctuation. Segments involve various languages and tasks, with no unified business semantics.

patterns.name: Plus-sign concatenation in code
patterns.context: Activations often occur at expression joins, especially where variables, property values, or string literals are combined into parameters, paths, or output text; some examples also contain commas or punctuation, suggesting a response to connection boundaries in code.
patterns.domain: Code and programming Q&A in various languages; JavaScript, Ruby, C#, etc.

patterns.name: Property, variable, and member-access identifiers
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur when code accesses object members, variables, or parameters; some markers are adjacent to periods, underscores, or assignment operators. The identifiers do not all belong to the same semantic category.

patterns.name: Template and markup-language structures
patterns.context: HTML tags and embedded template expressions are interleaved; activations concentrate on tags, template boundaries, and link-generation code. YAML front-matter boundaries also occur.
patterns.domain: Rails/ERB templates, HTML, and document metadata

patterns.name: Console output and collection iteration
patterns.context: Iterates over JSON objects and their properties, formatting property names and values for output; this is a single, specific code snippet.

patterns.name: User records and announcement handling
patterns.context: Loops through announcement records, looks up their associated users, and outputs titles; markers are distributed across comments and Ruby code.

patterns.name: YAML author/title metadata
patterns.context: YAML-style metadata fields at the start of a document; activations occur on line breaks, field names, and title text.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper or project documentation metadata

patterns.name: Map-layer conditions and toolbar activation
patterns.context: A conditional sets a boolean when a particular level is met, then concatenates a toolbar variable by name and calls an activation method.

patterns.name: onclick string concatenation
patterns.context: Explanatory text discusses concatenating a field from a response into an onclick attribute string and writing the result to an HTML attribute.

patterns.name: File path concatenation
patterns.context: In a Ruby file, the directory containing the current file is concatenated with a relative path to construct an example application path.

4_1271.concept: 代码表达式拼接与边界
4_1271.description: 主要响应源代码与模板中的表达式边界，尤其是加号拼接字符串、变量和属性值；同时对成员访问、HTML/ERB结构及换行标点有零散激活。各段涉及多种语言和具体任务，未见统一业务语义。

patterns.name: 代码中的加号拼接
patterns.context: 激活多落在表达式连接处，尤其是把变量、属性值或字符串字面量拼成参数、路径或输出文本；部分例子同时含逗号或标点，可能是对代码中连接边界的响应。
patterns.domain: 多种编程语言的代码与代码问答；JavaScript、Ruby、C#等

patterns.name: 属性、变量及成员访问标识符
patterns.context: 代码中访问对象成员、变量或参数时有零散激活；一些标记紧邻点号、下划线或赋值符号。并非所有标识符都遵循同一语义类别。

patterns.name: 模板与标记语言结构
patterns.context: HTML标签与嵌入式模板表达式交错，激活集中于标签、模板边界及链接生成代码；也出现 YAML 前置元数据边界。

patterns.name: 控制台输出及集合遍历
patterns.context: 遍历 JSON 对象及其属性，并将属性名和值格式化输出；是单一的具体代码片段。

patterns.name: 用户记录与公告处理
patterns.context: 循环处理公告记录，查找所属用户并输出标题；标记分布于注释和 Ruby 代码。

patterns.name: YAML作者/标题元数据
patterns.context: 文档开头的 YAML 风格元数据字段，激活落在换行、字段名及标题文本上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文或项目文档元数据

patterns.name: 地图图层条件与工具栏激活
patterns.context: 条件判断满足特定层级时设置布尔值，并按名称拼接工具栏变量后调用激活方法。

patterns.name: onclick 字符串拼接
patterns.context: 说明文字讨论把响应数据的字段拼入 onclick 属性字符串，并将结果写入 HTML 属性。

patterns.name: 文件路径拼接
patterns.context: Ruby 文件中用当前文件所在目录与相对路径拼接出示例应用路径。
patterns.domain: Github中的 Ruby 项目代码

en.concept: Fields and delimiters in structured text
en.description: Activations mainly fall on dots, operators, and property/method access in code, as well as title/author field markers in document or paper metadata; there are also local patterns involving title fields, the ending of the word crowdfunding, and the name MovieLens.

patterns.name: Ruby/code punctuation and property access
patterns.context: In Ruby/ERB or JavaScript code, activations occur near dots, operators, object properties, and method calls; the specific syntax varies across snippets.

patterns.name: ArXiv metadata fields
patterns.context: Author/title labels and colons appear in paper text or metadata, with the title possibly following; activations concentrate on field markers and colons.

patterns.name: YAML/Markdown title field
patterns.context: In YAML front matter delimited by three hyphens, a title field is followed by a colon and title text; title languages and content vary.

patterns.name: Within the word crowdfunding
patterns.context: The word crowdfunding appears in English prose, with activations on consecutive subword fragments, especially toward the end of the word.

patterns.name: Recommender-system dataset name
patterns.context: MovieLens is enclosed in parentheses or italics when datasets are listed in an academic context.

4_1271.concept: 结构化文本中的字段与分隔符
4_1271.description: 激活主要落在代码中的点号、运算符和属性/方法访问，以及文档或论文元数据的 title/author 字段标记；另有标题字段、crowdfunding 词尾和 MovieLens 名称等局部模式。

patterns.name: Ruby/代码标点与属性访问
patterns.context: Ruby/ERB 或 JavaScript 代码中，激活落在点号、运算符及对象属性、方法调用附近；不同片段具体语法不完全相同。

patterns.name: ArXiv 元数据字段
patterns.context: 论文文本或元数据中出现 author/title 标签及冒号，标题可能紧随其后；激活集中在字段标记和冒号。

patterns.name: YAML/Markdown 标题字段
patterns.context: 文档以三连横线分隔的 YAML front matter 中，title 字段冒号后接标题文本；标题语言、内容各异。

patterns.name: crowdfunding 词形内部
patterns.context: 英文叙述中出现 crowdfunding，激活落在该词的连续子词片段，尤其词尾部分。

patterns.name: 推荐系统数据集名称
patterns.context: 学术语境中列举数据集时，MovieLens 被括号或斜体标记包围。

en.concept: Code UI interaction and operation fragments
en.description: Activations often occur on buttons, click/press events, and Rails link templates in code, and also cover Ruby output and assignment and path concatenation; another example falls on an internal fragment of “crowdfunding,” which cannot be clearly unified with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Buttons, clicks, and press events in code
patterns.context: UI or hardware button-related code includes button controls, click/touch events, or descriptions of buttons being pressed and released; spans multiple languages and code syntax.
patterns.domain: Software development, UI code, patent technical descriptions

patterns.name: Rails links and template tags
patterns.context: Ruby on Rails view templates mix HTML tags with ERB/Rails helpers to generate links or navigation pages.

patterns.name: Ruby text output and assignment
patterns.context: Ruby code concatenates strings, outputs titles, or updates object state; there is no clear button or link context.

patterns.name: Symbols, paths, and concatenation in code
patterns.context: Code syntax includes file path construction and string concatenation; activation concentrates around periods and concatenation expressions.

patterns.name: Internal word fragment in a crowdfunding term
patterns.context: The word crowdfunding appears in ordinary prose, with activation on a split suffix fragment; although the paragraph mentions an advisory board and digital entertainment, it has no code or button context.

4_1271.concept: 代码界面交互与操作片段
4_1271.description: 激活多见于代码中的按钮、点击/按压事件和 Rails 链接模板，也覆盖 Ruby 输出与赋值、路径拼接；另有一例落在“crowdfunding”的词内片段，不能与主模式明确统一。

patterns.name: 代码中的按钮、点击与按压事件
patterns.context: 用户界面或硬件按钮相关代码中，出现按钮控件、点击/触摸事件，或描述按钮按下和释放；包含多种语言和代码语法。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、UI 代码、专利技术描述

patterns.name: Rails 链接与模板标签
patterns.context: Ruby on Rails 视图模板中，HTML 标签与 ERB/Rails 助手混用，生成链接或导航页面。

patterns.name: Ruby 文本输出与赋值
patterns.context: Ruby 代码中拼接字符串、输出标题或更新对象状态；没有明显按钮或链接语境。

patterns.name: 代码中的符号、路径与拼接
patterns.context: 代码语法中出现文件路径构造和字符串拼接；激活集中在点号及连接表达式附近。

patterns.name: 众筹平台词语内部片段
patterns.context: 普通叙述中出现 crowdfunding，激活落在被切分的词尾片段；段落虽提及 advisory board 和数字娱乐，但没有代码或按钮语境。

en.description: Activations are distributed across punctuation and source-code structures: field colons, HTML/JSX form attributes, feedback words, path concatenation, Markdown separators, and author-list symbols; there are also sporadic internal word fragments and project terminology, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: Colons in YAML/metadata
patterns.context: A colon follows a field name as the key-value separator, followed by a title or text
patterns.domain: ArXiv, Github documentation, or configuration text

patterns.name: HTML attribute assignment and form controls
patterns.context: In HTML/JSX forms or button tags, attributes are assigned with equals signs, including input, button, class, etc.

patterns.name: The word feedback
patterns.context: In text related to user support, tools, or product experience, feedback is followed by punctuation or a phrase
patterns.domain: Product descriptions, research software project descriptions

patterns.name: Other internal fragments of English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on token fragments within ordinary words or proper names, with no stable shared context

patterns.name: Path concatenation operator
patterns.context: Used in code as a string or path concatenation operator, between file path fragments

patterns.name: Markdown heading separator
patterns.context: At the beginning of a document or near a title, a separator consists of three hyphens

patterns.name: Author-line prefix
patterns.context: In an author list, a hyphen introduces a name after a line break

patterns.name: List-item prefix
patterns.context: At the beginning of YAML/metadata author entries

patterns.name: workshops
patterns.context: Appears in lists of project activities or work

patterns.name: Button click-event code
patterns.context: A JSX button binds a component method

4_1271.concept: 源码与结构化文本标记
4_1271.description: 激活分布于标点与源码结构：字段冒号、HTML/JSX 表单属性、反馈词、路径拼接、Markdown分隔线及作者列表符号；另有零散词内片段和项目用语，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: YAML/元数据中的冒号
patterns.context: 冒号紧跟字段名，作为键值分隔符，后接标题或文本

patterns.name: HTML 属性赋值与表单控件
patterns.context: HTML/JSX 表单或按钮标签中，属性以等号赋值，含 input、button、class 等

patterns.name: 反馈一词
patterns.context: 与用户支持、工具或产品体验相关的文本中，feedback 后接标点或短语
patterns.domain: 产品说明、科研软件项目描述

patterns.name: 其他英文词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通词或专名的分词片段中，未见稳定共同上下文

patterns.name: 路径拼接符
patterns.context: 代码中作为字符串或路径拼接运算符，位于文件路径片段之间

patterns.name: Markdown 标题分隔符
patterns.context: 文档开头或标题附近，以三条短横线构成分隔线

patterns.name: 署名行前缀
patterns.context: 作者列表中换行后以连字符引出姓名

patterns.name: 列表项前缀
patterns.context: YAML/元数据作者条目开头

patterns.name: workshops
patterns.context: 出现在项目活动或工作内容列举中

patterns.name: 按钮点击事件代码
patterns.context: JSX 按钮绑定组件方法

en.description: Activations are scattered across code and English text. More prominent cues include plus-sign concatenation and periods and other syntax punctuation in code, as well as internal fragments of several long words, feedback, and social media phrases. Segment 2 is difficult to connect to these cues, and there is little unified semantics overall.

patterns.name: Ruby file path concatenation
patterns.context: Ruby code calls File.dirname to obtain the current file’s directory and uses + to concatenate a relative path.

patterns.name: String or expression concatenation in programming
patterns.context: Code uses plus signs to join variables, properties, or strings; sometimes it joins assignment expressions, output text, or URL parameters.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within English phrases
patterns.context: Triggers fall inside longer English words or at affix boundaries, rather than on standalone words; contexts include crowdfunding, informatics, and headphones.

patterns.name: Feedback-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in contexts describing user feedback, exploration, or analysis.

patterns.name: Social media phrase
patterns.context: A news sentence mentions a player posting a message on Twitter or other social networking sites.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and member access
patterns.context: Periods for member access, function-call parentheses, or index brackets in code; it is unclear whether these form a stable trigger pattern on their own.

4_1271.concept: none
4_1271.description: 激活分散于代码及英文文本：较显著的线索包括代码中的加号拼接、点号等语法标点，以及若干长词内部片段、反馈和社交媒体短语。第2段难与这些线索对应，整体缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: Ruby 文件路径拼接
patterns.context: Ruby 代码中调用 File.dirname 获取当前文件目录，并用 + 拼接相对路径。

patterns.name: 编程中的字符串或表达式拼接
patterns.context: 代码里使用加号连接变量、属性或字符串；有时连接赋值表达式、输出文本或 URL 参数。

patterns.name: 英文词组内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 触发落在较长英文词的内部或词缀边界，并非独立单词；涉及众筹、信息学、耳机等不同语境。

patterns.name: 反馈相关词汇
patterns.context: 在描述用户反馈、探索或分析的语境中出现。

patterns.name: 社交媒体短语
patterns.context: 新闻句子提及球员在 Twitter 等社交网站发布消息。

patterns.name: 代码标点与成员访问
patterns.context: 代码中的点号成员访问、函数调用括号或索引括号；是否单独构成稳定触发模式不确定。

en.description: Primarily activates on addition/concatenation, assignment/field delimiters, and identifiers in code; there are also sporadic responses to the word feedback and to several specific code contexts.

patterns.name: Addition operator
patterns.context: Connects paths, URLs, strings, property values, or expressions in code; recurs across multiple passages

patterns.name: Colon and assignment-style fields
patterns.context: Object properties, variable assignments, or configuration fields are followed by values; some passages also contain strings or booleans
patterns.domain: JavaScript, C#, Ruby, and configuration code

patterns.name: Code identifiers and property names
patterns.context: Method, property, or field names in code, often in member-access, object-literal, or call contexts

patterns.name: The word feedback
patterns.context: Refers to user feedback or opinions associated with the use experience of a product, tool, or resource
patterns.domain: Product promotional copy and research project descriptions

patterns.name: Bluetooth headphones and music
patterns.context: Describes wireless headphones, built-in storage, and use without a phone

patterns.name: Research resources and data integration
patterns.context: Describes bioinformatics resources, data generation and analysis, and user interaction

patterns.name: Vue page initialization and prompt copy
patterns.context: Creates a Vue application when the page loads and sets an editing prompt for users

patterns.name: Text editor submission handling
patterns.context: Selects element text in an editor and binds an edit-submission handler

patterns.name: Ruby announcement handling
patterns.context: Iterates through announcements, finds their associated users, and outputs titles

patterns.name: require path concatenation
patterns.context: Constructs a relative path from the current file’s directory and loads an application file

patterns.name: Configuration options and comments
patterns.context: Configuration object fields and their Chinese comments

patterns.name: Knockout form validation
patterns.context: Configures required, length, and pattern validation rules for the Title field

patterns.name: Asynchronous analytics script loading
patterns.context: Constructs and loads a Google Analytics script URL based on the page protocol

patterns.name: JSON property output
patterns.context: Iterates through JSON object properties and outputs their names and values

4_1271.concept: 代码语法与标识符
4_1271.description: 主要激活于代码中的加法拼接、赋值/字段分隔符及标识符；另对 feedback 一词和若干特定代码语境有零散响应。

patterns.name: 加法运算符

en.description: Activations often fall on D or other within-word subword fragments, proper names/rare strings, and line-break whitespace boundaries; a few common words and punctuation marks also activate. patterns.name: Word-initial or within-word fragment D
patterns.context: Activation focuses on uppercase D or strings beginning with D; subsequent fragments vary and often occur at tokenization boundaries or at the beginnings of proper names, with no shared meaning.

patterns.name: Line breaks and whitespace boundaries

patterns.name: 局部常见词与标点
patterns.trigger: « supports»、« web»、«-»、« before»、« or»、« and»、«!»、«Anything»、« else»
patterns.context: 少数普通词、连字符和标点在短语中被激活，缺乏稳定的句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 机构说明、医学文本和邮件

en.concept: iv character fragments and layout features
en.description: Activations prominently occur on iv fragments and names or words containing iv, and also cover uppercase ordinals and layout whitespace in some legal headings; scattered activations on other words and proper names cannot be grouped into a stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Word-final/in-word iv and v spelling fragments
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on names, words, or transliterated fragments containing iv; they sometimes occur word-finally and sometimes are followed by other characters, with no unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, email subject lines, film descriptions, sports, chemistry, politics, and name lists

patterns.name: Uppercase segmentation in headings
patterns.context: Uppercase, segmented ordinals or department names in court letterheads; activations also cover spaces and line breaks in headers.

patterns.name: Layout whitespace and line breaks
patterns.context: Line breaks and alignment spaces at paragraph beginnings or in court letterheads have significant activations; whitespace activations are not limited to ordinary body text.

patterns.name: Other local words and names
patterns.context: Some individual common words, proper names, or their subword fragments also activate, with no consistent context across passages.
patterns.domain: Narrative text, proper names, and lists

4_1286.concept: iv 字符片段及版面特征
4_1286.description: 激活较突出地落在 iv 片段及含 iv 的姓名、词语中，也覆盖若干法律标题中的大写序数和排版空白；另有分散的词语、专名激活，无法归为稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 词尾/词内 iv 与 v 的拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在包含 iv 的姓名、词语或转写片段中；有时处于词尾，有时接续其他字符，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、邮件标题、电影简介、体育、化学、政治及人名列表

patterns.name: 标题中的大写字母切分
patterns.context: 法院抬头中大写、被切分标记的序数或部门名称；激活同时覆盖页眉中的空格与换行。

patterns.name: 版面空白与换行
patterns.context: 段落开头或法院抬头中，换行及对齐用空格有显著激活；空格激活并非仅限普通正文。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、法律文书排版

patterns.name: 其他局部词语与名字
patterns.context: 个别常见词、专名或其子词片段也有激活，缺少跨段一致的上下文。
patterns.domain: 叙述性文字、专名及列表

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical and biological terms, the research-recap word “previously,” mathematical statements, patent principles, list headings, and business emails; there is no shared theme that covers all passages.

patterns.name: previously and retrospective narration
patterns.context: Scientific or medical narration that reviews prior studies, requirements, or findings; sometimes co-occurs with longer technical terms.

patterns.name: Interest and population welfare
patterns.context: “interest” describes concern for a group and its demographic characteristics and welfare.
patterns.domain: NIH project or social research text

patterns.name: Logical reformulation of set complements
patterns.context: A mathematics Q&A reformulates a set relation as a logical negation.

patterns.name: Operating principle of an electronic scale
patterns.context: A patent background describes the operating principle underlying a weighing module.

patterns.name: Division remainder problems
patterns.context: A sequence of integer division or remainder problems, interspersed with numbers and line breaks.

patterns.name: List of realist artists
patterns.context: Introduces works exhibited at a gallery and lists artists line by line; “Close” has prominent activation.

patterns.name: Smooth muscle, integrins, and airway response
patterns.context: Describes airway responses and lung section results after integrin deletion in specific mouse cells.

patterns.name: Invitation to a Nordic energy event
patterns.context: An email forwards an invitation from the Oslo office and describes the event as highly impactful.

patterns.name: Oregon hospital directory heading
patterns.context: The title and opening of a Wikipedia list entry.

patterns.name: Lens and post-cataract-surgery vision
patterns.context: Discusses intraocular lenses and near vision or glasses needs after cataract surgery.

patterns.name: Oxidative stress and plant peroxidases
patterns.context: Discusses POD, hydrogen peroxide, and environmental stress responses in plants.

4_1286.description: 激活分散于医学与生物学术语、研究回顾词“previously”、数学表述、专利原理、名单标题及商务邮件等语境；没有能覆盖全部段落的共同主题。

patterns.name: previously 与回顾性叙述
patterns.context: 科学或医学叙述中回顾此前的研究、要求或发现；有时与较长的专业术语同现。
patterns.domain: 医学、生命科学及相关摘要

patterns.name: 兴趣与人口福利
patterns.context: “interest”描述对某一群体及其人口特征、福利的关注。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目或社会研究文字

patterns.name: 集合补集的逻辑改写
patterns.context: 数学问答中将集合关系改写为逻辑否定。

patterns.name: 电子秤工作原理
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述称重模块所依据的工作原理。

patterns.name: 除法余数题
patterns.context: 连续列出整数除法或求余数的问题，夹有数字与换行。

patterns.name: 写实艺术家名单
patterns.context: 介绍画廊展出的作品，并逐行列举艺术家；“Close”处激活突出。

patterns.name: 平滑肌、整合素与气道反应
patterns.context: 描述小鼠特定细胞中缺失整合素后的气道反应和肺切片结果。

patterns.name: 北欧能源活动邀请
patterns.context: 邮件转发来自奥斯陆办公室的邀请，并称活动影响力很高。

patterns.name: 俄勒冈医院目录标题
patterns.context: 维基百科列表条目的标题与开头。
patterns.domain: 维基百科地理或医疗目录

patterns.name: 晶状体及白内障术后视力
patterns.context: 讨论人工晶状体与白内障术后近视力或眼镜需求。

patterns.name: 氧化应激与植物过氧化物
patterns.context: 讨论植物中 POD、过氧化氢及环境胁迫响应。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: line breaks, tags, and code structure are prominent; court recurs in FreeLaw, alongside evidence/conditional words and layout traces. Patent technical passages and several numeric and symbolic triggers lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Line breaks or line-initial positions
patterns.context: The newline itself or text immediately following it is marked; this occurs across multiple passages, often alongside line wrapping or pagination in code and legal text.

patterns.name: XML/HTML tags and structured markup
patterns.context: Occurs near tag names, attributes, or closing tags, including XML- and HTML-style structures; activations also fall near tag contents.

patterns.name: Types, paths, and index structures in code
patterns.context: Marks occur in Scala type definitions and StackExchange explanations of array indices and shapes; the shared feature is code syntax or index/type expressions, but the precise trigger is not fully consistent.

patterns.name: court in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in legal opinions or judgment narratives, referring to a court; the word has strong activation in two passages.

patterns.name: Conditional/evidence expressions in legal text
patterns.context: Involves the application of legal rules, evidence, or statements of fact; includes different words besides court, so it cannot be identified as a single narrow trigger.

patterns.name: Technical terms and electromagnetic principles
patterns.context: Occurs separately in descriptions of memory technology and the electromagnetic force-compensation principle in electronic scales; the technical explanatory style is shared, but the trigger words differ.

patterns.name: NamedNodeMap identifier
patterns.context: In an HTML table code example, the initial segment of the interface name NamedNodeMap is strongly marked; other marks cluster around tags and line breaks.

patterns.name: Numbers and delimiters
patterns.context: Numbers, parentheses, or index-related symbols appear in legal citations, code, and mathematical explanations, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Pagination and indentation in legal layout
patterns.context: Weak activations occur near page breaks, indentation, and split words in case text; these may reflect PDF/OCR layout traces.
