4_1286.description: 激活模式分散：换行、标签与代码结构较明显；FreeLaw 中 court 反复突出，另有证据/条件词及排版痕迹。专利技术段和若干数字、符号触发缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: 换行或行首位置
patterns.context: 换行符本身或其后紧接文本被标记；在多段中出现，常伴随代码、法律文本的行折叠或分页格式。

patterns.name: XML/HTML 标签与结构化标记
patterns.context: 出现在标签名、属性或闭合标签附近，包含 XML、HTML 风格结构；激活也落在标签内容附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的类型、路径与索引结构
patterns.context: 标记出现在 Scala 类型定义及 StackExchange 对数组索引、形状的说明中；共同点是代码语法或索引/类型表达，但具体触发不完全一致。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 court
patterns.context: 出现在法律意见或判决叙述中，指法院；此词在两个片段中强激活。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的条件/证据表达
patterns.context: 涉及法律规则适用、证据或事实陈述；除 court 外还包含不同词语，不能确定为同一窄触发。

patterns.name: 技术名词及电磁原理
patterns.context: 分别出现在存储器技术背景和电子秤电磁力补偿原理的说明中；共享技术说明文体，但触发词并不一致。

patterns.name: NamedNodeMap 标识符
patterns.context: HTML 表格代码示例中，接口名 NamedNodeMap 的首段被强烈标记；其余标记集中在标签与换行。
patterns.domain: GitHub 技术文档/代码示例

patterns.name: 数字及分隔符
patterns.context: 数字、括号或索引相关符号在法律引文、代码和数学说明中均出现，未显示一致语义条件。

patterns.name: 法律排版中的分页与缩进
patterns.context: 判例文本中的分页符、缩进及被断开的单词附近出现较弱激活；可能反映 PDF/OCR 排版痕迹。

en.description: Activations often fall on arguments, definitions, and logical transitions following formulas in mathematics papers, especially alongside sets, matrices, coordinates, and LaTeX notation; a few domain-specific cases involve XML build configuration and physics/biology terms.

patterns.name: Introductions and explanations after formulas/symbols
patterns.context: After a mathematical symbol, formula, or definition, introduces a conclusion, property, or notation explanation; often occurs in complete English sentences
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers, StackExchange mathematics answers

patterns.name: Conditional clauses and logical transitions
patterns.context: Logical connectives in conditional, corollary, or case-based arguments, usually near formulas and mathematical objects

patterns.name: Sets/objects denoted by A and coordinate or index structures in formulas
patterns.context: Objects such as sets, matrices, or operators denoted by A, accompanied by coordinates, powers, indices, or linear-space notation

patterns.name: Paper notation and mathematical layout boundaries
patterns.context: Near LaTeX math environments, theorem labels, section-style notation explanations, or citation markers

patterns.name: Specific XML/MSBuild configuration markers
patterns.context: Near attribute conditions and build configuration strings in XML project files

patterns.name: Specialized terms in physical/biological materials
patterns.context: Describes stealth structures or the physical process of lasers acting on lipid molecules, with variables and units interspersed

patterns.name: Isolated Markov chain terminology
patterns.context: States the chain's irreducibility and its properties after a formula

patterns.name: Informal statement of a statistical distance definition
patterns.context: First states that a standard definition is used, then expresses distribution distance in terms of events and probabilities

4_1286.concept: 数学符号上下文中的论证衔接
4_1286.description: 激活常落在数学论文中公式后的论证、定义和逻辑衔接处，尤其伴随集合、矩阵、坐标及 LaTeX 记号；另有 XML 构建配置和物理/生物术语等少数领域特例。

patterns.name: 公式/符号后的引出与说明
patterns.trigger: “there is a coordinate”, “it follows that”, “we also have”, “denote”, “We say that”
patterns.context: 数学符号、公式或定义之后，引出结论、性质或记号说明；常见于完整英文句子中
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文、StackExchange 数学回答

patterns.name: 条件从句与逻辑衔接
patterns.trigger: “If such a Markov chain is irreducible, then”, “In particular”, “Thus”, “Second, if”
patterns.context: 条件、推论或分情况论证中的逻辑连接词，附近通常有公式与数学对象

patterns.name: 公式中的集合/对象 A 与坐标或索引结构
patterns.context: 集合、矩阵、算子等以 A 表示的对象，伴随坐标、幂、索引或线性空间记号

patterns.name: 论文记号与数学排版边界
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学环境、定理标签、章节式记号说明或引用标记附近

patterns.name: 特定 XML/MSBuild 配置标记
patterns.context: XML 项目文件中属性条件与构建配置字符串附近

patterns.name: 物理/生物材料中的专门术语
patterns.context: 描述隐身结构或激光作用于脂质分子的物理过程，夹杂变量与单位

patterns.name: 独立的马尔可夫链术语
patterns.context: 公式后陈述链的不可约性及其性质

patterns.name: 统计距离定义的口语化陈述
patterns.trigger: “We use a standard definition”, “We say that two distributions”
patterns.context: 先说明采用标准定义，再用事件与概率表达分布距离
patterns.domain: 理论计算机科学/概率论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across whitespace, line breaks, punctuation, and text-structure boundaries, and also involve common function words, subword fragments, and numeric symbols; they span domains and styles, with no stable topic word or single semantic field.

patterns.name: Non-contiguous whitespace and layout spacing
patterns.context: Unusually long spaces, line breaks, or layout spacing between words or at line beginnings; activations fall on whitespace tokens, often alongside other punctuation and word fragments.
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including legal, academic, web, code, and email text

patterns.name: Punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Punctuation, parentheses, arrows, braces, and line-break boundaries in sentences or code; sometimes co-occurs with nearby whitespace.
patterns.domain: Prose, mathematical typesetting, source code, and LaTeX

patterns.name: General function words and phrase continuation
patterns.context: Common English function words occur in grammatical connections, conditions, explanations, or requests within sentences; no fixed word or collocation recurs across all examples.
patterns.domain: Academic discussion, encyclopedias, Q&A, emails, and legal narratives

patterns.name: Subwords within words and technical identifiers
patterns.context: Internal fragments of words or identifiers, especially in compounds, underscore naming, and technical terms; triggers are sporadic.
patterns.domain: Academic text, technical documentation, and code

patterns.name: Numeric values and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Years, mathematical expressions, or numbers appear in explanatory text and formulas.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic historical entries, academic mathematics text

patterns.name: Incidental lexical items
patterns.context: These words occur in only one context and do not show a stable shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Web plugin Q&A, historical narration, business emails

4_1286.description: 激活分散于空白、换行、标点和文本结构边界，也涉及常见功能词、词内片段及数字符号；跨领域、跨文体，没有稳定主题词或单一语义场。

patterns.name: 非连续空白与排版间距
patterns.context: 在单词之间或行首出现异常长空白、换行或排版间距；激活落在空白 token 上，常与其他标点、词片段同时出现。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括法律文本、学术文本、网页、代码和邮件

patterns.name: 标点和结构边界
patterns.context: 句子或代码中的标点、括号、箭头、花括号及换行边界；有时与相邻空白共同出现。
patterns.domain: 散文、数学排版、源代码和 LaTeX

patterns.name: 通用功能词与短语续接
patterns.context: 常见英语功能词出现在句内语法连接、条件、说明或请求表达中；未见某个固定词或搭配贯穿所有例子。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、百科、问答、邮件及法律叙述

patterns.name: 词内子词与技术标识符片段
patterns.context: 词语或标识符的内部片段，尤其在复合词、下划线命名和技术术语中；触发较零散。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、技术文档与代码

patterns.name: 数值与数学符号
patterns.context: 年份、数学表达式或编号出现在说明性文本和公式中。
patterns.domain: 百科历史条目、学术数学文本

patterns.name: 偶发词项
patterns.context: 这些词只在单个语境中出现，未显示稳定的共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页插件问答、历史叙述、商务邮件

en.description: Activations occur across word-final or internal fragments of long words, whitespace and punctuation boundaries, and sporadically in date/time expressions, legal actions, regulatory compounds, entertainment descriptions, and code structures. No clear cross-domain rule emerges; some high activations fall on spaces or word endings.

patterns.name: Word-final or suffix fragments in long words
patterns.context: Activations often fall on the endings, suffixes, or internal fragments of longer words; this is especially evident in passages 1, 3, and 4. Not all instances can be reduced to the same morphological rule.
patterns.domain: Natural language across domains and legal text

patterns.name: Spaces or layout gaps
patterns.context: Activations mark interword whitespace or layout gaps, especially in email bodies, legal materials, and around code; whitespace itself may trigger jointly with following words or formatting boundaries.
patterns.domain: Emails, legal documents, code, and mixed-format text

patterns.name: Commas and nearby positions
patterns.context: Commas are prominent in business emails and also occur in other texts; punctuation alone does not explain the other high activations.

patterns.name: Date and time expressions
patterns.context: Moderate to strong activations occur near dates, years, days of the week, or durations; it is unclear whether this is an independent trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Sports news, music entries, and legal narratives

patterns.name: Action-word fragments in legal records
patterns.context: Activations occur near words related to bodily actions, movement, and testimony in legal narratives or trial records; commonality among these examples is limited.

patterns.name: Time frames and rulemaking-related words
patterns.context: Activations occur near compounds or word boundaries related to rulemaking and time frames in energy regulatory briefings.

patterns.name: Types and punctuation boundaries in code
patterns.context: In C# declarations, structural positions such as square brackets, identifier fragments, underscores, and colons activate, but intensity is scattered and difficult to unify with natural-language patterns.

patterns.name: Evaluative words in entertainment show descriptions
patterns.context: Near time words and evaluative or action words in the title or promotional description of a WWE show recap.

patterns.name: Entity fragments in song titles and album information
patterns.context: Activations occur around copulas, years, and entity names in song cover and album descriptions; no clear consistent semantic trigger is evident.

4_1286.description: 激活分布于长词末尾或内部片段、空白与标点边界，也零散出现在日期时间、法律动作、监管复合词、娱乐描述和代码结构中。跨域一致规则不明显，部分高激活落在空格或词尾。

patterns.name: 长词内部的词尾或后缀
patterns.context: 激活常落在较长单词的末尾、后缀或词内片段；段1、3、4尤其明显。但并非所有实例都能归结为同一词形规则。
patterns.domain: 多领域自然语言及法律文本

patterns.name: 空格或版式间隔
patterns.context: 激活标在词间空白或排版间隔上，尤其出现在邮件正文、法律材料及代码周边；空白本身可能与后续词或格式边界共同触发。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文书、代码及混合格式文本

patterns.name: 逗号及其邻近位置
patterns.context: 逗号在商务邮件中突出出现，也见于其他文本；单靠标点无法解释其余高激活。

patterns.name: 日期与时间表达
patterns.context: 日期、年份、星期或时长等时间表达附近出现中等至较强激活；是否为独立触发模式并不确定。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、音乐条目及法律叙述

patterns.name: 法律记录中的动作词片段
patterns.context: 法律叙述或庭审记录中，身体动作、移动及证言相关词附近出现激活；这些例子之间的共同性有限。

patterns.name: 时间框架及规则制定相关词
patterns.context: 能源监管简报中，规则制定、时间框架等复合词或词边界附近激活。

patterns.name: 代码中的类型与标点边界
patterns.context: C# 声明中方括号、标识符片段、下划线和冒号等结构位置有激活，但强度分散，难与自然语言模式统一。

patterns.name: 娱乐节目描述中的评价词
patterns.context: WWE 节目回顾的标题或宣传性描述中，时间词及评价、动作类词附近激活。

patterns.name: 歌曲名及专辑信息中的实体片段
patterns.context: 歌曲翻唱与专辑介绍中，系词、年份及实体名称周围出现激活；未见明确一致的语义触发词。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: tenure and duration of service; legal wording about restitution/fines, interests, duties, and programs; cosmetic lip plumping; sports adjectives; several within-word substrings; and evaluations of startup work. There is no single stable semantic pattern; some legal fragments may share a formal narrative style.

patterns.name: Duration expressions with tenure
patterns.context: Indicates the length of time someone has served at an institution or in a position; activation falls on tenure, often preceded by a duration

patterns.name: Restitution fines with monetary amounts in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears in court rulings or appeals, describing a defendant’s monetary penalty or restitution obligation

patterns.name: Interests recorded in legal texts
patterns.context: Describes a trust beneficiary’s or party’s interests in property or deeds

patterns.name: Duties described in legal texts
patterns.context: Specifies an employee’s duties in descriptions of employment or corporate relationships

patterns.name: Take-home programs or drug programs
patterns.context: Concerns a program suspension, internal review, or related procedure; activation falls on a component of take-home
patterns.domain: Legal texts, medical or regulatory contexts

patterns.name: Emphatic adjective coordination
patterns.context: Describes the characteristics of team players in sports coverage, with multiple adjectives in a series

patterns.name: Appearance and lip-plumping products
patterns.context: A beauty blog discusses lipstick making lips look fuller

patterns.name: Subword activations within or near the boundaries of English words
patterns.context: Triggering fragments occur at word endings or within compound components; no stable semantic or contextual conditions are evident

patterns.name: Frustrating startup work experiences
patterns.context: The author describes working at a startup, with positive and negative evaluations side by side

4_1286.description: 激活模式分散：tenure 与任期时长、法律文本中的赔偿金/权益/职责/项目用语、美妆丰唇、体育形容词，以及若干词内子串和创业工作评价。没有单一稳定语义；部分法律片段可能共享正式叙述文体。

patterns.name: tenure 的时长表达
patterns.trigger: « tenure»，常与数字及“-year”相邻，如“12-year tenure”“10-year-long tenure”
patterns.context: 表示某人在机构或职位上持续任职的时间；激活落在 tenure 上，前面常有任期长度

patterns.name: 法律文本中带金额的 restitution fine
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决或上诉文本中，说明被告的金钱处罚或赔偿义务

patterns.name: 法律文本中记录的 interests
patterns.context: 描述信托受益人或当事方在财产、契据中的权益

patterns.name: 法律文本中描述职责
patterns.context: 雇佣或公司关系叙述中，说明员工承担的职责

patterns.name: take-home 程序或药物项目
patterns.context: 涉及项目暂停、内部审查或相关程序；激活在 take-home 的组成部分
patterns.domain: 法律文本，医疗或监管语境

patterns.name: 形容词的强调性并列
patterns.context: 体育报道中描述球队球员的特征，多个形容词并列

patterns.name: 身体外观与丰唇产品
patterns.context: 美妆博客谈论唇膏使嘴唇显得更丰满

patterns.name: 英文词内部或边界附近的子词激活
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在词尾或复合词成分中，未见稳定的语义或上下文条件

patterns.name: 创业工作体验中的 frustrating
patterns.context: 作者描述创业公司的工作体验，正负评价并列

en.concept: Evaluative nouns and formal duties, authority
en.description: The strongest and most recurrent pattern is things in evaluative contexts; there are also activations for lip/product effects in beauty descriptions, duties and obligations, and power and tenure in political or professional contexts.

patterns.name: Evaluative collocations with things
patterns.context: things occurs in about phrases, preceded by an evaluative modifier, introducing the merits of a place, person, product, or service; e.g. “good things about Kasabian”“best things about Las Animas”“smart things to say”“great things about Google+”“two important things”。
patterns.domain: Reviews, travel introductions, music reviews, technology marketing, academic writing

patterns.name: Descriptions of appearance and physical features
patterns.context: Describes the appearance of lips and changes brought about by lip-plumping products; the same passage also contains pluming qualities, possibly related to appearance or product effects.

patterns.name: Duties or responsibilities
patterns.context: The noun refers to someone's work responsibilities or formal occupational duties; examples occur in employment-duty legal materials and a political report about senators' duties.

patterns.name: Power and tenure
patterns.context: Discusses emergency powers that can be used to take action, or the length of time someone holds a position; both occur in specific institutional or professional contexts.

4_1286.concept: 评价性名词及正式职责、权力
4_1286.description: 最强且重复的模式是评价性语境中的 things；另对美容描述中的唇部／产品效果、职责义务，以及政治或职业语境中的权力和任期有激活。

patterns.name: things 的评价性搭配
patterns.context: things 位于 about 短语中，前面带有评价性限定，介绍某地、人物、产品或服务的优点；如 “good things about Kasabian”“best things about Las Animas”“smart things to say”“great things about Google+”“two important things”。
patterns.domain: 评论、旅游介绍、音乐评论、科技营销、学术写作

patterns.name: 外观与身体特征描述
patterns.context: 描述唇部外观、丰唇产品带来的变化；同段还出现 pluming qualities，可能与外观或产品效果相关。
patterns.domain: 美容产品评论／生活方式文本

patterns.name: 职责或责任
patterns.context: 名词指某人的工作责任或正式职务义务；分别处于法律材料中的雇佣职责、政治报道中的参议员职责语境。

patterns.name: 权力与任期
patterns.context: 谈及可用于采取行动的紧急权力，或某人在某职位上的任职期限；两处均为具体制度或职业语境。

en.concept: Nouns in evaluative, positional, or quantitative contexts
en.description: Activations cover tenure length, duties and positions, positive evaluations or liking, placement, and multiplicative comparisons. Several evaluative collocations before “things” are similar, but the other patterns differ considerably.

patterns.name: Tenure/service duration
patterns.context: Years modify “tenure,” describing a period of employment or service

patterns.name: Duties, responsibilities, or job performance
patterns.context: Describes a position, duties, or employee work arrangements; in some segments, only the job status appears in context

patterns.name: Liked things/advantages
patterns.context: Evaluates something or lists liked and appreciated aspects; “things” appears near the trigger
patterns.domain: Music reviews, marketing articles, forums, personal dating profiles

patterns.name: Location or destination
patterns.context: Involves someone being assigned a place, or a work/content being released; activation focuses on “place”

patterns.name: Multiplicative comparison
patterns.context: The quantitative phrase “times as …” expresses a multiplicative comparison

4_1286.concept: 名词及其评价、职位或数量语境
4_1286.description: 激活涵盖任职年限、职责与职位、对事物的好评或喜爱、位置安排，以及倍数比较。多处“things”前的评价性搭配相似，但其余模式差异较大。

patterns.name: tenure/任职时长
patterns.context: 年数作定语修饰“tenure”，描述任职或服务经历

patterns.name: 职责、责任或履职
patterns.context: 描述职位、职责或员工工作安排；有的段落只在上下文中出现职位身份

patterns.name: 喜欢的事物/优点
patterns.context: 评价某事物或列举喜欢、欣赏的方面；触发附近有“things”
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、营销文章、论坛、个人交友简介

patterns.name: 位置或去处
patterns.context: 涉及某人被安排到某个位置，或作品/内容发布；激活集中在“place”

patterns.name: 倍数比较
patterns.context: 数量短语“times as …”表达倍数比较

en.description: Activations are most concentrated on things: it refers generally to matters, merits, or preferences, as well as personal belongings. There are also sporadic activations on duty terms duties/responsibilities, time and multiplicative expressions, and a few dates, punctuation marks, and proper-name fragments, with no unified syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Semantic uses of things
patterns.context: thing/things is a general noun, modified by an evaluative or preference word and often followed by about/of; describes preferences, merits, or matters.
patterns.domain: Blogs, reviews, personal profiles, and other informal text

patterns.name: things as personal belongings
patterns.context: things refers to someone's personal belongings to pack up or take, rather than abstract matters.

patterns.name: responsibilities in the sense of duties
patterns.context: Refers to someone's job responsibilities in legal text.

patterns.name: duties in the sense of responsibilities
patterns.context: In a public-office or professional-responsibility context, means carrying out one's duties.

patterns.name: Time spans and multiplicative units
patterns.context: Numbers modify time units or times to express term length or a multiplicative degree; the specific activated words differ.

patterns.name: Time words in column headings
patterns.context: Date/frequency words in a blog column introduction indicate a regular publishing schedule.

patterns.name: Punctuation and structural positions
patterns.context: Commas and periods in a list of committee names also activate, with no clear semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Local activations in titles or proper names
patterns.context: Occurs only in individual proper names, titles, or subword fragments, without a stable shared context.
patterns.domain: Personal dating profiles, committee names, etc.

patterns.name: Transcription/formatting residue
patterns.context: Possibly truncated words or layout/line-break residue; the semantic trigger cannot be determined from context.

4_1286.concept: 名词性事项与职责表达
4_1286.description: 激活最集中于 things：泛指事项、优点或喜好，也包括个人物品；另对职责词 duties/responsibilities、时间与倍数表达及少数日期、标点、专名片段有零散激活，未见统一句法条件。

patterns.name: things 的语义性用法
patterns.context: thing/things 作泛指名词，前有评价或偏好词修饰，常接 about/of；描述喜好、优点或事项。
patterns.domain: 博客、评论、个人资料等非正式文字

patterns.name: things 作个人物品
patterns.context: things 指某人要收拾或拿走的随身物品，而非抽象事项。

patterns.name: responsibilities 的职责义
patterns.context: 法律文本中指某人的工作职责，后接职责内容。

patterns.name: duties 的职责义
patterns.context: 公职或职业责任语境，表示履行职务。

patterns.name: 时间跨度与倍数单位
patterns.context: 数字修饰时间单位或 times，表达任期长度或程度倍数；被激活的具体词并不相同。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、环境政策文本

patterns.name: 栏目标题中的时间词
patterns.context: 博客栏目介绍中，日期/频率词用于安排定期发布。

patterns.name: 标点与结构位置
patterns.context: 委员会名称列举中的逗号、句点也出现激活，缺乏明确语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的局部激活
patterns.context: 只在个别专名、标题或词内片段出现，未显示稳定的共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 个人交友简介、委员会名称等

patterns.name: 转录/格式残留
patterns.context: 疑似截断词或排版/换行残留，无法从上下文确定语义触发因素。

en.description: Most activations focus on things/thing: these often occur with evaluative words such as good, favorite, great, best, and important, or introduce a topic with about/of, referring to things being discussed or evaluated. Other scattered activations occur in contexts such as duties and areas and are difficult to group into the same pattern.

patterns.name: Evaluative/emphatic expressions with things
patterns.context: “Things” refers generally to things worth praising, liking, or discussing, or to important matters; it often appears with a modifier before things or in a structure followed by about/of to introduce a topic.
patterns.domain: Blogs, reviews, travel descriptions, marketing copy, technical discussions, and other styles

patterns.name: Topic/focus expression with thing
patterns.context: Singular thing refers to the speaker’s most important point of focus or concern; it is modified by a possessive and a superlative, and appears in a context of experience or reflection.

patterns.name: Collocation “areas of expertise”
patterns.context: Areas refers to fields of expertise, modified by major and delimited by of expertise; this is not the things usage for generally positive things.

patterns.name: Senatorial duties expression
patterns.context: Senatorial modifies duties to describe public office responsibilities; this differs from the things/thing structures in other segments.

4_1286.description: 多数激活集中在 things/thing：它常与 good、favorite、great、best、important 等评价词搭配，或由 about/of 引出主题，表示被讨论或评价的事物。另有零散激活落在 duties、areas 等语境，难以归入同一模式。

patterns.name: things 的评价/强调表达
patterns.trigger: “things”及其后紧邻的程度、评价或关联成分，如 “good things about”、“favorite things”、“great things about”、“best things about”、“important things”
patterns.context: “things”用于泛指值得称道、喜爱、重要或可讨论的事物；常出现在 things 前有修饰语，或后接 about/of 引出主题的结构中。
patterns.domain: 博客、评论、旅游介绍、营销文案、技术讨论等多种文体

patterns.name: thing 的话题/重点表达
patterns.context: thing 用单数，指个人认为最重要的关注点或事项；由物主代词和最高级修饰，并置于经历或反思语境中。

patterns.name: areas of expertise 搭配
patterns.context: areas 指专业领域，受 major 修饰并由 of expertise 限定；不是泛指好事物的 things 用法。

patterns.name: 参议员职责表达
patterns.context: senatorial 修饰 duties，描述公职职责；与其他段的 things/thing 结构不同。

en.description: Activations fall on words such as things, affairs, season, sessions, work/works, duties, roles, place, and Ohio, covering general things, affairs, seasons, training, works, duties, roles, status, and case citations; they span multiple genres with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: General things or categories
patterns.context: The noun things refers to hobbies, benefits, topics, or objects, usually appearing after a modifier or in evaluations of a category of things.

patterns.name: Owning or conducting business
patterns.context: In legal contexts, refers to an organization’s affairs, preceded by the modifier business.

patterns.name: Season performance
patterns.context: Sports reporting discusses a team’s results or performance in a given season.

patterns.name: Boxing rounds and matchups
patterns.context: Describes a boxer’s training sparring and compares it with official matches.

patterns.name: Work or works
patterns.context: Refers to an individual’s creative or professional works, including literary and screen works.

patterns.name: Duties
patterns.context: Describes a public official’s duties and their balance with personal life.

patterns.name: Roles
patterns.context: Introduces an actor’s best-known acting roles.

patterns.name: Position
patterns.context: Discusses someone’s standing or position in boxing.

patterns.name: State name
patterns.context: A state name in a legal case citation, followed by reporter volume and page information.

4_1286.description: 激活落在 things、affairs、season、sessions、work/works、duties、roles、place、Ohio 等词上，涵盖泛指事物、事务、赛季、训练、作品、职责、角色、地位及判例引文；跨多种文体，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 泛指事物或类别
patterns.context: 名词 things 指爱好、好处、主题或事物，通常出现在修饰语之后或表达对某类事物的评价时。

patterns.name: 拥有或经营事务
patterns.context: 法律语境中指某组织的事务，前有 business 修饰。

patterns.name: 赛季表现
patterns.context: 体育报道中谈球队在某赛季的成绩或表现。

patterns.name: 拳击回合与对阵
patterns.context: 描述拳击手的训练对练，并与正式比赛作比较。

patterns.name: 工作或作品
patterns.context: 指个人创作或专业作品，分别涉及文学作品与影视作品。

patterns.name: 职责
patterns.context: 描述公职人员的职责及其与个人生活之间的平衡。

patterns.name: 角色
patterns.context: 介绍演员最知名的表演角色。

patterns.name: 地点
patterns.context: 讨论某人在拳击领域中的地位或位置。

patterns.name: 州名
patterns.context: 法律判例引文中的州名，后接判例集卷页信息。

en.description: Primarily activates on the noun things/thing, often following evaluative or preference modifiers such as good, greatest, favorite, important, biggest, and best; also seen in personal-interest expressions and sporadic anomalous collocations.

patterns.name: Modifiers before the noun things
patterns.context: Activation falls on things/thing; it is often preceded by an evaluative adjective and may be followed by a complement such as about.
patterns.domain: Reviews, news, blogs, explanatory writing, etc.

patterns.name: Everyday interests and personal preferences
patterns.context: Personal profiles or first-person narratives discuss interests, preferences, or age; the trigger form in [8] differs from the main pattern and may only be semantically related.
patterns.domain: Personal profiles, accounts of gaming experiences

patterns.name: Unexplained collocations
patterns.context: [4] activates on powers, which does not fit the things pattern; in [1], things is a strong trigger within the same segment, but “a couple of” may also contribute to the activation.

4_1286.concept: 评价性或偏好性的事物
4_1286.description: 主要对 things/thing 作名词、常见于 good、greatest、favorite、important、biggest、best 等评价或偏好修饰语之后时激活；另见个人兴趣表达及零散异常搭配。

patterns.name: 名词 things 前的修饰语
patterns.trigger: “good things”[1][3]、“good things about”[3]、“greatest things”[5]、“French things”[6]、“important things”[7]、“biggest thing”[9]、“best things”[10]
patterns.context: 激活落在 things/thing 上；前面常有评价性形容词，后面可接 about 等补语。
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻、博客、说明文等

patterns.name: 日常兴趣与个人偏好
patterns.context: 个人简介或第一人称叙述中，谈兴趣、偏好或年龄；[8] 的触发形式与主模式不同，仅可能是语义关联。
patterns.domain: 个人简介、游戏体验叙述

patterns.name: 未充分解释的搭配
patterns.context: [4] 激活在 powers 上，与 things 模式不符；[1] 中同一段内 things 是强触发词，但“a couple of”可能也参与激活。

en.description: The most stable pattern activates thing/things, especially when modified by evaluative adjectives or followed by complements such as about, to do, and to say. Several other content nouns also activate sporadically, without a unified context.

patterns.name: Positive or specific content after “things”
patterns.context: The noun thing(s) heads a phrase, often modified by evaluative words such as good, smart, or enjoyable, or followed by specifications such as about/to do/to say; activation falls on things/thing.
patterns.domain: Reviews, sports news, personal profiles, blogs, and other genres

patterns.name: Additional activation of thing or domain nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls on content nouns or within noun phrases, without an obvious things trigger nearby; their connection to the main pattern is unclear.
patterns.domain: News, law, sports and entertainment, blogs, literature

4_1286.description: 最稳定的模式是激活 thing/things，尤其在评价性形容词修饰、或接 about、to do、to say 等补语时。另有若干分散的内容名词激活，缺乏统一上下文。

patterns.name: “things”后的褒义或具体内容
patterns.trigger: « things»10 about« Kasabian»；« good»3« thing»9« happens»；« things»9 to do；« smart»« things»9 to say；« all»« things»8 French；« enjoyable»« things»8
patterns.context: 名词 thing(s) 位于短语中心，常由 good、smart、enjoyable 等评价词修饰，或接 about/to do/to say 等补充说明；激活落在 things/thing 上。
patterns.domain: 评论、体育新闻、个人简介、博客等多种文体

patterns.name: 事物或领域名词的补充激活
patterns.trigger: « emergency» powers；« Fourth»…« Amendment» rights；« hardcore» history；« place»；« favorite» things
patterns.context: 激活落在内容名词或名词短语内部，周围没有明显的 thing(s) 触发；这些例子与主模式的联系不明确。
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律、体育娱乐、博客、文学

en.description: Primarily responds to wording about constitutional rights, provisions, remedies, and penalties in legal documents; scattered activations also occur on ordinal seasons/years, legislative sessions and emergency powers, and things in reviews.

patterns.name: Rights, legal provisions, and remedies
patterns.context: In legal contexts, constitutional amendments, claims of rights, or court remedies/powers appear; activation often falls on provision names and words such as rights and powers.

patterns.name: Rulings and penalty-related wording
patterns.context: Discusses sentencing in criminal cases, conditions of a penalty, or whether a ruling is reasonable; activation covers related words such as sentence and conditions.

patterns.name: Ordinal and season/year expressions
patterns.context: Numbers appear with ordinal suffixes, seasons, or date/year combinations, especially specific time markers expressed numerically.

patterns.name: Legislative sessions and emergency powers
patterns.context: Political reporting discusses a busy period in a legislative session and calls for action using emergency powers.

patterns.name: Generic reference to things
patterns.context: Things is used to refer generally to the advantages of an object being evaluated; activation focuses on things.

4_1286.concept: 法律权利与法律程序措辞
4_1286.description: 主要响应法律文书中的宪法权利、条文、救济与刑罚措辞；另对序数赛季/年份、立法会期与紧急权力、评论中的 things 有零散激活。

patterns.name: 权利、法律条文与救济
patterns.context: 法律语境中，出现宪法修正案、权利主张或法院救济/权力等法律概念；激活常落在条文名称、rights、powers 等词上。

patterns.name: 判决及刑罚相关措辞
patterns.context: 讨论刑事案件的量刑、刑罚条件或判决是否合理；激活覆盖 sentence、conditions 等相关词。

patterns.name: 序数与赛季年份表达
patterns.context: 数字与序数后缀、赛季或日期/年份组合出现时，尤其是由数字构成的具体时间标记。
patterns.domain: 体育个人介绍、新闻叙述

patterns.name: 立法期间与紧急权力
patterns.context: 政治报道中谈及立法会期的繁忙时段，以及要求动用紧急权力采取行动。

patterns.name: 事情、事物的泛指表达
patterns.context: 评价某对象时用 things 泛指其优点；该处的激活集中在 things。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论或非正式评论

en.description: Activations occur mainly on things and nearby modifiers, especially expressions that categorize, evaluate, or enumerate things; other activations occur in “7th season” and “emergency powers” in political reporting, with different triggers.

patterns.name: Enumeration of kinds of things
patterns.context: When evaluating, introducing, or listing a category of “things,” often in structures such as “things about X,” “things French,” or “things to say”; the trigger falls on “things” and adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Reviews, blogs, news, and forum posts

patterns.name: Season marked by an ordinal
patterns.context: A professional athlete announces a return, with an ordinal numeral modifying “season.”

patterns.name: Emergency powers
patterns.context: Political news quotes an official calling on a governor to use emergency powers to provide aid; the trigger is “powers,” not a things-enumeration structure.

4_1286.description: 主要激活于 things 及其邻近修饰语，尤其是对事物作类别化、评价或列举的表达；另在“7th season”和政治报道的“emergency powers”中出现，触发条件不同。

patterns.name: 东西／事物的类别枚举
patterns.trigger: “things”后接或紧邻性质、类别词，如 “good things”“cool things”“French things”“interesting things”“smart things”
patterns.context: 在评价、介绍或列举某类“things”时，常用于 “things about X”“things French” 或 “things to say” 等结构；触发位置在 “things” 及其相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 评论、博客、新闻及论坛文本

patterns.name: 序数词所标记的赛季
patterns.context: 职业运动员宣布将回归，数字序数词修饰 “season”。

patterns.name: 紧急权力
patterns.context: 政治新闻引述官员要求州长动用紧急权力提供援助；触发词是 “powers”，而非 things 枚举结构。

en.description: Most segments activate on thing/things, often in evaluative “good thing(s)” expressions, and also in biggest thing and equally important things. Four other segments activate on th, powers, and years respectively, with no unified trigger condition identified.

patterns.name: “Good thing(s)” expressions
patterns.context: When evaluating something or listing its advantages, activation falls on thing/things; good precedes it, followed by varied collocations such as happens, about, and said.
patterns.domain: Sports news, technology reviews, music reviews, Q&A discussions

patterns.name: thing(s) and its modifiers
patterns.context: thing(s) appears in conversational recollections or design suggestions, with modifiers such as biggest and equally important; good is absent.

patterns.name: Highlighted content other than thing
patterns.context: Activations fall respectively on the ordinal suffix th, powers, the year 1960, and the year 1974; the surrounding text has no thing(s) trigger structure, and the cases have no clear shared condition.
patterns.domain: Sports social text, news reports, legal documents, historical quotations

4_1286.description: 多数段落在 thing/things 上激活，常见于“good thing(s)”评价，也见于 biggest thing、equally important things。另有四段分别激活 th、powers 与年份，暂无统一触发条件。

patterns.name: “good thing(s)”表达
patterns.trigger: “One good thing happens”[1]、“the only good thing I can say”[3]、“a couple of good things about”[4]、“good things said”[8]
patterns.context: 在评价或列举某事物的优点时，激活落在 thing/things 一词上；前有 good，后接 happens、about、said 等不同搭配。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、科技评论、音乐评论、问答讨论

patterns.name: thing(s)及其限定语
patterns.context: thing(s) 出现在口语回忆或设计建议中，带有 biggest、equally important 等限定语；没有 good。
patterns.domain: 体育访谈、网页设计评论

patterns.name: thing 以外的高亮内容
patterns.context: 激活分别落在序数词后缀 th、powers、年份 1960 和年份 1974；周围没有 thing(s) 触发结构，彼此也缺乏明显共同条件。
patterns.domain: 体育社交文本、新闻报道、法律文书、历史引文

en.concept: Multiple local lexical and code patterns
en.description: Activations cluster around good thing(s) collocations, legal remedies and powers, professional season expressions, Java Map generics, and contracts and debuts after soccer transfers; other scattered items cannot be grouped.

patterns.name: “things” noun collocations
patterns.context: thing(s) follows modifiers such as good or appears in evaluative expressions such as “one good thing happens” and “a couple of good things about”; activation centers on thing(s) and nearby collocates.
patterns.domain: News and review articles, everyday language

patterns.name: Legal remedies and powers
patterns.context: Legal discussion considers whether administrative remedies have been exhausted, whether legal remedies are adequate, and the court’s exercise of equitable powers.

patterns.name: Season and career expressions
patterns.context: An athlete announces a season in their professional career and says they will return to compete; activation falls on the ordinal season expression and season.

patterns.name: Java generic Map declaration
patterns.context: Java code declares a generic Map with String or Integer keys and String values, commonly in field or local-variable declarations.

patterns.name: Map generics in entity lists
patterns.context: Java method return values, variables, or collection elements use Map generics; code also includes types such as List, ItemEntity, String, and Object.
patterns.domain: Java code and comments on StackExchange/GitHub

patterns.name: Contract and debut after a soccer transfer
patterns.context: After a player transfers to a club, they sign a multiyear contract; the narrative describes their first match and the competition round.

patterns.name: Unexplained words and fragments
patterns.context: These occur separately in rugby news, text about the Hungarian league, band reviews, dietary advice, and code comments/annotations; the visible activation tokens do not reveal a common trigger sufficient for a unified category.
patterns.domain: Sports news, reviews, health articles, and code

4_1286.concept: 多类局部词汇与代码模式
4_1286.description: 激活集中于 good thing(s) 搭配、法律救济与权力、职业赛季表达、Java Map 泛型，以及足球转会后合同和首战；另有多处零散词项无法归并。

patterns.name: “things”名词搭配
patterns.context: thing(s) 位于 good 等修饰语后，或进入“one good thing happens”“a couple of good things about”这样的评价表达；激活集中在 thing(s) 本身及其邻近搭配。
patterns.domain: 新闻与评论文章、日常表达

patterns.name: 司法救济与权力用语
patterns.context: 法律论述中讨论行政救济是否穷尽、法律救济是否充分，以及法院行使衡平权力。

patterns.name: 赛季与生涯表达
patterns.context: 宣布职业生涯某一赛季，并说明将回归参赛；激活落在序数赛季表达及 season。

patterns.name: Java 泛型映射声明
patterns.context: Java 代码中声明以 String 或 Integer 为键、String 为值的泛型 Map，常见于字段或局部变量声明。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Java 源码

patterns.name: 实体列表中的 Map 泛型
patterns.context: Java 方法返回值、变量或集合元素使用 Map 泛型；代码中还出现 List、ItemEntity、String、Object 等类型。
patterns.domain: StackExchange/GitHub 上的 Java 代码及注释

patterns.name: 足球转会后的合同与首战
patterns.context: 球员转会至俱乐部后签订多年合同，并叙述首场比赛及赛事轮次。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式足球运动员传记

patterns.name: 未解释的词汇与片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在橄榄球新闻、匈牙利联赛相关文字、乐队评论、饮食建议和代码注释/标注中；可见激活 token 未显示出足以统一归类的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、评论、健康文章及代码

en.concept: Local patterns in English noun phrases
en.description: Activations are scattered across English noun phrases, quantity expressions, and mathematical formulas; matches and benefits also recur in sports narratives, but specialized terminology, formula fragments, and isolated numerals indicate no single clear trigger word.

patterns.name: High activation in quantity words or numeric expressions
patterns.context: Numerals, quantity phrases, or numbers/variables in formulas occur nearby; some instances also include a following noun.

patterns.name: match in sports narratives
patterns.context: In accounts of sports figures or teams, match means a game and often co-occurs with words such as first, played, and promotion.

patterns.name: thing(s) referring to matters, benefits, or outcomes
patterns.context: thing(s) refers to benefits worth mentioning or things that happen; occurs in everyday evaluative or advisory narratives.

patterns.name: Determiners and compound expressions before nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls on a local sequence in a noun phrase consisting of a determiner, quantity/modifier, and head noun; meanings vary by domain.

patterns.name: Domain terms or structural words in technical texts
patterns.context: Local fragments in technical terms or mathematical expressions; beyond common noun phrases, no specific technical term is consistently shared.

4_1286.concept: 英语名词短语局部模式
4_1286.description: 激活分散于英语名词短语、数量表达和数学式中；体育叙述里的比赛与好处也有重复，但专业术语、公式片段及孤立数词显示并无单一明确触发词。

patterns.name: 数量词或数字表达中的高激活
patterns.context: 数词、数量短语或公式中的数字/变量相邻出现；有些实例还伴随其后的名词。

patterns.name: 比赛叙述中的 match
patterns.context: 在体育人物或球队的经历叙述中，match 指比赛，常与 first、played、promotion 等词共现。

patterns.name: 事情、好处或成果的 thing(s)
patterns.context: thing(s) 指值得一提的好处或发生的事情；出现于评价、建议等日常叙述中。

patterns.name: 名词前的限定词与复合表达
patterns.context: 激活落在名词短语中由限定词、数量/修饰成分与中心名词组成的局部序列；含义随文域变化。

patterns.name: 专业文本中的领域术语或结构词
patterns.context: 专业术语或数学表达式中的局部片段；除常见名词短语外，没有稳定共享的具体术语。
patterns.domain: 科研资助文本、理论物理

en.concept: Broad responses to syntax and content words
en.description: Activations span sentence-final punctuation, common connective function words, and words conveying events, outcomes, or research content across genres. A few numeric time expressions and domain terms also activate, with no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-closing punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation appears at the end of sentences or clauses, with activations especially around commas and periods; sometimes it may cross subword boundaries.

patterns.name: Function words and verb collocations
patterns.context: Common function words or auxiliaries occur in syntactic connections, clause introductions, and verb phrases; the pattern is not very specific.

patterns.name: Key nouns in events or entries
patterns.context: Nouns in noun phrases activate when describing experiences, games, research functions, or research findings.
patterns.domain: Personal narratives, sports reporting, academic text

patterns.name: Key action or outcome words
patterns.context: Verbs and nominal outcome words activate when narrating events, people’s roles, or institutional/legal effects.
patterns.domain: News, entertainment, political and legal text

patterns.name: Numeric and time expressions
patterns.context: Numbers, years, and time units appear in personal experiences or sports/transfer timelines.

patterns.name: Insufficiently explained local collocations
patterns.context: These words activate locally in their respective contexts, but the samples do not establish common semantic or syntactic conditions.

4_1286.concept: 广泛的句法与内容词响应
4_1286.description: 激活分布于句末标点、常见连接功能词，以及多文体中承载事件、结果或研究内容的词；少数数字时间表达和领域词也被激活，缺乏单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 句子收束标点
patterns.context: 标点出现在句子或分句的收束位置，尤以逗号、句号前后激活；有时可能是跨子词边界

patterns.name: 功能词与动词搭配
patterns.context: 常见功能词或助动词出现在句法连接、从句引入及动词短语中，模式不够专一

patterns.name: 事件或条目中的关键名词
patterns.context: 描述经历、比赛、研究功能或研究发现时，名词短语中的名词被激活
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、体育报道、学术文本

patterns.name: 关键动作或结果词
patterns.context: 叙述事件发展、人物角色或制度/法律效力时，动词及名词性结果词出现激活
patterns.domain: 新闻、娱乐、政治法律文本

patterns.name: 数字与时间表达
patterns.context: 数字、年份及时间单位出现在个人经历或赛事/转会时间线中

patterns.name: 未充分解释的局部搭配
patterns.context: 这些词在各自语境中局部激活，但无法从样本确认共同的语义或句法条件
patterns.domain: 娱乐、食品科学、法律、商业

en.description: Activation is scattered: three segments occur in “first match” match narratives; the rest appear in formula typesetting, legal page numbers, JSON children fields, personal residence duration, and actor-role narratives. Even within formula segments, there is no single clear trigger word.

patterns.name: First match
patterns.context: Adjacent to the ordinal first and the noun match, in narratives about “someone’s/team’s first match”; the trigger window also covers surrounding match narratives.

patterns.name: Superscripts or formula delimiters in technical equations
patterns.context: Specific positions between formula commands, fractions, or symbols in mathematical typesetting; no match to the ordinary-language first match structure is observed.

patterns.name: Page-number markers in legal records
patterns.context: Bracketed, asterisk-style page-number markers near the bottom of legal document pages, surrounded by records, accounts, and page breaks.

patterns.name: Nested JSON children field
patterns.context: Repeated children keys, arrays, and nested objects in JSON; stronger markers cluster around key names and structural symbols.

patterns.name: Life stages and months
patterns.context: Personal narratives describing approximately how long someone lived in a place, reflecting on life and residence.

patterns.name: Breakthrough role
patterns.context: Interviews or profiles describing how a female actor landed a breakthrough role; activation is stronger near role.

patterns.name: Words in segmented formula typesetting
patterns.context: Formula segments consisting of integrals, exponential functions, and mathematical font commands; strong activation falls on formula-typesetting tokens.

4_1286.description: 激活模式分散：三段在“first match”比赛叙述中出现；其余分别落在公式排版、法律页码、JSON children 字段、个人居住时长和演员角色叙述。公式段内部也并非同一明确触发词。

patterns.name: 比赛首场
patterns.context: 紧邻表示首次出赛的序数词 first 与名词 match，出现在“某人/球队的首场比赛”叙述中；触发窗口还涵盖周围赛事叙述。
patterns.domain: 体育人物传记、维基百科

patterns.name: 技术公式中的上标或公式分隔符
patterns.context: 数学公式排版中，公式命令、分式或符号之间的特定位置；未见与普通自然语言的 first match 结构相同。

patterns.name: 法律记录中的页码标记
patterns.context: 法律文书页面底部附近的方括号星号式页码标记，周围有记录、账目及分页符。

patterns.name: JSON 嵌套 children 字段
patterns.context: JSON 中反复出现 children 键、数组及嵌套对象；较强标记集中在键名与结构符号附近。

patterns.name: 生活阶段与月份
patterns.context: 个人叙述中以约数描述在某地居住的时长，谈及回顾生活和居住地。

patterns.name: 突破角色
patterns.context: 人物采访或简介中叙述女性演员如何获得突破性角色，role 附近激活较强。

patterns.name: 分段公式排版词
patterns.context: 积分、指数函数及数学字体命令构成的公式片段，强激活落在公式排版 token 上。

en.concept: Mixed technical and narrative text features
en.description: Activation patterns are diverse: expressions about the credibility of testimony in legal trials, and distinct local patterns involving durations, mathematical summation and optimization, biomedical experiments, soccer narratives, and generated code comments.

patterns.name: Witness credibility
patterns.context: In a legal trial context, evaluates the credibility of a witness’s or party’s statements or testimony; often co-occurs with words such as trial, counsel, testimony, and statement.

patterns.name: Duration expressions
patterns.context: A duration modified by a number, especially with the colloquial approximation suffix “-ish,” in a personal account of past experiences.

patterns.name: Infinite sums in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A LaTeX mathematical derivation contains a sum from 1 to infinity and probability/expectation symbols.

patterns.name: BMP2 experiments and methods
patterns.context: Introduces experimental design and technical methods, reporting mice and assessing OA progression.

patterns.name: Summation in physics formulas
patterns.context: A field-theory formula in LaTeX sums indexed variables, alongside Greek letters and derivative symbols.

patterns.name: Soccer seasons and match narratives
patterns.context: Describes team season performance, player selections, and matches coached, including club and competition names.

patterns.name: Required-method comments in generated code
patterns.context: XML-style comments in a code designer’s generated region describe required methods and warn against modification.

patterns.name: Objective functions in optimization problems
patterns.context: A mathematical optimization statement marks the objective with Objective and requires minimizing an expression involving a sum, norm, or set size.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers or optimization problem descriptions

4_1286.concept: 混合技术与叙事文本特征
4_1286.description: 激活模式多样：法律审判中关于证言可信度的表述，以及时间长度、数学求和与优化、生物医学实验、足球叙述和生成代码注释等各自独立的局部模式。

patterns.name: 证人可信度
patterns.context: 法律审判语境中评价证人或当事人陈述、证言的可信性；常与 trial、counsel、testimony、statement 等词同现。

patterns.name: 时间长度表达
patterns.context: 数字修饰的时间长度，尤其带有口语化约数后缀“-ish”，并处于个人回顾经历的语境。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的无穷求和
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学推导中出现从 1 到无穷的求和及概率/期望符号。

patterns.name: BMP2实验与技术
patterns.context: 介绍实验设计、报告小鼠及评估 OA 进展的技术方法。

patterns.name: 物理公式中的求和
patterns.context: LaTeX 场论公式中对带指标的变量求和，伴随希腊字母及导数符号。

patterns.name: 足球赛季与比赛叙述
patterns.context: 叙述球队赛季表现、球员入选与教练执教比赛，含俱乐部和赛事名称。

patterns.name: 生成代码中的必需方法注释
patterns.context: 代码设计器生成区域中的 XML 风格注释，说明必需方法及勿修改提示。

patterns.name: 优化问题目标函数
patterns.context: 数学优化表述中以 Objective 标记目标，并要求最小化含求和、范数或集合大小的表达式。
patterns.domain: 数学论文或优化问题描述

en.description: Activation is scattered across complete words and word-internal fragments, mathematical symbols, document-format markers, and numbers; examples occur in sports, legal, and research texts, but no stable single semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-internal suffixes or final fragments
patterns.context: Activation often falls on complete words, word endings, or word-internal fragments spanning tokens; meanings and syntactic positions are not fixed.

patterns.name: Formal mathematics and symbol strings
patterns.context: Occurs in formulas, LaTeX mathematical typesetting, and symbolic expressions containing summation, subscripts/superscripts, or Greek letters.

patterns.name: Line breaks and document-structure markers
patterns.context: Activation sometimes corresponds to locations near line breaks or to headings, category labels, and HTML/Markdown formatting markers; line breaks alone do not consistently trigger every segment.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia page structure, formatted text, and paper typesetting

patterns.name: Numbers and values with units
patterns.context: Numbers occur in entity information such as birth years, astronomical parameters, or dates; occurrences are sparse, with no confirmed common numerical semantics.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, astronomy, and sports reports

patterns.name: Sports events, teams, and lineup narratives
patterns.context: Centered on matches, seasons, national teams, or club lineups; activation falls on some related words, but also on general words or word-internal fragments.

patterns.name: Legal cases and trial language
patterns.context: A military court ruling summary describes an appellant’s claims about counsel’s trial arguments and the judge’s handling of them.

patterns.name: Research subjects, evaluation, and outcome terminology
patterns.context: Research plans or papers mention terms for evaluation targets, experimental responses, stimuli, or research outcomes.
patterns.domain: NIH research plans and academic papers

4_1286.description: 激活分散于完整词及词内片段、数学符号、文档格式标记和数字；体育、法律、科研等内容均有实例，但未见稳定的单一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 单词内部后缀或末尾片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在完整词、词尾或跨 token 的词内片段上；词义和句法位置并不固定。
patterns.domain: 多领域散文及技术文本

patterns.name: 形式化数学与符号串
patterns.context: 公式、LaTeX 数学排版及含求和、上下标或希腊字母的符号表达式中出现。

patterns.name: 换行及文档结构标记
patterns.context: 激活有时对应换行附近或标题、类别标签、HTML/Markdown 排版标记；换行本身并非每段都稳定触发。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 页面结构、格式化文本及论文排版

patterns.name: 数字及带单位的数值
patterns.context: 数字出现在出生年份、天体参数或日期等实体信息中；出现稀疏，不能确认统一数值语义。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、天文学及体育报道

patterns.name: 体育赛事、队伍与阵容叙述
patterns.context: 围绕比赛、赛季、国家队或俱乐部阵容展开；激活落在若干相关词，但也落在一般词或词内片段上。

patterns.name: 法律案件与庭审语言
patterns.context: 军事司法判决摘要中描述上诉方对律师庭审陈词及法官处理方式的主张。

patterns.name: 研究对象、评估与结果术语
patterns.context: 研究计划或论文叙述中出现评估对象、实验反应、刺激或研究结果等术语。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划与学术论文

en.description: Activation is scattered across sports-career narratives, wrestling matches, values and units, mathematical formulas, personal experiences, research papers, and profiles; locally it often falls on words such as first and match, numbers, units, or formula structures, with no single theme spanning all segments.

patterns.name: Football events and player careers
patterns.context: Occurs in narratives about teams, players, or events, involving seasons, matches, transfers, or professional careers.

patterns.name: Values and measurement units
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in measurements, years, time conversions, or units of quantity; also includes units or value expressions near numbers.
patterns.domain: Math problems, mining reports, encyclopedias, and scientific texts

patterns.name: Generic words in match narratives
patterns.context: Describes a wrestler’s match history, affiliated event organizations, or championship contests.

patterns.name: Symbols and typesetting structures in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Symbols and LaTeX structures interleave in formula derivations or probability-theory prose.

patterns.name: Life and personal experience
patterns.context: First-person reflections on life, residence, or a personal experience.

patterns.name: Research variables and literature citations
patterns.context: Research methods or literature reviews list predictors and cite sources using tables and literature markers.

patterns.name: Roles and stories in profiles
patterns.context: A lighthearted profile recounts a woman’s experiences and her breakthrough role.

4_1286.description: 激活分散在体育生涯叙述、摔角比赛、数值与单位、数学公式、个人经历、研究论文及人物报道中；局部常落在 first、match、数字、单位或公式结构等词上，未见单一主题覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: 足球赛事与球员生涯
patterns.trigger: « match»、« season»、« first»、« transfer»、« contract»、« squad»、« manager»
patterns.context: 出现在球队、球员或赛事叙述中，涉及赛季、比赛、转会或职业经历。

patterns.name: 数值与度量单位
patterns.context: 数字嵌在测量结果、年份、时间换算或数量单位中；也包括数字附近的单位或数值表达。
patterns.domain: 数学题、矿业报告、百科及科学文本

patterns.name: 比赛叙述中的泛用词
patterns.context: 讲述摔角手的比赛经历、所属赛事组织或争夺冠军。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号与排版结构
patterns.context: 公式推导或概率论文字中，符号和 LaTeX 结构交错出现。

patterns.name: 生活与个人经历
patterns.context: 第一人称回顾生活、居住地或一段个人经历。

patterns.name: 研究变量与文献引用
patterns.context: 研究方法或文献综述中列举预测因子，并通过表格和文献标记引用来源。

patterns.name: 人物报道中的角色与故事
patterns.context: 以轻松报道口吻讲述女性人物的经历及其突破性角色。

en.concept: Phrase and field boundaries across diverse texts
en.description: Activations span multiple genres, concentrating mainly on phrase boundaries and specific word fragments in structured narratives: soccer matches, mining and health research terminology, unit-conversion problems, news expressions, and encyclopedia-entry formats. No unified semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Soccer events and player narratives
patterns.context: Mentions matches, seasons, transfers, or team history, often with years, dates, and team names.

patterns.name: Mining exploration results heading
patterns.context: A drilling report for a mining area or ore body describes mineral resource results and grade.

patterns.name: Diseases, outcomes, and groups in research reports
patterns.context: Disease or health research discusses outcome measures, occupational groups, and reference groups.

patterns.name: Numeric strings in math unit-conversion problems
patterns.context: Asks “What is/how many …?” and requires converting time or mass units; activation often falls on answer numbers or split numeric fragments.

patterns.name: Polls and percentages in reporting
patterns.context: Reports poll results, identifying the polling organization, media source, and share of voters.

patterns.name: Life and place of residence in personal reflections
patterns.context: First-person reflections on personal experiences mention work-life balance or place of residence.

patterns.name: Historical sports event narratives
patterns.context: Chronologically recounts teams’ visits, tours, or matches by year, involving British and American teams and historical figures.

patterns.name: Links and category labels at the end of encyclopedia entries
patterns.context: The end of an entry lists external links and categories for people, birth years, or ethnic background.

4_1286.concept: 多样文本中的短语与字段边界
4_1286.description: 激活覆盖多种文体，主要集中在结构化叙述中的短语边界与特定词片：足球比赛、矿业和健康研究术语、换算题数字、新闻表达，以及百科条目格式；未见统一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 足球赛事与球员叙述
patterns.trigger: « match»10；« first»5« match»9；« Euro»；« transfer»；« contract»
patterns.context: 提及比赛、赛季、转会或球队经历，常带年份、日期和球队名。
patterns.domain: 足球新闻与百科人物传记

patterns.name: 矿业钻探结果标题
patterns.context: 矿区或矿体的钻探报告，描述矿物资源结果及品位。

patterns.name: 研究报告中的疾病、结局与分组
patterns.context: 疾病或健康研究，讨论结局指标、职业分组及参照组。

patterns.name: 数学单位换算题中的数值串
patterns.trigger: «?»后的答案，以及« millenn»«ia»、« millig»«rams»、« tonnes»等单位附近的数字
patterns.context: 以“What is/how many …?”提问，要求对时间或质量单位进行换算；激活常落在答案数字或被拆分的数字片段上。

patterns.name: 民调报道中的调查与百分比
patterns.context: 报道民调结果，交代调查机构、媒体来源和选民比例。

patterns.name: 个人反思中的生活与居住地
patterns.trigger: « my» « life»；« I» call home；« months» in Nashville
patterns.context: 第一人称回顾个人经历，并谈到生活平衡或居住地。

patterns.name: 历史体育赛事叙述
patterns.context: 按年份叙述球队访问、巡回或比赛，涉及英美球队及历史人物。

patterns.name: 百科条目末尾的链接与分类标签
patterns.context: 条目尾部列出外部链接和人物类别、出生年份或族裔背景。

en.description: Activation is scattered across multiple contexts: match in sports reports, baseball statistics, numbers and decimal formats, the final s in advertising terms, astronomical degree symbols, and music copy; the trigger forms are not consistent and are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “match” at an English word boundary
patterns.context: A space precedes the word match; occurs in a football report, followed by “as Madrid manager”

patterns.name: Digit 5 after a decimal point
patterns.context: Immediately after a decimal point; the number string is “68.5”

patterns.name: 9 in the decimal part of a percentage
patterns.context: After the decimal point in “88.5”, followed by a percent sign

patterns.name: Final s in an advertising term
patterns.context: Appears in the Google Ad[s] marker, adjacent to a Google Ads ad link

patterns.name: Decimal part and separator in a number string
patterns.context: Appears in the answer to an arithmetic problem converting tons to grams; activation covers the decimal point and decimal digit

patterns.name: 155 in an area number string
patterns.context: Part of the comma-separated area value “6,155-hectare”, followed by a hyphen

patterns.name: 4 and 9 in sports score statistics
patterns.context: In the “2-for-4 night” statistical format in a baseball report

patterns.name: “first match” in a match narrative
patterns.context: Appears in an account of a player’s matches after a transfer, preceded by “first”

patterns.name: Degree marker in an astronomical number
patterns.context: The value 26.7 is followed by a LaTeX degree symbol and then “obliquity”

patterns.name: Plural ending in music-program copy
patterns.context: Immediately follows musical, forming “musicals”, followed by “of all time”

4_1286.description: 激活分散于多种语境：体育报道中的 match、棒球统计，数字与小数格式、广告词尾 s，以及天文度数符号和音乐文案；触发形式彼此不统一，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 英文单词边界处的“match”
patterns.context: 单词 match 前有空格；出现在足球报道中，后接 “as Madrid manager”

patterns.name: 小数点前的数字 5
patterns.context: 紧跟在小数点后，数字串为“68.5”

patterns.name: 百分数小数部分中的 9
patterns.context: 位于“88.5”小数点之后，后接百分号
patterns.domain: 娱乐新闻中的预测准确率

patterns.name: 广告词尾的 s
patterns.context: 出现在 Google Ad[s] 标记中，紧邻 Google Ads 广告链接

patterns.name: 数字小数部分及其分隔符
patterns.context: 出现在吨转克的算术题答案中；触发覆盖小数点及小数位数字

patterns.name: 面积数字串中的 155
patterns.context: 作为带千位逗号的面积数值“6,155-hectare”的一部分，后接连字符

patterns.name: 体育比分统计中的 4 与 9
patterns.context: 在棒球报道的“2-for-4 night”统计格式中

patterns.name: 比赛用语“first match”
patterns.context: 出现在球员转会后的比赛经历叙述中，前有“first”

patterns.name: 天文数字中的度数标记
patterns.context: 数值 26.7 后接 LaTeX 度数符号，再接“obliquity”

patterns.name: 音乐节目宣传语中的复数词尾
patterns.context: 紧接 musical，构成“musicals”，后接“of all time”

en.description: Activation is scattered across word-form fragments, match terminology, numerical statistics, and parts of proper names, spanning news, encyclopedias, websites, and emails. Numbers and entity-related words are common, but there is no clear trigger condition consistent across segments.

patterns.name: Morphological fragments within proper names or entities
patterns.context: Activation falls on specific fragments within English word forms or phrases, often in descriptions of entities, organizations, occupations, activities, or businesses; no consistent morphological boundary or syntactic position is evident.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including news, encyclopedias, websites, and emails

patterns.name: match in a match or event
patterns.context: Occurs in football reports, referring to a match played by a team or player; both examples recount match experience.

patterns.name: Values, percentages, and statistics
patterns.context: Numbers often occur in percentages, measurements, dates, demographic statistics, or ownership shares; activation strength on numbers varies across these examples, with no confirmed single numerical-format condition.
patterns.domain: Polling, mining, predictions, demographics, and business reports

patterns.name: Specific news or narrative wording
patterns.context: Activation occurs in accounts related to events, elections, or competitions, but the trigger words do not form a clear shared phrase.

patterns.name: Local fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation occurs only within specific names or parts of names; there is insufficient repeated evidence to infer more specific contextual conditions.
patterns.domain: Websites, local news, and personal narratives

patterns.name: Not explained by a shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: Occurs alone or can only be linked through broad semantics; its relationship to other activations is unclear.

4_1286.description: 激活分散于词形片段、赛事用语、数值统计及专名内部，涉及新闻、百科、网页和邮件。数字和实体相关词较常见，但没有跨段一致的明确触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名或实体内部的构词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词形或短语中的特定片段，常见于实体、机构、职业、活动或业务的描述；未显示统一的词法边界或句法位置。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、网页及邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 比赛或赛事中的 match
patterns.context: 出现在足球报道中，指球队或球员参加的一场比赛；两处均为叙述比赛经历。

patterns.name: 数值、百分比与统计量
patterns.context: 数字常处于百分比、测量结果、日期、人口统计或持股比例中；这些例子中数字激活强度各异，无法确认单一数值格式条件。
patterns.domain: 民调、采矿、预测、人口统计及商业报道

patterns.name: 特定新闻或叙事用语
patterns.context: 激活出现在事件、选举或竞赛相关叙述中，但触发词彼此不构成明确共同短语。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道及个人经历叙述

patterns.name: 专有名词中的局部片段
patterns.context: 仅在特定名称或名称的一部分中激活，缺少足够重复证据来归纳更具体的上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 网页、地方新闻及个人叙述

patterns.name: 无法由共有触发模式解释
patterns.context: 单独出现，或仅能由宽泛语义联系解释；其与其他激活的关系不清楚。

en.concept: Fact-based narratives dense with numbers and proper names
en.description: Activation is scattered across texts from multiple domains, often alongside proper names, numbers, and precise specifications: polling percentages, match data, experimental strains, mining grades, demographics, transfer fees, product specifications, and advertising, football, and real-estate narratives; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Percentages and numbers in news polls
patterns.context: News reports give poll results, with numbers and percentages appearing in statements about voter opinion.

patterns.name: Cricket scores and player statistics
patterns.context: Match narratives include scores, player runs, and data in parentheses.

patterns.name: Experimental strains and construct identifiers
patterns.context: In experimental methods or results, italicized gene/construct names are adjacent to strain identifiers.

patterns.name: Ore grades and drill intercepts in mineral exploration
patterns.context: In mining exploration reports, numbers represent drill-intercept lengths and ore grades.

patterns.name: Decimal percentages in demographics
patterns.context: Censuses or local profiles describe population composition using precise percentages and household counts.

patterns.name: Pound-denominated transfer fees
patterns.context: Football career narratives specify transfer fees in pounds.

patterns.name: Projector specifications and dimensions
patterns.context: Product descriptions list technical specifications such as resolution, brightness, and display size.

patterns.name: Website ads and user choices
patterns.context: Website privacy or advertising statements discuss targeted ads, cookies, and opt-out options.

patterns.name: Football season years and match narratives
patterns.context: In football biographies or season narratives, events, teams, and years appear together.

patterns.name: Real-estate markets and urban safe havens
patterns.context: Discusses a regional real-estate market, using safe haven to describe its market positioning.

4_1286.concept: 数字与专名密集的事实叙述
4_1286.description: 激活分散于多领域文本，常伴随专名、数字及精确规格：民调百分比、赛事数据、实验菌株、矿业品位、人口统计、转会费、产品规格，以及广告、足球和房地产叙述；未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 新闻民调中的百分比与数字
patterns.context: 新闻报道民调结果，数字与百分比出现在选民意见的陈述中。

patterns.name: 板球比分与球员数据
patterns.context: 比赛叙述中出现比分、球员得分及括号内数据。

patterns.name: 科研实验菌株与构建体编号
patterns.context: 实验方法或结果段落中，斜体基因/构建体名称与菌株编号相邻。

patterns.name: 矿产勘探品位和钻探截距
patterns.context: 矿业勘探报道中，数字表示钻探截距长度及矿石品位。

patterns.name: 人口统计中的小数百分比
patterns.context: 人口普查或地方概况以精确百分比和家庭数描述人口构成。

patterns.name: 英镑转会费
patterns.context: 球员生涯叙述中以英镑金额说明转会费用。

patterns.name: 投影仪规格与尺寸
patterns.context: 产品描述中列举分辨率、亮度和显示尺寸等技术规格。

patterns.name: 网站广告与用户选择
patterns.context: 网站隐私或广告说明中，谈及定向广告、Cookie 和退出选项。

patterns.name: 足球赛事年份与比赛叙述
patterns.context: 足球人物或赛季叙述中，赛事、球队和年份交织出现。

patterns.name: 房地产市场与城市安全港
patterns.trigger: « safe-haven« cities»3、« safe haven« market»2、« residential« market»9
patterns.context: 讨论区域房地产市场，并以 safe haven 描述市场定位。

en.description: Activations are distributed across multiple genres, marking common words, numbers, punctuation, and formatting fragments; the fragments show no stable semantic or topical commonality, and the available evidence is insufficient to identify a consistent trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenization boundary of the same surface string “ on”
patterns.context: Activation often falls on words beginning with a space or on punctuation, and sometimes on punctuation itself; meanings and grammatical functions vary widely, so these fragments do not establish a common semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including news, encyclopedias, email, medical abstracts, and webpages

4_1286.description: 激活分布于多种文体，标记位置包括常见词、数字、标点及格式片段；片段间看不出稳定的语义或主题共性，现有证据不足以确定一致触发模式。

patterns.name: 同一表面字符串“ on”的分词边界
patterns.trigger: «-»、«,»、« according»、« for»、« from»、« of»、« is»、« in»、« years»、« people»、« households»等被标记片段
patterns.context: 激活位置常落在以空格开头的词或标点上，也有标点自身；词义和语法功能差异很大，无法由这些片段确定共同语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、邮件、医学摘要及网页等多种文体

en.description: Activation is scattered across headings and structural boundaries, sequence expressions, numerical measurements, compound-word or proper-name boundaries, and web metadata; it spans domains and lacks a unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Heading/section structure markers
patterns.context: Activates at section headings, news headlines, or document-structure boundaries, especially when a heading is followed by body text
patterns.domain: Papers, web news, and structured documents

patterns.name: Ordinal and temporal sequence expressions
patterns.context: When describing event order, steps, match progression, or year sequences
patterns.domain: Sports reports, mathematical explanations, local news

patterns.name: Numbers and measurements
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in quantitative information such as scores, sample sizes, mining assay results, or image dimensions
patterns.domain: Sports, medical research, mining news, technical documents

patterns.name: Morpheme boundaries in proper names and noun phrases
patterns.context: Activation often falls within or near the boundaries of compound words, proper names, or noun phrases; it occurs across different semantic domains

patterns.name: Web/publication metadata and navigation copy
patterns.context: Templated web content such as ad opt-out notices, website footers, or email subscription disclaimers

patterns.name: Local activations not classifiable into a stable pattern
patterns.context: Local activations in individual segments are difficult to explain using one semantic condition and may be affected by tokenization, formatting, or incidental context
patterns.domain: Real-estate commentary, medicine, sports, and others

4_1286.description: 激活分散于标题和结构边界、顺序表达、数字计量、复合词或专名边界，以及网页元信息；跨领域且缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 标题/章节结构标记
patterns.trigger: “Materials and Methods”“Study Population”“New High-grade”“first match”；以及 Markdown 式“{#sec2}”“===”和换行
patterns.context: 在章节标题、新闻标题或文档结构边界处激活，尤其标题后接正文时
patterns.domain: 论文、网页新闻与结构化文档

patterns.name: 序数词与时间顺序表达
patterns.context: 描述事件、步骤、比赛进程或年份先后顺序时
patterns.domain: 体育报道、数学说明、地方新闻

patterns.name: 数字与计量结果
patterns.context: 数字嵌入比分、样本量、矿业化验结果或图像尺寸等量化信息中
patterns.domain: 体育、医学研究、矿业新闻、技术文档

patterns.name: 专名及名词短语中的词素边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在复合词、专名或名词短语内部/边界附近；不同语义领域均有出现

patterns.name: 网页/出版物元信息与导航文案
patterns.context: 广告退出说明、网站页脚或邮件订阅免责声明等模板化网页内容

patterns.name: 未能归入稳定模式的局部激活
patterns.trigger: “safe haven market”“CAD patients”“Bailey scored”及各段零散标记
patterns.context: 单段中的局部激活难以由同一语义条件解释，可能受分词、格式或偶然上下文影响
patterns.domain: 房地产评论、医学、体育及其他

en.description: Activation is distributed across sports matches and careers, numerical statistics and financial data, product specifications, historical citations, election reports, and NFL drafts; there is no clear shared trigger word covering all segments. Numbers, units, and domain-specific phrases form local patterns.

patterns.name: match in match or event narratives
patterns.context: Sports biographies or team match histories, especially narratives such as “first match”; both examples occur near the end of a paragraph.

patterns.name: Statistical values and percentages
patterns.context: Numerical expressions for population, equity, or sales, often involving decimals, percentages, or currency units; no stable single number format is apparent.

patterns.name: Transfers and career histories
patterns.context: Narratives about football players’ transfers, retirement, or match histories; [7] also triggers the “match” pattern.

patterns.name: Product specifications and marketing-style quotations
patterns.context: Introduces a projector model, resolution, brightness, and display size, accompanied by promotional copy and specification numbers.

patterns.name: Quarterly financial data
patterns.context: Quarterly sales, year-over-year changes, and currency amounts in company news; overlaps with general numerical expressions but is concentrated here in a financial-report context.

patterns.name: European historical terms and citation markers
patterns.context: Quotation marks, bracketed citation numbers, and historical-event descriptions in accounts of European history.

patterns.name: Political elections and polling
patterns.context: Reports about voting, people leaving the capital, and poll results before or after an election.

patterns.name: NFL drafts and quarterbacks
patterns.context: Sports reports describing teams trading draft picks and selecting quarterbacks.

4_1286.concept: 数字与结构化事实叙述
4_1286.description: 激活分布于体育比赛与履历、数字统计和财务数据、产品规格、历史引文、选举报道及NFL选秀；没有覆盖所有片段的明确共同触发词。数字、单位和特定领域词组各自形成局部模式。

patterns.name: 比赛或赛事叙述中的 match
patterns.context: 体育人物或球队的比赛经历，尤其是“first match”等比赛叙述；两例均在段落末尾附近。

patterns.name: 统计数值与百分数
patterns.context: 人口、股权或销售额等数据的数字表达，常见小数、百分比或金额单位；未见稳定的单一数字格式。

patterns.name: 转会及职业生涯履历
patterns.context: 足球运动员转会、退役或比赛履历的叙述；[7]也触发了“match”模式。

patterns.name: 产品规格与营销式引语
patterns.context: 介绍投影仪型号、分辨率、亮度和显示尺寸，伴随产品宣传语及规格数字。

patterns.name: 季度财务数据
patterns.context: 公司新闻中的季度销售额、同比变化和货币金额；与一般数值表达有重叠，但此处集中于财报语境。

patterns.name: 欧洲历史称谓与引语标注
patterns.context: 欧洲历史介绍中的引号、方括号引文编号及历史事件表述。

patterns.name: 政治选举与民调
patterns.context: 选举前后对投票、民众离开首都及民调结果的报道。

patterns.name: NFL选秀与四分卫
patterns.context: 描述球队在选秀中交易顺位、选择四分卫的体育报道。

en.description: Activation appears broadly in numbers, years, quantities, statistical values, and adjacent punctuation; it also occurs in formula indices, locations, and citation numbers. A few word activations lack clear shared conditions.

patterns.name: Numbers and statistics
patterns.context: Number strings appear as years, population figures, match statistics, amounts, or mathematical parameters; activation often falls on numbers, adjacent spaces, or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, sports reports, legal records, mathematics papers, business news

patterns.name: Dates and time spans
patterns.context: Numbers occur in expressions for dates, quarters, years, or time periods.
patterns.domain: News, legal, sports, and encyclopedic narratives

patterns.name: Quantities, scale, and units
patterns.context: Numbers express people, occurrences, area, money, or other measurable quantities.
patterns.domain: Demographics, legal, sports, real estate, and finance

patterns.name: Numbers or identifiers in proper names
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in event names, statutory footnotes, rankings, or specialized identifiers; these differ somewhat from general quantity expressions.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and parameter indices
patterns.context: Variables, subscripts, indices, and parameter values appear in formulas or hypothesis descriptions.

patterns.name: Locations and regional market descriptions
patterns.context: Place names occur in accounts of population, law, real estate, or personal experience; activation may be adjacent to a place name or a following number.

patterns.name: Citations, footnotes, and punctuation numbering
patterns.context: Bracketed reference numbers or citation markers after body text, often adjacent to years or statistical information.

patterns.name: Isolated textual activations
patterns.context: No obvious numerical trigger condition; activation falls on general words or terms, and the current sample cannot confirm an independent stable shared condition.
patterns.domain: Historical narratives, real-estate commentary, mathematics papers

4_1286.description: 激活广泛出现在数字、年份、数量、统计值及其邻近标点，也见于公式索引、地点和引文编号；少数词语激活缺乏清晰共同条件。

patterns.name: 数字与统计数据
patterns.context: 出现年份、人口、比赛统计、金额或数学参数等数字串；激活常落在数字、数字相邻空格或标点上。
patterns.domain: 百科、体育报道、法律记录、数学论文、商业新闻

patterns.name: 日期与时间跨度
patterns.context: 数字处于日期、季度、年份或一段时间的表达中。
patterns.domain: 新闻、法律、体育及百科叙述

patterns.name: 数量、规模与单位
patterns.trigger: “four of the monthly payments”“16-acre plot”“142,324 people”“1.23 billion reais”
patterns.context: 数字表达人数、次数、面积、金额或其他可计量规模。
patterns.domain: 人口统计、法律、体育、地产与财经

patterns.name: 专名中的数字或编号
patterns.context: 数字嵌在赛事名称、法条脚注、排名或专门编号中；与一般数量表达不完全相同。

patterns.name: 数学符号及参数索引
patterns.context: 变量、下标、索引及参数取值出现在公式或假设说明中。

patterns.name: 地点与地域性市场描述
patterns.context: 地名出现在人口、法律、房地产或人物经历的叙述中；激活可能邻接地名或其后的数字。

patterns.name: 引文、脚注与标点编号
patterns.context: 正文后的方括号参考编号或引文标记，常与年份、统计信息相邻。

patterns.name: 孤立的文本性激活
patterns.context: 没有明显数字触发条件，激活落在一般词语或术语上；当前样本无法确认独立稳定的共同条件。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述、地产评论、数学论文

en.concept: Multidomain text features related to numbers and structural boundaries
en.description: Activations span multiple topics, often occurring near years, quantities, specifications, punctuation, and paragraph boundaries; additional local contexts involve soccer, demographics, elections, legal payments, history, real estate, products, and food. No single semantic pattern fully explains them.

patterns.name: Numeric and quantity formats
patterns.context: Numbers or quantity expressions occur within sentences or in text sequences of adjacent numbers, units, commas, hyphens, and similar elements; the trigger is the number itself or a nearby token. Topics differ across passages.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedias, news, legal text, and product descriptions

patterns.name: Paragraph or section boundaries
patterns.context: A narrative unit has just ended, followed by a line break, heading, or new event opening; prominent activations in paragraphs 1, 3, and 4 are adjacent to these boundaries.

patterns.name: Place names and regional descriptions
patterns.context: Place names occur in descriptions of population, national history, city markets, or local food culture; activation may also fall on nearby quantities, domain words, or sentence structure.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, real estate, forum discussions

patterns.name: Population, growth, and statistical statements
patterns.context: Describes a county or region’s growth ranking, then turns to census information, population totals, and household counts.

patterns.name: Soccer narratives and match/season information
patterns.context: A team’s, player’s, or coach’s seasons, competitions, appointments, and transfer history; numbers and paragraph transitions may also contribute to activation.

patterns.name: Elections and opinion polls in news
patterns.context: Reports population movement and voting before and after an election, and polling organizations’ assessments of the state of the race.

patterns.name: Payments and dates in legal cases
patterns.context: Describes payment arrangements, recipients, months, and legal case records; date and amount formats are prominent.

patterns.name: National history and industrialization
patterns.context: Introduces Belgium’s history after independence, industrialization, and the context of European wars.

patterns.name: Real estate markets and safe havens
patterns.context: Distinguishes safe-haven status inside and outside a region, and discusses Dubai’s luxury housing market and possible drivers.

patterns.name: Product specifications and dimensions
patterns.context: In consumer electronics descriptions, specifications, brightness, screen size, and phrases describing image quality occur near each other.

patterns.name: Local food and identity differences
patterns.context: Forum-style discussion compares local food and its cultural influence, emphasizing subtle differences and local perspectives.

patterns.name: Article tags and caption markers
patterns.context: Headings, HTML attributes, and template markers appear at the start of a web article or in an image caption; strong activation in the passage may be related to formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Metaphorical title for European wars
patterns.context: A fixed metaphorical title describes Belgium’s geopolitical role in European wars, followed by an account of the two world wars.

4_1286.concept: 数字与结构边界相关的多域文本特征
4_1286.description: 激活分布于多种题材，常见于年份、数量、规格、标点及段落边界附近；另有足球、人口统计、选举、法律付款、历史、房地产、产品和饮食等局部语境，无法由单一语义模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 数字与数量格式
patterns.context: 数字或数量表达处于句中或相邻数字、单位、逗号、连字符等组成的文本序列；触发位置在数字本身或其紧邻 token。各段主题并不一致。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、法律、产品描述等多种文体

patterns.name: 段落或章节边界
patterns.trigger: “↵”“Later career”“In Juande Ramos' first match”等换行、章节标题或新段落开头
patterns.context: 文本刚结束一个叙述单元，随后出现换行、标题或新事件开头；第1、3、4段的显著激活紧邻这类边界。

patterns.name: 地名与区域描述
patterns.context: 地名出现在人口、国家历史、城市市场或地方饮食文化等描述中；触发也可能落在附近的数量、领域词或句子结构上。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、房地产、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 人口、增长与统计陈述
patterns.context: 描述县或地区的增长排名，并转入人口普查、人口总量及家庭数等统计信息。

patterns.name: 足球叙述与比赛／赛季信息
patterns.trigger: “the season against Real Zaragoza”“UEFA Euro 2008”“first match as Madrid manager”“joined ... Southampton”
patterns.context: 球队、球员或教练的赛季、赛事、任职及转会经历；数字和段落衔接也可能贡献激活。

patterns.name: 新闻中的选举与民意调查
patterns.trigger: “went home to vote”“polling organizations”“narrow race”“the country's two main”
patterns.context: 报道选举前后的人口流动、投票及民调机构对竞争态势的判断。

patterns.name: 法律案件中的款项与日期
patterns.trigger: “monthly payments”“four of the monthly payments”“March to June 1999”“June ... 1999”
patterns.context: 叙述付款安排、收款人、月份及法律案件记录，日期和金额式格式较突出。

patterns.name: 国家历史与工业化
patterns.context: 介绍比利时独立后的历史、工业化及欧洲战争背景。

patterns.name: 房地产市场与避风港
patterns.trigger: “safe-haven cities”“safe haven market”“Dubai’s luxury residential market”“boost”
patterns.context: 区分区域内外的避险属性，并讨论迪拜高端住宅市场及其可能受到的推动。

patterns.name: 产品规格与尺寸
patterns.context: 消费电子产品介绍中，规格、亮度、屏幕尺寸及形容画质的短语相邻出现。

patterns.name: 地方饮食与身份差异
patterns.context: 论坛式对话比较地方饮食及其文化影响，强调细微区别和本地人视角。

patterns.name: 文章标签与图注标记
patterns.context: 网页文章开头或图片图注中出现标题标签、HTML属性和模板标记；该段强激活可能与格式边界有关。

patterns.name: 欧洲战事的比喻称号
patterns.trigger: “the battlefield of Europe”“the cockpit of Europe”
patterns.context: 用固定比喻称号描述比利时在欧洲战争中的地缘角色，并接续两次世界大战的说明。

en.description: Activation is scattered across transitions from headings at paragraph openings, organizations and place names, sports events, financial transactions, numerical results, and specific narratives in law, medicine, history, elections, and mining; there is no single stable lexical or topical trigger.

patterns.name: Transitions after paragraph or section headings
patterns.context: Triggered by phrases at the start of a heading or new paragraph after a line break; the heading topic need not be consistent.
patterns.domain: Headings and paragraph openings in encyclopedias, news, mining reports, and other texts

patterns.name: Institution or organization names
patterns.context: When an organization, institution, or group name and nearby designation appear; may occur within a sentence or at the start of a paragraph.

patterns.name: Place names and regional entities
patterns.context: Countries, cities, regions, or demonyms occur in a narrative; sometimes adjacent to organizations, history, or event information.

patterns.name: Sports matches and event statistics
patterns.context: Match narratives include events, match actions, or player-scoring statistics.

patterns.name: Financial, market, or transaction matters
patterns.context: Economic-transaction contexts such as market conditions, payments, or transfer fees.
patterns.domain: Real-estate news, legal cases, sports transfer reports

patterns.name: Numbers and quantitative results
patterns.context: Specific amounts, years, doses, or measurements occur in narratives or result reports; number formats vary.
patterns.domain: Sports, medicine, mining, legal, and financial texts

patterns.name: Trial results and variation in medical research
patterns.context: Discusses inconsistent clinical-trial results and differences in individual responses to dosage.

patterns.name: Historical titles and national development
patterns.context: Uses historical titles for a region, followed by narratives of independence or industrialization.

patterns.name: Mining exploration and grade reports
patterns.context: Drilling reports from mining areas report ore bodies, drilling results, and ore grades.

patterns.name: Asylum application rulings
patterns.context: An immigration judge assesses whether an applicant has shown that their home-country government cannot or will not provide protection.

patterns.name: Elections and political organizations
patterns.context: Describes voting, polling organizations, and election prospects.

patterns.name: Isolated common narrative words
patterns.context: These words occur in their respective contexts and do not show a stable, shared special condition.

4_1286.concept: 结构化实体与事实叙述
4_1286.description: 激活分散于段首标题衔接、组织与地名、体育赛事、金融交易、数字结果及法律、医学、历史、选举和矿业等特定叙述；没有单一稳定的词汇或主题触发器。

patterns.name: 段落或章节标题后的衔接
