patterns.trigger: «↵»1Later career«↵»4；«↵»1Dubai；«↵»4In Juande Ramos' first match；«↵»3An OZ Minerals drilling program
patterns.context: 段落或小节换行后，以标题或新段落开头的词组触发；不要求标题主题一致。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、矿业报道等文本中的标题与段首

patterns.name: 机构或组织称谓
patterns.trigger: « CAT»1« claim»9；« two»4« main»2« polling»4« organizations»9；« the»2« club»1
patterns.context: 出现组织、机构或团体名称及其相邻称谓时；可位于句中或段首。
patterns.domain: 法律裁决、新闻、体育百科

patterns.name: 地名与地域实体
patterns.trigger: « England»1；« Spanish»1« press»1；« country»3；« Belgium»；« Nairobi»；« Guatemala
patterns.context: 国家、城市、地区或其地域形容词出现在叙述中；有时和机构、历史或赛事信息相邻。
patterns.domain: 体育、新闻、法律、历史百科

patterns.name: 体育比赛及赛事统计
patterns.trigger: « match»9；« toss»；« batted first»；« 53»；« 51»；« 72»；« UEFA Euro»
patterns.context: 比赛叙述中出现赛事、比赛动作或球员得分等统计信息。

patterns.name: 金融、市场或交易事项
patterns.trigger: « market»9；« boost»；« payments»；« four»« of»« the» monthly payments；« fee»
patterns.context: 市场行情、款项支付或转会费用等经济交易语境。
patterns.domain: 房地产新闻、法律案件、体育转会报道

patterns.name: 数字与量化结果
patterns.context: 具体金额、年份、剂量或测量值出现在叙述或结果报告中；数字本身形式多样。
patterns.domain: 体育、医学、矿业、法律与财经文本

patterns.name: 医学研究中的试验结果与变异
patterns.trigger: « inconsistent clinical trial findings»；« inter-individual variability»；« vitamin D dose»
patterns.context: 讨论临床试验结果不一致，以及个体对剂量反应的差异。

patterns.name: 历史性称号与国家发展
patterns.trigger: «the battlefield of Europe»；«the cockpit of Europe»；« independence»；« Industrial Revolution»
patterns.context: 以历史称号描述地区，并接续独立或工业化等历史叙述。

patterns.name: 矿业勘探与品位报告
patterns.context: 矿区钻探报道中报告矿体、钻探结果及矿石品位。

patterns.name: 庇护申请裁决
patterns.trigger: « failed to establish»；« government»；« would not protect him»；« CAT»« claim»
patterns.context: 移民法官评估申请人是否证明本国政府无法或不愿提供保护。

patterns.name: 选举与政治组织
patterns.context: 描述投票、民调机构及选情。

patterns.name: 单独出现的普通叙事词
patterns.trigger: « both» World Wars；« quick succession»；« result»
patterns.context: 这些词出现在各自语境中，未显示稳定且可归为同一模式的特殊条件。

en.concept: Proper nouns and structured factual text
en.description: Activations are scattered across encyclopedic facts, sports and place names, numbers and proper nouns, citations, and webpage formatting, and also occur in legal, real estate, and astronomy texts; no stable single semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Numbers and proper nouns in encyclopedia entries
patterns.context: Numbers, ordinals, years, and proper nouns appear densely in encyclopedic explanations or factual narratives; activation often falls near numbers or adjacent punctuation and spaces.
patterns.domain: Geography, population, sports, astronomy, and other encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Lists of place names and institution names
patterns.context: Place names, clubs, or institution names occur in introductions, lists, or news narratives; some activation falls on nearby words such as and, commas, or market.
patterns.domain: Geography, sports, medical institutions, and business reporting

patterns.name: Citations, parentheses, and structural markers
patterns.context: Parentheses, citation numbers, line breaks, or webpage markup occur next to body text, commonly in cited encyclopedias, papers, or webpages.

patterns.name: Claims and rulings in legal documents
patterns.context: In an immigration-law ruling, a judge explains point by point whether claims are substantiated; activation is prominent on “claim.”

patterns.name: Real estate market wording
patterns.context: Discusses safe-haven status inside and outside a region and the outlook for Dubai’s residential market; activation centers on “market.”

patterns.name: Technical terms and symbols
patterns.context: An astronomy paper discusses Titan’s obliquity, with terminology adjacent to mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Sports event titles and headings
patterns.context: An event entry title or section heading contains a sport and event name.

patterns.name: Sports biographies and club transfers
patterns.context: A soccer player’s career narrative is organized under headings and describes transfers and clubs.

patterns.name: Urban area safety and market comparisons
patterns.context: Compares how a city is positioned as a safe haven or market inside versus outside a region.

patterns.name: Repeated growth-rate statements
patterns.context: The same paragraph repeats a county’s ranking and the metropolitan area it belongs to.

4_1286.concept: 专名与结构化事实文本
4_1286.description: 激活分散于百科事实、体育与地名、数字和专名、引文及网页格式，也见于法律、房地产和天文学文本；未见稳定单一语义触发点。

patterns.name: 百科条目中的数字与专名
patterns.trigger: “2nd Fastest growing county”“2010 census”“142,324 people”“UEFA Euro 2008”“9th”“26.7$^{\circ}$”
patterns.context: 在百科式说明或事实叙述中，数字、序数、年份和专名密集出现；激活常落在数字附近或相邻标点、空格上。
patterns.domain: 地理人口、体育、天文等百科条目

patterns.name: 地名及机构专名列表
patterns.context: 地名、俱乐部或机构名称嵌在介绍、列表或新闻叙述中；部分激活落在附近的 and、逗号或 market 等词上。
patterns.domain: 地理、体育、医疗机构及商业报道

patterns.name: 引文、括号与结构标记
patterns.context: 括号、引用编号、换行或网页标记紧邻正文，常见于带引用的百科、论文或网页文本。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的主张与裁决
patterns.trigger: “the government of Guatemala would not protect him”“Finally”“CAT claim”
patterns.context: 移民法裁决叙述中，法官逐项说明主张是否成立；此处激活突出在“claim”。

patterns.name: 房地产市场措辞
patterns.context: 讨论区域内外的避险属性及迪拜住宅市场前景，激活集中在“market”。

patterns.name: 专业术语及技术符号
patterns.context: 天文学论文中，讨论泰坦的轴倾角，术语与数学符号相邻。

patterns.name: 体育赛事标题与小标题
patterns.trigger: “Swimming at the 2007 All-Africa Games”“The Swimming competition”
patterns.context: 赛事条目标题或章节标题，出现项目名和赛事名称。

patterns.name: 体育人物履历与俱乐部转会
patterns.context: 足球运动员生涯叙述中，以小标题和转会、俱乐部信息展开。

patterns.name: 城市区域安全与市场对比
patterns.context: 对比城市在区域内外作为避险地点或市场的不同定位。

patterns.name: 增长率重复表述
patterns.trigger: “2nd Fastest growing county”“2nd fastest growing county”
patterns.context: 同一段重复说明某县的排名及其所属都会区。

en.description: Strong activations occur both on the ile fragments in multiple words (tactile, facile, photolabile, and place-name spellings) and in patent phrases, the In in IM, and medical phrases; the segments lack a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word ending in tactile
patterns.context: The activation marker falls on the ile portion of tactile; it also appears in sensory-related terms.

patterns.name: Many electronic devices
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph begins with “Many personal electronic devices”.

patterns.name: Many computer systems
patterns.context: The sentence begins with “Many computerized systems”, followed by location and orientation sensors.

patterns.name: Split expansion of instant messaging abbreviation
patterns.context: Appears in the abbreviation “IM (Instant Messaging)”, specifically on the In fragment.

patterns.name: Fragment in an olefin reaction term
patterns.context: The activation falls on the ending of “facile”; the same chemistry title also includes terms for alkylation, olefins, and substituted products.

patterns.name: Fragment in a photochemistry term
patterns.context: The activation falls on the ending of “photolabile”, in a title about the photodissociation of manganese-NO complexes.

patterns.name: Fragment in a place name
patterns.context: Appears in the Wikipedia article title “Alileh Sar” and repeats on an adjacent line.

patterns.name: Fragment in a place name
patterns.context: Appears in the hyphenated construction of the place name “Baile-an-Iarla”.

patterns.name: Coronary artery risk phrase
patterns.context: Appears in a list of disease risks: “increased risk for coronary artery … disease”.

4_1405.concept: 混合的子词与短语触发
4_1405.description: 强激活既落在多个词中的 ile 片段（tactile、facile、photolabile、地名拼写），也出现在专利短语、IM 的 In 及医学短语中；各段缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: tactile 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活标记落在 tactile 一词的 ile 部分；同时出现在感觉相关术语中。
patterns.domain: PubMed/NIH 感觉与神经科学文献

patterns.name: 许多电子设备
patterns.context: 专利背景段以 “Many personal electronic devices” 起句。

patterns.name: 许多计算机系统
patterns.context: 句首 “Many computerized systems” 后接位置和方向传感器。

patterns.name: 即时通讯缩写拆分
patterns.context: 出现在缩写 “IM (Instant Messaging)” 内，具体落在 In 的片段。

patterns.name: 烯烃反应术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 “facile” 的词尾；同一化学标题另有烷基化、烯烃及取代产物术语。

patterns.name: 光化学术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 “photolabile” 的词尾，处于锰-NO 配合物光解离标题中。

patterns.name: 地名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在维基百科条目名 “Alileh Sar” 中，并在相邻行重复。

patterns.name: 地名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在地名 “Baile-an-Iarla” 的连字符构词中。

patterns.name: 冠状动脉风险短语
patterns.context: “increased risk for coronary artery … disease” 的疾病风险列举中。

en.concept: Multiple word forms and lexical triggers

patterns.name: 欧盟对技术项目的支持
patterns.context: 议会发言称技术进展离不开欧盟支持，并举 Desertec 项目为例

patterns.name: 软件作者或组件致谢
patterns.context: 出现在 CREDIT_LINE 代码宏中，与软件库及贡献者姓名并列
patterns.domain: 开源软件代码与致谢信息

patterns.name: 法律裁决及其后果
patterns.context: 评论法院作出的裁决，并表达对不同裁决可能引发后果的顾虑

patterns.name: 对倡议的法律支持
patterns.context: 州政府及倡议发起方介入案件，支持一项烟草税倡议
patterns.domain: 法律判决、选举倡议诉讼

patterns.name: 拒绝合作促使美国采取行动
patterns.context: 描述组织拒绝配合追捕或引渡后引发美国的后续行动；未见明确的“support”触发词

patterns.name: 软件库功能兼容性
patterns.context: 比较软件库对 Unicode 和片段库等功能的支持或处理能力

en.description: Activations are distributed across expressions of degree, rate, and time, as well as crisis escalation, political status, territorial control, and policy identity terms; another segment involves a Russian word fragment and sentence-boundary activation. They share few semantic regularities.

patterns.name: High degree, speed, or proportion
patterns.context: Activations cluster near words expressing degree, rate, or temporal position; sometimes they fall directly on a magnitude or time word, even when no explicit number appears in the preceding context.
patterns.domain: General narrative, scientific abstracts, news, and history

patterns.name: Pressure and crisis escalation
patterns.context: When describing oppressive weather, a growing crisis, or escalating political conflict, highlights words conveying intensity, severity, or unpredictability.
patterns.domain: Personal accounts, international news, political commentary

patterns.name: Control, rule, or forceful occupation
patterns.context: Narratives about armed groups or political forces controlling, ruling, or capturing cities and territories.

patterns.name: Political institutions and politicians’ status
patterns.context: Describes party power structures, candidates’ leading positions, or international political meetings in political reporting.

patterns.name: Controversial policy categories and identity labels
patterns.context: Employment equality statements and debate about whether affirmative action is compatible with equal opportunity.

patterns.name: Russian word fragment and syntactic boundary
patterns.context: In Russian text, activation falls on a segmented internal word fragment and near a sentence or paragraph boundary; no semantic connection to the other passages is apparent.

4_1405.description: 激活分散于程度、速率和时间表达，以及危机升级、政治地位、领土控制和政策身份词；另有一段俄语词片段与句界激活。它们共享的语义规律有限。

patterns.name: 高程度、速度或比例
patterns.context: 激活集中在表达程度、速率或时间位置的词附近；有时直接落在量级/时间词上，前文未必有显式数字。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、科学摘要、新闻与历史

patterns.name: 压力与危机加剧
patterns.trigger: «opp»1«ress»9«ively»4 cloudy；«rise»3 in«9» global crises；«unim»2«agin»3«able»5 prospect；«civil»3 war
patterns.context: 描述压迫性天气、危机增长或政治冲突升级时，突出表示强烈、严峻或难以预料的词。
patterns.domain: 个人经历、国际新闻、政治评论

patterns.name: 控制、统治或强势占据
patterns.trigger: government« control»9；«liberated»9 the city；under the« rule»4；«strong»hold in«5» the country
patterns.context: 武装组织或政治势力控制、统治或夺取城市及领土的叙述。

patterns.name: 政治机构与政治人物地位
patterns.context: 政治报道中描述党内权力结构、候选人领先地位或国际政治会议。

patterns.name: 争议性政策类别与身份标签
patterns.context: 雇佣平等声明及对平权行动与机会平等是否相容的讨论。
patterns.domain: 雇佣声明、社会政策讨论

patterns.name: 俄语词片段及句法边界
patterns.context: 俄语文本中，激活落在被拆分的词内片段与句子/段落边界附近；看不出与其他段落的语义联系。

en.concept: Degrees of change, rates, and levels
en.description: Activation primarily occurs when rate is modified by degrees such as high, higher, or low, or when medical-indicator levels are preceded by high/higher; sporadic activations also occur in real-estate market and startup competition contexts.

patterns.name: Degree or frequency modifiers before “rate”
patterns.context: rate denotes frequency of occurrence, growth speed, or dosage rate; it is often preceded by modifiers such as high, higher, or low, and can appear in the “at a … rate” construction.
patterns.domain: Expository or academic texts on medicine, public health, commodity supply, network technology, and other topics

patterns.name: High/low degree modifiers before “levels”
patterns.context: levels refers to numerical values of medical indicators such as hematocrit or GFR, and combines with degree adjectives.

patterns.name: Description of a strong housing market
patterns.context: Describes two expensive Canadian housing markets as remaining strong, without rate or levels.

patterns.name: Startup customers and competitors
patterns.context: Discusses startups pursuing high-end customers, adjusting their customer base, and winning customers from established businesses.

4_1405.description: 主要激活于 rate 前有 high、higher、low 等程度修饰，或医学指标 levels 前有 high/higher 的语境；另见房地产市场和初创企业竞争语境。

patterns.name: “rate”前的程度或频率修饰
patterns.trigger: «rate»；常见搭配为“high rate”“higher rate”“low dose rates”
patterns.context: rate 表示发生频率、增长速度或剂量率；前面常有 high、higher、low 等修饰语，且可出现在“at a … rate”结构中。
patterns.domain: 医学、公共卫生、商品供应、网络技术等说明性或学术文本

patterns.name: “levels”前的高低程度修饰
patterns.context: levels 指血细胞比容或 GFR 等医学指标的数值水平；与程度形容词组合。

patterns.name: 住房市场的强势描述
patterns.context: 描述加拿大两个昂贵住房市场仍然坚挺，未出现 rate 或 levels。

patterns.name: 初创企业客户与竞争者
patterns.context: 讨论初创企业争取高端客户、调整客户基础，并从既有企业手中争取客户。

en.concept: Heterogeneous word forms and degree expressions
en.description: Activations occur in superlatives, comparatives, quantity or range expressions, and also on common suffixes, internal word fragments, prepositions, and articles; there is also an isolated activation in the middle of a weather term and one in a concessive construction, with no unified trigger condition overall.

patterns.name: Degree or quantity limits/extremes
patterns.context: Trigger words often appear in expressions of degree, ranking, range, or magnitude of change; sometimes a following noun completes the phrase, and they can also occur as part of a comparative or superlative.
patterns.domain: Across fields: medicine, housing and business, geography, finance, etc.

patterns.name: Internal suffix or word-form fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword fragment within a complete word or at its ending; there is no apparent consistent semantic or grammatical condition.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres and vocabulary, including news, business, and academic texts

patterns.name: Specific English function words or phrase positions
patterns.context: Common prepositions, articles, or connectors activate in different collocations and syntactic positions; the conditions are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Middle of a climate or weather word
patterns.context: Appears inside an adverb describing overcast conditions, near mentions of no sunshine and winter; a single instance.

patterns.name: Word-form fragment expressing agreement/concession
patterns.context: Used to introduce a situation coexisting with the preceding assessment in a description of market performance; a single instance.

4_1405.description: 激活分布在最高级、比较级、数量或范围表达中，也落在常见后缀及词内片段、介词冠词等功能词上；另有天气词中部及让步结构的单例，整体触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: 程度或数量上限/极值
patterns.context: 触发词多出现在程度、排名、范围或变化幅度的表达中；有时由后接的名词补足，也可作为比较级或最高级的一部分。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：医学、住房与商业、地理、金融等

patterns.name: 词内后缀或词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词内部或词尾的子词片段；没有明显一致的词义或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 多种文体及词汇，含新闻、商业和学术文本

patterns.name: 特定英语功能词或短语位置
patterns.trigger: «in»（“in Toronto”“«in» *p38δ*”“«in» December”）、«after»（“«after» their Q3 earnings”“immediately «after» the operation”）、«a»（“at «a» lower Hct levels”“«a» terrible mistake”）
patterns.context: 常见介词、冠词或连接成分，在不同搭配与句法位置中激活；条件不统一。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文及学术文本

patterns.name: 气候与天气词中部
patterns.context: 出现在描述阴云密布的副词内部，附近提到无阳光与冬季；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 同意/让步词形片段
patterns.context: 在描述市场表现时，用于引出与前述判断并存的情况；单例。

en.concept: Expressions of quantity or degree extremes
en.description: Strong responses often fall on words denoting level, content, or quantity, such as levels/level, content, and quantities, especially in biomedical contexts; sporadic responses also occur on most and superlative -est forms.

patterns.name: Quantity/degree contexts for levels
patterns.context: Biomedical text describing blood, physiological, or experimental indicator levels; the neuron primarily marks levels, and also the adjacent level

patterns.name: Local collocations for indicator content or levels
patterns.context: Biomedical text discussing genome composition, plasma protein levels, or quantities of substances; levels need not appear

patterns.name: Superlatives and expressions of extreme position
patterns.context: Superlative suffixes or expressions of the highest degree occur in geographical extremes and proverbial metaphors

4_1405.concept: 数量或程度的极值表达
4_1405.description: 强响应常落在 levels/level、content、quantities 等表示水平、含量或数量的词上，尤其是生物医学指标语境；另有 most、-est 最高级形式的零星响应。

patterns.name: levels 的数量/程度词语境
patterns.trigger: «levels»10；前置修饰包括 «lower»、«low Pi»、«lower glucose»、«lower leptin»、«lower B»NP
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中描述血液、生理或实验指标的水平；神经元主要标记 levels，也见紧邻的 level
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要及生物医学论文

patterns.name: 指标含量或水平的局部搭配
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中谈论基因组组成、血浆蛋白水平或物质数量；未必出现 levels
patterns.domain: 微生物基因组、临床/生理研究

patterns.name: 最高级与极限位置表达
patterns.context: 最高级词尾或最高程度表达出现在地理极限、格言式比喻中
patterns.domain: 历史/气候论述；网络评论

en.description: The strongest pattern is sensitivity to levels in biomedical contexts, commonly lower/low levels and descriptions of indicator levels; there are also sporadic responses to the -est in weakest, material content, and price-cap phrases.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantification after levels
patterns.context: levels refers to the level of a physiological indicator or quantity, often preceded by lower/low and followed by a value, prepositional phrase, or related description; sometimes it appears without low/lower.

patterns.name: lowest/superlative construction
patterns.context: The suffix -est forms a superlative; this example occurs in the maxim-like expression “your weakest point”.

patterns.name: Percentage by weight
patterns.context: content refers to the nitrogen content of a material and is reported as a percentage by weight; the sentence compares candidate additives.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology, materials or agricultural chemistry

patterns.name: Price limits in political economy
patterns.context: rate cap refers to a wholesale price cap, appearing in a discussion of an institution filing a petition and the position of a utility.

4_1405.description: 最强模式是生物医学语境中对 levels 的敏感，常见 lower/low levels 及指标水平描述；另对 weakest 的 -est、材料含量及价格上限短语有零星响应。

patterns.name: levels 后的数字与量化表达
patterns.context: levels 表示某种生理指标或量的水平，前面常有 lower/low，后接数值、介词短语或相关描述；有时不带 low/lower。

patterns.name: lowest/superlative 结构
patterns.context: 词尾 -est 构成最高级；此例位于格言式表达“your weakest point”中。

patterns.name: 数值单位百分比
patterns.context: content 指材料中的氮含量，并以重量百分比报告；句中比较候选添加剂。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、材料或农业化学

patterns.name: 政治经济中的价格限制
patterns.trigger: “lower« the»3« rate»2 cap« on»1 wholesale« prices»2”
patterns.context: rate cap 指批发价格上限，出现在机构提交请愿及公用事业立场的讨论中。

en.concept: Measurement levels and sporadic lexical triggers
en.description: Primarily responds strongly to levels denoting measurements in biomedical contexts, including hematocrit, testosterone, phosphate, leptin, BNP, GFR, and Hp; sporadic triggers also include electricity price caps, the title of governor, and markets falling out of favor.

patterns.name: Nominalized measurement contexts after levels
patterns.context: levels appears in noun phrases describing physiological, clinical, or experimental measurements, often modified by degree terms such as low/high or followed by elements such as in/present; the subject matter varies across disciplines.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and body text

patterns.name: Rate cap in electricity markets
patterns.context: Discusses TURN and PG&E filing petitions to lower the wholesale electricity price cap.

patterns.name: Governor as a political title
patterns.context: Uses the title when referring to political figure Scott Walker.

patterns.name: Unfavorable stock-market trend
patterns.context: Describes a company’s trading background and an independent online market weakening and losing favor.

4_1405.concept: 测量水平及零散词汇触发
4_1405.description: 主要对生物医学语境中表示测量值的 levels 强烈响应，涵盖血细胞比容、睾酮、磷酸盐、瘦素、BNP、GFR 与 Hp；另有电价上限、州长称谓及市场失宠等零散触发。

patterns.name: levels 后的名词化测量语境
patterns.context: levels 出现在描述生理、临床或实验测量的名词短语中，常由低/高等程度词修饰，或后接 in/present 等成分；不同学科对象各异。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要与正文

patterns.name: 电力市场中的 rate cap
patterns.context: 讨论 TURN 与 PG&E 提交请愿、降低批发电价上限。

patterns.name: 政治人物称谓中的 Governor
patterns.context: 在提及政治人物 Scott Walker 时使用职务称谓。

patterns.name: 股市不利趋势
patterns.context: 描述公司交易背景及独立网络市场走弱、失去青睐。

en.description: Primarily responds to English levels, especially in medical contexts describing physiological measures or concentrations; also shows sporadic responses to president, economic and market-related words, and the superlative ending in weakest, with no consistent morphological or semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Physiological or measurement levels
patterns.context: Indicates the level of a physiological measure, experimental quantity, or substance concentration, often alongside high/lower, a numerical range, or a disease state; [1], [3], [7], [9], [10].

patterns.name: Presidential title
patterns.context: The presidential office appears in political text, with activation on president; includes both assertive and hypothetical contexts.

patterns.name: Market and economic conditions
patterns.context: Economic reporting about financial systems, housing markets, high prices, or speculative activity; the precise trigger location varies.
patterns.domain: Canadian financial and housing market reporting

patterns.name: Expression for the weakest link
patterns.context: In the fixed comparative expression “weakest point”, activation falls on the word-final superlative marker est; the preceding text discusses strength and dependency.

4_1405.description: 主要响应英语 levels，尤其医学语境中描述生理指标或浓度；另对 president、经济市场相关词及 weakest 的最高级词尾有零散响应，触发形态和语义并不统一。

patterns.name: 生理或测量水平
patterns.trigger: «levels»（[1] 的 «ct»«levels»；[3] 的 G«FR»«levels»；[7] 的 Pi«levels»；[9] 的 «levels»；[10] 的 «levels»）
patterns.context: 表示生理指标、实验量或物质浓度的高低，常与 high/lower、数值范围或疾病状态搭配；[1]、[3]、[7]、[9]、[10]。

patterns.name: 总统称谓
patterns.trigger: «president»，前有国家或政治人物语境（如 «black»«president»、U.S. «president»、«Conservative»«President»）
patterns.context: 政治文本中出现总统职务称谓，激活落在 president；包括肯定与假设语境。
patterns.domain: 新闻、政治评论、网络讨论

patterns.name: 市场与经济状况
patterns.context: 围绕金融系统、住房市场、价格昂贵或投机活动的经济报道；具体触发位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 加拿大金融与住房市场报道

patterns.name: 最弱环节表达
patterns.context: 固定比较表达“weakest point”中，激活落在词尾最高级标记 est；前文谈论强弱与依赖关系。

en.description: Activation is scattered across political figures and titles, statistical percentages, medical indicators, economic housing reports, dates, and several within-word fragments; no single stable semantic pattern is apparent, and common words activate sporadically.

patterns.name: Specific suffixes split within words
patterns.context: The triggering substring is a marked fragment inside a word, especially a word-final fragment or consecutive morphemes; seen in news bylines and historical narratives.

patterns.name: Political figures or titles in political news
patterns.context: Political figures, legislators’ titles, or party words appear in biographical, campaign, and political news contexts; some activation falls on word fragments.

patterns.name: Percentages and demographic statements
patterns.context: Age, gender composition, and percentages appear together in demographic or city profiles.

patterns.name: Word-final led in news headlines or reports
patterns.context: Appears in news headlines and descriptions of legislators’ names, with activation concentrated on an internal word fragment.

patterns.name: Time and quarter expressions in news reports
patterns.context: Reports discuss exports by quarter or include a dated byline; these words do not match other major trigger patterns in their sentences.

patterns.name: Clinical transfusion and hemoglobin levels
patterns.context: Discusses clinical applications of oxygen carriers, surgery, and transfusion, mentioning lower hematocrit levels.

patterns.name: Economic housing-market statements
patterns.context: Activation falls on a superlative fragment in descriptions of housing markets in two high-priced Canadian cities.

patterns.name: Local activations not assignable to a clear pattern
patterns.context: These common words or fragments occur in different domains, and the available excerpts show no unified trigger condition.

4_1405.description: 激活分散于政治人物与职务、统计百分比、医学指标、经济住房报道、日期及若干词内片段；未见单一稳定语义模式，且有常见词的零散激活。

patterns.name: 词内拆分的特定后缀
patterns.context: 触发子串是被拆分标记的词内部片段，尤其是词尾或连续词素；见于新闻署名和历史叙述。

patterns.name: 政治新闻中的政治人物或职务称谓
patterns.context: 政治人物、议员职务或政党词出现在人物介绍、竞选和政治新闻语境中；部分激活落在词的片段上。
patterns.domain: 政治新闻、百科人物传记

patterns.name: 百分比及人口统计表述
patterns.context: 人口统计或城市概况中，年龄、性别构成及百分比相邻出现。

patterns.name: 新闻标题或报道中的词尾 led
patterns.context: 出现在新闻标题及议员姓名的描述中，激活集中于单词内部片段。

patterns.name: 新闻报道中的时间与季度表述
patterns.context: 报道涉及按季度描述的出口情况，或附带日期的署名；这些词与所在句子的其他主要触发模式并不一致。

patterns.name: 临床输血与血红蛋白水平
patterns.context: 讨论氧载体临床应用、手术和输血时，提及较低的血细胞比容水平。

patterns.name: 经济住房市场表述
patterns.context: 在加拿大两座高房价城市的住房市场描述中，激活落在最高级词片段。

patterns.name: 无法归入清晰模式的局部激活
patterns.trigger: « over»、« at»、« of»、« in»、« born»、« worth»
patterns.context: 这些常见词或词片段分别出现在不同领域，现有片段未显示统一的触发条件。

en.concept: place rankings and other local word forms
en.description: Strongly activates mainly when place denotes a competition or database ranking; also appears with political office, nomination, governing, and comparative adjective suffixes. These uses are dispersed across different contexts.

patterns.name: place in a ranking
patterns.context: In competition, league, or database rankings, place denotes a rank; usually near ordinal or ranking information.

patterns.name: Political office and nomination
patterns.context: Accounts of political figures holding public office, receiving a party nomination, or running for a seat.

patterns.name: Political power and governing
patterns.context: Discusses a party's interest in maintaining the status quo and remaining in power.

patterns.name: Comparative adjective suffix
patterns.context: The suffix of a comparative form is marked; the examples describe spring and the condition of fish and birds.

4_1405.description: 主要在 place 表示比赛或数据库名次时强烈激活，也见于政治职位、提名、执政，以及比较级形容词后缀；这些用法分散于不同语境。

patterns.name: 名次或排名中的 place
patterns.trigger: « place»10、« place»9、« seventh»2 « place»9、« fourth»2 « place»9
patterns.context: 描述比赛、联赛或数据库排名时，place 表示名次；多为序数词或排名信息附近。

patterns.name: 政治职位与提名
patterns.trigger: « governor»6 « of»6、« governor»5、« nominee»10、« Senate»6 « seat»9
patterns.context: 政治人物担任公职、获得政党提名或竞选席位的叙述。

patterns.name: 政治权力与执政
patterns.context: 谈及政党维持现状及其继续执政的利益。

patterns.name: 比较级形容词后缀
patterns.context: 比较级词形的后缀部分被标记；此处分别描述春季和鱼类、鸟类的状况。
patterns.domain: 自然环境说明、评论性文章

en.description: Activation primarily falls on place/ordinal rankings in ranking contexts and the ain fragment in split chieftain; nominee also appears in political contexts. A shared feature may be word endings or ranking expressions, but the patterns are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: place/rank in rankings
patterns.context: Describes relative rankings of databases, leagues, or competitions; ordinals, placements, and “place” often appear.

patterns.name: Ordinal numbers and ranking endings
patterns.context: Ordinal ranks or “which place” expressions, especially an ordinal followed by place; also includes separated-token ordinal words.

patterns.name: Split fragment in chieftain
patterns.context: The word chieftain or chieftainship is split into multiple tokens, with strong activation concentrated on the ain fragment.

patterns.name: Political nomination term nominee
patterns.context: nominee in political contexts involving parties, candidates, or elections.

4_1405.description: 激活主要落在排名语境的 place/序数名次，以及被拆分的 chieftain 中 ain 片段；另见政治语境 nominee。共同点可能是词尾或名次表达，但各模式并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 排名中的 place/名次
patterns.context: 描述数据库、联赛或赛事的相对排名；常出现序数、名次及“place”

patterns.name: 序数词及名次结尾
patterns.context: 名次序数或“第几名”表述，尤其序数后接 place；也包括 separated token 的序数词

patterns.name: chieftain 的分词片段
patterns.context: 单词 chieftain 或 chieftainship 被拆成多个 token，强激活集中在 ain 片段

patterns.name: 政治提名词 nominee
patterns.context: 政党与候选人、选举等政治语境中的 nominee
patterns.domain: 政治百科、选举研究文章

en.description: Primarily responds to ordinal rankings and “place”, especially sports results and rankings; also responds to accounts of elections, political parties, and seats, with sporadic activations on names, word endings, and party politics.

patterns.name: Ranking or placement expressions
patterns.context: Ordinal numbers combine with place, or rank is expressed as “in + ordinal”; commonly found in rankings, competition results, or season summaries.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, encyclopedia entries, forum discussions

patterns.name: Political elections and seats
patterns.context: Involves candidates, parties, election outcomes, or seats; activation falls on election- and seat-related words.

patterns.name: Word endings in names or titles
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on internal or final fragments of proper names or common words, with no clear shared semantic condition locally.

patterns.name: Party-related words in political contexts
patterns.context: In U.S. political reporting, a party name is followed by a word related to a primary.

4_1405.description: 主要响应序数名次及“place”，尤其是体育成绩与排名；也响应选举、政党和议席叙述，并有零星人名或词尾及党派政治用例。

patterns.name: 名次或排名表达
patterns.trigger: “4th place of all open-source databases”“finish in third place”“finish in fourth place”“equal sixth place”“5th place”
patterns.context: 名次序数词与 place 搭配，或名次由“in + 序数词”表达；多出现在排名、比赛结果或赛季总结中。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、百科条目、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 政治选举及席位叙述
patterns.trigger: “bye election”“member of the … Dal”“lost the … seat”“nominee in the race for … Senate seat”
patterns.context: 涉及候选人、政党、选举胜负或议席；激活落在选举和席位相关词语上。

patterns.name: 人名或称谓中的词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名或普通词的内部/结尾片段，局部没有明确的共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 政治语境中的党派词
patterns.context: 美国政治报道中，党派名称后接初选相关词。

en.description: Primarily responds to ranking expressions, especially ordinal numerals or words followed by place; it also activates on quarter expressions and strings related to parties, election wins and losses, and control of government.

patterns.name: Ordinal rankings and placements
patterns.context: In ranking, placement, or competition-result expressions, especially ordinal words followed by place; numerals and ordinal suffixes may also trigger separately.
patterns.domain: Database rankings, sports reports, and profiles of people/teams

patterns.name: quarter after a quantity or proportion
patterns.context: Appears in the time phrases “second quarter” and “first quarter,” describing export levels.
patterns.domain: News reports, economic or energy information

patterns.name: Political parties and power outcomes in elections
patterns.context: Party names appear alongside election wins or losses, control, or governing power; also concerns parliamentary election results.

4_1405.description: 主要响应名次表达，尤其是序数数字或词语加 place；另对季度用语及政党、选举胜负和执政权相关词串有激活。

patterns.name: 序数排名与名次
patterns.context: 在名次、排名或比赛结果表达中，尤其是序数词及其后的 place；数字和序数后缀也可能分别触发。
patterns.domain: 数据库排名、体育赛事报道及人物/球队简介

patterns.name: 数量或比例后的 quarter
patterns.context: 出现在表示季度的时间短语“second quarter”“first quarter”中，描述出口水平。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、经济或能源资讯

patterns.name: 选举中的政党与权力结果
patterns.context: 政党名称与选举胜负、控制权或执政权相邻出现；也涉及议会选举结果。

en.description: Primarily responds to placement expressions in competitions, elections, or lists, especially ordinal numbers (including th/nd/rd) combined with place; nearby result words such as finishing and winning also activate. One passage highlights only primaries in a political context.

patterns.name: Rankings and “place”
patterns.context: Describes a person's or team's placement in competition, election, or list results, commonly in the form ordinal + place or in + rank; paragraph [1] also contains the database ranking phrase “4th place”.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, election results, list discussions

patterns.name: Other competition result words
patterns.context: The same context often contains rankings or competition results, but these words do not always pair with an explicit place ranking.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting and competition result accounts

patterns.name: Political primary context
patterns.context: Political reporting about Trump and his business partners and a proposal to bar Muslims; no explicit ranking or place expression is observed.

4_1405.description: 主要对赛事、选举或榜单中的名次表达起反应，尤其是序数数字（含 th/nd/rd）与 place 的组合；相邻的完赛、获胜等结果词也会激活。另有一段只突出政治语境中的 primaries。

patterns.name: 名次与“place”
patterns.trigger: 序数或排名数字及其后缀，如“4»1«th»4« place»10”、“35»2«th»6« place»9”、“5»2«th»5« place»9”、“2»2«nd»3« place»8”、“3»2«rd»4« place»8”；也包括“fourth»4« place»8”和“second»3« place»8”
patterns.context: 在比赛、选举或榜单结果中描述某人或队伍获得的名次，常见结构为序数 + place，或 in + 名次；第[1]段另有数据库排名表述“4th place”。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事报道、选举结果、榜单讨论

patterns.name: 其他比赛结果词
patterns.context: 同一上下文常出现排名或赛事结果，但这些词本身并不总是与明确的 place 名次搭配。
patterns.domain: 体育报道及竞赛结果叙述

patterns.name: 政治初选语境
patterns.context: 关于特朗普及其商业伙伴、禁入穆斯林提议的政治报道；未见明确的名次或 place 表达。

en.description: Activation is scattered across people’s titles and within-word fragments, political figures’ names, ordinal rankings and place, the phrase favor of, election victories, and seats; the commonality is weak, with no single stable semantic or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: Within-word continuation of people, titles, or offices
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of words related to historical figures, political offices, or rule; sometimes these are words formed across tokens, especially in biographies or political narratives.

patterns.name: Ordinal rankings and placement phrases
patterns.context: A ranking number is followed by place, indicating a leaderboard or competition position; activation is concentrated on place.

patterns.name: Word continuation in favor
patterns.context: Appears in the phrase favor of a competitor in a context of competition or gains and losses; the strongest marker falls on favor.
patterns.domain: Expository texts on business competition and information security

patterns.name: Seats or election outcomes after a win
patterns.context: Describes candidates or politicians winning elections and gaining seats; markers fall on winning and seats.

patterns.name: Name following the governor abbreviation
patterns.context: A political figure’s name follows the abbreviation Gov.; this pattern occurs only here, with activation varying in strength across the abbreviation and period.

patterns.name: Fragments of a monarch’s name not clearly fitting other patterns
patterns.context: A narrative about a religious figure influencing someone’s thought or political views mentions Tsar Alexander I; activation is concentrated within the name and on the Roman numeral.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic narratives on religious and European history

4_1405.concept: 政治与排名相关词语碎片
4_1405.description: 激活分散在人物职衔及其词内片段、政治人物姓名、序数名次与 place、favor of 短语、选举获胜及席位等处；共同点较弱，未见单一稳定的词义或语法条件。

patterns.name: 人物、头衔或职务词的词内续写
patterns.context: 激活落在与历史人物、政治职务或统治相关词语的片段上；有时是跨 token 拼成的词，尤其见于人物传记或政治叙述。

patterns.name: 序数名次及名次短语
patterns.context: 名次数字后接 place，表示排行榜或比赛中的排名；激活集中在 place。

patterns.name: favor 的词语续写
patterns.context: 在竞争或利益得失的语境中，出现在 favor of a competitor 短语；最强标记落在 favor。
patterns.domain: 关于商业竞争、信息安全的说明文

patterns.name: 获胜后的席位或选举结果
patterns.context: 描述候选人或政客在选举中获胜并取得议席；标记落在 winning、seats。

patterns.name: 州长缩写后的姓名
patterns.context: 缩写 Gov. 后接政治人物姓名；只在此处看到此模式，激活强弱分布在缩写及句点。

patterns.name: 未明显归入其他模式的君主姓名碎片
patterns.context: 宗教人物影响其思想或政治观点的叙述中，出现 Tsar Alexander I；激活集中于姓名词内部及罗马数字。
patterns.domain: 宗教史与欧洲史百科叙述

en.description: Most activations occur on ordinal suffixes in numerical rankings and near place, covering competition rankings, team season records, and other rankings; there are also activations related to political office, as well as proper-name and word-ending activations that do not fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffixes and place in rankings
patterns.context: Describes rankings, placements, or competition results; the number and ordinal suffix are usually adjacent, followed by place
patterns.domain: Sports results, database rankings, encyclopedia or forum texts about elections and local politics

patterns.name: Political figures and elected office
patterns.context: Biographies of political figures introduce office-holding, candidacy, or nomination; no single consistent trigger word is evident

patterns.name: Unexplained proper names and word endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized fragments of proper names or word endings, with no clear nearby ranking expression

4_1405.description: 多数激活出现在数字名次的序数后缀及 place 附近，涉及竞赛排名、球队赛季成绩和其他排名；另有政治职务相关激活，以及无法归入主模式的专名和词尾激活。

patterns.name: 名次中的序数后缀与 place
patterns.trigger: 数字后接 «th» / «st» 并出现 «place»，如 «4»«th»« place»、«5»«th»« place»、«35»«th»« place»、«7»«th»« place»、«9»«th»« place»
patterns.context: 描述排名、名次或竞赛结果；数字和序数后缀通常紧邻，随后出现 place
patterns.domain: 体育赛果、数据库排名、选举与地方政治等百科或论坛文本

patterns.name: 政治人物与选举职务
patterns.trigger: «Political» life、« school» « trustee»、« Democratic» « Party» « nominee»
patterns.context: 政治人物传记中介绍任职、参选或获提名；未见稳定的单一触发词

patterns.name: 未解释的专名与词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在分词后的专名片段或词尾，附近没有明显的名次表达

en.description: Primarily responds to candidates, offices, victories, terms, rankings, polls, and seats in political election contexts; also responds to political-process terms. The fish-disease sentence in paragraph 5 does not fit this main pattern; activation may be related to name spellings later in the text.

patterns.name: Political figures and election victories or defeats
patterns.context: Narratives about political figures campaigning, being elected, winning, or being reelected, often adjacent to offices, constituencies, terms, or election results.
patterns.domain: News, political commentary, biographies, election coverage

patterns.name: Political polls and voter attitudes
patterns.context: Reports poll percentages and voter attitudes toward candidates or policy issues.

patterns.name: Rankings and positions
patterns.context: Explicitly gives a database or candidate's position or ranking; “third” also appears in political campaign results.

patterns.name: General contest results or victories
patterns.context: Describes winning seats or holding a lead; one instance concerns seats after a federal election, another a percentage-point lead in a Kenyan election.

patterns.name: Political processes and institutions
patterns.context: Discusses campaigns, party behavior, political life, or parliamentary elections, without necessarily stating who won.
patterns.domain: Political commentary, biographies, and election coverage

patterns.name: Disease description co-occurring incidentally with political topics
patterns.context: Describes fish disease in an environmental or fisheries context; activation tokens also include the later subword fragments “«ov»” and “«.»” from a political figure's name.
patterns.domain: Environmental policy news and personal names

4_1405.description: 主要响应政治选举语境中的候选人、职位、胜选、任期、排名、民调和席位；也响应政治过程词。第5段鱼病语句无法归入该主模式，激活或与后文姓名拼写有关。

patterns.name: 政治人物与选举胜负
patterns.context: 政治人物的竞选、当选、胜选或连任叙述，常与职位、选区、任期或选举结果相邻。
patterns.domain: 新闻、政治评论、人物传记、选举报道

patterns.name: 政治民调与选民态度
patterns.context: 报道民调比例及选民对候选人或政策议题的态度。
patterns.domain: 选举新闻与公共议题报道

patterns.name: 排名与名次
patterns.context: 明确给出数据库或候选人的名次、排序位置；其中“third”也出现在政治竞选结果中。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、人物选举传记

patterns.name: 一般的竞赛结果或胜出
patterns.context: 描述取得席位或领先优势；一处是联邦选举后的席位，一处是肯尼亚选举中的百分点领先。

patterns.name: 政治过程与政治机构
patterns.context: 讨论竞选、党派行为、政治生活或议会选举，未必直接陈述胜负。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、传记及选举报道

patterns.name: 与政治话题偶然同现的疾病描述
patterns.context: 环境或渔业议题中描述鱼类疾病；激活 token 同时还包括后文政治人物姓名的拼写片段“«ov»”“«.»”。
patterns.domain: 环境政策新闻与人物姓名

en.description: Activations concentrate on wins and losses, rankings, candidates, and offices in political and election contexts; they also occur in government decisions, legislation, and election lists, as well as database and company rankings and a Portuguese word for government resolution.

patterns.name: Rankings and placements
patterns.context: A database, company, or candidate's relative ranking, placement, or ordering appears, usually within a noun phrase.

patterns.name: Competition results and wins or losses
patterns.context: Discusses success, leading, winning, or an outcome favoring one side, often involving a campaign or election.

patterns.name: Election- and political office-related words
patterns.context: Political candidates, elections, terms of office, or positions such as president/senator appear; activation falls on related words and their subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Political news, legal texts, encyclopedia entries, email

patterns.name: Election headings and list formats
patterns.context: Headings or tabular entries such as election names, years, and candidate lists; often accompanied by line breaks and years.

patterns.name: Government decisions and legislative processes
patterns.context: Content related to government officials, Congress, or administrative decisions; the trigger may be an office, institution, or its actions.

patterns.name: Government and resolution words in Portuguese
patterns.context: Portuguese text contains words for government, decision, or council; activation is distributed across subwords within the words.

4_1405.description: 激活集中在政治与选举语境中的胜负、排名、候选人和职位，也见于政府决策、立法与选举列表；另有数据库和公司排名，以及葡语政府决议词。

patterns.name: 排名与名次
patterns.context: 出现数据库、公司或候选人的相对排名、名次或排序；通常位于名词短语中。

patterns.name: 竞赛结果与胜负
patterns.context: 谈论成功、领先、胜出或结果偏向某方，常涉及竞选或选举。

patterns.name: 选举与政治职位相关词
patterns.context: 出现政治候选人、选举、任期或总统/参议员等职位；激活落在相关词及其子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 政治新闻、法律文本、百科条目、邮件

patterns.name: 选举标题及列表格式
patterns.context: 选举名称、年份、候选人列表等标题或表格式条目；常伴随换行和年份。

patterns.name: 政府决策及立法程序
patterns.context: 政府官员、国会或行政决策相关内容；触发可能由职位、机构或其行动引起。

patterns.name: 葡语中的政府与决议词
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语文本中出现政府、决定或理事会等词；激活分布在词内子词。

en.description: Primarily responds to words such as elections/election, run/ran, and win/won in election and candidacy contexts; also responds to wins, runner-up finishes, and ranking expressions in contests. It is also activated by British political commentary containing “Tories”.

patterns.name: Elections, candidacy, and political victories
patterns.context: Describes candidates running for office, winning elections or reelection, or forecasts election outcomes; triggers often fall on election terms, victory verbs, and nearby political context.
patterns.domain: Political news, election entries, and political biographies

patterns.name: Contest rankings and awards
patterns.context: Identifies winners, runners-up, or final placements in contest results, rankings, or prize lists; distinct from political elections but similarly concerns competitive outcomes.

patterns.name: British Conservative Party political context
patterns.context: Mentions the British Conservative Party and discusses austerity and public assets; contains no explicit description of an election or victory.

4_1405.description: 主要响应选举与参选语境中的 elections/election、run/ran、win/won 等词；也响应赛事中的获胜、亚军和名次表达。另对“Tories”所在的英国政治评论有激活。

patterns.name: 选举、参选及政治胜选叙述
patterns.context: 描述候选人参选、赢得选举或连任，或预测选举结果；触发常落在选举词、胜选动词及其邻近政治语境中。
patterns.domain: 政治新闻、选举条目与政治人物传记

patterns.name: 竞赛名次与奖项结果
patterns.context: 在比赛结果、名次或奖金列表中，说明获胜者、亚军或最终名次；与政治选举不同，但同样涉及竞争结果。

patterns.name: 英国保守党相关政治语境
patterns.context: 出现英国保守党称谓，谈及紧缩政策及公共资产；没有明确选举或胜选描述。

en.description: Primarily responds to terms related to winning, reelection, candidates, and party competition in election and political-power contexts; also covers government statements, challenges to the political order, and a win and runner-up finish in a nonpolitical contest.

patterns.name: Political figures or parties winning elections
patterns.context: Candidates, parties, or political forces win elections, seek reelection, or compete for power; sometimes co-occurs with election results, campaigning, or term conditions.
patterns.domain: News coverage, election entries, and political commentary

patterns.name: Election procedures and events
patterns.context: Describes election dates, constituencies, candidates, election petitions, or post-election changes in seats; may not explicitly state who won.

patterns.name: Political power and competition
patterns.context: Discusses party power, political organizations, ideologies, or political competition, without necessarily describing voting results.
patterns.domain: Political commentary and histories of figures and parties

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary governance language
patterns.context: Portuguese text mentions a new government; activation falls on the split word form govern-.

patterns.name: Victory in a nonpolitical contest
patterns.context: Identifies a champion and runner-up in an entertainment contest rather than a political election.
patterns.domain: Reality TV or music contest encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Political reform or challenges to social order
patterns.context: Describes progressive or labor forces challenging the established social order and the dominance of industrial elites.

4_1405.description: 主要对选举及政治权力语境中的赢得、连任、候选人和政党竞争相关词语反应；也涵盖政府表述、政治秩序挑战，以及一次非政治竞赛中的获胜与亚军。

patterns.name: 政治人物或政党赢得选举
patterns.context: 候选人、政党或政治力量在选举中获胜、连任或争取权力；有时与选举结果、竞选或任期条件同现。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、选举条目及政治评论

patterns.name: 选举程序与选举事件
patterns.context: 描述选举日期、选区、候选人、选举请愿或选举后的席位更替；不一定出现明确的获胜表述。

patterns.name: 政治权力与政治竞争
patterns.context: 讨论政党权力、政治组织、意识形态或政治竞争，不必直接描述投票结果。
patterns.domain: 政治评论与人物、政党历史

patterns.name: 葡语议会治理表述
patterns.context: 葡语文本中谈到新政府；激活落在被拆分的 govern-词形上。

patterns.name: 非政治比赛获胜
patterns.context: 娱乐竞赛中陈述冠军与亚军，而非政治选举。
patterns.domain: 真人秀或音乐竞赛百科条目

patterns.name: 政治改革或社会秩序挑战
patterns.context: 描述进步派或劳工力量对既有社会秩序、工业精英支配地位的挑战。

en.description: Primarily activates on “place” in ordinal ranking phrases and on ranking expressions; also appears in contexts involving election victories, candidacy, and terms of office, as well as political office terms and sporadic activations on “faces”.

patterns.name: Ranking phrase “place”
patterns.context: Indicates a placement in a competition, ranking, or list; usually modified by an ordinal, occasionally hyphenated
patterns.domain: News, web discussions, biographies, and sports reporting

patterns.name: Winning and placement in elections
patterns.context: Political election reporting describes a candidate winning, running, serving a term, or placing

patterns.name: Ranking or list position
patterns.context: Describes a company or database's position in a ranking; ranking may be based on market size or criteria such as an open-source database

patterns.name: Sports competition placement
patterns.context: An athlete or racehorse's placement in an event or challenge

patterns.name: Political identity and constituency labels
patterns.context: Biographical or political career passages mention an office, position, or constituency; not necessarily related to ranking expressions

patterns.name: Political processes and election vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses campaigns, party interests, governance, or election prospects, without necessarily containing an explicit ranking phrase

patterns.name: Word-form activation of unclear relation
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence about inequality in the UK; context alone does not establish its relation to other patterns

4_1405.description: 主要对序数名次短语中的“place”及排名表达激活，也见于选举获胜、参选和任期语境；另有政治职务词及“faces”等零散激活。

patterns.name: 名次短语“place”
patterns.context: 表示竞赛、排名或列表中的名次；通常由序数词修饰，偶尔连字符连接
patterns.domain: 新闻、网页讨论、传记及体育报道

patterns.name: 选举中的获胜与名次
patterns.context: 政治选举报道中描述候选人获胜、参选、任期或名次

patterns.name: 排名或榜单位置
patterns.context: 描述公司或数据库在排名中的位置；排名可由市场规模或开放源代码数据库等标准确定

patterns.name: 体育赛事名次
patterns.context: 运动员或赛马在赛事、挑战赛中的名次

patterns.name: 政治身份与选区标签
patterns.context: 人物简介或政治生涯段落中，涉及职务、职位或选区；不一定与名次表达有关

patterns.name: 政治过程与选举语汇
patterns.context: 讨论竞选、政党利益、治理或选举前景，但不必出现明确排名短语

patterns.name: 不明关联的词形激活
patterns.context: 出现在关于英国不平等的句子中；单凭上下文无法确认与其他模式的关系

en.description: Responds strongly to expressions related to elections, candidates, parties, and winning or losing positions; also responds to rankings outside elections, such as company rankings, journal ratings, and contest placements.

patterns.name: Campaigns and political office
patterns.context: Involves candidates running for office, terms, election results, or political figures winning; common in campaign coverage and biographies.
patterns.domain: Political news, biographies of political figures

patterns.name: Parties and electoral power
patterns.context: Discusses party interests, the status quo, governing, and future elections.

patterns.name: Candidates and election results
patterns.context: Reports candidates winning, being reelected, or changes in support during an election.

patterns.name: Rankings and positions
patterns.context: Ranks companies, candidates, journals, or competitors by position, wins and losses, or prize money; not limited to political elections.
patterns.domain: Business rankings, political commentary, journal ratings, sports events

patterns.name: References to people or organizations in news headlines
patterns.context: A news headline uses an abbreviated party name to refer to a political organization and reports its appeal.

4_1405.description: 对选举、候选人、政党及胜败名次相关表达反应明显，也响应非选举领域的名次排序，如公司排名、期刊评选和赛事名次。

patterns.name: 竞选与政治职位
patterns.trigger: «Political» life；«ran» «for» school« trustee»；«Ward» 4；«run» for a «third» term；«wins»
patterns.context: 涉及候选人参选、任期、选举结果或政治人物胜选；常见于竞选报道和人物传记。
patterns.domain: 政治新闻、政治人物传记

patterns.name: 政党与选举权力
patterns.context: 讨论政党利益、维持现状、执政及未来选举。

patterns.name: 候选人及选举结果
patterns.context: 报道候选人胜选、连任或选举中的支持度变化。

patterns.name: 排名与名次
patterns.context: 将公司、候选人、期刊或参赛者按名次、胜负或奖金排序；不是只限政治选举。
patterns.domain: 商业排名、政治评论、期刊评选、体育赛事

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的人物或机构称谓
patterns.context: 新闻标题以缩写党名指称政治组织，并报道其呼吁。

en.description: Primarily responds to placement expressions, especially second/first/fourth place; also responds to runner-up descriptions and political contexts involving winning, reelection, elections, and taking power.

patterns.name: Place in rankings or placements
patterns.context: Describes a position in a competition, challenge, or company ranking, usually following an ordinal or hyphen
patterns.domain: News, biographies, sports, and contest coverage

patterns.name: Victories, losses, and terms in elections or campaigns
patterns.context: Mentions candidates winning, being reelected, campaigning, or their political standing after an election

patterns.name: Runner-up placement expression
patterns.context: Describes a contestant finishing as runner-up in a music contest; activation is near “up”

patterns.name: Unexplained
patterns.context: The paragraph contains ranking or political terms but lacks the same clear trigger structure as other paragraphs, or the activation distribution does not correspond to a single pattern

4_1405.description: 主要响应名次表达，尤以 second/first/fourth place 为代表；也响应竞赛亚军表述，以及政治文本中胜选、连任、选举和掌权相关语境。

patterns.name: 名次/排名中的 place
patterns.trigger: “place”与名次词或数字相邻，如 “second place”“fourth-place”“first place”
patterns.context: 描述比赛、挑战或公司排名中的名次，通常在序数词或连字符后出现
patterns.domain: 新闻、人物传记、体育与竞赛报道

patterns.name: 选举或竞选中的胜负与任期
patterns.trigger: “wins”“won”“re-election”“in power”“next election”等选举结果和权力相关词语
patterns.context: 提及候选人胜选、连任、竞选或选举后的政治地位

patterns.name: runner-up 名次表达
patterns.context: 音乐比赛中描述参赛者获得亚军；激活落在 “up” 附近

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 未能明确由主模式解释的词
patterns.context: 段落虽含排名或政治词汇，但缺少与其他段相同的明确触发结构，或激活分布不对应单一模式

en.description: Primarily responds to placement expressions, especially place and up in runner-up; also responds to wins in political campaigns, some ordinal terms, and lead expressions. Overall, it leans toward contests, rankings, and outcomes, but trigger locations are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Place in placements
patterns.context: Indicates a position in a competition, ranking, or challenge; may follow an ordinal or form part of a compound adjective

patterns.name: Runner-up and variants
patterns.context: Indicates a runner-up or alternate placement in a contest or selection; activation is concentrated on the final word up in runner-up

patterns.name: Election victories and terms
patterns.context: A political figure, if victorious, will enter or be unable to run again for a term; strong activation falls on wins

patterns.name: Preposition in placement phrases
patterns.context: Describes someone taking second place, in the phrase “taking a second place in a … race”

patterns.name: Unresolved local trigger
patterns.context: After a merger, a company rises to second place in a customer-size ranking; it fits the placement theme, but second is additionally highlighted here

patterns.name: Unresolved local trigger
patterns.context: Describes a team leading an opponent; this is not a direct placement marker

patterns.name: Unresolved local trigger
patterns.context: Uses a placement to describe a political figure; strong activation falls on the ordinal rather than place

patterns.name: Unresolved local trigger
patterns.context: A polling lead in political competition; contains no explicit place ranking

patterns.name: Unresolved local trigger
patterns.context: States a final competition placement; activation is on the placement term rather than placed

patterns.name: Unresolved local trigger
patterns.context: A hypothetical election sentence predicting governance after a political figure wins

4_1405.description: 主要对名次表达，尤其 place 及 runner-up 中的 up 强烈响应；也响应政治竞选的 wins、部分名次词和领先表达。整体偏向竞赛、排名及胜负语境，但触发位置不完全一致。

patterns.name: 名次中的place
patterns.context: 表示比赛、排名或挑战中的名次；可在 place 前有序数词，也可作复合形容词的一部分

patterns.name: runner-up及其变体
patterns.context: 表示比赛或选拔中的亚军/候补名次，激活集中在 runner-up 的末词 up
patterns.domain: 餐饮人物介绍、音乐比赛报道

patterns.name: 竞选获胜与任期
patterns.context: 政治人物若获胜将进入或不能再竞选某个任期；强激活落在 wins

patterns.name: 名次短语中的介词
patterns.context: 描述某人取得第二名，短语为“taking a second place in a … race”

patterns.name: 无法归并的局部触发
patterns.trigger: «second»5，处在“propelling the new group to second place”中
patterns.context: 公司合并后在客户规模排名中升至第二；与名次主题相符，但此处额外高亮 second

patterns.name: 无法归并的局部触发
patterns.trigger: «ahead»1，出现在“a full 20 games ahead of the second-place…”
patterns.context: 描述球队领先对手；不是直接名次标记

patterns.name: 无法归并的局部触发
patterns.context: 用名次修饰政治人物；强激活落在序数词而非 place

patterns.name: 无法归并的局部触发
patterns.context: 政治竞争中的民调领先幅度；不含明确 place 名次

patterns.name: 无法归并的局部触发
patterns.context: 陈述赛事最终名次，激活在名次词而非 placed

patterns.name: 无法归并的局部触发
patterns.context: 选举假设句，预测政治人物获胜后的治理

en.concept: rankings and wins or losses in competitions and elections
en.description: Activations mainly fall on phrases for placements and wins or losses in competitions or elections: runner-up, second/fourth place, candidacy, election victories, and losing rankings; there is also a call to action in a news headline and a campaign gaffe.

patterns.name: Placement expression: runner-up
patterns.context: Describes a contestant finishing as runner-up in a talent or singing competition; paragraph 2 has “runner-up to”, paragraph 6 has “runner-up of the third season”, and paragraph 10 has “runner-up”.

patterns.name: Ordinal ranking and place
patterns.context: Describes a company ranking, competition placement, or candidate position; the ranking word is adjacent to place or forms a hyphenated placement phrase.
patterns.domain: Business reporting, political commentary, sports biographies

patterns.name: Election- and outcome-related expressions
patterns.context: Involves running for office, winning an election, or describing candidates by rank; paragraphs 1 and 9 discuss elections and conditions for winning, while paragraph 4 recounts a campaign and lists rankings and the incumbent.

patterns.name: Call to action in a news headline
patterns.context: A headline-style short phrase in which a political group calls for an action; activation concentrates on part of the party name.

patterns.name: Gaffe in a campaign context
patterns.context: Discusses a verbal gaffe in campaign reporting; it co-occurs with election outcome context in the same passage but is not an explicit ranking expression.

4_1405.concept: 竞赛与选举中的名次、胜负
4_1405.description: 激活主要落在比赛或选举中的名次与胜负词句：亚军、第二/第四名、参选、胜选和落选排名；另有一处新闻标题中的呼吁，以及竞选口误表述。

patterns.name: 名次表达：runner-up
patterns.context: 选秀或歌唱比赛中，描述参赛者获得亚军；段2为“runner-up to”，段6为“runner-up of the third season”，段10为“runner-up”。

patterns.name: 序数名次与 place
patterns.context: 描述公司排名、比赛名次或候选人位置；名次词与 place 相邻或以连字符组成名次短语。
patterns.domain: 商业报道、政治评论、体育传记

patterns.name: 选举及胜负相关表达
patterns.context: 涉及参选、赢得选举或按名次描述候选人；段1、9讨论选举及胜选条件，段4记述竞选并列出名次和现任者。
patterns.domain: 政治新闻、政治人物传记

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的呼吁表达
patterns.context: 标题式短句中，政治团体呼吁采取某项行动；激活集中在党派名称的一部分。

patterns.name: 舌误及竞选语境
patterns.trigger: «in» «the» best slip «of» the tongue of the «campaign»（段9）
patterns.context: 竞选报道中讨论口误；与同段选举胜负语境并存，但并非明确名次表达。

en.description: The strongest and most consistent trigger is place in placement phrases, especially an ordinal followed by place, across contests, rankings, and league results. Other related expressions include runner-up, ahead, and third term.

patterns.name: Place in placement results
patterns.context: An ordinal or placement description precedes place, commonly in contest, ranking, or sports results; activation is concentrated on place.
patterns.domain: Rankings, contests, and sports coverage or biographies

patterns.name: Contest victories and first place
patterns.context: Won occurs with first place, or a narrative says someone won a competitive placement.

patterns.name: Ordinal expressions such as second league
patterns.context: An ordinal is part of a league name and describes a team's level or promotion/relegation.

patterns.name: Other placement expressions in ranking, voting, and political contexts
patterns.context: The text concerns journal rankings, election leads, or a political figure's term; these paragraphs lack a prominent place trigger.
patterns.domain: Journal rankings, election coverage, and politics

patterns.name: Company market rankings
patterns.context: A company is expected to rise to a market ranking after a merger and is compared with competitors.

4_1405.description: 最强、最稳定的触发是名次短语中的 place，尤其序数词加 place，涵盖赛事、排名和联赛结果。另有 runner-up、ahead、third term 等排名或序数相关表达。

patterns.name: 名次结果中的 place
patterns.context: place 前出现序数词或名次描述，常见于比赛、排名或体育赛事结果；激活集中在 place。
patterns.domain: 排名、比赛与体育报道或传记

patterns.name: 竞赛获胜与第一名
patterns.context: won 与 first place 连用，或叙述人物赢得比赛名次。

patterns.name: second league 等序数表达
patterns.context: 序数词作为联赛名称的一部分，描述球队级别或升降级。

patterns.name: 名次、投票与政治语境中的其他名次表达
patterns.trigger: “runner»1«-»2«up»10” “was« ahead»3« by»3” “« run»4« for»8 a« third»1« term”
patterns.context: 文本涉及期刊排名、选举领先或政治人物任期；这些段落没有显著的 place 触发形式。
patterns.domain: 期刊排名、选举报道与政治

patterns.name: 公司市场排名
patterns.context: 企业合并后将升至某个市场排名，并与竞争者比较。

en.description: Primarily responds to placements, wins and losses, and relative leads in contest, sports, or election contexts, especially place in placement phrases; also reacts to political campaigns and numerical outcome expressions.

patterns.name: Place in rankings
patterns.context: In placement expressions such as “first/second/fourth-«place»”, activation is concentrated on place; the preceding placement term may vary.

patterns.name: Political elections and campaign results
patterns.context: Describes candidates campaigning, voters, polls, or election results; place need not appear.
patterns.domain: Political news and biographies of political figures

patterns.name: Contest wins and placements
patterns.context: Narrates a person or team winning a contest, achieving a placement, or the win/loss relationship in an event; some examples also include place.
patterns.domain: Singing contests, business competitions, sports events, and music contests

patterns.name: Leading or ranking highly
patterns.context: Compares the relative positions of candidates, teams, or organizations; may overlap with placement expressions or occur independently.
patterns.domain: Political polls, sports coverage, business rankings

patterns.name: General quantity or percentage expressions
patterns.context: Contexts involving values, percentages, or percentage points; activation is weaker and may be related to election outcomes.

4_1405.description: 主要响应竞赛、体育或选举语境中的名次、胜负与相对领先，尤其是名次短语中的 place；也对政治竞选及数字化结果表达有反应。

patterns.name: 排名中的 place
patterns.context: “first/second/fourth-«place»”等名次表达中，激活集中在 place；前置名次词可不同。

patterns.name: 政治选举与竞选结果
patterns.context: 描述候选人竞选、选民、民调或选举结果；不一定出现 place。
patterns.domain: 政治新闻与政治人物传记

patterns.name: 竞赛获胜与名次
patterns.context: 叙述某人或队伍赢得比赛、取得名次，或赛事中的胜负关系；部分例子同时有 place。
patterns.domain: 歌唱比赛、商业竞赛、体育赛事与音乐比赛

patterns.name: 领先或排名靠前
patterns.context: 比较候选人、球队或机构的相对位置；可与名次表达重叠，也可单独出现。
patterns.domain: 政治民调、体育报道、商业排名

patterns.name: 一般数量或比例表达
patterns.context: 数值、百分比或百分点构成的上下文；激活较弱，可能与选举结果相关。

en.description: Primarily responds to runner-up finishes, wins, and relative placements in contests, elections, and ratings; also appears in political campaign language. A few subword fragments within proper names have no clear connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Runner-up placement
patterns.context: Appears in a contest, election, ranking, or rating context; runner-up refers to second place or a losing finalist. Activation is concentrated on up

patterns.name: Winning outcomes
patterns.context: States that a candidate, contestant, or team won an election or contest; often adjacent to placement or victory conditions
patterns.domain: News and encyclopedias, elections, singing contests, sports

patterns.name: Placements and rankings
patterns.context: Describes the relative position of an organization, team, or person in a comparison or list, not necessarily a direct contest

patterns.name: Campaigning and political office
patterns.context: A political figure runs for office, seeks reelection, or campaigns for a position; some trigger words can also mean running generally, so political context is needed

patterns.name: Coincidental subword fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Some trigger fragments occur within proper names, with no reliable connection to placement, victory, or ranking semantics

4_1405.description: 主要响应竞赛、选举和评比中的亚军、胜出及相对名次，也见于政治竞选表述；少数专名词内片段与主模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 亚军名次
patterns.context: 出现比赛、选举、排行榜或评选结果语境，runner-up 指第二名或落败的决赛者；激活集中在 up

patterns.name: 胜出结果
patterns.context: 陈述候选人、选手或团队赢得选举或比赛；常与名次或胜选条件相邻
patterns.domain: 新闻与百科，选举、歌唱比赛、体育

patterns.name: 名次与排名
patterns.context: 描述机构、队伍或个人在比较、榜单中的相对位置，不一定涉及直接竞赛

patterns.name: 竞选与政治职位
patterns.trigger: “« political» «push»”“« run» for … «term»”“« Democratic Party nominee» … «race» for … «Senate» seat”
patterns.context: 政治人物参选、争取连任或竞选职位；部分触发词也可表示一般奔跑，需政治语境

patterns.name: 词内片段与专名偶合
patterns.context: 触发部分落在专名内部，与名次、胜负或排序语义未见可靠联系

en.description: Activations concentrate on expressions of competition and outcomes: running for office, winning or campaigning in political elections, and rankings such as runner-up, placement, and place; also includes a leading score and loses to.

patterns.name: Winning, candidacy, or campaigning in political elections
patterns.context: Political figures run for office, win elections, or discuss campaigns and election outcomes; sometimes in predictions or conditional statements, sometimes in biographies.

patterns.name: runner-up / rankings and place
patterns.context: Describes runner-up finishes and placements in competitions, evaluations, or rankings; includes evaluation contexts such as “runner-up for the top five”.
patterns.domain: Entertainment, academic journal rankings, political campaign reporting, company rankings

patterns.name: Sporadic competition results or comparison structures
patterns.context: Compares entities by score or states who is leading or losing; related to ranking but not a typical runner-up expression.
patterns.domain: Journal evaluations, polls, or news reporting

4_1405.description: 激活集中在竞争与结果表达：政治选举中的参选、获胜或竞选，以及 runner-up、名次、place 等排名说法；另见领先分数和 loses to。

patterns.name: 政治选举中的获胜、参选或竞选
patterns.context: 政治人物参选、赢得选举或讨论竞选及选举结果；有时是预测或条件句，有时是人物履历。
patterns.domain: 新闻政治报道、政治人物传记

patterns.name: runner-up／名次与 place
patterns.context: 描述比赛、评选或排名中的亚军及名次；包括“runner-up for the top five”这类评选语境。
patterns.domain: 娱乐、学术期刊排名、政治竞选报道、企业排名

patterns.name: 零散的竞赛结果或比较结构
patterns.context: 以分数比较对象或陈述领先、落败；含义与排名相关，但不属于典型的 runner-up 表述。
patterns.domain: 期刊评比、民调或新闻报道

en.description: Primarily responds to placement, ranking, and contest-outcome expressions, especially place, runner-up, and finished third; also often appears in election and political campaign coverage, along with one Welsh party news headline.

patterns.name: Placements and positions
patterns.context: In placement, contest, or ranking expressions, especially an ordinal followed by place; also includes related expressions such as runner-up and finished third.
patterns.domain: News coverage, encyclopedic biographies, and sports/journal rankings

patterns.name: Elections and political campaigns
patterns.context: Narratives about political figures running for office, campaigning, election results, or political activity; activation sometimes falls on nearby ordinals or election-related phrases.

patterns.name: British news headline fragment
patterns.context: A short headline or news-lede-style fragment mentioning an abbreviation for a British political party; the provided context is insufficient to identify a more specific trigger condition.

4_1405.description: 主要对名次、排名及竞赛结果表达有反应，尤其是 place、runner-up、finished third 等；也常见于选举和政治竞选报道，另有一条威尔士政党新闻标题。

patterns.name: 名次与位置

patterns.name: prospered 词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 prospered 的词尾分段，谈群体在现代制度下兴盛。

patterns.name: affected 词中片段

patterns.name: interaction 词中片段

patterns.name: 科学计数法数字片段

en.description: Primarily activates word-final fragments containing -pered in tempered, peppered, prospered, tampered, and similar words, especially at labeled subword fragments; isolated activations in interaction, inhibits, and Citric acid do not fit this spelling pattern.

patterns.name: Word ending in tempered

patterns.name: Other words containing -pered

patterns.name: Word ending in tampered with
patterns.context: In a political election context, refers to electronic voting machines possibly being tampered with

patterns.name: Isolated activations in domain vocabulary

patterns.name: Sporadic activation in a chemical name
patterns.context: At the beginning of a chemical buffer name; activation falls on the tokenized fragments Citric and acid

patterns.name: tempered 的词尾

patterns.name: HDL-related medical terms
patterns.context: Appears in medical text about lipoproteins, cholesterol, plasma, lipid metabolism, or treatment

patterns.name: Cooking instructions containing Mixture

patterns.name: IgA and treatment or immune response

patterns.name: C# marker

patterns.name: HDL 相关医学术语

patterns.context: 食谱中准备鸡蛋、牛奶等混合物的操作说明

patterns.name: MRI/GRASS 成像术语
patterns.context: 描述病灶在特定 MRI 序列上的表现或成分

patterns.name: NIR 光谱术语
patterns.context: 讨论星系恒星族群及近红外光谱模板

patterns.name: C# 标记
patterns.context: 出现在 Hacker News 关于创业公司创始人技术背景的句子中

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on limiting, excluding, or emphatic words such as only/even, often used to restrict a subject, frequency, or scope, or to highlight contrast; a few high activations fall on the Salmonella/Typhi scientific names and words about sharing product ideas, which do not fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: only as a limiter/emphasis
patterns.context: Appears in limiting, excluding, or emphatic contexts such as “not only in Saipan,” “electrons only follow,” “meat only once,” “found only in Ecuador,” “not only worse performance,” and “didn't even matter”; also appears in concessive emphasis such as “possible to detect defect even though.”
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narrative, papers, forums, encyclopedias, patents

patterns.name: Pathogen names
patterns.context: Near bacterial scientific names and their classification and serotype names, especially italicized scientific names.

patterns.name: Context of sharing ideas
patterns.context: Discusses making a product before sharing it, as well as possible consequences of sharing only an idea.

4_1522.description: 激活主要集中在 only/even 等限制、排除或强调词，常用于限定对象、频率、范围或突出反差；少数高激活落在 Salmonella/Typhi 学名及分享产品想法的词语上，无法归入主模式。

patterns.name: only 限定/强调
patterns.context: 出现在“not only in Saipan”“electrons only follow”“meat only once”“found only in Ecuador”“not only worse performance”以及“didn't even matter”等限制、排除或强调语境中；也有“possible to detect defect even though”这样的让步强调。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、论文、论坛、百科、专利

patterns.name: 病原体名称
patterns.context: 细菌学名及其分类、血清型名称附近，尤其是斜体学名。

patterns.name: 分享想法的语境
patterns.context: 讨论先做出产品再分享，以及只分享一个想法的可能后果。

en.concept: Local word forms and punctuation patterns
en.description: The more evident recurring patterns are emphatic uses of really/Really and apostrophes in English contractions; other isolated triggers include differentially, Markdown asterisks, quite, and x in an error message. They occur across several styles, with no unified semantic or grammatical pattern apparent.

patterns.name: Emphatic word really
patterns.context: Appears in statements or evaluations to strengthen a judgment, express degree of truth, or emphasize something; may occur within a sentence or in a title.
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, philosophical prose, music titles, etc.

patterns.name: ’ll / ’s in contractions
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated near the apostrophe in a contraction, followed by ll or s; the sentence concerns the future or expresses an existential judgment.

patterns.name: Differential in expressions of difference
patterns.context: A biomedical sentence describes differences in gene expression; nearby are identify genes, expressed, and cancer progression.

patterns.name: Markdown asterisk markers
patterns.context: Embedded in Markdown/formatting text fragments made up of asterisks, letters, and bold markers.
patterns.domain: Marked-up text in PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Subword at a token boundary
patterns.context: A sentence colloquially asks about “finding no way”; activation falls on the common word quite, with no clear recurrence in the available examples.

patterns.name: x inside quotation marks
patterns.context: In an error message about iPhone recovery failure, x is near a device name enclosed in double quotation marks; the cause of the trigger is unclear.

4_1522.description: 激活以 really/Really 的强调用法及英语缩写撇号为较明显重复模式；另有 differentially、Markdown 星号、quite 和错误提示中的 x 等孤立触发，跨多种文体，未见统一语义或语法规律。

patterns.name: really 强调词
patterns.context: 出现在陈述或评价中，用来加强判断、表达真实程度或强调某事；可位于句中，也可出现在标题中。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、哲学散文、音乐标题等

patterns.name: 缩写中的 ’ll / ’s
patterns.context: 激活集中于缩写撇号附近，后接 ll 或 s；所在句子谈论未来或表达存在判断。

patterns.name: 差异表达中的 differential
patterns.context: 生物医学句子中描述基因表达差异，附近有 identify genes、expressed、cancer progression。

patterns.name: Markdown 星号标记
patterns.context: 嵌在由星号、字母和粗体标记构成的 Markdown/格式化文本片段中。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文中的标记文本

patterns.name: 分词边界上的子词
patterns.context: 句子表达“找不到办法”的口语化提问；激活落在普通词 quite 上，当前材料中没有明确复现。

patterns.name: 引号内的 x
patterns.context: iPhone 恢复失败的错误提示中，x 位于双引号括起的设备名称附近；触发原因不明确。

en.concept: English high-frequency function words and contractions
en.description: The most stable phenomenon is a response to apostrophe-suffixes in English colloquial contractions ('ll, 're, 's). Other sporadic triggers include get to, infinitives, really, negation words, intensifying adverbs, quotations, and formatting symbols across a range of styles.

patterns.name: Future auxiliary contraction after apostrophe
patterns.context: An apostrophe is followed by ll, re, s, or other colloquial contraction suffixes; commonly occurs mid-sentence or in quotations.
patterns.domain: Online forums, colloquial English, and philosophical examples

patterns.name: Verb get with a to-infinitive
patterns.context: get is followed by to and the verb watch, meaning “was unable to go see”.

patterns.name: Adverbial really
patterns.context: really modifies earn or needs to intensify an evaluation; the two instances have different syntactic contexts.

patterns.name: Direct quotation introduced after think
patterns.context: think is followed by a quotation mark introducing an inner judgment.

patterns.name: Collocation of create and value
patterns.context: Discusses the contrast between the value of creating and the value of acquiring.

patterns.name: Negation word NOT
patterns.context: Uppercase NOT is used for emphatic negation; contexts are advice and tax discussion, respectively.

patterns.name: Negation word not with modal expressions
patterns.context: Ordinary syntactic negation occurs in evaluations, argumentative questions, and descriptions of technical failures.

patterns.name: Emphatic adverb even
patterns.context: even intensifies degree or interrogative force, with differing collocations.

patterns.name: Discourse-transition So at sentence beginning
patterns.context: An email begins a question with So to connect to the preceding text.

patterns.name: Negation combination in evaluative context
patterns.context: no denying forms a concessive affirmation, acknowledging that the award recipient truly deserved the award.

patterns.name: could not be in technical text
patterns.context: Quotes an error message about an iPhone recovery failure.

patterns.name: Standalone punctuation and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Separators, quotation marks, italic markers, and line breaks; each occurs in a different position.

patterns.name: Sporadic highlighted content words and internal fragments
patterns.context: Highlights fall on different common words, proper names, or internal subword fragments, with no stable shared syntactic condition.

4_1522.concept: 英语高频功能词与缩写
4_1522.description: 最稳定的现象是对英语口语缩写撇号后缀（'ll、're、's）的响应；另有零散的 get to、不定式、really、否定词、强调副词、引语及格式符号等触发，覆盖多种文体。

patterns.name: 缩写中的将来助动词省略号
patterns.context: 撇号后接 ll、re、s 等口语缩写后缀；常见于句中或引语中。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛、口语化英语及哲学例句

patterns.name: 动词 get 的 to 不定式搭配
patterns.context: get 后接 to 和动词 watch，表达“没能去看”。

patterns.name: really 的程度副词用法
patterns.context: really 修饰 earn 或 needs，强化评价；两处句法环境不同。
patterns.domain: 娱乐评论、哲学思想实验

patterns.name: think 后引出直接引语
patterns.context: think 后以引号引出内心判断。

patterns.name: create 与 value 的搭配
patterns.context: 讨论创造的价值与获取的价值之间的对比。

patterns.name: 否定词 NOT
patterns.context: 大写 NOT 用作强调性否定；上下文分别是建议与税务讨论。

patterns.name: 否定词 not 与情态表达
patterns.context: 普通句法中的否定，分别出现在评价、疑问式论证和技术故障描述中。

patterns.name: 强调性副词 even
patterns.context: even 用于加强程度或疑问语气，搭配并不相同。

patterns.name: 句首 So 的话语衔接
patterns.context: 邮件中以 So 开启提问，承接前文。

patterns.name: 评价语境中的否定词组合
patterns.context: no denying 构成让步式肯定，承认获奖者确实配得上奖项。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的 could not be
patterns.context: 引用 iPhone 恢复失败的错误信息。
patterns.domain: 技术支持／设备故障报告

patterns.name: 独立标点与格式符号
patterns.context: 分隔线、引用符、斜体标记及换行等格式符号；各自出现位置不同。

patterns.name: 零散高亮的实词与词内片段
patterns.context: 高亮落在不同的普通词、专名或词内子词片段，没有稳定共同句法条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛、娱乐评论、技术文本

en.concept: English apostrophe contractions and diverse word fragments
en.description: Most samples highlight apostrophes in English contractions ('s, 're, 'll) and surrounding characters; other sporadic patterns include emphatic NOT, URL metadata, and subword fragments in technical, biological, and film-related text.

patterns.name: Apostrophe and following characters in English contractions
patterns.context: The apostrophe occurs in English colloquial contractions or possessive forms, often connecting a pronoun or noun to following characters; the apostrophe and characters after it are especially prominent.

patterns.name: Negative word NOT
patterns.context: Uppercase NOT emphasizes negation or advice in discussions and quotations.

patterns.name: Web resource URL and filename fragments
patterns.context: Markers span multiple short tokens in continuous web metadata and path strings, such as URLs, dates, or image filenames.

patterns.name: Internal subwords in technical terms
patterns.context: In technical discussions, full words or proper names are split into subwords; examples involve Electron, Chromium instances, and cross-process sharing.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in biological names
patterns.context: In academic text about plants, snails, and Latin scientific names, activation falls on subword fragments of English words or taxonomic names.

patterns.name: Film-related proper names and title fragments
patterns.context: Fragments around film terminology, work titles, and personal names appear in discussions of filmmaking, awards, or works.

4_1522.concept: 英语撇号缩写及多样词片段
4_1522.description: 多数样本突出英语缩写撇号（'s、're、'll）及周边字符；另有 NOT 强调、URL 元数据，以及技术、生物学和电影文本中的词或专名子词片段，后几类较零散。

patterns.name: 英文缩写中的撇号与后续字符
patterns.context: 撇号出现在英语口语缩写或所有格形式中，常连接代词或名词与后续字符；被标记的撇号及其后的字符尤为突出。

patterns.name: 否定词 NOT
patterns.context: 大写 NOT 用于强调否定或建议，出现在讨论和引述中。

patterns.name: 网页资源 URL 与文件名片段
patterns.context: URL、日期或图像文件名等连续的网页元数据与路径字符串中，标记跨越多个短 token。

patterns.name: 技术词的内部子词
patterns.context: 技术讨论中，完整词或专名被切分成子词；涉及 Electron、Chromium 实例及跨进程共享。

patterns.name: 生物学名称的词内片段

patterns.name: 电影相关专名与标题片段
