en.concept: s after an apostrophe (with various miscellaneous activations)
en.description: The most stable pattern is s after an apostrophe, seen in various contractions and also in cause and rock'n'roll. Other activations include number boundaries, negation words, emphasis words, URL fragments, and scattered terms; some short fragments are unexplained.

patterns.name: s after an apostrophe
patterns.context: The letter s immediately follows an apostrophe, commonly in contractions such as it's, that's, there's, you're, and also in non-contracted forms such as cause and rock'n'roll; triggers span diverse contexts and may not require a specific syntax.
patterns.domain: HackerNews discussions and comments, email, music descriptions, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Letter-number boundary
patterns.context: A number or number string occurs in the body text; [4] is “game 3 the other day”, [9] is a year, and [10] is a number in a URL fragment. No obvious shared context with the apostrophe pattern.
patterns.domain: Email, music descriptions, technical Q&A, and URLs

patterns.name: fre in a URL
patterns.context: Occurs in the URL “http://www.freepascal.org/faq.var#unix-ld219”, with activation on an internal part of the domain name.

patterns.name: Negative words and negation expressions
patterns.context: Negation words or prepositions expressing opposition occur in arguments and opinions; they are sporadic and the contexts differ.

patterns.name: Emphasis or evaluative words in comments
patterns.context: Emphasis, responses, and evaluative words in colloquial or comment contexts; these are scattered and do not form a shared fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Scattered common words and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Appear respectively as common words, proper-name fragments, or parts of technical strings in different passages; the available examples do not reveal a unified trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Email, book recommendations, software discussions, music descriptions, URLs

patterns.name: Unexplained short-fragment activations
patterns.context: Occur in code fences, truncated text, or ordinary sentences; the available context is insufficient to explain their relationship to other patterns.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, email, and mixed text

4_1522.concept: 撇号后的 s（但有多种杂项激活）
4_1522.description: 最稳定的模式是撇号后的 s，见于多种缩写，也见于 cause、rock'n'roll；另有数字边界、否定词、强调词、网址片段及零散词项激活，部分短片段无法解释。

patterns.name: 撇号后的 s
patterns.context: 撇号后紧接字母 s，常见于 it's、that's、there's、you're 等缩写，也见于 cause、rock'n'roll 等非缩写形式；触发跨多种语境，未必要求特定句法。

patterns.name: 字母与数字的边界
patterns.context: 数字或数字串出现在正文中；其中[4]是“game 3 the other day”，[9]是年份， [10]是网址片段中的数字。与撇号模式没有明显共同上下文。

patterns.name: 网址中的 fre

patterns.name: 负向词及否定表达

patterns.name: 评论中强调或评价的词

patterns.name: 未解释的短片段激活
patterns.context: 位于代码围栏、截断文本或普通句子中，现有上下文不足以解释这些激活与其他模式的关系。

en.concept: English apostrophe contractions and Live wording

patterns.context: 出现在英语口语或非正式书面语中，构成 it’s、there’s 等缩写；周边内容并不固定
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、StackExchange 答复及其他英语文本

patterns.name: Live 字样及音乐现场语境
patterns.trigger: «Live»9，以及 «vinyl»、«box set»、«concert»、«BBC Proms» 等相邻词
patterns.context: 提及现场演出、现场录音或音乐发行物；Live 有时是标题的一部分
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、唱片介绍和百科条目

patterns.name: 特殊标记符号
patterns.context: Markdown 引文、强调或代码围栏等格式标记；只在个别段落出现，未见一致语义

en.concept: English contraction apostrophes and forum formatting
en.description: The most stable clue is the apostrophe and following letters in English contractions (is, are, will, negation forms), often co-occurring with Markdown italics or quotation formatting; there are also sporadic activations on tilde separators and a few split word fragments.

patterns.name: ’s in contracted forms
patterns.context: Activations cluster around apostrophes and the contraction letters that follow, including is (“that’s”, “it’s”), are (“you’re”), will (“it’ll”), and negative auxiliary forms (“didn’t”); surrounding words and topics vary.

patterns.name: Underscore italic markers
patterns.context: Co-occur with English contractions in several passages, marking the boundaries of quoted or emphasized italic text; activations also occur near words inside italics.

patterns.name: Markdown block quote
patterns.context: Activations occur near the block quote prefix; the content is a comment or someone else’s words.

patterns.name: Tilde separator
patterns.context: Appears as a standalone separator line in forum post fragments, often followed by a username or new content; it has no obvious semantic connection to apostrophe contractions or quoted content.

patterns.name: Localized activations on specific words
patterns.context: A few activations fall on tokenized fragments of proper names or words, or on an exclamatory response; there is no shared semantic or contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Technical comments, medication discussion, and general forum conversation

4_1522.concept: 英语缩写撇号及论坛格式
4_1522.description: 最稳定的线索是英语缩写中撇号及后续字母（is、are、will、否定形式），常与 Markdown 斜体或引用格式同现；另对波浪号分隔符及少数拆分词片段有零散激活。

patterns.name: 所有格缩写中的 ’s
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在撇号及其后的缩写字母附近，涵盖 is（“that’s”“it’s”）、are（“you’re”）、will（“it’ll”）和否定助动词形式（“didn’t”）；周边词语与主题各异。

patterns.name: 下划线斜体标记
patterns.context: 多段中与英语缩写同现，标记引用或强调文字的斜体边界；也有激活落在斜体内部词语附近。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 的 Markdown 格式文本

patterns.name: Markdown 引用块
patterns.context: 引用块起始符附近出现激活，内容是评论或引述他人的话。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 的 Markdown 格式文本

patterns.name: 波浪号分隔符
patterns.context: 在论坛帖子片段中作为独立分隔行出现，之后常接用户名或新内容；与撇号缩写和引用内容无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 特殊词语局部激活
patterns.context: 少数激活落在被分词拆开的专名、词语或感叹回应上，缺乏共同的语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 技术评论、药物讨论及一般论坛对话

en.concept: English apostrophe-s and conversational comment fragments
en.description: The most stable signal is s after an apostrophe, commonly in contractions of is/has. It also activates conversational evaluations, intensifiers, common function words, and a few subword fragments. Forum quotations and formatting symbols show sporadic activation; encyclopedia proper nouns are difficult to interpret.

patterns.name: Local combination of apostrophe and suffix s
patterns.context: Activation concentrates near the apostrophe and s, commonly in contractions of is/has; sometimes adjacent to sentence openings or emphatic constructions.
patterns.domain: Primarily HackerNews posts, as well as discussion text

patterns.name: Conversational judgments and emphasis
patterns.context: Appears when expressing agreement, evaluation, rebuttal, or emphasis of scope; often co-occurs with the apostrophe-s pattern, but not always in the same fixed phrase.

patterns.name: English grammatical function words and phrase boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinary English syntax; activation is scattered, with no stable semantic or positional conditions.

patterns.name: Specific word-final or intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Appears only in individual words, possibly triggered by inflectional forms or subword fragments; no shared context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, bibliographies, and music/museum descriptions

patterns.name: Quotations, formatting markers, and special symbols
patterns.context: Appears in HackerNews quotations, separators, or Markdown-style emphasis; often adjacent to sentence-initial content such as «That» and «Rather».

patterns.name: Sporadic strong activations with no clear common trigger
patterns.context: Individual fragments activate, especially proper nouns and URLs in encyclopedia passages; no stable relationship to other activations is apparent.

4_1522.concept: 英语撇号-s及口语评论片段
4_1522.description: 最稳定的信号是撇号后的 s，常见于 is/has 缩写；还会激活口语评价、强调词、普通功能词及少量词片段。论坛引用和格式符号也有零散激活，百科专名难以解释。

patterns.name: 撇号与后缀 s 的局部组合
patterns.context: 激活集中在撇号和 s 附近，常见于缩写 is/has；有时紧邻句首或强调结构。
patterns.domain: 以 HackerNews 网帖为主，也有讨论性文本

patterns.name: 口语化判断与强调语
patterns.context: 在表达赞同、评价、反驳或强调范围时出现；与撇号-s 模式常共现，但并非总是同一固定搭配。

patterns.name: 英语语法功能词及短语边界
patterns.context: 出现在普通英语句法结构中；激活分散，未显示稳定的语义或位置条件。

patterns.name: 特定词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 只在个别词项中出现，可能是词形或子词片段触发，缺少共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、书目和音乐/博物馆介绍

patterns.name: 引用、格式标记与特殊符号
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 的引用、分隔线或 Markdown 式强调格式中；常与 «That»、«Rather» 等句首内容相邻。

patterns.name: 未见明确共同触发的零散强激活
patterns.context: 个别片段激活，尤其百科段落中的专名和网址；看不出与其他激活的稳定关系。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 音乐与博物馆条目

en.concept: English apostrophe contractions and comment formatting
en.description: The most stable clue is English apostrophe contractions and their split tokens. Some comment quotation formats and argumentative words co-occur; other lexical activations are scattered and difficult to group into a unified semantic category.

patterns.name: Apostrophe and contracted forms
patterns.context: The apostrophe and following letters are split into separate tokens, commonly in English possessives, contractions, or colloquial spellings; no specific sentence meaning is required.
patterns.domain: English online discussions and colloquial email

patterns.name: Quoted or formatted comment openings
patterns.context: Occurs near quoted comments, separators, or underscore formatting, often in the same passage as apostrophe contractions, though not all related passages contain these markers.

patterns.name: Contrastive, rebuttal, or emphatic wording
patterns.context: Expresses an unexpected view, transition, emphasis, or negation in discussion; these words occur in only a few passages and show no stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Scattered vocabulary and colloquial details
patterns.context: Occasional words or fragments co-occur with contraction triggers but lack shared meaning; they may be secondary activations or contextual effects.
patterns.domain: Energy discussions, email, and startup discussions

4_1522.concept: 英语撇号缩写与评论格式
4_1522.description: 最稳定的线索是英语撇号缩写及其拆分 token；部分评论引用格式和论辩词伴随出现，另有零散词汇激活，难以归为统一语义。

patterns.name: 撇号及缩写形式
patterns.context: 撇号与后续字母被分成不同 token，常见于英语所有格、缩写或口语拼写；不要求特定句义。
patterns.domain: 英语网络讨论与邮件口语

patterns.name: 引用或格式化的评论开头
patterns.context: 评论引用、分隔线或下划线格式附近出现，常与撇号缩写同段，但并非所有相关段都有这些标记。

patterns.name: 对比、反驳或强调性措辞
patterns.context: 在讨论中表达反常观点、转折、强调或否定；这些词只在少数段出现，未显示稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 零散词汇与口语细节
patterns.context: 与缩写触发并存的偶发词或词片，彼此缺少共同语义，可能是次要激活或上下文效应。
patterns.domain: 能源讨论、邮件及创业讨论

en.description: Activations are scattered across contraction endings with apostrophes, quotation marks and punctuation, negation and contrast words, code delimiters, and subword boundaries in medical compounds. They also involve formatting markers, degree words, and common function words; no single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Contraction components after apostrophes
patterns.context: An apostrophe is followed by an English contraction ending, as in “that’s,” “you’re,” “it’ll,” and “they’d”; activation often falls on the apostrophe or ending fragment.

patterns.name: Quotation and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs at quotation, code-string, or sentence boundaries, especially in quoted text and the punctuation following it.

patterns.name: Negation or contrast expressions
patterns.context: Expresses opposition, negation, correction, or contrast; occurrences are few and contexts are not entirely alike.

patterns.name: Morpheme boundaries in medical compounds
patterns.context: Long medical terms are split into multiple subwords, especially “cardioverter-defibrillator,” “ischemic,” and “resynchronization”.

patterns.name: Strings and delimiters in code
patterns.context: Strings, identifiers, and statement separators in SQL or JavaScript/Apps Script code.

patterns.name: Emphasis or degree words
patterns.context: Modifiers express degree, emphasis, or duration; these words occur in different syntactic contexts and lack a shared theme.

patterns.name: Quotations and formatting markers
patterns.context: Near comment separators, quotation formatting, or Markdown markers; the trigger may be the formatting symbol itself or the quoted text that follows.

patterns.name: Pronominal demonstratives and determiners
patterns.context: High-frequency function words in ordinary English sentences; distribution is sporadic, with no stable semantic conditions.

4_1522.description: 激活分散在缩写撇号词尾、引号及标点、否定转折词、代码分隔符和医学复合词子词边界，也涉及格式标记、程度词与普通功能词；未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 撇号后的缩写成分
patterns.context: 撇号后跟英文缩写词尾，如“that’s”“you’re”“it’ll”“they’d”；激活常落在撇号或词尾片段。

patterns.name: 引号与标点边界
patterns.context: 标点出现在引号、代码字符串或句子边界处，尤其是引号内文字及其后的标点。

patterns.name: 否定或对比表达
patterns.context: 表达反对、否定、纠正或转折；出现次数少，语境并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 医学复合词中的词素边界
patterns.context: 长医学术语被切分成多个子词，尤其是“cardioverter-defibrillator”“ischemic”“resynchronization”。

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串及分隔符
patterns.context: SQL 或 JavaScript/Apps Script 代码中的字符串、标识符与语句分隔处。

patterns.name: 强调或程度词
patterns.context: 修饰语表示程度、强调或持续；这些词分布于不同句法环境，缺少共同主题。

patterns.name: 引文与格式标记
patterns.context: 评论分隔线、引用格式或 Markdown 标记附近；可能是格式符号本身或其后的引文文本。

patterns.name: 代词性指示与限定词
patterns.context: 普通英文句子中的高频功能词，分布零散，未显示稳定语义条件。

en.description: The most stable clue is the in-word Def/def string across a range of topics. Other activations are scattered across apostrophes, quotation marks, common words, and code strings, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: In-word Def string
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on in-word fragments in the case forms Def/def; in some instances the word continues across a marker boundary to form a complete word.
patterns.domain: Football, film, medicine, music, technology discussions, and other styles

patterns.name: Contractions or colloquial tone inside quotations
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across apostrophes, quotation marks, and neighboring characters, covering possessives, contractions, quoted speech, and code strings, with no unified syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Specific common words and punctuation
patterns.context: Activates on common words or punctuation in their respective sentences; local contexts vary and show no stable shared condition.
patterns.domain: Forums, encyclopedias, film reviews, philosophical texts

patterns.name: Output strings in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript code, activations fall near the quotation marks of a log-output string.

4_1522.description: 最稳定的线索是词内 Def/def 字符串，横跨多种主题；其余激活分散于撇号、引号、普通词及代码字符串，缺少一致语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 词内 Def 字符串
patterns.trigger: «Def»9（[2][3][7][8]）及 «def»8（[10]）；还包括«Def»9 与后续未标记字母组成的词，如“Defiance”“Defibrillator”“Defy”“definitely”
patterns.context: 激活集中在大小写形式 Def/def 的词内片段；部分词跨越标记边界继续拼成完整词。
patterns.domain: 足球、电影、医学、音乐、科技讨论等多种文体

patterns.name: 引号内的缩合或口语化语气
patterns.context: 激活散布在撇号、引号及其邻近字符，涵盖所有格、缩合形式、引用语和代码字符串，未见统一句法条件。

patterns.name: 特定常见词与标点
patterns.trigger: « remotely»2、« for»1、« '»2、« mad»1、« breaks»2、« still»1/2、« from»1、« ever»2、« '»9
patterns.context: 在各自句子中激活于普通词或标点，局部语境各异，未显示稳定共同条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛、百科、影视评论、哲学文本

patterns.name: 代码中的输出字符串
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中，激活落在日志输出字符串的引号附近。

en.description: Activations most often fall on apostrophes and their suffixes in English contractions, and also sporadically cover subword fragments, forum formatting symbols, HTML entities, name fragments, and conversational forms of address. These occur in varied contexts and do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Apostrophes and suffixes in English contractions
patterns.context: The apostrophe occurs in English contractions or colloquial forms, commonly before a pronoun, copula, or negation; activation sometimes falls on the apostrophe or suffix.
patterns.domain: English text in HackerNews discussions, novel dialogue, email, etc.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper nouns or word endings
patterns.context: Activation falls inside or at the end of a segmented word, with no consistent semantic context; it may relate to segmentation boundaries or specific spellings.

patterns.name: Markers and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Occurs in forum formatting such as quotations, separators, or italics markers, often alongside English text.

patterns.name: Specific alphanumeric entity
patterns.context: An HTML character entity is written as separate fragments, with activation concentrated on parts of the entity; seen only near one question title.

patterns.name: Fragments in musician names
patterns.context: Appears in an introduction to members of the band Queen, adjacent to names and band-history prose.

patterns.name: Salutation in a conversational email
patterns.context: An email opens with an informal greeting between acquaintances; seen once.

4_1522.description: 激活最常落在英语缩写的撇号及其后缀，也零散覆盖分词词片、论坛格式符号、HTML实体、姓名片段和口语称呼；这些位置分布在多种语境中，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语缩写中的撇号与后缀
patterns.context: 撇号位于英语缩写或口语形式中，常见于后接代词、系动词或否定词；激活有时落在撇号或后缀上。
patterns.domain: HackerNews讨论、小说对话、邮件等英语文本

patterns.name: 专名或词尾的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词内部或词尾，缺少一致的语义上下文；可能与分词边界或特定拼写有关。

patterns.name: 标记及格式符号
patterns.context: 出现在引用、分隔线或斜体标记等论坛排版中，附近常伴随英文文本。

patterns.name: 特定字母数字实体
patterns.context: HTML字符实体被拆分书写，激活集中在实体字符片段；仅见于一个提问标题附近。

patterns.name: 音乐人姓名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在Queen乐队成员介绍中，姓名与乐队史叙述相邻。

patterns.name: 口语邮件中的称呼
patterns.context: 邮件开头以熟人间的口语称呼作招呼；仅见一次。

en.description: Activations span diverse fields and styles, often falling on apostrophes, quotation marks, hyphens, and neighboring fragments; there are also code syntax and scattered common-word activations. No stable topic or semantic condition is evident.

patterns.name: Nonstandard apostrophe tokenization
patterns.context: In dialogue, colloquial, or informal text, punctuation is adjacent to contractions, dialect spellings, or possessives; activations often fall on the apostrophe and a short following fragment rather than a semantically stable word.
patterns.domain: Informal styles including forums, news quotations, novel dialogue, and band biographies

patterns.name: Quotation marks and quotation boundaries
patterns.context: Opening and closing quotation marks or punctuation within quotations; often co-occurs with apostrophe tokenization and colloquial content, but can also occur independently.
patterns.domain: Quotations, dialogue, and direct citations in articles

patterns.name: Punctuation fragmented within or between words
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs as a standalone token or embedded in words, code identifiers, or quoted text; no particular topic is required.
patterns.domain: Forum text, news, legal text, code, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Specific word fragments and common-word activations
patterns.context: These words occur across different syntactic positions and topics; the examples show no common collocation or consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Code strings and SQL syntax fragments
patterns.context: Strings, function names, and error-handling statements in PHP/SQL code.

4_1522.concept: 标点及局部 token 碎片
4_1522.description: 激活跨多种领域与文体，常落在撇号、引号、连字符等标点及其邻近碎片；另有代码语法和分散的普通词激活。缺乏稳定的主题或语义条件。

patterns.name: 非标准撇号切分
patterns.trigger: 撇号或引号附近的片段，如 «’» 后接 s / re / cause / em，以及 «'» 后接 im / it / cause / s
patterns.context: 对话、口语或非正式文本中，标点与缩写、方言拼写或所有格相邻；激活往往落在撇号及其后续短片段，而非稳定的语义词上
patterns.domain: 论坛、新闻引语、小说对白、乐队自述等非正式语体

patterns.name: 引号与引语边界
patterns.context: 引号开启、关闭或引语中的标点；常与撇号切分及口语内容同时出现，但也可能独立出现
patterns.domain: 引语、对话及文章中的直接引述

patterns.name: 词内或词间碎片化标点
patterns.context: 标点作为独立 token，或嵌在词、代码标识符、引用文本中；上下文不要求特定主题
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、新闻、法律文本、代码及百科条目

patterns.name: 特定词片段及普通词激活
patterns.context: 这些词分散出现于不同句法位置和主题，现有例子中看不出共同搭配或一致语义条件

patterns.name: 代码字符串与 SQL 语法碎片
patterns.context: PHP/SQL 代码中的字符串、函数名及错误处理语句

en.concept: Possible preference for apostrophes and colloquial contractions
en.description: The clearest identifiable pattern is the colloquial contraction ’cause (segments 2 and 3), with activation on the apostrophe; other highlights are scattered across common words, punctuation, proper nouns, and split words, with no consistent explanation.

patterns.name: Colloquial contraction of because
patterns.context: A spoken quotation uses ’cause instead of because; may occur with nonstandard spelling and punctuation tokenization.
patterns.domain: News quotations, band profiles; segments 2 and 3

patterns.name: Near sentence-final apostrophes or quotation marks
patterns.context: Highlights fall on apostrophe- or quotation-like punctuation, followed by a colloquial contraction or quoted content; similar apostrophe tokenization also appears in segments 4, 6, and 7, but is not marked as the strongest activation.
patterns.domain: Online comments, quotations, and informal text

patterns.name: Split or unusual tokenization
patterns.context: May relate to nonstandard token boundaries, intra-word segmentation, or punctuation tokenization; segments 5 and 8 contain extensive intra-word splitting, but the strongest activation positions have no obvious shared meaning.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, academic papers, and colloquial spelling

patterns.name: Other sporadic text fragments
patterns.context: These highlights each occur in different local contexts, such as grammar, proper nouns, titles, and song names; the context does not confirm a stable connection to the ’cause pattern.

4_1522.concept: 可能偏好撇号与口语缩写
4_1522.description: 最突出的可辨模式是口语缩写 ’cause（段2、3），激活落在撇号上；其余高亮分散于普通词、标点、专名和拆分词中，缺少一致解释。

patterns.name: 缩写口语化拼写中的 because
patterns.context: 口语引语中用 ’cause 代替 because；可伴随非标准拼写和标点分词。

patterns.name: 句末撇号或引号附近
patterns.context: 高亮落在撇号/引号类标点上，后面接口语缩写或引语内容；段4、6、7中也出现相似的撇号分词但强度未标为最高。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、引语与非正式文本

patterns.name: 拆分或异常分词的文本
patterns.trigger: 多处词内部被拆成子词，例如«sign»«ificantly»、«con»«centrations»、«magnet»«oh»«y»«dro»；以及« ’»10cause
patterns.context: 可能与非标准 token 边界、词内分段或标点分词有关；段5和8有大量词内拆分，但最高激活位置并不呈现明显共同词义。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、学术论文及口语拼写

patterns.name: 其他零散文本片段
patterns.trigger: 段1的« live»；段9的«of»；段10的«Def»；段7的« '»
patterns.context: 这些高亮各自出现在语法或专名、标题、歌曲名等不同局部语境，无法从上下文确认与 ’cause 模式有稳定联系。
patterns.domain: 音乐介绍、唱片目录、影评

en.description: Activations appear in terminology fragments and citation markers in papers, as well as band names, instruments, and colloquial quotations. There are also common words and formatting markers in discussions of 3D printing and inclusion. No single stable trigger pattern covers all fragments.

patterns.name: Terminology and compound fragments in academic papers
patterns.context: Positive activations fall on technical terms, compounds, or their token boundaries; many are embedded in formal scientific discussion, and the activation points do not all correspond to the same part of speech or terminology.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central academic papers; topics include seafood identification, toxicity and drug delivery, sea turtle ecology, carbon sequestration

patterns.name: Paper citations and reference markers
patterns.context: Occurs in bracketed citations, bibliography numbers, or similar reference markers in PLOS/PubMed Central text.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and their citation formatting

patterns.name: Band members, instruments, and music-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in band descriptions, member names, and descriptions of instruments or production roles; some activations fall on subwords in names or occupational suffixes.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia band entries and Pile-CC music descriptions

patterns.name: Spellings and discourse markers in colloquial quotations
patterns.context: Informal spellings and colloquial expressions in quotations from the band’s Myspace page; activations concentrate on abbreviated spellings or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Colloquial quotations embedded in Wikipedia entries

patterns.name: Common function words in 3D-printing discussions
patterns.context: Occurs in the body of a paper introducing 3D printing and media coverage; from this passage alone, it is difficult to tell whether activation comes from topic words or general sentence structure.

patterns.name: Function words and formatting markers in inclusion discussions
patterns.context: In a colloquial HackerNews question about whether all niche needs should be covered; includes Markdown italic markers.

4_1522.description: 激活散见于论文中的术语片段与引文标记，也见于乐队姓名、乐器和口语引文；另有3D打印及包容性讨论中的常见词和格式标记。没有能覆盖全部片段的单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 学术论文中的术语与复合词片段
patterns.trigger: « Blue»1fin« t»3una、« cod»1、«-»2induced、« Met»3«abolic»1、« minimized»1、«-»1«of»4«-»1action、«head»3、« tropical»1、« safe»2、« long»3-term« sequest»3ration
patterns.context: 正激活落在专业词语、复合词或其分词边界上；多处嵌于正式科学论述中，激活点并不都对应同一词类或术语。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 学术论文；海产品鉴定、毒性与药物递送、海龟生态、碳封存等主题

patterns.name: 论文引文与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 出现在 PLOS/PubMed Central 文本的方括号引用、文献编号或类似参考文献标记中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及其引文格式

patterns.name: 乐队成员、乐器与音乐相关词
patterns.context: 出现在乐队介绍、成员姓名与乐器／制作职位描述中；部分激活落在姓名的子词或职业后缀上。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 乐队条目与 Pile-CC 音乐简介

patterns.name: 口语化引用中的拼写与语气词
patterns.context: 乐队 Myspace 引语中的非正式拼写和口语表达；激活集中于缩略拼写或标点。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目内嵌的口语引文

patterns.name: 3D 打印话题中的常见功能词
patterns.context: 出现在介绍 3D 打印及媒体报道的论文正文中；仅凭此段难以判断激活来自主题词还是一般句式。

patterns.name: 包容性讨论中的功能词及格式标记
patterns.context: 在 HackerNews 的口语化提问中，围绕是否需要覆盖所有细分需求展开；包含 Markdown 斜体标记。

en.description: Activations are scattered across segmented proper nouns, common phrases, intra-word fragments, formula symbols, forum usernames, and markers; local trigger forms vary, with no unified semantic or stable syntactic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in abbreviations or proper nouns
patterns.context: Trigger points occur inside segmented or punctuated organization names, gene names, species names, proper nouns, or domain names; fragments are often adjacent to periods, spaces, or other subwords.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical, music-encyclopedia, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Fixed phrases and common word groups
patterns.context: Appears in titles, natural-language phrases, or comparison questions; activation spans different parts of speech, with no stable syntactic position.

patterns.name: Intra-word or short-word fragments
patterns.context: Triggered by substrings within common words, hyphenated compounds, or local fragments such as short prepositions; contextual conditions are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Technical forums, mathematical and physics text

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls near parentheses, operators, or variable symbols in formulas, especially segmented mathematical notation.
patterns.domain: Quantum physics and theoretical physics papers

patterns.name: Chat markers and nonstandard spelling
patterns.context: Appears in non-prose forms such as forum usernames, interjections, underscores, or HTML entities.

4_1522.description: 激活分散于拆分的专名、常见短语、词内片段、公式符号及论坛用户名和标记；各处局部触发形式不一，未见统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 缩写或专名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 触发点位于被切分或带标点的机构名、基因名、物种名、专名或域名内部；片段常紧邻句点、空格或其他子词。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学、音乐百科、技术讨论

patterns.name: 固定短语与常见词组
patterns.context: 出现在标题、自然语言短语或比较问句中；激活跨越不同词类，并无稳定句法位置。

patterns.name: 词形内部或短词片段
patterns.context: 触发于普通词内部的子串、连字符构词，或短介词等局部片段；上下文条件不一致。
patterns.domain: 技术论坛、数学物理文本

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式边界
patterns.context: 激活落在公式的括号、运算符或变量符号附近，尤其是被拆分的数学标记。
patterns.domain: 量子物理、理论物理论文

patterns.name: 聊天标记与非标准拼写
patterns.context: 出现在论坛用户名、感叹语、下划线或 HTML 实体等非普通正文形式中。

en.description: Activations are scattered across internal fragments of proper names and technical terms, paper citations and identifiers, code strings/indentation, news dates, and music-review quotations; no single stable semantic or stylistic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Letters or morphemes embedded in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of proper names or technical terms, often combining with adjacent fragments to form a full name rather than marking a uniform semantic component at a whole-word boundary.
patterns.domain: News, papers, law, medicine, and biology

patterns.name: Citation and numbering formats
patterns.context: Appears in bracketed author–year citations, paper reference identifiers, or journal citation numbers; digits and letter fragments are interleaved.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers, medical papers, and their citation markers

patterns.name: Fragments of specific biomedical terms
patterns.context: Located within technical terms or adjacent words concerning acoustic imaging, RNA silencing, enzymes, and mitochondria; trigger locations vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, molecular biology, and biophysics papers

patterns.name: Formatting tokens in code and test strings
patterns.context: Appears in Python test code, indentation, string literals, and multiline message examples; code structure and string contents both show activation.

patterns.name: Proper-name and quotation fragments in music reviews
patterns.context: Appears around album or place-name-style titles, quotation marks, and review outlet names; quoted reviews describe musical styles and evaluations.

patterns.name: News dates and formatting markers
patterns.context: Located in dates, times, and punctuation formats at the beginning of news excerpts; the same passage also contains split markers in celebrity names.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on grammatical function words and common words
patterns.context: A small number of common words or internal word fragments occur in different contexts, without consistent semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Paper abstracts, medical texts, and reviews

4_1522.description: 激活分散在专名和专业术语的内部片段、论文引文与编号、代码字符串/缩进、新闻日期及音乐评论引语中；未见单一稳定语义或文体触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名中嵌入的字母或词素
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或技术术语的内部片段上，常与相邻片段共同拼出完整名称，而非完整词边界上的统一语义成分。
patterns.domain: 新闻、论文、法律、医学与生物学

patterns.name: 文献引用与编号格式
patterns.context: 出现在方括号内的作者—年份引文、论文参考文献标识或期刊文献编号中；数字与字母片段交错。
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文、医学论文及其引文标记

patterns.name: 特定生物医学术语片段
patterns.trigger: «ac»«oust»（“photoacoustics”）；«ic»« noble»（“plasmonic noble metal”）；«induced»« silencing»；«Argona»«ute»；« py»«ruvate»、« dehydrogenase»、« phosphatase»
patterns.context: 位于专业名词内部或相邻词中，涉及声学成像、RNA沉默、酶及线粒体等内容；各例触发位置并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分子生物学与生物物理学论文

patterns.name: 代码与测试字符串中的格式 token
patterns.context: 出现在 Python 测试代码、缩进、字符串字面量及多行消息示例中；对代码结构和字符串内容均有激活。

patterns.name: 音乐评论中的专名及引语片段
patterns.context: 出现在专辑或地名式标题、引号以及评论媒体名称周边，评论引用描述音乐风格与评价。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 音乐条目、唱片评论

patterns.name: 新闻日期与排版标记
patterns.context: 位于新闻片段开头的日期、时间及标点格式中；同段还出现被拆分标记的名人姓名。

patterns.name: 语法虚词与普通词的零散激活
patterns.context: 少量普通词或词内片段在不同语境中出现，缺乏一致的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 论文摘要、医学文本及评论

en.description: Activations occur in Deficit in ADHD, the legal abbreviation Def., agn inside magnet(s), and fragments in medical formatting, JUSTIN, and ’Oumuamua; the main commonality is specific intra-word fragments or boundaries.

patterns.name: Deficit across a subword boundary
patterns.context: Deficit follows Attention across a fragment boundary; Hyperactivity, Disorder, or ADHD often appears later.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in magnet
patterns.context: In terms related to electromagnets or ferromagnetic materials, agn occurs inside magnet(s).

patterns.name: Def in a legal citation
patterns.context: In the U.S. Supreme Court case name Nat. Res. Def. Council, Def. is part of an abbreviation.

patterns.name: Numeric and marker fragments in medical text
patterns.context: Near supplementary-material links, sequence identifiers, and variant identifiers, activation falls on punctuation, numbers, or formatting markers.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and their structured markup

patterns.name: JUST in a band name
patterns.context: The initial fragment of the uppercase name JUSTIN, appearing in an introduction to band members.

patterns.name: Oumuamua fragments in an astronomical name
patterns.context: Multiple subword fragments combine to form the interstellar object ’Oumuamua, near quotations and astrophysics discussion.

4_1522.description: 激活散见于 ADHD 的 Deficit、法律缩写 Def.、magnet(s) 内的 agn，以及医学格式碎片、JUSTIN 和 ’Oumuamua 的分词片段；共同点主要是特定词内片段或边界。

patterns.name: 分词边界中的 Deficit
patterns.context: Attention 后接 Deficit，跨片段边界标记；后文常继续出现 Hyperactivity、Disorder 或 ADHD。
patterns.domain: 医学、精神病学、法律文书

patterns.name: magnet 的词内片段
patterns.context: 电磁铁或铁磁材料相关术语中，agn 位于 magnet(s) 的词内。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的 Def
patterns.context: 美国最高法院判例名称 Nat. Res. Def. Council 中，Def. 为缩写的一部分。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的数字及标记碎片
patterns.context: 补充材料链接、序列号和变异编号附近，激活落在标点、数字或格式标记上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及其结构化标记

patterns.name: 乐队名中的 JUST
patterns.context: 大写人名 JUSTIN 的词首片段，出现在乐队成员介绍中。

patterns.name: 天体名称中的 Oumuamua 碎片
patterns.context: 跨多个子词片段拼成星际天体 ’Oumuamua，邻近引文与天体物理讨论。

en.concept: Proper Names, Subword Fragments, and Formatting Fragments
en.description: Activations are scattered across subword fragments of varied proper names: medical conditions, pathogens and dust-mite scientific names, personal names, legal institutions, as well as numbers, quotations, and word-internal fragments in film reviews; some activations have no shared condition inferable from local text.

patterns.name: ADHD segmentation in a disease name
patterns.context: The phrase follows Attention as part of the name of a neuropsychiatric condition or pediatric behavioral disorder.
patterns.domain: Medicine, clinical descriptions, or NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: Justin Hendy segmentation in a personal name
patterns.context: The name Justin Hendy appears in a band-member introduction, with activation on name fragments.

patterns.name: Segmentation of Mycobacterium bovis
patterns.context: The bacterial name Mycobacterium bovis appears in contexts concerning bovine tuberculosis and animal transmission.
patterns.domain: Veterinary medicine, infectious disease research abstracts

patterns.name: Segmentation of a dust-mite scientific name
patterns.context: The dust-mite scientific name Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus appears in allergen or mouse airway studies.

patterns.name: Abbreviation in a legal case name
patterns.context: The institutional abbreviation Natural Resources Defense Council appears in a citation of the Chevron case.

patterns.name: Digits in bibliographic identifiers
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across digits and separators in paper numbers, gene transcript identifiers, and reference identifiers; there is no uniform format.

patterns.name: Colloquial contraction in a quotation
patterns.context: A colloquial contraction of because begins with an apostrophe in a band-member quotation.

patterns.name: Internal word fragments in a film-review quotation
patterns.context: Activation falls within ordinary English words in a direct film-review quotation, with no clear semantic relation to the disease, names, or proper names in other examples.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic markers
patterns.context: Local activations occur at ordinary word boundaries or in incomplete markers, making stable trigger conditions difficult to determine from the fragment alone.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper formatting and supplementary materials

4_1522.concept: 专名与子词片段及格式碎片
4_1522.description: 激活分散于多种专名及其子词片段：医学疾病、病原体和尘螨学名，人名、法律机构名，以及编号、引语和影评词内片段；另有部分激活无法从局部文本归纳出共同条件。

patterns.name: 疾病名称中的 ADHD 分词
patterns.context: Attention 后出现该短语，作为神经精神疾病或儿科行为障碍名称的一部分。
patterns.domain: 医学、临床或 NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 人名中的 Justin Hendy 分词
patterns.context: 乐队成员介绍中出现姓名 Justin Hendy，激活落在名字片段上。

patterns.name: Mycobacterium bovis 的分词
patterns.context: 细菌学名 Mycobacterium bovis 出现在牛结核及动物传播语境中。
patterns.domain: 兽医学、传染病研究摘要

patterns.name: 尘螨学名的分词
patterns.context: 过敏原或小鼠气道研究中出现尘螨学名 Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、呼吸道医学摘要

patterns.name: 法律判例名称中的缩写
patterns.context: 引用 Chevron 判例时出现机构名称缩写 Natural Resources Defense Council。

patterns.name: 文献标识符中的数字
patterns.context: 激活散布于论文编号、基因转录本编号或参考文献标识符等数字与分隔符中；缺乏统一格式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及参考文献标记

patterns.name: 引语中的口语缩写
patterns.context: 乐队成员引语中，because 的口语缩写以撇号开头。

patterns.name: 影评引语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 电影评论的直接引语中，激活落在普通英语单词内部，未见与疾病、姓名或专名相同的明显语义关系。

patterns.name: 未解释的零散标记
patterns.context: 局部激活出现在普通词边界或残缺标记中，单凭片段难以确定稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 科学论文格式与补充材料

en.concept: Proper Names and Formatting Fragments in Text
en.description: Activations are scattered across subword fragments within heterogeneous texts, proper names/titles, literature citations and identifiers, and bibliographic, figure, and section-format markers; no single semantic theme covers them all.

patterns.name: Cross-boundary subword fragments within segmented words
patterns.context: Activation falls within segmented proper names, terms, or word forms; many triggering fragments are only parts of words, requiring surrounding context to reconstruct the full word.
patterns.domain: Biomedical texts, disease names, and drug names

patterns.name: Phrases in book and album titles
patterns.context: Some word fragments activate in title-cased phrases that name music albums or works; also «single»-«disc», «re»-«released».

patterns.name: Paper citations and bibliographic markers
patterns.context: Near author–year citations, reference numbers, or filenames and punctuation in bibliography metadata.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, ArXiv, and their bibliographic formats

patterns.name: Citation numbers and file-like identifiers
patterns.context: After the paper body, identifiers formed from journal names, volume/pages, or figure anchors appear; activation spans multiple identifier fragments and closing symbols.

patterns.name: Section heading formats
patterns.context: All-caps section headings in papers and the equals-sign separators beneath them.

4_1522.concept: 文本中的专名与格式片段
4_1522.description: 激活分散在异质文本的词内子词、专名/标题、文献引用与编号，以及书目、图表和章节格式标记；没有单一语义主题能覆盖全部。

patterns.name: 分词内部的跨边界子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的专名、术语或词形内部；不少触发片段只是词的一部分，需结合左右文还原完整词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、疾病名称及药物名称

patterns.name: 书名、专辑名中的短语
patterns.context: 音乐专辑或作品名称的标题式大小写与连续短语中，部分词片段激活；另有 «single»-«disc»、«re»-«released»。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、音乐作品目录

patterns.name: 论文引用及书目标记
patterns.context: 参考文献的作者-年份引用、文献编号，或 bibliography 元数据中的文件名及标点附近。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、ArXiv 及其书目格式

patterns.name: 引文编号与文件式标识符
patterns.context: 论文正文后出现期刊名、卷页或图表锚点拼成的标识符；激活覆盖标识符的多个片段及闭合符号。
patterns.domain: 医学论文的图表/期刊标识符

patterns.name: 章节标题格式
patterns.context: 论文中全大写章节标题及其下方的等号分隔线。
patterns.domain: 天体物理论文、结构化学术文本

en.description: Activations primarily occur in internal fragments of Neisseria species names, especially Neisseria gonorrhoeae and Neisseria meningitidis; sporadic activations also occur in IFNα, ADHD, nonsense mutations, film reviews, and bibliographic identifiers.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Neisseria species names
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal subword fragments of bacterial scientific names, including Neisseria gonorrhoeae and Neisseria meningitidis; surrounding text typically describes pathogen detection, infection, or vaccines.
patterns.domain: Biomedical science, microbiology, diagnostics, and infection research

patterns.name: IFNα character fragments
patterns.context: Appears in lists of plasmid names and interferon-related reagents; activation covers only the two parts of IFNα.
patterns.domain: Materials or methods descriptions in molecular biology and immunology papers

patterns.name: Fragments in neurodevelopmental disorder terminology
patterns.context: Located in names of clinical presentations such as Attention Deficit Hyperactivity, followed by a comma and other diagnostic categories.

patterns.name: Mutation terminology
patterns.context: Modifies a gene mutation, specifically a homozygous nonsense mutation in C2CD3; surrounding text describes sequencing and variants.

patterns.name: Word fragments in film reviews
patterns.context: Activations are scattered in film-review quotations about comedy, release, and film titles; there is no apparent shared semantic or local grammatical condition.

patterns.name: Neurogastrointestinal and anatomical experiment text
patterns.context: Activation occurs in a parenthetical journal citation identifier; the rest of the passage describes the gastrointestinal tract, uterus, and electrode locations, with no clear common trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Biomedical experiment papers and citation identifiers

4_1522.concept: 生物医学术语片段偏好
4_1522.description: 主要激活于奈瑟菌属名称的内部片段，尤见淋病奈瑟菌与脑膜炎奈瑟菌；另有 IFNα、ADHD、无义突变及电影评论和文献标识符中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 奈瑟菌属名称内部片段
patterns.trigger: «iss»eria、«gon»or«rho»、«mening»it«idis»；尤其是被拆分标注的 Ne«iss»eria gon«or»rho«e»ae 和 Ne«iss»eria mening«it»idis
patterns.context: 激活落在细菌学名的内部子词片段上，涉及淋病奈瑟菌和脑膜炎奈瑟菌；周围通常是病原体检测、感染或疫苗相关描述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、微生物学、诊断与感染研究

patterns.name: IFNα字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在质粒名称及干扰素相关试剂的罗列中；激活仅覆盖 IFNα 的两部分。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、免疫学论文中的材料或方法描述

patterns.name: 神经发育障碍术语片段
patterns.context: 位于 Attention Deficit Hyperactivity 等临床表现名称中，后接逗号和其他诊断类别。
patterns.domain: 精神病学、神经发育障碍研究

patterns.name: 突变术语
patterns.context: 修饰基因突变，具体为 C2CD3 的纯合无义突变；周围是测序和变异描述。

patterns.name: 电影评论中的词语片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在电影评论引语中，涉及喜剧、发行和电影标题；没有明显统一的语义或局部语法条件。

patterns.name: 神经胃肠与解剖实验文本
patterns.context: 激活出现在括号中的期刊引用标识符；该段其余内容描述胃肠道、子宫和电极位置，未见清楚的共同触发模式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学实验论文及引用标识符

en.concept: Rare Subwords in Proper Names and Technical Text
en.description: Activations are scattered across subwords in proper names and technical strings: biomedical terms, gene/protein symbols, radiotracers, and paper citations and figure markers; they also occur in music, actor entries, and spoken quotations, with no single stable trigger word evident.

patterns.name: Dust-mite scientific name and immunology terms
patterns.context: The dust-mite name Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus is split into multiple subwords in biomedical abstracts about mouse airway changes and immune deficiency.

patterns.name: Apostrophes in spoken quotations
patterns.context: Informal direct quotations in a band-member announcement; an apostrophe introduces the colloquial contraction 'cause, and a capitalized name also shows activation.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia band entries and spoken quotations

patterns.name: PET tracer and drug description
patterns.context: Describes unchanged patient medication and PET scans; the symbol and name of the radiotracer [¹¹C]harmine are segmented.

patterns.name: Paper figure citations and formatting markers
patterns.context: Number/marker sequences, Fig. citations, Markdown anchors, and ref-type figure metadata in paper text.
patterns.domain: Academic paper webpages or converted markup text

patterns.name: Band names and tour lineups
patterns.context: Proper names of bands or artists are segmented in tour descriptions, e.g., Oh, Sleeper, The Devil Wears Prada, P.O.; commas and list structure occur nearby.

patterns.name: Show titles in actor biographies
patterns.context: A parallel list of acting credits in which proper show and title names are segmented, with role types and “appeared in” constructions.

patterns.name: Author–year citations
patterns.context: Bracketed author–year citations in academic discussion, with author names, years, and separators tokenized.

patterns.name: Gene variants and sequence identifiers
patterns.context: Gene symbols, transcript identifiers, and variant coordinates in genetic case reports, embedded in mutation descriptions.

patterns.name: Molecular pathways and protein symbols
patterns.context: Transcription factors, growth factors, and protein names in discussions of autophagy and signaling pathways, often containing hyphens, Greek letters, or numbers.

patterns.name: Experimental aliquots and figure-panel identifiers
patterns.context: Experimental results compare sample aliquots and cite panels of Fig. 1; this resembles the paper figure-marker pattern, but experimental description words also activate.

4_1522.concept: 专名及技术文本中的稀有子词
4_1522.description: 激活分散于专名和技术字符串的子词：生物医学术语、基因/蛋白符号、放射性示踪剂，以及论文引文和图表标记；另见音乐、演员条目及口语引语，未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 尘螨学名与免疫术语
patterns.context: 尘螨名称 Dermatophagoides pteronyssinus 被拆成多个子词，出现在小鼠气道变化和免疫缺陷的生物医学摘要中。

patterns.name: 口语引语中的撇号
patterns.context: 乐队成员公告中的非正式直接引语；撇号引出缩写口语 'cause，大小写强调的人名也有激活。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 乐队条目及口语引语

patterns.name: PET 示踪剂与药物描述
patterns.context: 描述患者用药未变及 PET 扫描；放射性示踪剂 [¹¹C]harmine 的符号和名称被拆分。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 临床/影像研究

patterns.name: 论文图表引用与排版标记
patterns.context: 论文正文中的数字/标记序列、Fig. 引用、Markdown 锚点及 ref-type 图表元数据。
patterns.domain: 学术论文网页或转换后的标记文本

patterns.name: 乐队名与巡演名单
patterns.context: 巡演叙述中乐队或艺人专名被拆分，如 Oh, Sleeper、The Devil Wears Prada、P.O.；周边有逗号和名单结构。

patterns.name: 演员履历中的剧名
patterns.context: 演员出演经历的并列列表，专有节目名和剧名被拆分，含角色类型及“出演于”结构。

patterns.name: 文献作者与年份引文
patterns.context: 学术论述中方括号式作者-年份引用，作者名、年份和分隔符分词呈现。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论/计算科学论文

patterns.name: 基因变异与序列编号
patterns.context: 遗传学病例报告中的基因符号、转录本编号及变异坐标，夹在突变描述中。

patterns.name: 分子通路与蛋白符号
patterns.context: 自噬及信号通路论述中的转录因子、生长因子和蛋白名称，常含连字符、希腊字母或数字。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 分子生物学/医学综述

patterns.name: 实验 aliquot 与图版标识
patterns.context: 实验结果比较样本 aliquot，并引用 Fig. 1 的分图；与论文图表标记模式相近，但也有实验描述词激活。

en.description: Activations most clearly cover Clostridium botulinum, toxins, and related detection; there are also fragments of numbering, punctuation, abbreviations, and citation formats in academic literature, as well as scattered word fragments in biomedical, physics, and review texts, making a single semantic category difficult to assign.

patterns.name: Clostridium botulinum and its toxins
patterns.context: Mentions Clostridium botulinum, its toxins, or toxin detection, including lists of bacterial species and clinical applications.
patterns.domain: Microbiology, nucleic acid detection, medical literature

patterns.name: Literature markers and numeric citations
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across digits, punctuation, and label fragments in figures, supplementary materials, references, and bibliographic metadata formats.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and corpus annotation formats

patterns.name: English word fragments in quotations
patterns.context: Several ordinary English words or word fragments are marked in music-review quotations, without an obvious semantic trigger shared with the other passages.

patterns.name: Biomedical molecules and pathway terms
patterns.context: Internal fragments of terms activate when cell signaling, proteins, or autophagy-related factors are listed.

patterns.name: Fragments of equipment or neuroscience terms
patterns.context: In a neuroscience paper passage mentioning β-burst, phase-locking duration, and figure citations, activation concentrates on preceding number/abbreviation strings; the association is uncertain.

patterns.name: Fragments of mathematical physics formulas and citations
patterns.context: Symbol and number fragments near magnetic receptor ions, exchange interactions, and formulas/citations.

patterns.name: Fragments of reproductive medicine figure citations
patterns.context: Activations occur in journal figure numbers or reference identifiers following descriptions of uterine electrode experiments; no clear content-word trigger is evident.

4_1522.description: 激活最明确地覆盖肉毒梭菌、毒素及相关检测；另有学术文献中的编号、标点、缩写与引用格式片段，以及分散的生物医学、物理和评论文本词片段，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 肉毒梭菌及其毒素
patterns.context: 提及肉毒梭菌、其毒素或毒素检测；包括菌种列举和临床用途。
patterns.domain: 微生物学、核酸检测、医学文献

patterns.name: 文献标记与数字化引用
patterns.trigger: «1»、«-»、«type»、«Supplementary»、«Fig.»等标记附近的编号、标点或引用格式
patterns.context: 图表、补充材料、参考文献及文献元数据格式中，激活散布在数字、标点和标签片段。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及语料标注格式

patterns.name: 引文中的英文词语片段
patterns.context: 音乐评论引文中若干普通英文词或词片段被标记，缺少与其他段一致的明显语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 维基百科中的音乐评论

patterns.name: 生物医学分子与通路术语
patterns.context: 列举细胞信号、蛋白质或自噬相关因素时，术语内部片段激活。

patterns.name: 实验设备或神经科学术语片段
patterns.context: 出现β-burst、锁相持续时间及图表引用的神经科学论文段落中，激活集中于前置数字/缩写串，关联不确定。

patterns.name: 数学物理公式与引用片段
patterns.context: 磁性受体离子、交换相互作用及公式/文献引用附近的符号和编号片段。

patterns.name: 生殖医学图注引用片段
patterns.context: 子宫电极实验描述后的期刊图号或文献标识中出现激活；未见明确内容词触发。

en.description: Activations are scattered across scientific terms, alphanumeric strings, citations, and formatting markers, and also occur in music titles and proper names; a few fall on ordinary modifiers. No single stable semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric fragments in technical terms and identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs in technical terms, gene or protein names, astronomical names, measurements, chemical formulas, and citation markers; activation falls on local fragments of these strings without requiring a fixed word meaning.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, astronomy, and physics papers, and academic citations

patterns.name: Alphanumerics and punctuation in citation markers
patterns.context: When author names, years, parentheses, square brackets, semicolons, and related elements occur adjacent to or interleaved with one another in academic text.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of scientific terms
patterns.context: Within technical vocabulary or compound terms, especially longer words containing capitalization or hyphens; there is no clear unified semantic category.

patterns.name: Quoted titles and lyric-like text
patterns.context: Quotation marks, titles, years, and informal or creative spellings in titles occur next to one another.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, album catalogs, and other encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Personal names, organization names, and capitalization boundaries
patterns.context: Local activations occur near capitalization shifts, abbreviations, or word boundaries in proper names.

patterns.name: Markdown and structured markers
patterns.context: When webpages or exported papers retain links, citations, and formatting markers.

patterns.name: Statistical modifiers and common vocabulary
patterns.context: Modifiers of constraint, recency, or degree when comparing or describing research results; occurs only sporadically.

4_1522.concept: 专业文本中的异质片段
4_1522.description: 激活分散于科学文本的术语、数字字母串、引文及格式标记，也见于音乐标题和专名；少量落在普通修饰语上。未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 技术及术语中的数字字母片段
patterns.trigger: 如「NM_01 55 31 .4」「2 mG」「H$_2$」「NGC 13 99」「HIF-1*α」「P45 01A」等数字、字母与标点交织的串
patterns.context: 在专业术语、基因或蛋白名称、天体名称、测量值、化学式及引用标记中；激活落在这些串的局部片段上，不要求固定词义
patterns.domain: 生物医学、天文学、物理学论文及学术引文

patterns.name: 引用标记中的字母数字与标点
patterns.context: 学术文本中作者名、年份、括号、方括号、分号等相邻或交错出现时

patterns.name: 科学名词的词内片段
patterns.context: 专业词汇或复合术语中，尤其是较长、含大小写或连字符的词；没有明显统一的语义类别

patterns.name: 引号内标题及歌词式文本
patterns.context: 引号、标题、年份及标题中的非正式或创意拼写相邻出现
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、唱片目录等百科文本

patterns.name: 人名、组织名及大小写边界
patterns.context: 专名中大小写切换、缩写或词界附近出现局部激活
patterns.domain: 百科文本与生物医学文本

patterns.name: Markdown及结构化标记
patterns.trigger: 「[Supplementary Fig. 1a](#SD1){ref-type="supplementary-material"}」中的括号、连字符、引号及标记字段
patterns.context: 网页或论文导出文本保留链接、引用和格式标记时

patterns.name: 统计性修饰语与普通词汇
patterns.context: 比较或描述研究结果时，修饰受约束程度、近期性或程度；仅零星出现

en.concept: Local fragments and punctuation in English text
en.description: Activations are distributed across several text types: quotation punctuation, years and citation numbers, fragments within proper nouns, and fragments in biomedical, astronomical, and sensor terminology; there is no consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: English quotation marks and quotation punctuation
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on quotation marks, question marks, periods, and other punctuation within quotations or at their boundaries; the quoted content varies widely
patterns.domain: English book titles, lyrics, reviews, and web quotations

patterns.name: Number and year strings
patterns.context: Numbers occur in work titles, years, or publication years, often adjacent to punctuation or English text
patterns.domain: Music entries, film reviews, academic literature

patterns.name: Proper nouns and intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Proper nouns or English words are marked as segmented; no stable semantic or syntactic conditions are apparent

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur inside gene, protein, or microorganism names and related terminology, often at segmentation boundaries

patterns.name: Reference-number fragments
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in author-year citation keys and accompanied by semicolons, @ symbols, or other citation formatting

patterns.name: Renewable energy sensor terminology
patterns.context: Appears in technical descriptions of energy harvesting and wireless rechargeable sensor networks

patterns.name: Mathematical and gene-symbol fragments
patterns.context: Appears within alphanumeric identifiers such as transcript IDs or variant loci

patterns.name: Astronomical abbreviation fragments
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of stellar mass-luminosity relations and stellar types

4_1522.concept: 英文文本中的局部片段与标点
4_1522.description: 激活分布于多类文本：引语标点、年份与引文数字、专名词内片段，以及生物医学、天文和传感器术语中的碎片；没有一致的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文引号及引语标点
patterns.context: 激活集中在引号、问号和句点等引语内部或其边界；引语内容本身差异较大
patterns.domain: 英文书名、歌词、评论及网页引语

patterns.name: 数字与年份串
patterns.context: 数字出现在作品名、年份或文献年份中，常与标点或英文文本相邻
patterns.domain: 音乐条目、影评、学术文献

patterns.name: 专名及词内片段
patterns.context: 专名或英文词语被分段标记；未见稳定的词义或句法条件

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在基因、蛋白质或微生物名称及相关术语内部，常见分词边界

patterns.name: 参考文献编号片段
patterns.context: 数字嵌在作者—年份式引文键中，并伴随分号、@符号等引用格式
patterns.domain: 天体物理及天文学论文

patterns.name: 可再生传感器术语
patterns.context: 出现在能量采集与无线可充电传感器网络的技术描述中

patterns.name: 数学及基因符号碎片
patterns.context: 出现在转录本编号或变异位点等字母数字混合标识内

patterns.name: 天文缩写碎片
patterns.context: 出现在恒星质量—光度关系及恒星类型的论述中

en.concept: English Word Fragments and Proper-Name Recognition
en.description: Activations are distributed across varied English words and their subword fragments, often involving proper names, terms, punctuation, and titles; academic texts also show section formatting, citations, and biomedical entities. Titles and quotations are also prominent in entertainment entries, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Segmented English words and affixes
patterns.context: Activation falls on whole English words or segmented fragments, often in proper names, terms, common words, and suffixes; the words vary widely in meaning and syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, including biomedical texts, music reviews, film reviews, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Quotation marks, punctuation, and quoted text
patterns.context: Activations occur near punctuation in quotations, titles, lists, or prose; sometimes punctuation and the enclosed words activate together.

patterns.name: Title and document-structure markers
patterns.context: Appears in section headings, heading separators, and numbering in papers or technical documents.

patterns.name: References and digit strings
patterns.context: Digits or citation identifiers are embedded in references, supplementary-material links, or bracketed citations in papers.

patterns.name: Biomedical named entities and abbreviations
patterns.context: Genes, proteins, drug targets, and other technical entities occur in mechanism descriptions, mutation reports, or treatment descriptions; some entities appear only in unmarked context, so the specific trigger word is unclear.

patterns.name: Work titles and review quotations
patterns.context: Work titles, album names, or review statements appear in music- or film-related entries, often enclosed in quotation marks.

4_1522.concept: 英文词片段与专名识别
4_1522.description: 激活分布在多种英文词及其子词片段上，常涉及专名、术语、标点和标题；学术文本中还见章节格式、引用及生物医学实体。文娱条目里标题与引语也突出，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 被拆分的英文词与词缀
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词的完整形式或分词片段上，常见于专名、术语、普通词以及词尾；词本身的语义和句法位置差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，包括生物医学、音乐评论、电影评论、百科条目

patterns.name: 引号、标点与引用文字
patterns.context: 引用、标题、列表或行文中的标点附近出现激活；有时标点与其中的词同时激活。

patterns.name: 标题及文档结构标记
patterns.context: 出现在论文或技术文档的章节标题、标题分隔线及编号中。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文、传感器相关文档

patterns.name: 参考文献与数字串
patterns.context: 数字或引用标识嵌在论文的参考文献、补充材料链接或方括号引用中。

patterns.name: 生物医学命名实体与缩写
patterns.context: 基因、蛋白、药物靶点等专业实体出现在机制描述、突变报告或治疗说明中；部分实体仅有未标记上下文，具体触发词并不明确。

patterns.name: 作品名及评论引语
patterns.trigger: «Why Stop Now»、«Live '89»、«Are You Butt Place?»、«East L.A. style»
patterns.context: 作品标题、专辑名或评论语句出现在音乐或电影相关条目中，且常被引号包围。

en.description: Activations are distributed across varied texts, mainly on segmented proper names, abbreviations, alphanumeric strings, and specially formatted fragments, especially biological, astronomical, and chemical names and author–year citations in academic literature; sporadic triggers also occur in forum speech, URLs, legal formulas, and marketing terms. The shared pattern may be sensitivity to unusual spellings or segmentation boundaries rather than a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Segmented proper names and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments split by the tokenizer in proper names, abbreviations, gene or chemical names, and citation identifiers; word meanings vary across domains.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, astronomy, and chemistry papers and academic citations

patterns.name: Fragments of bacterial genus and species names
patterns.context: Scientific texts in microbiology list species or compare their gene sequences; high activation occurs especially on segmented fragments of Latin names.

patterns.name: Sequence-, gene-, and variant-related words
patterns.context: Statements concerning genes, proteins, or DNA sequences and their homology or mutations.

patterns.name: Astronomical proper names and abbreviations
patterns.context: Proper names or domain abbreviations occur in discussions of star clusters, planetary nebulae, stars, and their relations; activation often concentrates on subwords within names.

patterns.name: Author–year references
patterns.context: Literature citations in academic prose, with author names or years segmented; not all citation fragments trigger equally.

patterns.name: Chemical-name and structural-formula fragments
patterns.context: Structural nomenclature in compound names containing numbers, parentheses, and bond-position markers; activation is not triggered exclusively by ordinary chemistry vocabulary.

patterns.name: English contractions and negative forms
patterns.context: Colloquial English expressing negation or hypothetical consequences, with activation at internal segmentation points.

patterns.name: Emphatic words and colloquial expressions in quotations
patterns.context: Informal quotations discussing the Facebook IPO and investing; activations are scattered across quoted words, not obviously proper names or academic vocabulary.

patterns.name: Google Cloud documentation URL
patterns.context: The domain portion of a URL in a technical question, with nearby mentions of Cloud and App Engine documentation.

patterns.name: Formulas and formatted content in legal documents
patterns.context: A chemical formula is mixed with line breaks, numbering, and OCR-like symbols in scanned or malformed legal materials.
patterns.domain: Legal documents and patent disclosure excerpts

patterns.name: Advertising and marketing terms
patterns.context: Reports concerning telemarketing, cold calls, and do-not-call lists.

4_1522.description: 激活分布在多种文本中，主要落在被分词拆开的专名、缩写、数字字母串及特殊格式片段，尤见于学术文献中的生物、天文、化学名称和作者年份引用；另有论坛口语、网址、法律公式与营销词等零散触发。共同模式可能是对特殊拼写或切分边界敏感，而非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 被切分的专名与字母数字串
patterns.trigger: 词内被拆分标记的片段，如 «N.»、«gon»«or»«rho»、«Mor»«ax»、«NGC»« 13»«99»，以及 «HA»«91»、«fph»«ar» 等
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、缩写、基因或化学名称、引用标识等被分词器拆开的片段上；不同领域的具体词义并不一致
patterns.domain: 生物医学、天文学、化学论文及学术引用

patterns.name: 细菌属种名片段
patterns.context: 细菌学术文本中列举物种或比较其基因序列；高激活尤其出现在拆开的拉丁学名片段
patterns.domain: 微生物学、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 序列、基因及变异相关词
patterns.context: 与基因、蛋白质或 DNA 序列及其同源性、突变有关的陈述

patterns.name: 天文与天体物理专名、缩写
patterns.context: 专名或领域缩写出现在星团、行星状星云、恒星及其关系的讨论中；激活常集中于专名内部的子词
patterns.domain: 天文学与天体物理学论文

patterns.name: 作者—年份式参考文献
patterns.context: 学术正文中的文献引用，作者名或年份被拆分；并非所有引用片段都同样触发

patterns.name: 化学名称与结构式片段
patterns.context: 化合物名称中带数字、括号和键位标记的结构命名；激活并非只由普通化学词汇触发

patterns.name: 英语缩约与否定词形
patterns.context: 口语化英语中表达否定或假设性后果，激活出现在词内切分处

patterns.name: 引号中的强调词及口语表达
patterns.context: 讨论 Facebook IPO 与投资时的非正式引语；激活分散在引语词语上，并非明显的专名或学术词汇

patterns.name: Google Cloud 文档网址
patterns.context: 技术问答中 URL 的域名部分，周围提及 Cloud、App Engine 文档

patterns.name: 法律文书中的公式与格式化内容
patterns.context: 扫描或格式异常的法律材料中，化学通式夹杂换行、编号和 OCR 式符号
patterns.domain: 法律文件与专利披露摘录

patterns.name: 广告营销相关词
patterns.context: 关于电话营销、冷呼及禁止来电名单的报道
patterns.domain: 新闻或消费者保护类文本

en.concept: Segmentation of Numeric Strings and Identifiers
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on numbers and their segmented fragments, especially years, identifiers, literature markers, article codes, chemical-formula numbers, and track durations; they often occur in bibliographic and technical text where quotation marks, parentheses, hyphens, or mixed alphanumeric strings are present.

patterns.name: Closing quotation marks and punctuation after numbers or years
patterns.context: Years, decades, page numbers, or digit strings are segmented, with quotation or entry punctuation nearby; unmarked numbers also often occur next to activated numbers.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, paper citations, and catalogs

patterns.name: Separators and identifiers within digit strings
patterns.context: In article numbers, filenames, formulas, or structural identifiers, digits are split into multiple tokens; activation often falls on digit fragments, hyphens, or underscores.

patterns.name: Numeric fragments in proper names and bibliographic strings
patterns.context: A proper name is followed by a two- or multi-digit year or identifier, and digits may be interleaved with letters.

patterns.name: Duration format
patterns.context: Track durations in minutes and seconds, with digits after a colon.

patterns.name: Numeric fragments in chemical expressions
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded among letters, parentheses, or punctuation in chemical formulas, molecular names, or reaction equations.

4_1522.description: 激活主要集中于数字及其分段片段，尤其是年份、编号、文献标识、文章代码、化学式数字和曲目时长；常出现在引号、括号、连字符或字母数字混排的书目与技术文本中。

patterns.name: 数字或年份后的闭引号与标点
patterns.context: 年份、年代、页码或数字串被分段标记，且附近有引文或条目标点；未标记数字也常与激活数字相邻
patterns.domain: 百科条目、论文引文及目录

patterns.name: 数字串中的分段符号与编号
patterns.context: 文章编号、文件名、公式或结构编号中，数字被拆成多个 token，激活常落在数字片段、连字符或下划线上
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及文档标识

patterns.name: 专名及书目字符串中的数字片段
patterns.context: 人名或专名后接两位或多位年份、编号，数字可能与字母片段交错
patterns.domain: 论文引用及天文物理文本

patterns.name: 时间长度格式
patterns.context: 歌曲目录中的分秒时长，数字位于冒号之后

patterns.name: 化学表达式中的数字片段
patterns.context: 化学式、分子名称或反应式中数字嵌入字母、括号或标点之间
patterns.domain: 专利与生物医学化学文本

en.description: Activations are distributed across heterogeneous text, often falling on quotation marks or apostrophes, numeric identifiers, punctuation, and segmented proper nouns. They span song lists, paper citations and variant identifiers, URLs, forum wording, table formulas, and instrument models, with no single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Text within quotation marks and apostrophes
patterns.context: Song names or other titles are enclosed in English double quotes and contain contractions or possessive apostrophes; hits concentrate on the apostrophe and nearby title characters.

patterns.name: Numbers and alphanumeric strings in proper nouns
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in gene variant identifiers, literature citations, or URLs/file names, often adjacent to letters, punctuation, or percent-encoding.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, astronomy papers, web links

patterns.name: Apostrophes near table identifiers
patterns.context: In table or formula formatting in patent or legal materials, numeric identifiers are adjacent to chemical formulas and apostrophe markers.

patterns.name: English function words and negation/time expressions
patterns.context: Forum prose contains colloquial contractions, negation, or explanations of default time limits; triggers are scattered through sentences.

patterns.name: URL domains and path fragments
patterns.context: Some subwords and punctuation activate within URLs made up of continuous domains, paths, file names, and encoded characters.

patterns.name: Directory titles and track-list formatting
patterns.context: Song entries appear in structured formats including titles, track lists, composer notes, and line breaks, quotation marks, and durations.

patterns.name: Paper terminology and citation formatting
patterns.context: Disciplinary terminology, author names, and year identifiers are mixed together in academic paper text or bracketed references.

patterns.name: Biomedical variant descriptions
patterns.context: Gene and transcript IDs, variant coordinates, and mutation types appear in sentences in medical papers.

patterns.name: Instrument brands and model names
patterns.context: Guitar brands, model names, and product names with years appear in instrument descriptions.

4_1522.concept: 专名与结构化文本片段
4_1522.description: 激活分布在异质文本中，常落于引号/撇号、数字编号、标点及被切分的专名；涵盖歌曲列表、论文引文与变异编号、URL、论坛措辞、表格公式和乐器型号，未见单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 引号与撇号中的文字
patterns.context: 歌曲名或其他标题以英文双引号括起，且包含缩写或所有格撇号；命中位置集中在撇号及其邻近标题字符。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 音乐条目、曲目列表

patterns.name: 专名中的数字及字母数字串
patterns.context: 数字嵌在基因变异编号、文献引用或 URL/文件名中，常邻接字母、标点或百分号编码。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、天文学论文、网页链接

patterns.name: 表格编号附近的撇号
patterns.context: 专利或法律材料的表格/公式排版中，数字编号与化学式、撇号标记相邻。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及否定/时间表达
patterns.context: 论坛自然语言中出现口语缩写、否定表达或设置默认期限的说明；触发分散在句中。

patterns.name: URL 域名及路径片段
patterns.context: 连续的域名、路径、文件名及编码字符构成的 URL 中，部分子词和标点获得激活。

patterns.name: 目录标题和曲目列表格式
patterns.context: 歌曲条目以标题、曲目列表、作曲者说明及换行/引号/时长等结构化格式呈现。

patterns.name: 论文术语及引用格式
patterns.context: 学术论文正文或方括号内参考文献中，学科术语、作者名和年份编号混排。

patterns.name: 生物医学变异描述
patterns.trigger: homozygous« nonsense»4 mutation… C2CD«3»1… NM«_»6… c.«184»1
patterns.context: 基因与转录本编号、变异坐标及突变类型出现在医学论文句子中。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 乐器品牌与型号名称
patterns.context: 吉他品牌、型号名及带年份的产品名称出现在乐器介绍中。

en.concept: Formatted Proper Names and Alphanumeric Fragments
en.description: Activations broadly fall on numbers, internal fragments of proper names, and punctuation, often in format-dense names, years, citations, track lists, chemical formulas, and file markers; sporadic fragments of common words also occur, making it difficult to summarize them as a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Digits in alphanumeric strings and identifiers
patterns.context: Activation falls on digits or digit fragments, often in strings such as gene variant coordinates, citation years, publication years, or track years; digits need not form separate words.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, astronomy papers, music entries, and other numbered materials

patterns.name: Letter fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation covers local letters/subwords within personal names, band names, products, or brands; there is no consistent whole-word-boundary pattern.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, song information, and academic citations

patterns.name: Quotation marks, apostrophes, and special markers
patterns.context: Occurs near album names, song titles, years, or boundaries in formatted citations and text; activation often falls on punctuation or adjacent fragments.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia lists, academic citations, and mixed-format text

patterns.name: Song, album, and band entries
patterns.context: Occurs in titles, track lists, release years, and instrument product descriptions for music works or bands; activation concentrates on title fragments and names.

patterns.name: Chemical-formula and chemical-nomenclature fragments
patterns.context: Located in compound structural formulas, substituent names, or paper figure filenames, mixing numbers, hyphens, letters, and abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Chemistry, biomedical papers, and patent text

patterns.name: English fragments in negatives or proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs in local spellings within negative-form product/feature names or proper names; there is insufficient evidence of a stable response to negation semantics itself.

4_1522.concept: 格式化专名与字母数字片段
4_1522.description: 激活广泛落在数字、专名内部片段及标点上，常见于格式密集的名称、年份、引文、曲目表、化学式和文件标记；也有零散普通词片段，难以归纳为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 字母数字串与编号中的数字
patterns.context: 激活落在数字或数字片段上，常处于基因变异坐标、文献引用年份、出版年份、曲目年份等编号串中；数字不必单独成词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、天文学论文、音乐条目及其他带编号的资料

patterns.name: 专名内部的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖人名、乐队名、产品或品牌名中的局部字母/子词；并非一致的完整词边界模式。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、歌曲信息和学术引文

patterns.name: 引号、撇号及特殊标记
patterns.context: 在专辑名、歌曲名、年份或格式化的引文与文本边界附近出现；激活常落在标点或其相邻片段。
patterns.domain: 百科列表、学术引用及格式混杂文本

patterns.name: 歌曲、专辑及乐队条目
patterns.context: 出现在音乐作品或乐队的标题、曲目表、发行年份和乐器产品介绍中；激活集中于标题片段和名称。

patterns.name: 化学式与化学命名片段
patterns.context: 位于化合物结构式、取代基名称或论文图文件名中，混合数字、连字符、字母和缩写。
patterns.domain: 化学、生物医学论文及专利文本

patterns.name: 否定或专名中的英文词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在否定式产品/功能名称或专名的局部拼写中；没有足够证据表明对否定语义本身有稳定反应。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体讨论、乐队名称

en.description: Activations are scattered across table markers, quotation marks and titles, segmented drug and personal names, citation years, supplementary-material/variant identifiers, and two “Do Not” phrases. Most are local subwords or formatting tokens, with no unified semantic trigger apparent.

patterns.name: Quotation boundaries in song titles and album track lists
patterns.context: Track lists or quoted song titles in music entries; activation concentrates on quotation marks, title fragments, and adjacent title formatting.

patterns.name: Segmentation within drug names
patterns.context: Generic drug names are split into multiple subword fragments, especially BRAF/MEK inhibitors ending in -fenib.

patterns.name: Author and year fragments in paper citations
patterns.context: Year-number fragments activate when astronomy papers list references consecutively in author-year format.

patterns.name: Table markers and row/column structure
patterns.context: Wikipedia table markup, line breaks, and column values occur together; some columns also contain years and film titles.

patterns.name: Slack's Do Not Disturb feature name
patterns.context: Slack’s “Do Not Disturb” is segmented in a discussion about do-not-disturb settings and workplace communication.

patterns.name: Supplementary-material citations and variant identifiers
patterns.context: A gene research paper contains HTML attributes for supplementary materials alongside transcript IDs and variant coordinates.

patterns.name: Do Not Call list phrase
patterns.context: In an anti-telemarketing context, someone mentions being placed on a “Do Not Call” list; it shares some word forms with segment 4 but has a different meaning.

patterns.name: Apostrophes and formula formatting in chemical formulas
patterns.context: A patent text presents a dicarboxylic acid general formula, preceded by a line break, with apostrophe-marked variables and chemical formulas after R.

patterns.name: Hendrix subword in a personal name
patterns.context: A music biography mentions Jim Hendrix Experience; activation falls on a segmented part of the name and the band name.

4_1522.description: 激活分散于表格标记、引号与标题、药名和人名内部切分、引文年份、补充材料/变异编号，以及两种“Do Not”短语；多为局部子词或格式 token，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 歌名及专辑曲目表中的引号边界
patterns.context: 音乐条目中的曲目列表或引号包住的歌名，激活集中在引号、标题片段及相邻标题格式上。

patterns.name: 药名内部切分
patterns.context: 药物通用名被拆成多个子词片段，尤其是以 -fenib 结尾的 BRAF/MEK 抑制剂名称。

patterns.name: 论文引用中的作者与年份片段
patterns.context: 天文学论文以作者—年份格式连续列举文献时，年份数字片段激活。

patterns.name: 表格标记与行列结构
patterns.context: 百科表格的维基标记、换行及列值交错出现；部分列中还含年份和影视标题。

patterns.name: Slack 的免打扰功能名称
patterns.context: Slack 的 “Do Not Disturb” 被拆分，处于讨论免打扰设置和工作沟通的语境。

patterns.name: 补充材料引用及变异编号
patterns.context: 基因研究文章中同时出现补充材料的 HTML 属性、转录本编号和变异坐标。

patterns.name: 禁止来电名单短语
patterns.context: 反电话营销语境中提及被列入 “Do Not Call” 名单；与第4段共享部分词形，但含义不同。

patterns.name: 化学式中的撇号及公式排版
patterns.context: 专利文本展示二羧酸通式，公式前有换行，R 后接带撇号的变量及化学式。

patterns.name: 人名中的 Hendrix 子词
patterns.context: 音乐人经历叙述中出现 Jim Hendrix Experience，激活落在人名内部切分及乐队名上。

en.concept: Specific string fragments and summary markers
en.description: Primarily responds to the string fragment “den,” especially in the surname Belden, across email, quotation, legal, and historical texts; also responds to the fixed ArXiv abstract opening “---↵abstract:” and to “ital” in the single occurrence of Capitalism.

patterns.name: Surname Belden
patterns.context: Appears as a person’s or patent-related surname in email signatures, email subject lines, academic citation author names, legal document names, and historical narratives.
patterns.domain: Email, academic papers, legal documents, encyclopedias

patterns.name: Paper abstract opening marker
patterns.context: Acts as a separator and abstract label in an ArXiv paper, followed by the abstract text.

patterns.name: Capitalism word fragment
patterns.context: Appears once at the beginning of a sentence as part of the word Capitalism; no stable additional contextual condition is evident.

4_1620.concept: 特定字符串片段与摘要标记
4_1620.description: 主要响应字符串片段“den”，尤其出现在姓氏 Belden 中，跨邮件、引文、法律及历史文本；另响应 ArXiv 摘要固定开头“---↵abstract:”，以及单次词语 Capitalism 中的“ital”。

patterns.name: 姓氏 Belden
patterns.context: 作为人名/专利相关姓氏出现；在邮件署名、邮件主题、学术引用作者名、法律文书人名及历史叙述中均有
patterns.domain: 邮件、学术论文、法律文书、百科

patterns.name: 论文摘要起始标记
patterns.context: 作为 ArXiv 论文摘要的分隔线与 abstract 标签，后接摘要正文

patterns.name: Capitalism 词语片段
patterns.context: 单次出现在句首，组成单词 Capitalism；未见稳定的额外上下文条件

en.concept: Multiple subword fragments and abstract-format markers
en.description: Strong responses are distributed across multiple subword fragments: den in Belden, Selden, usden, and denying, and ital in Capitalism; there is also a stable response to the “--- abstract:” format marker at the beginning of ArXiv abstracts.

patterns.name: Surname Selden
patterns.context: Selden as a personal name in an account of automotive patent history; the surname is split into subwords

patterns.name: Surname Belden
patterns.context: The personal name Belden in email bodies, signatures, or subject lines; activation occurs at the surname’s token boundary

patterns.name: usden substring
patterns.context: The usden substring occurs in proper names such as “Oudheusden,” as part of a cited author’s name

patterns.name: den in denying
patterns.context: The initial part of denying is tokenized as den + ying in legal text

patterns.name: Abstract separator
patterns.context: The fixed marker at the beginning of an ArXiv abstract and the following abstract label; activation concentrates on the dash sequence, while subsequent abstract content varies

patterns.name: Capitalism initial fragment
patterns.context: The sentence-initial word Capitalism is split; it is followed by a direct reference to capitalism

4_1620.concept: 多种词片段与摘要格式标记
4_1620.description: 强响应分散在多个分词片段：Belden、Selden、usden、denying 中的 den，以及 Capitalism 的 ital；另对 ArXiv 摘要开头的“--- abstract:”格式标记稳定响应。

patterns.name: Selden 姓氏
patterns.context: 人名中的 Selden；出现在汽车专利史叙述中，且该姓被分成子词

patterns.name: Belden 姓氏
patterns.context: 邮件正文或签名/主题中的人名 Belden，姓氏分词边界处激活

patterns.name: usden 子串
patterns.context: “Oudheusden”一类专名中包含 usden 子串，属于文献引用作者名

patterns.name: denying 中的 den
patterns.context: 法律文本中 denying 一词的词首部分被切分为 den + ying

patterns.name: 摘要分隔符
patterns.context: ArXiv 摘要开头的固定标记及其后的 abstract 标签；触发集中在破折号序列，后续摘要内容不同

patterns.name: Capitalism 词首
patterns.context: 句首单词 Capitalism 被拆分；其后是对资本主义的直接称呼

en.concept: Specific token fragments and abstract-format markers
en.description: Activation primarily occurs on the subword fragment den, especially in Belden, Selden, or other words, and responds strongly to the fixed separator in ArXiv abstract headers; it also responds independently to ital in Capitalism. No unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Fragments of the surnames Belden/Selden
patterns.context: High activation falls on den after tokenization; it appears in the names Belden and Selden (the latter in a patent-related context), as well as in word-internal den fragments.
patterns.domain: Emails, historical encyclopedias, academic citations, and legal texts

patterns.name: Abstract separator
patterns.context: The fixed separator at the beginning of an ArXiv abstract appears consecutively with the abstract label.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in capitalism
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the middle token «ital» in Capitalism; the sentence is an exclamation about work and capitalism.

4_1620.concept: 特定分词片段与摘要格式标记
4_1620.description: 激活主要落在分词片段 den（尤其 Belden、Selden 或其他词内），另对 ArXiv 摘要头部固定分隔符高响应；还单独响应 Capitalism 中的 ital，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 姓氏 Belden/ Selden 的片段
patterns.context: 高激活落在分词后的 den；出现于人名 Belden、专利相关姓氏 Selden，以及词内片段 den。
patterns.domain: 邮件、历史百科、学术引文及法律文本

patterns.name: 摘要分隔符
patterns.context: ArXiv 摘要开头的固定分隔符与 abstract 标签连续出现。

patterns.name: capitalism 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在单词 Capitalism 的中间 token「ital」；句子以感叹句谈工作与资本主义。

en.description: Primarily responds to the ArXiv metadata separator and field labels, especially abstract:, and also author:; one instance of activation on the ordinary English phrase Capitalism gave you does not clearly fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: ArXiv abstract separator and label
patterns.context: Appears in ArXiv document metadata, with a line break after the dashes and the label abstract:; the following abstract content varies.

patterns.name: ArXiv author field
patterns.context: After the dashes and a line break, the author: field introduces an author list.

patterns.name: Capitalism word form and following phrase
patterns.context: Capitalism, split into subword fragments, appears in an ordinary sentence followed by “gave you a job!”; unrelated to ArXiv metadata format.

4_1620.description: 主要响应 ArXiv 元数据的横线换行及字段标签，尤其是 abstract:，也覆盖 author:；另有一例对 Capitalism gave you 的普通英语短语激活，无法与主模式明显统一。

patterns.name: ArXiv 摘要分隔符与标签
patterns.context: 出现在 ArXiv 文档元数据中，横线后换行并以 abstract: 开始；后续摘要内容各不相同。

patterns.name: ArXiv 作者字段
patterns.context: 横线后换行，出现 author: 作者列表字段。

patterns.name: Capitalism 词形及后续短语
patterns.context: 普通句子中出现分词拼成的 Capitalism，后接“gave you a job!”；与 ArXiv 元数据格式无关。

en.description: Strongly responds to the word-initial fragment «Acc» (five PubMed titles), as well as salient fragments of words or proper names at token boundaries and title/document-format markers; the latter categories are scattered across different corpora, with no unified semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Word-initial Acc-
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of words, followed by «el» (Accelerated), «uracy» (Accuracy), «urate» (Accurate), and «ult» (Acculturation); these are all word-internal subword fragments.

patterns.name: Serialized Spanish title
patterns.context: A Spanish phrase with tokenization markers appears in a title: «Problemas al ordenar archivo csv python», interspersed with line breaks and punctuation.

patterns.name: Capitalism
patterns.context: The word Capitalism appears in the colloquial political sentence «Capitalism gave you a job!» with an exclamation mark.

patterns.name: Place name Kirkandrews
patterns.context: The proper name Kirkandrews is assembled from subwords; one occurrence is in a railway-station entry and geographical description, and another appears in an email company name, «Kirk Ketcherside with IGI Resources, Inc.»

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in Eden
patterns.context: «Eden» appears in the place name «Kirkandrews-on-Eden», with «den» as a salient word-internal fragment.

patterns.name: Document separator
patterns.context: Three hyphens form a line followed immediately by a newline and «abstract:» at the beginning of paper content.

4_1620.description: 强烈响应词首片段 «Acc»（五段 PubMed 标题），也响应若干分词边界处的醒目词片段或专名，以及标题/文档格式标记；后几类分散于不同语料，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 词首 Acc-
patterns.context: 出现在单词开头，后续分别接 «el»（Accelerated）、«uracy»（Accuracy）、«urate»（Accurate）、«ult»（Acculturation）；都是词内分词片段。

patterns.name: 序列化的西班牙语标题
patterns.context: 标题中出现分词标记的西班牙语短语 «Problemas al ordenar archivo csv python»，并夹有换行及标点。

patterns.name: Capitalism
patterns.context: 单词 Capitalism 出现在带感叹号的口语化政治句子 «Capitalism gave you a job!» 中。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页文本／口号式句子

patterns.name: 地名 Kirkandrews
patterns.context: 分词拼出的专名 Kirkandrews；一处位于铁路站条目与地理描述中，另一处出现在邮件中的公司名称 «Kirk Ketcherside with IGI Resources, Inc.»。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 地理条目；Enron 邮件

patterns.name: Eden 的词尾片段
