patterns.context: «Eden» 出现在地名 «Kirkandrews-on-Eden» 中，且 «den» 是醒目的词内片段。

patterns.name: 文档分隔符
patterns.context: 三个连字符构成的横线后紧接换行及 «abstract:»，位于论文内容的开头。

en.description: The most apparent recurring trigger is “pitched,” but it spans distinct senses involving promotion, battle, roofs, throwing, and pitching a ball. Other high activations fall on unrelated fragments involving absence records, Rails checkboxes, a signature name, and stem-cell signals, making it difficult to group them into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Multiple senses of pitched
patterns.context: The same word form occurs in different contexts: business promotion, fierce battle, roof shape, throwing an object away, and baseball pitching; the meanings are not unified.

patterns.name: Absence and attendance records
patterns.context: Discusses being absent for several consecutive days and checking school attendance records; high activation falls on “recorded”.

patterns.name: Rails checkbox associations
patterns.context: Updates checkbox values in a Rails has_and_belongs_to_many relationship; high activation falls on “boxes”.

patterns.name: Name in production credits
patterns.context: A production credit line in an electronic text, with a name split into multiple subwords; high activation falls on “Sha”.

patterns.name: Stem-cell signal response
patterns.context: Stem cells begin to differentiate after receiving the appropriate activation signals; high activation falls on “receive”.

4_1620.description: 最明显的重复触发是“pitched”，但涵盖推介、战斗、屋顶、投掷和投球等不同义项。其余高激活分别落在缺勤记录、Rails 复选框、署名名字及干细胞接收信号等互不相同的片段，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: pitched 的多义用法
patterns.context: 同一词形出现在商业推介、激烈战斗、屋顶形状、把物品扔开、棒球投球等不同语境；意义并不统一。

patterns.name: 缺勤与考勤记录
patterns.context: 讨论连续多日缺勤，并查询学校考勤记录；高激活落在“recorded”。

patterns.name: Rails 复选框关联
patterns.context: Rails 的 has_and_belongs_to_many 关系中更新复选框值；高激活落在“boxes”。

patterns.name: 制作人员署名中的名字
patterns.context: 电子文本的制作人员署名行，名字被拆成多个子词；高激活落在“Sha”。

patterns.name: 干细胞信号响应
patterns.context: 干细胞接收适当的激活信号后开始分化；高激活落在“receive”。

en.description: Most strong activations fall on improving, across contexts involving improvements in business operations, patient outcomes, paper quality, HDL function, detection metrics, medical practice, and cancer treatment; receive is also activated in two sports-related contexts, and considering in one instance.

patterns.name: Meaning and form of improving
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences describing improved, enhanced, or optimized outcomes or functions; often takes an object and can also appear in gerund constructions.
patterns.domain: Business emails, medical and research abstracts, technical papers, writing advice, and sports coverage

patterns.name: receive in sports coverage
patterns.context: receive is followed by an item or playing time someone will get; appears in an informal email question or player news.

patterns.name: Considering as an introduction to an assessment
patterns.context: Introduces background circumstances to consider when making an assessment or judgment.

4_1620.description: 多数强激活落在 improving，涵盖商业运营、患者结局、论文质量、HDL功能、检测指标、医疗实践和癌症治疗等改善语境；另在两处体育相关语境激活 receive，并在一处激活 considering。

patterns.name: improving 的语义和词形
patterns.context: 在描述改善、提升、优化结果或功能的句子中；常接宾语，也可用于动名词结构。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、医疗与科研摘要、技术论文、写作建议及体育报道

patterns.name: 体育报道中的 receive
patterns.context: receive 后接某人将获得的物品或上场时间；出现在非正式邮件提问或球员新闻中。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的体育相关内容

patterns.name: considering 引导考量
patterns.context: 用于引出评价或判断时需要考虑的背景情况。

en.description: Activations are scattered across email commitments, checking and reimbursement, first-person biographies, philosophical study, research improvements and conditional terminology, as well as startup pitches and descriptions of intense conflict; there is no clear unified lexical or semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: First-person commitment or duty
patterns.context: First-person “I” is followed by a statement of something to be completed, handled, or undertaken; this example is an email commitment.

patterns.name: First-person experience and knowledge statements
patterns.context: The first person reports what was learned or imagined from a specific text or experience; activation falls within the work’s title.
patterns.domain: Philosophy papers discussing fiction, imagination, and knowledge

patterns.name: First-person career aspirations and long-term commitment
patterns.context: The first person describes a long-term commitment in the perfect tense, followed by a career or research field.

patterns.name: To-do items and checks
patterns.context: In an email, the first person says that an item needs to be checked, followed by contract details.

patterns.name: Startup product criticism and investment pitches
patterns.context: Startup or product discussions assess features and interfaces and consider pitching to investors; another colloquial fragment expresses leaving or lack of interest.

patterns.name: Research improvement in an academic abstract
patterns.context: The abstract opens with “This work is devoted to improving…” to introduce the research objective.

patterns.name: Conflict or competition reaching an intense stage
patterns.context: In an account of the confrontation between climate change advocates and the fossil fuel industry, “pitched battle” describes an intense struggle.
patterns.domain: News coverage, climate and energy issues

patterns.name: Expense reports and deadlines in email
patterns.context: The first person needs to submit an expense report by a specified date.

patterns.name: Startup pitching amid funding difficulties
patterns.context: A startup account describes pitching to venture capitalists while a platform partnership is stalled and funds are running low; this shares the startup/investment context of pattern 5.

patterns.name: Conditional scheme or conditional treatment
patterns.context: The predictions of multiverse theory must be evaluated using a conditional scheme to assess probability distributions; the highlighted word is part of a term.
patterns.domain: ArXiv theoretical physics, probability, and anthropic reasoning

4_1620.description: 激活分散于邮件承诺、核查与报销，第一人称履历、哲学学习，论文中的改进及条件化术语，以及创业推介和激烈冲突表述；没有明显统一的词法或语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 第一人称承诺或履责
patterns.trigger: «I»8« will»6« get»10« this»6« taken»7« care»4« of»6«
patterns.context: 第一人称“I”后接将要完成、处理或承担某事的表达；此例为邮件中的承诺。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件、日常工作沟通

patterns.name: 第一人称经历与知识陈述
patterns.context: 以第一人称报告从某个具体文本或经验中学到、想象到的内容；激活落在作品名内部。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文，讨论小说、想象与知识

patterns.name: 第一人称职业志向与长期投入
patterns.trigger: «I»8« have»8« been»9« committed»9« to»7« a»4« career»4« in»6
patterns.context: 第一人称以完成时态表述长期承诺，并接职业或研究领域。

patterns.name: 待办事项与核查
patterns.context: 邮件中第一人称说明需要检查某事项，随后列出合同细节。

patterns.name: 创业产品批评与投资推介
patterns.context: 创业或产品讨论中评价功能、界面，并设想向投资者推介；另有表达退出或不感兴趣的口语片段。

patterns.name: 学术摘要中的研究改进
patterns.context: 摘要开头以“This work is devoted to improving…”引出研究目标。

patterns.name: 冲突或竞争达到激烈阶段
patterns.context: 在气候变化与化石燃料产业的对抗叙述中，用“pitched battle”形容激烈斗争。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、气候与能源议题

patterns.name: 邮件中的费用报告与截止期限
patterns.trigger: «I»8« need»3« to»7« get»9« expense»4« reports»5« in»6
patterns.context: 第一人称需要在指定日期前提交费用报告。

patterns.name: 融资困境中的创业推介
patterns.context: 平台合作受阻、资金将尽的创业叙述中，提到向风险投资人推介；与第5段同属创业/投资语境。

patterns.name: 条件化方案或条件化处理
patterns.context: 多重宇宙理论的预测需结合一种条件化方案来评估概率分布；高亮词位于术语内部。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论物理、概率与人择推理

en.description: High-activation fragments are scattered across different words and word fragments: Limiting, I, goal statements, funding pitches, Know, Limor in an email address, Tonight, Impact, and Trim. Apart from repeated words, the semantics and domains differ substantially.

patterns.name: Limit/limiting stem
patterns.context: The word begins with the split fragment “Lim,” followed by “iting”; one context discusses reducing dietary variety, and another discusses conditions limiting the use of specialist knowledge.
patterns.domain: NIH nutrition research abstract; PubMed health services research abstract

patterns.name: First-person pronoun I
patterns.context: The first-person pronoun appears at the beginning of a sentence or in an abbreviation; one instance is colloquial email language.

patterns.name: first/goal objective statements
patterns.context: A research plan identifies its primary objective and elaborates on research goals later.

patterns.name: emphasis
patterns.context: A research objective states that the focus is on a particular category of influencing factors.

patterns.name: pitched funding statement
patterns.context: An entrepreneur describes having pitched to venture capitalists but not yet receiving funding.

patterns.name: Know as an imperative suggestion
patterns.context: An imperative suggestion at the beginning of a sentence appears in both a religious statement and a leadership checklist, with different meanings and contexts.

patterns.name: Limor email string
patterns.context: A string fragment within a name or email address, with no clear semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Tonight in a weather forecast
patterns.context: The initial part of a time word used in a weather forecast describing conditions that night.
patterns.domain: Weather forecast in an Enron email

patterns.name: Impact in a heading
patterns.context: A research application abstract uses a heading about impact to introduce the project objectives.

patterns.name: Trim weight-loss phase name
patterns.context: The name of a phase in a weight-loss program, followed by a description of achieving weight-loss goals.

4_1620.description: 高激活片段主要分散在不同词语或词内片段：Limiting、I、目标表述、融资推介、Know、邮箱中的 Limor、Tonight、Impact 与 Trim。除同词重复外，各段语义和领域差异较大。

patterns.name: Limit/limiting 词干
patterns.context: 词首被切分为 “Lim”，后接 “iting”；一个语境讨论减少饮食种类，另一个讨论限制使用专科知识的条件。
patterns.domain: NIH 营养研究摘要；PubMed 医疗服务研究摘要

patterns.name: 人称代词 I
patterns.context: 第一人称代词出现在句首或缩写中；其中一处为邮件口语表达。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究申请；Enron 邮件

patterns.name: first/goal 目标表述
patterns.context: 研究计划中说明首要目标，并在后文展开研究目标。

patterns.name: emphasis 强调词
patterns.context: 研究目标陈述中，说明研究重点落在某类影响因素上。
patterns.domain: NIH 家庭人口学研究申请

patterns.name: pitched 融资陈述
patterns.context: 创业者描述向风投推介但尚未获得融资的处境。

patterns.name: Know 祈使式建议
patterns.context: 句首祈使式建议，分别出现在宗教语句和领导力清单中，含义及语境不同。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件；PubMed 领导力建议

patterns.name: Limor 邮箱字符串
patterns.context: 姓名或邮箱地址内部的字符串片段，没有明显的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Tonight 天气预报时间词
patterns.context: 天气预报在描述当晚天气时使用的时间词首段。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的天气预报

patterns.name: Impact 标题词
patterns.context: 研究申请摘要中以影响意义标题引出项目目标。

patterns.name: Trim 减重阶段名
patterns.context: 减重项目分阶段说明中的阶段名称，后接实现减重目标的描述。

en.description: Activations are often triggered by the initial word fragments “Lim” and “Un,” across different meanings and styles; there is also the proper name Uber and an email confidentiality label. No stable shared semantics or context is evident.

patterns.name: Lim/Limiting word fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning or within words, in spelling fragments from different words such as limits, Limba, and Limiting; meanings are not consistent.

patterns.name: Initial Un
patterns.context: As an initial fragment, it precedes varying content in Uniting, Unix, Unusual, and random identifiers in JSON strings.
patterns.domain: Website copy, technical discussions, encyclopedias, code

patterns.name: Uber
patterns.context: Appears as a proper name in a passage discussing Uber and its impact on value creation for drivers.

patterns.name: CONFIDENTIAL
patterns.context: An uppercase confidentiality notice in an email body, with emphasis separators.

4_1620.description: 激活多由词首片段“Lim”和“Un”触发，横跨不同词义与文体；另有 Uber 专名和邮件保密标记。没有稳定的共同语义或语境。

patterns.name: Lim/Limiting 词片段
patterns.context: 在词首或词内，出现在 limits、Limba、Limiting 等不同词的拼写片段中；语义并不一致。

patterns.name: Un 词首
patterns.context: 作为词首片段，出现在 Uniting、Unix、Unusual、JSON 字符串中的随机标识符等不同后续内容前。
patterns.domain: 网站文案、技术讨论、百科、代码

patterns.name: Uber
patterns.context: 作为专名在讨论 Uber 及其对司机创造价值影响的段落中出现。

patterns.name: CONFIDENTIAL
patterns.context: 出现在邮件正文中的大写保密声明，带有强调分隔符。

en.description: Activations are scattered across several words and phrases: senses of firmly involving fixation or grounding, Intel, vital impact, noun phrases with of in literary texts, research narratives, and discussions of linguistic vocabulary; no unified trigger condition is evident.

patterns.name: firmly and related collocations
patterns.context: The word occurs in collocations describing close connection, fixation, or a reliable basis; “firmly” may be followed by secured, associated, or grounded.
patterns.domain: Technical explanations, philosophical introductions, everyday advice

patterns.name: Intel brand name
patterns.context: Appears in contexts discussing Intel technology, products, or employees.

patterns.name: Emphasizing importance or impact
patterns.context: Modifies impact to indicate the importance of something to patient care.

patterns.name: Noun phrases with of in narrative
patterns.context: Appears in noun phrases in religious prose or narrative texts, such as “of God,” “of El,” and “of the quack”.

patterns.name: Discussion of function words and lexical repetition
patterns.context: Discusses words in sentences, similar sounds, and functional load; activation falls on “words” and nearby context.

patterns.name: Narrative of research and discovery
patterns.context: Describes someone studying a field and gradually glimpsing its wonders.

4_1620.description: 激活分散在若干词汇与搭配：firmly 的固定或依据义、Intel、vital impact，以及文学文本中的 of 短语、研究叙事和语言学词汇讨论；未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: firmly 及其近义搭配
patterns.context: 该词出现在描述紧密结合、固定或有可靠依据的搭配中；“firmly”后可接 secured、associated、grounded。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、哲学介绍、日常建议

patterns.name: Intel 品牌名
patterns.context: 出现在谈论 Intel 技术、产品或员工的语境中。

patterns.name: 强调重要性或影响
patterns.context: 修饰 impact，说明某事项对患者照护的重要作用。

patterns.name: 叙事中的名词 of 短语
patterns.context: 出现在宗教散文或叙事文本的名词短语中，如“of God”“of El”“of the quack”。

patterns.name: 功能词及词汇重复的讨论
patterns.context: 讨论句中词语、相似声音及功能负荷；激活落在“words”及附近语境。

patterns.name: 研究与发现的叙事
patterns.context: 描述人物研究某领域、逐渐窥见其中奇妙事物的过程。

en.concept: Specific word forms and identifier fragments
en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on specific string fragments: Cit, Intel, and fragments such as Token/key in code identifiers; these occur in patents, technical discussions, encyclopedias, reviews, and code text, without a unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Citronella or Cit prefix
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the initial substring «Cit» of a word or proper name, followed respectively by ronella, ations, and icorp; no consistent syntactic or semantic context is required.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, museum reviews, news headlines

patterns.name: Proper name Intel and adjacent text
patterns.context: Intel appears as a company name, followed by a trademark symbol, parentheses, a copula, a possessive, or a product number.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: In code or code-like text, activation falls on fragments of camel-case identifiers (keyIwant, formToken) and adjacent punctuation/assignment symbols; the activation span may cross subwords.

4_1620.concept: 特定词形与标识符片段
4_1620.description: 激活主要集中于特定字符串片段：Cit、Intel，以及代码标识符中的 Token/key 等片段；分布于专利、技术讨论、百科、评论和代码文本，缺少统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: Citronella 或 Cit 前缀
patterns.context: 触发点落在单词或专名的开头子串「Cit」，后续分别接 ronella、ations、icorp；并不依赖一致的句法或语义环境。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、博物馆评论、新闻标题

patterns.name: Intel 专名及其邻接
patterns.context: Intel 作为厂商名出现，后续可接商标符号、括号、系词、所有格或产品编号。

patterns.name: 编码标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 在代码或类代码文本中，激活落在驼峰命名标识符的片段（keyIwant、formToken）及其紧邻标点/赋值符号；触发范围可能跨越子词。

en.description: Strong activations often fall on within-word fragments: Intel, Cit, DOM, Key, Dean, and rever; there are also of and tongue-in-cheek. The contexts vary widely, and the activations may relate to local subwords or spelling fragments.

patterns.name: Intel occurring within a word
patterns.context: Intel appears as a proper name in technical, software, or hardware contexts, followed by either a registered trademark symbol or a product name.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions, computer technology discussions

patterns.name: Cit occurring within a word
patterns.context: Cit is the beginning of a longer proper name: Citronella or Citations.
patterns.domain: Patent background information, museum and academic writing

patterns.name: DOM occurring within a word
patterns.context: DOM appears in code comments as part of DOM Storage.

patterns.name: Key occurring within a word
patterns.context: Key appears in a keyboard event API documentation path, adjacent to identifiers such as keyboard, Event, and key.

patterns.name: Dean occurring within a word
patterns.context: Dean is the beginning of the job title dean, appearing in an account of university employment.

patterns.name: rever occurring within a word
patterns.context: rever begins reverberates, describing energy echoing through an atmosphere of the mind.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC spiritual or New Age-style text

patterns.name: of occurring within a word
patterns.context: of appears in the expression “There was nothing of interest,” with a narrative description of a street nearby.

patterns.name: tongue-in-cheek in a sentence
patterns.context: Determines whether a poster is serious or sarcastic; the phrase is split across a line break.

4_1620.description: 强激活多落在词内片段：Intel、Cit、DOM、Key、Dean、rever；另有 of、tongue-in-cheek。各例语境差异大，可能与局部子词或拼写片段有关。

patterns.name: 词中包含的 Intel
patterns.context: Intel 作为专名出现在技术、软件或硬件语境中；分别接注册商标符号或产品名称。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、计算机技术讨论

patterns.name: 词中包含的 Cit
patterns.context: Cit 是较长专名的开头：Citronella 或 Citations。
patterns.domain: 专利背景说明、博物馆与学术写作

patterns.name: 词中包含的 DOM
patterns.context: DOM 出现在代码注释中，作为 DOM Storage 的组成部分。

patterns.name: 词中包含的 Key
patterns.context: Key 出现在键盘事件 API 的文档路径中，并与 keyboard、Event、key 等标识符相邻。

patterns.name: 词中包含的 Dean
patterns.context: Dean 是职位名称 dean 的词首，出现在大学任职经历中。

patterns.name: 词中包含的 rever
patterns.context: rever 是 reverberates 的词首，描述能量在心灵氛围中回响。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 灵性或新时代风格文字

patterns.name: 词中包含的 of
patterns.context: of 出现在“There was nothing of interest”这一表达中，附近为叙事性的街景描写。

patterns.name: 句中包含的 tongue-in-cheek
patterns.context: 判断发帖者是在认真还是讽刺；短语被换行拆开。

en.concept: Inconsistent local word-form and structural triggers
en.description: Activation is scattered across varied contexts: abstract nouns following of, it in emphatic sentences, body parts such as hand/foot, and labels, data, and research terms in classification or technical text. The trigger forms are not consistent.

patterns.name: Abstract nouns following of
patterns.context: Relatively strong activation occurs before nouns such as interest, value, and significance after of; it also activates in questions or emphatic constructions.
patterns.domain: Novels, forum text, personal health accounts, email Q&A, and business articles

patterns.name: Body parts and quantity expressions
patterns.context: hand or foot appears in descriptions of bodily movement, lists of body parts, or quantity phrases; activation is not always strong.

patterns.name: Classification labels and category names
patterns.context: Activation appears near labels, colons, and following categories or key names in marked or structured text.

patterns.name: Data and research terminology
patterns.context: Local contexts involving technical terms such as data, methylation, and markers, as well as compound product names.

4_1620.concept: 不一致的局部词形与结构触发
4_1620.description: 激活分散于多种语境：of 后的抽象名词、强调句中的 it、hand/foot 等身体部位，以及分类或技术文本中的标签、数据和研究术语。各处触发形式并不统一。

patterns.name: of 后接抽象名词
patterns.trigger: “of»10« interest»4”（[1]）；“anything« of»8« value»2”（[3]）；“nothing« of»8« significance»2”（[5]）；另见“it»8”（[4]、[9]）
patterns.context: 较明显的高激活出现在 of 后的 interest、value、significance 等名词前；另有 it 在疑问或强调结构中激活。
patterns.domain: 小说、论坛文字、个人健康叙述、邮件问答及商业文章

patterns.name: 身体部位与数量表达
patterns.context: hand 或 foot 出现在身体动作、身体部位列举或数量短语中；并非每次都强激活。
patterns.domain: 法律叙述、小说、健康叙述

patterns.name: 分类标签与类别名
patterns.context: 标记或结构化文本中的标签、冒号及其后的类别或键名附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 数据与研究术语
patterns.context: data、methylation、markers 等技术词及复合产品名的局部上下文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、商业技术文章

en.description: Activations are scattered across noun phrases introduced by of, the nothing but construction, foot phrases, and several words or subwords with no apparent commonality. The material spans fiction, online discussions, encyclopedias, and technical text, making it difficult to attribute the activations to a single semantic or syntactic feature.

patterns.name: of phrases before nouns
patterns.context: of introduces noun phrases expressing possession, properties, content, or association; the trigger is not limited to a fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Fiction, encyclopedias, technical explanations, and online articles

patterns.name: but indicating exclusion or contrast
patterns.context: but follows nothing to mean “only/nothing more than”; pattern 5 uses a contrastive description, while pattern 8 summarizes web content.

patterns.name: foot-related compounds or phrases
patterns.context: foot refers to a body part or forms part of footlights; the two instances have different meanings.

patterns.name: Specific words or rare fragments
patterns.context: Each passage has only local token activations, with no identifiable shared syntactic or semantic condition; passage 7 in particular resembles sporadic subwords in Russian regular-expression text.
patterns.domain: Fiction, online articles, technical documentation, Russian technical Q&A

4_1620.description: 激活分散在 of 引出的名词短语、nothing but 结构、foot 词组及若干无明显共性的词或子词；材料横跨小说、网络讨论、百科与技术文本，难以归结为单一语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: 名词前的 of 短语
patterns.trigger: “of interest”“of a meteoric nature”“of a power loss”“of the ocean”
patterns.context: of 引出所属、性质、内容或关联名词短语；触发并不局限于某个固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 小说、百科、技术说明及网络文章

patterns.name: but 表示排除或转折
patterns.context: but 出现在 nothing 后，表示“只有／不过是”；第5段为对照式描写，第8段为网页内容概述。

patterns.name: foot 相关复合词或词组
patterns.context: foot 作为身体部位，或作为 footlights 的构词部分；两处语义不同。

patterns.name: 特定单词或罕见片段
patterns.context: 各段只有局部 token 激活，未见可确认的共同句法或语义条件；第7段尤其像俄语正则表达式文本中的零碎子词。
patterns.domain: 小说、网络文章、技术文档、俄语技术问答

en.concept: Preposition of and several lexical/contextual triggers
en.description: The most stable cue is the preposition of, especially in something/nothing/anything of + noun phrase, and also in of interest. Other cases include descriptions of gazing and movement, stage footlights, and a single instance of strongly.

patterns.name: of in of-phrases
patterns.context: The main trigger is the preposition of, especially in “something/nothing/anything of + noun or noun phrase”; it also appears in ordinary of interest constructions. Various nouns and semantic contexts can trigger it.
patterns.domain: Fictional narration, encyclopedia entries, reviews, philosophy papers, and forum text; cross-domain and cross-genre

patterns.name: Visual gaze and bodily movement
patterns.context: Describes a person looking or staring, or accompanying concrete bodily movement; activation is distributed across related action words and body/scene words, without a single clear trigger word.

patterns.name: Stage and footlights
patterns.context: A theatrical context mentions whether a play can be staged and the footlights; activation falls on foot, but may overlap literally with the body-part word foot.

patterns.name: Adverb of intensity
patterns.context: Describes the strength of a belief formed from experience or evidence when expressing an opinion; a single instance, with uncertain relation to other patterns.

4_1620.concept: 介词 of 及若干词汇／语境触发
4_1620.description: 最稳定的线索是介词 of，尤其嵌在 something/nothing/anything of + 名词短语中，也见于 of interest。另有注视与动作描写、舞台 footlights，以及单例 strongly。

patterns.name: of-短语中的 of
patterns.trigger: «of»10« interest»3、«of»9 a« met»e«oric»1 nature、something« of»8« explanation»3、Nothing« of»8 what« fantastic»2« storytelling»3、something« of»8« Time»4、something« of»8« the»4« contextual»2« sens»2ibility、anything« of»8« value»2
patterns.context: 主要触发点是介词 of，尤其处于“something/nothing/anything of + 名词或名词短语”结构；也出现在普通 of interest 结构。多种名词和语义环境均可触发。
patterns.domain: 小说叙述、百科条目、评论、哲学论文、论坛文字；跨领域、跨文体

patterns.name: 视觉注视与身体动作
patterns.trigger: «foot»9 on« the»4« curb»1、«slowly»4 lowered the« apple»2；«gaze»2« and»1 watched her；«eyes»4 fixed« upon»1 the street
patterns.context: 描写人物注视、凝视或伴随的具体身体动作；激活分散在相关动作词和身体／场景词上，非单一明确触发词。

patterns.name: 舞台与脚灯
patterns.context: 戏剧演出语境，提到剧本能否登台及脚灯；激活落在 foot 上，但可能与身体词 foot 的字面重合。
patterns.domain: 小说叙述中的戏剧／舞台术语

patterns.name: 强烈程度副词
patterns.context: 修饰表达意见时依经验或证据而形成的信念强度；单例，和其他模式的联系不确定。

en.description: Activations are scattered across English function words such as “of,” fragments within Russian words, and line breaks and punctuation; book titles, theatrical vocabulary, and astronomical descriptions also appear. The triggers do not show a stable, unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: “of” and its syntactic collocations
patterns.context: In English prose, a preposition or function word appears in a natural syntactic collocation; the strongest trigger is “of interest,” also seen in “something of a meteoric nature”

patterns.name: Fragments within Russian words
patterns.context: Activations fall inside Russian words, not always on complete words; they appear in varied contexts, including examples, questions, bibliographies, and body text
patterns.domain: Russian technical Q&A, encyclopedic bibliographies, and political texts

patterns.name: Line breaks and adjacent punctuation
patterns.context: Activations appear near text line breaks or punctuation, alongside line breaks in English sentences, HTML/code snippets, or theatrical formatting
patterns.domain: Fiction, technical Q&A, and literary texts

patterns.name: English book-related terms
patterns.context: Classification or bibliography-style headings at the start of encyclopedic entries, also involving landform structures
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia headings and Russian geography bibliographies

patterns.name: Theatrical performance vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes a theatrical work that may be impossible to stage; vocabulary centers on scripts, acts, scenes, and stage lighting

patterns.name: “редовен” in a Russian word form
patterns.context: A Bulgarian sentence describing Malaysian society and dialogue; the activation point resembles other Russian fragments, but the word form itself differs

patterns.name: Descriptions of astronomical objects
patterns.context: Describes a meteor passing over Toronto and its possible meteoric nature; local activations span English words and phrases

4_1620.description: 激活分散于英语of等功能词、俄语词内片段及换行标点；另见书目标题、戏剧词汇和天文叙述。触发未显示稳定统一的语义主题。

patterns.name: “of”及其句法搭配
patterns.context: 英语散文中，介词或功能词处在自然句法搭配内；最强触发是“of interest”，也见“something of a meteoric nature”

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在俄语单词内部，而非总是完整词；出现在示例、提问、书目和正文等不同上下文
patterns.domain: 俄语技术问答、百科书目及政治文本

patterns.name: 换行与标点邻接
patterns.context: 激活出现在文本换行或标点附近，伴随英语句子换行、HTML/代码片段或戏剧文本排版
patterns.domain: 小说、技术问答及文学文本

patterns.name: 英语书籍类词项
patterns.context: 百科条目开头的分类或书目式标题，并涉及地貌结构
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科标题及俄语地理书目

patterns.name: 戏剧演出词汇
patterns.context: 叙述戏剧作品可能无法上演，词汇集中于剧本、幕、场景与舞台灯光

patterns.name: 俄语词形中的“редовен”
patterns.trigger: «на»、«ред»，位于“се радват на редовен и ползотворен диалог”
patterns.context: 保加利亚语句子中描述马来西亚社会与对话；激活点与其他俄语片段相似，但词形本身不同

patterns.name: 天文对象描述
patterns.context: 描述流星经过多伦多及其可能的流星性质；局部激活跨英语词语与短语

en.description: Primarily responds to the restrictive English phrase “something of,” found across narrative, review, and academic genres; other activations fall on word-internal fragments in Russian and Bulgarian, as well as a few English narrative fragments, with no unified semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: something of construction
patterns.context: The phrase qualifies or hedges a following noun, evaluation, or quality; it is followed by different elements such as “interest,” “a meteoric nature,” “an admission of failure,” “what fantastic storytelling,” and “the contextual sensibility.”
patterns.domain: English narrative, reviews, journalism, and academic writing

patterns.name: Word-internal Bulgarian fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls inside Bulgarian word forms rather than on a fixed complete word; the passages concern parliamentary speeches or EU affairs.

patterns.name: Word-internal Russian fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed within Russian words, including a technical Q&A about regular expressions for IP addresses.

patterns.name: Word-internal segmentation in English narratives
patterns.context: Occurs in English narrative action or character descriptions; markers fall on fragments of tokenized “eyes” and on local items such as “foot,” but there is no clear semantic condition repeated across passages.

4_1620.description: 主要响应英语中的“something of”这一限定性短语，跨叙述、评论与学术文体出现；另有多处激活落在俄语、保加利亚语词内片段，以及少量英语叙事词段，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: something of 结构
patterns.context: 该短语用于弱化或限定后续名词、评价或性质；后接“interest”“a meteoric nature”“an admission of failure”“what fantastic storytelling”“the contextual sensibility”等不同成分。
patterns.domain: 英语叙述、评论、新闻及学术写作

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段
patterns.trigger: 词内被标出的字符片段，如“им”及“ад”“ч”“вним”“пр”“ич”；常见于西里尔字母单词内部。
patterns.context: 激活落在保加利亚语词形内部，而非固定完整单词；段落涉及议会发言或欧盟事务。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于俄语词内部，包含关于 IP 地址正则表达式的技术问答。
patterns.domain: 俄语 StackExchange 技术文本

patterns.name: 英语叙事中的词内分段
patterns.context: 出现在英文叙事动作或人物描写中；标记落在“eyes”拆分后的词段以及“foot”等局部词项上，但缺少跨段重复的明确语义条件。

en.description: Activation patterns mainly fall on several local word forms: foot and its compounds, the preposition of, and the Russian fragment “рим”; there is also an internal fragment in fingerprints and a one-off instance of firmly secured. The terms are not semantically or stylistically unified.

patterns.name: foot word forms
patterns.context: Contains foot or a word beginning with foot; refers variously to a body part, stage lighting, or a unit of area.

patterns.name: of
patterns.context: Appears in the common preposition of, with varied semantic collocations such as “of interest,” “of what,” and “of a meteoric nature.”

patterns.name: Russian “рим” fragment
patterns.context: The same Cyrillic letter sequence appears inside Russian words, specifically “Примите” and “Пример”.

patterns.name: Fragment inside fingerprints
patterns.context: Appears only inside the word “Fingerprints”; semantically consistent with the preceding fingerprint evidence, but supported by only one example.

patterns.name: The collocation firmly secured
patterns.context: Activates when describing a container lid as firmly secured; a single instance does not establish whether the trigger is a word or a collocation.

4_1620.description: 激活模式主要落在若干局部词形上：foot及其复合词、介词of、俄语片段“рим”；另有fingerprints内部片段和firmly secured单例。各词项语义与文体并不统一。

patterns.name: foot 词形
patterns.context: 包含 foot 或以 foot 开头的词；分别指身体部位、舞台灯光或面积单位。

patterns.name: of
patterns.context: 出现在常见介词 of 中，语义搭配不一，如“of interest”“of what”“of a meteoric nature”。

patterns.name: 俄语“рим”片段
patterns.context: 俄语词内部出现相同的西里尔字母片段，分别属于“Примите”“Пример”。

patterns.name: fingerprints 内部片段
patterns.context: 只在“Fingerprints”一词内部；与前文指纹证据的语义相符，但证据仅一例。

patterns.name: firmly secured 搭配
patterns.context: 在描述容器盖子被牢固固定时激活；单例，无法判断是词项还是搭配触发。

en.concept: English preposition of and local collocations
en.description: The most stable cue is the English preposition of, especially in constructions such as nothing/something/anything of; the remaining activations are scattered across other function words, technical terms, narrative details, and isolated lexical items, with no reliable unified condition.

patterns.name: of before a noun
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the preposition of, especially in collocations expressing quality, degree, content, or possession; sometimes of itself or the immediately following word is marked.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English narrative, reviews, religious texts, forums, and technical texts; passages 1–7, 9–10

patterns.name: Other prepositions or function-word collocations
patterns.context: A few activations fall on common prepositions, conjunctions, articles, or pronouns in their local syntactic collocations; no stable shared semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Literary narrative, reviews, and forum text; passages 1, 3–4, 8, 10

patterns.name: Semiconductor circuit terminology and voltage relationships
patterns.context: Involves p-well, source region, n-channel FET, diode conduction, and the voltage difference between the source region and substrate.

patterns.name: Body parts and spatial descriptions in narrative
patterns.context: Scenes of characters gazing, moving, or stopping, with spatial and body-part descriptions; these activations do not necessarily correspond to the same part of speech or meaning.

patterns.name: Local emphasis or evaluative word
patterns.context: A negative evaluative sentence discusses whether something is avant-garde or advanced; found in only one passage.

patterns.name: Other isolated lexical items
patterns.context: Occur respectively in reviews, literature, forums, or web text; there is insufficient evidence for a shared trigger condition.

4_1620.concept: 英语介词 of 及局部搭配
4_1620.description: 最稳定的线索是英语介词 of，尤其见于 nothing/something/anything of 等结构；其余激活分散在其他功能词、技术术语、叙事细节与孤立词项，未形成可靠统一条件。

patterns.name: 名词前的 of
patterns.trigger: «of»9、«of»10、«of»8；如 “nothing of interest”“something of a meteoric nature”“nothing of what fantastic storytelling”“remember anything of England”“requires nothing of the ‘sinner turned saint’”“anything of value”“something of a trend”“nothing particularly forward thinking”
patterns.context: 激活集中在介词 of，尤其是表示性质、程度、内容或所属关系的搭配；有时 of 本身或紧邻其后的词被标记。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语叙述、评论、宗教文本、论坛及技术文本；段1–7、9–10

patterns.name: 其他介词或功能词搭配
patterns.context: 少数激活落在常见介词、连词、冠词或代词上，处于各自局部句法搭配中；未见它们稳定共享同一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 文学叙述、评论及论坛文本；段1、3–4、8、10

patterns.name: 半导体电路术语及电压关系
patterns.context: 涉及 p-well、源区、n-channel FET、二极管导通，以及源区与衬底间电压差。
patterns.domain: 专利背景／半导体工程；段7

patterns.name: 叙事中的身体部位与方位描写
patterns.context: 人物凝视、移动或停步的场景，含空间位置和身体部位描写；这些激活未必对应同一词类或含义。

patterns.name: 局部强调或评价词
patterns.context: 否定评价语句中讨论某事是否前卫或先进；只有一个段落。

patterns.name: 其他孤立词项
patterns.context: 分别出现在评论、文学、论坛或网页文本中；没有足够证据支持共同触发条件。

en.concept: Weakly related emphasis and evaluative expressions
en.description: Activations are scattered across English nouns or evaluative structures introduced by of, and across expressions of attention, degree, body parts, and commentary modifiers in multiple languages; no single word sense explains all examples.

patterns.name: Emphasis or degree structures after “of”
patterns.context: English nominal or evaluative phrases introduced by “of”; common structures include “nothing of interest,” “something of a …,” and “nothing of what …”. Activations fall on of and subsequent tokens.
patterns.domain: English fiction, encyclopedias, religious commentary, book reviews, and web text

patterns.name: Attention and focus
patterns.context: Bulgarian and Russian morphological fragments expressing receiving or giving attention, such as “получи … внимание” and “Особено внимание”.
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, Bulgarian, and Russian

patterns.name: Modifiers of severity
patterns.context: In Swedish descriptions of injury or damage, an adverb modifies “large/severe,” expressing excessive or extreme severity.

patterns.name: Body parts and position
patterns.context: A narrative explicitly describes a character with one foot on the curb; it also occurs in a sentence where the character stops moving.

patterns.name: Editorial-style evaluation
patterns.context: When discussing video content, an adverb modifies “milquetoast attempt,” evaluating the editing as bland and dull.

patterns.name: Forward-looking evaluation
patterns.context: Denies that something is forward-looking or advanced: “nothing particularly forward thinking or advanced”.

4_1620.concept: 弱关联的强调与评价表达
4_1620.description: 激活分散于英语of引出的名词或评价结构，以及多语种中“注意”、程度、身体部位和评论性修饰语；没有单一词义能解释全部例子。

patterns.name: “of”后的强调或程度结构
patterns.context: 英语中“of”引出的名词性或评价性短语；常见于“nothing of interest”“something of a …”“nothing of what …”等结构。激活落在 of 及其后续 token 上。
patterns.domain: 英语小说、百科、宗教评论、书评及网页文本

patterns.name: 注意力与关注
patterns.context: 保加利亚语和俄语形态片段中，表示获得或给予注意；如“получи … внимание”“Особено внимание”。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、保加利亚语和俄语

patterns.name: 严重程度的修饰
patterns.context: 瑞典语伤害或损害的描述中，程度副词修饰“大的/严重的”，表达过度或极其严重。

patterns.name: 身体部位及位置
patterns.context: 叙事中明确描写人物的一只脚放在路缘上；同时处于人物停下动作的句子里。

patterns.name: 编辑风格评价
patterns.context: 讨论视频内容时，副词修饰“milquetoast attempt”，评价编辑做法平淡乏味。

patterns.name: 前瞻性评价
patterns.context: 否定某物具有前瞻性或先进性；“nothing particularly forward thinking or advanced”。

en.concept: Negative judgments and descriptions of qualities
en.description: Activation commonly occurs in judgments of negation, absence, or quality, especially near nothing and in of constructions; other sporadic triggers involve salience, degree of research, technical differences, cleanliness descriptions, and editing-related words.

patterns.name: Judgments of negation or absence
patterns.context: Modifiers occur between or near “nothing” and “wrong,” especially when indicating that something lacks a problem, meaning, or content; also includes “nothing of interest” and “nothing of what fantastic storytelling.”
patterns.domain: Reviews, narratives, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Expressions of degree or quality introduced by “of”
patterns.context: “of” connects nothing/something and similar words to a following quality, content, or evaluation; also appears in “nothing of the ‘sinner turned saint’”.
patterns.domain: Narrative, reviews, religious discussion, and academic abstracts

patterns.name: Salience or importance evaluation
patterns.context: Evaluates whether an object has salient, advanced, or noteworthy features; the example is paired with a negative judgment.

patterns.name: Quantity or degree emphasis
patterns.context: Modifies a noun in descriptions of research or knowledge, emphasizing a lack of systematic study or the extent of research.

patterns.name: Descriptions of existence and difference
patterns.context: Technical text states whether a difference exists between regions, often in a context ensuring that a condition holds.

patterns.name: Descriptions of cleanliness and attention to detail
patterns.context: An adverb emphasizes that a room or environment is clean and carefully maintained; preceding text describes simple furnishings.

patterns.name: Editing-related adverb
patterns.context: Describes an editor’s involvement in content or presentation, in a discussion of video content and viewing experience.

4_1620.concept: 否定性判断与性质描述
4_1620.description: 激活较常见于否定、缺失或性质判断，尤其是 nothing/something 附近及 of 结构；另有显著性、研究程度、技术差异、清洁描写和编辑相关词等零散触发。

patterns.name: 否定或缺失判断
patterns.context: “nothing”与“wrong”之间或附近出现修饰语，尤其是指出某事缺少问题、意义或内容；也包括 “nothing of interest” 和 “nothing of what fantastic storytelling”。
patterns.domain: 评论、叙事及一般说明文

patterns.name: “of”引出的程度或性质表达
patterns.trigger: “something of a meteoric nature”；“nothing of interest”；“nothing of what fantastic storytelling”
patterns.context: “of”连接 nothing/something 等词与后续性质、内容或评价；也见于 “nothing of the ‘sinner turned saint’”。
patterns.domain: 叙事、评论、宗教论述及学术摘要

patterns.name: 显著性或重要性评价
patterns.context: 评价对象是否有显著、先进或值得注意的特征；例中与否定评价搭配。

patterns.name: 数量或程度强调
patterns.context: 在研究或知识状态描述中修饰名词，强调系统性不足或研究程度。

patterns.name: 存在与差异描述
patterns.context: 技术说明中陈述某区域之间是否存在差异，常处于确保某条件成立的语境。

patterns.name: 整洁与细致描写
patterns.context: 以副词强调房间或环境清洁、维护细致；前文描写陈设朴素。

patterns.name: 编辑相关副词
patterns.context: 描述编辑对内容或呈现方式的介入，出现在视频内容与观看体验的讨论中。

en.concept: Scope limitation and negative evaluative expressions
en.description: The strongest activation is on way in the phrase “in any way,” spanning negation, possibility, behavior, and scope; there are also negative evaluations or existence expressions, plus a weaker, sporadic response to specifically in “nothing specifically wrong.”

patterns.name: Scope-limiting expression “in any way”
patterns.context: way is strongly marked in the phrase “in any way”; it modifies negation, possibility, ability, behavior, or degree. Paragraph 7 extends this to “in any way other than”.
patterns.domain: Mostly Hacker News forum text, also general web text and legal text

patterns.name: Negative evaluation or negated existence
patterns.context: Negation combines with evaluations, existence, or descriptions of properties; examples include varied collocations such as “nothing particularly …” and “nothing of interest”.

patterns.name: specifically in a particular phrase
patterns.context: In “nothing specifically wrong about it,” specifically modifies wrong, expressing that no specific problem is identified; only one example.
patterns.domain: Commentary on homosexuality and religious stances

4_1620.concept: 范围限定与否定评价表达
4_1620.description: 主要对短语“in any way”中的way强激活，涵盖否定、可能性、行为和限定范围；另对否定评价或存在表达，以及“nothing specifically wrong”中的specifically有较弱的零散响应。

patterns.name: “in any way”限定表达
patterns.trigger: «way»9 / «way»8，位于 “in any way” 或 “in any way other than” 中
patterns.context: 短语 “in any way” 中 way 被强标记；修饰否定、可能性、能力、行为或程度。第7段扩展为 “in any way other than”。
patterns.domain: 以 Hacker News 论坛文字为主，也见于一般网络文本及法律文本

patterns.name: 否定评价或否定存在
patterns.context: 否定词与评价、存在或性质描述结合；包括 “nothing particularly …” 和 “nothing of interest” 等不同搭配。

patterns.name: 特定短语中的 specifically
patterns.context: 在 “nothing specifically wrong about it” 中，specifically 修饰 wrong，表达没有明确指出具体问题；仅此例。
patterns.domain: 关于同性恋及宗教立场的评论

en.description: Activation points are scattered, often falling on “in any way,” of/scope or evaluative phrases, and question or quantity expressions; semantics and genres differ substantially, so no single clear trigger pattern explains them.

patterns.name: Manner/scope phrase “in any way”
patterns.context: The phrase emphasizes a possible manner or degree; it is sometimes preceded by negation, as in “not in any way,” and sometimes used as an open-ended generalization, as in “in any way that I can.”
patterns.domain: Online reviews and Q&A; different topics

patterns.name: Negative evaluation and “nothing of interest”
patterns.context: nothing combines with evaluative words to express a lack of a problem or anything worth noticing; the two examples differ in semantic direction.

patterns.name: Qualifying/emphatic word before a noun
patterns.context: Activation falls on an emphasizing or scope-limiting modifier before a noun; here it occurs only in “key details” in a discussion of film adaptations.

patterns.name: Quantity and comparison expressions
patterns.context: In an account of an astronomical discovery, superlatives and quantity phrases describe the size of a planet.

patterns.name: Narration of reading and sensory response
patterns.context: Literary expression of the intense feeling produced by listening to a poem being read aloud; activation is prominent on “of.”

patterns.name: Question preamble
patterns.context: The poster says they are asking because they lack knowledge and clarifies that the question is not rhetorical.

patterns.name: Fictional scene and description of interest
patterns.context: Narrative describes a character sitting in an office and looking toward the street, noting that there is nothing of interest; its resemblance to the negative evaluative expression in passage 1 is superficial.

4_1620.concept: 不确定的短语与限定表达
4_1620.description: 激活点分散，较常落在“in any way”、of/范围或评价短语及问题、数量表达上；各处语义和文体差异明显，无法由单一明确触发模式解释。

patterns.name: 方式/范围短语“in any way”
patterns.context: 该短语用于强调某种可能方式或程度；有时前接否定，如“not in any way”，有时用于开放式泛指，如“in any way that I can”。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、问答；不同主题

patterns.name: 否定评价与“nothing of interest”
patterns.trigger: “nothing specifically wrong about it”及“nothing of interest to be seen”
patterns.context: 以 nothing 搭配评价性词语，表达缺乏问题或缺乏值得关注之处；两例语义方向不同。

patterns.name: 名词前的限定/强调词
patterns.context: 激活落在名词前的强调或范围限定成分；此处只见于影视改编讨论中的“key details”。

patterns.name: 数量与比较表达
patterns.context: 在介绍天文学发现时，用最高级和数量短语说明行星大小。

patterns.name: 阅读与感官反应叙述
patterns.context: 文学化表达听诗朗读引起的强烈感受；“of”处激活突出。

patterns.name: 疑问引入语
patterns.context: 发帖者声明自己因缺乏了解而提出问题，并说明并非反问。

patterns.name: 小说场景与兴趣描写
patterns.context: 叙事描写人物坐在办公室看向街道，说明眼前无可关注之物；与段1的否定评价表达仅有表面相似。

en.description: Activations most often occur in expressions of manner such as “in any way”; other examples include evaluative words in discussions of gender and sexuality, polite phrasing in fiction, “key” in a medical context, “frost” in a dessert context, and “no time.” These triggers span word senses and styles and are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: way in expressions of manner
patterns.context: way appears in prepositional phrases expressing manner, scope, or possibility; it may be modified by negation or emphasis.
patterns.domain: Online commentary, medical papers, general articles

patterns.name: way in unexpected or vague contexts
patterns.context: When discussing inclusiveness and coverage of niche areas, the emphasis expression “no time” appears. It has no clear connection to the way phrases in other paragraphs.

patterns.name: Evaluative words in discussions of sex and gender
patterns.context: Discusses attitudes and judgments about sexism and sex-related content in relation to homosexuality or tech communities.

patterns.name: Polite expression
patterns.context: A character in a narrative tries to politely conceal their feelings.

patterns.name: Age-related medical conditions
patterns.context: Describes older populations, comorbidities, and medical research inclusion criteria; the marked token includes “key”.

patterns.name: frost in dessert and promotional contexts
patterns.context: Describes frosting suitable for various soft-serve desserts; the marked substring is “frost”.

4_1620.description: 激活最常见于“in any way”等方式表达；另见性别与性议题中的评价词、小说礼貌措辞、医学语境的“key”、甜点语境的“frost”，以及“no time”。这些触发跨词义与文体，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 方式表达中的 way
patterns.context: way 出现在表达方式、范围或可能性的介词短语中；可由否定或强调词修饰。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、医学论文、一般文章

patterns.name: 意外或模糊情形的 way
patterns.trigger: “in no time”中的 “way” 不适用；更准确地说，本段触发为 “no time”
patterns.context: 在讨论包容性与覆盖细分领域时，出现强调程度的 “no time”。与其他段落的 way 短语缺乏明显联系。

patterns.name: 性与性别议题中的评价词
patterns.context: 讨论同性恋或科技社区对性别歧视、性相关内容的态度与判断。

patterns.name: 礼貌表达
patterns.context: 叙事中人物试图礼貌地掩饰感情。

patterns.name: 年龄相关医学条件
patterns.trigger: “over age 70 years”及“key common comorbid medical conditions”
patterns.context: 描述老年人群、共病及医学研究纳入条件；被标记的 token 包括 “key”。

patterns.name: 甜点与促销语境中的 frost
patterns.context: 描述适用于多种软糖霜甜点的糖霜；被标记子串为 “frost”。

en.description: All segments highlight way in “in any way” (or variants), indicating manner, degree, context, or handling; a few distant tokens may be incidental co-occurrences.

patterns.name: way followed by qualifying or extending elements
patterns.context: In the phrase “in any way,” activation is concentrated on way; following text may specify a place, manner, condition, or negating qualifier.
patterns.domain: Online comments, conversation, news, and general discussion

patterns.name: way indicating degree or quality
patterns.context: way occurs with any to negate or weaken a characterization of a person, action, argument, or statement made earlier.

patterns.name: way indicating methods or available choices
patterns.context: any way introduces a method that can be used or expresses unrestricted choice of method.
patterns.domain: Requests for help, personal advice, and motivational writing

patterns.name: way indicating a specific manner of handling
patterns.context: way refers to how a work is presented or an image is handled, modified by other than or a negation.

patterns.name: way indicating a relevant field or aspect
patterns.context: way combines with contextual expressions such as here or at this point to refer broadly to the current situation or aspect.
patterns.domain: Forum arguments, reports on political negotiations

patterns.name: way in a nearby fixed expression
patterns.context: way occurs in “not in any way,” emphasizing a complete denial of the following characterization; the passage also contains the impression-related context “comes across as.”

patterns.name: Local non-primary pattern: emphatic use of really
patterns.context: really occurs in a parenthetical phrase and emphasizes the preceding statement; it has no clear semantic connection to any way.

patterns.name: Local non-primary pattern: surprise confirming expectations
patterns.context: The phrase indicates that the preceding disagreement is unsurprising; it is relatively distant from the way phrase.

patterns.name: Local non-primary pattern: feet as a unit of quantity
patterns.context: feet occurs with the area unit square; it has no clear semantic connection to any way.

4_1620.concept: any way 短语中的 way
4_1620.description: 所有片段都在 in any way（或变体）中突出 way，表示方式、程度、情境或处理层面；少数远处 token 可能是偶然共现。

patterns.name: way 后接限定或扩展成分
patterns.trigger: “in any way” / “in any way that …” / “in any way other than …”
patterns.context: 短语 in any way 中，激活主要落在 way；后文可接地点、方式、条件或否定限定。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、对话、新闻及一般论述

patterns.name: way 表示程度或性质
patterns.trigger: “any way a conspiracy nut job”“in any way unfair”“in any way rhetorical”“in any way wrong”
patterns.context: way 与 any 连用，否定或弱化对前述人物、行为、论证或说法的某种定性。

patterns.name: way 表示方法或选择空间
patterns.trigger: “in any way that I can”“Life works in any way that you want it to work”
patterns.context: any way 引出可采取的方法，或表达方式选择不受限制。
patterns.domain: 求助、个人建议与励志表达

patterns.name: way 表示具体处理方式
patterns.trigger: “in any way other than a glimpse”“not retouched or post-processed in any way”
patterns.context: way 指作品呈现或图像处理的方式，受到 other than 或否定修饰。
patterns.domain: 科幻电影讨论、摄影文章

patterns.name: way 表示相关领域或层面
patterns.trigger: “in any way here”“in any way at this point”
patterns.context: way 与 here 或 at this point 等语境成分结合，泛指在当前情境或层面上。
patterns.domain: 论坛争论、政治谈判报道

patterns.name: way 与紧邻固定搭配
patterns.trigger: “comes across as completely reasonable and not in any way a conspiracy nut job”
patterns.context: way 位于 not in any way 中，强调完全否认后接身份定性；该段另有“comes across as”这一表象判断语境。

patterns.name: 局部非主模式：really 的强调用法
patterns.context: really 出现在插入语中，强调前述说法；与 any way 无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 局部非主模式：surprise 的预期确认
patterns.context: 短语用于表示对前述分歧并不意外；与 way 短语相距较远。

patterns.name: 局部非主模式：feet 的数量单位
patterns.context: feet 与面积单位 square 连用；与 any way 无明显语义联系。

en.description: Strong responses primarily occur on way in “in any way,” spanning contexts of negation, questions, conditions, and scientificity; “way other than” and an isolated “bit of it” sequence also appear, the latter difficult to explain as part of the same pattern.

patterns.name: way in “in any way”
patterns.context: way appears in the fixed phrase “in any way”; it may be preceded by negation, a question, or a condition, or be further specified by following modifiers such as “other than a glimpse,” “possible,” or “scientific”.
patterns.domain: Hacker News comments, web articles, and general discussion

patterns.name: Other phrasal uses of way
patterns.context: way combines with other than to mean a “way besides …”; it shares way with the main pattern but is not the “in any way” structure.
patterns.domain: Hacker News, comment on a singularity film

patterns.name: The word sequence bit of it
patterns.context: In “I regret every bit of it.”, the activation falls on bit of it, not a way-related structure.

4_1620.description: 主要对“in any way”中的 way 强烈响应，涵盖否定、疑问、条件及科学性等语境；另见“way other than”和孤立的“bit of it”序列，后者与主模式难以解释为同一规律。

patterns.name: “in any way”中的 way
patterns.context: way 出现在固定搭配 “in any way” 中；前面可有否定、疑问或条件语境，也可由后续修饰语补足，如 “other than a glimpse”“possible”“scientific”。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、网络文章及一般论述

patterns.name: way 的其他短语用法
patterns.context: way 与 other than 连用，表示“除了……之外的方式”；与主模式共享 way，但不是 “in any way” 结构。

patterns.name: bit of it 的词序列
patterns.context: 在 “I regret every bit of it.” 中，激活落在 bit of it，而非 way 相关结构。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on the phrase “in any way” and similar negative or qualifying structures, such as “no way” and “any way other than.” It spans many topics and styles, with no stable domain theme apparent.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “in any way”
patterns.context: Primarily in negative, questioning, or qualifying contexts, it means “by any means / to any degree”; it also occurs in structures such as “not in any way” and “no way.”
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, news commentary, legal texts, web articles, and other styles

4_1620.description: 激活集中于短语“in any way”及相近的否定或限定结构，如“no way”和“any way other than”。跨越多种话题与文体，未见稳定的领域主题。

patterns.name: 固定短语“in any way”
patterns.trigger: “in any way”中的“way”（第 [1] 段为“any way other than”，其余多为“in any way”）
patterns.context: 主要在否定、质疑或限定语境中，表示“以任何方式／在任何程度上”；也出现在“not in any way”“no way”等结构中。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、新闻评论、法律文本、网页文章等多种文体

en.description: All passages contain “in any way” or “in any way at all.” The neuron mainly responds to way in this negative or qualifying phrase; contexts involve judgments, scientific validity, questions, evidence, guarantees, personal choice, privacy, and product claims.

patterns.name: Negative qualifying phrase “in any way”
patterns.context: The phrase negates, weakens, or qualifies a preceding judgment, relationship, piece of evidence, guarantee, or claim. In most passages, activation is concentrated on way (strength 9–10), with nearby context often including “not/don’t/no/never” or “isn’t/aren’t claiming.”
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, news reports, legal texts, product articles, and other styles

4_1620.description: 全部段落都出现“in any way”或“in any way at all”，神经元主要响应该否定或限定短语中的 way；语境涉及判断、科学性、提问、证据、保证、个人选择、隐私及产品主张。

patterns.name: 否定限定短语“in any way”
patterns.trigger: “in any way”以及其变体“in any way at all”
patterns.context: 该短语用于否定、弱化或限定前面的判断、关系、证据、保证或主张；在多数段落中，激活集中于 way（强度9–10），上下文常为“not/don’t/no/never”或“isn’t/aren’t claiming”。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、新闻报道、法律文本、产品文章等多种文体

en.description: Strong activations almost all fall on “way,” especially in negative or scope-limiting expressions such as in any way and in no way; a few activations are scattered over ordinary words in the passages, with no identifiable shared pattern.

patterns.name: way in negative or scope-limiting phrases
patterns.context: “way” appears in negative, interrogative, or restrictive expressions, often adjacent to any/no, limiting whether something holds, is reasonable, or happens in any manner; sentence-final punctuation also occurs
patterns.domain: Web articles, forum discussions, technical Q&A, and commentary

patterns.name: way meaning a path or method
patterns.context: way combines with any in broad expressions of manner or means, such as “in any way a conspiracy nut job,” “in any way scientific,” and “in any way possible”; meaning varies by sentence and is not fixed
patterns.domain: News commentary, technology articles, forum dialogue

patterns.name: no way meaning absolutely not/impossible
patterns.context: no way negates the possibility of a description or action; in [10], a comma is inserted before “make $3.99 from a…”
patterns.domain: Film discussions, technical explanations, privacy commentary, business/consumer commentary

patterns.name: Sparse collocations and local word-form activations
patterns.context: A few activations in these passages fall on ordinary words with no clear relation to way phrases; they may reflect weak local collocations or contextual effects, but the samples do not establish a shared trigger condition
patterns.domain: Various web texts and technical or technology-related topics

4_1620.description: 强激活几乎都落在“way”，尤其是 in any way、in no way 等否定或范围限定表达；少数激活分散在各段的普通词上，缺乏可确认的共同模式。

patterns.name: way 构成否定或范围限定短语
patterns.trigger: “in any way”（[1]–[5]、[8]、[9]）以及“in no way”（[6]–[8]、[10]）；突出位置主要是“way”
patterns.context: “way”出现在否定、疑问或限制性表达中，常与 any/no 相邻，用来限定某事是否以任何方式成立、合理或发生；也有句末标点
patterns.domain: 网络文章、论坛讨论、技术问答与评论

patterns.name: way 表示路径或办法
patterns.context: way 与 any 构成宽泛的方式／途径表达，如“in any way a conspiracy nut job”“in any way scientific”“in any way possible”；含义随句子变化，并非固定短语意义
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、科技文章、论坛对话

patterns.name: no way 表示绝不／不可能
patterns.context: no way 用于否定描述或行为可能性；[10] 中插入逗号并接“make $3.99 from a…”
patterns.domain: 影评讨论、技术说明、隐私评论、商业／消费评论

patterns.name: 稀疏的搭配与局部词形激活
patterns.trigger: “largest party”（[1]）、“officials … issues”（[2]）、“mobile interface … screen”（[3]）、“a lot in your post … surprise there”（[4]）、“vaguely … theories … explanations”（[5]）、“generations of robots … sense … singularity movie”（[6]）、“rewrite rules … compiler … sense”（[7]）、“biggest concern … Facebook … information”（[8]）、“questions … rhetorical”（[9]）
patterns.context: 这些片段中有少量激活落在与 way 短语无明显关系的普通词上；可能是弱的局部搭配或上下文效应，无法从样本确立共同触发条件
patterns.domain: 多种网络文本及技术、科技主题

en.description: Activation mainly occurs on “way” in ordinary expressions, especially negative or interrogative constructions, but also in the positive “every way”; there is one additional activation on the ending of the architectural term “façade.”

patterns.name: Negative constructions with “way”
patterns.context: “way” is an ordinary noun meaning manner, degree, or aspect, often used in negative or interrogative expressions; the trigger is “way” itself, while the surrounding negation and preposition patterns are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Online forum conversations, news texts, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Architectural term “façade”
patterns.context: Occurs in an encyclopedia context describing building façades and classical architecture; activation falls on the final token “ade.”

4_1620.description: 主要在普通表达中的“way”激活，尤见否定或疑问构式，但也见肯定的“every way”；另有一次建筑术语“façade”词尾激活。

patterns.name: “way”否定构式
patterns.trigger: “any way” / “every way”，尤其是 “in any way”“in any way here”“in any way possible”“in every way”
patterns.context: “way”作为方式、程度或方面的普通名词，常置于否定或疑问表达中；触发点在“way”本身，前后否定词与介词搭配并不完全固定。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛对话、新闻文本及百科说明

patterns.name: 建筑术语“façade”
patterns.context: 出现在描述建筑正立面及古典建筑的百科语境中；激活落在词尾 token “ade”。

en.description: Nearly all segments activate on way in the phrase “in any way” or “any way,” often in negative, qualifying, or softened judgments; [1] activates on the ending ade in facade and also contains the collocation sense.

patterns.name: way in way phrases
patterns.context: “way” is immediately preceded by “any” and often followed by a modifier or sentence-final element, as in “in any way possible” and “in any way here”; it is commonly used in negative, interrogative, or judgment-softening expressions.
patterns.domain: Forums, news, and general argumentative texts

patterns.name: Architectural ending façade
patterns.context: The term for a building’s front appears in sentences describing public buildings and their classical architectural elements.

patterns.name: Collocation with sense
patterns.context: “sense” occurs in a fixed or semi-fixed collocation; the two examples differ in meaning, and the activation annotation does not fall on this word.
patterns.domain: Architectural explanatory text; science-fiction film commentary

patterns.name: Contrast between reasonableness and conspiracy nut
patterns.context: “not in any way” emphasizes that someone is not a conspiracy nut; this overlaps with the way-phrase pattern.
patterns.domain: Informal account related to political volunteers

patterns.name: Negative guarantee or qualification
patterns.context: A report on negotiation progress uses “in any way” to qualify the inability to give a guarantee; this overlaps with the way-phrase pattern.

patterns.name: Conditional expression about rule abuse
patterns.context: A school policy describes how students’ abuse of privileges may result in permission being revoked; this overlaps with the way-phrase pattern.

patterns.name: Softening or emphasizing a position in comments
patterns.context: Online discussants use “in any way” to express judgments about information gathering, scientific validity, intent behind a question, or another person’s behavior; all overlap with the way-phrase pattern.

4_1620.concept: 英语 way 短语中的 way
4_1620.description: 几乎所有段都在短语“in any way”或“any way”中的 way 处激活，常见于否定、限定或缓和判断；[1]则激活 facade 的词尾 ade，且出现 sense 搭配。

patterns.name: way 短语中的 way
patterns.context: “way”前紧邻“any”，常后接修饰语或句末成分，如“in any way possible”“in any way here”；多用于否定、疑问或弱化判断的表达。
patterns.domain: 论坛、新闻及一般议论性文本

patterns.name: 建筑词尾 façade
patterns.trigger: “fac”与“ade”跨 token 构成“facade”，其中“ade”激活最强；同段另有“elements of classical architecture”“tradition and authority”
patterns.context: 建筑正立面一词出现在介绍公共建筑及其古典建筑元素的句子中。

patterns.name: sense 搭配
patterns.trigger: “sense”：“a sense of tradition and authority”[1]；“no sense a singularity movie”[5]
patterns.context: “sense”处于固定或半固定搭配中；两例语义不同，且激活标注未落在该词上。
patterns.domain: 建筑说明文；科幻电影评论

patterns.name: reasonableness 与 conspiracy nut 对照
patterns.trigger: “reasonable and not in any way a conspiracy nut job”
patterns.context: 以“not in any way”强调某人并非阴谋论狂热者；与 way 短语模式重合。
patterns.domain: 政治志愿者相关的非正式叙述

patterns.name: 否定性保障或限定
patterns.trigger: “can’t guarantee in any way at this point”
patterns.context: 谈判进展报道中，以“in any way”限定不能作出保证；与 way 短语模式重合。

patterns.name: 滥用规则的条件表达
patterns.context: 学校政策文本中描述学生滥用特权可能导致撤销许可；与 way 短语模式重合。

patterns.name: 评论中的立场缓和或强调
patterns.trigger: “in any way possible”“in any way scientific”“in any way here”
patterns.context: 网络讨论者用“in any way”表达对信息收集、科学性、提问意图或他人行为的判断；均与 way 短语模式重合。

en.concept: way in the phrase “in any way”
en.description: All passages activate on way in the phrase “in any way”; the phrase is used to negate, qualify, or ask whether something holds in any respect.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “in any way”
patterns.context: The phrase means “by any means / in any sense” and is often modified by negation, questions, or qualifiers such as “not,” “no,” “doubt,” “curious,” “scientific,” and “possible”; passages 1–6 contain the complete phrase, and passages 7–10 also contain it but with slightly lower activation on way.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain commentary, discussions, arguments, and explanatory writing

4_1620.concept: 短语“in any way”中的 way
4_1620.description: 全部段落都在短语“in any way”中的 way 处激活；短语用于否定、限定或询问某事是否在任何方面成立。

patterns.name: 固定短语“in any way”
patterns.trigger: “in any way”，其中 way 激活最强；第 7–10 段为 “in any way” 的变体或带后续词形式
patterns.context: 短语表示“以任何方式／在任何意义上”，常被否定、疑问或限定表达修饰，如 “not”“no”“doubt”“curious”“scientific”“possible”；第 1–6 段为完整短语，第 7–10 段同样出现该短语但 way 强度略低
patterns.domain: 跨领域的评论、讨论、论辩与说明性文字

en.description: Activations commonly occur in expressions such as “in any way,” especially in negative or softened judgments; they also appear in noun phrases introduced by “of” and a few proper names or word-form fragments. Sample topics and styles are varied.

patterns.name: way in negative, generic, or degree expressions
patterns.context: The phrase and its neighboring words are repeatedly marked, often in negative or softened judgments (e.g., “not … in any way,” “aren’t … in any way”); it can also express uncertainty or degree and does not require a particular topic.
patterns.domain: Online commentary, news, and general narrative

patterns.name: way collocating with abstract properties or effects
patterns.context: “way” appears in descriptions of a presentation, property, or effect; there is also “a sense of tradition and authority,” describing the impression created by a building.
patterns.domain: Technical commentary, cultural and architectural descriptions

patterns.name: Noun phrase following of
patterns.context: Triggers cluster on the preposition “of” and its following noun phrase; examples in this set involve bodily description, software, sports results, and architecture.
patterns.domain: Fiction, technical discussion, sports history, architectural encyclopedias

patterns.name: Out-of-pattern proper names or word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on proper names or subword fragments split across words; the examples do not establish stable semantic conditions.

4_1620.description: 激活常见于“in any way”一类表达，尤其是否定或缓和判断；也见于“of”引出的名词短语及少量专名、词形片段，样例主题和文体分散。

patterns.name: way 用于否定、泛指或程度表达
patterns.context: 该短语及其邻近词被反复标记，常见于否定或弱化判断（如 “not … in any way”“aren’t … in any way”），也可表示不确定或程度；不要求特定主题。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、新闻及一般叙述

patterns.name: way 与抽象性质或效果搭配
patterns.trigger: “in any way” 以及 “a sense of”
patterns.context: “way”出现在对某种呈现、性质或效果的描述中；另有 “a sense of tradition and authority”，表达建筑赋予的印象。
patterns.domain: 技术评论、文化建筑叙述

patterns.name: of 后接名词性成分
patterns.trigger: “of hair”“piece of software”“game drawn”“elements of classical architecture”
patterns.context: 触发点集中在介词 “of” 及其后名词短语；本组样例涉及身体描写、软件、体育赛果和建筑。
patterns.domain: 小说、技术讨论、体育史、建筑百科

patterns.name: 非主模式的专名或词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或跨词切分的子词片段，无法从样例确认稳定的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 百科建筑词汇、网页评论

en.concept: Words related to scope and appearance
en.description: Activation is scattered: it often occurs in expressions of negation, degree, or scope qualification (especially way, really, anything, and to no), but also on specific terms in financial data, building façades, bodily descriptions, and design appearance. No single semantic pattern explains the activations.

patterns.name: Manner, degree, and scope qualification
patterns.context: Near “way” there is “in any” or “any,” or the statement contains negation, low degree, or approximation; activation often falls on way, really, or to.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, commentary, narrative, and legal texts

patterns.name: Economic data and market response
patterns.context: When discussing how the market responds to small amounts of economic data, activation falls on “of,” near “every small bit.”

patterns.name: Classical building façade and authority
patterns.context: Describes classical architectural elements in a public building and their symbolism of tradition and authority; activation is particularly concentrated on “facade.”

patterns.name: A wisp of hair on the chest
patterns.context: In a description of the male body or a nude scene, activation falls on “wisp,” near a mention of chest hair.

patterns.name: Surface appearance of a design
patterns.context: Discusses design and distinguishes its essence from its surface appearance; activation falls on “veneer.”

4_1620.description: 激活较分散：多见于否定、程度或范围限定表达（尤其 way、really、anything、to no），也出现在财经数据、建筑立面、身体描写及设计表象等具体词语上，难以由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 方式、程度与范围限定
patterns.trigger: “in any way”“any way”“not ... anything”“little to no”“almost”
patterns.context: “way”附近有“in any”或“any”等范围限定，或陈述中出现否定、低程度、近似表达；激活位置常在 way、really、to 等词上。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、评论、叙述及法律文本

patterns.name: 经济数据与市场反应
patterns.context: 讨论市场如何回应少量经济数据时，激活落在“of”上，邻近“every small bit”。

patterns.name: 古典建筑立面与权威
patterns.context: 描述公共建筑的古典建筑元素及其象征的传统和权威；激活特别集中在“facade”。

patterns.name: 胸前一缕毛发
patterns.context: 描写男性身体或裸露场景时，激活落在“wisp”，附近提到胸部毛发。

patterns.name: 设计的表面外观
patterns.context: 谈设计并区分设计本质与表面外观，激活落在“veneer”。

en.description: Many activations are concentrated on “way” (especially any/in every way) and expressions emphasizing meaning, specificity, or truth, but there are also sporadic triggers involving hair, good news, economic data, software, and legal vocabulary; no single semantic pattern adequately explains all segments.

patterns.name: End position after the fixed expression “any way”
patterns.context: In negative or qualifying expressions, the phrase means “by any means / in any sense”; activation is concentrated on the phrase-final way or sense rather than on a stable topic word.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain commentary, forum discussions, and narrative

patterns.name: Important information following “of”
patterns.context: The context contains a quantity, negation, or evaluation, followed by important, specific, or truthful content; trigger words vary and may emphasize the information content.
patterns.domain: Financial commentary, software discussions, religious commentary, and legal texts

patterns.name: Small changes in data
patterns.context: Describes small bits of news about economic data and the market’s response to them.

patterns.name: Body hair details
patterns.context: Describes fine body hair on a nude male chest.

patterns.name: News prompting optimism
patterns.context: In a market context, a small amount of good news is expected to prompt buying.

patterns.name: Political judgment about a party
patterns.context: Discusses a party’s size, political position, and the views of volunteers.

patterns.name: Discussion of the “Singularity” film
patterns.context: Discusses whether a film can depict the technological Singularity; activation falls on way rather than the topic word singularity.

patterns.name: Practical powerlessness in a legal context
patterns.context: Discusses the actions available to a judge in cases involving severe sentences.

patterns.name: Ethical judgment and description of a scam
patterns.context: Says that a Ponzi scheme is unethical in every way and describes how the last people to join do not get their money back.

patterns.name: Differences in software implementation
patterns.context: Discusses how different software implements features.

patterns.name: Data warehouse tool not tied to a platform
patterns.context: Evaluates Kimball’s data warehouse book as easy to read and not tied to a particular platform.

patterns.name: Robot generations and the Singularity
patterns.context: Compares generations of robots and discusses the relationship between works of fiction and the Singularity concept.

patterns.name: No specific reason for opposition mentioned
patterns.context: Criticizes arguments against homosexuality for not explicitly stating what is wrong.

patterns.name: Other emotion or identity terms
patterns.context: These occur separately in market anxiety, evaluations of volunteers, and legal statements; no shared local trigger pattern is apparent.

4_1620.description: 多处激活集中在“way”（尤其 any/in every way）及意义、具体性、真实性等强调表达，但也出现 hair、good news、经济数据、软件与法律词汇等零散触发；各段无法由单一语义模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 固定表达 “any way” 后的结束位置
patterns.trigger: “any way” / “in any way”，通常激活在 way；另见 “in any sense” 中的 “sense”
patterns.context: 否定或限定性表达中，短语表示“以任何方式/在任何意义上”；激活集中于短语末尾的 way 或 sense，而非稳定的主题词
patterns.domain: 多领域评论、论坛讨论及叙述

patterns.name: “of”后接重要信息
patterns.trigger: “shred of good news”中的 of；“piece of software”中的 of；“nothing specifically wrong”中的 specifically；“not anything really”中的 really
patterns.context: 上下文出现数量词、否定词或评价语，随后引出重要、具体或真实的内容；触发词不统一，可能是强调信息内容
patterns.domain: 财经评论、软件讨论、宗教评论、法律文本

patterns.name: 数据的小幅变化
patterns.trigger: “small bit of economic data”中的 “bit of”
patterns.context: 描述经济数据的小幅消息，以及市场对消息的反应

patterns.name: 身体毛发细节
patterns.context: 描写裸露男性胸部的细小体毛

patterns.name: 新闻引发乐观情绪
patterns.context: 市场背景下，少量利好消息被预期会带来买盘

patterns.name: 对某党派的政治判断
patterns.context: 谈及政党规模、政治立场及志愿者观点

patterns.name: 对“奇点”电影的讨论
patterns.context: 讨论电影能否呈现技术奇点；激活点落在 way，而不是主题词 singularity

patterns.name: 法律语境中的实际无能为力
patterns.context: 论述法官面对重刑及相关案件时能采取的措施

patterns.name: 伦理判断与诈骗描述
patterns.context: 称某个 Ponzi scheme 在各方面都不道德，并描述最后加入者拿不到钱

patterns.name: 软件实现差异
patterns.context: 谈论不同软件各自实现功能的方式

patterns.name: 数据仓库工具的非平台专属性
patterns.context: 评价 Kimball 的数据仓库书籍易读且不依赖特定平台

patterns.name: 机器人代际与奇点
patterns.trigger: “generations of robots”及“in no sense a singularity movie”
patterns.context: 比较机器人代际，并讨论作品与奇点概念的关系

patterns.name: 未提及具体反对理由
patterns.trigger: “nothing specifically wrong about it is mentioned”
patterns.context: 批评针对同性恋的论证没有明确说明具体错误之处

patterns.name: 其他情绪或身份词汇
patterns.context: 各自出现在市场焦虑、志愿者评价及法律陈述中；没有显示共同的局部触发规律

en.concept: Cues for negation/degree and noun structures
en.description: Activation is scattered across judgments of existence, degree, and possibility in negative or weakened contexts, as well as “X of Y” noun structures and several isolated topics: financial good news, building façades, and cricket draws. The segments lack a unified, stable lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Evaluative or degree expressions under negation or weakening
patterns.context: Activation falls on degree or scope words in negative, interrogative, or weakened contexts, often involving judgments about whether something exists, is possible, or has exceptions; the specific grammatical relations are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Legal arguments, commentary, and technical discussions

patterns.name: “of” structure preceding a noun
patterns.context: Occurs within a noun phrase, especially “X of Y” and adjacent noun-modifier structures; the trigger sometimes falls on “of” or a nearby following noun.
patterns.domain: Technical forums, narrative prose, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Good news and market response in the news
patterns.context: Market commentary describes a small amount of good news as sufficient to prompt optimism or buying.

patterns.name: Classical building front and institutional authority
patterns.context: Describes a building façade and links classical architectural elements to symbolic meanings such as tradition and authority.

patterns.name: Cricket match results and a draw
patterns.context: Lists wins and one draw when recounting a team’s match results.

4_1620.concept: 否定／程度与名词结构线索
4_1620.description: 激活分散于否定或弱化语境中的存在、程度与可能性判断，也出现在“X of Y”名词结构及若干孤立主题中：金融利好、建筑立面和板球平局。各段缺乏统一而稳定的词法触发点。

patterns.name: 否定或弱化中的评价／程度表达
patterns.trigger: “anything really a Judge can do”（2）、“nothing specifically wrong”（3）、“any way a conspiracy nut job”（5）、“any way other than”（6）、“little to no browser support”（8）
patterns.context: 激活落在否定、疑问或弱化语境中的程度／范围词，常涉及对某事是否存在、是否可行或是否有例外的判断；具体语法关系并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 法律论证、评论、技术讨论

patterns.name: 名词前的“of”结构
patterns.trigger: “piece of software”（4）、“wisp of hair”（7）、“principal façade”（9，附近另有“elements of classical architecture”）
patterns.context: 在名词短语内部，特别是“X of Y”及相邻的名词修饰结构中；触发位置有时落在“of”或其后的名词附近。
patterns.domain: 技术论坛、叙事散文、百科说明

patterns.name: 新闻中的正面消息与市场反应
patterns.context: 市场评论中，少量利好消息被描述为足以引发乐观情绪或买盘。

patterns.name: 古典建筑正面与机构权威
patterns.context: 描述建筑立面，并将古典建筑元素与传统、权威等象征意义联系起来。

patterns.name: 板球比赛结果与平局
patterns.context: 叙述球队比赛结果时，列出胜场及一场平局。

en.description: Activations fall on various local word sequences and compound fragments, including building facades, collective or quantity expressions, hair, film reception, good news, economic data, and drawn matches. They span domains and have inconsistent activation locations, with no reliable unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments at compound boundaries
patterns.context: Activations often fall on the latter half of multiword expressions or compounds, word-final fragments, or meaningful local word sequences; sometimes the same sequence occurs in different contexts, so these examples alone cannot establish whether boundaries or word meaning are responsible.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, forums, literature, emails, and web text

patterns.name: The word facade
patterns.context: In architectural descriptions, “principal facade” refers to a building’s principal front; the trigger is distributed across word forms spanning tokens.

patterns.name: Abstract quantity or collection
patterns.context: Countable objects, groups, or sets of items are introduced by quantity or collection words; the precise activation locations vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Software discussion, historical narrative, management commentary, consumer entertainment descriptions

patterns.name: Description of body hair
patterns.context: Describes a small tuft of hair on a man’s chest; activation falls on “wisp” and is not seen in other passages.

patterns.name: Box-office success expression
patterns.context: “little fanfare” describes a film’s very limited reception or publicity after release; activation falls on the latter part of a compound.

patterns.name: Good news expression
patterns.context: In a financial-market context, any bit of good news may bring optimism and buying; activation falls on “good”.

patterns.name: Economic data fragment
patterns.context: Discusses the stock market’s response to a small amount of economic data; strong activation falls on “of,” rather than the more obviously domain-specific “economic data”.

patterns.name: A tied match
patterns.context: A match in a cricket series ends in a tie; strong activation falls on “game,” while “match” in the same passage has weaker activation.

4_1620.description: 激活落在多类局部词串和复合词片段上，包括建筑立面、集合或数量表达、毛发、电影反响、好消息、经济数据与平局比赛。跨领域且落点不一致，尚无可靠统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 复合词边界的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在多词表达或复合词的后半部分、词尾片段或有意义的局部词串上；有时同一词串出现在不同语境，无法仅凭这些例子确认是否由边界或词义触发。
patterns.domain: 百科、论坛、文学、邮件及网页文本

patterns.name: 立面一词
patterns.context: 建筑描述中，“principal facade”指建筑正立面；触发分布在跨 token 的词形片段上。

patterns.name: 抽象数量或集合
patterns.context: 可数的物件、群体或一组项目由数量或集合词引出；不同例子中激活具体落点并不相同。
patterns.domain: 软件讨论、历史叙述、管理评论、消费娱乐介绍

patterns.name: 身体毛发描写
patterns.context: 描写男性胸口的一小撮毛发；激活落在“wisp”上，未见于其他段落。
patterns.domain: 叙事性、带裸露内容的网页小说

patterns.name: 票房成功表达
patterns.context: 电影上映后“little fanfare”表示反响或宣传声势很小；激活落在复合词后半部分。

patterns.name: 好消息表达
patterns.context: 金融市场语境中，任何一点好消息都可能带来乐观和买盘；激活落在“good”上。

patterns.name: 经济数据片段
patterns.context: 谈股市对少量经济数据的反应；强激活落在“of”，而非显然更具领域特征的“economic data”。

patterns.name: 比赛打平
patterns.context: 板球系列赛中一场比赛以平局收场；强激活落在“game”，但同段另有“match”，其激活较弱。

en.description: High activations are scattered across adverbs, terms for matches and releases, elements of specific objects, quantity/data words, and financial terms. Contexts vary markedly; only a few show local semantic similarities, and no single stable trigger pattern explains them.

patterns.name: Emphasis on explicitness/truth
patterns.context: Activation falls on adverbs indicating that something is indeed the case or specifying degree or detail; they respectively modify “a Judge can do,” “wrong about it,” and “recreated.”
patterns.domain: Legal discussion, commentary, and introductions to people/performances

patterns.name: Key items in event or match outcomes
patterns.context: The passage recounts a match result or the release of a film; activation falls on the event unit “game” and on “fanfare,” referring to public reaction after the release.

patterns.name: Characteristic parts or elements
patterns.context: In architectural description, activation falls on “facade”; in a description of a recreated performance costume, it falls on “detail.” Both are identifiable components of what is being presented, though their meanings are not identical.

patterns.name: Quantities or data units
patterns.context: These occur respectively in taxable income amounts, the number of games per month, and economic data; activation is adjacent to a number or measured item.
patterns.domain: Legal tax matters, price promotions, and financial commentary

patterns.name: Good news and market response
patterns.context: Stock market commentary describes positive news as prompting optimism and upward pressure; the peak falls on “good” in “good news.”

4_1620.description: 高激活分散在副词、比赛与上映词、具体对象要素、数量/数据词及财经词中。各段语境差异明显，只有若干局部语义相似，无法由单一稳定触发模式解释。

patterns.name: 明确性/真实性强调
patterns.context: 激活落在表示事情确实如此、具体程度或细致程度的副词上；分别修饰“a Judge can do”“wrong about it”和“recreated”。
patterns.domain: 法律论述、评论文字、人物/表演介绍

patterns.name: 事件或比赛结果中的关键项
patterns.context: 段落叙述比赛结果或电影上映经过，激活落在赛事单位“game”及上映后公众反响“fanfare”上。

patterns.name: 特征性部位或要素
patterns.context: 建筑描述中激活“facade”，演出服饰复刻描述中激活“detail”；均是具体呈现对象的可辨识组成部分，但词义并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 定量或数据单位
patterns.context: 分别处于应税收入金额、每月游戏数量、经济数据等数量或信息量表达中；激活与数字或衡量对象相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律税务、价格促销、财经评论

patterns.name: 好消息及市场反应
patterns.context: 股票市场评论中，正面消息被描述为带来乐观情绪和上涨压力；峰值落在“good news”中的“good”。

en.description: Strong activations often occur near noun phrases introduced by of, involving hair, economic data, paper, taxable income, good news, matches, and political groups; there are also scattered activations on descriptive words or function words that are difficult to group into a unified pattern.

patterns.name: of followed by quantity, fraction, or range expressions
