patterns.context: The preposition of is followed by a noun phrase or a nearby relational word within a prepositional phrase; examples include quantity/part, possession, or abstract-noun collocations, with no consistent semantic role. In paragraph 9, strong activation falls on by, possibly just a local phrase-structure effect.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including fiction, financial reporting, sports history, legal text, political history, and educational writing

patterns.name: Emphasis or detail expressions before nouns
patterns.context: Strong activations fall on descriptive nouns or common function words, often surrounded by modifiers, degree expressions, or emphasis; the examples have unstable semantic and syntactic relations and may reflect local collocations rather than a unified pattern.
patterns.domain: Entertainment descriptions, financial commentary, narrative text

4_1620.description: 强激活多出现在of引出的名词短语附近，涵盖头发、经济数据、纸张、应税收入、好消息、比赛和政治团体等；另有若干分散的描述性词语或小词激活，难以归为统一模式。

patterns.name: of 后接数量、分数或范围表达
patterns.trigger: «of»10 hair；«of»10 economic data；«of»10 a whole sheet；«of»10 taxable income；«of»10 good news；«of»10 one game；«of»10 the small band；by«10 which
patterns.context: 介词 of 后接名词短语，或介词短语中紧邻关系词；有的例子是数量/部分、所属或抽象名词搭配，并无一致的语义角色。第 9 段强激活落在 by 后，可能只是邻近的短语结构效应。
patterns.domain: 小说、财经报道、体育史、法律文本、政治史、教育文章等多种文体

patterns.name: 名词前的强调或细节表达
patterns.trigger: every« detail»9 has；«small»6 bit；«to»5 create；«It»4 doesn’t；«hair»5
patterns.context: 强激活位于描述性名词或常用小词上，周围常有修饰、程度或强调表达；这些例子彼此语义和句法关系不稳定，可能是局部搭配而非统一模式。
patterns.domain: 娱乐介绍、财经评论、叙事文本

en.description: The strongest triggers cluster around the character sequence uj, appearing in Polish and Slovak word forms and personal names; there is also one activation on the digit 3 in a mathematical expression. Segments 1, 5, 7, and 10 are not explained by these patterns.

patterns.name: uj in inflected Polish words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the character sequence uj, which is split into separate tokens; segment 3 places it inside a Polish word form, while segment 9 has it in a name/string, with no obvious semantic requirement.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary text; names or strings in forums

patterns.name: uj in Slovak word endings
patterns.context: Appears inside a Slovak word form, followed by úce.

patterns.name: 3 in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: The digit 3 occurs in a sequence of numbers/operators in a mathematical expression; activation occurs only once.

patterns.name: uj in surnames
patterns.context: The name Bujis appears in an English sentence, with the trigger on uj inside the name.

patterns.name: uj in personal names
patterns.context: The name Tetsujin is quoted in an English answer, with the trigger on uj inside the name.

4_1843.concept: 字符序列 uj（证据有限）
4_1843.description: 最显著触发集中在字符序列 uj，出现在波兰语、斯洛伐克语词形及人名中；另有一处数学式数字 3 激活。第1、5、7、10段未能由这些模式解释。

patterns.name: 波兰语屈折词中的 uj
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的字符序列 uj；第3段是波兰语词形内部，第9段则是人名/字符串中的字母序列，未见明显语义要求
patterns.domain: 波兰语议会文本；论坛中的人名或字符串

patterns.name: 斯洛伐克语词尾 uj
patterns.context: 出现在斯洛伐克语词形内部，后接 úce

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 3
patterns.context: 数字 3 位于数学式的数字/运算符序列中；只在一处激活

patterns.name: 姓氏中的 uj
patterns.context: 英文句子中出现姓名 Bujis，触发落在姓名内部的 uj

patterns.name: 人名中的 uj
patterns.context: 英文回答中引用姓名 Tetsujin，触发落在人名内部的 uj

en.description: Primarily activates on the cross-token character fragment “uj”, without apparent semantic or domain constraints; also activates on the digit “3” in two mathematical expressions. The activation in the first passage falls on HTML/text and cannot be explained by the pattern above.

patterns.name: “uj” character fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the character sequence “uj” in texts spanning multiple languages, word forms, proper names, and mathematical content; surrounding contexts vary widely, with no stable semantic condition observed.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; web pages, parliamentary text, mathematics, and multilingual text

patterns.name: Digit 3 in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears as part of a formula or arithmetic expression; activation is on the digit 3.

4_1843.concept: 字符片段「uj」及数字「3」
4_1843.description: 主要激活于跨 token 的字符片段「uj」，不受明显语义或领域限制；另在两段数学式中激活于数字「3」。第1段的激活落在HTML/文本中，无法由上述模式解释。

patterns.name: “uj”字符片段
patterns.trigger: 相邻字符片段「uj」，包括跨 token 边界（如「B«uj»is」「Tets«uj»in」「zyb…」中的 uj」「z«uj»jb」）
patterns.context: 多种语言、词形、专名或数学文本中，激活落在「uj」这段字符上；周围上下文差异很大，未见稳定语义条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；网页、议会文本、数学及多语种文本

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字 3
patterns.context: 作为公式或算术表达式的一部分出现；激活标在数字 3 上。

en.concept: Slavic morphological fragments and miscellaneous structures
en.description: Activations are concentrated in Polish and Slovak word fragments, especially the endings “ą”, “uj”, “ują”, and “ujú”; they also occur in HTML, table code, mathematical symbols, and sporadic English words, suggesting a mixture of language and structure.

patterns.name: Slavic morphological endings
patterns.context: Markers cluster within Slavic words, often in inflectional or derivational endings; especially prominent in passages 4, 7, and 10. Slavic text containing “uj” also appears in passages 8 and 9.

patterns.name: Pipes and marked values in code and structured text
patterns.context: Pipe delimiters recur in database-field tables; strong activations also occur on field names and placeholder values in the same passages.

patterns.name: HTML tags and name text
patterns.context: Appears in HTML snippets and Expected Output examples, where tag structure and attribute values form local conditions.

patterns.name: Local symbol fragments in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in algebraic expressions dense with parentheses; activations fall on local segments containing digits, parentheses, and operations.

patterns.name: Sporadic words in ordinary English text
patterns.context: These words appear in narrative or Q&A text, with no consistent meaning or local structure; no stable English trigger pattern is observed.

4_1843.concept: 斯拉夫语形态片段及杂项结构
4_1843.description: 激活主要集中在波兰语、斯洛伐克语词形片段，尤其是词尾「ą」「uj」「ują」「ujú」；另在HTML、表格代码、数学符号及零散英语词上出现，提示语言与结构混杂。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语形态词尾
patterns.trigger: 波兰语、斯洛伐克语中被标记的「ą」「uj」「ują」「ujú」，以及相邻的重音字母与分词片段
patterns.context: 标记集中在斯拉夫语词内部，常位于屈折或派生词尾；第4、7、10段尤其明显，第8、9段也出现斯拉夫语文本中的「uj」
patterns.domain: 波兰语、斯洛伐克语及其混合文本

patterns.name: 代码与结构化文本中的竖线及标记值
patterns.context: 数据库字段表格中重复出现竖线分隔符；同段还出现较强的字段名和占位值

patterns.name: HTML标签与名称文本
patterns.context: 出现在HTML片段及Expected Output示例中，标签结构与属性值构成局部条件

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的局部符号片段
patterns.context: 位于括号密集的代数表达式中；激活落在数字、括号和运算式局部

patterns.name: 英语普通文本中的零散词语
patterns.context: 这些词分布于叙述或问答正文，缺乏一致的词义或局部结构；未见稳定的英语触发模式

en.description: Activation patterns are sporadic: they include mathematical symbol sequences, recurring Name fields in structured text, medical terminology, erasable word forms in patents, code path parameters, and colloquial French word forms. The Name-field pattern spans multiple segments; the others are mostly local word-form or formatting features.

patterns.name: Numbers and mathematical symbol sequences
patterns.context: Short symbol sequences in mathematical expressions, such as minus signs, parentheses, fractions, or exponentiation; markers cluster around operators and numbers.

patterns.name: Name fields and their values
patterns.context: Occurs in structured fields, attributes, or labels, where Name often serves as a field name or part of a compound name; it is sometimes followed by a person’s name, a language name, or a model description.

patterns.name: Specific medical terminology
patterns.context: A tokenized fragment of the term Trichotillomania, followed by the abbreviation “(TTM)”.

patterns.name: Erasable/rewritable concepts in technical text
patterns.context: Word forms such as eraseable/erasable occur in sentences describing programmable, erasable memory; activation falls on fragments within the word.

patterns.name: Path options in configuration or documentation
patterns.context: In code parameter documentation, Path refers to a file, near configuration descriptions mentioning JSONL, documentation, or model options.
patterns.domain: Github code and command-line parameter documentation

patterns.name: Colloquial French word forms
patterns.context: Colloquial expressions and inflected word forms appear in French sentences; activation is distributed within French words or on common words.

4_1843.concept: 词形与结构化字段片段
4_1843.description: 激活模式较分散：包括数学符号序列、结构化文本中反复出现的 Name 字段、医学术语、专利中的 erasable 词形、代码路径参数及法语口语词形。Name 字段模式覆盖多段，其余多为局部词形或格式特征。

patterns.name: 数字与数学符号序列
patterns.context: 负号、括号、分数或幂运算等数学表达式中的短符号序列；标记集中在运算符和数字附近。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 数学题或公式

patterns.name: Name 字段及其值
patterns.context: 出现在结构化字段、属性或标签中，Name 常作字段名或复合名称的一部分；有时后接人名、语言名或模型描述。
patterns.domain: 代码、HTML 示例、数据库文档

patterns.name: 特定医学术语
patterns.context: 术语 Trichotillomania 的分词片段，后接缩写“(TTM)”。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的可擦除／可改写概念
patterns.context: eraseable/erasable 一类词形出现在描述可编程、可擦除存储器的句子中；激活落在词内部片段。

patterns.name: 配置或文档中的路径选项
patterns.context: 代码参数说明中，Path 指向文件，附近有 JSONL、文档或模型选项等配置描述。
patterns.domain: Github 代码与命令行参数文档

patterns.name: 法语口语词形
patterns.context: 法语句子中出现口语表达及屈折词形，激活分布在法语词内部或常见词上。

en.concept: Diverse text fragments and structural markers
en.description: Activations occur in math expressions dense with digits and symbols, French words and intra-word fragments, as well as table/HTML structures, medical terminology, and physics terminology; the specific triggers vary substantially across contexts.

patterns.name: Digits and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Digits, parentheses, and arithmetic symbols appear in alternation; the context is a partial mathematical expression.

patterns.name: French word-form fragments
patterns.context: In continuous French text, activation falls on words or affix fragments; examples include both colloquial expressions and formal parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Fragments within long French words
patterns.context: In formal French text, activation is distributed across subword fragments within longer words; passage 4 is especially concentrated on “autorisation” and “commercialisation”.

patterns.name: Table patterns and field names
patterns.context: In pipe-delimited structured tables or field definitions, activation occurs near delimiters, field names, and type names.

patterns.name: HTML output structure
patterns.context: HTML tags, attributes, and element text in example output; adjacent to an example converting an array object into HTML.

patterns.name: Biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: In lists of cytokines and immunological indicators, activation concentrates on terms composed of abbreviations, hyphens, and numbers.

patterns.name: Fragments within disease names
patterns.context: Standalone medical diagnoses are split into multiple subword fragments, with activation primarily inside the names.

patterns.name: High-energy physics terms and symbols
patterns.context: The abstract opening describes high-energy gamma rays and contains English technical terms, mathematical symbols, and an energy threshold.

4_1843.concept: 多样文本片段与结构标记
4_1843.description: 激活见于数字和符号密集的数学式、法语词语及词内片段，也见于表格/HTML结构、医学术语和物理术语；各处具体触发形式差异明显。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与运算符
patterns.trigger: «3»、«2»、«4»，以及括号和运算符附近的数字
patterns.context: 数字、括号和算术符号交错出现；上下文是残缺的数学表达式。

patterns.name: 法语词形片段
patterns.context: 法语连续文本中，激活落在词语或词缀片段上；既见于口语表达，也见于正式议会文本。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 对话、EuroParl 正式发言

patterns.name: 法语长词内部片段
patterns.context: 法语正式文本中，激活分布于较长词语的内部子词片段；第4段尤集中于“autorisation”“commercialisation”。

patterns.name: 表格模式及字段名
patterns.context: 竖线分隔的结构化表格或字段定义中，激活出现在分隔符、字段名及类型名附近。

patterns.name: HTML 输出结构
patterns.context: 示例输出中的 HTML 标签、属性和元素文本；与数组对象转成 HTML 的示例相邻。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 细胞因子及免疫学指标列表中，激活集中于缩写、连字符和编号组成的术语。

patterns.name: 疾病名称内部片段
patterns.context: 单独出现的医学诊断名称被拆成多个子词片段，激活主要落在名称内部。

patterns.name: 高能物理术语与符号
patterns.context: 摘要开头描述高能伽马射线，包含英文专业词、数学符号及能量阈值。

en.description: Word fragments and subword tokens activate in Cyrillic and French, along with individual digits, operators, and punctuation; examples include formulas, code strings, and connected prose. No single lexical or topical trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Within compact arithmetic notation containing digits, parentheses, and operators; individual symbols and formula fragments activate.

patterns.name: Fragments of Cyrillic words
patterns.context: Activation falls on parts of Cyrillic strings and words, often when words are split into subword tokens; in segment 3, a string array and code occur nearby.

patterns.name: French suffixes and word forms
patterns.context: Fragments of French words appear in connected formal text and conversational messages, with no single fixed position.

patterns.name: Fragments of Russian words and names
patterns.context: Subword tokens inside Cyrillic words, including common vocabulary, names/titles, and forms in connected text or code-like contexts.
patterns.domain: Russian text: StackExchange, Github, and EuroParl

patterns.name: Punctuation and token boundaries
patterns.context: Individual punctuation tokens occur in conversational exchanges and multilingual text; the examples do not reveal a clear shared cause.

4_1843.concept: Фрагменты токенов в разнородном тексте
4_1843.description: Активируются фрагменты слов и субтокены на кириллице и французском, а также отдельные цифры, операторы и пунктуация; примеры охватывают формулы, кодовые строки и связную речь. Единого лексического или тематического триггера не видно.

patterns.name: Математические выражения
patterns.context: Внутри компактной записи арифметических выражений, с цифрами, скобками и операторами; активируются отдельные символы и фрагменты формулы.

patterns.name: Фрагменты кириллических слов
patterns.trigger: «С» в «С», «Ш» в «Ш», а также фрагменты «ый», «в», «ар» в «Гыйнварь»
patterns.context: Активация приходится на части кириллических строк и слов, часто при разбиении слов на субтокены; в сегменте 3 рядом присутствуют массив строк и код.
patterns.domain: Github, код и данные со строками

patterns.name: Французские суффиксы и словоформы
patterns.context: Фрагменты французских слов; встречаются в связном официальном тексте и разговорном сообщении, без единого фиксированного положения.

patterns.name: Фрагменты русских слов и имён
patterns.context: Субтокены внутри кириллических слов, включая обычную лексику, имена/названия и формы в связном тексте или кодоподобном контексте.
patterns.domain: Русский текст: StackExchange, Github и EuroParl

patterns.name: Пунктуация и границы токенов
patterns.trigger: «))» в сегменте 5; также активируются запятые и фрагменты вокруг знаков препинания
patterns.context: Отдельные пунктуационные токены возникают внутри разговорных реплик и многоязычного текста; самостоятельная общая причина по примерам не ясна.

en.description: Activation is distributed across several text types: it strongly favors Name/name identifiers, struct fields, and some system/testing contexts in Go code and comments; it also occurs in viral composition terminology, truncated mathematical expressions, and legal parcel numbers.

patterns.name: Name / Name field identifiers
patterns.context: Name in UpperCamelCase identifiers, or names in code comments, type/field/function names; segment 2 also contains a struct field named Name.
patterns.domain: Go source code and comments; sporadic matches also occur in place names/parcel numbers in the legal text in segment 8

patterns.name: Declarations and struct fields in Go code
patterns.context: Go struct definitions with adjacent field and type names; code snippets also contain field construction or entity-attribute descriptions.

patterns.name: Go standard library identity and user queries
patterns.context: Looking up system user information, involving comments and function definitions related to usernames, passwords, and group databases.

patterns.name: Go cloud signed-cookie constants
patterns.context: A comment describing a cookie name and its corresponding constant assignment; the value is a CloudFront signed-cookie name.
patterns.domain: Go cloud service code on Github

patterns.name: Equality comparisons in Go tests
patterns.context: Testing deep equality comparisons for recursive types, tracking visited map entries and short-circuiting recursion.
patterns.domain: Go test code and comments on Github

patterns.name: Process signals and PID name tests
patterns.context: Sending SIGUSR2 to a process named odyssey and checking error handling when retrieving a process name by PID.
patterns.domain: Go system test code on Github

patterns.name: Full command name method
patterns.context: Comments and method declarations describe a command’s full name; a subcommand’s path includes its parent command.

patterns.name: Retroviral gene-structure terminology
patterns.context: Describes retroviruses and their LTR sequences, genes, and protein composition; triggers cluster near composed of and technical terms.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: The fragment retains only truncated parentheses, fractions, minus signs, and arithmetic expressions, making the specific operation context hard to determine.

patterns.name: Parcel numbers in legal real-estate documents
patterns.context: A real-estate legal document lists land and its improvements, contents, and parcel/numbers.

4_1843.concept: 名称/标识符及编号片段
4_1843.description: 激活分散在多类文本中：明显偏好 Go 代码及注释里的 Name/名称标识符、结构体字段和若干系统/测试语境；也出现在病毒组成术语、截断数学式和法律地块编号中。

patterns.name: Name / Name 字段标识符
patterns.context: 大写驼峰标识符中的 Name，或代码注释、类型/字段/函数名中的名称；第2段也有结构体字段 Name。
patterns.domain: Go 源码及注释；第8段法律文本中的地名/地块名称编号也有零散匹配

patterns.name: Go 代码中的声明与结构体字段
patterns.context: Go 结构体定义与字段名、类型名相邻；代码片段还出现构造字段或实体属性说明。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Go 示例代码

patterns.name: Go 标准库身份与用户查询
patterns.context: 查找系统用户信息，涉及用户名、密码和组数据库的注释与函数定义。
patterns.domain: Go 系统/用户管理代码注释

patterns.name: Go 云端签名 Cookie 常量
patterns.context: 描述 Cookie 名称的注释及其对应的常量赋值；值为 CloudFront 签名 Cookie 名。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Go 云服务代码

patterns.name: Go 测试中的相等比较
patterns.context: 测试递归类型的深度相等比较，追踪已访问的 map 项并短路递归。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Go 测试代码与注释

patterns.name: 进程信号与 PID 名称测试
patterns.context: 向名为 odyssey 的进程发送 SIGUSR2，并检查按 PID 查询进程名时的错误处理。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Go 系统测试代码

patterns.name: 命令全名方法
patterns.context: 注释和方法声明描述命令的完整名称，子命令的路径包含父命令。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Go CLI 代码

patterns.name: 逆转录病毒基因结构术语
patterns.context: 描述逆转录病毒及其 LTR 序列、基因和蛋白质组成；触发集中于 composed of 和专业术语附近。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与符号
patterns.context: 片段只保留了被截断的括号、分数、负号与算术表达式，难以确定更具体的运算语境。

patterns.name: 法律地产文书中的地块编号
patterns.context: 房地产法律文书列出土地及其改良物、内容和地块/编号。

en.concept: Function words and constraint expressions in technical text
en.description: Activation is distributed across code, comments, and technical forums, often occurring on “not,” “to,” and expressions of constraints or outcomes; there are also segment-specific terms, validation code, lists, and discussion content, with no unified semantic pattern apparent.

patterns.name: not in code or text
patterns.context: The negation appears in a negative judgment, restriction, or suggestion, covering content from programming rules to news headlines and Q&A.
patterns.domain: Code comments, news headlines, technical Q&A and discussions

patterns.name: Infinitive to
patterns.context: Appears before verbs to form infinitives, or in expressions such as “allows you to”.
patterns.domain: Code comments, technical documentation, forum posts

patterns.name: Expressions of permission, resolution, and conditional outcomes
patterns.context: Describes a mechanism that enables an operation or explains what problem a solution addresses.

patterns.name: Code constraints, validation, and design requirements
patterns.context: States requirements and restrictions on identifier formats, input ranges, patterns, or designer code.
patterns.domain: Code comments, API or implementation descriptions

patterns.name: Null or boundary checks in code
patterns.context: Handles special inputs or boundary cases by comparing character ranges or checking for empty collections.

patterns.name: Reflection and recursive comparison
patterns.context: Tests deep equality comparisons and uses a visited map to handle recursive types.

patterns.name: Generated-code notice in a designer
patterns.context: A maintenance warning in an autogenerated code region.

patterns.name: Denial of impact in a news headline
patterns.context: The headline asserts that an event or issue does not affect SSH at all.

patterns.name: Task list for a messaging system
patterns.context: Lists requirements such as push notifications, message archiving, and device synchronization.

patterns.name: State object and character-reading code
patterns.context: Reads a character code and checks whether it is within the allowed range.

patterns.name: Immutable collection test
patterns.context: Tests whether an empty collection is immutable, using the clear operation to illustrate its behavior.

patterns.name: Doctrine association refresh and traversal
patterns.context: Discusses excluded values, fetched associations, and ORM association traversal.

patterns.name: Page feedback after acceptance or rejection
patterns.context: Asks how to display a result message after a user accepts or rejects an action.

patterns.name: Sarcasm about trivial and category theory discussion
patterns.context: Discusses category theory and whether the target domain is obvious, in a comment or debate tone.

4_1843.concept: 技术文本中的功能词与约束表达
4_1843.description: 激活分散在代码、注释和技术论坛中，常见于“not”“to”、限制或结果表达；另有各段特定术语、校验代码、列表和讨论内容，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 代码或文本中的 not
patterns.context: 否定词出现在否定判断、限制或建议句中；对应内容从编程规则到新闻标题和问答
patterns.domain: 代码注释、新闻标题、技术问答与讨论

patterns.name: 不定式 to
patterns.context: 出现在动词前构成不定式，或出现在“allows you to”等表达中
patterns.domain: 代码注释、技术文档、论坛帖子

patterns.name: 允许、解决与条件结果表达
patterns.context: 描述某机制使某操作成为可能，或说明方案解决什么问题

patterns.name: 代码限定、校验与设计约束
patterns.context: 陈述标识符格式、输入范围、模式或设计器代码的要求与限制
patterns.domain: 代码注释、API 或实现说明

patterns.name: 代码中的空值或边界检查
patterns.context: 通过比较字符范围或检查空集合处理特殊输入或边界情形

patterns.name: 反射与递归比较
patterns.context: 测试深度相等比较，并借助已见映射处理递归类型

patterns.name: 配置器生成代码提示
patterns.context: 自动生成代码区域中的维护警告
patterns.domain: C# 代码与设计器注释

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的影响否定
patterns.context: 标题断言某事件或问题完全不影响 SSH

patterns.name: 消息系统的任务列表
patterns.context: 列举推送通知、消息归档和设备同步等需求

patterns.name: 状态对象与字符读取代码
patterns.context: 读取字符码并检查其是否在允许范围内

patterns.name: 不可修改集合测试
patterns.context: 测试空集合是否不可修改，并以 clear 操作说明行为

patterns.name: Doctrine 关联刷新与遍历
patterns.trigger: “will not fully refresh” / “walk all the associations”
patterns.context: 讨论排除值、已检索关联及 ORM 关联遍历

patterns.name: 接受或拒绝后的页面反馈
patterns.context: 询问用户执行接受或拒绝操作后如何展示结果消息

patterns.name: trivial 的反讽及范畴论讨论
patterns.context: 讨论范畴论及目标领域是否显然，带有评论或辩论语气

en.description: All fragments prominently activate not, including standalone negation, negation after modal or auxiliary verbs, and negative sentences in error messages, comments, academic text, and business text; a few fragments contain may not or does not include in parentheses.

patterns.name: Local activation of the negation word “not”
patterns.context: Appears as not in a phrase or clause; the negated element and syntactic position vary, including “should not be,” “Could not detect,” and “does not include.” In most cases, not itself is the highest-activation token.
patterns.domain: Prose, emails, code comments, and error messages across domains

patterns.name: may not in possibility constructions
patterns.context: Repeated may forms uncertainty or presents two possibilities in parallel.

patterns.name: Parenthetical does not
patterns.context: A parenthetical note indicates that something is not included, using the structure does not include.
patterns.domain: Energy transportation contract or quantity-description email

4_1843.concept: 英语否定词 not
4_1843.description: 所有片段均突出激活 not，涵盖独立否定、情态动词或助动词后的否定，以及错误消息、注释、学术与商业文本中的否定句；少数片段含 may not 或括号内 does not include。

patterns.name: 否定词“not”的局部激活
patterns.context: 在短语或从句中出现 not；否定对象和句法位置不固定，包括 “should not be”“Could not detect”“does not include”。多数情况下，not 本身是最高激活 token。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的散文、邮件、代码注释和错误信息

patterns.name: 可能性结构中的 may not
patterns.context: 重复 may 构成不确定性或两种可能并列的结构。

patterns.name: does not 括号补充
patterns.context: 括号内说明某项未计入，not 位于 does not include 结构中。
patterns.domain: 能源运输合同或数量说明邮件

en.description: Primarily responds to not, especially not only, not to, and not just; there are also sporadic subword activations in a viewport string and in medical, Russian, HTML, and headline contexts, with no unified pattern yet apparent.

patterns.name: Negating/restrictive word not
patterns.context: Directly activates on not; common in “not only” or “not to,” but also occurs in uses such as “not just.”
patterns.domain: Patents, medical papers, memory research, news, mathematics text

patterns.name: viewport string
patterns.context: viewport embedded in an HTML meta tag, or written as view«port»; also occurs in descriptions of narrow-screen layouts.
patterns.domain: HTML, responsive web design, frontend Q&A

patterns.name: Intermediate-form word fragment
patterns.context: A Russian word is split into multiple subword fragments; activation falls on the character substring “идл,” not on an obvious English semantic word.
patterns.domain: Russian Q&A text mixed with JavaScript

patterns.name: Subword fragment in biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal tokenized fragment of a technical term; one is an anatomical term, and the other is a word form related to an appendix/supplement.

patterns.name: Word-ending fragment in HTML metadata
patterns.context: Occurs inside a person’s name in HTML copyright metadata, with no confirmable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Incomplete Russian/Cyrillic fragment
patterns.context: Activation occurs in a string of Russian character fragments; the specific meaning and trigger cannot be determined from the local context.
patterns.domain: Russian Q&A text mixed with code

patterns.name: Character fragment in a title
patterns.context: An isolated initial appears after the author’s name and before the date and title; there is no clear semantic association.

patterns.name: Irregular English subword fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a truncated or nonstandard word form at the beginning of a news paragraph; there is not enough context to determine its referent.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments of common words in context
patterns.context: These words or subwords occur in individual segments and do not form a stable shared phrase or exhibit an obvious common syntactic or semantic condition.

4_1843.concept: not 的否定／限制用法
4_1843.description: 主要对 not（尤其 not only、not to、not just）有反应；另见 viewport 字符串及医学、俄语、HTML 和标题中的零散子词激活，尚无统一规律。

patterns.name: 否定／限制词 not
patterns.context: 直接出现在 not 上；常见于“not only”或“not to”，但也有“not just”等用法。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学论文、记忆研究、新闻、数学文本

patterns.name: viewport 字符串
patterns.context: 嵌在 HTML meta 标签中的 viewport，或连写的 view«port»；同时见于关于窄屏布局的描述。
patterns.domain: HTML、网页响应式设计、前端问答

patterns.name: 中间形态词片段
patterns.context: 俄语词被分成多个子词片段；激活落在“идл”内部的字母子串，而非明显的英语语义词。
patterns.domain: 俄语夹杂 JavaScript 的问答文本

patterns.name: 生物医学术语中的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活位于专业术语的内部切分片段；一个是解剖术语，一个是附录／补充材料相关词形。

patterns.name: HTML 元数据中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在 HTML copyright 元数据的人名内部，缺少可确认的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 残缺俄语／西里尔字母片段
patterns.context: 激活在一串俄语字母片段中；具体词义与触发条件无法从局部上下文确定。
patterns.domain: 俄语夹杂代码的问答文本

patterns.name: 标题中的字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在作者姓名后、日期与标题之前的孤立首字母；没有明确语义关联。

patterns.name: 不规则英语子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻段落开头的截断或非标准词形中，语境不足以确定所指。

patterns.name: 上下文中零散的常用词片段
patterns.context: 这些词或子词仅在单个段落中出现，既不构成稳定共同短语，也没有明显统一句法或语义条件。

en.concept: Numbering and structured technical text, with domain-specific word responses
en.description: Activation is most concentrated in compound fields in code or documentation, numbering, and version/timestamp contexts; other domain-specific responses occur in clinical research terminology, descriptions of an ocular opening, counts of studies in reviews, and current-trace captions. Some common-word activations are sporadic and hard to group under a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Compound identifiers and code fields
patterns.context: Words are joined into field names, variable names, attribute names, or titles in code, configuration, or markup; activation also falls on component words and nearby punctuation.

patterns.name: number and its contexts
patterns.context: number appears as a label or value related to an identifier, version, count, or timestamp, often in documentation or explanatory statements; activation may extend to adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, code comments, webpage metadata, segments 1, 7, 8, 9

patterns.name: Common nouns in clinical research
patterns.context: Activation occurs near words for study subjects, examinations, protocols, and informed consent in descriptions of clinical research methods or participants.

patterns.name: Area, opening, and enlargement
patterns.context: In a sentence describing enlargement of the anterior capsular opening after laser treatment, activation clusters on the definite article and opening/area.

patterns.name: Number of studies in a systematic review
patterns.context: Explains the rationale for conducting a systematic review, mentioning the large number of individual studies already available.

patterns.name: Current-experiment figure caption
patterns.context: The caption describes currents evoked under voltage-clamp conditions and leptin treatment; activation clusters on current-related words.

patterns.name: Sentence-final or document-structure markers
patterns.context: A few high-activation function words or common words occur in different texts, with no stable shared local semantic condition; these may be sporadic responses beyond the compound pattern.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose and technical text, segments 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10

4_1843.concept: 编号与结构化技术文本，兼有领域词响应
4_1843.description: 激活最集中于代码或文档里的复合字段、编号与版本/时间戳语境；另有临床研究术语、眼科开口描述、综述研究数量及电流图注等领域性响应。部分普通词激活分散，难以归为统一语义。

patterns.name: 复合标识符与代码字段
patterns.context: 代码、配置或标记语言中，词被拼接成字段名、变量名、属性名或标题；激活也落在组成词及其邻近标点上。

patterns.name: number及其语境
patterns.trigger: « number»、«number»，以及 «Build number»、«revision number»、«this number»、«Last updated on»
patterns.context: number作为编号、版本、计数或时间戳相关标签/值出现，常位于文档或说明语句中；激活也可延伸到相邻词。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、代码注释、网页元数据，段1、7、8、9

patterns.name: 临床研究中的常见名词
patterns.context: 临床研究方法或受试者描述中，研究对象、检查、方案及知情同意等词附近激活。

patterns.name: 区域、开口与扩大
patterns.context: 描述激光治疗后扩大前囊开口的句子中，激活集中于定冠词和 opening/area。

patterns.name: 系统综述的研究数量
patterns.context: 说明开展系统综述的理由，提及已有大量个别研究。

patterns.name: 电流实验图注
patterns.context: 图注描述电压钳条件下诱发电流及瘦素处理，激活集中在电流相关词。

patterns.name: 句末或文档结构标记
patterns.trigger: «is»、«are»、«in»、«on»、«area»等分散词，以及多处换行/标点附近标记
patterns.context: 不同文本中出现少数高激活功能词或普通词，未见稳定、共同的局部语义条件；可能是复合模式之外的零散响应。

en.concept: Delimiters and labels in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to dot-connected identifiers and adjacent fragments in code and configuration; also involves segmentation labels such as tab/segments, medical headers, and isolated title words. Activations on common English words lack consistent conditions.

patterns.name: Dot-delimited identifiers in source or structured text
patterns.context: Activations cluster on periods and adjacent fragments in identifiers in code, configuration, paths, or technical text; common in qualified names, property/method access, version numbers, and filenames.
patterns.domain: Software code, XML configuration, technical text

patterns.name: Segmentation or partition labels
patterns.context: Appears in noun phrases describing interface labels or anatomical/measurement partitions, often surrounded by category names or location modifiers.

patterns.name: Words in a coal-related headline
patterns.context: Appears in a news-style headline about rising coal prices and future trends; an isolated example, without the code-identifier condition.
patterns.domain: Finance/energy headline quoted in an email

patterns.name: Table or case-field labels
patterns.context: Appears as a bold column heading in the header row of a medical-paper patient-characteristics table.

patterns.name: Incomplete fragments of general English
patterns.context: Occurs sporadically in ordinary explanatory text or code descriptions; these frequent words have inconsistent contexts and do not yield a stable trigger condition on their own.

4_1843.concept: 结构化文本中的分隔标记与标签
4_1843.description: 主要对代码与配置中点号连接的标识符及相邻片段起反应，也涉及tab/segments等分段标签、医学表头和孤立标题词；常见英文词的激活缺少一致条件。

patterns.name: 源码或结构化文本中的点分隔标识符
patterns.trigger: «.»（尤其紧接在标识符、命名空间或路径片段之后）；如 «Current»«.»«Get», «transaction»«.»«edit», «CognitiveServices»«.»«Language», «order»«.»«create», «D»«9»«3», «tarballs»«.»«jl»
patterns.context: 激活集中在代码、配置、路径或技术标识符中的句点及其相邻片段；常见于连续限定名、属性/方法访问、版本号或文件名。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、XML配置、技术文本

patterns.name: 分段或分区标签
patterns.context: 在描述界面标签或解剖/测量分区的名词短语中出现，周围常有分类名称或位置修饰语。

patterns.name: 煤炭主题标题中的词语
patterns.context: 出现在关于煤炭价格上涨及未来走势的新闻式标题中；孤例，未见代码标识符条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件中引用的财经/能源标题

patterns.name: 表格或病例字段标签
patterns.context: 医学论文的患者特征表格标题行中，作为加粗列名出现。

patterns.name: 不完整的一般英文片段
patterns.trigger: « to»、« that»、« a»、« in»等常见词
