patterns.domain: 论坛评论、带修辞色彩的英文散文

patterns.name: 代码测试中的局部变量与循环
patterns.context: 测试代码讨论 FiberRef、子节点继承和值；激活分散在代码词与短语中。

patterns.name: 专名中的数字与席位描述
patterns.context: 苏格兰选举结果叙述中，数字紧随姓氏，句子涉及唯一席位。

patterns.name: 字符串转整数的提问句式
patterns.context: 询问为何字符串不能按整数读取，并请求建议。

patterns.name: 强调数量与捐赠号召
patterns.context: 出现在要求读者捐款的号召中，强调当前需求更迫切。

patterns.name: 数据分析代码中的空白分隔符
patterns.context: 描述读取 CSV 时以空白字符作为分隔符，并提到示例输入。

patterns.name: 法律条款及条号
patterns.context: CC&Rs 条文引用附近，涉及协会规则、执行与处罚。

patterns.name: 价格与卖点表达
patterns.context: 谈论游戏的艺术表现与价格吸引力。

en.description: Activation locations vary. A clearer recurring pattern is the comparison structure “more than”, especially “than”; other sporadic triggers include intra-word fragments, numeric prices, disease and population references, Africa-related word endings, and idiomatic phrases. Overall, the activations are heterogeneous.

patterns.name: Threshold comparison with “more than”
patterns.context: Appears in structures comparing quantity, time, or degree, especially “more than”; activation concentrates on “than”.
patterns.domain: Popular-science/academic text, medical studies, institutional descriptions

patterns.name: Letter fragments within words or at word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter fragments within words, tokenization boundaries, or adjacent word fragments; contextual conditions are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Webpage titles, links, Portuguese parliamentary text, clinical papers

patterns.name: Middle Eastern population and disease description
patterns.context: Describes disease patterns in a specific population; strong activations fall on “Eastern” and the adjacent “with”.

patterns.name: Price-tag digit
patterns.context: The number appears as a dollar price, specifically $9.99.

patterns.name: Word ending in an Africa-related term
patterns.context: A Portuguese sentence mentions the African continent and its opportunities; activation concentrates on a fragment of “continente”.

patterns.name: “off” in a phrase about cutting
patterns.context: In the idiom “cutting off the nose to spite the face”, “off” and the following definite article are marked.

patterns.name: Surgical timing in a paper abstract
patterns.context: Compares surgery within 12 hours of admission versus later for patients with hip fractures. Adjacent to the general “more-than” pattern, but the trigger context is specific.

patterns.name: Emphasis on the future
patterns.context: A project fundraising description emphasizes the long-term future and the need for donations.

patterns.name: Unmerged word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall in separate locations, including phrases in comments, physics terms, and word fragments in clinical narratives; there is no shared local semantic or syntactic condition.

4_1843.concept: 词片段与比较标记
4_1843.description: 激活位置多样：较清楚的重复是比较结构“more than”，尤其 than；另有词内片段、数字价格、疾病与人群、非洲相关词尾及习语短语等零散触发，整体异质。

patterns.name: more than 的阈值比较
patterns.context: 出现在比较数量、时间或程度的结构中，尤指“more than”；激活集中在 than。
patterns.domain: 科普/学术文本、医学研究、机构说明

patterns.name: 词内或词边界处的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的字母片段、分词边界或相邻词片段上；上下文条件不统一。
patterns.domain: 网页标题、链接、葡萄牙语议会文本、临床论文

patterns.name: 中东人群与疾病描述
patterns.context: 描述特定人群中的疾病模式；强激活落在“Eastern”及相邻的“with”。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助/研究计划文本

patterns.name: 价格标签数字
patterns.context: 数字以美元价格形式出现，具体为 $9.99。

patterns.name: 非洲相关词的词尾
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中提到非洲大陆及其机遇；激活集中于 continente 的片段。

patterns.name: 切断短语中的 off
patterns.context: 习语“cutting off the nose to spite the face”中，off 与其后定冠词被标记。

patterns.name: 论文摘要中的手术时间
patterns.context: 比较髋部骨折患者入院后12小时内外接受手术。与一般 more-than 模式相邻，但触发语境具体。

patterns.name: 对未来的强调
patterns.context: 项目募捐说明中强调长期未来以及捐赠需求。

patterns.name: 未能归并的词片段
patterns.context: 激活分别落在评论中的短语、物理学术语、临床叙述词片段等位置，缺少共同的局部语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 评论、物理学论文、医学文本

en.description: Activations occur on the relative pronoun which, generic or quantitative one, decimal points, sentence-initial capitalized fragments, camel-case method names in code, and fragments within Portuguese words; there is no single stable semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: Which in relative clauses
patterns.context: An antecedent or preceding text lists one or more things, followed by a relative clause introduced by which; activation falls on which.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, legal documents, technical discussions

patterns.name: One in multiword hierarchies
patterns.context: One denotes an option or level and follows more than; the context discusses file organization.

patterns.name: One in descriptive or emphatic wording
patterns.context: One is a generic pronoun referring to a person or agent performing an action.

patterns.name: One at the beginning of a sentence
patterns.context: Capitalized One at the start of a sentence denotes an unspecified number, item, or agent; this example is insufficient to determine the specific meaning.

patterns.name: Decimal point after the number 1
patterns.context: A digit after the decimal point in a monetary amount; currency symbols and amount units occur nearby.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial capital letter after a period
patterns.context: A period marks the end of a sentence or entry, followed by a capitalized abbreviation; here it is a manual macro format.

patterns.name: Capital T in a JavaScript method name
patterns.context: A camel-case JavaScript method name within a method-call chain.

patterns.name: Word endings in Portuguese plural forms
patterns.context: Topics such as climate change appear in Portuguese sentences; activation is scattered within words and near punctuation, with no consistent lexical condition.

4_1843.concept: 局部异质片段
4_1843.description: 激活分散于关系代词which、泛指或数量one、数字小数点、句首大写片段、代码驼峰方法名及葡萄牙语词内片段；没有单一稳定的语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: 关系从句中的 which
patterns.trigger: “each of which”“neither of which”“neither of which”“both of which”一类结构中的 “which”
patterns.context: 先行词或前文列举了一个或多个事物，后接 which 引导的关系从句；激活落在 which 上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律文书、技术讨论

patterns.name: 多词层级中的 one
patterns.context: one 表示一个选项或层级，置于 more than 之后；上下文讨论文件组织方式。

patterns.name: 描述或强调用词中的 one
patterns.context: one 作泛指代词，指执行某动作的人或主体。

patterns.name: One 在句首
patterns.context: 句首大写的 One，表示不确定的某个数字、项目或主体；此例不足以判定具体语义。

patterns.name: 数字 1 后接小数点 8
patterns.context: 金额数字格式中，小数点后的数字；周围有货币符号及金额单位。

patterns.name: 句点后接句首大写字母
patterns.context: 句点标记句子或条目结束，后接大写缩写；此处是手册宏格式。

patterns.name: JavaScript 方法名中含大写 T
patterns.context: 驼峰式 JavaScript 方法名，位于方法调用链中。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语复数形式的词尾
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中，谈及气候变化等议题；激活分散在词内及标点附近，未见一致词法条件。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual word fragments, common function words, proper names, and code and punctuation boundaries; some highlighted tokens occur in words containing n/nt, but this does not explain all samples.

patterns.name: English n/nt syllables within or between words
patterns.context: Activation falls on word fragments containing or continuing n/nt syllables; sometimes the tokenizer splits the fragment, and no specific syntactic position is required.
patterns.domain: Legal, news, medical, encyclopedic, and forum text

patterns.name: Portuguese endings and inflected forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on Portuguese word endings or internal fragments, often in long words or at tokenizer splits.
patterns.domain: Portuguese Q&A and European Parliament text

patterns.name: Punctuation, quotation marks, and code boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur on code punctuation, tokens near quotation marks, or fragments of code method names and object properties; no clearly stable semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: JavaScript code; punctuation in legal quotations, news, and proper names

patterns.name: Common English function words and collocations
patterns.context: Appears in complete sentences as a preposition, pronoun, conjunction, or component of a common collocation; there is no notably consistent semantic context.
patterns.domain: English narrative, legal text, and sports reporting

patterns.name: Proper names or intra-word letter fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on proper names or internal fragments of ordinary words split by the tokenizer; word meanings and contexts vary widely.
patterns.domain: Personal names, place names, company names, and news headlines

4_1843.concept: 词片段与边界响应
4_1843.description: 激活分散于多语种词片段、常见功能词、专名及代码与标点边界；部分高亮落在含 n/nt 的词中，但不足以解释全部样本。

patterns.name: 英文词内或词间的 n/nt 音节
patterns.trigger: «ent»、«Continent»、«unit»、«international»、«government» 等；尤其是被拆分的词片段，如 subcontin«ent»、noncontin«ent»
patterns.context: 激活落在含有或延续 n/nt 音节的词片段上；有时词片段被 tokenizer 拆开，且不要求特定句法位置
patterns.domain: 跨法律、新闻、医学、百科与论坛文本

patterns.name: 葡语词尾与屈折形式
patterns.context: 激活落在葡语词的词尾或内部片段；常见于长词或 tokenizer 切分处
patterns.domain: 葡语问答与欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 标点、引号及代码边界
patterns.context: 激活出现在代码标点、引号附近的 token，或代码方法名及对象属性片段；缺少明显稳定的语义条件
patterns.domain: JavaScript 代码；另有法律引文、新闻与专名中的标点

patterns.name: 英文常见功能词与搭配
patterns.context: 在完整句子中作为介词、代词、连接词或常见搭配成分出现；没有显著一致的语义场景
patterns.domain: 英语叙述、法律文本与体育报道

patterns.name: 专名或词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或普通词被切分后的内部片段，所在词义与上下文差异很大
patterns.domain: 人名、地名、公司名与新闻标题

en.description: Activations involve the participial ending of Industry, the geographical adjectives Asian/Eastern, multi-item structures with more than one, and occasional patent boilerplate, printing phrases, and America in news URLs. The pattern spans domains, and trigger features are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Industry-related word form Industry
patterns.context: Industry is split into multiple tokens, with activation concentrated on the ending fragment «ry»; [1] has Industry in a class template, while [10] occurs in policy commentary about industry benefits.

patterns.name: Geographical or ethnic adjective Asian
patterns.context: A geographical or ethnic name modifies a population, region, or project; both instances occur in compound place names such as Middle Eastern / Central Asian.

patterns.name: One in multi-item or multi-level structures
patterns.context: One occurs in the structure more than one, referring to folder levels, games, messages, or names; the meanings all involve plural objects or choices.

patterns.name: Laid-Open in patent terminology
patterns.context: Occurs near a patent application number and title; a fixed term in formal patent documents.

patterns.name: Out as an emphasis marker
patterns.context: Occurs in a description of printing previously entered messages in sequence; out is part of the phrase print ... out.

patterns.name: America in news URLs
patterns.context: Occurs in the path of a CNN article URL, among news links concerning the US-China tariff war.

4_1843.concept: none
4_1843.description: 激活涉及 Industry 的分词词尾、Asian/Eastern 地理形容词、more than one 多项结构，也零星响应专利固定词、打印短语及新闻网址中的 America；模式跨领域，触发特征并不统一。

patterns.name: 行业相关词形 Industry
patterns.context: 词内 Industry 被拆分成多个 token，激活集中在词尾片段 «ry»；[1] 位于类名模板中的 Industry，[10] 位于行业受益的政策评论中。

patterns.name: 地理或族群形容词 Asian
patterns.context: 地理/族群名称修饰人群、地区或项目；两处都在 Middle Eastern / Central Asian 这样的复合地名中。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生研究、百科叙述

patterns.name: 多项或多层级结构中的 one
patterns.trigger: « more»7« than»7« one»9 folder« hierarchy»1（[3]）；“more than« one»9 game”（[4]）；“more than« one»8 message”（[7]）；“more than« one»8« name»1”（[8]）
patterns.context: one 出现在 more than one 结构中，表示多个文件夹层级、游戏、消息或名称；语义均涉及复数对象或选择。
patterns.domain: 问答、软件/游戏讨论、论文图注

patterns.name: 专利术语中的 Laid-Open
patterns.context: 出现在专利申请编号及专利名称附近，是正式专利文献中的固定术语。

patterns.name: 强度标记的 out
patterns.context: 出现在将先前输入的消息逐次打印出来的操作描述中，out 是短语 print ... out 的一部分。

patterns.name: 新闻网址中的 America
patterns.context: 出现在 CNN 文章网址的路径中，周围是美国与中国关税战相关的新闻链接。

en.description: Activations are scattered: they occur in regional-name fragments such as Balk«an», Central «Asian», and Middle «East», as well as the ending of “industry”, the quantity structure “more than one”, and near code indentation; these examples show no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Place-name fragment “Middle East”
patterns.context: In the geographic name “Middle East”, activation falls on “East”; in [1], it occurs in the similar regional name Balk«an»10.
patterns.domain: News, politics, and international affairs text

patterns.name: Regional adjective “Asian”
patterns.context: Appears in the proper name Central Asian as a regional adjective; also occurs in Latin American.

patterns.name: Ending of “industry”
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of “industry”; another instance is in “porn industry”, but the marker is on an unmarked position before “industry”.

patterns.name: Quantity-comparison structure
patterns.context: Appears in “more than one”, indicating a quantity greater than one or a single item; the preceding contexts concern folder levels and NE555, respectively.

patterns.name: Word endings near code indentation
patterns.context: Near space indentation and identifiers related to indent/indentation in code; activation does not fall only on code tokens.

4_1843.concept: none
4_1843.description: 激活位置分散：含 Balk«an»、Central «Asian»、Middle «East» 等地域名称片段，也见 industry 词尾、more than one 数量结构及代码缩进附近；这些用例未显示统一触发条件。

patterns.name: Middle East 地名片段
patterns.context: “Middle East”这一地理名称中，激活落在 East；[1]中则为相近的区域名称 Balk«an»10。
patterns.domain: 新闻、政治与国际事务文本

patterns.name: Asian 区域形容词
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Central Asian 中，用作地区形容词；另见 Latin American。
patterns.domain: 百科与公共卫生学术文本

patterns.name: industry 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 industry 的词尾；另一处为 “porn industry”，但标记在 industry 前的未标记位置。
patterns.domain: 代码标识符与网络讨论

patterns.name: 数量比较结构
patterns.context: 出现在 “more than one” 中，表示数量超过一个或单一项；两处前文分别涉及文件夹层级和 NE555。

patterns.name: 代码中的缩进词尾
patterns.context: 代码中空格缩进以及 indent/indentation 相关标识符附近；激活并不只落在代码 token 上。

en.description: Activations are most concentrated in for-loop headers in code, with additional instances in Python dotted imports, code parameters, and punctuation. A few peaks fall on unrelated phrases such as upstream/up, Balkan, Asia Pacific, and drone pilot, making them difficult to unify.

patterns.name: upstream/upscale phrases
patterns.context: Occurs in “upstream project” in a business/infrastructure context or in “scale up to large numbers” about scaling up drones; these are not the same fixed phrase.
patterns.domain: Energy business reporting; technology policy discussion

patterns.name: For-loop opening
patterns.context: Near the for keyword and following parentheses/loop header in code; multiple languages and loop variables are represented.

patterns.name: Python module/property dots
patterns.context: Module and property names separated by dots in a Python import path; the same segment also contains class names and response-class code.

patterns.name: Specific regional phrase
patterns.context: A geographical region name in a commercial market description, followed by regional; BP also appears nearby, but the activation peak falls on Pacific.

patterns.name: Balkan proper noun
patterns.context: Balkan Pipeline Talks appears in an energy news headline, alongside other company names and an upstream project in the same segment.

patterns.name: Drone compound
patterns.context: In a discussion of FAA drone licensing and airspace management, drone and pilot form drone pilot licenses.

patterns.name: Goods fragment in a function name
patterns.context: In a JavaScript function definition, the parameter Goods is inside the function parentheses, followed by a loop.

patterns.name: Numeric values/parameters and code punctuation
patterns.context: Numeric arguments in code, texture/buffer API parameters, or values in animation function calls; local markers are scattered without a stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Code-block indentation and output call
patterns.context: Indented code within a loop, immediately followed by a produce call; appears alongside a for loop in the same segment.

4_1843.concept: none
4_1843.description: 激活最集中于代码中的 for 循环头，另有 Python 点号导入、代码参数与标点；少量高峰落在 upstream/up、Balkan、Asia Pacific、drone pilot 等互不相同的词组，难以统一。

patterns.name: upstream／upscale 短语
patterns.context: 出现在商业／基础设施语境的“upstream project”，或无人机规模扩大的“scale up to large numbers”中；不是相同固定短语。
patterns.domain: 能源商业报道；科技政策讨论

patterns.name: for 循环开头
patterns.context: 代码中 for 循环关键字及其紧随的括号／循环头附近；多种语言和循环变量。

patterns.name: Python 模块／属性点号
patterns.context: Python import 路径中，以点号分隔的模块与属性名称；同段也有类名和响应类代码。

patterns.name: 特定地域词组
patterns.context: 商业市场描述中的地理区域名称及其后接 regional；BP 一词也在附近，但激活峰值落在 Pacific。

patterns.name: Balkan 专名
patterns.context: 能源新闻标题中出现 Balkan Pipeline Talks；与同段其他公司名及 upstream 项目并存。

patterns.name: drone 复合词
patterns.context: FAA 无人机许可及空域管理讨论中，drone 与 pilot 构成 drone pilot licenses。

patterns.name: Goods 函数名片段
patterns.context: JavaScript 函数定义中，参数名 Goods 位于函数括号内，后续进入循环。

patterns.name: 数值／参数与代码标点
patterns.context: 代码中的数字参数、纹理／缓冲区 API 参数或动画函数调用数值；局部标记分散，未形成稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 代码块缩进与输出调用
patterns.context: 循环体内缩进代码，紧接 produce 调用；与同段 for 循环同时出现。

en.concept: Occupying (take up) and several intraword fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to “take up” meaning to occupy space, bandwidth, power, or time, especially up; also shows isolated responses to ent, the Italian intraword fragment elt, and the legal collocation “as to what”.

patterns.name: Occupying space or resources
patterns.context: “Take up” means to consume a power allocation, bandwidth, space, cargo capacity, or time; strong activations concentrate on up, across varying collocations and objects of occupancy.
patterns.domain: Patent background, networking and energy descriptions, testing procedures

patterns.name: Non-continent urinary diversion
patterns.context: The ent substring within “noncontinent” is strongly activated in a medical context discussing urinary diversion options after cystectomy.

patterns.name: Italian word-final fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter sequence elt within Italian words; the context is parliamentary transcripts, with no clear connection to other patterns.

patterns.name: Expressions of cause and degree of pain
patterns.context: The fixed phrase “as to what” introduces a disputed explanation of the deceased’s pain and suffering; activation concentrates on to.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in subcontinent
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ent at the end of “subcontinent”, in a context discussing cricket matches and teams returning to the subcontinent; it echoes the same character fragment in the medical passage, but the contexts differ.

4_1843.concept: 占用（take up）及若干词内片段
4_1843.description: 主要响应表示占用空间、带宽、电力或时间的“take up”，尤其是 up；另对 ent、意大利语 elt 词内片段及法律搭配“as to what”有孤立响应。

patterns.name: 占用空间或资源
patterns.trigger: «take»3 «up»10« the»1；«takes» up»10 considerable space；take« up»10« to»3
patterns.context: “take up”表示占用电力额度、带宽、空间、货舱容积或时间；强激活集中在 up，搭配和占用对象各异。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、网络与能源说明、测试流程

patterns.name: 非连续型分流管道
patterns.context: “noncontinent”一词内部的 ent 子串被强烈激活，处在膀胱切除术后尿液分流选项的医学语境中。

patterns.name: 意大利语词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语词中间的 elt 字母串；上下文是议会发言记录，未见与其他模式的明显联系。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语记录

patterns.name: 原因与疼痛程度表述
patterns.context: 固定搭配“as to what”引出关于死者疼痛和痛苦原因的争议说明；激活集中在 to。

patterns.name: subcontinent 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在“subcontinent”末尾的 ent，语境谈板球赛事及球队返回次大陆；与医学段中同样的 ent 字符片段相呼应，但上下文不同。

en.concept: Local structures and fragments in English text
en.description: Activations occur across multiple styles, commonly marking function words and number-hyphen-noun compounds. They also cover local fragments such as take up, legal phrasing, patent citation numbers, and code indices, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Spaces and prepositional connections
patterns.context: Common function words such as prepositions and conjunctions are marked, but their specific trigger positions vary across segments.
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including legal documents, everyday web text, and patent specifications

patterns.name: Numbers and word segments in hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: The number two combines with a hyphen and following noun to form a compound modifier; another example is «two»«-»«thirds».
patterns.domain: Legal and patent technical descriptions; also legislative text

patterns.name: Fixed multiword fragment take up
patterns.context: The phrase refers to using up an electricity allowance in one segment and occupying space in another.

patterns.name: Numbers, identifiers, and punctuation in English text
patterns.context: Numbers and punctuation occur in code data resembling arrays or indices, without natural-language syntax.

patterns.name: Legal causation and degree phrasing
patterns.context: Occurs in a legal sentence about injury, pain, and a jury's determination.

patterns.name: Fundraising and legislative voting language
patterns.context: Concerns funds from private sources, fundraising, and wording about a House resolution passing.

patterns.name: Patent document numbers and citation format
patterns.context: Cites US patent numbers and document formatting in a patent background section.

patterns.name: Patent numbers composed of consecutive digits/letters
patterns.context: European patent numbers are split into multiple numeric and alphabetic fragments.

patterns.name: Array index assignment code
patterns.context: Near variable assignments and row/column index expressions.

patterns.name: Product requirements and invention purpose in patents
patterns.context: Describes the structure of an end-cap assembly, regulatory requirements, and the invention's purpose of reducing costs.

4_1843.concept: 英语文本局部结构与片段
4_1843.description: 激活分布于多种文体，常见标记涉及功能词及数字-连字符-名词复合结构；也覆盖 take up、法律表述、专利引文编号和代码索引等局部片段，未显示单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 空格及介词连接结构
patterns.context: 介词、连词等常见功能词被标记，但不同段落中的具体触发位置不一致。
patterns.domain: 法律、日常网页文本、专利说明书等多种文体

patterns.name: 连字符复合词中的数字与词段
patterns.context: 数字 two 与连字符及后续名词构成复合修饰语；另有«two»«-»«thirds»。
patterns.domain: 法律与专利技术说明；另见立法文本

patterns.name: 固定多词片段 take up
patterns.context: 片段中该短语分别指占用电力额度或占用空间。

patterns.name: 英文文本中的数字、编号与标点
patterns.context: 数字及标点出现在类似数组或索引的代码数据中，缺少自然语言句法。

patterns.name: 法律因果与程度表述
patterns.context: 位于关于伤害、疼痛及陪审团评定的法律句子中。

patterns.name: 筹资与立法表决用语
patterns.context: 涉及私人来源资金、筹款，以及众议院通过决议的表述。

patterns.name: 专利文献编号及引文格式
patterns.context: 专利背景段中引用美国专利号及文献格式。

patterns.name: 连续数字/字母组成的专利编号
patterns.context: 欧洲专利编号被拆分成多个数字和字母片段。

patterns.name: 数组索引赋值代码
patterns.context: 变量赋值及行列索引表达式附近。

patterns.name: 专利中的产品要求和发明目的
patterns.context: 描述端盖组件的结构、监管要求及降低成本的发明目的。

en.description: Activation spans multiple languages, domains, and styles, falling on common words/intraword subwords, hyphenated numbers, and legal layout fields; patent technical terms, sports transfer terms, and informal compounds also appear, without a single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Cross-subword activation on function words or common words
patterns.context: Short common words or intraword subwords are marked in multilingual continuous text; they often occur at tokenization boundaries within longer words, with no unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: English, French, Portuguese, and other narrative and professional texts

patterns.name: Legal document layout fields and numbers
patterns.context: Structured layout fields such as court document headers, case numbers, dates, and page numbers; numbers, punctuation, and spaces also activate.

patterns.name: Hyphenated number combinations
patterns.context: Activation occurs in hyphenated number expressions in case numbers, page numbers, or technical text; their functions and meanings vary.
patterns.domain: Legal documents and patent technical texts

patterns.name: Word-final or morpheme fragments in English compounds
patterns.context: Activation falls on hyphenated compounds, word endings, or concatenated intraword fragments; there is no apparent unified theme.

patterns.name: Patent technical terms and descriptive fragments
patterns.context: Sentences in patent background sections involving electronics, lasers, recording, sensors, or optical devices; markers are scattered across terminology and common linking words.

patterns.name: Intraword subwords in French
patterns.context: In French parliamentary text, marked subwords may occur within complete words and also include common words; no topic-specific semantics are apparent.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Portuguese
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary text, activation is distributed across intraword subwords and common words.

patterns.name: Sports news about player transfers and departures
patterns.context: Discusses players’ summer transfers and a wave of departures from a team; several triggers form a related semantic chain.

patterns.name: Comparisons and quantities in patent sentences
patterns.context: Technical descriptions include quantities and comparisons involving devices, power, or system types; these may overlap with other patterns, so semantic selectivity cannot be confirmed independently.

4_1843.concept: 混合的子词与格式特征
4_1843.description: 激活跨多语言、领域与文体，落在常见词/词内子词、数字连字符及法律版式字段；另见专利技术词、体育转会词和非正式复合词，未呈现单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 虚词或常见词的跨子词激活
patterns.context: 多语言连续文本中，短常见词或词内子词被标记；往往嵌在较长词的分词边界处，缺乏统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 英语、法语、葡萄牙语等叙述及专业文本

patterns.name: 法律文档版式字段及数字
patterns.context: 法院文件页眉、案号、日期、页码等结构化版式字段；数字、标点和空格也有激活。

patterns.name: 数字连字符组合
patterns.context: 激活出现在案号、页码或技术文本的连字符数字表达中；用途和语义不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 法律文书及专利技术文本

patterns.name: 英文复合词中的词尾或词素片段
patterns.context: 激活落在连字符复合词、词尾或拼接的词内片段中；此处没有明显统一主题。

patterns.name: 专利技术术语与描述片段
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中涉及电子、激光、记录、传感器或光学装置的句子；标记分散在术语及常见连接词上。

patterns.name: 法语词形内部子词
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中，标记子词可能位于完整单词内部，也包括常用词；未显示专属议题语义。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会文本中，激活分布在词内子词和常用词上。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡萄牙语议会发言

patterns.name: 体育新闻中的转会离队叙述
patterns.context: 谈及球员夏季转会及球队离队潮，若干触发项组成相关语义链。

patterns.name: 专利语句中的比较及数量表达
patterns.context: 技术说明中出现设备、功率或系统类型的数量和比较表达；可能与其他模式重叠，不能单独确认语义选择性。

en.concept: Hyphenated two-compounds, with intraword fragment responses
en.description: The main pattern is activation on the hyphen in English two-compounds, especially quantity compounds before technical nouns; several isolated intraword fragments also occur in sports, names, Russian verbs, and English word endings, with no unified condition.

patterns.name: Hyphen in compounds
patterns.context: Activation falls on the hyphen in English compound constructions whose first element is two and whose second is a noun or technical term.
patterns.domain: Technical styles such as patents, astrophysics, and optics; passages 2, 4, 8, 9, 10

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in football contexts
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within player names, in contexts involving teams, transfers, or player contracts; however, intensity and position vary.

patterns.name: Language fragment embedded in a word
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final fragment of the geographic term subcontinent, surrounded by cricket match coverage; there is no obvious trigger shared with the other patterns.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in Russian
patterns.context: Activation occurs within the Russian imperative verb “Установите” (install); the context is a technical Q&A about Java and pom.xml.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in English
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the end of the sarcastic phrase usability overlords; there is no clear shared semantic or syntactic condition.

4_1843.concept: two-连字符复合词，兼有词内片段响应
4_1843.description: 主要模式是激活英文 two-连字符复合词中的连字符，尤其是技术名词前的数量复合词；另有若干体育、人名、俄语动词及英语词尾中的孤立词内片段，未见统一条件。

patterns.name: 复合词中的连字符
patterns.context: 激活落在连字符，出现在英语复合词构造中，前项均为 two，后接名词或技术术语。
patterns.domain: 专利、天体物理、光学等技术文体；段2、4、8、9、10

patterns.name: 足球语境中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在球员姓名内部的词片段，且上下文涉及球队、转会或球员合同；但强度与位置并不一致。

patterns.name: 嵌在词中的语言片段
patterns.context: 激活落在地理词 subcontinent 的词尾片段，周围是板球比赛报道；与其他模式没有明显一致的触发条件。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于俄语祈使动词“Установите”（安装）内部；上下文是关于 Java 与 pom.xml 的技术问答。

patterns.name: 英语词内的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活在讽刺性短语 usability overlords 的词尾；没有清楚的共同语义或句法条件。

en.concept: Occupying (take up) and code indentation whitespace
en.description: Primarily responds to the phrase “take up” and the following content denoting occupied space, resources, or time. Examples include equipment taking up space, networks using bandwidth, and tests taking time; there are also activations on indentation whitespace near closing parentheses in two code segments.

patterns.name: “take up” meaning occupying space or resources
patterns.context: The subject is equipment, an object, activity, or process, followed by the occupied quantity, such as space, screen area, bandwidth, or testing time; also includes the weaker “takes up a large portion”.
patterns.domain: Patent background, technical descriptions, forum comments, and popular science articles

patterns.name: Indentation whitespace in code blocks
patterns.context: In JavaScript code or code snippets, a newline and consecutive indentation spaces appear near a closing parenthesis; activation falls on whitespace rather than an obvious semantic word.

patterns.name: Unexplained atypical code marker
patterns.context: A combination of numbers and punctuation in code. Although indentation whitespace is nearby, this specific marker is inconsistent with other trigger forms.

4_1843.concept: 占用（take up）与代码缩进空白
4_1843.description: 主要响应短语“take up”及其后表示被占用的空间、资源或时间的内容，涵盖设备占空间、网络占带宽、测试耗时等；另在两段代码中对闭括号附近的缩进空白激活。

patterns.name: “take up”表示占用空间或资源
patterns.context: 主语是设备、物体、活动或过程，后接空间、屏幕、带宽、测试时间等被占用的量；也包括较弱的“takes up a large portion”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科技说明、论坛评论及科普文章

patterns.name: 代码块中的缩进空白
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码或代码片段中，闭括号附近出现换行和连续缩进空格；激活落在空白而非明显语义词上。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的代码

patterns.name: 未解释的非典型代码标记
patterns.context: 代码中的数字及标点组合，附近虽有缩进空白，但该具体标记与其他触发形式不一致。

en.description: Activations are scattered across JS code closing brackets and indentation, the C. elegans model organism, legal case numbers, container dimensions, the Southern Hemisphere, and Russian intraword fragments, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Code block endings and right-brace indentation
patterns.context: Near the end of functions, objects, or callbacks in code snippets, especially whitespace before right braces and closing symbols; indented spaces also show high activation.

patterns.name: C. elegans species name
patterns.context: In biomedical narrative, C. elegans is used as a model organism; activation falls on organism.

patterns.name: Legal case number field
patterns.context: After a citation, a court case number appears at a page or line break; the strongest point is on the numbered characters in the case number.

patterns.name: Container dimension descriptions
patterns.context: A product description explains that a technology reduces the dimensions of empty containers; high activation concentrates on down.

patterns.name: Southern Hemisphere directional term
patterns.context: Historical discussion of ancient views about the antipodes or southern regions; high activation falls on hemisphere.

patterns.name: Intraword suffix fragment in Russian
patterns.context: Intraword subword fragments are marked in Russian sentences, with stronger activation on commas than on adjacent word fragments; no clear connection to surrounding code patterns.

4_1843.concept: none
4_1843.description: 激活分散：JS代码闭合括号及缩进、C. elegans模式生物、法律案号，以及容器尺寸、南半球和俄语词内片段，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 代码块结束与右花括号缩进
patterns.context: 代码片段中函数、对象或回调结束附近，尤其是右花括号前的空白及闭合符号；也有高激活的缩进空格。

patterns.name: C. elegans 物种名
patterns.context: 生物医学叙述中以 C. elegans 作为模式生物，激活落在 organism。

patterns.name: 法律案号字段
patterns.context: 引文之后换页或换行，出现法院案件编号格式；最强点在案号中的编号字符。

patterns.name: 容器尺寸表述
patterns.context: 产品描述中说明某种技术减少空置容器的尺寸；高激活集中在 down。
patterns.domain: 商业或产品可行性材料

patterns.name: 南半球方位词
patterns.context: 历史论述中谈及古人对对跖地或南方区域的看法；高激活落在 hemisphere。

patterns.name: 俄语词内后缀片段
patterns.context: 俄语句子中词语内部的子词片段被标记，逗号激活强于相邻词片段；与周围代码模式无明显联系。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly at the boundaries of code and structured text, especially line-ending closing symbols, indentation whitespace, and mixed numbers and punctuation; short word fragments such as up and one also appear, along with domain-specific vocabulary concerning drones, electricity costs, vaccines, and the supernatural, which cannot be grouped under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Line-ending closures and indentation in code
patterns.context: In code blocks or structured text, closing brackets, semicolons, or braces occur at the ends of statements/callbacks, often with newlines and whitespace
patterns.domain: StackExchange code; also seen in case number formatting in legal documents

patterns.name: Mixed numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Numbers occur in case numbers, parameters, comparisons, or formatted strings in code

patterns.name: up in English phrases
patterns.context: up functions as a particle in verb phrases, followed by a quantity or object

patterns.name: Word forms related to one
patterns.context: Occurs in drone compounds, English quantity expressions, or code method calls; these uses differ semantically

patterns.name: Specific fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Long identifiers, compounds, or proper names in technical text; no consistent semantic trigger is apparent

patterns.name: Structured key-value and null fields
patterns.context: Repeated field names, colons, and null values in objects or records

patterns.name: Discussion of electricity consumption by appliances
patterns.context: Discusses how device use or activities affect electricity costs/consumption

patterns.name: Vaccine and mucosal adjuvant terminology
patterns.context: Summarizes the development of oral vaccines and experimental research background

patterns.name: Conspiracy theories and supernatural topics
patterns.context: Discusses George, Art Bell, and supernatural or conspiracy theory topics

4_1843.concept: 代码边界与格式片段
4_1843.description: 激活主要聚集在代码及结构化文本的边界处，尤其行尾闭合符号、缩进空白、数字与标点混排；另有 up、one 等短词片段，以及若干领域特定词汇，涵盖无人机、电费、疫苗和超自然话题，无法归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 代码中的行尾闭合与缩进
patterns.context: 代码块或结构化文本中，闭合括号、分号或花括号出现在语句/回调末尾，常伴随换行和空白
patterns.domain: StackExchange 程序代码；也见于法律文书中的案号格式

patterns.name: 数值与标点混排
patterns.context: 数字处于案号、参数、比较表达式或代码中的格式化串中

patterns.name: 英语短语中的 up
patterns.context: 动词短语中 up 作小品词，后接数量或宾语

patterns.name: one 相关词形
patterns.context: 出现在无人机复合词、英文数量表达或代码方法调用中；这些用法语义并不相同

patterns.name: 技术词中的特定片段
patterns.context: 技术文本中的长标识符、复合词或专名；没有明显一致的语义触发条件

patterns.name: 结构化键值与空值字段
patterns.context: 对象或记录中重复排列的字段名、冒号和 null 值

patterns.name: 电器用电量讨论
patterns.context: 讨论设备使用或活动如何影响电费/用电量

patterns.name: 疫苗与黏膜佐剂术语
patterns.context: 概述口服疫苗开发及实验研究背景

patterns.name: 阴谋论与超自然话题
patterns.context: 谈论 George、Art Bell 及超自然或阴谋论话题

en.description: Activation does not form a single semantic pattern: it includes the technical use of scale up, trailing indentation and punctuation in code snippets, Swedish word fragments, legal citations and case numbers, and intraword fragments in papers involving here, scales, and medical terminology.

patterns.name: up / up to expressions of scale
patterns.context: In English contexts, especially discussions of scaling capacity or systems, up follows scale or forms part of scale up; the trigger falls on up.

patterns.name: Trailing whitespace or indentation in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript and other code snippets, newlines and indentation whitespace after right parentheses, braces, or semicolons show strong activation; no particular code logic is required.

patterns.name: Swedish word forms and inflectional fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on fragments within Swedish words or at word boundaries (e.g., svar, var), rather than on an obvious syntactic or semantic structure.

patterns.name: Legal citations and case number formatting
patterns.context: Activation occurs in legal document formatting, including citations, years, parentheses, and court case numbers; the strongest point falls on “1” in a case number.

patterns.name: Use of scales in academic papers
patterns.context: In academic papers discussing research methods or measurement scales, activation occurs near the word scales and what follows; it may have only a morphological connection to scale up in HackerNews.

patterns.name: here in academic style
patterns.context: In formal commentary or academic discussion, here occurs in expressions referring to the article being presented.

patterns.name: Date picker callback code
patterns.context: JavaScript/jQuery date picker and callback code snippets; activation includes parameters, punctuation, and whitespace at callback endings, and is difficult to attribute to a single API token.

patterns.name: Screen width condition code
patterns.context: JavaScript code that reads window or document width and branches on a threshold; activation is mainly on width variables, punctuation, and indentation.

patterns.name: here in research purpose statements
patterns.context: Medical abstracts introduce the current study in a formal academic style; activation falls on here, similar to its academic demonstrative use in [7].

patterns.name: Intraword fragments
patterns.context: Intraword subword fragments in chemical names and words such as carcinogen in medical abstracts are activated; no stable connection to other patterns is currently apparent.

4_1843.concept: none
4_1843.description: 激活并非单一语义模式：包括 scale up 的技术用法、代码片段末尾缩进与标点、瑞典语词片段、法律引文案号，以及论文中的 here、量表和医学术语词内片段。

patterns.name: up / up to 规模表达
patterns.context: 英文语境中，尤其是讨论扩展规模、能力或系统时，up 紧接 scale 或组成 scale up；触发落在 up 上。

patterns.name: 代码行尾空白或缩进
patterns.context: JavaScript 等代码片段中，右括号、花括号或分号后的换行与缩进空白获得强激活；不要求特定代码逻辑。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形与分词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在瑞典语词内或词边界的片段（如 svar、var），而非明显的句法或语义结构。

patterns.name: 法律引文与案号格式
patterns.trigger: “(Fed. Cir.↵2004) cert. denied, 546 U.S. 826 (2005) (citation omitted)”以及“Case 1:16-cv-01230-”
patterns.context: 引文、年份、括号及法院案号等法律文书格式中出现激活，强点落在案号中的 “1”。

patterns.name: 论文中的 scales 用语
patterns.context: 学术论文叙述研究方法或量表时，scales 一词及其后续内容附近有激活；与 HackerNews 的 scale up 可能仅有词形联系。

patterns.name: 学术文体中的 here
patterns.context: 正式评论或学术论述中，here 出现在指称当前呈现文章的表达里。

patterns.name: 日期选择器回调代码
patterns.context: JavaScript/jQuery 日期选择器及回调代码片段；激活包含参数、标点和回调结束处空白，难以归结为单一 API token。

patterns.name: 屏幕宽度条件代码
patterns.context: JavaScript 中读取窗口或文档宽度并按阈值分支的代码；激活主要在宽度变量、标点和缩进处。

patterns.name: here 与研究目的陈述
patterns.context: 医学摘要以正式论文语气介绍当前研究；激活落在 here，和 [7] 的学术指示用法相似。

patterns.name: 词内切分片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中化学物质名和 carcinogen 等词的内部子词片段受到激活，暂看不出与其他模式的稳定联系。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code, SQL, aviation, toxicology, supernatural topics, commercial copy, and vaccine abstracts; no stable cross-domain semantic trigger is apparent. Some code snippets share a technical Q&A context, but their triggers differ.

patterns.name: Width variables and boundary checks in JavaScript
patterns.context: Assigns and compares browser-window or document width, then branches at a threshold; followed by window event code at the end of the segment.

patterns.name: SQL queries and table joins
patterns.context: Selects projected columns, aliases, tables, and join conditions, involving relational data such as players/products.

patterns.name: Drone regulation and airspace operations
patterns.context: Discusses drone pilot licenses, coordination with existing air traffic control, and restrictions on large-scale operations.

patterns.name: Occupational exposure and toxicology research
patterns.context: Introduces exposure to MDA in manufacturing environments and assesses internal dose and toxicity risks.

patterns.name: Supernatural, UFO, and conspiracy topics
patterns.context: A podcast or talk-show introduction describes the supernatural and conspiracy topics discussed by its hosts.

patterns.name: JavaScript objects, constructors, and options
patterns.context: Shows a constructor initializing options and votes, and discusses copying options rather than updating votes.

patterns.name: Null fields in a user profile object
patterns.context: An object literal lists user profile fields initialized with null, followed by Q&A content.

patterns.name: Cost and size of collapsible containers
patterns.context: Marketing or feasibility copy compares empty container sizes and resulting cost savings.

patterns.name: Oral vaccines and mucosal adjuvants
patterns.context: Discusses adjuvant availability in oral vaccine development and introduces related experiments.

4_1843.concept: none
4_1843.description: 激活分散于代码、SQL、航空、毒理、超自然话题、商业文案和疫苗摘要；未见跨领域稳定的语义触发。部分代码片段共享技术问答语境，但触发内容各异。

patterns.name: JavaScript 中的宽度变量及边界判断
patterns.context: 浏览器窗口或文档宽度赋值、比较并按阈值分支；片段末尾接着 window 事件代码。

patterns.name: SQL 查询与表连接
patterns.context: 查询投影列、别名、表及连接条件，涉及玩家/产品等关系型数据。

patterns.name: 无人机监管与空域运行
patterns.context: 讨论无人机驾驶执照、与现有空管协调及规模化运行限制。

patterns.name: 职业暴露与毒理研究
patterns.context: 介绍生产环境中接触 MDA 的情况，并评估内剂量与毒性风险。

patterns.name: 超自然、UFO 与阴谋话题
patterns.context: 播客或谈话节目介绍主持人讨论的超自然及阴谋论主题。

patterns.name: JavaScript 对象、构造函数与选项
patterns.context: 展示构造函数初始化选项和票数，并讨论复制选项而非更新投票。

patterns.name: 用户资料对象中的空值字段
patterns.context: 对象字面量列出用户资料字段并以 null 初始化，后续接问答内容。

patterns.name: 可折叠容器的成本与尺寸
patterns.context: 营销或可行性说明比较空容器尺寸及其带来的成本节省。

patterns.name: 口服疫苗与黏膜佐剂
patterns.context: 讨论口服疫苗开发中的佐剂可用性，并介绍相关实验。

en.description: Activation is scattered across code indentation, newlines, and block/statement boundaries, and also appears on “here” in medical abstracts, “up” in medical titles, and “down” in commercial copy; there is currently no unified meaning, though code boundaries are the clearest pattern.

patterns.name: Code statement boundaries and indentation whitespace
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of code lines, blocks, or statements, often with indentation, semicolons, parentheses, or braces
patterns.domain: JavaScript, Java, and other code in StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Object fields and initialization punctuation
patterns.context: In object or configuration structures, a field name is followed by a colon and value, or the object is closed

patterns.name: Segmented medical abstract narrative
patterns.context: Sentences in research abstracts introducing the purpose, experiment, or subject of the study, often using phrasing such as “presented here”

patterns.name: Sentence-final/paragraph-transition context in research abstracts
patterns.context: Discusses normal synaptic function in development; this high activation occurs near the end of a sentence and does not show a medical vocabulary pattern consistent with other high-activation triggers

patterns.name: Action phrases in commercial copy
patterns.context: Occurs in a phrase describing product technology that reduces the dimensions of empty containers
patterns.domain: Pile-CC business or product marketing text

patterns.name: Phrase at the end of a title
patterns.context: Occurs within the phrase “Long term follow up...” in a title, rather than in ordinary body text

4_1843.concept: 代码边界与空白
4_1843.description: 激活分散于代码的缩进、换行及块/语句边界，也见于医学摘要的“here”、医学标题的“up”和商业文案的“down”；目前没有统一词义，代码边界模式最明显。

patterns.name: 代码语句边界与缩进空白
patterns.trigger: 行末或块末的空格、换行及闭合符号，如 « »10、«↵»3、«}»3
patterns.context: 处于代码行、块或语句的结束位置，常伴随缩进、分号、括号或大括号
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的 JavaScript、Java 等代码

patterns.name: 对象字段与初始化标点
patterns.context: 对象或配置结构中，字段名后跟冒号和值，或对象闭合
patterns.domain: StackExchange 中的 JavaScript/JSON 风格代码

patterns.name: 分块的医学摘要叙述
patterns.context: 研究摘要中介绍研究目的、实验或研究内容的句子，常见于“presented here”一类表述
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 研究摘要中的句末/段落承接
patterns.context: 讨论发育正常的突触功能；该高激活落在句子末尾附近，未显现出与其他高激活触发词一致的医学词汇模式

patterns.name: 商业文案中的动作短语
patterns.context: 出现在描述产品技术降低空容器尺寸的短语中
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 商业或产品宣传文本

patterns.name: 标题末尾的短语
patterns.context: 出现在标题“Long term follow up...”的短语内部，而非普通正文句子

en.description: Activation occurs mainly around code structure boundaries, identifiers, and structured fields; it also covers color styling, C array access, file statistics output, and specific wording in clinical reports and patents, with no single semantic explanation for all examples.

patterns.name: Code brackets or structure closures
patterns.context: Activation often falls near line endings, block boundaries, or structural closures in code snippets; it is not tied to a specific language and is not necessarily triggered by a single punctuation mark.

patterns.name: Structured data and markup syntax
patterns.context: Structured labels in tables/clinical reports, or attributes and fields in HTML, templates, and configuration-style syntax; activation is often near field boundaries, attribute values, or formatting markers.
patterns.domain: Clinical papers, frontend and template code

patterns.name: Code identifiers and API names
patterns.context: Camel-case identifiers, functions, or type names in code; highlighting often appears near names, but languages and uses vary.
patterns.domain: JavaScript/React, Go, and other code Q&A

patterns.name: Color and appearance descriptions
patterns.context: Words for colors, styles, or visual effects; these appear both in code properties and in ordinary English patent narratives.
patterns.domain: Frontend styling, application data, lighting patents

patterns.name: C pointer array element formatting
patterns.context: Shows or compares C code accessing and printing array elements through pointers.

patterns.name: File and count variable output
patterns.context: Program closes a file and outputs a count or maximum value; activation is near formatted output and variables.

patterns.name: Spatial wording in patents
patterns.context: Describes an independent lighting fixture occupying residential space and its drawbacks.

patterns.name: Clinical sample and follow-up statistics
patterns.context: Sample composition, baseline characteristics, and follow-up results in a clinical research report.

4_1843.concept: 代码与结构化文本边界
4_1843.description: 激活主要出现在代码结构边界、标识符和结构化字段附近；也涵盖颜色样式、C 数组访问、文件统计输出，以及临床报告和专利中的具体措辞，未见单一语义能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 代码括号或结构闭合处
patterns.trigger: `}、»、» 以及代码末尾的空白/换行（如 [2]「},」「}」、[4]「class ProductList extends React.Component {」、[5]「//7, 6, 9」、[6]「main()」、[10]「」
patterns.context: 激活常落在代码片段的行尾、块边界或结构闭合附近；并非固定某种语言，也未必只由单一标点触发。

patterns.name: 结构化数据与标记语法
patterns.context: 表格/临床报告中的结构标签，或 HTML、模板、配置式语法中的属性和字段；激活常邻近字段边界、属性值或格式标记。
patterns.domain: 临床论文、前端及模板代码

patterns.name: 代码标识符与 API 名称
patterns.context: 代码中的驼峰式标识符、函数或类型名称；高亮多出现在名称附近，但各例语言与用途不同。

patterns.name: 颜色与外观描述
patterns.trigger: 「font color」「color: red」「background-color: yellow」「favoriteColor」「favorite lighting effects」「color changing」
patterns.context: 颜色、样式或视觉效果词语；既有代码属性，也有普通英语专利叙述。
patterns.domain: 前端样式、应用数据、照明专利

patterns.name: C 指针数组元素格式
patterns.context: 展示或比较 C 代码对指针所指数组元素的访问及打印。

patterns.name: 文件与计数变量输出
patterns.context: 程序关闭文件并输出计数或最大值，激活靠近格式化输出及变量。

patterns.name: 专利中的空间措辞
patterns.context: 描述独立照明装置占用住宅空间及其缺点。

patterns.name: 临床样本与随访统计
patterns.context: 临床研究报告中的样本构成、基线特征和随访结果。

en.concept: Local features of up and numeric formatting/phrases
en.description: The most prominent clues are up (often in take up and follow up) and the number 2; scattered patterns also include page numbers, case numbers, research table statistics, game-related words, and patent terminology, without a single semantic pattern across corpora.

patterns.name: Fixed collocations with “up”
patterns.context: up is part of a phrasal verb, following take or used in the noun collocation follow up; activation falls on up.
patterns.domain: Forums, patents, emails, and other corpora

patterns.name: Number 2
patterns.context: Occurs in different numeric formats, including Division 2, table numbers, page numbers, dates, and patent publication numbers.
patterns.domain: Sports reporting, medical papers, legal documents, patent text

patterns.name: Follow-up expressions
patterns.context: follow up means subsequent follow-up; additionally, “next term” and “three more seasons” in passage 1 express future timing, but do not have the same marker.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, business emails, sports reporting

patterns.name: Page numbers and legal document formatting
patterns.context: Page numbers and nearby line breaks, headers/footers, and litigation record formatting.

patterns.name: Table references and statistical results
patterns.context: Medical paper contexts involving study samples, baseline characteristics, and analysis results.

patterns.name: Game-related words
patterns.context: Refers separately to sports matches and recreational games; the meanings differ from other highlighted patterns.

patterns.name: Number fragments in legal records
patterns.context: Case number or layout number fragments in court documents, appearing near page breaks.

patterns.name: General terms in patent text
patterns.context: Patent specifications describing devices, structures, or constructions; there is no evidence that these words form a unified trigger.

patterns.name: Scattered words and phrases
patterns.context: These words occur in their respective sentences, but have little apparent shared meaning or stable contextual conditions.
patterns.domain: Forums, medical papers, and various texts

4_1843.concept: up 与数字格式/短语的局部特征
4_1843.description: 激活最突出的线索是 up（常见于 take up、follow up）及数字 2；另有页码、案号、论文表格统计、游戏词和专利术语等零散模式，跨语料未形成单一语义。

patterns.name: 固定搭配“up”
patterns.trigger: «up»9/10，分别出现在 “take up” 与 “follows up”
patterns.context: up 是短语动词的一部分，前接 take、follow 或使用 follow up 名词搭配；激活落在 up 上。
patterns.domain: 论坛、专利、邮件及其他语料

patterns.name: 数字 2
patterns.context: 出现在 Division 2、表格编号、页码、日期或专利文献编号等不同数字格式中。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、医学论文、法律文书、专利文本

patterns.name: 后续／随访表达
patterns.context: follow up 表示后续跟进或随访；此外第1段的 “next term”“three more seasons” 也含后续时间表达，但没有相同标记。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、商业邮件、体育报道

patterns.name: 页码与法律文书格式
patterns.context: 页码及其附近的换行、页眉页脚和诉讼记录格式。

patterns.name: 表格引用与统计结果
patterns.context: 研究样本、基线特征和分析结果的医学论文语境。

patterns.name: 游戏相关词
patterns.context: 分别指体育比赛和休闲游戏；语义与其他高亮模式不一致。

patterns.name: 法律记录中的编号碎片
patterns.context: 法院文书的案号或版面编号碎片，出现在分页符附近。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的通用术语
patterns.context: 专利说明书描述设备、结构或构造；没有证据表明这些词构成统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 零散词项与短语
patterns.context: 这些词在各自句子中出现，但彼此缺少明显共同语义或稳定上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛、医学论文及多种文本

en.concept: Common phrase fragments and formatting markers
en.description: The clearest pattern is the phrasal verb take up, especially meaning to occupy space or a screen; Here you go also repeatedly activates strongly in emails. There are also sporadic activations on numbers, proper nouns, and code whitespace, with unclear relationships.

patterns.name: Phrasal verb take up (occupy/use up)
patterns.context: take up is followed by space, screen, or another object being occupied; also includes the unusual usage “take up the kva”.
patterns.domain: Patents, home descriptions, forum comments, and web text

patterns.name: Go in emails
patterns.context: In email body text, Here you go introduces a file or content being provided.

patterns.name: Numbers and formatting markers
patterns.context: Structured numeric text such as legal document page numbers/case numbers and email dates/times; it is unclear whether they share a trigger condition.

patterns.name: Marked technical terms or proper nouns
patterns.context: Strong activations occur around proper nouns or group labels, but trigger positions are scattered and lack an obvious shared local pattern.

patterns.name: Spaces in code
patterns.context: In an HTML/CSS example, strong activation falls on a space marker after code, possibly related to whitespace or code formatting.

4_1843.concept: 常见短语片段与格式标记
4_1843.description: 最清楚的模式是短语动词 take up，尤其表示占用空间或屏幕；邮件中 Here you go 也反复强烈激活。另有数字、专名及代码空格处的零散激活，彼此关联不明。

patterns.name: 短语动词 take up（占用/耗费）
patterns.context: take up 后接 space、screen 等表示被占用的对象；也有“take up the kva”这一异常用法。
patterns.domain: 专利、家居描述、论坛评论及网络文本

patterns.name: 邮件中的 go
patterns.context: 邮件正文中以 Here you go 引出所提供的文件或内容。

patterns.name: 数字与格式标记
patterns.context: 法律文书页码/案号与电子邮件日期时间等结构化数字文本；是否由同一触发条件导致不确定。

patterns.name: 带标记的技术或专名
patterns.context: 专名或分组标签周围出现较强激活，但触发位置分散，缺少共同的明显局部模式。

patterns.name: 代码中的空格
patterns.context: HTML/CSS 示例中，较强激活落在代码后的空格标记，可能与空白或代码格式有关。

en.description: The clearest pattern is the phrase “take(s) up” meaning to occupy space; there is also activation on numbers and punctuation in legal citations and case number formatting, as well as scattered activation near stock academic phrasing in medical abstracts.

patterns.name: Occupying space
patterns.context: “Take/takes up” means that something occupies space or screen area; up is the most stable trigger, across different domains and sentence forms

patterns.name: Legal citations and case number formatting
patterns.context: Sequences of numbers and punctuation in legal judgment citations, case numbers, or litigation document layout

patterns.name: Generic academic words in medical research text
patterns.context: Stock academic phrasing about research aims, experiments, or study design in medical abstracts; activation is scattered near these phrases, with no stable single trigger word apparent

4_1843.concept: 占用空间与文本格式线索
4_1843.description: 最明确的模式是短语“take(s) up”表示占用空间；另有法律引文与案号格式中的数字、标点激活，以及医学摘要研究套语附近的零散激活。

patterns.name: 占用空间
patterns.trigger: “takes up”后接“space”“considerable space”“a significant volume of cargo space”“half the screen”等
patterns.context: “take/takes up”表示某物占据空间或屏幕区域；触发最稳定的是 up，也见于不同领域和句式

patterns.name: 法律引文及案号格式
patterns.trigger: “2004)”“denied,”“Case 1:16-cv-01230”等数字、标点和法律文书格式 token
patterns.context: 法律判决引文、案号或诉讼文本排版中出现的数字及标点序列

patterns.name: 医学研究文本的泛化学术词
patterns.trigger: “presented here”“The aim of the study”“experiments presented here”“pharmacokinetic study”等
patterns.context: 医学摘要中研究目的、实验或研究设计的学术套语；当前激活分散在套语附近，未见稳定的单一触发词

en.concept: Mixed local morphological and phrase features
en.description: Strong activations concentrate on “take up” in resource-occupancy contexts, and also occur in “all the time,” Swedish word endings, legal citation numbers, and indentation in structured text; the latter categories have no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: “take up” meaning occupying space or resources
patterns.context: In the phrase “take up,” describes equipment, shipping containers, activities, or broadcasting occupying space, capacity, or resources; in [7], the object is kva in an electricity bill, an unusual meaning.
patterns.domain: Patent background, technical descriptions, general descriptions

patterns.name: Time in “all the time”
patterns.context: Occurs in “all the time,” meaning that something happens continuously or remains true; one instance is in casual chat, another in a remote-work discussion.

patterns.name: Swedish word endings and “ändringar”
patterns.context: A subword fragment in continuous Swedish text; strong activation falls near word endings or subword boundaries.

patterns.name: Number 1 in a legal citation
patterns.context: Occurs in the legal case citation “Syllabus Point 1,” with a comma following the number.

patterns.name: Indentation whitespace
patterns.context: A large span of spaces after a field in structured text provides indentation, followed by a closing brace.

4_1843.concept: 混合的局部词形与短语特征
4_1843.description: 强激活集中于“take up”及资源占用语境，也出现在“all the time”、瑞典语词尾、法律引文数字和结构化文本缩进中；后几类缺少明显共同语义。

patterns.name: “take up”表示占用空间或资源
patterns.context: 在“take up”短语中，描述设备、运输箱、活动或广播占用空间、容量或资源；[7]的对象是电费中的 kva，语义略不寻常。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、技术说明、一般说明

patterns.name: “all the time”中的 time
patterns.context: 出现在“all the time”中，表示某事持续发生或一直如此；一处是口语聊天，一处是远程工作讨论。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾与“ändringar”
patterns.context: 瑞典语连续文本中的词内片段；高激活落在词尾或分词边界附近。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的编号 1
patterns.context: 出现在法律判例引文“Syllabus Point 1,”中，数字后接逗号。

patterns.name: 缩进空白
patterns.context: 结构化文本中，字段结束后的大段空格用于缩进，随后接闭合花括号。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 风格的代码或数据片段

en.description: All passages activate on “organisms” and are noun phrases in a life-science context; the preceding modifiers and specific topics vary.

patterns.name: organisms and its complex noun phrases
patterns.context: The word appears after various modifiers or determiners, often at the end of a noun phrase in scientific statements; it is sometimes preceded by “fungal,” “higher-order,” “vertebrate,” etc.
patterns.domain: Life-science papers, abstracts, and grant text

4_2183.description: 所有段都在“organisms”上有激活，且均处于生命科学语境中的名词短语；前置修饰语和具体主题各不相同。

patterns.name: organisms 及其复杂名词短语
patterns.context: 该词出现在多种修饰语或限定词之后，常位于科学陈述中的名词短语末尾；有时前面是“fungal”“higher-order”“vertebrate”等
patterns.domain: 生命科学论文、摘要和基金文本

en.description: All fragments show strong activation at “organisms,” spanning multiple types of biomedical and life sciences texts; the specific organisms, topics, and syntactic contexts vary.

patterns.name: Biological noun “organisms”
patterns.context: The word appears in scientific texts, often referring to fungi, bacteria, mammals, or other living things; no particular syntactic position or organism category is required.
patterns.domain: Academic texts in biomedicine, microbiology, genetics, environmental science, and related fields

4_2183.description: 所有片段均在“organisms”处出现强激活，涵盖多类生物医学和生命科学文本；具体生物、主题与句法环境各异。

patterns.name: 生物学名词“organisms”
patterns.context: 该词出现在科学文本中，常指真菌、细菌、哺乳动物或其他生物；不要求特定句法位置或具体生物类别。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、微生物学、遗传学及环境科学等学术文本

en.description: The strong pattern is the ending of organisms, concentrated on occurrences of this plural noun across diverse biomedical contexts; other passages also concern fungi or organisms, but the trigger is not always clear, and some activations cannot be explained by a shared term.

patterns.name: Organism suffix
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the ending of the full word organisms, especially at sentence end or before a comma; the word is often modified by a determiner or adjective.
patterns.domain: Academic texts in biomedicine, genetics, ecology, and related fields

patterns.name: Fungus-related endings
patterns.context: Fungi appear as organisms or research subjects; passage 1 activates strongly on organisms, while passages 3 and 7 involve fungus-related contexts without the same trigger being marked.

patterns.name: Biological root within a word
patterns.context: The singular organism appears in descriptions of microbes or simple fermenting organisms; the word is unmarked in passage 4, so the activation evidence is weak.

patterns.name: Potential plural-noun semantics
patterns.context: The term covers different categories such as higher-order, vertebrate, mammalian, and periodontal-associated; the commonality is the noun for an organism, not a particular group or topic.

4_2183.description: 强模式是 organisms 的词尾，集中于该复数名词在多种生物医学语境中的出现；其余段落也涉及真菌或生物体，但触发并不总是明确，部分激活无法由共同词项解释。

patterns.name: 生物体后缀
patterns.context: 激活集中在完整单词 organisms 的词尾，尤其是句末或逗号前；该词常由限定词或形容词修饰。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、遗传学、生态学等学术文本

patterns.name: 真菌相关词尾
patterns.context: 真菌作为生物体或研究对象出现；第1段强烈激活在 organisms，第3、7段出现 fungus 相关语境但并未标出同一触发词。
patterns.domain: 真菌学、微生物与宿主相互作用

patterns.name: 词内生物词根
patterns.context: 单数 organism 出现在对微生物或简单发酵生物体的描述中；第4段该词未标记，激活证据较弱。

patterns.name: 潜在的复数名词语义
patterns.context: 该词涵盖 higher-order、vertebrate、mammalian、periodontal-associated 等不同类别；共同点是生物体名词，而非特定类群或主题。

en.description: Most passages show strong activation on the final s in organisms across biomedical, neuroscience, patent, and agricultural contexts; a few fungal words also activate weakly. The strong activations on January and Mem cannot be explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: final letter of organisms
patterns.context: The complete word organisms begins with an unmarked space, and its final s is marked as highly activating; it appears in noun phrases or sentences and may have various preceding modifiers.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, neuroscience, patent, and agricultural texts

patterns.name: fungus-related word forms
patterns.context: Fungal or fungus appears in fungus-related sentences; the strongest activation remains on the final letter of organisms, while fungus itself also activates more weakly.

patterns.name: Other non-organism word forms or fragments
patterns.context: These occur respectively in a month name in a date and in an internal fragment of a tumor name; neither the word form nor the context matches organisms, and no shared trigger can be confirmed.

4_2183.description: 多数段落在 organisms 的词尾 s 处强激活，跨生物医学、神经科学、专利和农业语境；少数真菌词也弱激活。January 与 Mem 的强激活无法与主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: organisms 的词尾
patterns.context: 完整单词 organisms 以未标记的空格开头、末尾 s 标记为高激活；出现在名词短语或句子中，且前面可有多种修饰语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、神经科学、专利及农业文本

patterns.name: 真菌相关词形
patterns.context: 真菌相关句子中出现 fungal 或 fungus；最高激活仍落在 organisms 的词尾，而 fungus 本身也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 其他非 organism 词形或片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在日期中的月份名和肿瘤名称内部片段；与 organisms 词形及语境均不相同，缺乏可确认的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论文日期；医学肿瘤名称

en.description: Activation appears across diverse surface formats: English subword fragments, numeric identifiers in citations or titles, and month names in dates. There is no single clear semantic theme; identifiers and numeric forms occur in more passages, but the specific trigger mechanism remains uncertain.

patterns.name: Numeral or letter fragments at the beginning or within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on parts of English words or short function words; visible contexts involve groundwater, fungi and drugs, and medical procedures, but share no consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Numbers in reference identifiers or legal citations
patterns.context: Numbers occur in citations, mathematical expressions, or numbered titles; the identifier formats and following text vary.
patterns.domain: Legal, mathematical, parliamentary, and article-title text

patterns.name: Months in dates
patterns.context: A month appears in an article’s online publication date, followed by the day and year.

4_2183.concept: 多样格式中的局部片段
4_2183.description: 激活分布在多种表面格式中：英文词片段、引文或标题里的数字编号，以及日期月份。没有单一明确语义主题；编号/数字形式覆盖较多段，但具体触发机制仍不确定。

patterns.name: 词首或词内的数字/字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词的组成部分或短功能词上；可见上下文涉及地下水、真菌与药物、医疗操作，但没有一致的语义主题。

patterns.name: 文献编号或法律引文中的数字
patterns.context: 数字位于引文、数学式或编号标题中；编号形式和其后的文本各异。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、数学文本、议会文本及论文标题

patterns.name: 日期中的月份
patterns.context: 月份出现在论文在线发表日期中，后接日期与年份。

en.description: All snippets contain the Introduction heading, section marker, and equals-sign divider used in PMC papers; after the divider is the opening body text of introductions from papers in various fields. Specific topics and trigger words vary, with no consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Paper introduction heading and divider
patterns.context: The beginning of a PMC paper introduction, with a section marker and equals-sign divider after the heading; present in every passage, though passage 1 uses a slightly different form of section marker.

patterns.name: Field-specific terms or topic openings in introductions
patterns.context: The opening body text after the divider; different papers discuss topics such as anemia, hormones, obesity, mental illness, aquaporins, and praying mantises, with no shared lexical meaning or domain condition.

patterns.name: General academic phrasing in introduction text
patterns.context: After the divider, the text includes statements of the paper's topic, research methods, or background; trigger words and sentence structures differ.

4_2183.description: 所有片段都含PMC论文的Introduction标题、章节标记及等号分隔线；分隔线后是多领域论文引言的正文开头，具体主题和触发词各异，未见一致的语义主题。

patterns.name: 论文引言章节标题与分隔线
patterns.context: PMC 论文的引言开头，标题后带章节标记及等号分隔线；各段均出现，段1的章节标记形式稍有不同

patterns.name: 引言中的领域术语或主题开头
patterns.context: 分隔线后的引言正文开头；不同文章分别涉及贫血、激素、肥胖、精神疾病、水通道蛋白、螳螂等主题，未见统一的词义或领域条件

patterns.name: 引言正文中的一般学术表达
patterns.trigger: «Translation» of scientific discoveries into practice；«The» construction of a comprehensive phylogenetic；«In»dependent component analysis；«Our» world is facing the pandemic
patterns.context: 分隔线后出现论文主题陈述、研究方法或背景句；触发词和句式彼此不同

en.description: All snippets share the PMC paper Introduction heading and the same divider format. Activations in the body text are scattered across different words and topics, with no consistent semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Paper introduction heading template
patterns.context: Every passage begins with the same PMC document structure: the Introduction heading, a fragment resembling a number or marker, a divider, and a line break; the opening words of the body text vary.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central paper text and its formatting markers

patterns.name: Local word activations in body text
patterns.context: In the opening body-text fragments following the heading template, several different words or subword fragments activate; no stable shared meaning or topic is apparent.
patterns.domain: Cross-topic scientific paper text, including scientific translation, phylogeny, gonadotropins, ICA, obesity, schizophrenia, aquaporins, praying mantises, epidemics, and geometry

4_2183.description: 所有片段共享 PMC 论文 Introduction 标题及相同分隔格式。正文激活分散在不同词语与主题中，未显现一致的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 论文引言标题模板
patterns.context: 每段均以相同的 PMC 文档结构开头：Introduction 标题、类似编号/标记的片段、分隔线和换行；正文开头词各异。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文文本及其格式标记

patterns.name: 正文中的局部词语激活
patterns.context: 标题模板之后的正文起始片段中，若干不同词语或词内子词被激活；未见稳定的共同词义或主题。
patterns.domain: 跨主题科学论文正文；涉及科学转化、系统发育、促性腺激素、ICA、肥胖、精神分裂症、水通道蛋白、螳螂、疫情及几何等

en.concept: mixed features of mathematical symbols and question fragments
en.description: Strong activations cluster around mathematical symbols, numbers, and simplification problems, with scattered activations in questions, English function words, and passages from different fields. Technical Q&A, research abstracts, workplace discussions, and population surveys each contribute sporadic triggers, which cannot be reduced to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Local fragments in numbers and mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in DM Mathematics number puzzles or arithmetic and radical simplification content; triggers are not limited to a single operator or fixed number.

patterns.name: Question or interrogative contexts
patterns.context: Appears in questions or sentences containing a question mark; some math problems, Q&A, and survey texts contain such cues, but they do not explain all mathematical activations.

patterns.name: Connectives and function words in English text
patterns.context: Several common function words and components within phrases are marked in continuous English text; no single fixed word or phrase covers these examples.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, expository text, Q&A, forum text

patterns.name: Code and technical terminology
patterns.context: In a Java object and index question and an explanation of a Linux ioctl call, some words in code or technical Q&A are marked; the trigger words in the two passages do not fully match.

patterns.name: Field-specific word fragments in a research abstract
patterns.context: A few words are marked in the opening of an abstract introducing a solar dynamo model; this does not establish whether the cause is astrophysical semantics or abstract style.

patterns.name: Work experience and comparison of time gaps
patterns.context: Compares two developers' years of work experience and periodic gaps, then asks about their impact.

patterns.name: Family planning survey and demographic factors
patterns.context: Survey-style questions about an Indonesian family planning program, education, and fertility rates.

4_2183.concept: 数学符号与问句片段的混合特征
4_2183.description: 强激活集中于数学符号、数字及化简题，同时散见问句、英文功能词和不同领域语段；技术问答、科研摘要、职场与人口调查各有零散触发，无法归结为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字与数学表达式中的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 DM Mathematics 的数字谜题或算术、根式化简内容中；触发并非只限某一个运算符或固定数字。
patterns.domain: 形式化数学题、符号算式

patterns.name: 提问或疑问语境
patterns.context: 问题句或带问号的句子中出现；部分数学题和问答、调查文本包含这类线索，但不足以解释所有数学激活。

patterns.name: 英文词语间的连接与功能词
patterns.context: 英文连续文本中，若干常见功能词及词组内部成分被标记；未见单一固定词或短语能覆盖这些例子。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、说明文、问答、论坛文本

patterns.name: 代码与技术术语
patterns.context: Java 对象与索引问题、Linux ioctl 调用说明中，代码或技术问答的部分词语被标记；两段触发词并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的领域词片段
patterns.context: 摘要开头介绍太阳发电机模型时，少量词语被标记；无法据此确定是天体物理语义还是摘要文体导致。

patterns.name: 求职经历与时间间隔比较
patterns.context: 比较两位开发者的工作年限及周期性空档，并追问其影响。

patterns.name: 家庭计划调查与人口因素
patterns.context: 围绕印尼家庭计划项目、教育与生育率的调查式问题。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或人口学调查材料

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the Tor string and its subsequent tokens across various fields; they also occur on tan, arithmetic symbols, and delimiters in mathematical formulas. A Q&A passage containing garbled text and a suspected encoded string also triggers multiple locations, for unclear reasons.

patterns.name: Continuation of the Tor string
patterns.context: The word-initial or internal fragment “Tor” is highlighted; subsequent characters may form different words or names due to tokenization.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including software discussions, marketing copy, emails, car repair, and game descriptions

patterns.name: tan in special mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical formulas or LaTeX-style equations containing arctan/tan; passage 9 also highlights formula delimiters and differential symbols.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text, StackExchange math or physics Q&A

patterns.name: Corrupted or abnormally encoded text
patterns.context: After garbled characters or a hash/encoding-like string, multiple tokens in an ordinary question are also highlighted; no clear shared semantic trigger is apparent.
patterns.domain: StackExchange help Q&A with garbled or unusual characters

4_2183.concept: 字符串片段与公式符号触发
4_2183.description: 激活主要落在 Tor 字符串及其后续分词上，跨多种领域；另在数学公式的 tan、算式符号和定界符处激活。一个含乱码与疑似编码串的问答也触发多处，原因不明。

patterns.name: Tor 字符串延续
patterns.context: 词首或词内的片段“Tor”被突出；后续字符因分词而可能继续组成不同单词或名称。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括软件讨论、营销文案、邮件、汽车维修、游戏介绍等

patterns.name: 特殊数学表达式中的 tan
patterns.context: 出现在 arctan/tan 的数学公式或 LaTeX 风格方程中；第9段还突出公式定界符及微分符号。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、StackExchange 数学或物理问答

patterns.name: 损坏或异常编码文本
patterns.context: 字符乱码或类似哈希/编码串之后，普通问句中的多个 token 也被突出；未见清楚的共同语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 求助问答，文本含乱码或异常字符

en.description: The main response is to underscore-separated compound identifiers and member-access structures in code, and activations also commonly appear at syntax boundaries such as parentheses, commas, semicolons, and line breaks. Other instances include HTML row attributes, comments, and natural-language passages about circuits and golf.

patterns.name: Underscore-separated parts of identifiers
patterns.context: Activations often fall near an underscore or on an identifier fragment after it; the fragment is usually part of a compound variable, attribute, or key name in a code statement.
patterns.domain: Multilingual programming code (JavaScript, Python, Swift, PHP, etc.), covering [1][2][3][4][8][9].

patterns.name: Member-access period and adjacent names
patterns.context: In code, the member-access operator next to an object, module, or variable is adjacent to a property or method name; it may co-occur with underscore identifiers.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Code punctuation appears near function calls, arguments, statement endings, or code-block boundaries; activations are not limited to any one punctuation mark.

patterns.name: HTML rows and attribute formatting
patterns.context: Structured text appears in HTML table tags and attribute values; activations fall near row-markup-related content.

patterns.name: Rule explanations in code comments
patterns.context: Comments explain CSS property rules or classifications, with code conditionals nearby.
patterns.domain: Github code comments and CSS-related code, covering [6].

patterns.name: Word fragments in ordinary text
patterns.context: Activations appear in a response's natural-language explanation of a circuit design, rather than in identifiers or code structure.

patterns.name: Words in golf equipment discussions
patterns.context: Discusses golf club performance and differences, with activations scattered across ordinary narrative words.

4_2183.concept: 代码标识符与结构边界
4_2183.description: 主要响应代码中的下划线复合标识符及成员访问结构，也常见于括号、逗号、分号和换行等语法边界；另有 HTML 行属性、注释，以及电路和高尔夫自然语言片段。

patterns.name: 标识符中的下划线分隔部分
patterns.context: 激活常落在下划线附近或下划线后的标识符片段；片段通常是复合变量名、属性名或键名，处于代码语句中。
patterns.domain: 多语言编程代码（JavaScript、Python、Swift、PHP 等），覆盖 [1][2][3][4][8][9]。

patterns.name: 成员访问点号及其邻接名称
patterns.context: 代码中对象、模块或变量后的成员访问符与属性/方法名相邻，可能与下划线标识符同时出现。

patterns.name: 代码标点与结构边界
patterns.context: 代码标点出现在函数调用、参数、语句结束或代码块边界附近；激活并非只限于某一种标点。

patterns.name: HTML 行与属性格式
patterns.context: HTML 表格标签及属性值中出现结构化文本；激活落在行标记相关内容附近。
patterns.domain: HTML 模板/网页代码，覆盖 [9]。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的规则说明
patterns.context: 注释解释 CSS 属性规则或分类，附近仍有代码条件判断。
patterns.domain: Github 代码注释与 CSS 相关代码，覆盖 [6]。

patterns.name: 普通文本中的词语片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在回答中对电路方案的自然语言说明，而非标识符或代码结构。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 电子/电路问答，覆盖 [5]。

patterns.name: 高尔夫器材讨论中的词语
patterns.context: 讨论高尔夫球杆性能及差异，激活散落在普通叙述词语中。

en.description: Activations are distributed across mathematical formulas, numbers and inequalities, database terminology, legal phrasing, personal names and addresses, and forum words; they also include several subwords and sporadic English words. Triggers span domains and occur in scattered locations, making it difficult to reduce them to a single semantic function.

patterns.name: Specific word forms and tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Activations fall on subwords within words, affixes, or word boundaries; however, the words and semantics differ, with no shared contextual condition.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula structure
patterns.context: Occurs in formulas, variables, comparison symbols, or mathematical expressions; activation locations and mathematical topics are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Math Q&A, analysis, and partial differential equation papers

patterns.name: Numbers and comparison/numeric boundaries
patterns.context: Appears adjacent to values, variables, and inequalities; it may also overlap with general formula structure.

patterns.name: Database and relational-schema terminology
patterns.context: Relational database queries or database normal forms/key dependencies appear; activations fall on SQL fields and words in a discussion of 3NF, respectively.

patterns.name: Legal provisions and command phrasing
patterns.context: In a Chapter 13 bankruptcy case, the court orders the trustee to calculate interest.

patterns.name: Personal names, addresses, and mapping examples
patterns.context: Example data maps personal names to name and address records; activations are scattered across personal names and street/address fragments.

patterns.name: Person names and descriptions of artworks
patterns.context: Describes an Indigenous representative, their portrait painter, artwork, and the artist who painted it.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies and art history entries

patterns.name: Reference, contrast, and evaluation in forum dialogue
patterns.context: [6] concerns commentary and evaluative tone; [9] concerns a forum post introducing a catalog of cheat tables. The passages have no clear shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Sporadic English words and formula fragments
patterns.context: These activations are distributed in ordinary text or at formula edges; the few examples do not establish a stable meaning or consistent context.
patterns.domain: Mixed mathematical, legal, and technical texts

4_2183.description: 激活分布于数学公式、数字与不等式、数据库术语、法律措辞、人名地址及论坛词语；还包括若干词内子词和零散英文词。触发条件跨领域且位置分散，难以归结为单一语义功能。

patterns.name: 特定词形与分词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在词内子词、词缀或词边界附近；但各词和语义不一致，缺乏共同上下文条件

patterns.name: 数学符号及公式结构
patterns.context: 处于公式、变量、比较符号或数学表达式中；激活位置和数学主题并不固定
patterns.domain: 数学问答、分析与偏微分方程论文

patterns.name: 数字及比较/数值边界
patterns.context: 数值、变量与不等式相邻时出现；也可能与一般公式结构重叠

patterns.name: 数据库及关系模式术语
patterns.context: 出现关系数据库查询或数据库范式/键依赖术语；激活分别落在 SQL 字段及3NF讲解中的词语
patterns.domain: SQL 编程与数据库教学/讨论

patterns.name: 法律条文及命令措辞
patterns.context: 破产法第13章案件中，法院命令受托人计算利息

patterns.name: 人名、地址及映射示例
patterns.context: 以人名映射到姓名和地址记录的示例数据；激活散布在人名和街道/地址片段
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的示例

patterns.name: 人名与艺术作品记述
patterns.context: 介绍原住民代表及其肖像画家、艺术作品和画作作者
patterns.domain: 百科人物与艺术史条目

patterns.name: 论坛对话中的指代、转折与评价
