patterns.name: 零散英文词与公式残片
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在普通文本或公式边缘，无法从给出的少量例子判定稳定语义或一致上下文
patterns.domain: 混合数学、法律与技术文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across mathematical formulas and nearby text, the name Matt, subword fragments of various English words, and numeric expressions in scientific and engineering texts; there is no stable shared trigger across passages.

patterns.name: “Matt” in fixed expressions
patterns.context: Part of a personal name, appearing in “Matt Tifft” and “John Mattke”; the former is tokenized as «Matt», while the latter is marked within the given name and surname
patterns.domain: Wikipedia articles about a racing figure and a tennis player biography

patterns.name: Ending or internal fragments in English compounds
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of different English words in contexts involving freeze–thaw cycles, software application names, table entries, mathematical terms, and mining terms, with no stable shared meaning
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, StackExchange software questions, tables, mathematical papers, mining reports

patterns.name: Local fragments near mathematical expressions and identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs in formulas, problem subparts, and nearby text; activation is distributed across mathematical symbols, numbers, and surrounding words, unlike the clear lexical triggers in other passages

patterns.name: Local fragments in physical quantities and numerical expressions
patterns.context: One passage discusses cosmic-ray spectrum parameters, while another reports mine elevations and tunnel progress; these sporadic triggers do not reveal a shared physical-quantity pattern

4_2183.description: 激活分散于数学公式及其局部文本、人名 Matt、若干不同英文词的子词片段，以及科学和工程文本中的数值表达；跨段缺少稳定统一的触发条件。

patterns.name: 固定搭配中的 “Matt”
patterns.context: 人名的一部分，出现在 “Matt Tifft” 和 “John Mattke” 中；前者被分词为 «Matt»，后者在名字与姓氏内部被标记
patterns.domain: 赛车维基百科人物报道、网球运动员传记

patterns.name: 英文复合词中的末尾或内部片段
patterns.trigger: “freeze-thaw” 中的 «freeze»；“boot” 中的 «boot»；“abandoned/abandoning” 中的 «abandon”；“polynomial” 中的 «pol»；“stope” 中的 «ope»
patterns.context: 激活落在不同英文词的子词片段上，分别处于冻结循环、软件应用名称、表格词项、数学术语及矿业术语语境，未见稳定共同词义
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、StackExchange 软件问答、表格、数学论文、矿业报告

patterns.name: 数学表达式与编号附近的局部片段
patterns.context: 公式、题目小问及其邻近文本中出现，激活分布在数学符号、数字和周边词语上；与其他段落的明显词汇触发不一致

patterns.name: 物理量与数值表达中的局部片段
patterns.context: 一个段落为宇宙射线谱参数讨论，另一个为矿井标高和巷道进展报告；仅凭这些零散触发看不出共同的物理量模式
patterns.domain: 天体物理论文、矿业进展报告

en.description: The most salient activation cue is freeze/thaw and its cycles, especially in biomedical and drug-storage contexts; other activations are scattered across honeycomb structures, unit values, sports and software names, mathematical terms, and legal words, with no unified pattern.

patterns.name: freeze/thaw compounds
patterns.context: Refers to freezing, thawing, and their cycles, counts, or procedures; it can describe bone experiments or drug storage.

patterns.name: comb in compound words
patterns.context: Activates in compounds such as honeycomb ducts/openings; the context concerns honeycomb structures or filtration channels.

patterns.name: Local strings in proper names or terminology
patterns.context: Activations fall in sports event names and playoff vocabulary, the software name Spring Boot, and the mathematical terms radius/hamming spheres; no shared semantic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Sports biographies, software Q&A, math Q&A

patterns.name: Units and numerical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in material capacity units or quantity statements, activating local subwords/numbers rather than a stable repeated expression.

patterns.name: Large values and repeated counts
patterns.context: Appears in experimental repetition counts or statistical analyses, as well as in general counting statements.

patterns.name: Procedural terms in legal text
patterns.context: Appears in a presentence investigation report; the activation here seems to fall on an internal word fragment.

4_2183.concept: 混合的词形与领域线索
4_2183.description: 激活最突出的线索是 freeze/thaw 及其循环，尤其见于生物医学与药品储存；其余激活分散在蜂窝结构、单位数值、体育与软件专名、数学术语和法律词语中，未形成统一模式。

patterns.name: freeze/thaw 复合词
patterns.context: 表示冷冻、解冻及其循环、次数或操作；可描述骨骼实验或药物储存。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、药品与材料研究

patterns.name: 复合词中的 comb
patterns.context: 在 honeycomb ducts/openings 等构词中被激活；上下文谈及蜂窝结构或过滤通道。

patterns.name: 专名或术语中的局部字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在体育赛事名称及季后赛词汇、软件名称 Spring Boot，以及数学术语 radius/hamming spheres 中；难见共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 体育传记、软件问答、数学问答

patterns.name: 单位与数值表达
patterns.context: 出现在材料容量单位或数量陈述中，激活局部子词/数字，而非稳定的同一表达。

patterns.name: 大数值与重复计数
patterns.context: 在实验重复次数或统计分析中出现；同时有一般计数表述。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的程序词
patterns.context: 出现在 presentence investigation report（量刑前调查报告）中；此处激活似为词内片段。

en.description: Activation appears in diverse technical and specialized texts: wording about sufficient conditions, numerical units, algorithmic terms, and specialized expressions in chemistry, biomaterials, mechanics, law, and stochastic processes. No clear common thread is apparent; the pattern may combine technical terminology with local orthographic triggers.

patterns.name: “not sufficient / sufficient” qualifying language
patterns.context: Appears in technical discussions of conditions, criteria, or logical entailment; the words need not appear together.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, quantum information, function theory; academic writing

patterns.name: Physical quantities and numerical units
patterns.context: Numbers, measurement units, errors, or concentrations in experimental or theoretical accounts.

patterns.name: “Monte Carlo” method
patterns.context: Introduces a computational method or algorithm, particularly for particle methods and optimization.
patterns.domain: Computational mathematics, evolutionary computation; academic writing

patterns.name: Freeze–thaw cycles
patterns.context: Describes changes in bone material properties after repeated freezing and thawing.

patterns.name: “okadaic acid” chemical name
patterns.context: Discusses phosphatases insensitive to a drug or acid and asks about their correspondence.

patterns.name: Device structure and assembly actions
patterns.context: Describes a slider, deformation location, and a mechanical operation in which a housing disengages from a mating housing.

patterns.name: Claims and alternative statements in litigation
patterns.context: Discusses whether a claim may proceed and how a party cites precedent in support of an alternative statement.
patterns.domain: Legal opinions or court decisions; legal writing

patterns.name: Random-reset experiment terminology
patterns.context: Compares constant-speed and constant-return-time experiments, then introduces a random-reset case with instantaneous return.
patterns.domain: Stochastic processes and experimental physics; academic writing

4_2183.description: 激活分布于多种技术与专业文本：条件充分性措辞、数值单位、算法术语，以及化学、生物材料、机械、法律和随机过程专用表达。共同线索不明显，可能兼具技术术语与局部词形触发。

patterns.name: “not sufficient / sufficient”判定措辞
patterns.context: 出现在描述条件、标准或逻辑蕴含关系的技术论述中；词不必都同时出现。
patterns.domain: 数学、量子信息、函数理论；学术文体

patterns.name: 物理量与数值单位
patterns.context: 实验或理论叙述中出现数值、测量单位、误差或浓度。
patterns.domain: 物理、生物医学；学术文体

patterns.name: “Monte Carlo”方法
patterns.context: 介绍计算方法或算法，特别是粒子方法及优化用途。
patterns.domain: 计算数学、演化计算；学术文体

patterns.name: 冷冻—解冻循环
patterns.context: 描述骨材料经多次冷冻和解冻后的性质变化。
patterns.domain: 生物医学材料研究；学术文体

patterns.name: 化学物质名称中的“okadaic acid”
patterns.context: 讨论对药物或酸不敏感的磷酸酶，并询问其对应关系。
patterns.domain: 生物化学研究；学术文体

patterns.name: 器件结构与装配动作
patterns.context: 描述滑块、变形位置以及壳体脱离配合壳体的机械操作。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术；专利文体

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的主张与替代陈述
patterns.context: 讨论主张是否可继续审理，以及当事人引用判例支持替代陈述。
patterns.domain: 法律意见或裁判文书；法律文体

patterns.name: 随机重置实验术语
patterns.context: 对比恒速与恒定返回时间实验，并引入瞬时返回的随机重置情形。
patterns.domain: 随机过程与实验物理；学术文体

en.concept: mixed technical text and local word-form patterns
en.description: Activations are scattered across plural noun endings, formula numbers and symbols, technical word fragments, and fragments within drug names; other instances occur in network formula variables, predictive decision language, conversational speech, and expressions of experimental results, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Plural endings adjacent to numbers/symbols
patterns.context: Activations often fall on the endings of English plural nouns, especially in mathematical, scientific, or technical contexts; some words are split at token boundaries.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, biomedicine, and machine-learning texts

patterns.name: Numbers or relation symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur near numbers, operators, or formula layout, often alongside equations, combinations, or decimal problems.
patterns.domain: Math Q&A, formulas, and scientific data

patterns.name: Local substrings in technical terms
patterns.context: Falls on local fragments of technical terms or common English words, with descriptions of inverse functions, matrices, or models nearby; no consistent semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Fragment within a drug name
patterns.context: The name “okadaic acid” is split into tokens, and the fragment activates in a discussion of phosphatase inhibitors.

patterns.name: Backpropagation symbols and variables
patterns.context: Activations occur near variables and formula symbols in an error-update equation for neural-network output units.

patterns.name: Quantifiers in predictive decisions
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of whether to adopt a prediction, probabilities, and remaining time; cases also fits the plural-noun pattern.

patterns.name: Conversational discourse and chat sign-offs
patterns.context: In an IRC conversation, colloquial connectives, expressions confirming or ending the conversation, and chat-style abbreviations are marked.

patterns.name: Numeric units or result expressions
patterns.context: Sporadic activations appear near percentage changes and mean ± error expressions in experimental results.

4_2183.concept: 混合的技术文本与局部词形模式
4_2183.description: 激活分散于复数名词词尾、公式数字与符号、技术词片段及药名内部；另见网络公式变量、预测决策措辞、聊天口语和实验结果表达，未形成统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 复数词尾与数值/符号相邻
patterns.trigger: « waves»；« spheres»；« operations»；« fluctuations»；« components»；« estimates»；« arte»facts；« outputs»；« cases»
patterns.context: 激活多落在英语复数名词的词尾，尤其在数学、科学或技术语境中；部分词在标记边界处被拆分
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、生物医学及机器学习文本

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字或关系符号
patterns.context: 数字、运算符或公式排版附近出现零散激活，常伴随等式、组合数或小数题目
patterns.domain: 数学问答、公式及科学数据

patterns.name: 技术词项中的局部子串
patterns.context: 落在技术术语或常见英语词的局部片段上，周围有反函数、矩阵或模型描述；未见一致的语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 药物名称内部片段
patterns.context: 名称“okadaic acid”被分词拆开，片段在讨论磷酸酶抑制剂时激活

patterns.name: 反向传播符号与变量
patterns.context: 神经网络输出单元的误差更新公式中，变量和公式符号附近激活

patterns.name: 预测决策中的数量词
patterns.context: 讨论是否采纳预测、概率及剩余时间时出现；其中 cases 也符合复数名词模式

patterns.name: 口语话语与聊天结束语
patterns.context: IRC 对话中，口语连接词、确认/结束对话的表达及聊天式缩写被标记

patterns.name: 数字单位或结果表达
patterns.context: 实验结果中，百分比变化和均值±误差式表达附近出现零散激活

en.description: Activation often falls on short subwords after tokenization; the more consistent lexical pattern is contrast, negation, and sufficient-versus-necessary condition comparisons of the “but not / but insufficient” type in academic texts. Other triggers are scattered across scientific, code, licensing, and social science contexts, with no shared theme.

patterns.name: but not / but insufficient contrast structures
patterns.context: A contrastive structure first states a condition, property, or conclusion, then uses but to introduce a limitation, opposing conclusion, or insufficiency; the most prominent trigger is not following but.
patterns.domain: Academic argumentation, mathematics, and scientific texts

patterns.name: Adjacent tokenized or subword boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on short tokens after segmentation; these tokens often occur within longer words, proper names, symbols, or chemical names, and have no unified meaning on their own.

patterns.name: Discussions of representation or properties
patterns.context: Discusses mathematical forms, activities described by parameters, or material properties; activation is distributed around property descriptions and related nouns.
patterns.domain: Physics, mathematics, game theory, and materials science papers

patterns.name: Time concepts and time ranges
patterns.context: Discusses points in time representable by a time type or ranges relative to an epoch.

patterns.name: Molecular or pharmacological terminology
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of drug sensitivity and whether a phosphatase corresponds to a particular enzyme class.

patterns.name: Self, social structure, and psychological analysis
patterns.context: Discusses topics such as psychological analysis, social structure, and the formation of the self; activation concentrates in sentences describing research aims.

patterns.name: License and acknowledgment text
patterns.context: Software terms of use request acknowledgment in product documentation; the text contains a courteous suggestion rather than a requirement.

patterns.name: Polymer and chemical composition
patterns.context: Describes reaction products of soft and hard segments and related compound names.

patterns.name: Positive selection and signaling pathway contrasts
patterns.context: Compares the role of calcineurin in positive and negative T-cell selection and distinguishes ERK from other pathways.

patterns.name: Cardiac contraction experimental results
patterns.context: Reports experimental values for drug treatment conditions and myocardial shortening velocity relative to controls.

patterns.name: Probability or payoff strategy descriptions
patterns.context: Participants adjust strategies to maximize payoff while subject to rules or specifications.
patterns.domain: Game theory or related mathematical papers

4_2183.description: 激活常落在分词后的短子词上；较一致的词语模式是学术文本中“but not／but insufficient”式转折、否定与充分必要条件对照。其余触发分散于科学、代码、许可和社会科学语境，缺乏共同主题。

patterns.name: but not / but insufficient 对照结构
patterns.context: 在转折或对照结构中，先陈述一种条件、属性或结论，再用 but 引出限制、相反结论或不充分性；最显著的触发是 but 后接 not。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、数学与科学文本

patterns.name: 相邻分词或子词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在切分后的短 token 上；这些 token 常位于较长单词、专名、符号或化学名称内部，单独看并无统一词义。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、代码、技术文本

patterns.name: 表示或描述性质的论述
patterns.context: 谈论数学形式、参数所描述的活动或材料性质；激活分布在性质描述及相关名词附近。
patterns.domain: 物理、数学、博弈论、材料科学论文

patterns.name: 时间概念与时间范围
patterns.context: 讨论时间类型可表示的时间点或相对某个 epoch 的范围。

patterns.name: 分子或药理术语
patterns.context: 在讨论药物敏感性以及某种磷酸酶是否对应特定酶类时出现。

patterns.name: 自我、社会结构与心理分析
patterns.context: 讨论心理分析、社会结构及自我形成等研究主题；激活集中于描述研究目标的语句。

patterns.name: 许可与致谢文案
patterns.context: 软件使用条款要求在产品文档中致谢；包含礼貌性建议而非强制要求。

patterns.name: 聚合物与化学组成
patterns.context: 描述软硬链段的反应产物及相关化合物名称。
patterns.domain: 材料化学与聚合物研究

patterns.name: 正向选择及信号通路对照
patterns.context: 对比钙调神经磷酸酶在 T 细胞正向与负向选择中的作用，并区分 ERK 与其他通路。

patterns.name: 心肌收缩实验结果
patterns.context: 报告药物处理条件和心肌缩短速度相对对照的实验数值。

patterns.name: 概率或收益策略描述
patterns.context: 参与者调整策略以最大化收益，同时受规范或规格约束。
patterns.domain: 博弈论或相关数学论文

en.concept: Multiple local word-form and formatting features
en.description: Activation is clearest on fragments of the okadaic acid name, base-number strings, argumentative connectives, plus/minus notation, and the adhes root. Formula formatting, patent and legal phrasing, and sporadic word fragments also appear; no single stable theme is evident.

patterns.name: Internal fragments of the “okadaic acid” drug name
patterns.context: When describing protein phosphatases and their pharmacological inhibitors, activation centers on the okadaic fragment split by tokenization; segment 1 also concerns phosphatases insensitive to the drug.

patterns.name: Chunking of base-number strings
patterns.context: Appears in base-15, base-13, and similar questions; activation is on alphanumeric strings and their chunks. Whether it points to a specific number pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Logical connectives and conditional expressions
patterns.context: These words connect inferences, indicate contrast, or express necessary/sufficient conditions in arguments; the specific topics vary across segments.

patterns.name: Plus/minus notation
patterns.context: Appears in experimental-result error expressions “plus/minus 0.95” and “plus/minus 28%”.

patterns.name: Mathematical formatting boundary fragments
patterns.context: Near formulas or LaTeX formatting, trigger points fall on mathematical notation, variable boundaries, or within split words.

patterns.name: Adhesion-related word root
patterns.context: Contexts describe cell adhesion, bonding of fibers to a substrate, or objects remaining attached; trigger words share the adhes root or a near-synonymous form.
patterns.domain: Biomedical science and patent materials descriptions

patterns.name: Psychosocial terminology fragments
patterns.context: Discusses self-image, social structures, and their formation; activation falls on terms and nearby common words, with a weak pattern.

patterns.name: Numeric range symbols
patterns.context: Appears in the experimental concentration notation “1x10-16M”; activation centers on the hyphen and adjacent unit fragment.

patterns.name: Concessive connective in patent phrasing
patterns.context: A patent description first states that a material can maintain adhesion during use, then contrasts this with its easy removal.

patterns.name: Claims and requests in litigation
patterns.context: Describes parties’ claims, alternative pleadings, and whether a case proceeds in discussion of court proceedings.

patterns.name: Other sporadic argumentative and common words
patterns.context: These activations fall variously on common function words, letter fragments, quantum entanglement terminology, game-theory vocabulary, or contrastive connectives, and resist grouping into a unified content pattern.

4_2183.concept: 多种局部词形与格式特征
4_2183.description: 激活最明确地落在okadaic酸名称、进位制数字片段、论证连接词、plus/minus记法及adhes词根；另有公式排版、专利和法律句式及零散词片段，未见单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: “okadaic acid”药物名称内部片段
patterns.context: 在描述蛋白磷酸酶及其药理抑制剂时，激活集中在被分词拆开的 okadaic 片段；段1还涉及对该药不敏感的磷酸酶。

patterns.name: 进位制数字串的分块
patterns.context: 出现在 base 15、base 13 等进位制数值题中，激活的是字母数字串及其分块；是否指向特定数字模式不明确。

patterns.name: 逻辑连接词及条件表达
patterns.trigger: « and»、« thus»、« but»、« not»、« necessary»、« sufficient»、« condition»
patterns.context: 这些词出现在论证中，用于连接推论、转折或表达必要/充分条件；各段具体主题不同。

patterns.name: plus/minus 书写形式
patterns.context: 出现在实验结果的数值误差表达式“plus/minus 0.95”及“plus/minus 28%”中。

patterns.name: 数学排版边界片段
patterns.context: 公式或 LaTeX 排版附近，触发点落在数学标记、变量边界或被拆分的单词内部。
patterns.domain: 数学/理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 黏附相关词根
patterns.context: 描述细胞黏附、纤维与基体黏结或物体保持黏附的语境；触发词共享 adhes 词根或近义形式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与专利材料描述

patterns.name: 心理社会学术语片段
patterns.context: 讨论自我形象、社会结构及其形成；激活落在术语及邻近常见词上，模式较弱。

patterns.name: 数字范围符号
