patterns.context: Discusses a few known low-redshift gamma-ray bursts, then uses a contrast to introduce detection status.

patterns.name: Discussion of energy correlator constraints
patterns.context: Reviews constraints on the one-point energy correlator, then moves to a derivation or subsequent discussion.

4_2183.concept: 英文文本中的局部结构与转折
4_2183.description: 激活分布于版权模板和法律免责声明、数学表达式、技术或学术文本；可见的局部触发包括大写法律套语、算术符号及句中 but，但这些内容并无统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 版权模板中的占位符与大写词
patterns.context: 代码注释中的标准版权声明模板；激活落在被拆分的大写单词片段及撇号等标点上。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码与许可证文本

patterns.name: 免责声明中的法律措辞
patterns.trigger: “PARTICULAR PURPOSE”、“DISCLAIMED”、“IN NO EVENT SHALL”、“LIABLE”、“INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED”
patterns.context: 免责声明中列举责任限制、损害类型与例外。

patterns.name: 英文数学题中的运算符与变量表达式
patterns.context: 数学题或自动生成的代数题中，变量、函数定义与算术式交替出现。
patterns.domain: 数学题目与形式化算术文本

patterns.name: 句中转折连接词
patterns.context: 前文陈述后接限制、反差或补充；该词在不同主题文本中均出现。
patterns.domain: 多种英文说明文与学术文本

patterns.name: 比较级或程度表达 longer
patterns.context: 比较交付方式所需时间，并以“but”引出安全性反差。

patterns.name: 特定技术缩写与邮件术语
patterns.context: 描述邮件认证政策、DNS 域及汇总报告的技术说明。

patterns.name: 生化研究中的限定性论述
patterns.context: 提出组织来源脂肪酸合成酶之间可能存在的相互作用。

patterns.name: 天体物理文本中的低红移爆发
patterns.context: 讨论少数已知低红移伽马射线暴，并以转折引出探测情况。

patterns.name: 能量关联函数约束论述
patterns.trigger: “energy correlators”、“what kind of constraints do we get?”、“but for now”
patterns.context: 先回顾一点能量关联函数的约束，再转入推导或后续讨论。

en.concept: but contrast and local subword fragments
en.description: The most prominent shared pattern is activation near but (and the exception, limitation, or contrast introduced by but); other activations occur in degree or evaluative expressions, enough/prime in mathematical text, a subword fragment within Epidemiological, and split identifiers in .NET security code.

patterns.name: but in contrast or comparison
patterns.context: but occurs locally, often introducing a limitation, reversal, or qualification; [1] gives an exception condition in an interactive program, [3] compares delivery methods, [4] compares the effects of dietary plans, and [9] limits the evidentiary force of materials.
patterns.domain: Legal licenses, commercial descriptions, health advice, legal commentary

patterns.name: Before adjectives indicating greater degree or quality
patterns.context: Immediately adjacent to expressions of degree, evaluation, possibility, or prominence; some follow the activation word (such as enough), while in others the activation word itself is nearby. Several passages are not clearly related to the but pattern.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, commercial descriptions, publishing introductions, research recruitment, legal texts, mathematics papers

patterns.name: Word-internal segmentation of “Epidemiological”
patterns.context: A word split across a line break appears as multiple tokens, with activation concentrated on the “em” fragment; no clear semantic or syntactic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and security credential fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in .NET security initialization code and identifiers such as credentials and context parameters; activation is distributed across split code tokens and does not consistently match the trigger patterns in other passages.

4_2183.description: 最突出的共性是 but（及 but 引出的例外、限制或对照）附近的激活；另有程度或评价表达、数学文本中的 enough/prime、Epidemiological 的词内片段，以及 .NET 安全代码中的拆分标识符。

patterns.name: 转折/对照中的 but
patterns.context: 局部出现 but，常引出限制、反向或补充说明；[1] 为交互式程序的例外条件，[3] 比较配送方式，[4] 比较饮食方案效果，[9] 限定材料的证明力。
patterns.domain: 法律许可证、商业说明、健康建议、法律评论

patterns.name: 更高程度或质量的形容词前
patterns.context: 紧邻程度、评价、可能性或突出性表达；有的紧随激活词之后（如 enough），有的激活词本身就在相邻位置，且若干段与 but 模式并不明显相关。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、商业说明、出版介绍、研究招募、法律文本、数学论文

patterns.name: 词内片段“Epidemiological”的切分
patterns.context: 跨换行后出现被分成多个 token 的单词，激活集中于“em”片段；未见清楚的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与安全凭据片段
patterns.context: 处于 .NET 安全初始化代码及凭据、上下文参数等标识符中；激活分布在拆分后的代码 token，无法与其他段的触发模式稳定对应。

en.description: Activation is scattered across Google identifiers in code, give up, enough time, astronomical numeric units, but contrasts in patent and legal language, and the mathematical term prime ideal. No single stable semantics or style covers all segments.

patterns.name: Google/GitHub identifiers and separators
patterns.context: Google API/Protobuf names and path fragments in code, script URLs, or serialized data; activation falls on domain and path components

patterns.name: give up phrase
patterns.context: The phrase means to quit and often takes career, dream, or another goal as its object; activation centers on up

patterns.name: enough followed by time/quantity
patterns.context: Indicates in a conditional sentence that sufficient time is available to act

patterns.name: Numeric and unit markers
patterns.context: Describes absorption lines and wavelengths in astronomy/physics text

patterns.name: Material properties and concessive contrast
patterns.context: A patent statement first describes a material’s adhesion properties, then uses but to introduce its removability

patterns.name: Negation or limitation following but
patterns.context: In legal discussion, acknowledges that material is helpful while limiting its evidentiary value; but also appears in [9], but in a different context

patterns.name: Mathematical term prime ideal
patterns.context: Introduces a prime ideal of codimension 1 and related theory

4_2183.description: 激活分散于代码中的 Google 标识符、give up、enough time、天文数值单位、专利与法律语句中的 but 转折，以及数学术语 prime ideal；没有单一稳定语义或文体能覆盖全部段。

patterns.name: Google/GitHub标识符与分隔符
patterns.context: 代码、脚本 URL 或序列化数据中，Google API/Protobuf 名称及路径片段；激活落在域名和路径的组成部分
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码或二进制/协议数据

patterns.name: give up 短语
patterns.context: 短语表示放弃，常接 career、dream 或其他目标；激活集中在 up
patterns.domain: 人物经历与建议性散文

patterns.name: enough 后接时间/数量
patterns.context: 条件句中表示有足够的时间可采取行动

patterns.name: 数值与单位标记
patterns.context: 天文/物理文本中描述吸收线及波长

patterns.name: 材料性能及让步转折
patterns.context: 专利语句先说明材料粘附性能，再以 but 引出可剥离性

patterns.name: but 转折后的否定或限制
patterns.context: 在法律论述中承认材料有帮助，同时限制其证明力；与[9]同样出现 but，但上下文不同
patterns.domain: 法律意见或选举法论述

patterns.name: prime ideal 数学术语
patterns.context: 介绍余维数为1的素理想及相关理论

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the contrastive conjunction “but,” especially when it connects concessive, contrasting, or corrective content; sporadic activations also occur on enough, the mathematical term prime, the reflexive pronoun themselves, and the URL domain com, with no single stable pattern tying them together.

patterns.name: Contrastive but
patterns.context: Connects clauses, adjectives, or evaluations that form a concession or contrast; the preceding and following content may qualify or correct one another.
patterns.domain: Software licenses, sports reports, product delivery, science-fiction reviews, mathematics papers, biomedical abstracts, software architecture discussions

patterns.name: Enough time
patterns.context: enough modifies time, indicating there is ample time before a certain date; the passage also repeatedly includes “take the prediction into account”.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic text, prediction and decision-making discussion

patterns.name: The term prime ideal
patterns.context: prime modifies ideal as a mathematical term.

patterns.name: The reflexive pronoun themselves
patterns.context: The reflexive pronoun refers to the preceding k servers, describing their inability to communicate with one another.

patterns.name: URL domain fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the Google APIs URL domain googleapis.com.

4_2183.description: 主要对转折词“but”敏感，尤其是连接让步、反差或修正性内容时；另有零散激活分别落在 enough、数学术语 prime、反身代词 themselves 和网址域名 com 上，无法归为同一稳定模式。

patterns.name: 对比转折 but
patterns.context: 连接前后语义形成让步或反差的分句、形容词或评价；前后内容可互相限制或修正。
patterns.domain: 软件许可证、体育报道、商品配送、科幻评论、数学论文、生物医学摘要、软件架构讨论

patterns.name: 足够时间
patterns.context: enough 修饰 time，表示在某个日期之前时间充裕；该段还多次出现“take the prediction into account”。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术文本，预测决策讨论

patterns.name: prime ideal 术语
patterns.context: prime 作数学术语修饰 ideal。

patterns.name: themselves 反身代词
patterns.context: 反身代词指代前文的 k 个服务器，描述它们彼此不能通信。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 网址域名片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Google APIs 的网址域名 googleapis.com 中。

en.concept: Local phrase and formula patterns across domains
en.description: Activations are scattered across mathematical definitions, technical explanations, scientific abstracts, and sports reports; local patterns often involve trade-offs or conditions, but also cover endpoints, compiler detection, pitch counts, offline caching, and short formula words. No single semantic pattern explains them.

patterns.name: Comparisons and trade-off expressions
patterns.context: Weighs whether to adopt something or a practice, and its costs and effects, within a contrastive or conditional frame; lexical cues include but, if, enough, long.
patterns.domain: Scientific discussion, technical Q&A, and general explanations

patterns.name: Common short words and adjacent symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Mathematical problem text between formulas or variable definitions; activations occur on short words, symbols, and adjacent positions, without indicating a stable, specific mathematical concept.

patterns.name: Operational constraint to minimize damage
patterns.context: In a discussion of artifact analysis, explicitly requires minimizing damage to the subject and conducting detection in situ.

patterns.name: Range endpoint matching
patterns.context: Explains how a method checks whether interval endpoints match the value being tested; this is an operational procedure description.

patterns.name: Build system and compiler detection terminology
patterns.context: After a code snippet, describes subsequent behavior of build or compiler feature detection.

patterns.name: Pitch counts in baseball narration
patterns.context: A sports report describing an inning and a pitcher quickly retiring the opposing batters.

patterns.name: Offline-first software and caching
patterns.context: Introduces offline-first software features or related modules.

patterns.name: Loose but specific interactions in a biochemical paper
patterns.context: Proposes a hypothesis about interactions between tissue components related to fatty acid synthesis.

4_2183.concept: 多领域局部短语与公式模式
4_2183.description: 激活分散于数学定义、技术说明、科学摘要和体育报道等文本；局部常见权衡/条件表达，但也涵盖端点、编译检测、投球数、离线缓存及公式短词，无法由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 比较与权衡表达
patterns.trigger: “take the prediction into account”“enough time”“long-winded but it will work”“loose but specific”
patterns.context: 在转折或条件框架中权衡是否采纳某事、某做法的代价与效果；词汇线索包括 but、if、enough、long。
patterns.domain: 科学论述、技术问答及一般说明

patterns.name: 数学公式中的常见短词与符号邻接
patterns.trigger: “Let”“be”“=”“-”“+”及变量字母，如“Let o(i) =”“Let m₂(r) =”“Let x(n) =”
patterns.context: 公式或变量定义之间的数学题文本；激活落在短词、符号及其邻接位置，未显示一个稳定的特定数学概念。

patterns.name: 尽量少破坏的操作约束
patterns.trigger: “as little destructive as possible”“performed directly on the object”
patterns.context: 讨论文物分析时，明确要求减少对研究对象的损伤并就地检测。

patterns.name: 范围端点匹配
patterns.trigger: “a start and an end”“fit the value you're testing”
patterns.context: 解释用方法检查区间端点是否符合待测值，属于操作步骤说明。

patterns.name: 构建系统与编译检测术语
patterns.context: 代码片段之后说明构建或编译特性检测的后续表现。

patterns.name: 棒球叙述中的投球数
patterns.trigger: “just seven pitches to retire the Gophers”
patterns.context: 描述一局比赛及投手快速解决对手打者的体育报道。

patterns.name: 软件离线优先与缓存
patterns.context: 介绍离线优先的软件功能或相关模块。

patterns.name: 生化论文中的松散但特异相互作用
patterns.context: 提出脂肪酸合成相关组织成分之间相互作用的假说。

en.description: The most prominent trigger is but, especially in contrast, concession, or disclaimers; it appears across multiple domains. The remaining segments show no clear shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Strong contrast after but
patterns.context: But is often followed by negation, limitation, or content contrasting with what precedes it; the marker falls on but itself.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, explanatory text, and license text

patterns.name: But in license disclaimers
patterns.context: In software licenses or copyright disclaimers, but introduces “no warranty”; warranty and without often occur nearby.

patterns.name: But at the end of code snippets
patterns.context: After code or comments, but shifts to natural-language explanation or a qualification.

patterns.name: Concessive explanation addressed to readers
patterns.context: But introduces concerns or difficulties readers may encounter, followed by a solution.

patterns.name: But contrast in a mathematics paper
patterns.context: Describes a quantity that cannot be measured directly but can be reconstructed from other information.

patterns.name: But with weak neighboring-word activation
patterns.context: In an architecture description, but is followed by don’t forget, reminding readers of a benefit that remains important despite the trade-off.

4_2183.description: 最突出的触发是 but，尤其在转折、让步或免责声明中；多领域均出现。其余段落的激活未见明确共同触发模式。

patterns.name: but 后的强转折
patterns.context: 在 but 之后，常接否定、限制或与前文形成对照的内容；标记落在 but 本身。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、说明文及许可证文本

patterns.name: 许可证免责声明中的 but
patterns.context: 软件许可证或版权免责声明中，but 引出“无任何保证”；多处邻近 warranty、without。

patterns.name: 代码片段末尾的 but
patterns.context: 在代码或注释之后，but 转入自然语言说明或限制。
patterns.domain: 代码托管文本、技术问答

patterns.name: 面向读者的让步说明
patterns.context: but 引出读者可能遇到的疑虑或困难，随后给出解决方案。
patterns.domain: 面向开发者的网页文案

patterns.name: 数学论文中的 but 转折
patterns.context: 描述某量不可直接测量，但可由其他信息重建。

patterns.name: 相邻词强度较弱的 but
patterns.context: 架构说明中，but 后接 don’t forget，提示权衡后仍应注意收益。

en.description: The most stable cue is the sentence-internal contrastive word but, often introducing a limitation or addition; other activations occur on waiting/time in scientific text, duration expressions in delivery descriptions, and sporadic local sequences in code, licenses, HTML, and mathematical formulas. The latter groups are difficult to assign a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-final contrastive but
patterns.context: After a long sentence or explanation, but introduces a contrast, limitation, or addition; it is often a locally highlighted trigger.
patterns.domain: Natural language across domains, including technical Q&A, medical explanations, sports reports, and Portuguese text

patterns.name: Words related to waiting
patterns.context: Describes a brief waiting period during a process, immediately followed by the purpose of waiting.

patterns.name: Some function words and code boundaries
patterns.context: Local sequences in code, source snippets, or license text; there is no consistent lexical trigger substring, and formatting or boundaries may be involved.
patterns.domain: Open-source licenses, CMake/code, HTML, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Quantity expressions and duration comparisons
patterns.context: Compares the time taken by delivery methods; but introduces a subsequent emphasis on safety.

patterns.name: Character sequences in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Characters, operators, and numbers are split into tokens in formulas and factorization text; no clear semantic commonality is evident.

4_2183.description: 最稳定的线索是句中转折词 but，常引出限制或补充；另有科学文本里的 waiting/time、交付说明中的时长表达，以及代码、许可证、HTML 和数学公式中的零散局部序列，后几类难以归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 句末转折词 but
patterns.context: 在较长句子或说明之后，but 引出转折、限制或补充；多为局部高亮的触发点。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言，包括技术问答、医学说明、体育报道和葡语文本

patterns.name: 等待相关词语
patterns.context: 描述运动过程中的短暂等待时间，紧接着说明等待目的。

patterns.name: 某些功能词与代码边界
patterns.trigger: «that»10«you»3«will»2…（段[7]），以及大量标记在许可证文本和 HTML/模板代码附近的 token
patterns.context: 代码、源码片段或许可证文本中的局部序列；尚无一致的词法触发子串，可能受格式或边界影响。
patterns.domain: 开源许可证、CMake/代码、HTML 与技术问答

patterns.name: 数量表达与时长比较
patterns.context: 比较交付方式耗时，but 引出后续强调的安全性。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的字符序列
patterns.context: 公式与因式分解文本中，字符、运算符和数字被拆分标记；未见明确语义共性。

en.description: Activations are concentrated on minus signs representing negative numbers or subtraction in mathematical expressions; other instances occur on runs in cricket score narration, expressions of duration, and concessive but in Q&A responses. The patterns are not unified in form or meaning.

patterns.name: Minus signs in signed integer operations
patterns.context: A minus sign occurs among consecutive integers, parenthetical expressions, fractions, or arithmetic expressions; mathematics problem text often separates the question from the answer with a line break

patterns.name: Cricket scores and runs
patterns.context: Contexts involving scores, dismissals, wins or losses, or player performance in cricket narration; clearer triggers include the space before runs and the word runs

patterns.name: Waiting time and extended processes
patterns.context: Expressions describing a waiting period or process as taking a short or long time; the two examples are semantically similar but have different surface triggers
patterns.domain: Research papers and product delivery descriptions

patterns.name: Concessive wording in English responses
patterns.context: Near the beginning of the sentence, first indicates that the answer may be incomplete, then uses but to introduce a potentially helpful suggestion

4_2183.description: 激活主要集中于数学算式中表示负数或减法的负号；另见板球比分叙述中的 runs、时间长短表述，以及问答回应中让步转折的 but。各模式表面与语义上并不统一。

patterns.name: 带符号整数运算中的负号
patterns.context: 负号出现在连续的整数、括号表达式、分数或算式中；数学题文本常以换行分隔题目与答案

patterns.name: 板球比分与 runs
patterns.trigger: « runs»8 / « runs»10；以及相关比赛结果附近的 «»（如 [1] 的 «»2、[7] 的 «»10）
patterns.context: 板球叙述中比分、出局、胜负或球员表现的语境；较明确的触发是 runs 前的空格和 runs 这个词

patterns.name: 等待时间及延长过程
patterns.trigger: « short»4« waiting»10« time»5；另有 « little»2« longer»3« but»9
patterns.context: 描述一段等待或过程所需时间较短、较长的表达；两个例子语义相近但表面触发不同
patterns.domain: 科研论文与商品配送说明

patterns.name: 英文让步回应措辞
patterns.trigger: « but»10 might« give»3« you»2« a»1 head« start»2
patterns.context: 句首附近先表示回答可能不完整，再以 but 引出可能有帮助的建议

en.description: Activations occur mainly on addition and subtraction operators in mathematical expressions and on but connecting clauses in sentences across domains; another passage has scattered activations at code and line-break boundaries, with no confirmed pattern.

patterns.name: Operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Numbers and parentheses are split into tokens around operators in arithmetic problems or algebraic expressions; activation occurs on the operators

patterns.name: Contrastive word but
patterns.context: Connects opposing, supplementary, or restrictive clauses, usually appearing after a preceding judgment and before the subsequent contrastive content
patterns.domain: Sports narration, academic papers, forum discussions, creative interviews, and other genres

patterns.name: Boundaries and line breaks in varied text
patterns.context: At formatting boundaries in code, forum answers, or document fragments; many other tokens in the passage are also marked, making it difficult to determine whether boundaries themselves are the main trigger

patterns.name: Local activations outside the main pattern or weakly associated with it
patterns.context: Occurs in mathematics problem statements and variable definitions, or build system code; these activations do not yield a common trigger condition that can be consistently inferred from other passages

4_2183.description: 激活主要落在数学表达式的加减运算符，以及多领域句子中连接前后分句的 but；另有一段代码/换行边界处的分散激活，无法确认其规律。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的运算符
patterns.context: 算术题或代数表达式中，运算符附近的数字和括号被切分成 token；激活落在运算符上

patterns.name: 转折词 but
patterns.trigger: “but”，包括“emotional but a proud day”“further but focusing”“logical but because”“code a bit more but don’t forget”“long-winded but it will work”“commercial but also”
patterns.context: 连接相反、补充或限制性分句，通常位于前一判断之后、后续转折内容之前
patterns.domain: 体育叙述、学术论文、论坛讨论及创作访谈等多种文体

patterns.name: 多样文本中的边界与换行
patterns.trigger: 换行符“↵”、代码分隔标记“EOF”，以及换行后出现的普通叙述起始语“After that you will see”
patterns.context: 代码、论坛回答或文档片段在格式边界处；该段还有大量其他 token 被标记，难以确认边界本身是否是主要触发因素

patterns.name: 非主模式或弱关联的局部激活
patterns.trigger: [1] 中“Let v2 =”附近的“Let”“v”“=”；[2] 中“c2_std_11”“static_assert”“macro”等代码 token
patterns.context: 数学题干与变量定义、或构建系统代码中出现；这些局部激活无法从其他段稳定归纳成共同触发条件
patterns.domain: 数学题及 CMake/C++ 代码

en.description: Activation covers operators and variables in mathematical expressions, code and formatting boundaries, scoring contexts in cricket reports, and qualifying statements in academic abstracts. Trigger forms differ substantially across segments, with no unique stable lexical or semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Plus/minus signs and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Near math problems, expressions, or formulas; a minus sign may occur before a number, within parentheses, or between operators, with no fixed sentence pattern required.

patterns.name: Structural boundaries in code and markup languages
patterns.context: In HTML/code snippets or formatted license text; activation is distributed across tags, near line breaks, and body words, with no single fixed trigger word.
patterns.domain: Web markup, code Q&A, and software license text

patterns.name: Quantity or score in a narrative
patterns.context: Numbers in cricket match narratives indicate runs, innings scores, or match results; the specific numbers in [5] and [6] are unmarked, while runs is prominently activated.

patterns.name: Qualifying language in academic text
patterns.context: An academic abstract on artifact analysis discusses research constraints, especially minimizing damage.

4_2183.description: 激活覆盖数学表达式中的运算符与变量、代码及格式边界、板球报道中的得分语境，以及学术摘要中的限制性表述。各段的触发形式差异明显，未见唯一稳定的词项或语义模式。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的正负号与运算符
patterns.trigger: «+», «-», «*», «/» 等算术符号，尤其是运算式中的 «-»；也包括 [1] 的 «p»、«v»、«f» 等变量标记
patterns.context: 数学题、表达式或公式附近；负号可处于数字、括号或运算符之间，并不要求固定句式。

patterns.name: 代码与标记语言中的结构边界
patterns.trigger: [2] 的 «</option», «</select», «</div»、缩进和换行；[4] 的 «↵» 及 «under» 等许可证文本边界处标记
patterns.context: HTML/代码片段或带有格式化结构的许可证文本中；激活分布在标签、换行附近及正文词语上，未呈现单一固定触发词。
patterns.domain: 网页标记、代码问答与软件许可证文本

patterns.name: 叙述中的数量或得分
patterns.context: 数字出现在板球比赛叙述中，表示得分、局分或比赛结果；[5]、[6] 的具体数字未标记，明显激活包括 runs。

patterns.name: 学术文本中的限制表达
patterns.context: 关于文物分析的学术摘要中，讨论研究需遵守的约束，尤其是尽量减少破坏。

en.description: The most prominent pattern is waiting time(s); several other strong activations occur on English or Portuguese but and on negation marker not. Remaining sporadic activations occur on mathematical minus signs, HTML, URL hyphens, quantity words, the INTERVAL subword, and narrative words.

patterns.name: wait/waiting time intervals
patterns.context: Indicates allocating waiting time for a process or a long waiting period; activation is concentrated on waiting, with strong activations also on time/times

patterns.name: Latin conjunction but
patterns.context: but expresses concession, contrast, or an addition; surrounding sentence structures vary

patterns.name: Colloquial suggestions after but
patterns.context: In Portuguese, mas (meaning but) introduces a suggestion or general explanation; web HTML markup is also present

patterns.name: Negation marker not
patterns.context: not negates or qualifies a proposition, appearing in legal argumentation and scientific description

patterns.name: Minus signs in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: A minus sign is embedded in mathematical expressions and variable assignments; the symbol activates much more strongly than neighboring words

patterns.name: HTML closing tags and code formatting
patterns.context: HTML tags, indentation, and line breaks appear densely; activations are scattered around tag boundaries and whitespace
patterns.domain: Web code mixed with Q&A text

patterns.name: Hyphens in URLs
patterns.context: A hyphen occurs in a URL path string resembling a hash value; activation is present but weak

patterns.name: Numeral/quantity word two
patterns.context: In the fixed contrastive construction not one but two, two denotes a quantity; the passage also has not activation

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment INTERVAL
patterns.context: The SQL type name INTERVAL is split into tokens, with strong activation on the VAL subword; the surrounding text discusses a parameterized time interval

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in a personal name
patterns.context: A narrative includes character pronouns and the name Fontenac; the strongest position is on himself, with no clear shared semantic trigger

4_2183.concept: 等待时间与转折/否定词
4_2183.description: 最突出的是 waiting time(s)，另有多处强激活落在英语或葡语 but、否定 not；其余零散出现在数学负号、HTML、URL 连字符、数量词、INTERVAL 子词及叙事词语中。

patterns.name: wait/waiting 时间间隔
patterns.context: 表示为某个过程预留等待时间，或等待时间很长；激活集中在 waiting，time/times 也有较强激活

patterns.name: 拉丁转折词 but
patterns.context: but 用于让步、转折或补充说明；周围句子结构不同

patterns.name: but 后的口语建议表达
patterns.trigger: funcionar «mas»10 a ideia geral é esta（4）
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中 mas（意为 but）引出建议或一般性说明；并伴有网页 HTML 标记
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语 StackExchange 回答

patterns.name: 否定词 not
patterns.context: not 用于否定或限定命题，分别出现在法律论证和科研描述中
patterns.domain: 法律判决、粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的负号
patterns.context: 负号嵌在数学表达式及变量赋值中；符号的激活远强于邻近词

patterns.name: HTML 闭合标签及代码排版
patterns.context: HTML 标签、缩进和换行符密集出现；激活分散在标签边界及空白处
patterns.domain: 网页代码与问答文本混排

patterns.name: URL 中的连字符
patterns.context: 连字符位于类似哈希值的 URL 路径字符串中；虽有激活但强度较弱

patterns.name: 数字/数量词 two
patterns.context: 固定对照结构 not one but two 中，two 表示数量；本段同时有 not 激活

patterns.name: 词内片段 INTERVAL
patterns.context: SQL 类型名 INTERVAL 被拆分成 token，强激活落在 VAL 子词；周边在讨论带参数的时间间隔

patterns.name: 人名词尾片段
patterns.context: 叙事文本中出现人物代词及 Fontenac 这一人名；最强位置落在 himself，未见明确共同语义触发

en.description: Activations are scattered across the comparative construction as, the phrase distance, word-internal fragments in overlooked and suppositories, mathematical operators, HTML whitespace tags, and separators in paper source text; no shared semantic or stable lexical pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: “as” at the end of a phrase and comparative constructions
patterns.context: Responds notably to structures where as is followed by possible or a quantity/degree complement; passage 2 is “as little destructive as possible”, and passage 4 is “as little as $10”.

patterns.name: Short-distance/proximity expressions
patterns.context: distance receives high activation in a noun phrase describing location or distance.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in “overlooked”
patterns.context: Within the adjective overlooked, look is the main trigger fragment; a hyphen and the modifier easily occur nearby.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in “suppositories”
patterns.context: A word-internal fragment of the dosage-form name suppositories is activated; it occurs in a drug list or formulation description.

patterns.name: Plus signs and arithmetic symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Operators, numbers, and parentheses are interspersed in mathematics problems; both mathematical contexts show activation, but the specific trigger symbols and strengths do not fully match.

patterns.name: Whitespace and tag boundaries in code/markup
patterns.context: Activations occur around indentation whitespace, closing tags, and line breaks in HTML snippets; the latter half of the same passage also contains Portuguese text.
patterns.domain: StackExchange posts, code, or web markup

patterns.name: Separators and mathematical symbols in YAML/LaTeX documents
patterns.context: Activations occur near YAML metadata, Markdown heading separators, and LaTeX mathematical notation in paper documents; there is no clear lexical trigger shared with other passages.

4_2183.description: 激活分散于 as 比较结构、distance 短语、overlooked 与 suppositories 的词内片段，以及数学运算符、HTML 空白标签和论文源码分隔符；未见能解释全部片段的共同语义或稳定词法模式。

patterns.name: 短语末尾的“as”及比较结构
patterns.context: 较显著地响应 as 后接 possible 或数量/程度补语的结构；片段 2 是“as little destructive as possible”，片段 4 是“as little as $10”。

patterns.name: 短距离/邻近表达
patterns.context: 描述位置或距离的名词短语中，distance 获得高激活。

patterns.name: “overlooked”词内片段
patterns.context: 在形容词 overlooked 中，look 是主要触发片段；周围有连字符及 easily 修饰语。

patterns.name: “suppositories”词内片段
patterns.context: 药物剂型名 suppositories 的词内分段片段被激活；出现在药品列表或制剂描述中。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的加号及算术符号
patterns.context: 数学题中运算符与数字、括号交错；两段数学上下文均有激活，但具体触发符号和强度并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 代码/标记中的空白与标签边界
patterns.context: HTML 片段中的缩进空白、标签闭合和换行附近出现激活；同段后半还夹有葡萄牙语文字。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 帖子、代码或网页标记

patterns.name: YAML/LaTeX 文档中的分隔符与数学符号
patterns.context: 论文文档的 YAML 元数据、Markdown 标题分隔线及 LaTeX 数学记号附近激活；没有与其他段明确共享的词汇触发。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across suppositories, being alone, waiting, minimizing damage, cricket scores, personal choice, and dienes; some patterns recur, while others occur in only one passage.

patterns.name: suppositories
patterns.context: The trigger word suppositories occurs in specialized text about dosage forms, formulations, or routes of administration; other dosage forms or drugs are often listed earlier.

patterns.name: Being alone
patterns.context: A character is alone, separated from others, or acting alone; the original wording in all cases is by himself.
patterns.domain: Literary narrative, news, or biographical reporting

patterns.name: Waiting time
patterns.context: A brief wait occurs during a process described in stages, with the duration or purpose of waiting explained.

patterns.name: Minimize damage as much as possible
patterns.context: Explains that artifact analysis should minimize damage to the object, often using the phrasing as little destructive as possible.

patterns.name: Runs scored
patterns.context: In cricket scoring narration, runs appear alongside scores, batting, or match outcomes.

patterns.name: Self-selection and limiting options
patterns.context: In job-seeking advice, own combines with options to emphasize that a person's actions can limit their choices.

patterns.name: Organic chemistry dienes
patterns.context: dienes occurs in discussion of cycloaddition reactions and is listed alongside cyclic or acyclic reactants.

4_2183.description: 强激活分散于 suppositories、独自一人、等待、尽量少破坏、板球得分、个人选择和二烯等词句；部分模式有重复，其余各仅见一段。

patterns.name: suppositories
patterns.context: 在药物剂型、制剂或给药途径的专业文本中，触发词 suppositories；前文常列出其他剂型或药物。

patterns.name: 自身独处
patterns.context: 人物处于独自一人、与他人分开或独自行动的叙述中；原文均为 by himself。
patterns.domain: 文学叙事、新闻或人物报道

patterns.name: 等待时间
patterns.context: 运动或实验过程分阶段描述时，出现短暂等待，并说明等待的时长或目的。

patterns.name: 尽可能少破坏
patterns.context: 说明文物分析应尽量减少对对象的破坏，常见句式 as little destructive as possible。

patterns.name: 运行得分
patterns.context: 板球比赛记分叙述中，runs 与比分、击球或胜负等信息并列。

patterns.name: 自我选择与限制选项
patterns.context: 求职建议中，own 与 options 搭配，强调个人行为会限制自身选择。

patterns.name: 有机化学二烯
patterns.context: 讨论环加成反应时出现 dienes，并与环状或非环状反应物并列。

en.description: Activation is distributed across multiple domains. Clearer triggers include “suppositories” in pharmaceutical patents and the words destructive, waiting, dienes, runs, and words; mathematical segments fall on various forms of notation, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Rectal dosage form “suppositories”
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of pharmaceutical formulations, routes of administration, or related background; strong activation falls in the middle of the word, “itories”.

patterns.name: “destructive” in a phrase about degree of damage
patterns.context: Discusses scientific testing of artifacts or objects, particularly the constraint to be “as little destructive as possible”.

patterns.name: “waiting” in a phrase about waiting time
patterns.context: Describes a stage in a trajectory, where waiting is a short phase after diffusion and return.

patterns.name: Diene reactant name “dienes”
patterns.context: Mentions cyclic or acyclic reactants in a cycloaddition reaction chemistry abstract.

patterns.name: Local activation in numbers or mathematical notation
patterns.context: Near mathematical formatting, algebra problems, or formulas; no consistent mathematical semantics or shared trigger substring explains the activation.

patterns.name: Runs as the required score
patterns.context: In a cricket match report, a team needs to reach a specific score to preserve its chance of advancing.

patterns.name: “words” in a keyword heading
patterns.context: The “Suggested Keywords” field at the end of a paper or in abstract metadata.

4_2183.concept: 无统一概念（局部词形/词汇触发）
4_2183.description: 激活分散于多个领域，较明确的触发包括药学专利中的“suppositories”，以及 destructive、waiting、dienes、runs、words 等词；数学段落则落在多种记号上，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 直肠给药剂型“suppositories”
patterns.context: 在药物制剂、给药途径或相关背景描述中出现；强激活落在词的中段“itories”。

patterns.name: 破坏性程度短语中的“destructive”
patterns.context: 讨论文物或对象的科学检测，尤其在“as little destructive as possible”这一尽量减少破坏的约束中。

patterns.name: 等待时间短语中的“waiting”
patterns.context: 描述运动轨迹的阶段，等待是扩散、返回之后的短暂阶段。

patterns.name: 二烯反应物名“dienes”
patterns.context: 环加成反应的化学摘要中提到环状或非环状反应物。

patterns.name: 数值或数学记号中的局部激活
patterns.context: 数学排版、代数题或公式附近；没有一致的数学语义或相同触发子串可解释激活。

patterns.name: “runs”所指的得分需求
patterns.context: 板球比赛报道中，球队需要达到特定得分以保住晋级机会。

patterns.name: 关键词标题中的“words”
patterns.context: 论文末尾或摘要元数据里的“Suggested Keywords”字段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across different word forms or markers, including suppo-sitories, cricket runs, academic discourse, table line breaks, own/himself, algebraic plus signs, and patent art; most occur only once or twice, with no shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Word ending in suppositories
patterns.context: Activation falls on a word-final fragment of suppositories, the name of a dosage form; both passages also involve drugs or formulations.

patterns.name: Cricket scores runs
patterns.context: In cricket match narration, runs denotes a score; nearby text mentions the score, batter, or match result.

patterns.name: Word ending in discourse
patterns.context: In academic discussion such as discourse analysis, activation occurs on the word discourse; the same passage also discusses data, writing, and conversation.

patterns.name: Table line-break marker
patterns.context: In a parameter table in a mathematics paper, activation occurs on a line-break marker, following table data rows and a separator.

patterns.name: Self/oneself
patterns.context: When a character is described as eating or smoking alone, a possessive or reflexive pronoun emphasizes being alone.

patterns.name: Phrase own options
patterns.context: In job-seeking advice, own modifies options to express that personal choices are limited.

patterns.name: Numeric constant 28
patterns.context: In a polynomial expression in an algebra problem, activation falls on the plus sign connecting the constant 28 to the following term.

patterns.name: Related prior art in a patent
patterns.context: Patent text reviews related art and discusses photoresists, surfactants, and process defects; the strongest unmarked fragment is resists.

4_2183.description: 激活分散在 suppo-sitories、板球 runs、学术 discourse、表格换行、own/himself、代数加号及专利 art 等不同词形或标记上；多数只出现一两次，缺乏共同语义触发。

patterns.name: suppositories词尾
patterns.context: 在药物剂型名称 suppositories 中，激活落在词尾片段；两段都同时出现药物或配方语境。

patterns.name: 板球得分 runs
patterns.context: 板球比赛叙述中，runs 表示得分；附近有比分、击球手或比赛结果。

patterns.name: discourse 的词尾
patterns.context: 在 discourse analysis 等学术论述中，激活落在 discourse 一词上；同段还讨论数据、写作与交谈。

patterns.name: 表格换行标记
patterns.context: 数学论文的参数表中，激活出现在换行标记，紧随表格数据行及分隔线。

patterns.name: 自身/自己
patterns.context: 叙述人物独自进食、吸烟时，所有格或反身代词强调各自独处。

patterns.name: own options 短语
patterns.context: 求职建议中，own 修饰 options，表达个人选择受到限制。

patterns.name: 数字常数 28
patterns.context: 代数题的多项式表达式中，激活落在加号，连接常数 28 与后续项。

patterns.name: 专利中的相关现有技术
patterns.context: 专利文本回顾 related art，并讨论光刻胶、表面活性剂及工艺缺陷；未标记的最强片段是 resists。

en.concept: Mathematical problem text boundaries and local function words
en.description: Primarily appears in math-question wording, answer-to-next-question boundaries, and text following numbers; local words also appear in artifact-research constraints and scientific trajectory descriptions. No unified cross-domain semantics emerges.

patterns.name: Question marks in math problems
patterns.context: Direct questions in math problems, especially questions beginning with Is, What, Find, Solve, or Calculate; activation is near words or punctuation within the question.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, interleaved problems and solutions

patterns.name: Answer boundaries in math problems
patterns.context: A math Q&A ends, the answer is followed by a line break, and a new problem begins with Let; this pattern occurs where adjacent problems are concatenated.

patterns.name: Text following numbers in math problems
patterns.context: After a numerical answer or numeric expression in a calculation problem, a new problem prompt follows; the trigger position may span the problem boundary.

patterns.name: Analysis constraints for an artifact
patterns.context: In an introduction to scientific artifact research, describes constraints to be observed, especially minimizing damage and working directly on the object.

patterns.name: Waiting phase in motion
patterns.context: When describing motion trajectories in phases, the waiting phase is used to optimize localization; strong activation centers on waiting and time.
patterns.domain: ArXiv research paper, trajectories and localization

4_2183.concept: 数学题文本边界及局部功能词
4_2183.description: 主要出现在数学题问句、答案与下一题的边界及数字后续文本；另见文物研究限制和科研轨迹描述中的局部词语，未形成跨领域统一语义。

patterns.name: 数学题中的问号
patterns.trigger: “Is f”, “Is z a composite number?”, “What is the thousands digit of n?”, “Find the second derivative”, “Solve … for g”, “Calculate n(14)”
patterns.context: 数学题里出现直接提问，尤其是以 Is、What、Find、Solve、Calculate 引出的问句；激活落在问句中的词或标点附近。

patterns.name: 数学题的答案边界
patterns.context: 一个数学问答结束、答案后换行，并紧接新题的 Let；此模式在相邻题目拼接处出现。

patterns.name: 数字后的题目文本
patterns.context: 计算题的数值答案或数字表达式后，继续出现新题提示词；触发位置可能横跨题目边界。

patterns.name: artifact 的分析限制
patterns.context: 介绍文物科学研究时，描述研究应遵守的限制，尤其是尽量少破坏、直接在物件上进行。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，文物分析方法

patterns.name: motion 的等待阶段
patterns.context: 描述运动轨迹分阶段时，等待阶段用于优化定位；强烈激活集中于 waiting 与 time。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 科研论文，轨迹与定位

en.concept: Letter strings and common subword fragment detection
en.description: The most consistent trigger is the Marcel letter string split across words; it occasionally matches Carcel as well. “components” also repeatedly activates in technical or scientific contexts. Activations for Anchors, email phrases, and a public-health sentence are isolated and difficult to reconcile with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Marcel substring
patterns.context: The letter sequence Marcel appears across word boundaries or in names, often with different tokenizations; [1] is the Spanish phrase «Carcel de la Corte», which does not exactly match the spelling of Marcel.
patterns.domain: Incidental spellings in personal names, place names, and book titles; novels, Wikipedia, legal texts, and astrophysics papers

patterns.name: components
patterns.context: The word appears in statements about constituent parts, ingredients, or components; activation is concentrated on the word itself.

patterns.name: Isolated AnChors string
patterns.context: The capitalized string Anchors appears in code or structured text; nearby are YAML-style key-value pairs and Khmer text.

patterns.name: Isolated “on recent” phrase
patterns.context: An email notifies recipients about recent activity; activation falls on “on” in a common phrase.

patterns.name: Isolated homelessness phrase
patterns.context: Literature discusses homeless individuals responding to drug abuse; activation is distributed across several common words in the sentence, with no clear shared trigger with other passages.

4_2253.concept: 字母串与常见词片段探测
4_2253.description: 最一致的触发是跨词切分的 Marcel 字母串，偶尔也命中 Carcel；另有 components 在技术或科学语境反复激活。Anchors、邮件短语及公共卫生句的激活较孤立，难与主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: Marcel 子串
patterns.context: 跨词边界或姓名中出现字母序列 Marcel，且常以不同 token 切分；[1] 是西班牙语短语 «Carcel de la Corte»，与 Marcel 拼写并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 人名、地名及书名中的偶然拼写；小说、Wikipedia、法律和天体物理论文

patterns.name: components
patterns.context: 该词出现在对组成部分、成分或部件的陈述中；触发集中在词本身。
patterns.domain: 专利技术描述、科学论文

patterns.name: 孤立 AnChors 字符串
patterns.context: 代码或结构化文本中出现首字母大写的 Anchors 字符串；附近有 YAML 样式键值和高棉文字。

patterns.name: 孤立 on recent 短语
patterns.context: 邮件中通知收件人近期活动；激活落在常见短语中的 on。

patterns.name: 孤立 homelessness 短语
patterns.context: 讨论无家可归者应对药物滥用的文献；激活分布在该句多个常用词上，未见与其他段落明确共有的触发。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要/公共卫生

en.concept: Character patterns across subword fragments (including arcel)
en.description: Activation most consistently falls on character fragments containing Marcel/Carcel/Barcel, and also appears on subword fragments such as components and Anchors with no clear shared semantics. Contexts span multiple genres and are difficult to attribute to a single topic.

patterns.name: Marcel string
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the string Marcel in names or quotations, with spelling split across tokens; capitalization and surrounding characters vary. Examples include names at the start of a passage, names in article citations, and names in legal texts.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, academic citations, legal records

patterns.name: components
patterns.context: The word appears in engineering descriptions and biomaterials research; the word itself triggers activation despite differing subject domains.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, technical papers, biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Carcel
patterns.context: The word form Carcel in a Spanish title, occurring in book chapter titles and prison-related titles.

patterns.name: homeless individual coping
patterns.context: Academic phrasing about how homeless people cope with substance abuse; activation spans multiple adjacent subword fragments.

patterns.name: Activity update notice
patterns.context: An email updating the recipient on recent activities, including the wording “update you on recent activities”.

patterns.name: Khmer JSON field
patterns.context: Field names, quotation marks, and Khmer strings appear in structured code data; strong activation falls on tokenized fragments of Anchors.

patterns.name: Official named Marcel
patterns.context: The person’s name Marcel Buysse appears repeatedly in an encyclopedia entry.

patterns.name: Cited author name Marcel
patterns.context: The author’s surname Barceló appears in an astrophysics paper citation; activation falls on tokenized fragments of the surname.

patterns.name: Legal party named Marcel
patterns.context: The defendant’s name, Marcel James Diggie, appears in a legal case record.

4_2253.concept: 跨词片段的字符模式（含 arcel）
4_2253.description: 激活最稳定地落在含 Marcel/Carcel/Barcel 的字符片段，也出现在 components、Anchors 等无明显共同语义的词片段；上下文横跨多种文体，难以归为单一主题。

patterns.name: Marcel 字符串
patterns.context: 激活集中在跨 token 拼写的人名或引用中的字符串 Marcel，大小写及前后字符有所变化；包括段首姓名、文章引用姓名和法律文本中的姓名。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、学术引文、法律记录

patterns.name: components
patterns.context: 该词在工程描述及生物材料研究中出现；词本身触发，与主题领域不同。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、技术论文、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: Carcel
patterns.context: 西班牙语标题中的词形 Carcel；处于书籍章节标题与监狱相关标题之间。

patterns.name: homeless individual coping
patterns.context: 讨论无家可归者应对药物滥用的学术表述；激活跨越多个相邻词片段。

patterns.name: 通知活动更新
patterns.context: 邮件中向收件人更新近期活动，含“update you on recent activities”措辞。

patterns.name: 高棉语 JSON 字段
patterns.context: 结构化代码数据中出现字段名、引号和高棉语字符串；强激活落在 Anchors 的分词片段。

patterns.name: 官员姓名 Marcel
patterns.context: 人物姓名 Marcel Buysse 在百科条目中重复出现。

patterns.name: 引用作者名 Marcel
patterns.context: 天体物理论文引用中作者姓 Barceló；激活落在姓氏的分词片段。

patterns.name: 法律当事人姓名 Marcel
patterns.context: 法律案件记录中的被告姓名 Marcel James Diggie。

en.concept: Mixed word forms and local phrase features
en.description: Activation cues are scattered: it repeatedly hits “arcel” in names and “components” in technical contexts. There are also isolated instances of two “on” constructions, Khmer configuration text, and the medical word “inadvertently”; no single trigger condition accounts for all fragments.

patterns.name: “Barcel” substring
patterns.context: Appears in the spelling of a first or last name; activation concentrates near the substring “arcel”, with varying prefixes and following spelling.
patterns.domain: Literary texts, encyclopedia entries, astrophysics papers

patterns.name: “components” and descriptions of it
patterns.context: Describes parts, composition, or constituent elements in technical or scientific contexts.

patterns.name: Topic phrase after “on”
patterns.context: The “literature on …” construction introduces a research topic.
patterns.domain: Public health or social medicine abstracts

patterns.name: Status-update phrase after “on”
patterns.context: An email uses “update you on …” to introduce recent developments or matters.

patterns.name: Khmer interface string
patterns.context: Khmer text appears in menu, name, and noAnchors fields in YAML or similar configuration.

patterns.name: Local activation on “inadvertently”
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes accidental removal and reinsertion of a tunneled central venous catheter.

4_2253.concept: 混合词形与局部短语特征
4_2253.description: 激活线索分散：反复命中人名中的“arcel”和技术语境的“components”；另有两个“on”结构、柬文配置文本及医学词“inadvertently”等单例，未见能覆盖全部片段的统一触发条件。

patterns.name: “Barcel”子串
patterns.trigger: «B»…«arcel»（片段1的“Barcel”跨 token 写作 «C»«arcel»，片段2为 «M»«arcel»，片段10为 @B«arcel»）
patterns.context: 出现在人名或姓氏的拼写中；激活集中在子串“arcel”附近，前缀和后续拼写各异。
patterns.domain: 文学文本、百科条目、天体物理论文

patterns.name: “components”及其说明
patterns.trigger: “components”在片段3、5、6中均被标记为强激活（片段3 «components»10，片段5 «components»9，片段6 «components»9）；片段3另有“comprise”。
patterns.context: 技术或科学语境中描述组成部件、构成或组成成分。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、工程、电磁学、生物医学

patterns.name: “on”后的议题短语
patterns.trigger: «on»9，后接“homeless individuals coping with drug abuse”。
patterns.context: “literature on …”结构中，引出研究主题。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或社会医学摘要

patterns.name: “on”后的状态更新短语
patterns.context: 邮件中以“update you on …”引出近况或事项。

patterns.name: 柬文界面字符串
patterns.context: YAML/类似配置的 menu、name、noAnchors 字段中出现柬文文本。

patterns.name: “inadvertently”的局部激活
patterns.context: 描述隧道式中心静脉导管被意外移除及重新置入的医学摘要。

en.concept: Specific substrings at word beginnings and within words
en.description: Activation mainly falls on word-initial Con (conventionally, conventional, concomitant, conjugated), and also appears in proper-name fragments such as Marcel, Conrad, and Carcel, as well as in components; spans patent, medical, encyclopedia, and literary texts.

patterns.name: Word-initial Con- fragment
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on «Con» at the beginning of words; subsequent forms vary and include conventionally, conventional, concomitant, conjugated

patterns.name: Subword fragments in names
patterns.context: These substrings appear in personal or proper names; Carcel in [3] occurs in the French title «Carcel de la Corte»

patterns.name: components in general sentences
patterns.context: A patent sentence describes components and their composition; activation mainly falls on components

4_2253.description: 激活主要落在词首 Con（conventionally、conventional、concomitant、conjugated），也出现在 Marcel、Conrad、Carcel 等专名片段及 components；跨专利、医学、百科和文学文本。

patterns.name: Con-词首片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在单词开头的 «Con»；后续词形各异，涵盖 conventionally、conventional、concomitant、conjugated

patterns.name: 人名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 人名或专名中出现这些子串；[3]中的 Carcel 位于法语标题 «Carcel de la Corte»
patterns.domain: 百科条目、古典文学文本

patterns.name: 一般句子中的组件词
patterns.context: 专利句子中描述组件及其构成；激活主要落在 components

en.description: Most fragments activate on the Con substring at the beginning or within English words across different contexts, including patents and medicine. Two other fragments occur inside names and one is a generic phrase in a patent; these are not fully explained by that pattern.

patterns.name: Word-initial Con fragment
patterns.context: Strong activation concentrates on the initial subword Con in English words, while subsequent meanings and sentence topics vary. It appears in several USPTO and PubMed passages.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, medical abstracts, general English

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment in a name
patterns.context: A proper name appears in Wikipedia-style text, followed by a line break and a repeated name. It superficially resembles the word-initial Con pattern but is not an ordinary lexical use.

patterns.name: Generic phrase in a patent
patterns.context: A sentence opening in patent background text describes component composition and specific parts; no Con-triggering fragment is present.

4_2253.concept: 英语中的 Con 子串
4_2253.description: 多数片段在英语词首或词内的 Con 子串处激活，涵盖专利、医学等不同语境；另有两段姓名内部片段和一段专利普通词组，不能由该模式充分解释。

patterns.name: Con 起始词片段
patterns.trigger: 句首或词首的 «Con»；常继续为 «Con»ventionally、«Con»ventional、«Con»comitant、«Con»jugated、«Con»formational
patterns.context: 高激活集中在英语词的起始子串 Con，后续词义和句子主题不固定；在若干 USPTO 与 PubMed 片段中出现。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学摘要及一般英语

patterns.name: 人名中的分词片段
patterns.trigger: «M»arcel «Bu»ysse、«Con»rad Logan；激活涉及名字内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 专名在 Wikipedia 条目式文本中出现，后有换行和重复姓名；与 Con 起始词模式表面相似，但不是普通词汇用法。

patterns.name: 专利短语中的普通词组
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中的句子开头，描述组件构成及特定部件；未见 Con 触发片段。

en.description: The activation pattern is scattered: inspection appears in patent, regulatory, and real-estate texts, while medical terms such as vision and language disorders also activate. Other local strings concern component composition, public health, photon methods, target quotations, and commercial advertising, making them difficult to group under a single semantic category.

patterns.name: inspection and related forms
patterns.context: Inspection and its inflected or compound forms appear in contexts involving inspectors conducting inspections, inspection light sources/defect detection, and contractual inspection periods.
patterns.domain: Regulatory texts, semiconductor patents, real-estate descriptions

patterns.name: vision
patterns.context: Vision screening tools or threatening complications related to eyesight

patterns.name: Terms for language disorders
patterns.context: Descriptions of dyslexia subtypes, language disorders, and their manifestations

patterns.name: Statements about components and composition
patterns.context: A patent background explains how certain parts make up a seat component

patterns.name: homeless individuals and drug abuse
patterns.context: Discusses related literature and homeless individuals responding to drug abuse; words span token fragments

patterns.name: Photon and color sequences
patterns.context: Discusses conformational changes in photon intervals and recognition when color sequences appear scrambled

patterns.name: Target and series transition sentence
patterns.context: A sentence introducing the following text by turning to a series of targets

patterns.name: estate coaching and infomercials
patterns.context: Mentions real-estate training companies, advertisements, and conditions for refunding deposits

4_2253.description: 激活模式分散：inspection 在专利、监管及房地产文本中出现，vision、语言障碍等医学词汇也有激活；另有成分构成、公共卫生、光子方法、目标引述和商业广告等局部词串，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: inspection 及其同族词
patterns.context: inspection 及其屈折或复合用法；分别见检查人员执行检查、检查光源/缺陷检测、合同检查期等上下文
patterns.domain: 监管、半导体专利、房地产说明

patterns.name: vision
patterns.context: 视觉筛查工具或视力相关的威胁性并发症

patterns.name: 语言障碍类别词
patterns.context: 描述阅读障碍亚型、语言障碍及其表现

patterns.name: 成分与组成表述
patterns.context: 专利背景中说明某些部件构成座椅部件

patterns.name: homeless individuals 与 drug abuse
patterns.context: 讨论相关文献及无家可归者应对药物滥用；词语跨分词片段
patterns.domain: 公共卫生/研究项目文本

patterns.name: 光子与颜色序列
patterns.context: 讨论光子间隔中的构象变化，以及颜色序列看似打乱时的识别

patterns.name: 目标与系列转折句
patterns.context: 以转向某系列目标的句式引出下文

patterns.name: estate coaching 与 infomercials
patterns.context: 谈及房地产培训公司、广告和订金退还条件

en.description: The main pattern concerns “inadvertently” and the accidental omissions, misoperations, mislabeling, damage, or outcomes it introduces. Other isolated activations include explaining, patent boilerplate, and email name fragments.

patterns.name: Related to “inadvertently”
patterns.context: The word appears directly, usually describing something happening unintentionally; in multiple passages it is the highest-activation point.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, scientific papers, emails, etc.

patterns.name: Oversight or omission
patterns.context: Describes a part unintentionally left out during assembly; “inadvertently” also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Preventing accidental operation
patterns.context: Describes a locking arm or retaining arm being accidentally operated; preceding text explains that a cover structure is intended to prevent this.

patterns.name: Water accidentally entering a crack
patterns.context: Describes water possibly entering cracks in a material unintentionally during rolling.

patterns.name: Unintentional mislabeling
patterns.context: Uncontrolled labels may cause a content topic to be mislabeled.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, information retrieval and content labeling

patterns.name: Accidental injury to adjacent tissue
patterns.context: Describes the possibility of unintentionally puncturing adjacent tissue or organs during a transesophageal procedure.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, medical devices and surgery

patterns.name: Part omitted during assembly
patterns.context: Describes a component being unintentionally omitted during assembly of a connector assembly.

patterns.name: Unintentionally producing a positive effect
patterns.context: Describes a system design that may unintentionally produce a positive effect.

patterns.name: Explanatory wording
patterns.context: Activation falls on “explaining,” meaning an explanation of research results or limitations; “inadvertently” is absent.

patterns.name: Patent boilerplate fragment
patterns.context: An isolated patent-description boilerplate phrase; no obvious trigger shared with other highly activated words.

patterns.name: Business email and name fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a recipient-name fragment, surrounded by arrangements for approving and sending a press release; no obvious shared semantic trigger.

4_2253.description: 主模式是对“inadvertently”（非故意地）及其引出的意外遗漏、误操作、误标、损伤或结果敏感；另有 explaining、专利套语及邮件人名等孤立激活。

patterns.name: “inadvertently”相关
patterns.context: 该词直接出现，通常描述某事非故意发生；在多处是最高激活点。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科研论文、邮件等

patterns.name: 疏漏或遗漏
patterns.context: 描述组装过程中零件被无意漏装；同段还有“inadvertently”。

patterns.name: 防止误操作
patterns.context: 描述锁臂、保持臂被意外操作，前文说明遮盖结构用于防止这种情况。

patterns.name: 水意外进入裂缝
patterns.context: 描述滚压时水可能非故意进入材料裂缝。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，道路施工材料

patterns.name: 无意误标
patterns.context: 未受控标签可能使内容主题被错误标记。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，信息检索与内容标注

patterns.name: 意外损伤邻近组织
patterns.context: 描述经食道操作时可能无意刺穿邻近组织或器官。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，医疗器械与手术

patterns.name: 组装时漏装部件
patterns.context: 描述组装接头组件时某部分被无意遗漏。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，电气组件组装

patterns.name: 意外产生正面影响
patterns.trigger: “inadvertently end up having a positive impact”
patterns.context: 描述系统设计可能非故意产生正面影响。

patterns.name: 解释性表述
patterns.context: 激活落在“explaining”，语义为解释研究结果或限制；未见“inadvertently”。
patterns.domain: NIH 科研摘要，癌症免疫治疗

patterns.name: 专利套语片段
patterns.context: 孤立的专利描述套语；未见明显与其他高激活词相同的触发。

patterns.name: 商业邮件与人名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在收件人姓名片段，周围是新闻稿审批与发送安排；无明显共同语义触发。

en.description: Strong activations often fall on find or morphologically varied fragments within words; one medical abstract also activates around quantities, scales, and examination terms. Some fragments may be coincidental and are difficult to group under a unified semantic category.

patterns.name: The “find” word family and cross-word fragments
patterns.context: The highest-intensity points are often subword fragments within or at the boundaries of words; explicit instances of find occur in “to find their way” and “could find no relationship,” while fragments from several other words resemble them.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains: stage directions, medical abstracts, patents, business emails, news, forums, traffic headlines, physiology abstracts, biographies

patterns.name: Quantities and examination terms in medical papers
patterns.context: Quantities, scales, examination procedures, and medical terms occur densely; activation falls on these words or fragments within them.

patterns.name: Stage lighting and performer access
patterns.context: Describes lighting that helps performers and technicians find their way in the dark during a performance; find is a standalone word in the sentence.

patterns.name: find in schizophrenia research
patterns.context: In the negative construction “could find no relationship,” find means that the study did not detect a relationship between variables.

4_2253.description: 强激活常落在 find 或形态各异的词内片段；另有一段医学摘要在数量、量表、检查术语处激活。部分片段可能只是偶合，难以归为统一语义。

patterns.name: “find”词族及其跨词片段
patterns.context: 强度最高处多为单词内部或边界处的子词片段；显式的 find 出现在“to find their way”和“could find no relationship”中，另有若干不同词的片段与其相似。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：舞台说明、医学摘要、专利、商务邮件、新闻、论坛、交通标题、生理学摘要、人物传记

patterns.name: 医学论文中的数量及检查术语
patterns.context: 数量、量表、检查过程及医学术语密集出现；激活分布在这些词或词内片段上。

patterns.name: 舞台灯光与演员通行
patterns.context: 介绍演出期间供演员和技术人员在暗处辨路的灯光；find 是句中独立词。

patterns.name: 精神分裂症研究中的 find
patterns.context: 在否定结构“could find no relationship”中，find 表示研究未发现变量间关系。

en.description: Activation often falls on sporadic subword fragments within words or across multilingual characters, most notably vis (e.g., viscoelastic, visage); there are also fragments in a Chinese idiom and an Arabic prayer. The passages differ greatly in domain and meaning, making it difficult to establish a unified trigger.

patterns.name: Cross-character fragment vis
patterns.context: The string appears within words or near hyphens/masking markers; it is not limited to a single domain or meaning.

patterns.name: Within-word letter fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within tokenized words or multibyte characters; the fragments span domains, with no consistent lexical or grammatical condition.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, medicine, philosophy, literature, and multilingual texts

patterns.name: Specific Chinese-character fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a Chinese idiom describing the appearance of the Four Great Beauties; fragments within the characters activate sporadically.

patterns.name: Arabic fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of an Arabic Islamic prayer; multiple letters and diacritical marks activate separately.

4_2253.description: 激活多落在词内或多语字符的零碎子词片段，最醒目的是 vis（如 viscoelastic、visage）；另有汉字成语和阿拉伯祈祷语片段。各段领域与语义差异大，难以确认统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 跨字符片段 vis
patterns.context: 该字符串出现在词内部或连字符/遮挡标记附近；并非只在一个固定领域或语义中出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、科研及其他文本

patterns.name: 词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词或多字节字符内部，片段本身跨领域，未见一致的词义或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、医学、哲学、文学及多语文本

patterns.name: 特定汉字片段
patterns.context: 出现在描述四大美女容貌的汉语成语中，汉字内部片段分散激活。

patterns.name: 阿拉伯文片段
patterns.context: 出现在伊斯兰祈祷语的阿拉伯文开头，多个字母及附加符号分别激活。

en.description: Primarily activates on word forms ending in -ing and their cross-token fragments, including gerunds, participles, and adjectives; semantics are varied, with a few additional contexts involving dance, music, funding, and spectra.

patterns.name: Nominalized verbs ending in -ing
patterns.context: Responds to words ending in -ing or -ing forms assembled across tokens; words may function as gerunds, nouns, or adjectives. They are often preceded by verb, adjective, or noun stems.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including encyclopedias, academic papers, policy texts, news, and music profiles

patterns.name: Dance and skating terms
patterns.context: Dance activities or figure-skating contexts appear; passage 1 concerns dancers and ballet, while passage 7 describes an athlete switching to ice dancing.

patterns.name: Expressions describing vocals or music
patterns.context: Evaluates the emotional quality or effect of a melody; song«writing»10 in passage 2 also refers to songwriting, but is not the same semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Policy funding
patterns.context: Concerns the provision or allocation of funding for employment programs or public education; all strongly activated words end in -ing.

patterns.name: Vibrational modes in ice and water spectra
patterns.context: Discusses molecular vibrations on ice surfaces or spectral band intensity; stretching is an -ing form, and bending is another form of the same kind.

patterns.name: Other unexplained -ing uses
patterns.context: Various participles, gerunds, or within-word tokenizations, with weaker intensity and no more specific semantic category.

4_2253.description: 主要对以 -ing 结尾的词形及其跨 token 片段激活，涵盖动名词、分词和形容词；语义分散，另有少量舞蹈、音乐、资金与光谱语境。

patterns.name: 词尾 -ing 的动词名词化
patterns.context: 对以 -ing 结尾的词或跨 token 拼成的 -ing 词形反应；词可作动名词、名词或形容词。前面常有动词、形容词或名词词干。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术论文、政策文本、新闻、音乐介绍等多种文体

patterns.name: 舞蹈与滑冰术语
patterns.context: 出现舞蹈活动或花样滑冰语境；段1是舞者与芭蕾，段7是运动员转向冰舞。

patterns.name: 描述声乐或音乐的表达
patterns.context: 评价音乐旋律的情绪或效果；此外段2的 song«writing»10 指歌曲创作，但不是同一语义触发。

patterns.name: 政策资金投入
patterns.context: 涉及就业项目或公共教育资金的提供、投入；强激活词均以 -ing 结尾。
patterns.domain: 欧盟政策文本、政治新闻

patterns.name: 冰与水的光谱振动模式
patterns.context: 讨论冰表面分子振动或光谱带强度；stretching 是 -ing 词形，bending 也属于同类形式。

patterns.name: 未解释的其他 -ing 用法
patterns.context: 多种分词、动名词或词内切分形式，强度较弱，无法归为更具体的语义类别。

en.description: Activation locations are scattered: several passages involve “-ing” nominalizations for operations or processes, but others activate content words, punctuation, and sentence beginnings. Domains and semantics are not unified, and no single pattern covers them all.

patterns.name: “-ing” nouns around word-final or stem “ing”
patterns.context: Appears in names of processes, systems, or operations, often alongside words such as procedures, systems, and information; gerunds or nominalized operations also appear near “monitoring,” “retrieval,” “fixing,” “touching,” “seeking,” “dist[r]acting,” and “occupancy.”
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including academic papers, patents, news commentary, emails, and institutional descriptions

patterns.name: Specific content words or local forms
patterns.context: Activation falls within or near a few content words, with no stable pattern explained by shared context.
patterns.domain: Separately concerns news commentary, insect chemical ecology, residential care facilities, discussion of sexual consent, and neuropsychology; varied genres

patterns.name: Punctuation and sentence-initial boundaries
patterns.context: In some passages, activation is near line breaks or punctuation, but other passages show no consistent boundary pattern.

4_2253.description: 各段触发位置分散：若干涉及“-ing”名词化操作或过程词，但也有内容词、标点和句首激活；领域与语义并不统一，无法用单一模式覆盖。

patterns.name: 词尾或词干“ing”前后的“-ing”类名词
patterns.context: 出现在过程、系统或操作的名称中，常与 procedures、systems、information 等词搭配；另见 “monitoring”“retrieval”“fixing”“touching”“seeking”“dist[r]acting”“occupancy”附近的动名词或名词化操作。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、新闻评论、邮件及机构介绍等多种文体

patterns.name: 特定内容词或局部词形
patterns.context: 激活落在少数内容词的内部或附近，未见可由共同上下文解释的稳定规律。
patterns.domain: 分别涉及新闻评论、昆虫化学生态、养老机构、性同意讨论、神经心理学；文体不一

patterns.name: 标点及句首边界
patterns.context: 部分段落的激活位于换行或标点附近，但其余段落没有一致边界模式。

en.concept: Maintenance and care words, plus several word endings
en.description: Strong activation falls on words related to care and maintenance, such as maintenance, care, and caring. High activation also occurs on parenting, comedies, and fragments of terms such as egg shell and anticoagulation, which are not readily explained by one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Words related to maintenance
patterns.context: Maintenance as a noun appears in contexts involving housing, equipment or system upkeep, or biological processes; it is sometimes modified by minimal, on-site, required, and similar words.

patterns.name: Care / caring word family
patterns.context: Care/caring refers to nursing, care services, or care relationships; the meaning varies with context.
patterns.domain: Nursing research, child welfare, medical services

patterns.name: Word endings in specific technical terms
patterns.context: Terms are split into multiple tokens; activation falls on the latter part or ending of a term rather than on a consistent semantic category.

patterns.name: parenting
patterns.context: Appears in the collocation “positive parenting”, describing positive parenting outcomes associated with open services.

patterns.name: comedies
patterns.context: Appears in a movie review describing comedies.

4_2253.concept: 维护与照护词及若干词尾
4_2253.description: 激活较强地落在 maintenance、care/caring 等照护与维护相关词上；另有 parenting、comedies 及 egg shell、anticoagulation 等术语片段的高激活，难以由同一语义规律充分解释。

patterns.name: maintenance 相关词
patterns.context: maintenance 作为名词，出现在住房维护、设备/系统维护或生物学过程的语境中；有时前面有 minimal、on-site、required 等修饰
patterns.domain: 日常邮件、专利、科研摘要

patterns.name: care / caring 词族
patterns.context: care/caring 指护理、照护服务或照护关系；词义随上下文变化
patterns.domain: 护理研究、儿童福利、医疗服务

patterns.name: 特定专业术语的词尾
patterns.context: 术语被拆分成多个 token；激活落在术语后部或结尾，而非一致的词义类别

patterns.name: parenting
patterns.context: 出现在“positive parenting”这一搭配中，描述开放服务带来的积极育儿结果

patterns.name: comedies
patterns.context: 出现在电影评论中，位于对喜剧作品的描述里

en.concept: Words related to care, maintenance, and protection
en.description: Activation is concentrated in care/caring and child support contexts involving care and welfare, and also appears in maintenance/servicing contexts. Other passages concern protective products and mental-health coping, and the trigger words are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Care, nursing, and welfare services
patterns.context: Concerns caregiving relationships, end-of-life care, child welfare, or family support obligations; related words need not be adjacent, as in child support.
patterns.domain: Nursing and social-welfare research, legal documents

patterns.name: Maintenance and repair
patterns.context: Describes reducing maintenance needs or maintaining and servicing equipment, vehicles, or housing.
patterns.domain: Everyday emails, patent backgrounds, legal and financial documents

patterns.name: Protection and safeguarding
patterns.context: Describes products or materials providing surface protection.

patterns.name: Mental health and coping
patterns.context: Discusses severe mental illness and positive coping strategies.

4_2253.concept: 照护、维护及保护相关词
4_2253.description: 激活集中在 care/caring 与 child support 等照护、福利语境，也出现在 maintenance/servicing 维护语境；另涉及防护产品及心理健康应对，触发词分布并不完全统一。

patterns.name: 照护、护理与福利服务
patterns.context: 涉及护理关系、临终照护、儿童福利或家庭抚养义务；相关词不一定相邻，如 child support。
patterns.domain: 护理与社会福利研究、法律文书

patterns.name: 维护与维修
patterns.context: 描述减少维护需求，或设备、车辆、住房的维护与服务。
patterns.domain: 日常邮件、专利背景、法律财务文书

patterns.name: 保护与防护
patterns.context: 描述产品或材料提供表面防护。

patterns.name: 心理健康与应对
patterns.context: 讨论严重精神疾病及积极应对策略。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生与心理健康研究

en.description: Strong activation is distributed across nursing and healthcare, Portuguese coordination word forms, governance, ecological conservation, and firefighting texts. Some passages share local thematic similarities, but triggers and domains are not consistent, so no single semantic explanation applies.

patterns.name: Nursing and care
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving care relationships, clinical pharmacy, patient adherence, healthcare, or end-of-life care; usually describes care actions, services, or support needs.

patterns.name: Coordination-related word forms
patterns.context: Portuguese coordination and collaboration word forms beginning with coorden-; activation concentrates on the internal fragment «en».
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, Portuguese-language philosophical introductions

patterns.name: Public affairs and governance
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of international governance, political systems, or public spending; no shared high-activation semantic word is apparent.

patterns.name: Ecological conservation management
patterns.context: Discusses tropical forest species loss, insufficient survey resources, and conservation management.

patterns.name: Firefighting equipment
patterns.context: Describes fire detection, automatic suppression systems, and extinguishing agents.

4_2253.description: 强激活分布于护理医疗、葡语协调词形、治理、生态保护和消防文本；部分段落有局部主题相似，但触发词与领域并不统一，无法由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: 护理与照护
patterns.context: 出现在护理关系、临床药学、患者依从性、健康照护或临终照护语境中；多为描述照护行为、服务或支持需求。

patterns.name: 协调相关词形
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中以 coorden- 开头的协调、协作词形；激活集中在词内片段«en»。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本、葡萄牙语哲学介绍

patterns.name: 公共事务与治理
patterns.context: 讨论国际治理、政治制度或公共支出时出现；未见共同的高激活语义词。

patterns.name: 生态保护管理
patterns.context: 讨论热带森林物种损失、调查资源不足及保护管理。

patterns.name: 消防设备
patterns.context: 描述火灾探测、自动灭火系统及灭火剂。

en.description: Activations are scattered across domains and topics; “carotenoids” is notably repeated in nutrition and biomedical texts. Other hits concern care, child support, public spending, patient services and variability, parenting compliance, and rights and crime, with no unified semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Nursing and caring relationships
patterns.context: In contexts involving relationships between nurses and residents, especially descriptions of promoting caring behavior or relationships.

patterns.name: Child support payments
patterns.context: In a family-law context, describes a parent failing to pay child support.

patterns.name: Public spending
patterns.context: Discusses differences in public spending in the context of Scottish politics and democracy.

patterns.name: Carotenoids
patterns.context: Discusses the stability, bioavailability, or release of carotenoids, or lists them as food components or antioxidants.
patterns.domain: Food science, nutrition, and biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: Patient adherence and counseling
patterns.context: Clinical pharmacy services describe promoting patient adherence, individualized counseling, and related assessments.

patterns.name: Inter- and intra-patient variability and clearance
patterns.context: Describes inter- and intra-patient CL variability and introduces predictors associated with reduced clearance.

patterns.name: Compliance and positive parenting
patterns.context: Discusses how professionals’ adherence to program theory explains how open services promote positive parenting.

patterns.name: Rights and crime
patterns.context: Discusses combating crime within a rights framework in a free and open society.

4_2253.description: 激活分散于不同领域和主题；明显重复的是营养与生物医学文本中的“carotenoids”。其余命中分别涉及关怀、抚养费、公共支出、患者服务与变异、育儿合规及权利犯罪，缺少统一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 护理与关怀关系
patterns.context: 护理、护士与住户关系的语境中，尤其是描述促进关怀行为或关怀关系时。

patterns.name: 抚养费与儿童支持
patterns.context: 家庭法语境中，描述父母未支付子女抚养费。

patterns.name: 公共支出
patterns.context: 苏格兰政治与民主讨论中，谈及公共支出差异。

patterns.name: 类胡萝卜素
patterns.context: 谈及类胡萝卜素的稳定性、生物利用度、释放，或将其列为食物成分、抗氧化物。
patterns.domain: 食品科学、营养与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 患者依从性与咨询
patterns.context: 临床药学服务中，说明促进患者依从性、个体化咨询及相关评估。

patterns.name: 患者个体内外变异与清除率
patterns.context: 描述患者间及患者内 CL 变异，并引出与清除率降低相关的预测因素。

patterns.name: 合规与积极育儿
patterns.context: 讨论专业人员遵循项目理论如何解释开放服务促进积极育儿。

patterns.name: 权利与犯罪
patterns.context: 在自由开放社会的权利框架内讨论打击犯罪。

en.concept: Word-internal substrings and local word-form triggers
en.description: The most consistent trigger is en within carotenoids. There are also local strong responses to care/caring, support, iz in organizational, line breaks in formulas, and fact in counterfactual. Other weaker markers are scattered, with no unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: en substring in carotenoid-related words
patterns.context: Within the word carotenoids, especially when en is followed by oid(s); appears in nutrition, food, phytochemistry, or experimental research contexts.

patterns.name: care/caring vocabulary
patterns.context: Discussions of care, nursing relationships, or caregiving; activation falls on the care/caring stem.

patterns.name: support vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses whether parents pay child support; activation occurs on the word support.

patterns.name: iz substring in organization-related words
patterns.context: The word organizational is split into tokens, with strong activation on the iz substring.

patterns.name: Line breaks in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: An explicit line break appears in a mathematical formula, near discussion of neutrino mass, mixing angles, and oscillation data.

patterns.name: fact substring in counterfactual
patterns.context: Discusses counterfactual thinking and its relationship to elections and willingness to engage in collective action; strong activation falls on the fact substring.

patterns.name: Unmerged weak sporadic activations
patterns.context: Several markers fall on different words or subword fragments and show no stable shared condition beyond the triggers summarized above.

4_2253.concept: 词内子串与局部词形触发
4_2253.description: 最稳定的触发是 carotenoids 内的 en；另对 care/caring、support、organizational 中 iz、公式换行及 counterfactual 中 fact 有局部强响应。其余较弱标记分散，未见统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 类胡萝卜素相关词中的 en 子串
patterns.context: 在 carotenoids 这个词内部，尤其是 en 与后续 oid(s) 连写时；在营养、食品、植物化学或实验研究语境中出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、食品科学、植物化学

patterns.name: care/caring 词汇
patterns.context: 照护、护理关系或护理行为的讨论；激活落在 care/caring 词干上。

patterns.name: support 词汇
patterns.context: 谈及父母是否支付子女抚养费，激活位于 support 一词。

patterns.name: 组织相关词中的 iz 子串
patterns.context: organizational diversity 一词被拆分标注，强激活位于 iz 子串。
patterns.domain: 组织管理与多元化研究

patterns.name: 数理表达中的换行符
patterns.context: 数学公式中出现显式换行，附近讨论中微子质量、混合角及振荡数据。

patterns.name: counterfactual 词中的 fact 子串
patterns.context: 讨论反事实想法及其与选举、集体行动意愿的关系；强激活落在 fact 子串。
patterns.domain: 社会心理学、政治行为研究

patterns.name: 无法归并的弱零散激活
patterns.context: 若干标记落在不同词或词片段上，除上述已归纳触发外，未显示稳定共同条件。

en.description: Dispersed patterns: organizational diversity in management, child support in law, mathematical equation line breaks, nutritional components and carotenoids, mnemonic words, transportation planning, and Portuguese and Dutch subword fragments; there is no stable shared semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: organisational
patterns.context: Organizational diversity in organizational and management studies; activation concentrates near “izational” and “diversity”

patterns.name: child support
patterns.context: Family-law context describing a mother who did not pay child support

patterns.name: Mathematical equation line breaks
patterns.context: Line breaks in mathematical equation layout; strong activation falls on equation line boundaries or newline characters

patterns.name: Chemical components and carotenoids
patterns.context: Discussing the nutritional components of plants or food, the subject of analysis, or the properties of carotenoids

patterns.name: Words in a passphrase
patterns.context: A sequence of English words appears in a cryptocurrency mnemonic example; activation falls on words within the phrase

patterns.name: Bicycle lanes and vehicle crossings
patterns.context: Road design describing bicycle lanes, conflict zones, and right-turning vehicles crossing them

patterns.name: Portuguese word-final fragment
patterns.context: Portuguese parliamentary speech; activation falls on in-word substrings and surrounding words

patterns.name: Dutch word-final fragment
patterns.context: A word ending in this fragment appears in Dutch parliamentary text

4_2253.description: 模式分散：管理学组织多样性、法律中的 child support、公式换行、营养成分与类胡萝卜素、助记词、交通规划，以及葡语和荷兰语词内片段；没有稳定共享的语义或领域。

patterns.name: organisational
patterns.context: 组织/管理研究中谈组织多样性，激活集中在“izational”及“diversity”附近

patterns.name: child support
patterns.context: 家庭法语境中说明母亲未支付子女抚养费

patterns.name: 数学公式换行
patterns.trigger: "↵"，以及公式中的反斜杠、LaTeX 命令
patterns.context: 数学公式排版中出现换行；强激活落在公式行边界或换行符

patterns.name: 化学成分与类胡萝卜素
patterns.context: 讨论植物/食品的营养成分、分析对象或类胡萝卜素的性质

patterns.name: 密码短语中的词
patterns.context: 加密货币助记词示例中出现一串英文词；具体激活落在短语内的词

patterns.name: 自行车道与车辆交叉
patterns.context: 道路设计说明自行车道、冲突区及右转车辆穿越

patterns.name: 葡语词尾片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会发言；激活落在词内子串及周边词上

patterns.name: 荷兰语词尾片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会文本中出现以该片段结尾的词

en.description: The main response is to the family-law term child support, but there are also responses to fur, organizational word forms, and several domain-specific terms. Other activations occur in medical interventions, movie titles, intercultural education, and scattered common-word fragments, making a single semantic pattern difficult to identify.

patterns.name: child support family-law context
patterns.context: “child support” appears in accounts involving parents, child support obligations, divorce, or unpaid support. It often co-occurs with words such as custody, paid, Father, and husband.

patterns.name: fur word / seed word
patterns.context: One instance is the standalone word fur in a mnemonic word sequence; another describes the short, dense fur of a Russian Blue cat.

patterns.name: organizational spelling fragments
patterns.context: Appears in formal statements about organizational arrangements or measures; the word is split into multiple activation fragments, including British spelling and variants.

patterns.name: Fragments of medical intervention terms
patterns.context: Multiple internal fragments of medical terms are marked in descriptions of intravascular ultrasound, PCI, and coronary medications.

patterns.name: Numbers in movie titles
patterns.context: In a list of films, the number word Three and the beginning of the title Angels are marked; the list also includes years.

patterns.name: Intercultural education phrase
patterns.context: Describes incorporating intercultural education into health-professional training to address health disparities.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions, public health education

patterns.name: Isolated structural or common-word fragments
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across different contexts and show no consistent semantic or syntactic condition; they may reflect subword fragments, formatting, or local collocations.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including legal, parliamentary, medical, and encyclopedia texts

4_2253.concept: 多种词汇与词片段触发
4_2253.description: 主要响应 child support 家庭法用语，也响应 fur、organizational 词形片段及若干领域术语；另有医学介入、电影标题、跨文化教育和分散的常用词片段，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: child support 家庭法语境
patterns.context: “child support”出现在父母、子女抚养、离婚或未支付抚养费的叙述中；并常与 custody、paid、Father、husband 等词同现。

patterns.name: fur 毛皮／种子词

en.description: The strongest shared pattern is the legal context of child support; the fur substring also appears across several domains, along with sporadic activations on the full word accommodation and on among. The triggering word forms have no single stable meaning.

patterns.name: Child support
patterns.context: In legal rulings or family arrangements, especially around child support, describing payment amounts, payment obligations, or nonpayment.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, divorce, custody, and child-support legal texts

patterns.name: Token fragment fur
patterns.context: Activation falls on the substring fur in compound words or within words; it appears in mnemonic lists, references to cat fur and character fur, and the horse-racing distance unit furlongs.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in component term

patterns.domain: Military encyclopedias and medical research abstracts

patterns.name: Phrase with among
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence about programmers regarding leap second handling, referring to confusion among programmers.

4_2253.concept: 词形片段与子女抚养费

en.description: Activation has no single stable semantic interpretation: it is scattered across words or phrase fragments such as appraisals, the family-law phrase child support, technical and medical terms, forest-floor cover, movie titles, and walking-aid support. In several cases, subword tokenization may be a factor.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of the substring apprais

patterns.name: child support legal phrase
patterns.context: In legal accounts of divorce, child support obligations, or expenses, support forms a fixed phrase with child.

patterns.name: Local combination in among the
patterns.context: A sentence about a programmer’s confusion over leap-second handling; strong activation concentrates on among.

patterns.name: Forest seed phrase
patterns.context: A split word fragment follows forest in an Electrum seed example.

patterns.name: Cardiac rhythm term fragment

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Angels

patterns.name: Walking-aid support
patterns.context: In an assessment of walking ability, support refers to aids such as canes and braces.
