There is no clear semantic trigger common to all texts.

patterns.name: Child support and custody arrangements
patterns.context: Family-law rulings or disputes discussing child support, custody, visitation, education, and medical expenses; activation is especially prominent near “child support.”

patterns.name: Real estate and co-ownership disputes
patterns.context: Litigation or appeals discussing property division, real-estate ownership, or co-ownership.

patterns.name: Film titles and year lists

patterns.name: Church offices and classifications in Britain
patterns.context: Descriptions of church offices, dioceses, or related classifications.

patterns.name: Discourse on abolition and slavery

patterns.name: Family environment and child assessment
patterns.context: Research designs listing assessments and measurements of children, family environments, or parents.

patterns.name: Hospital resource use and management
patterns.context: Discussing the efficient use of inpatient facilities, beds, and existing resources, and organizational measures.

patterns.name: Fragments in Lithuanian text
patterns.context: Continuous Lithuanian text with prominent subword-fragment activations; the given context is insufficient to identify a specific semantic trigger.

patterns.context: 介绍教会职务、教区或相关分类条目。

patterns.name: 废奴与奴隶制论述

patterns.context: 连续立陶宛语文本，出现显著的子词片段激活；所给上下文不足以确定具体语义触发条件。

en.description: Highlights fall mainly on fur (including furious, fur, and fur near) and several internal substrings with no clear shared semantics; there are also a few line-break markers. Domains and contexts differ substantially, suggesting subword or character patterns rather than a unified topic.

patterns.name: fur subword fragment
patterns.context: English words or phrases beginning with fur; the fragment alone does not show whether activation depends on the full word or the subword.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: fiction, animal descriptions, horse racing, mnemonic seeds, general narrative

patterns.name: Other highlighted subword fragments
patterns.context: Local subwords or character fragments in each passage, with widely varying surrounding contexts; no shared semantic or grammatical condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting markers
patterns.context: Appear at paragraph or line boundaries, often alongside word fragments in the body text; it is unclear whether they are independent triggers.

4_2253.concept: 含 fur 的子词片段
4_2253.description: 高亮主要落在 fur（含 furious、fur、fur near 等）及若干无明显共同语义的词内子串；另有少量换行标记。文本领域与上下文差异显著，可能反映子词或字符模式，而非统一主题。

patterns.name: fur 子词片段

en.concept: Mixed responses to specific subword fragments and symbols
en.description: Activation locations are dispersed: Lithuanian word-initial fragments, en within words across languages, mathematical subscripts in papers, and word-final fragments in mothering and overcrowding. There is no stable semantic theme across passages; some hits may be coincidental subword or character fragments.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment matching English abbreviation content
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments matching en within cross-lingual or line-broken words; the contexts are semantically inconsistent.

patterns.name: Lithuanian words containing the letter sequence od

patterns.name: Subscript characters in specific astrophysical notation
patterns.context: Activation appears in LaTeX mathematical expressions, especially subscript markers and adjacent symbols; some represent physical quantities or cosmological parameters.

patterns.name: Suffix in a word related to mothering
patterns.context: Activation falls on the suffix of mothering in a passage describing adoptive parenting.

patterns.name: End of the word crowding
patterns.context: Activation falls on the end of overcrowding in a list of socioeconomic indicators, preceded by references to family housing and other factors.
patterns.domain: Population and socioeconomic variables in medical papers

4_2253.concept: 特定子词片段与符号的混合响应

en.description: The main response is to internal cont-/conten- fragments across multiple languages, but there are also responses to ren fragments, area/overcrowding word fragments in a statistics paper, and several fragments in a Swedish parliamentary text; word meanings and contexts are not consistent.

patterns.name: “conten-”-related stems
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words beginning with cont-/conten- in multiple languages. Meanings vary, including “contain/containing,” “content,” and conditions in English legal text.
patterns.domain: Portuguese technical discussion, French and Italian parliamentary texts, English legal texts, Spanish parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Words containing the ren fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the internal character fragment ren; one instance is the Lithuanian word for “decide,” and another is a fragment of the biochemical term prenyltransferase.

patterns.name: “area” and nearby statistical terms
patterns.context: Appears in a statistical methods sentence describing the components of an area deprivation index; activated fragments span multiple English words, especially area and fragments within overcrowding.

patterns.name: Swedish short words or endings
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across several word fragments in a Swedish parliamentary text, involving a proposed revision, a meeting date, and the identity of the questioner; no stable single meaning or positional pattern is apparent.

4_2253.description: 主要对多语种 cont-/conten- 词内片段强烈响应，但也响应 ren 片段、统计论文中的 area/overcrowding 词片段及一段瑞典语议会文本中的多处碎片；词义和语境并不统一。

patterns.name: “conten-”相关词干

en.concept: Scientific notation and technical text fragments
en.description: Activations occur mostly near formulas and technical notation in academic text, especially Greek letters, subscripted parameters, variables, and scientific terms; they also cover clinical values, units of measurement, and segmented word forms. The pattern is dispersed and cannot be fully explained by a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Sigma in mathematical symbols and formulas
patterns.context: The Greek letter sigma appears in mathematical formulas or quantity notation, often with subscripts, superscripts, or variables; activation falls on different parts of the symbol string.
patterns.domain: Physics, astronomy, statistics, and other academic papers

patterns.name: Density or cosmological parameters in scientific formulas
patterns.context: Cosmological formulas and parameter explanations, especially contexts describing the age of the universe and total density parameters.

patterns.name: Specific word forms in technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls inside segmented technical terms or chemical names; the former are paper terminology, while the latter are polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon names.
patterns.domain: Astronomy, condensed matter physics, environmental health

patterns.name: Values and units in clinical records
patterns.context: In clinical descriptions of patient conditions and lab results, activation covers fragments of test indicators, values, and units.
patterns.domain: Medical case reports or clinical studies

patterns.name: Time variables and subscripts in formulas

patterns.name: Kappa parameter in physics formulas

patterns.name: Surface tension symbol
patterns.context: In a theoretical discussion, uppercase Sigma denotes the induced value of surface tension.

patterns.name: F and Sigma notation in formulas
patterns.context: Formula fragments at the end of a mathematical derivation; activation involves a subscripted F term and an S notation containing Sigma.

patterns.name: Number and measurement formats
patterns.context: When values are adjacent to medical or biological sample measurement units, activation falls on local portions of the number, unit, and slash format.

patterns.name: Local subwords in technical terms

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式中的 sigma
patterns.context: 希腊字母 sigma 出现在数学公式或量的记号中，常带下标、上标或变量；激活落在符号串的不同部分。

patterns.name: 科学公式中的密度或宇宙学参数

patterns.name: 专业术语中的特定词形

patterns.name: 临床记录中的数值与单位

patterns.name: 公式中的时间变量及下标
patterns.context: 宇宙学公式中用带下标的 t 表示时间，并在后文解释变量含义。

patterns.name: 物理公式中的 kappa 参数

patterns.domain: 核物理或粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 表面张力符号

patterns.name: 公式中的 F 与 Sigma 记号
patterns.context: 数学推导末尾的公式片段，激活涉及带下标的 F 项及含 Sigma 的 S 记号。

patterns.name: 数字及计量格式
patterns.context: 数值与医学或生物样本计量单位相邻时，激活落在数字、单位及斜线格式的局部。

patterns.name: 专业词中的局部子词
patterns.context: 激活出现在普通英语词被拆分的子词片段中；未见稳定的共同语义条件。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on numbers, units, statistical symbols, and adjacent abbreviations in specialized academic texts. Medical research is most common, but quantitative environmental pollution reports and astrophysical equations also appear, along with one comparative expression.

patterns.name: Units, values, and abbreviation boundaries in medical/biomedical contexts
patterns.context: Numeric expressions for laboratory measures, doses, intake, statistical results, or clinical endpoints in medical papers; activation often falls on numbers, unit symbols, abbreviations, and their separators

patterns.name: Quantitative environmental pollution and substance names
patterns.context: Pollutant types, concentrations, or emissions/growth amounts and units in environmental reports or test results
patterns.domain: Environmental science, pollution monitoring and reporting

patterns.name: Astrophysical parameters and equation notation
patterns.context: Equation and parameter symbols embedded in academic discussion of model constraints, mass fluctuations, and systematic errors

patterns.name: Contrast or comparative words in quantitative results
patterns.context: Comparative constructions adjacent to numerical comparisons

4_2253.concept: 学术文本中的定量记号
4_2253.description: 激活主要集中于专业学术文本中数值、单位、统计符号及其相邻缩写；医学研究最常见，也见环境污染定量报告和天体物理公式，另有一次比较词触发。

patterns.name: 医学/生物医学语境中的单位、数值与缩写边界
patterns.context: 医学论文中实验室指标、剂量、摄入量、统计结果或临床终点的数字表达；激活常落在数字、单位符号、缩写及其分隔处

patterns.name: 天体物理参数与公式记号

en.description: Activations occur across formulas and symbols, numbers and measurement units, quantitative results, and chemical or nutrition terminology in research texts. They appear in medical, environmental, and astrophysical corpora, with no single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Slashes and time/mass units in scientific measurements
patterns.context: Numbers, quantities, or abbreviations are slash-separated from units, denominators, or ratios, especially for concentrations, intake, and medical indicators.

patterns.name: Numeric ranges or quantity expressions
patterns.context: Scientific or clinical prose contains measurements, doses, durations, orders of magnitude, or ranges; activation may fall on a number, unit, or adjacent word.
patterns.domain: Research papers, medical abstracts, environmental reports

patterns.name: Mathematical and physics formula symbols
patterns.context: Near formulas, subscripts, fractions, or scientific symbols, mixed with explanatory prose and formatting markers.

patterns.name: Quantitative results or statistical descriptions in scientific prose
patterns.context: Research results or methods describe pollution changes, model fits, observational data, or statistical analyses; activation is dispersed across terminology and adjacent phrases.

patterns.name: Chemical substances and nutrition/pollutant names
patterns.context: When discussing dietary components, blood indicators, or chemicals in environmental samples, compound names and their parts are marked.

patterns.name: Salt intake recommendations and public health statements
patterns.context: Describes the benefits of reducing salt intake, organizational recommendations, or intake targets for population groups.

4_2253.concept: 科学文本中的量化表达
4_2253.description: 激活分布于科研文本中的公式与符号、数字及计量单位、定量结果和化学/营养术语；医学、环境与天体物理语料均有出现，未见单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 科学计量单位中的斜线与时间/质量单位

patterns.name: 数值范围或数量表达

patterns.domain: 科研论文、医学摘要、环境报告

patterns.name: 数学与物理公式符号
patterns.context: 公式、下标、分数或科学符号周围，夹杂正文解释与排版标记。

patterns.name: 科学叙述中的量化结果或统计描述

en.description: Activations occur broadly in quantitative expressions in scientific text: numbers, unit slashes, statistical symbols, parentheses, and formula formatting. Specific semantics span clinical measurements, nutrition doses, environmental emissions, and astrophysical quantities, with a few activations on domain-specific terms.

patterns.name: Slash structures in numbers and units
patterns.context: A number, measurement unit, or abbreviation is adjacent to a slash to form a unit expression; numbers or letters often occur on either side.

patterns.name: Mixed numbers, statistical symbols, and parentheses
patterns.context: Parentheses, comparison symbols, decimal points, and similar marks occur near values, abbreviations, or statistical results; some activation falls on punctuation or numbers.

patterns.name: Quantitative intake, frequency, and dose expressions
patterns.context: Dietary or nutritional intake is expressed as mass/time, or frequency, groups, and doses are reported.

patterns.name: Scientific quantities and unit expressions
patterns.context: Scientific prose or formulas contain values, units, variables, or subscripted quantities; mathematical formatting symbols may be included.
patterns.domain: Environmental science, astrophysics, and theoretical physics

patterns.name: Medical measurements and bodily indicators
patterns.context: Demographics, physiological indicators, and measurements for patients or study participants, often with values, units, or ranges.

patterns.name: Statistical comparisons and significance reporting
patterns.context: Groups, changes, or results are compared, with P values or significance reported; numbers and comparison markers are interspersed.

patterns.name: Substance, element, or celestial mass ratios
patterns.context: Discusses relative amounts or mass ratios of substances or elements, including element names or formula symbols.

patterns.name: Environmental pollution and emission changes
patterns.context: Describes industrial and domestic wastewater or ecological impacts, with emission changes expressed numerically.

patterns.name: High spectral resolution
patterns.context: Describes instrument or observational capability, especially spectral resolution; appears in the same passage as a discussion of mass ratios.

patterns.name: Formula formatting and backslash commands
patterns.context: Formulas contain LaTeX commands, fractions, variables, and mathematical punctuation; activation is distributed across formatting symbols and expressions.

patterns.name: DHA and platelet-related experiments
patterns.context: Reports blood coagulation parameters or in vitro platelet aggregation results following dietary DHA supplementation.

4_2253.description: 激活广泛出现在科学文本中的定量表达：数字、单位斜杠、统计符号、括号和公式排版。具体语义跨临床测量、营养剂量、环境排放及天体物理量，另有少数领域术语触发。

patterns.name: 数字与单位的斜杠结构
patterns.context: 数值、测量单位或缩写紧邻斜杠，形成单位表达；斜杠两侧常有数字或字母。
patterns.domain: 生物医学定量文本、科学论文

patterns.name: 数字与统计符号/括号的混排
patterns.context: 数值、缩写或统计结果附近出现括号、比较符号、小数点等；部分激活落在标点或数字上。

patterns.name: 定量摄入、频率与剂量表述
patterns.trigger: « food»2« groups»1、« frequency»2、« int»1«akes»1、« 6»2« g»3«/»9d、« 60« g»1«/»9day
patterns.context: 饮食或营养摄入量以质量/时间表示，或报告频率、分组及剂量。
patterns.domain: 营养学与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 科学量值和单位表达
patterns.context: 科学叙述或公式中出现数值、单位、变量或带下标的量；可能包含数学排版符号。
patterns.domain: 环境科学、天体物理及理论物理

patterns.name: 医学测量值及身体指标
patterns.trigger: « hemoglobin« 9»2«.»1«6»1« g»2、« age»4、« body»2« mass»6« index»1
patterns.context: 患者或研究对象的人口统计、生理指标及测量结果，常带数值、单位或范围。

patterns.name: 物质、元素或天体质量比
patterns.context: 讨论物质或元素的相对量、质量比，含元素名称或公式符号。

patterns.name: 环境污染及排放变化
patterns.context: 描述工业与生活废水或生态影响，并以数值表示排放量变化。

patterns.name: 高光谱分辨率
patterns.context: 描述仪器或观测能力，特别是光谱分辨率；与质量比讨论同段出现。

patterns.name: 公式排版与反斜杠命令

patterns.name: DHA 与血小板相关实验
patterns.context: 报告饮食补充 DHA 后的血液凝固参数或体外血小板聚集结果。

en.concept: Symbols and term fragments in scientific texts
en.description: Activation is dispersed across numbers, units, symbols, and fragments of technical terms in scientific texts. Some passages involve measurement or comparisons of change, but no stable lexical trigger pattern explains all activations.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and statistical values
patterns.context: Near measurements, concentrations, units, numeric ranges, and statistical results in medical or experimental texts; several passages activate parts of numbers or units, but the markers are not always contiguous
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical reports, and statistical results

patterns.name: Numbers, symbols, and separators within terms
patterns.context: In proper abbreviations, mathematical expressions, or chemical/physical notation, activation falls on numbers, punctuation, backslashes, and symbol fragments rather than whole words
patterns.domain: Medical abbreviations, mathematical equations, physics papers

patterns.name: Local word fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Multisyllabic terms, in-word fragments, or technical nouns in scientific or technical contexts; the context involves substances, measurements, or classification

patterns.name: Expressions of direction, comparison, and change
patterns.context: Narrative describing quantity changes, threshold comparisons, or lists of multiple factors

4_2253.concept: 科学文本中的符号与术语片段
4_2253.description: 激活分散在科学文本中的数值、单位、符号及专业术语片段；部分段落涉及测量或比较变化，但没有一个稳定的词汇触发模式能解释全部激活。

patterns.name: 数字、单位与统计数值
patterns.context: 医学或实验文本中的测量值、浓度、单位、数值范围和统计结果附近；多个段落激活数字或单位的一部分，但标记并不总是连续
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学报告及统计结果

patterns.name: 术语内部的数字、符号与分隔符
patterns.context: 专有缩写、数学表达式或化学/物理符号中，激活落在数字、标点、反斜线及符号片段上，而非完整词语
patterns.domain: 医学缩写、数学公式、物理学论文

patterns.name: 专业词语中的局部字词片段
patterns.context: 科学或技术语境中的多音节术语、词内片段或专业名词；上下文涉及物质、测量或分类
patterns.domain: 环境科学、微生物学、医学

patterns.name: 方向、比较与变化表达
patterns.trigger: « increase»2、« industrial»3« and»3« domestic»2« waste»1«waters»4、« greater»1« than»1
patterns.context: 描述数量变化、阈值比较或多类因素并列的叙述

en.description: Activations occur in numeric and unit formats, formula formatting, statistical comparisons, as well as role-playing recommendations, complaints about résumé formatting, and “divided into” structural expressions; there is no single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Measurement units and numeric expressions
patterns.context: Local numeric formatting near numbers, units, slashes, or decimal points; common in medical statistics, biological measurements, or environmental data.
patterns.domain: Quantitative reporting in scientific and medical texts

patterns.name: Mathematical formatting and formula markers
patterns.context: In formula environments, LaTeX commands, and chemical abundance notation, markers cluster near formatting-control tokens and symbols.

patterns.name: Role-playing instructional recommendations
patterns.context: Explains how to design and conduct role-playing activities, including operational recommendations organized by stage.

patterns.name: Plain-text résumés and layout constraints
patterns.context: Describes fitting work experience into fixed forms on job websites and expressing dissatisfaction with formatting limitations.
patterns.domain: Personal experiences, job seeking, and web commentary

patterns.name: Division into stages or parts
patterns.context: When discussing a process or book structure, uses “divided into” to introduce stages or parts and their number.
patterns.domain: Medical review articles and book reviews

patterns.name: Group comparisons and statistical significance
patterns.context: Compares groups, time points, or conditions and reports P values or the direction of differences.

4_2253.description: 激活分布于数值及单位格式、公式排版、统计比较，也见于角色扮演建议、简历格式抱怨和“divided into”结构表达；没有单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 测量单位与数值表达
patterns.context: 数字、单位、斜线或小数点附近的局部数值格式；常见于医学统计、生物测量或环境数据。
patterns.domain: 科学与医学文本中的定量报告

patterns.name: 数学排版与公式标记
patterns.context: 公式环境、LaTeX 命令及化学丰度符号中，标记聚集在格式控制 token 和符号附近。

patterns.name: 角色扮演教学建议

patterns.context: 说明如何设计并实施角色扮演活动，包含分阶段的操作建议。

patterns.name: 文本简历与版面限制
patterns.trigger: « fit»5« my»1↵experience« into»10 boring little boxes
patterns.context: 描述将个人经历塞进求职网站的固定表格，并对格式限制表达不满。
patterns.domain: 个人经历、求职与网页评论

patterns.name: 按阶段或部分划分
patterns.trigger: « be»3 divided« into»9« three»4 phases；« divided« into»9« two»3 sections
patterns.context: 讨论某种过程或书籍结构时，使用“divided into”引出阶段或部分及其数量。

patterns.name: 群体比较与统计显著性
patterns.trigger: « between»4 athletes« and»1 nonathletes；(P<0.01)；« than»3 for C than for W
patterns.context: 比较组别、时间点或条件，并以 P 值或差异方向报告结果。

en.description: Primarily responds to dense formatting of numbers, units, symbols, and quantitative results in scientific text, and also favors parallel lists and comparisons; sporadic activations also occur on astrophysical terms, chromatography tables, and dielectric spectroscopy topics.

patterns.name: Number and unit formats
patterns.context: Near numbers, measurements, or scientific notation, especially when values are adjacent to units or mathematical symbols; activation falls on number fragments, unit fragments, and formatting symbols between them.
patterns.domain: Scientific texts such as medical tests, environmental chemistry, and astronomy

patterns.name: Parallel lists and conjunctions
patterns.context: When variables, substances, groups, or stages are listed in parallel, activation occurs near conjunctions and list boundaries; [1][7][10] also show comparison structures.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper abstracts, body text, and tables

patterns.name: Scientific quantities, units, and symbol markers
patterns.context: Near symbolic representations of quantities such as chemical formulas, concentrations, mass, length, wavelength, speed, or conductivity; often accompanied by numeric/subscript formatting.

patterns.name: Measurement results and statistical comparisons
patterns.context: When reporting observations, distributions, group differences, or changes over time or space, some result terms and statistical comparison statements are activated.
patterns.domain: Medical and natural science research reports

patterns.name: Star formation and astrophysical terminology
patterns.context: Astrophysical discussions of star formation, protoplanetary disks, or galaxy star formation rates; these terms may also occur in general scientific contexts.

patterns.name: Chromatography table heading formats
patterns.context: Markdown headings, table column names, and compound names are segmented and marked; activation is fragmentary and not clearly dependent on numeric patterns.

patterns.name: Dielectric spectroscopy and phase transition terminology
patterns.context: Discusses using dielectric spectroscopy to study coexisting phases and dynamics near phase transitions; appears more like local activation on topic-specific terms.

patterns.name: Velocity dispersion and galaxy cluster comparisons
patterns.context: Compares velocity dispersion with radius, galaxy cluster mass distributions, and metal-poor/enriched systems.

4_2253.description: 主要响应科学文本中数字、单位、符号和量化结果的密集格式，也偏好并列列举与比较表述；另对天体物理术语、色谱表格和介电谱主题有零散激活。

patterns.name: 数值与单位格式
patterns.context: 数字、测量值或科学记数法附近，尤其数值与单位、数学符号相邻；激活落在数字片段、单位片段及其间的格式符号上。
patterns.domain: 医学检验、环境化学、天文学等科学文本

patterns.name: 并列列举与连接符
patterns.context: 并列变量、物质、群体或阶段时，连接词及列表边界附近有激活；[1][7][10]还出现比较结构。
patterns.domain: 科学论文摘要、正文与表格

patterns.name: 科学量、单位及符号标记
patterns.context: 化学式、浓度、质量、长度、波长、速率或电导率等量的符号化表示周围；常与数字/上下标格式同时出现。

patterns.name: 测量结果与统计比较
patterns.trigger: « prevalence»、« significantly»、« no significant difference»、« concentrations»、« median»、« increase»
patterns.context: 报告观测量、分布、组间差异或随时间/空间变化时，部分结果词及统计比较语句被激活。

patterns.name: 星体形成与天体物理术语
patterns.context: 围绕恒星形成、原行星盘或星系恒星形成率的天体物理讨论；这些词在一般科学语境中也可能出现。

patterns.name: 色谱表格标题格式
patterns.trigger: «**»、« HPLC quantification of« meth»1«an»1olic extract»、« Ret«ention»2 time»
patterns.context: Markdown 标题与表格栏名、化合物名称被拆分标记；激活较零碎，不明显依赖数值模式。

patterns.name: 介电谱与相变术语
patterns.context: 讨论介电谱用于研究共存相及相变附近动力学；更像特定主题词上的局部激活。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理 ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 速度弥散及星系团比较
patterns.context: 将速度弥散与半径、星系团质量分布及金属贫乏/富集系统作比较。
patterns.domain: 天体物理 ArXiv 论文

en.concept: Fragments and numbers in scientific text
en.description: Activations are dispersed across paper numbers and units, statistical comparisons, medical terminology, and chemical name fragments; they also occur on table markers and instructional recommendations. Some triggers may be coincidental token fragments, with no unified semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Fragments in chemical names
patterns.context: Inside chemical or drug names, especially when name endings or substrings are split into multiple tokens; includes pesticides, elements, and environmental samples

patterns.name: Quantitative measurements and units
patterns.context: In experimental or clinical results, numbers, decimal points, concentrations/doses, and units are adjacent; measurements, ranges, or thresholds often occur

patterns.name: Statistical comparisons and association statements
patterns.context: Describes group differences, correlations, significance, or research results, often alongside indicators, groupings, and statistical values

patterns.name: Structured paper/web markers
patterns.context: Formatting markers and numbers occurring near table or figure cross-references

patterns.name: Ordinal numbers and steps in instructional recommendations
patterns.context: Reader-facing guidance organized by stages or steps; emphasizes activity design and participants

patterns.name: Clinical history and case descriptions
patterns.context: Narratives of case timelines, symptoms, treatment choices, and clinical indicators

patterns.name: Medical terminology/character combinations not covered by the patterns above
patterns.context: Near medical abbreviations, pathological terms, or classification indicators; triggers may come from token fragments within terms

patterns.name: Sporadic subword fragments in other words
patterns.context: When these words occur in general explanatory sentences; seen in only one passage, so no stable contextual condition can be confirmed

4_2253.concept: 科学文本中的碎片与数值
4_2253.description: 激活分散于论文数值与单位、统计比较、医学术语和化学名称片段，也见表格标记及教学建议；部分触发可能是分词片段巧合，未显出统一语义。

patterns.name: 化学物质名中的片段
patterns.context: 化学物质或药物名称内部、尤其是名称的词尾或子串被切分成多个 token；涉及农药、元素和环境样品
patterns.domain: 环境化学与毒理学论文

patterns.name: 量化测定与单位
patterns.context: 实验或临床结果中，数值、小数点、浓度/剂量与单位相邻；常出现测量值、范围或阈值

patterns.name: 统计比较与关联表述
patterns.context: 描述组间差异、相关性、显著性或研究结果，常与指标、分组及统计数值共同出现
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要与论文

patterns.name: 结构化论文/网页标记
patterns.context: 表格或图表交叉引用附近出现的格式化标记与编号

patterns.name: 教学建议中的序数与步骤
patterns.context: 面向读者的指导文字，按阶段或步骤组织建议；强调活动设计与参与者

patterns.name: 临床病史与病例叙述
patterns.context: 病例时间线、症状、治疗选择及临床指标的叙述

patterns.name: 难以归入上述模式的医学术语/字符组合
patterns.context: 医学缩写、病理术语或分类指标附近；触发可能来自术语内部的分词片段

patterns.name: 其他词语中的零散子词片段
patterns.trigger: « humor»、« experimentation»、« matter»、« what»、« mistakes»、« Here»、« are»
patterns.context: 一般说明性句子中出现这些词时；仅见于单段，无法确认稳定的上下文条件

en.description: Activation is distributed across several local cues: spatial or capacity collocations with into, numbers and symbols and units in scientific and medical texts, encyclopedia list boundaries, and specific expressions such as per and within; no single semantic rule covers all passages.

patterns.name: “into” and its collocations
patterns.context: “into” appears in expressions describing putting content into a limited space or container; one example is a resume placed in a box, the other an insult compressed into a short space.

patterns.name: Numbers, separators, and units in scientific notation
patterns.context: Activation appears around mathematical, measurement, or statistical data, especially subscripts, exponents, slashes, values, and units; the trigger is not limited to one specific symbol.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers, medical literature, and statistical results

patterns.name: List entries and entry boundaries
patterns.context: Activation appears near line breaks, consecutive name entries, and “See also” in encyclopedia articles or disambiguation pages; entries often include identities or years in parentheses.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia people lists and disambiguation pages

patterns.name: “per” and per-unit-time expressions
patterns.context: A “per unit time” structure describes frequency or quantity, with nearby content discussing the number of distractions.

patterns.name: “within” and diagnostic pathway expressions
patterns.context: “within” indicates the place of a measure or test method in an existing workflow; activation concentrates on the word and the phrase following it.

4_2253.description: 激活分散在几类局部线索上：into 的空间/容量搭配、科学和医学文本中的数字符号与单位、百科列表边界，以及 per、within 等特定表达；没有覆盖所有片段的单一语义规律。

patterns.name: “into”及其搭配
patterns.context: “into”出现在描述把内容放进有限空间或容器的表达中；前者是简历装进方框，后者是把侮辱塞进短小篇幅。

patterns.name: 科学符号中的数字、分隔符与单位
patterns.context: 数学、计量或统计数据周围出现激活，尤其是下标、指数、斜线、数值及单位；触发点并不固定为某个单一符号。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文、医学文献及统计结果

patterns.name: 列表条目与条目边界
patterns.context: 百科条目或消歧义页中，换行、连续人名条目及“See also”附近出现激活；条目常含括号内身份或年份。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物列表和消歧义页

patterns.name: “per”及单位时间表达
patterns.context: 以“每单位时间”的结构描述频率或数量，且邻近内容谈论分心次数。

patterns.name: “within”与诊断路径表达
patterns.context: “within”用于说明某指标或检测方法在既有流程中的位置；激活集中在该词及其后续短语。

en.concept: List boundaries and structural relation words
en.description: The most consistent signal is item separation in encyclopedia-style lists and the “See also” section at the end; outside encyclopedia text, structural words such as into/within are common, involving division, inclusion, or distribution, but trigger conditions are not fully consistent. There are also several sporadic local word-form activations.

patterns.name: “See also” section at the end of a list
patterns.context: A See also section appears in an encyclopedia entry or list, with activation concentrated on “See,” “also,” and adjacent entry content.

patterns.name: Item separators and continuation in lists
patterns.context: Consecutive encyclopedia-style entries of names, birth/death years, and identity descriptions, as well as categories or supplementary lists following entries.

patterns.name: Internal segmentation in entry titles or names
patterns.context: Names, titles, or proper nouns are segmented around marked tokens; may involve parentheses, birth/death years, name spelling, or title formatting, with no stable semantic category apparent.

patterns.name: Dividing content into separate elements or parts
patterns.context: Describes dividing an experience, content, or recommendations into multiple parts, or arranging them within a structure.
patterns.domain: Business and social media articles; teaching recommendations

patterns.name: Scope, inclusion, or distribution within a structure
patterns.context: Explains that something is within a system, process, product scope, or organizational structure, or enters different parts; overlaps lexically with the “division” pattern but emphasizes inclusion or distribution.
patterns.domain: Medical reviews, patent backgrounds, product and application discussions

patterns.name: Function words and local word forms not clearly matching the main patterns
patterns.context: Activations are dispersed through body text and segmented word forms; aside from a few contexts related to scope, inclusion, or structure, they are difficult to group under a unified trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Blogs, forums, business articles, medical and patent texts

4_2253.concept: 列表边界与结构关系词
4_2253.description: 最一致的线索是百科式列表中的条目分隔及“See also”尾部；非百科文本中常见 into/within 等结构词，涉及拆分、归属或分布，但触发条件不完全一致。另有若干零散局部词形激活。

patterns.name: 列表末尾的“另见”小节
patterns.trigger: «See»…« also»；其后接人名、地点或家族条目
patterns.context: 百科条目或列表中出现 See also 小节，激活集中在“See”“also”及相邻条目内容上。

patterns.name: 列表中的条目分隔与续接
patterns.trigger: «↵» 后接人名、条目标题或分类；如“«↵»6Albert Hofmann”“«↵»5 Humphrey Lloyd”“«↵»4 Vladimir Chelomey”
patterns.context: 百科式人名、人物生卒年与身份说明的连续条目，以及条目后接类别或补充列表。

patterns.name: 条目标题或姓名中的内部切分
patterns.context: 姓名、标题或专名在标记 token 周围被拆分；可能涉及括号、生卒年、姓名拼写或标题格式，未见稳定的语义类别。

patterns.name: 将内容拆分为独立元素或部分
patterns.trigger: «into»；如“into«10» separate«2» elements”与“tips« into»10« the three phases”
patterns.context: 描述把体验、内容或建议划分为多个部分，或安排进某个结构中。
patterns.domain: 商业与社交媒体文章；教学建议

patterns.name: 结构中的范围、归属或分布
patterns.trigger: «within»、«into»；如“within the existing diagnostic pathway”“segregation … into different tissues”
patterns.context: 说明事物位于某个系统、流程、产品范围或组织结构之内，或进入不同部分；与“拆分”模式有词面重合，但语义侧重归属或分布。
patterns.domain: 医学综述、专利背景、产品与应用讨论

patterns.name: 未明确对应主模式的功能词与局部词形
patterns.context: 激活分散在正文和被切分的词形中；除了少数与范围、归属或结构有关的语境，难以归为统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 博客、论坛、商业文章、医学与专利文本

en.description: Activations are dispersed across multiple text formats: names and disambiguation entries, numbers, units, and quantitative results in papers and reports, medical indicators, environmental and forestry descriptions, and business and forum commentary. No single word meaning explains all examples.

patterns.name: Names, biographical entries, and disambiguation lists
patterns.context: Name entries, person disambiguation pages, or related-person links at the end of an entry; parentheses often contain birth year, occupation, region, or identity.

patterns.name: Numbers and unitized measurements
patterns.context: Values appear in parentheses, results reports, or quantitative descriptions, often adjacent to decimals, ranges, statistical comparisons, units, or per-unit expressions.
patterns.domain: Scientific, medical, nutrition, and environmental reports

patterns.name: Paper structure markers and results statements
patterns.context: References to figures and tables in paper body text or supplementary materials, followed by experimental results or property assessments.

patterns.name: Medical clinical indicators and condition descriptions
patterns.context: In patient cases or clinical reports, disease severity, signs, and blood test values are presented together.

patterns.name: Comparisons of components or nutrition indicators
patterns.context: Groups are labeled with letters and intake amounts or differences are reported using numbers and units.

patterns.name: Business products and strategy discussions
patterns.context: Discusses new opportunities on social platforms or at companies, product unbundling strategies, and effects that remain to be seen.

patterns.name: Pollution and environmental impacts
patterns.context: Describes the impact of industrial activity on ecosystems and quantifies warnings using emission increases and years.

patterns.name: Fuel load and forest descriptions
patterns.context: Compares forest conditions and reports total fuel per unit area and the proportion of fine fuels.

patterns.name: Sarcastic expressions in code golf discussions
patterns.context: Forum commentary on code golf and code maintenance; includes evaluations of terse expressions or verbal attacks.

4_2253.description: 激活分散于多种文本格式：人名/消歧条目、论文和报告中的数字单位与定量结果、医学指标、环境及林业描述，以及商业和论坛评论。没有单一词义能解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 名字、人物条目与消歧列表
patterns.trigger: « (»…«)»、人名及其后的身份说明；«See» « also»；«disambiguation»
patterns.context: 人名条目、人物消歧页面或条目末尾的相关人物链接；括号常附出生年份、职业、地区或身份。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物条目与消歧列表

patterns.name: 数字与单位化测量值
patterns.context: 数值出现在括号、结果报告或定量描述中，常与小数、范围、统计比较、单位、每单位表达式相邻。
patterns.domain: 科学、医学、营养学及环境报告

patterns.name: 论文结构标记与结果陈述
patterns.context: 论文正文或补充材料中引用图表，并引出实验结果或性质评价。

patterns.name: 医学临床指标与病情描述
patterns.context: 患者病例或临床报告中，病情分级、体征与血液检验值并列。

patterns.name: 成分或营养指标的比较
patterns.context: 以组别字母对照，并用数值和单位报告摄入量或差异。

patterns.name: 商业产品与策略论述
patterns.context: 讨论社交平台或公司的新机会、产品拆分策略及其效果尚待观察。

patterns.name: 污染与环境影响
patterns.context: 描述工业活动对生态系统的影响，并以排放量增长和年限量化警告。

patterns.name: 燃料负荷与森林描述
patterns.context: 比较森林状况，并报告单位面积燃料总量及细燃料占比。

patterns.name: 代码高尔夫讨论中的讽刺表达
patterns.context: 论坛对代码高尔夫及维护代码的评论；出现对短小表达或言语攻击的评价。

en.concept: Quantitative expressions and scientific document cues
en.description: The most stable signal is the combination of numbers and measurement units, frequency, or ratios, across scientific, medical, ecological, climate, and everyday narratives; other activations involve document markers, proper-name terminology, plural forms, line breaks, and several domain-specific semantic cues, and cannot be fully reduced to one pattern.

patterns.name: Quantity, measurement units, and ratio expressions
patterns.context: In quantitative descriptions, numbers, units, ranges, or frequencies occur adjacently; common patterns include per followed by a time, area, or account as the measured object.
patterns.domain: Scientific reports, medicine, ecology, climate, personal experiences, technical Q&A, and more

patterns.name: Numbers and special-format markers, citations, or lists
patterns.context: Person index entries or citations and figure/table markers in papers; activation falls on parentheses, numbers, citation formats, and nearby tokens.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, academic papers, and structured text

patterns.name: Plural or intraword morphological fragments
patterns.context: Plural endings, morphological fragments, or segmented parts within words are marked; these words also occur in general descriptive narratives.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, climate descriptions, ecology, and review texts

patterns.name: Technical terms and proper nouns
patterns.context: Terms in medical, biological, or chemical contexts are marked; some occur within quantitative or academic sentence structures.
patterns.domain: Biomedical and scientific papers, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Connectives and syntactic function words
patterns.context: These common connective or preposition tokens are occasionally activated in longer explanatory sentences; there is no consistent local semantic condition.

patterns.name: Line breaks and item boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs at separators between encyclopedia biography entries, in paper paragraphs, or at line boundaries in Q&A narratives.

patterns.name: Place, climate, and physical geography descriptions
patterns.context: Describes regional environmental, climatic, or ecological conditions; these do not always co-occur with the dominant number-and-unit signal.

patterns.name: Personal goals and action narratives
patterns.context: First-person narrative sets and follows a daily distance goal, quantified by distance and time.

patterns.name: Data scale and service limits
patterns.context: Discusses dataset size, free-service capacity limits, and alternatives.

patterns.name: Paper methods and diagnostic procedures
patterns.context: Discusses review studies, sample types, and methodological choices in diagnostic procedures.

patterns.name: Genetic allocation process in patents
patterns.context: Explains the mechanism by which mitochondria are allocated to different tissues during egg-cell division.

patterns.name: Forest fuel load measurements
patterns.context: Reports forest fuel quantities and fine-fuel amounts, including area units and approximate values.

4_2253.concept: 量化表达及科学文档线索
4_2253.description: 激活最稳定的线索是数字与计量单位、频率或比率的组合，横跨科学、医学、生态、气候及日常叙述；另有文档标记、专名术语、复数形态、换行和若干领域特定语义线索，不能完全归为同一模式。

patterns.name: 数量、计量单位及其比率表达
patterns.trigger: 数字与单位或单位/周期搭配，如「60 km³ per year」「24 per year」「1.9, and hemoglobin 9.6 g/dL」「16.4 tonnes per hectare」「1000km in a year」「10km per day」「15GB per account」
patterns.context: 定量叙述中，数字、单位、范围或频率相邻；常见 per 后接时间、面积或账户等计量对象。
patterns.domain: 科学报告、医学、生态、气候、个人经历与技术问答等

patterns.name: 数字及特殊格式的标记、引用或列表
patterns.context: 人物索引条目或论文中的引用、图表标记；激活落在括号、数字、引用格式及附近 token 上。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、学术论文及结构化文本

patterns.name: 复数或词内形态片段
patterns.context: 复数词尾、形态片段或被切分的词内部有标记；这些词也出现在一般描述性叙述中。
patterns.domain: 百科、气候描述、生态与综述文本

patterns.name: 专业术语与专名
patterns.context: 医学、生物或化学语境中的术语被标记；部分术语嵌在量化或学术句式里。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与科学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: 衔接词及句法功能词
patterns.context: 在较长的说明性句子中，这些常见连接或介词 token 偶有激活；缺少一致的局部语义条件。

patterns.name: 换行及条目边界
patterns.context: 出现在百科人物条目的分隔处、论文段落或问答叙述的行间边界。
patterns.domain: 结构化文本与网页摘录

patterns.name: 地点、气候及自然地理描述
patterns.context: 描述地区环境、气候或生态条件；与主导的数字单位线索并不总是同时出现。

patterns.name: 个人目标与行动叙述
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述设定并执行每日移动距离目标，包含距离和时间量化。

patterns.name: 数据规模与服务限额
patterns.context: 讨论数据集大小、免费服务容量限制及替代方案。

patterns.name: 论文方法与诊断流程
patterns.context: 讨论综述研究、样本类型以及诊断流程中的方法选择。

patterns.name: 专利中的遗传分配过程
patterns.context: 解释线粒体在卵细胞分裂过程中向不同组织分配的机制。

patterns.name: 森林燃料负荷测量
patterns.context: 报告森林燃料量及细燃料所占数量，包含面积单位和近似值。

en.description: Activation is distributed across several genres: encyclopedia entry formatting, medical research and case reports, and “entering/dividing into” structures; diagnostic workflows, job-application text boxes, and Swedish parliamentary word fragments also appear, making it difficult to identify a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Dividing or splitting into different parts
patterns.context: Describing an object, experience, or content being divided into different parts; one example is cell allocation, the other product splitting.

patterns.name: Parentheses and entry formatting in directory entries
patterns.context: Names, identities, years, positions, and other details arranged in compact entries, often with parentheses, line breaks, and “See also” cross-references.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia disambiguation pages or people directories

patterns.name: Research associations and grouping
patterns.context: Research describes associations between variables and groups cases by interval.

patterns.name: Diagnostic pathways and sample types
patterns.context: Discussing how a review helps researchers select samples and determine the role of a test in the existing diagnostic workflow.

patterns.name: Fitting into an established space or container
patterns.context: Describing a personal experience compressed into a text box on a job-search website; it shares the surface form of “entering a container/part” with cell allocation or product splitting.
patterns.domain: Online essay about a personal job-search experience

patterns.name: Medical values and units
patterns.context: A clinical narrative listing INR and hemoglobin values and units.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Swedish parliamentary speech
patterns.context: Swedish parliamentary records contain subword fragments, proper names, and procedural language; there is little apparent semantic connection to the other passages.

4_2253.concept: 多模式格式与分隔结构
4_2253.description: 激活分布于多种文体：百科条目格式、医学研究与病例，以及“进入/分入”结构；另有诊断流程、求职文本框和瑞典语议会词片段，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 分隔或拆分为不同部分
patterns.context: 表示将某对象、经验或内容分入不同部分；前者是细胞分配，后者是产品拆分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学；科技商业评论

patterns.name: 名录条目的括号与条目格式
patterns.context: 姓名、身份、年份、职务等以紧凑条目排列，常有括号、换行和“See also”交叉引用。
patterns.domain: 百科全书消歧义页或人物名录

patterns.name: 研究关联与分组
patterns.context: 研究描述变量间的关联，并将病例按区间分组。

patterns.name: 诊断路径与样本类型
patterns.context: 讨论综述如何帮助研究者选择样本并确定某检测在现有诊断流程中的作用。

patterns.name: 嵌入既定空间或容器
patterns.context: 描述把个人经历压缩到求职网站的文本框中；与细胞分配或产品拆分共享“进入容器/部分”的表面形式。
patterns.domain: 个人求职经历的网络随笔

patterns.name: 医疗数值及单位
patterns.context: 病历叙述中列出 INR 与血红蛋白数值及单位。

patterns.name: 瑞典语议会发言中的词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会记录中出现分词片段、专名及议事用语；与其他段落缺少明显语义联系。

en.description: Activations are dispersed across intraword substrings, numbers, and punctuation formats, commonly in encyclopedia lists, names, and Swedish parliamentary text; they also cover résumé links, clinical terminology, and biological expressions, with no unified semantic trigger apparent.

patterns.name: Number and unit formats
patterns.context: Number strings, years, ranges, or values with units, especially when numbers are adjacent to punctuation or units.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments and morphological boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on local word substrings, commonly affixes, stems, or intraword segments; not limited to a particular language.
patterns.domain: English, Swedish, and other natural text

patterns.name: Encyclopedia lists and entry navigation
patterns.context: In entry-style formatting, line breaks separate people, disambiguation parentheses, related entries, or categories.

patterns.name: Local word forms in Swedish parliamentary text

en.description: Responses are scattered: Open, Use in code comments, divided in math problems, date slashes, and Private in a title all trigger locally; the other highlights span code, legal, and list text and are difficult to assign to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Open identifier
patterns.context: The capitalization variant Open appears in license phrases, game/forum effect names, and compound identifiers; it is not necessarily a standalone word.

patterns.name: -ing suffix
patterns.context: Appears in the mathematical term “p-summing,” with activation on the final ing.

patterns.name: Division arithmetic question
patterns.context: In elementary math problems phrased as “number divided by number,” involving negative numbers or general division calculations.

patterns.name: Slash in dates
patterns.context: A slash separates month, day, and year in a court-record date field.

patterns.name: The number 10
patterns.context: Used as a divisor in an arithmetic problem or as part of a case number; the contexts differ.

patterns.name: Private in a title
patterns.context: Appears in the movie-list entry title “Private Affairs,” followed by Affairs and a year.

patterns.name: Use in code comments
patterns.context: Code comments begin with “Use …” to give an alternative or operational suggestion; the same trigger appears multiple times.

patterns.name: Unexplained code and documentation patterns
patterns.context: Involves comment markers, documentation tags, code identifiers, or formatting, but activation does not consistently fall on these common markers and cannot be explained by a single clear trigger.

patterns.name: Other unexplained highlights
patterns.context: Occur in localized contexts such as game configuration, legal tables, and movie titles, with no reliable shared trigger pattern.

4_2299.description: 响应分散：Open、代码注释里的 Use、数学题中的 divided、日期斜线及 Private 标题等均有局部触发；其余高亮跨代码、法律和列表文本，难归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: Open 标识符
patterns.context: 大小写形式 Open 出现在许可证短语、游戏/论坛效果名及复合标识符中；未必是独立单词。

patterns.name: 动名词后缀 -ing
patterns.context: 出现在数学术语“p-summing”中，激活落在词尾 ing。

patterns.name: 除法算术问句
patterns.context: 在小学数学题的“数 divided by 数”表达中，涉及负数或一般除法计算。

patterns.name: 日期中的斜线
patterns.context: 斜线分隔月、日、年，位于法院档案日期字段中。

patterns.name: 数字 10
patterns.context: 作为算术题中的除数，或案号数字的一部分；上下文并不相同。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Private
patterns.context: 出现在电影条目标题“Private Affairs”中，后接 Affairs 和年份。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的 Use
patterns.context: 代码注释以“Use …”给出替代方案或操作建议；多处出现相同触发词。

patterns.name: 未解释的代码与文档模式
patterns.context: 涉及注释标记、文档标签、代码标识符或格式化，但激活未稳定落在这些常见标记上，且无法由同一明确触发项解释。

patterns.name: 未解释的其余高亮
patterns.context: 分别处于游戏配置、法律表格和电影标题等局部语境，未见共享的可靠触发模式。
patterns.domain: 代码、法律文书、列表文本

en.concept: Software execution and related word forms
en.description: Primarily responds to executed/execute in software contexts involving running programs or tasks; there are also sporadic activations on fragments of decompression terms, Python threading identifiers, cited surnames, and moving in the context of version migration.

patterns.name: Endings of execution-related words
patterns.context: Describes running or executing programs, commands, queries, test cases, etc.; activation is mainly on executed and occurs across different corpus types.
patterns.domain: Software engineering, programming Q&A, patent technical text

patterns.name: Fragment within a compression-related word
patterns.context: Appears in tokenized fragments of words such as decompressed and decompressing, in discussions of decompressing programs or instructions and when to execute them.

patterns.name: Thread fragment in a Python identifier
patterns.context: Occurs in Python modules or class names such as threading.Event and threading.RLock; activation falls on the tokenized fragment threading.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in patent citations
patterns.context: Appears in tokenized parts of the author surnames Wiessmuller and Wittinghofer, surrounded by journal citation formatting and years.
patterns.domain: Academic citations in patent background technology

patterns.name: Version-control migration terminology
patterns.context: A team describes moving from Visual SourceSafe to Subversion; this activation does not fall on the main execution-related words.

4_2299.description: 主要响应软件语境中执行、运行程序或任务的 executed/execute；另对解压词片段、Python threading 标识符、引文姓氏片段及版本迁移中的 moving 有零星激活。

patterns.name: 执行相关词的词尾
patterns.context: 与程序、命令、查询、测试用例等作主语或宾语，描述运行或执行；主要激活在 executed，且不同语料类型均出现。
patterns.domain: 软件工程、编程问答、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 压缩词内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 decompressed、decompressing 等词被切分后的片段中，讨论程序或指令的解压及其执行时机。

patterns.name: Python 标识符中的线程片段
patterns.context: 处于 threading.Event、threading.RLock 等 Python 模块或类名中；激活落在被切分的 threading。

patterns.name: 专利引文中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在作者姓氏 Wiessmuller、Wittinghofer 的切分部分，周围是期刊引用格式与年份。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术中的学术引文

patterns.name: 版本控制迁移用语
patterns.context: 团队说明从 Visual SourceSafe 转向 Subversion；该激活未落在主要的执行词上。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on -ing endings, Development, code structure, and program- or computing-related words such as storage/calculation; several other one-off sporadic activations are difficult to assign to a stable pattern.

patterns.name: -ing suffix activation
patterns.context: Activation falls on a subword at the end of an -ing word; the first two examples are Programming, and another is threading.

patterns.name: Development and its collocations
patterns.context: The complete word Development occurs in project planning or descriptions of institutional roles.

patterns.name: Code structure phrase
patterns.context: The phrase code structure appears in contexts discussing code organization or showing program implementation.

patterns.name: Program- and storage-related words
patterns.context: Computer-, program-, or data-processing-related descriptions; the examples concern program storage in a contract and path calculation in memory.

patterns.name: Unresolved sporadic activations
patterns.context: Each occurs in only one passage, with no consistent morphological, semantic, or syntactic environment; they should not be grouped with the repeated patterns above.
patterns.domain: Forums, encyclopedias, patents, and other styles

4_2299.description: 主要激活落在 -ing 词尾、Development、code structure，以及 storage/calculation 等程序或计算相关词；另有若干单次零散激活，难归为稳定模式。

patterns.name: -ing 词尾激活
patterns.context: 激活落在以 -ing 结尾的词内部子词上；前两例为 Programming，另一例为 threading。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、百科条目、代码

patterns.name: Development 及其搭配
patterns.context: 完整单词 Development，在项目规划或机构职务描述中出现。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、百科人物介绍

patterns.name: 代码结构短语
patterns.trigger: «structure»9（[6]「The code structure will be exactly the same」；[9]「The code structure goes as follows」）
patterns.context: 短语 code structure，出现在讨论代码组织或展示程序实现的上下文。

patterns.name: 程序与存储相关词
patterns.context: 计算机、程序或数据处理相关表述；分别涉及合同中的程序存储和存储器中的路径计算。

patterns.name: 未解析的零散激活
patterns.context: 各自仅在单段出现，未见一致的词形、语义或句法环境；不应并入上述重复模式。
patterns.domain: 论坛、百科、专利等多种文体

en.description: Activation is distributed across Java identifier fragments, fragments within ordinary words, proper names, agreement/enforcement language in legal and business texts, codebase terminology, and threading terminology; no stable meaning or contextual pattern spans the examples.

patterns.name: “gu” inside Java identifiers
patterns.context: In Java/Maven dependency configurations, activation falls on the identifier fragment “gu” or on the Guava name containing it

patterns.name: Word-final or stem fragments in legal texts
patterns.context: In formal legal provisions, activation occurs inside ordinary words rather than on stable legal terms

patterns.name: Spelling fragments in proper names and technical terms
patterns.context: Subword fragments inside proper names or technical identifiers are marked, with no consistent meaning observed

patterns.name: Language of transactions and legal documents
patterns.context: Business emails discuss agreements, document revisions, and enforcement; «approved» and «sentence executed» also occur in a military judgment context

patterns.name: Library and interface terminology in code
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across multiple words, such as library names and interface descriptions, in code imports or technical documentation comments
patterns.domain: C# and C++ code and comments

patterns.name: Thread-creation terminology
patterns.context: Discusses how parallel-programming runtimes create threads and determine the number of threads

4_2299.description: 激活分散在Java标识符片段、普通词内片段、专名及法律商务文本的协议/执行用语、代码库术语和线程术语中；没有贯穿各段的稳定词义或上下文模式。

patterns.name: Java标识符内部的“gu”
patterns.context: Java/Maven依赖配置里，激活落在标识符片段“gu”或包含它的Guava名称上

patterns.name: 法律文本中的词尾或词干片段
patterns.context: 正式法律条文中，激活出现在普通单词内部，而非稳定的法律术语上

patterns.name: 专名与技术词中的拼写片段
patterns.trigger: «Skating» 中的 «Sk»；«Chartered» 中的 «ered»；«Threading» 中的 «ing»
patterns.context: 专名或技术标识符内部的子词片段被标记，未见一致词义

patterns.trigger: «PrimeTrade Agreement»、«referenced Agreement»、«documents»、«execution process» 中的标记
patterns.context: 商务邮件中讨论协议、文件修改及执行；另有军事判决语境中的 «approved»、«sentence executed»

patterns.name: 代码中的库与接口术语
patterns.context: 代码导入语句或技术文档注释中，激活分布在库名、接口说明等多个词上

patterns.name: 线程创建术语
patterns.context: 讨论并行编程运行时如何创建线程及决定线程数

en.description: The most consistent triggers are -ing suffix fragments in several English words: operating, executing, sentencing, logging, and resulting, across legal, encyclopedia, and technical contexts; other sporadic weak markers cannot be explained in a unified way.

patterns.name: Tokenized operating
patterns.context: Capitalization varies; the trigger substring spans the word-initial fragment and suffix. It appears in the legal phrase “operating under a charter,” the hospital-list title “Operating,” and the technical phrase “operating systems.”

patterns.name: Tokenized executing
patterns.context: “Executing” activates when describing carrying out a development plan or implementing an investment strategy; the word-initial fragment is sometimes marked as well.

patterns.name: Tokenized sentencing
patterns.context: In criminal proceedings, the suffix “encing” strongly activates when sentencing is mentioned; it is associated with procedural contexts involving error review and preserved disputes.

patterns.name: Tokenized logging
patterns.context: The English word logging in an XML dependency comment strongly activates on the final fragment.

patterns.name: Tokenized resulting
patterns.context: When introducing a result in a code example, the suffix “ing” strongly activates, while the word-initial fragment is weaker.

patterns.name: -ing endings in execution/run-related contexts
patterns.context: English verb -ing suffix fragments repeatedly activate strongly across multiple domains, but not all -ing words or semantically similar examples appear; therefore, all examples should not be treated as a single pattern.
patterns.domain: Legal, encyclopedia, software, and technical text

patterns.name: Other sporadic activations
patterns.context: Low-intensity markers scattered across passages, with no repeatable, clear shared trigger condition.

4_2299.description: 最稳定的触发是若干英语词的 -ing 后缀片段：operating、executing、sentencing、logging、resulting，分布于法律、百科及技术语境；另有零散弱标记，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 被切分的 operating
patterns.context: 大小写不一，触发子串跨词首片段与后缀；出现在法律条文中的“operating under a charter”、医院列表标题“Operating”、技术文本“operating systems”。
patterns.domain: 法律、百科列表、技术讨论

patterns.name: 被切分的 executing
patterns.context: “executing”描述执行发展计划或实施投资策略时激活；词首片段有时也标记。
patterns.domain: 百科政务说明、法律叙述

patterns.name: 被切分的 sentencing
patterns.context: 在刑事程序中提及量刑时，后缀“encing”强激活；与错误审查、保留争议等程序语境相连。

patterns.name: 被切分的 logging
patterns.context: XML 依赖项注释中的英文词 logging，强激活集中在词尾片段。

patterns.name: 被切分的 resulting
patterns.context: 代码示例引出结果时，后缀“ing”强激活，词首片段较弱。

patterns.name: 执行/运行相关的 ing 词尾
patterns.trigger: “cre«ated»4”“ran« it»9”并非同一切分；较明确的形式为“exec«uting»9”“oper«ating»9/10”“Log«ging»9”“Result«ing»9”
patterns.context: 多个领域中，英语动词的 -ing 词尾片段反复强激活，但并非所有 -ing 词或同类语义都出现；不能由此把所有样例归为单一模式。
patterns.domain: 法律、百科、软件与技术文本

patterns.name: 其他零散激活
patterns.context: 分散于各段的低强度标记，未显示可重复、明确的共同触发条件。

en.description: Activation is most prominent on “ating,” formed across subword boundaries, in skating words and operating; weaker activation is distributed across code parentheses, should, command-line comments, and varied programming Q&A, encyclopedia, and technical texts, with no unified semantic pattern observed.

patterns.name: “ating” suffix and skating vocabulary
patterns.context: The English suffix “ating” is formed across subword boundaries; it occurs in “Figure Skating” and “Operating/operating systems.”
patterns.domain: Wikipedia sports or list articles, technical articles

patterns.name: Parentheses in programming code
patterns.context: Parentheses in code snippets are used for calls, grouping, or function parameters; the trigger is weak.

patterns.name: Imperative or prescriptive wording in code explanations
patterns.context: Occurs when describing expected code behavior or suggesting improvements; the trigger is weak.

patterns.name: Reporting results after running code
patterns.context: The questioner describes running self-written code and encountering an error.

patterns.name: Command-line options and debugging code comments
patterns.context: Comments describe command execution, parameter parsing, or debugging options.

patterns.name: Data structures and random-value questions
patterns.context: Asks how a Python function can generate random integers and handle duplicate values.

patterns.name: Character input and comparison logic
patterns.context: A program reads user characters one by one and compares them; the questioner reports unexpected behavior.

patterns.name: Medal descriptions in athlete biographies
patterns.context: A skating athlete’s biography describes competition history and number of championships.

patterns.name: Incomplete list entries and category headings
patterns.context: A list of hospitals is marked incomplete and organized by entry headings.

patterns.name: Technical description of NTP leap seconds
patterns.context: Discusses NTP leap-second implementation in Unix/Linux operating systems.

4_2299.description: 激活最明显地落在跨子词边界拼成的“ating”，覆盖滑冰词与 operating；此外弱激活分散于代码括号、should、命令行注释及多类编程问答和百科、技术文本，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: “ating”后缀及滑冰词汇
patterns.context: 跨子词边界形成英文后缀“ating”；分别出现在“Figure Skating”以及“Operating/operating systems”中。

patterns.name: 编程代码中的括号

patterns.name: 代码解释性文字中的祈使/规范表述

patterns.name: 代码运行后报告结果

patterns.name: 命令行选项与调试代码注释

patterns.name: 数据结构与随机值问题

patterns.name: 字符输入与比较逻辑
patterns.context: 程序逐次读取用户字符并比较，提问者报告流程异常。

patterns.name: 运动员履历中的奖牌描述

patterns.name: 列表条目的未完备与分类标题

patterns.name: NTP闰秒技术描述
