en.description: Responds most strongly to the in-word suffix fragment ating in operating; it also responds more weakly to several word-final or in-word fragments (ed, ored, ining, aced, and ancing). Sporadic activations in code, publishing, institutional, and web text are difficult to assign to a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of operating
patterns.context: The fragments cross an in-word boundary to form operating; the word appears in contexts involving hospitals, law, operating systems, and paper citations. Activation focuses on ating.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, law, technical discussions, academic papers

patterns.name: Common suffixes in spelling or grammar markers
patterns.context: Activation falls on suffixes or stem fragments within English words; neighboring words may belong to different contexts, such as publishing notes, code comments, or explanations of regular expressions.
patterns.domain: Book copyright pages, code and technical text

patterns.name: Word ending in an administrative agency name
patterns.context: In the full name of the U.S. agency “Health Care Financing Administration,” activation falls on the ending of Financing.
patterns.domain: Public health and administrative agency abstracts

patterns.name: Web-rendered text with no clear shared trigger
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across ordinary words in Q&A about HTML page rendering, with no stable in-word fragment or semantic pattern.

4_2299.description: 主要对 operating 的词内后缀片段 ating 强烈响应；另对若干词尾或词内片段（ed、ored、ining、aced、ancing）有较弱响应。代码、出版、机构及网页文本中的零散激活难以归为统一语义模式。

patterns.name: operating 的拆分词片段
patterns.trigger: «Oper»...«ating»，以及 «oper»...«ating»...；主要是 Oper/oper 后接 ating
patterns.context: 片段跨越词内边界，形成 operating；在 hospitals、law、operating systems、论文引文等语境中出现。激活重点落在 ating。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、法律、技术讨论、学术论文

patterns.name: 拼写或语法标记中的常见后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在英文词内部的后缀或词干片段；相邻词可属于出版说明、代码注释、正则表达式说明等不同场景。
patterns.domain: 书籍版权页、代码与技术文本

patterns.name: 行政机构名称中的词尾
patterns.context: 在美国卫生机构全称“Health Care Financing Administration”中，激活落在 Financing 的词尾。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生与行政机构摘要

patterns.name: 无明确共同触发的网页渲染文本
patterns.context: 激活分散在 HTML 页面渲染相关问答中的普通词，未显示稳定的词内片段或语义模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to tokenized forms of Calling, commonly in question titles or sentences, with activation biased toward ing; it also responds to calling in code. In segment 10, activation occurs on it is, dates, and similar items, unlike the main pattern.

patterns.name: Standalone word Calling
patterns.context: Capitalization varies; Calling appears at the beginning of a question or within a sentence, with activation concentrated on ing and weaker activation on Call.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, health product descriptions, personal narratives, HackerNews discussions, bibliographic indexes

patterns.name: calling in code
patterns.context: Used as a verb in PowerShell code, followed by a function or cmdlet name.

patterns.name: Possibly unrelated word-form/boundary activation
patterns.context: No clear Calling or call; activation falls on ordinary pronouns, forms of be, date numerals, and other tokens.

4_2299.description: 主要对 Calling 的分词形式有反应，常见于问题标题或句中，激活偏向 ing；也响应代码里的 calling。第10段激活在 it is、日期等处，和主模式不符。

patterns.name: 独立词 Calling
patterns.trigger: «Call»…«ing»，即 Call/Calling 的词首与后缀分词
patterns.context: 大小写不一；以问句开头或句中出现 Calling，激活集中在 ing，Call 也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、健康产品说明、个人叙事、HackerNews 讨论、书目索引

patterns.name: 代码中的 calling
patterns.context: PowerShell 代码中作为动词，后接函数或 cmdlet 名称。

patterns.name: 可能无关的词形/边界激活
patterns.context: 没有明显的 Calling 或 call；激活落在普通代词、系动词、日期数字等 token 上。

en.concept: English inflectional suffixes and intra-word boundaries
en.description: Activations fall mainly on morphological boundaries within English words: Call-ing, List-ing/ed, Oper-ating; they also occur in the scale name State-Trait Inventory. Trigger words come from different contexts, with no consistent thematic semantics.

patterns.name: “Calling” inflection
patterns.context: “Call” combines with the suffix “ing” to form a gerund or noun; it is sometimes followed by an object or prepositional phrase.
patterns.domain: StackExchange questions, health product descriptions, book indexes

patterns.name: Listing inflection
patterns.context: The root List is followed by -ing or -ed; it occurs in proper names, catalogs, or list-related sentences.

patterns.name: Operating inflection
patterns.context: Oper is followed by -ating as a subheading in a list.

patterns.name: Inventory in a statistical scale name
patterns.context: Occurs in the full names Beck and IDATE State-Trait Inventory of psychological scales.

4_2299.concept: 英语词形后缀与词内边界
4_2299.description: 激活主要落在英语词形内部的形态边界：Call-ing、List-ing/ed、Oper-ating；另涉及量表名称中的 State-Trait Inventory。触发词分属不同语境，未见一致的主题语义。

patterns.name: “Calling”词形
patterns.context: “Call”与后缀“ing”组合成动名词或名词；有时后接宾语或介词短语。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问题、健康产品论述、书籍索引

patterns.name: Listing 词形
patterns.context: 词根 List 后接 -ing 或 -ed；出现在专名、目录或清单相关语句中。
patterns.domain: 维基百科说明、文档、历史条目

patterns.name: Operating 词形
patterns.context: Oper 后接 -ating，作为清单中的小标题。

patterns.name: 统计量表名称中的 Inventory
patterns.context: 出现在心理量表全名 Beck and IDATE 的 State-Trait Inventory 中。

en.concept: List-related word forms and suffix fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to the -ed suffix in list-context words such as listed, often in encyclopedia categories and building directories; it also activates on suffix fragments in printed, financing, and listing, on it/commas in code, on fragments within proper names, and on line-break heading markers, which cannot be fully explained by a single rule.

patterns.name: -ed ending in list items
patterns.context: Past participle listed in titles, directories, categories, or descriptive text, especially “Listed buildings” and “Listed educational buildings”; activation centers on the List/ed tokenization and adjacent list markers.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia categories, directories, and article text

patterns.name: -ed endings in other words
patterns.context: Not limited to listed: -ed forms and related morphological fragments also activate, such as a suffix fragment in financing, -ed in printed, and -ing in listing; the meanings and syntax vary.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, book publishing texts, encyclopedia articles

patterns.name: it and punctuation in code
patterns.context: In a program error description, the final fragment of the pronoun it receives strong activation, and a comma is also marked; this is not clearly related to lists or past participles.

patterns.name: Listed word form in a BMX article
patterns.context: In a sports biography, listed occurs in a list description in a championship-title note; similar to encyclopedia list usage, but activation is prominent on ed.

patterns.name: Irregular or internal fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Subword fragments inside place names, personal names, or proper names are marked, without consistent semantic or syntactic conditions.

patterns.name: Document structure markers and heading words
patterns.context: Activation occurs on line breaks, section headings, or fragments of heading words in letters and publishing text; no consistent content condition emerges.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia page structure, Gutenberg letters and publishing notes

4_2299.description: 主要响应 listed 等列表语境中的 -ed 词尾，常见于百科分类与建筑目录；但也对 printed、financing、listing 的词尾片段、代码中的 it/逗号、专名内部片段及换行标题标记激活，无法由单一规律完全解释。

patterns.name: 列表项词尾 -ed
patterns.context: 标题、目录、分类或说明语中的过去分词 listed，尤其是“Listed buildings”“Listed educational buildings”等；激活集中在 List/ed 的分词形态及相邻列表标记。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 分类、目录和条目正文

patterns.name: 其他词中的 -ed 词尾
patterns.context: 不只 listed：词根加 -ed 或相关形态片段也会激活，如 financing 中的词尾片段、printed 的 -ed、listing 的 -ing；具体词义和句法不同。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、书籍出版文本、百科正文

patterns.name: 代码中的 it 及标点
patterns.context: 程序报错描述中，代词 it 的末尾片段获得强激活，逗号也有标记；与列表或过去分词语境无明显关系。

patterns.name: BMX 条目中的 listed 词形
patterns.context: 体育人物条目中，listed 出现在冠军头衔注释的列表说明里；与百科列表用法相似，但激活突出 ed。

patterns.name: 不规则或专名内部片段
patterns.context: 地名、人名或专名内部的子词片段被标记，缺少一致的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 文档结构标记及标题词
patterns.context: 换行、章节标题或书信/印刷文本中的标题词片段出现激活；未形成统一的内容条件。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 页面结构、Gutenberg 书信与出版说明

en.description: The most consistent signal is the ed fragment, especially in words such as Listed and Printed; it also commonly appears in catalogs, classifications, and lists. Other examples include listing, printing and publishing, dentistry, email phrasing, legal headings, and several numbers or subword fragments, without forming a unified pattern.

patterns.name: ed at word endings or within words
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the string ed, appearing in past participles, adjectives, or list-entry headings; it often coincides with the endings of words such as Listed and Printed.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, catalogs, historical texts, publication information, etc.

patterns.name: Listed catalog entries
patterns.context: Occurs in classification catalogs, lists, explanatory headings, or real-estate records; activation falls at different positions in the stem or ending.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia categories, email notices, professional descriptions, real-estate records

patterns.name: Publishing and printing terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in bibliographic or copyright information about book publishers, printing, and places of publication.
patterns.domain: End pages of Gutenberg books, publication information

patterns.name: dentistry in organization names
patterns.context: Occurs in government department names and research funding information, with activation split within dentistry.

patterns.name: Special category headings and formatting markers
patterns.context: Punctuation, line breaks, and category numbers also activate in category lists at the ends of Wikipedia entries; these are not necessarily explained by the ed ending.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia category markers and page formatting

patterns.name: Collaborative phrasing in business email
patterns.context: Activates in email body text describing teamwork, mutual support, and assistant coverage arrangements; it is adjacent to listed-related contexts but is not the same inflection.

patterns.name: Objecting creditor in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears in bankruptcy case titles, describing creditors who filed objections.

patterns.name: Several independent subword fragments
patterns.context: Occur respectively in category numbers, real-estate record statuses, letter closings, and novel titles; no clear shared context.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, real-estate records, historical letters, bibliographies

4_2299.description: 最一致的信号是 ed 词段，尤其是 Listed、Printed 等词中；也常见于目录、分类和清单。另有 listing、印刷出版、dentistry、邮件措辞、法律标题及若干数字或词片段，未形成统一模式。

patterns.name: 词尾或词内的 ed
patterns.context: 激活集中在 ed 字符串上，出现在过去分词、形容词或列目标题中；常与 Listed、Printed 等词的词尾重合。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、目录、历史文本、出版信息等

patterns.name: Listed 目录条目
patterns.context: 出现在分类目录、清单、说明标题或房产记录中；激活落在词干或词尾不同位置。
patterns.domain: 百科分类、邮件通知、专业论述、房产记录

patterns.name: 出版与印刷用语
patterns.context: 出现在书籍出版者、印刷及出版地等书目或版权信息中。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍末页、出版信息

patterns.name: 机构名称中的 dentistry
patterns.context: 出现在政府部门名称及研究资助信息中，激活拆分在 dentistry 的词内。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、公共卫生研究

patterns.name: 特殊类别标题与格式标记
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的 “Category«:»”“«↵»”及数字片段
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾的分类列表中，标点、换行和分类编号也有激活；未必由 ed 词尾解释。
patterns.domain: 百科分类标记与页面格式

patterns.name: 商务邮件中的协作措辞
patterns.context: 在说明团队协作、相互支持及助理替补安排的邮件正文中激活；与 listed 清单语境相邻，但不是同一词形。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的异议债权人
patterns.context: 出现在破产案件标题中，描述提出异议的债权人。

patterns.name: 若干独立词片段
patterns.context: 分别见分类编号、房产记录状态、书信套语和小说书名；没有明确共同上下文。
patterns.domain: 百科、房产记录、历史书信、书目

en.description: Activation is distributed: it commonly occurs on it in run it/ran it, and also on it in legal sentences, the comma after conducted, line breaks, past-participle ed, fragments of all-caps names, and near financial amounts.

patterns.name: Ending after the pronoun it
patterns.context: Strong activation falls on it, preceded by run/ran and followed by so, again, or a comma; it may also occur near the end of a sentence.

patterns.name: it in a judgment
patterns.context: it refers to property mentioned earlier and occurs as the object of a court order, followed by the past participle sold.

patterns.name: Sentence ending after conducted
patterns.context: Activation falls after conducted and before a comma, followed by the next clause in the same sentence; unrelated to it.

patterns.name: Line break after a programming example
patterns.context: A line break follows a sequence of code calls, followed by a thank-you; activation falls on the line-break marker.

patterns.name: Line break at sentence/paragraph end
patterns.context: A blank line or text boundary immediately follows the end of the body; no visible lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Past-tense verb -ed ending
patterns.context: Activation falls on the -ed subword fragment of a regular past-tense verb, immediately before With.

patterns.name: Fragment within an all-caps legal name
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal fragment of an all-caps compound occupational noun split by BPE, surrounded by the name of a union or group.

patterns.name: Participle suffix ed
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ed subword fragment of sectioned, followed by material; similar to a past-tense ending, but here it is a participial modifier in a medical paper.

patterns.name: Numeric fragment in an amount
patterns.context: Activation falls on a word-final fragment of totaled; nearby is a comma-grouped monetary amount.

4_2299.description: 激活位置分散：常见于 run it/ran it 中的 it，也见于法律句中的 it、conducted 后逗号、换行、过去分词 ed、全大写名称片段及财务金额附近。

patterns.name: 代词 it 后的词尾
patterns.trigger: «it»6« so»1 he could« run»2« it»10；«run»2« it»10« again»1；«ran»4« it»10
patterns.context: 强激活落在 it，前面是 run/ran，后面接 so、again 或逗号；也可能处在句末附近。

patterns.name: 判决中的 it
patterns.context: it 指代前文提到的财产，位于法院命令的宾语位置，后接过去分词 sold。

patterns.name: conducted 后的句末
patterns.context: 激活位于 conducted 后、逗号前，随后转入同一句的下一分句；与 it 无关。

patterns.name: 编程示例后的换行
patterns.context: 代码调用序列之后出现换行，随后是感谢语；激活落在换行标记。

patterns.name: 句末／段落尾换行
patterns.context: 正文结束后紧接空行或文本边界；没有可见词汇触发。

patterns.name: 过去时动词 ed 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在规则过去式的 ed 子词片段，紧接介词 With。

patterns.name: 全大写法律名称中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被 BPE 切分的全大写复合职业名词中间片段，周围为工会或团体名称。

patterns.name: 分词后缀 ed
patterns.context: 激活落在 sectioned 的 ed 子词片段，后接 material；与过去时词尾相似，但此处是医学论文中的分词修饰语。

patterns.name: 金额数字片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 totaled 的词尾片段；附近是带逗号分组的金额数字。

en.description: Activations often fall on -ing and -ed endings, especially in calling, listed, charged, tried, and similar words; they also occur in line breaks in legal texts and fragments within names in case opinions. Earlier examples contain calling, but activation positions vary; semantics and genres span a wide range.

patterns.name: -ing in calling constructions
patterns.context: When used with Call(s), activation falls mainly on the ing ending of calling; there is also one instance of “query«ing»”.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comments, health product descriptions; one example also in a technical context

patterns.name: ing ending in a proper name
patterns.context: An internal suffix; the full word appears to be “contributing”, surrounded by email text about team responsibilities and supporting colleagues.

patterns.name: ed ending in list labels
patterns.context: Occurs in lists or item descriptions, with activation on the -ed ending of Listed.

patterns.name: Litigation verbs in legal documents
patterns.context: In criminal case narratives or court instructions, activation falls on the endings of charged, tried, convicted, and charging.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in legal names
patterns.context: Activation is embedded within uppercase names or spelling variants and does not correspond to an ordinary semantic affix.

patterns.name: Line-break markers in legal texts
patterns.context: The line break itself is marked, near the body text or signature formatting of an opinion.

patterns.name: ed ending in BMX event titles
patterns.context: Event titles listed after a heading in a profile; similar to ordinary list usage but occurring in an athlete career entry.

patterns.name: Hard-to-classify ed endings
patterns.context: Past participles in narratives of arrest, trial, and conviction, overlapping with the legal litigation-verb pattern.

4_2299.description: 激活常落在 -ing、-ed 词尾，尤其是 calling、listed、charged、tried 等；也见于法律文本换行及判决姓名内部片段。前几段虽含 calling，触发位置不尽一致，语义和文体跨度大。

patterns.name: calling 结构中的 -ing
patterns.context: 与 Call(s) 连用时，激活主要落在 calling 的词尾 ing；另有“query«ing»”这一处。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论、健康产品介绍；技术语境中也有一例

patterns.name: 专名词尾 ing
patterns.context: 词内后缀，完整词似为“contributing”，周围是团队职责和支持同事的邮件内容。

patterns.name: 列举标签词尾 ed
patterns.context: 出现在名单或条目说明中，激活落在 Listed 的 -ed 词尾。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 运动员履历、商务邮件

patterns.name: 法律文书中的诉讼动词
patterns.context: 刑事案件叙述或法院指示中，激活落在 charged、tried、convicted、charging 的词尾。

patterns.name: 法律姓名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活嵌在大写或拼写变体的姓名内部，不对应普通语义词缀。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的换行标记
patterns.context: 换行符本身被标记，出现在判决正文或署名排版附近。

patterns.name: BMX 赛事名称词尾 ed
patterns.context: 履历中标题后列出的赛事头衔；与普通名单用法相似，但出现在运动员生涯条目。

patterns.name: 难以归类的词尾 ed
patterns.trigger: “charg«ed»8”之外的片段：无；本段主要高亮“«charged»”相关词形
patterns.context: 逮捕、审判和定罪叙述中的过去分词，与法律诉讼动词模式重合。

en.concept: Highly discriminative word forms in legal texts
en.description: Activation falls mainly on charging (jury instructions or charging documents), chaired (chairing a committee/project), and relates (applicability to a claim); it also occurs on the ending of Briefs in a legal case docket title.

patterns.name: charging in jury instructions
patterns.context: A legal opinion discusses whether the court erred in instructing the jury; nearby words often include “the jury,” “court,” and “erred.”

patterns.name: Serving as chair / chairing a committee
patterns.context: chair(ed) is preceded by to be or a personal name as subject and followed by a committee, research project, or institution; activation falls on the tokenized “chaired.”
patterns.domain: Biographies, institutional announcements, research project descriptions

patterns.name: The legal term charging instrument
patterns.context: The phrase “the charging instrument” is followed by “that it would seek an enhanced sentence”; this is not a jury-instruction context.

patterns.name: relates in a clause of applicability
patterns.context: The court discusses how summary judgment applies to a mental anguish damages claim, in the construction “as it relates to the claim.”

patterns.name: Docket/brief title format
patterns.context: In a formatted heading containing a court case caption or filing record and brief information, activation falls on the final letters of Briefs.

4_2299.concept: 法律文本中的高区分词形
4_2299.description: 激活主要落在 charging（陪审团指示或指控文件）、chaired（主持委员会/项目）及 relates（适用于某项请求）；另见法律案卷标题中的 Briefs 词尾。

patterns.name: 陪审团指示中的 charging
patterns.context: 法律意见讨论法院是否错误地向陪审团作出指示；附近常有“the jury”“court”“erred”等词。
patterns.domain: 美国刑事/上诉法律文书

patterns.name: 充当主席／主持委员会
patterns.context: chair(ed) 前面出现 to be 或人名作主语，后面接委员会、研究项目或机构；触发落在分词切开的“chaired”上。
patterns.domain: 人物简介、机构公告、研究项目介绍

patterns.name: charging instrument 法律术语
patterns.context: “the charging instrument”指控文件之后接“that it would seek an enhanced sentence”；不是陪审团指示语境。

patterns.name: 关系条款中的 relates
patterns.context: 法院讨论 summary judgment 如何适用于某项 mental anguish damages claim，句式为“as it relates to the claim”。

patterns.name: 案卷／摘要标题格式
patterns.trigger: «s»9（Briefs）及换行、案号、日期等标题元素
patterns.context: 法院案件抬头或提交记录与摘要信息的格式化标题中，激活落在 Briefs 的词尾字母。
patterns.domain: 法律案件标题／案卷元数据

en.concept: Procedural and record-related terms in documents
en.description: Activations occur mainly on procedural or adjudicative terms in legal documents and on data-collection phrasing involving “collection” in research texts; two other examples fall on participial endings in different contexts and are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Data collection
patterns.context: In research, project, or trial contexts, describes designing, conducting, or analyzing data, or related tools and processes.

patterns.name: Legal adjudication/procedure terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in legal texts such as court opinions, case titles, or orders; trigger words appear in different descriptions of litigation procedures, rulings, or documents.

patterns.name: Word endings in participles
patterns.context: Activation falls on part of a word split across tokens; the surrounding contexts are respectively a technical forum discussion and a news/encyclopedia narrative, with no shared semantic condition.

4_2299.concept: 文书中的流程与记录用词
4_2299.description: 激活主要落在法律文书中的程序或裁判用词，以及研究文本中“collection”数据收集表述；另有两处落在分词词尾，语境不同，难以与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 资料收集
patterns.context: 研究、项目或试验语境中，描述设计、实施、分析数据或相关工具与流程。

patterns.name: 法律裁判／程序用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见、案件标题或命令等法律文本中，触发词分布在不同诉讼程序、裁判或文书表述里。

patterns.name: 分词中的词尾
patterns.trigger: «Call»«ing»（第5段中的 Calling）；«cha»«ired»（第6段中的 chaired）
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 切分的词的一部分，周围分别是技术论坛讨论和新闻／百科叙述；未见共同语义条件。

en.concept: Unstable local word forms and legal-context features
en.description: Activation is scattered across litigation and legal-argument language, as well as the technical identifier “32,” email interface terms, code comments, and internal fragments in Spanish words and document titles; no single stable semantic trigger is observed.

patterns.name: Litigation procedure and trial
patterns.context: Legal texts describe case transfers, trials, judgments, or related procedures; activation often falls on “trial” or an internal substring.

patterns.name: Language linking claims to a judgment
patterns.context: Legal arguments use “it relates to” to introduce applicability, the scope of a judgment, or a claim; activation concentrates on tokens in the relation phrase.

patterns.name: 32 within a technical term
patterns.context: A Windows/Win32 identifier occurs in a technical context; activation falls on the number substring “32,” not the surrounding explanatory text.

patterns.name: Instructions for managing mailbox size
patterns.context: In steps explaining how to view Outlook mailbox size, activation occurs on Folder in the interface label “Folder Size.”

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a Spanish word
patterns.context: In a Spanish passage, activation falls on a tokenized fragment of the word “Quedan.”

patterns.name: Comment about a related data framework
patterns.context: The all-caps English phrase “BUILD CORRELATION DATAFRAMES INTO …” appears in a code comment.

patterns.name: Fragment within a legal document title
patterns.context: In a court document title, activation falls on the final tokenized fragment of “PROCEEDINGS.”

4_2299.concept: 不稳定的局部词形与法律语境特征
4_2299.description: 激活散见于诉讼审理与法律论证用语，也落在技术标识“32”、邮件界面词、代码注释及西语词和文书标题的词内片段；未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 诉讼程序与审理
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述案件移送、审理、判决或相关程序；激活常落在“trial”或词内子串上。

patterns.name: 判决内容关联表述
patterns.context: 法律论证中用“it relates to”引出适用性、判决范围或诉求；激活集中在关系表述中的 token。

patterns.name: 技术词内部的 32
patterns.context: 技术语境中出现 Windows/Win32 标识；激活落在“32”这一数字子串，而非周边说明文字。

patterns.name: 邮件箱大小操作说明
patterns.context: 说明如何查看 Outlook 邮箱大小的步骤中，激活出现在界面名称“Folder Size”里的 Folder。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语段落中，激活落在词内子串“Quedan”的切分部分。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会西班牙语发言

patterns.name: 相关数据框架注释
patterns.context: 代码注释中的大写英文短语“BUILD CORRELATION DATAFRAMES INTO …”。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题词内片段

patterns.context: Appears near headings, work lists, or section titles in encyclopedia entries.

patterns.name: Stars／hip fragment in a proper noun
patterns.context: The fragment occurs in the spelling of the band name Jefferson Starship／Starship; the passage also mentions songs, albums, and singles.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase in a license statement
patterns.context: Appears in a copyright and license statement at the top of a source-code file.

4_2299.concept: compile相关文本及异质格式片段
4_2299.description: 激活模式以“compile/compiles”相关代码或技术讨论最明确；此外也出现在代码词内子词、法律文书日期栏、邮件日期、百科标题、音乐专名及版权许可声明中，未见单一语义规律能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: compile/编译相关代码文本
patterns.context: 出现在命令、代码注释、插件配置或讨论软件版本的句子中；通常明确提到编译是否成功或编译配置。

patterns.name: 单词内部的切分片段
patterns.trigger: “k8s”“kustomize”“T[it]les”“licensed”“ballad”等含有被拆分标记的词片段，如“k«8»”“T«it»”“Lic«ensed»”“ball«ad»”
patterns.context: 激活常落在词内部而非完整语义单位；不同领域中都出现，可能与这些子词片段的分词或词形有关。
patterns.domain: 代码、法律、百科、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 法律文书中的日期与法官栏
patterns.trigger: “14, 2016)”“Before HULL, MARCUS and ANDERSON, Circuit Judges”“Date Filed: 12/14/2016”
patterns.context: 出现在上诉法院意见书首页的案号、日期、法官和页码格式中。

patterns.name: 日期与转发邮件格式
patterns.context: 日期、时间和转发头信息相邻，正文是活动邀请邮件。

patterns.name: 百科条目标题/目录标签
patterns.context: 出现在百科条目的标题、作品列表或小节标题附近。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Stars／hip 片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在乐队名 Jefferson Starship／Starship 的拼写中；该段同时提到歌曲、专辑及单曲。

patterns.name: 许可证声明中的固定短语
patterns.trigger: “Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. All Rights Reserved. Licensed under the MIT License.”
patterns.context: 作为源代码文件头部的版权与许可证声明出现。

en.description: Mainly responds to ending fragments in English verb forms: compiles in code contexts, naming/defining, executes, and out in various contexts. The latter commonly occurs in fill out and also appears in handouts out.

patterns.name: compile/compiles forms
patterns.context: In sentences describing building, code compilation, compiler behavior, or compilation results; highlighting falls on the ending -iles, while the root is unmarked.

patterns.name: Naming convention
patterns.context: A subsection heading in technical documentation introducing naming rules for identifiers or interfaces.

patterns.name: Defining class paths
patterns.context: An XML comment heading explaining the definition of class paths; activations fall on the ending of defining and a local fragment of classpaths.

patterns.name: Executing tests and examples
patterns.context: Comments describe running examples and tests; the trigger is the ending of executes.

patterns.name: Filling out forms/applications
patterns.context: fill out means completing an approval form or application materials; separately, out in print handouts out occurs with “distribute handouts,” in a similar activation position but with a different meaning.
patterns.domain: Business email, legal factual statements, educational content

4_2299.description: 主要响应英语动词词形中的词尾片段：代码语境的 compiles、命名/定义、executes，以及不同语境里的 out；后者常见于 fill out，也出现于 handouts out。

patterns.name: compile/compiles 词形
patterns.context: 在描述构建、代码编译、编译器行为或编译结果的句子中；突出显示落在词尾 -iles 上，且词根部分未标记。

patterns.name: 命名 convention
patterns.context: 技术文档中的小节标题，介绍标识符或接口的命名规则。

patterns.name: 定义 class paths
patterns.context: XML 注释标题，说明 class paths 的定义；激活落在 defining 的词尾及 classpaths 的局部。

patterns.name: 执行测试与样例
patterns.context: 注释中描述运行样例和测试的动作，触发词为 executes 的词尾。

patterns.name: 填写表格/申请材料
patterns.context: fill out 表示填写审批表或申请材料；另有 print handouts out 中 out 与“发放讲义”搭配，激活位置相似但语义并非填写。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、法律事实陈述、教育内容

en.description: Activations are scattered across compilation descriptions, naming subsections, code comments, and several email, legal, and table-format fields. Some numbers, rare word forms, and filenames also trigger; no single stable semantic pattern covers all examples.

patterns.name: compile(s) and code compilation descriptions
patterns.context: Occurs in source comments or technical discussions describing whether code, tests, or a project can compile; “compile(s)” is a prominent trigger, though the marked span varies slightly across examples.
patterns.domain: Software development, code comments, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Naming
patterns.context: Occurs in a naming-conventions subsection heading in documentation comments, followed by convention and a separator line.

patterns.name: Number and date fields
patterns.context: Numbers occur in case-header dates, email timestamps, location numbers, or table dates and values; no single visible numeric format explains all instances.

patterns.name: plists filename
patterns.context: Occurs in Android/macOS/iOS build instructions, referring to generated or included plist files.

patterns.name: Religious suffix -tling
patterns.context: Occurs in a narrative of the Catholic canonization process, in the form “titling her as a Servant of God”; this word form is uncommon.

patterns.name: Special body symbol
patterns.context: An asterisk opens a C-style documentation comment line; the marker covers only the symbol, with nearby content describing an API/module.

patterns.name: Email field marker
patterns.context: Occurs in the cc field of an email header, followed by a colon and whitespace.

patterns.name: Other scattered formatting triggers
patterns.context: Occur respectively in a number in a historical narrative, ordinary words in technical documentation, and email fields; they lack shared local semantics or stable context and cannot be assigned a more specific pattern.

4_2299.description: 激活分散于编译说明、命名小节、代码注释及若干邮件、法律和表格格式字段。部分数字、罕见词形和文件名也触发，未见能覆盖全部例子的单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: compile(s)及代码编译说明
patterns.context: 出现在源码注释或技术讨论中，描述代码、测试或项目能够编译；“compile(s)”是醒目触发词，但各段标记范围略有不同。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、代码注释及技术问答

patterns.name: Naming
patterns.context: 出现在文档注释的命名约定小节标题中，后接 convention 和分隔线。

patterns.name: 数字及日期字段
patterns.context: 数字嵌在案件页眉日期、邮件时间戳、位置编号或表格日期与数值中；没有可见的单一数值格式能解释全部实例。

patterns.name: plists 文件名
patterns.context: 出现在 Android/macOS/iOS 构建说明中，指生成或附带的 plist 文件。

patterns.name: 宗教词尾 -tling
patterns.context: 出现在天主教封圣程序叙述中，形式为“titling her as a Servant of God”；该词形较少见。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、宗教人物传记

patterns.name: 特殊正文符号
patterns.context: 以星号开启 C 风格文档注释行；标记只覆盖符号，邻近内容是 API/模块说明。

patterns.name: 邮件字段标记
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头的 cc 字段，后接冒号及空白。

patterns.name: 其他零散格式触发
patterns.context: 分别出现在历史叙述中的数字、技术文档普通词语和邮件字段中，缺少共同的局部语义或稳定上下文，无法据此归为更具体模式。

en.description: Mainly activates on the subword fragment “iles” in compile-related words, involving building, compilers, and target code. Sporadic activations also occur on date digits, version/math numbers, form-filling words, and fragments within several identifiers; these are not explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: Compilation and code generation
patterns.context: Discusses code compilation, build results, compilers, or compiling to a particular target; the trigger word may be split into subwords
patterns.domain: Software development, programming Q&A, and code comments

patterns.name: Slashes and digit fragments in date numbers
patterns.context: Date-format numbers in HTML table cells

patterns.name: Short numbers or digit fragments
patterns.context: Numbers appear in mixed numeric text such as version numbers, mathematical expressions, or dates; no clear shared semantic condition is evident across these examples
patterns.domain: Version discussions, table data, math problems

patterns.name: Form-filling action
patterns.context: A legal narrative describes filling out a car rental application

patterns.name: Unusual in-word subword activations
patterns.context: Appear respectively inside a software identifier, a legal proper noun, and a path/identifier, with no consistent context

4_2299.concept: 编译相关子词与杂项数字
4_2299.description: 主要对编译相关词的子词片段“iles”激活，涉及构建、编译器及目标代码；另有日期数字、版本/数学数字、填表词及若干标识符内片段的零散激活，无法由主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 编译及代码生成
patterns.context: 谈论代码编译、构建结果、编译器或编译到某种目标；触发词可能被拆分为子词
patterns.domain: 软件开发、编程问答与代码注释

patterns.name: 日期数字中的斜线与数字片段
patterns.context: HTML 表格单元格里的日期格式数字

patterns.name: 短数字或数字片段
patterns.context: 数字出现在版本号、数学表达式或日期等混合数字文本中；这些例子中未见共同的明确语义条件
patterns.domain: 版本讨论、表格数据、数学题

patterns.name: 填表动作
patterns.context: 法律叙述中描述填写汽车租赁申请表

patterns.name: 非常规词内子词激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在软件标识符、法律专名和路径/标识符内部，缺乏一致上下文

en.description: Most passages trigger on the ending of compiles, concerning software compilation or system processing. Other activations occur on the ending of titles and cross-posted, which have no apparent semantic relation to the main pattern.

patterns.name: compile forms and stem
patterns.context: Code or systems perform compilation, or the text directly discusses compilation; commonly appears as the verb compiles, with a few contexts involving compiled code or generating a browser build
patterns.domain: Software development, compiler and information-processing documentation

patterns.name: Ending of titles
patterns.context: The activation falls on the ending of titles in a list of headings; unrelated to compilation

patterns.name: Ending of cross-posted
patterns.context: The author says they reposted a comment from Reddit elsewhere; unrelated to compilation

4_2299.description: 多数段落在 compiles 一词的词尾触发，涉及软件编译或系统处理；另在 titles 的词尾和 cross-posted 的词尾触发，后两者与主模式无明显语义关联。

patterns.name: compile 的词形与词干
patterns.trigger: «iles»，出现在 comp«iles»；也包括«iles» code 和 comp«iles» separate versions
patterns.context: 代码或系统执行编译，或文字直接谈到编译；常见于动词 compiles，少数语境涉及编译代码、为浏览器生成版本
patterns.domain: 软件开发、编译器与信息处理说明

patterns.name: titles 的词尾
patterns.context: 标题列表的标题一词中，激活落在词尾，不涉及编译

patterns.name: cross-posted 的词尾
patterns.context: 作者说明将评论从 Reddit 转发到另一处；与编译无关

en.concept: Mixed word fragments and numeric formats
en.description: Activations mainly occur on compile/compiles forms in code, comments, and compiler documentation. They also occur on table-date digits, email phone numbers and timestamps, the heading Titles, and an in-word fragment of cross-posted; the latter cases have no clear semantic connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: compile / compiles
patterns.context: In code or compiler contexts, in-word fragments of the stem compile/Compile are strongly activated; they may appear in sentences, comments, headings, or identifiers.

patterns.name: Date digits in HTML tables
patterns.context: An HTML table row contains the location Tokyo, the position Integration Specialist, and the date 2010/10/14; two passages are nearly identical.

patterns.name: Titles in a heading
patterns.context: In an encyclopedia entry, introduces a list of published works as a subheading; the word is split by a line break.

patterns.name: Digits and separators in date-times
patterns.context: In email signatures, forwarded headers, or email timestamps, phone numbers and date-times are segmented into digits and punctuation.

patterns.name: Explanation of C# compiler directives
patterns.context: Explains how the C# compiler compiles the code between #if and #endif directives.

patterns.name: Specific fragment within a word
patterns.context: Appears across the hyphen and latter part of the word cross-posted; the context concerns reposting a comment across platforms.

4_2299.concept: 混合的词片段与数字格式
4_2299.description: 主要激活于 compile/compiles 相关词形（代码、注释、编译器说明）；此外还对表格日期数字、邮件电话与时间戳、Titles 标题，以及 cross-posted 的词内片段有激活，后几类与主模式缺少明显语义联系。

patterns.name: compile / compiles
patterns.context: 代码或编译器语境中，词干 compile/Compile 的词内片段受到强激活；可出现在句子、注释、标题或标识符中。

patterns.name: HTML 表格中的日期数字
patterns.context: HTML 表格行包含地点 Tokyo、职位 Integration Specialist 和日期 2010/10/14；两段几乎重复。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Titles
patterns.context: 百科条目中作为小标题引出已出版作品列表，词被换行拆分。

patterns.name: 日期时间中的数字与分隔符
patterns.context: 电子邮件签名、转发头或邮件时间戳中，电话号码和日期时间按数字与标点分段。

patterns.name: C# 编译器指令说明
patterns.context: 解释 C# 编译器遇到 #if 与 #endif 指令时如何编译其间代码。

patterns.name: 单词内部的特定片段
patterns.context: 出现在 cross-posted 一词的连字符和后半部分；上下文谈及将评论跨平台转发。

en.concept: Fields and operational statements in structured technical and business texts
en.description: Primarily responds to forwarded-email headers, date and time fields, and contact fields in business email; it also covers requests, thanks, proposal feedback, printing, and event invitations in email, as well as code compilation checks and version-revision descriptions in technical Q&A.

patterns.name: Compilation/code-check context
patterns.context: Mentions ensuring a successful build or compilation result, or describes whether code compiles after changes.

patterns.name: Email forwarding and header metadata
patterns.context: Forwarded-email markers and the structured email-header information that follows, such as sender, date and time, and contact details.

patterns.name: Polite requests and email closings
patterns.context: In email body text, requests feedback, offers help, or responds, and closes with thanks.

patterns.name: Phone and contact information
patterns.context: Office/mobile numbers, fax numbers, or email addresses listed near a name.

patterns.name: Email subject and proposal review
patterns.context: The email subject identifies a revised draft or proposal, and the body requests feedback.
patterns.domain: Corporate email, project or regulatory proposal communications

patterns.name: Printing request
patterns.context: A brief email body directly requests printing, followed by thanks or forwarded information.

patterns.name: Event invitation/attendance inquiry
patterns.context: Lists the event time and place and asks whether the recipient would like to attend.

patterns.name: Version numbers and revision notes
patterns.context: Explains version updates, changes in revision numbers, and replacement of references.

patterns.name: Date/time numeric formats in email
patterns.context: Dates and times are split into numeric and punctuation tokens, often in quoted or forwarded email headers.

4_2299.concept: 结构化技术与商务文本中的字段和操作语句
4_2299.description: 主要响应商务邮件的转发头、日期时间和联系人字段，也覆盖邮件中的请求、感谢、提案意见、打印、活动邀请；另响应代码编译检查及技术问答中的版本修订说明。

patterns.name: 编译/代码检查语境
patterns.context: 提到确保构建成功、编译结果，或描述代码修改后能否编译
patterns.domain: 软件开发讨论、代码/命令行上下文

patterns.name: 邮件转发与邮件头元数据
patterns.trigger: «Forward»ed；« on» 日期、时间及 AM/PM；邮件地址、姓名或组织路径
patterns.context: 转发邮件标记及其后的发件人、日期时间、联系方式等结构化邮件头信息

patterns.name: 礼貌请求与邮件收尾
patterns.context: 邮件正文中请求反馈、提供帮助或回应，并以感谢语收尾

patterns.name: 电话与联系信息
patterns.context: 姓名附近列出办公/手机号码、传真或电子邮件地址
patterns.domain: 商务邮件签名/联系方式

patterns.name: 邮件主题及提案审阅
patterns.context: 邮件主题标明修订稿或提案，正文要求提供意见
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、项目或监管提案沟通

patterns.name: 打印请求
patterns.context: 简短邮件正文直接请求打印，随后附感谢或转发信息

patterns.name: 活动邀请/出席询问
patterns.context: 列出活动时间地点，并询问收件人希望参加与否

patterns.name: 版本号与修订说明
patterns.context: 解释版本更新、修订编号变化及参考资料替换

patterns.name: 邮件日期时间数字格式
patterns.context: 日期、时间被拆分为数字与标点 token，常出现在邮件引述或转发头中

en.description: Activations on “compiles” cover software compiling code, templates, or directives, as well as a list of information-processing system functions in patent text; the pattern occurs across different technical genres.

patterns.name: Compiling code or configuration templates
patterns.context: “compiles” appears in the context of compilation: compiling code, templates, code between directives, or a build process; often near words such as code, version, and compiler.
patterns.domain: Software development, programming Q&A, and technical discussions

patterns.name: List of information-processing system functions
patterns.context: Appears as one of a series of coordinated functions in patent background text; the fixed wording occurs in four nearly identical passages.

4_2299.description: 对“compiles”一词的激活，涵盖软件编译代码、模板或指令，以及专利文本中信息处理系统的功能列举；不同技术文体中均出现。

patterns.name: 编译代码或配置模板
patterns.context: “compiles”处于编译动作的语境：编译代码、模板、指令之间的代码，或构建过程；常与代码、版本、编译器等词邻近。
patterns.domain: 软件开发、编程问答及技术讨论

patterns.name: 信息处理系统的功能列举
patterns.context: 在专利背景文本中，作为信息处理系统的一系列并列功能之一；该固定措辞出现在四段近乎重复的文本中。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、信息处理系统

en.description: Strongly responds to “compiles” in code contexts and also to the encyclopedia subsection heading “Titles”; it additionally responds to date/time formats in Enron forwarded-email headers and activates on “copied” in a command-line discussion. The common pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: compile/compiles code builds
patterns.context: Occurs in software code, testing, or version-change contexts, often as the predicate describing whether a build succeeds; the word activates most strongly in [1], [2], and [3].

patterns.name: Wikipedia title label
patterns.context: Serves as a heading or subsection heading in an encyclopedia entry, followed by a publication list or a description of a full title; the token is split into “T”“it”“les”.

patterns.name: Date and time in forwarded email headers
patterns.context: In forwarded Enron email metadata, dates, slashes, years, colons, and hour/minute fields are separately marked; the trigger may relate to date numbers and email-header formatting.

patterns.name: Copying command-line output
patterns.context: Discusses copying source files from a terminal; activation is on a subword of “copied”.

4_2299.description: 强烈响应代码语境中的“compiles”，也响应百科小节标题“Titles”；另对 Enron 转发邮件头中的日期时间格式有反应，并在一段命令行讨论的“copied”上激活。各模式的共同规律不明确。

patterns.name: compile/compiles 代码构建
patterns.context: 出现在软件代码、测试或版本变更的上下文中，常作为构建成功与否的谓语；[1]、[2]、[3] 中该词激活最强。

patterns.name: Wikipedia 标题标签
patterns.context: 百科条目中作为标题或小节标题，后接出版物清单或完整书名说明；token 被拆分为 “T”“it”“les”。

patterns.name: 邮件转发头中的日期时间
patterns.context: Enron 邮件的转发元数据中，日期、斜线、年份、冒号、时分等字段被分别标记；触发可能与日期数字和邮件头格式有关。

patterns.name: 复制命令行输出
patterns.context: 讨论从终端复制源文件；激活标在单词 “copied” 的子词上。

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the indefinite article «an» before words beginning with a vowel phoneme, across many genres; occupational introductions in biographical entries are a common context. The activation on «saving» in paragraph 3 does not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: Indefinite article an
patterns.context: The article an precedes a noun or adjective phrase beginning with a vowel phoneme; the following word may begin with a vowel letter or, as in «American» and «ionic», with a vowel phoneme.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: patents, medical abstracts, encyclopedia biographies, research abstracts, and project summaries

patterns.name: Occupational descriptions in biographies
patterns.context: A biographical entry gives a person’s name and dates of birth and death or birth, then uses “was an …” or “is an …” to introduce their identity, occupation, or nationality.

patterns.name: Saving-operation context (anomalous)
patterns.context: Appears in the question title “Safeguarding against user error when saving a list of information”; there is no an in this instance, so it cannot be explained by the article pattern.

4_2317.description: 主要对元音音素开头词前的不定冠词 «an» 强烈响应，跨多种文体；人物条目中的职业介绍是其常见语境。第3段的 «saving» 激活与此模式不符。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 an
patterns.context: 冠词 an 位于以元音音素开头的名词或形容词短语之前；后续词可为元音字母开头，也可如 «American»、«ionic» 以元音音素开头。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：专利、医学摘要、百科人物传记、科研摘要及项目摘要

patterns.name: 人物传记中的职业描述
patterns.context: 人物条目先给出姓名、生卒或出生日期，随后以“was an …”或“is an …”引出身份、职业或国籍描述。

patterns.name: 保存操作语境（异常）
patterns.context: 出现在提问标题“Safeguarding against user error when saving a list of information”中；该处未标记 an，无法由冠词模式解释。

en.description: The most stable pattern is strong activation on the indefinite article an: it appears in texts across multiple domains and introduces a following noun or adjective phrase. A few passages also activate on name fragments, when saving, to, and other locations, with no clear shared condition.

patterns.name: indefinite article an
patterns.context: The neuron primarily activates on the indefinite article an before a noun or noun phrase; strength ranges from 8 to 10.
patterns.domain: Multidomain texts, including patents, medical abstracts, Q&A, biographies, research abstracts, and project descriptions

patterns.name: Article an in a disease title
patterns.context: an introduces the noun update in a medical paper title; the same passage also contains «to»6, but there is insufficient evidence that it shares the main pattern.

patterns.name: when near a saving action
patterns.context: when is followed by saving, describing a user error while saving a list of information; the salient activation falls on saving, not an.

patterns.name: Cardwell in a personal name
patterns.context: The surname Cardwell is split into Card and well and appears at the start of a biography; «an»9 also occurs later in the passage.

patterns.name: Fraser in a personal name
patterns.context: The name Andy Fraser appears in a biography title position; the triggering fragment is a spelling fragment in the name, followed by «an»9 in the same passage.

patterns.name: Horace in a name
patterns.context: The name Horace appears in the biography title and again in the body; activation falls on ace in the split name, and the same passage also contains «an»9.

patterns.name: Frederick in a personal name
patterns.context: The name Frederick appears in a full personal name; activation falls on rick in the split name, and the passage also contains «an»8.

patterns.name: Multiple instances of to in research text
patterns.context: In a description of ion-channel screening, to activates in two infinitive constructions; the same passage also contains «an»9.

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase before an
patterns.context: an introduces alternating external bias; the passage is a physics abstract describing current under alternating bias.

patterns.name: an in a project description
patterns.context: an introduces important facet in a project description.

4_2317.description: 最稳定模式是对不定冠词 an 的强激活：它出现在多领域文本中并引出后续名词或形容词短语。少数段还在姓名片段、when saving、to 等位置激活，未见清晰共同条件。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 an
patterns.context: 神经元主要在不定冠词 an 上激活，出现在名词或名词短语之前；强度从 8 到 10。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本，包括专利、医学摘要、问答、人物传记、科研摘要和项目简介

patterns.name: 冠词 an 与疾病标题
patterns.context: an 引出名词 update，处在医学论文标题中；同段还出现«to»6，但没有足够证据表明它与主要模式相同。

patterns.name: 保存动作附近的 when
patterns.context: when 后接 saving，描述保存信息列表时的用户错误；显著激活落在 saving，而非 an。

patterns.name: 人物姓名中的 Cardwell
patterns.context: 姓氏 Cardwell 被拆成 Card 与 well，且处于人物传记开头；段中后续也有«an»9。

patterns.name: 人物姓名中的 Fraser
patterns.context: 名字 Andy Fraser 出现在传记标题位置；触发片段是姓名中的拼写片段，随后同段有«an»9。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Horace
patterns.context: 名字 Horace 在传记标题及正文再次出现，激活落在拆分姓名中的 ace；同段另有«an»9。

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Frederick
patterns.context: 名字 Frederick 出现在人物全名中；激活落在拆分姓名中的 rick，段中另有«an»8。

patterns.name: 科研文本中的多个 to
patterns.context: 描述离子通道筛选时，to 在两个不定式结构中激活；但同段也有«an»9。

patterns.name: an 之前的介词短语
patterns.context: an 引出 alternating external bias；同段属于物理学摘要，描述交变偏置下的电流。

patterns.name: 项目简介中的 an
patterns.context: an 引出 important facet，处于项目简介中。

en.description: Activation is scattered across different words and contexts: saving, Ruby-like, and interested in StackExchange; an in multidomain texts; numbers and was in biographies; and to in medical contexts. These lack a unified trigger.

patterns.name: saving position
patterns.context: Appears in software questions about “saving a list of information,” “saving space,” or “before/after saving instance”; strong activation is concentrated on the word

patterns.name: Placeholder after the indefinite article an
patterns.context: A noun or noun phrase follows an, across technical texts, biographies, and biomedical contexts; the activated token is actually an

patterns.name: Ruby-like
patterns.context: A programming question asks how to generate combinations in a Ruby-like style

patterns.name: Numbers in time expressions
patterns.context: Year or day-and-year number fragments in biography dates; however, dates in adjacent biographies do not all clearly activate

patterns.name: to in a high-throughput screening context
patterns.context: In technical sentences about ion-channel screening, to introduces an infinitive

patterns.name: to in an ac context
patterns.context: In a drug-resistance title, to connects viruses and a drug name; this differs from the infinitive use

patterns.name: interested in a list-processing context
patterns.context: Emphasizes a point of interest while discussing list iteration and avoiding extra passes

patterns.name: Isolated was
patterns.context: A copula in a biography; the word is not consistently highlighted in similar biographies, so a stable pattern cannot be confirmed

4_2317.description: 激活分散在多种词与语境：StackExchange 中 saving、Ruby-like、interested；多领域文本中的 an；传记数字及 was；医学语境中的 to。它们缺乏统一触发条件。

patterns.name: saving 位置
patterns.context: 出现在“saving a list of information”“saving space”或“before/after saving instance”等软件问题中；强激活集中在该词

patterns.name: 不定冠词 an 后的占位
patterns.context: an 后面接名词或名词短语，涵盖技术文本、人物传记和生物医学语境；激活 token 实际落在 an
patterns.domain: 多领域散文与百科传记

patterns.name: Ruby-like
patterns.context: 询问如何用 Ruby 风格生成组合的编程问题

patterns.name: 时间表达中的数字
patterns.context: 人物传记日期中的年份或日、年份数字片段；但相邻传记的日期并非都明显激活

patterns.name: 超高通量筛选语境中的 to
patterns.context: 离子通道筛选相关的技术句子中，to 引出动词不定式

patterns.name: ac 上下文中的 to
patterns.context: 耐药性标题中，to 连接 viruses 与药物名；与不定式用法不同

patterns.name: 列表处理语境中的 interested
patterns.context: 讨论迭代列表与避免额外遍历时，强调关注点

patterns.name: 单独的 was
patterns.context: 人物传记中的系动词；相似传记中该词并未一致高亮，无法确认稳定模式

en.concept: Weak subword fragments and heterogeneous lexical responses
en.description: Activations are scattered across domains; repeatable local cues include saving, like in hyphenated compounds, and list/information-related fragments. Most others are one-off proper nouns, numbers, technical terms, or common subword fragments, with no unified semantics or context.

patterns.name: saving substring
patterns.context: The trigger appears in general English text, including a question title, technical discussion, or explanation of a religious term; surrounding semantics and syntax are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: StackExchange questions and answers, Wikipedia religious entries

patterns.name: like in compounds
patterns.context: Appears as the second part of a hyphenated compound, preceded by a protein or gene name; occurs only in specialized terminology.

patterns.name: Intra-word/boundary fragment of the indefinite article an
patterns.context: Appears as the complete article an before audio or after was; the adjacent contexts differ, suggesting a response to a common word fragment.

patterns.name: Patent material-property term
patterns.context: Modifies cross-linked polymeric material, describing its antioxidant properties.

patterns.name: update in a title
patterns.context: Appears in the title of a review of herpes simplex viruses and acyclovir resistance, followed by ten-year survey.

patterns.name: List and information words in a citation/title
patterns.context: Appears in the StackExchange title “Safeguarding against user error when saving a list of information”; the body also discusses returned lists.

patterns.name: Year numerals in biographical format
patterns.context: Appears after a name in an encyclopedia biography, in parentheses as birth and death dates; year or date fragments are marked.

patterns.name: Name and noun-phrase fragments in encyclopedia entries
patterns.context: Names appear in entry titles or dictionary-style phrases, or a Sanskrit giving-related term and its definition; activations are sporadic and show no consistent trigger.

patterns.name: Audio vocabulary in technical text
patterns.context: Audio codec, controller, and samples occur together in a patent technical description.

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology fragments
patterns.context: Appear respectively in a review title on antiviral resistance and a gene-expression abstract; apart from compound like, there is no shared salient semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Compound engineering terms
patterns.context: A genome-engineering review lists terms such as artificial chromosomes, nucleases, and TALENs; highlights span several different words.

patterns.name: extra traversal in a programming performance discussion
patterns.context: Discusses the trade-off between lazy lists, repeated traversal, and saving space; salient activations do not fall on core list terminology.

4_2317.concept: 弱词片段与异质词汇响应
4_2317.description: 激活分散于多领域；可重复的局部线索是 saving、like（连字符复合词）及列表/信息相关片段。其余多为单次专名、数字、术语或常见词片段，缺少统一语义与上下文。

patterns.name: saving 子串
patterns.context: 触发词出现在一般英文文本中；可处于疑问标题、技术讨论或宗教术语释义中，周围语义和句法不统一。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、Wikipedia 宗教条目

patterns.name: like 复合词中的 like
patterns.context: 作为连字符复合词后半部分出现，前面为蛋白质或基因名称；只见于专门术语。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 an 的词内/词边界片段
patterns.context: 出现在 audio 前的完整冠词 an，或 was 后的冠词 an；相邻上下文不同，可能是常见词片段响应。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本、百科人物传记

patterns.name: 专利材料性质词
patterns.context: 修饰 cross-linked polymeric material，描述其抗氧化性质。

patterns.name: 标题中的 update
patterns.context: 出现在 herpes simplex viruses 对 acyclovir resistance 的综述标题中，并接续 ten-year survey。

patterns.name: 引文/标题中的列表与信息词
patterns.context: 出现在 StackExchange 标题“Safeguarding against user error when saving a list of information”中；另有正文谈 returned lists。

patterns.name: 人物传记格式中的年份数字
patterns.context: 在百科人物条目的姓名后，以括号内出生、逝世日期形式出现；年份或日期片段被标记。

patterns.name: 百科姓名与名词短语片段
patterns.context: 条目标题或词条式短语中出现人名，或梵语布施术语及其释义；激活零散分布，未形成一致触发条件。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物条目、宗教/梵语条目

patterns.name: 技术文本中音频词汇
patterns.context: 音频 codec、controller 与 samples 同现，属于专利技术描述。

patterns.name: 生物医学领域术语片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在抗病毒耐药综述标题和基因表达摘要中；除复合词 like 外，没有共同的显著语义触发。

patterns.name: 工程术语复合词
patterns.context: 基因组工程综述中列举人工染色体、核酸酶及 TALEN 等术语；高亮涉及多个不同词。

patterns.name: 程序性能讨论中的 extra traversal
patterns.context: 讨论惰性列表、重复遍历与节省空间的取舍；显著激活未落在核心列表术语上。

en.description: Activation does not reflect a single semantics: the most stable recurring cue is like in hyphenated or compound terms; other isolated cues include passing, saving, name segmentation, the patent article an, legal citation numbers, and banking-history vocabulary.

patterns.name: like in compound words
patterns.context: like appears in hyphenated compound terms or category names, preceded by a descriptor or proper name; it is sometimes adjacent to a segmentation boundary.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, genetic engineering, and programming Q&A

patterns.name: passing
patterns.context: The word appears in action or event descriptions; [8] is “passing through,” and [9] is passage of a bill.

patterns.name: Within-word segmentation or subword boundary
patterns.context: Activation can fall on a segmented fragment within a word or on a complete token of an ordinary word; name segmentation and other highlighted words do not show a shared semantics.

patterns.name: an in patent corpora
patterns.context: An article between noun phrases such as audio codec and audio controller in patent technical descriptions.

patterns.name: Numbers in legal citations
patterns.context: Volume numbers, reporter abbreviations, and page numbers adjacent to case-citation formats, such as “87 F.3d 117”.

patterns.name: Banking-history vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes the U.S. Congress passing a bill that granted banks the right to issue paper money; salient activation is concentrated on «passing».

4_2317.description: 激活并非单一语义：最稳定的重复线索是连字符或复合术语中的 like；另有 passing、saving、姓名分词、专利冠词 an、法律引文数字，以及银行史词汇等孤立线索。

patterns.name: 复合词中的 like
patterns.trigger: «like»10（[3]、[5]），«like»9（[7]、[10]）；另见«most Ruby-»与«like»之间的组合、«transcription activator-like effector»
patterns.context: like 出现在连字符复合术语或类别名称中，前面为描述词或专名；有时邻接分词边界。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、基因工程、编程问答

patterns.name: passing
patterns.context: 该词出现在动作或事件描述中；[8] 为“passing through”，[9] 为法案通过。

patterns.name: 分词内部或子词边界
patterns.context: 激活可落在词内分词片段，也可落在普通词的完整 token；词内姓名分割与其他高亮词未显示共同语义。

patterns.name: 专利语料中的 an
patterns.context: 专利技术描述中，audio codec、audio controller 等名词短语之间的冠词。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字
patterns.context: 紧邻判例引文格式中的卷号、报告集缩写及页码，如“87 F.3d 117”。

patterns.name: 银行史词汇
patterns.trigger: «entitled» to print、«National Banking Act»及«National Currency Act»
patterns.context: 描述美国国会通过法案并赋予银行发行纸币的权利；显著激活集中在«passing»。

en.concept: Enzyme terminology and sporadic word forms
en.description: Activations concentrate on enzyme, coenzyme, and isoenzyme term fragments in biochemical abstracts; there are also instances of passing in varied contexts, plus an isolated code identifier Bit and the descriptive form like, with no shared semantics apparent.

patterns.name: Enzyme- and coenzyme-related terminology
patterns.context: Descriptions of enzymes, isoenzymes, coenzymes, and their activity or metabolic roles; some terms are split into multiple tokens, with activations mainly on term fragments.

patterns.name: passing and transfer contexts
patterns.context: passing means transferring, carrying, or performing an operation; however, its specific meaning varies substantially across paragraphs.
patterns.domain: Medical experiment descriptions, programming questions and documentation

patterns.name: The letter sequence “Bit” in a technical name
patterns.context: Appears as part of a method name in code; it may be triggered by a specific identifier, with only one instance.

patterns.name: “like” in a medical term
patterns.context: Describes an animal with rodent-like incisors; occurs once, and its relation to other activation patterns is unclear.

4_2317.description: 激活集中在生化摘要中的酶、辅酶及同工酶术语片段；另有多种语境中的 passing，以及孤立的代码标识符 Bit 和形态描述 like，未显示共同语义。

patterns.name: 酶与辅酶相关术语
patterns.context: 围绕酶、同工酶、辅酶及其活性或代谢作用的描述；部分术语被拆分成多个 token，激活主要落在术语片段上。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、医学与生命科学摘要

patterns.name: passing 及传递语境
patterns.context: 出现 passing，表示传递、携带或执行某项操作；但不同段落的具体含义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 医学实验描述与编程问答、文档

patterns.name: 技术名词中的字母组合“Bit”
patterns.context: 代码中作为方法名的一部分出现，可能是特定标识符触发，语境仅此一例。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的“like”
patterns.context: 形容动物具有类似啮齿类的门齿；单次出现，和其他激活模式的关系不明。

en.description: The most prominent trigger shared by all snippets is the indefinite article «an»; it is followed by an occupation, physical object, product slogan, graph structure, compound, programming data type, or academic question. Genres and topics vary, with no reliable domain restriction.

patterns.name: Complement following an
patterns.context: Activations consistently occur after the English indefinite article an; the following noun or adjective phrase varies with context, including “English songwriter”, “alternating external bias”, “all-new Avatar”, “embedded graph”, “edge”, “array pointer”, “ions”, “eigenvalue problem”, and “interference alignment problem”.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text, especially abstracts and expository writing

4_2317.description: 所有片段共同且最突出的触发点都是不定冠词 «an»；其后接人物职业、物理对象、产品宣传语、图结构、化合物、程序数据类型或各类学术问题。文体与主题多样，未见可靠的领域限定。

patterns.name: an 后接不定冠词补语
patterns.context: 激活集中稳定出现在英文不定冠词 an 之后；后续名词或形容词短语因上下文而异，包括“English songwriter”“alternating external bias”“all-new Avatar”“embedded graph”“edge”“array pointer”“ions”“eigenvalue problem”“interference alignment problem”。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文文本，尤以摘要和说明文为主

en.concept: Local English word forms and formatting fragments
en.description: Activations occur in several types of English text: the patent material term resistant, an in technical question titles, the Apache license template in code comments, and local words or typography in bibliographic and literary text. No single trigger pattern explains all snippets.

patterns.name: “resistant” in patent material terminology
patterns.context: Appears in the compound material name “Oxidation resistant cross-linked polymeric material”, describing a material property; activations concentrate on resistant.

patterns.name: an in an English question title
patterns.context: “an” appears in a StackExchange question title, followed by a technical object or operation, such as “an XML”, “an array”, or “an Entry Field”; the title has surrounding Q: and line-break formatting.

patterns.name: Software copyright notices and Apache license template
patterns.context: Code comments include copyright years and project or author information, followed by “Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2”; this involves formatted comments and fixed license text.

patterns.name: English book titles and directory-style poem-title formatting
patterns.context: The article an in a book title, or a poem title surrounded by formatting markers with author, page number, and line breaks; the precise trigger differs across instances.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia bibliographic text and Gutenberg poetry collection contents/titles

patterns.name: “throbbing heart” in literary narration
patterns.context: “the throbbing heart” metaphorically describes a metropolis as the center of an empire; activation spans an intra-word fragment in throbbing and the following noun.

4_2317.concept: 英文局部词形与格式片段
4_2317.description: 激活分布在多类英语文本中：专利材料词 resistant、技术问句中 an、代码注释的 Apache 许可模板，以及书目和文学文本中的局部词语或排版。没有单一触发模式能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 专利材料术语中的“resistant”
patterns.context: 出现在复合材料名称“Oxidation resistant cross-linked polymeric material”中，修饰材料性质；激活集中在 resistant。

patterns.name: 英文疑问帖标题中的 an
patterns.context: “an”出现在 StackExchange 问题标题中，后接技术对象或操作对象，如“an XML”“an array”“an Entry Field”；周围有 Q: 与标题换行格式。

patterns.name: 软件项目版权声明与 Apache 许可模板
patterns.context: 代码注释中出现版权年份、项目或作者信息，随后是“Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2”；涉及格式化注释及固定许可文本。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源代码注释、开源许可证

patterns.name: 英文书名与目录式诗题排版
patterns.context: 书名中的冠词 an，或诗题中被排版标记包围的标题、作者、页码与换行；具体触发点不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 百科书目文本与 Gutenberg 诗集目录/标题

patterns.name: 文学叙述中的 throbbing heart
patterns.context: “the throbbing heart”用于描写大都市作为帝国中心的比喻；激活跨越 throbbing 的词内片段及其后名词。

en.description: All segments prominently feature “an”, usually before nouns or names beginning with a vowel phoneme; most are definition sentences following titles. Some activations fall on titles, line breaks, question-and-answer markers, and sporadic proper-name fragments, which cannot be attributed to a consistent condition.

patterns.name: Indefinite article “an”
patterns.context: Immediately precedes a letter, abbreviation, or name/noun beginning with a vowel phoneme; activations often occur in title restatements or explanatory sentences
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, abstracts, and question-and-answer text

patterns.name: Encyclopedia definition sentence following a title
patterns.context: A title or question is followed by a brief definition, introduction, or description; this pattern overlaps with “an” itself

patterns.name: Title and line-break formatting
patterns.context: A title occupies its own line, and the body begins with the same name after a line break; activations are scattered across title characters and line breaks

patterns.name: Question-and-answer site markers and titles
patterns.context: A question title or title fragment appears before the question-and-answer body; some title words are activated

patterns.name: Specific names or title fragments
patterns.context: A few words in proper names, book titles, paper titles, or term headings are marked; no consistent semantic or morphological condition is apparent

4_2317.description: 所有段都突出“an”，通常位于元音音素起始的名词或名称前；多数为标题后定义句。部分激活落在标题、换行、问答标记及零散专名词片段上，无法归为一致条件。

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to the indefinite article an before noun phrases, often in technical or formal explanatory text; also appears in encyclopedia entries where an introduces a proper-name modifier.

4_2317.description: 主要对名词短语前的不定冠词 an 强烈响应，常见于技术或正式说明文本；也见于百科条目中 an 引出的专名修饰语。

patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、科学论文及正式技术文体

patterns.context: an 是不定冠词，紧接专名 NBC-affiliated，构成电视台介绍句

en.description: Activations often fall on segmented English identifiers, abbreviations, or proper-name fragments, such as LocalDb, PhpUnitTest, C-130J, KNEP, and itensor; there are also sporadic examples involving C, email addresses, and ordinary phrase boundaries. They span domains and genres, with no unified semantics or stable grammatical condition.

patterns.name: “LocalDb” identifier fragment
patterns.context: LocalDb appears as an instance name in a description of SQL Server installation options and instance names; activations concentrate on fragments within the identifier.

patterns.name: PHPUnit identifier fragment
patterns.context: Appears as part of a namespace or path key in the autoload configuration of composer.json.

patterns.name: Strict identifier fragment
patterns.context: Within the field name Strict-Transport-Security in an HTTP response header.

patterns.name: C-130 aircraft model fragment
patterns.context: The model C-130J appears in an introduction to an airlift squadron and its aircraft.

patterns.name: C programming language marker
patterns.context: C appears as part of a tool name in a CPAchecker project comment; it is also specified in parentheses in a Linux work-history entry.

patterns.name: Local portion of an email address
patterns.context: The letter C appears in a contact email address within segmented address text.

patterns.name: KNEP callsign fragment
patterns.context: The television callsign KNEP appears in an introduction to a broadcast television station.

patterns.name: itensor path fragment
patterns.context: The directory name itensor/ appears in a C/C++ header-file include path.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in “inspecting”
patterns.context: The patent background includes “an inspecting function”; the high-activation fragment is near the boundary between the indefinite article and the following word.

4_2317.description: 激活多落在被切分的英文标识符、缩写或专名片段中，如 LocalDb、PhpUnitTest、C-130J、KNEP、itensor；也有 C、邮件地址及普通词组边界等零散例子。跨领域、跨文体，未见统一语义或稳定语法条件。

patterns.name: “LocalDb”标识符片段

patterns.name: 邮件地址域名局部

patterns.name: “inspecting”词内片段
patterns.context: 专利背景中出现 “an inspecting function”；高激活片段位于不定冠词与后接词的边界附近。

en.description: Activation is scattered across code structures and paths, configuration fields, HTML tags, command-line arguments, and fragments of proper names, abbreviations, and scientific terms; triggering forms vary by context, with no unified word meaning or stable theme.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: Around punctuation, line breaks, and split identifiers in C# method implementation/generated code snippets; activation is concentrated on structural symbols and name fragments.

patterns.name: Proper-name and place-name fragments
patterns.context: Call signs and place names in news entries, or email recipients/name lists; some activation falls on subword fragments of proper names.

patterns.name: C/C++ include paths
patterns.context: Consecutive preprocessor include directives, with paths composed of directory names, slashes, and filenames.

patterns.name: Configuration fields and connection status
patterns.context: Aligned fields and values resembling network status/configuration dumps, including connection type and status.

patterns.name: HTML lists and links
patterns.context: In repeated li/a tag structures, link attributes, list items, and link text appear adjacent to one another.

patterns.name: Command-line arguments and filesystem operations
patterns.context: After describing filesystem recovery steps, a remount command and extundelete arguments appear.

patterns.name: Word fragments in name lists
patterns.context: Bibliographies or personal names listed line by line, with multiple names sharing recurring components such as Rajab Ali.

patterns.name: Scientific terms and chemical symbols
patterns.context: Paper sentences describing peroxides, substrate intermediates, and radical/ionic properties; activation falls on chemical symbols and term fragments.

patterns.name: Abbreviations and experimentally induced results
patterns.context: Experimental abstract comparing abbreviations such as PABA, INH, AN and enzyme-activity induction results.

4_2317.description: 激活分散于代码结构与路径、配置字段、HTML 标签、命令行参数，以及专名、缩写和科学术语片段；各段触发形式随语境变化，未见统一词义或稳定主题。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与标点边界
patterns.context: C# 方法实现/生成代码片段中，标点、换行和被切分的标识符周围；激活集中在结构符号及名称片段上。

patterns.name: 专名与地名片段
patterns.context: 新闻条目中的呼号、地名，或邮件收件人/姓名列表；部分激活落在专名的子词片段上。

patterns.name: C/C++ include 路径
patterns.context: 连续的预处理器 include 指令中，路径由目录名、斜杠和文件名组成。

patterns.name: 配置字段与连接状态
patterns.context: 类似网络状态/配置转储的对齐字段和值，含连接类型与状态。

patterns.name: HTML 列表与链接
patterns.context: 重复的 li/a 标签结构中，链接属性、列表项及链接文字相邻出现。

patterns.name: 命令行参数与文件系统操作
patterns.context: 说明文件系统恢复步骤后，出现 remount 命令及 extundelete 参数。

patterns.name: 人名列表中的词片段

patterns.name: 科学术语与化学符号

patterns.name: 缩写与实验诱导结果
patterns.context: 比较 PABA、INH、AN 等缩写及酶活性诱导结果的实验摘要。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code, configuration, encyclopedia, and scientific text: they often fall on subword fragments of proper names or technical terms, and also cover Shell/XML tags, filenames, numbering, and punctuation. No single word-form or semantic trigger is stable across all segments.

patterns.name: Mount options in Shell commands
patterns.context: A Linux command-line discussion includes mount/remount and read-only filesystem options; adjacent delete/restore commands are also marked.

patterns.name: Shell conditional tests and paths
patterns.context: A Shell script tests a file or path, references HOME, and loads an RVM script; activations also cover a closing square bracket and the source dot.

patterns.name: Place name Scott and other proper names
patterns.context: In geographical or broadcast-station descriptions, Scott is part of the place name Scott(s)bluff; An«gor»a is also marked in the same segment.

patterns.name: U.S. election title and proper-name segmentation
patterns.context: In the title or index entry for the 1906 special election, the state name and the name of the U.S. House of Representatives are split into marked fragments; there are also minor activations on the number and Special.

patterns.name: Code identifier in an unimplemented exception
patterns.context: A C# method throws NotImplementedException; activation falls on the identifier Un«o», with some surrounding braces and implemented also marked.

patterns.name: Military unit name and number
patterns.context: An entry title names an Airlift Squadron with an ordinal number; the body continues with information about the air force unit, base, and aircraft.

patterns.name: Filename references and header include chain
patterns.context: A technical explanation lists #include relationships between .h header files; punctuation in numbered lists is also activated.

patterns.name: JSON configuration fields and boolean-style values
patterns.context: In a JSON configuration snippet, field names and values are mostly off and concern preference options; activations concentrate on field-name fragments rather than off alone.

patterns.name: XML/HTML tags and attributes
patterns.context: A page-layout template uses namespaced form tags, include elements, and XHTML paths.

patterns.name: Term fragments in a scientific title
patterns.context: The title and abstract discuss protease-resistant, highly active phytase; activations cover fragments within engineered terminology.

4_2317.description: 激活分散于代码、配置、百科和科学文本：常落在专名或技术词的子词片段，也覆盖 Shell/XML 标记、文件名、编号与标点。没有跨所有段都稳定出现的单一词形或语义触发器。

patterns.name: Shell 命令中的挂载参数
patterns.context: Linux 命令行讨论中出现 mount/remount 及只读文件系统参数；相邻的 delete/restore 命令也被标记。

patterns.name: Shell 条件测试与路径
patterns.context: Shell 脚本里测试文件或路径，引用 HOME 并加载 RVM 脚本；激活还覆盖闭合方括号和 source 点号。

patterns.name: 地名 Scott 与地名专名
patterns.context: 地理或广播电台介绍中，Scott 作为地名 Scott(s)bluff 的组成部分；同段还标记了 An«gor»a。

patterns.name: 美国选举标题及专名分词
patterns.context: 1906 年特别选举的标题或索引条目中，州名与美国众议院名称被拆分标记；数字和 Special 也有少量激活。

patterns.name: 未实现异常中的代码标识符

patterns.name: 军种单位名称与编号

patterns.name: 文件名引用与头文件包含链

patterns.name: JSON 配置字段与布尔样式值
patterns.context: JSON 配置片段里字段名和值多为 off，涉及偏好选项；激活集中在字段名的片段，而非单独的 off。

patterns.name: XML/HTML 标签与属性
patterns.context: 页面布局模板中使用带命名空间的表单标签、include 元素和 XHTML 路径。

patterns.name: 科学标题中的术语片段
patterns.context: 标题及摘要讨论耐蛋白酶、高活性的植酸酶；激活覆盖工程化术语中的片段。

en.description: Activation occurs across various technical texts, web data, legal decisions, paper acknowledgments, encyclopedias, and email headers; it often falls on mixed-case or segmented proper names, abbreviations, fields, command options, and technical terms, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Shell commands, paths, and system configuration
patterns.context: In command-line or configuration snippets, activation falls on options, identifiers, and their segmented substrings; includes Linux filesystem operations and build-environment setup.

patterns.name: English legal terms and litigation roles
patterns.context: Legal roles such as parental rights and appellant appear in a family-law decision narrative; stronger activation is on «appellant».

patterns.name: Paper acknowledgments and funding agencies/numbers
patterns.context: Conference/project information and author funding acknowledgments in a mathematics paper; agency names and numbers are split into subword fragments.

patterns.name: Web interface status fields
patterns.context: Field names, periods, script statuses, and values interleave in web status objects or serialized interface data.

patterns.name: CORS and HTTP preflight
patterns.context: Explains how to enable cross-origin resource sharing and preflight requests; terms are segmented into case-sensitive subwords.

patterns.name: Header-file inclusion relationships
patterns.context: Describes a simple, linear inclusion chain between C/C++ header files; activation involves include directives and filename fragments.

patterns.name: Broadcast station call signs and place names
patterns.context: Introduces Nebraska TV station channels, studios, and transmitter locations; call signs and place names are segmented.

patterns.name: Email headers and forwarding/authentication warnings
patterns.context: Authentication warnings, sender rewriting, and forwarding markers appear in mailing-list message headers.

patterns.name: C language standards and compiler support
patterns.context: Compares C99 with C programming resources, GNU/GCC usage, and compiler support levels.

4_2317.description: 激活分布在多种技术文本、网页数据、法律判决、论文致谢、百科和邮件头中；常落在大小写混合或被拆分的专名、缩写、字段、命令选项及专业术语上，没有单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: shell 命令、路径与系统配置

patterns.context: 讨论刑事被告是否获告知权利，以及律师或认罪协议如何满足相关程序要求。

patterns.name: 战争报道中的盟军与作战描述
patterns.trigger: “forces… are fighting”、“backed by the US-led coalition”
patterns.context: 描述叙利亚、伊拉克的武装冲突及库尔德、伊拉克部队获得联军支持。

en.description: Activations are distributed across code and configuration files, technical documentation, legal titles and body text, email lists, repeated data strings, and Slovenian text. Common visible features are subword splitting, structural markers, or formatted text; no single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Visible tokenizer subword boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur in words or identifiers split by tokenization; no specific semantic content is required.

patterns.name: Punctuation and fields in code
patterns.context: Punctuation, field names, and nearby structured content are marked in code or configuration files; segment 1 contains array-/type-like code, and segment 4 contains a Conda environment configuration.

patterns.name: Legal case titles and citation format
patterns.context: Near case citations, party names, and litigation-status labels; not limited to ordinary legal body text.

patterns.name: Rights and agreement vocabulary in legal arguments
patterns.context: In legal body text discussing whether a defendant was informed of their rights and plea agreements.

patterns.name: Document markers and file-property vocabulary
patterns.context: Titles, reStructuredText markers, and file-property descriptions occur together in document or API text.

patterns.name: Email addresses and comma-separated contacts
patterns.context: Multiple email addresses listed consecutively and separated by commas or line breaks.

patterns.name: Repeated alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: The same short string is repeated multiple times, followed by slightly varying alphanumeric sequences; no visible natural-language context.
patterns.domain: Formatted or data strings in email

patterns.name: Token fragments in European political text
patterns.context: Split words in Slovenian text discussing the European Council, plans, or approvals.

4_2317.concept: 格式化文本中的分词碎片
4_2317.description: 激活分散于代码与配置、技术文档、法律标题和正文、邮箱列表、重复数据串及斯洛文尼亚语文本；共同可见特征多为子词拆分、结构标记或格式化文本，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 可见的 tokenizer 子词边界
patterns.trigger: 字母被拆成带空格的子词，如 «TR»«UST»EES OF INTER«NAL»« IM»«PR»OVEMENT、av«l»2jeni« v»1« cel»1ot«ni»1；以及代码中的 «c»«_»«v»
patterns.context: 触发出现在被分词拆开的词或标识符中；不要求特定语义内容。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本、法律文本、代码

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与字段
patterns.context: 代码或配置文件中，标点、字段名及其附近结构化内容被标记；第1段为类似数组/类型的代码，第4段为 conda 环境配置。

patterns.name: 法律判例标题与引证格式
patterns.context: 判例引证、当事人姓名与诉讼身份标签附近；并非仅普通法律正文。

patterns.name: 法律论述中的权利与协议词汇
patterns.context: 叙述被告是否获告知权利及认罪协议的法律正文中。

patterns.name: 文档标记与文件属性词汇
patterns.context: 文档或 API 文本中，标题、reStructuredText 标记和文件属性说明相邻出现。

patterns.name: 邮箱地址与逗号分隔联系人
patterns.context: 多个邮箱地址连续列出，并由逗号或换行分隔。

patterns.name: 重复的字母数字串
patterns.context: 相同短串多次重复，后接略有变化的数字字母序列；无可见自然语言语境。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的格式化或数据串

patterns.name: 欧洲政治文本中的分词碎片
patterns.context: 斯洛文尼亚语文本中被拆开的词，谈及欧洲理事会、计划或批准事项。

en.concept: formatting and boundary cues in structured text
en.description: Activation occurs across various formatted texts: indentation, line breaks, punctuation, and segmented identifiers in code, configuration, command-line documentation, and lists; localized words in legal, historical, license, and email contexts also appear.

patterns.name: Indented whitespace in code or documentation
patterns.context: Activation often falls on leading indentation or around line breaks in structured text; sometimes it appears alongside punctuation or code markers, but the content differs across examples.
patterns.domain: Code, configuration files, command-line manuals, and email

patterns.name: Uppercase or mixed-case code identifier fragments
patterns.context: In code, XML, or command-line documentation, identifiers are split into multiple tokens; activation is concentrated on internal identifier fragments rather than a stable whole-word meaning.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and code structure
patterns.context: Adjacent to paths, numbers, arguments, ranges, or structural boundaries in code or command-line syntax; the specific syntax differs across passages.

patterns.name: Fixed-format legal text
patterns.context: Appears in continuous legal narrative about whether a defendant was informed of their constitutional rights and about plea agreements.

patterns.name: Proper names and dates in railroad history
patterns.context: Describes historical events involving railroad line leases, mergers, and takeovers.

patterns.name: Phrases in open-source license statements
patterns.context: In code license or contributor statements, explains that a work is covered by an open-source license and the right to submit modifications.

patterns.name: Brief confirmation and a single letter in email
patterns.context: After the brief reply “That works for me.” there is a separate letter D; its meaning cannot be determined from context.

patterns.name: C++ set-algorithm call
patterns.context: A function body calls the standard-library set-intersection algorithm and passes two ranges and an output iterator.

patterns.name: Hyphenated entries in a dependency list
patterns.context: Lists software packages or build dependencies line by line, with entries beginning with an indented hyphen.

patterns.name: Structured XML configuration fields
patterns.context: A configuration snippet uses tags, attributes, and values to describe connections, chassis, and implementation items.

4_2317.concept: 结构化文本中的格式与边界线索
4_2317.description: 激活分布于多种格式化文本：代码、配置、命令行文档和清单中的缩进、换行、标点及被切分的标识符；另见法律、历史、许可声明和邮件中的局部词语。

patterns.name: 代码或文档中的缩进空白
patterns.trigger: 缩进空格、制表符，以及换行附近的空白，如「   」「↵」「	」
patterns.context: 激活常落在结构化文本的行首缩进或换行周围；有时与标点、代码标记同时出现，但各例内容不同。
patterns.domain: 代码、配置文件、命令行手册及邮件

patterns.name: 大写或混合大小写的代码标识符片段
patterns.context: 在代码、XML 或命令行文档中，标识符被切分为多个 token；激活集中于标识符内部片段，而非稳定的完整词义。

patterns.name: 数字、标点与代码结构
patterns.context: 在代码或命令行语法中邻接路径、数字、参数、范围或结构边界；各段对应的具体语法并不相同。

patterns.name: 固定格式的法律文本
patterns.context: 出现在关于被告是否获告知宪法权利及认罪协议的连续法律叙述中。

patterns.name: 铁路历史叙述中的专名与日期
patterns.context: 描述铁路线路租赁、并入及接管的历史事件。

patterns.name: 开源许可声明中的词组
patterns.context: 在代码许可或贡献者声明中说明作品受开源许可覆盖及提交修改的权利。

patterns.name: 邮件中的简短确认及单字母
patterns.context: 简短回复“That works for me.”之后，另有单独的字母 D；字母的含义无法从上下文确定。

patterns.name: C++ 集合算法调用
patterns.context: 函数体中调用标准库集合交集算法，并传入两个范围及结果迭代器。

patterns.name: 依赖项清单中的连字符条目
patterns.context: 逐行列出软件包或构建依赖，条目以缩进连字符开头。
