patterns.name: 结构化 XML 配置字段
patterns.context: 配置片段以标签、属性和值描述连接、机箱及实现项。

en.description: Activations are most prominent on itself/self, Appellant in legal case names, and document boundary markers. Sporadic responses also occur on patents, philosophical arguments, physics terms, email subject lines, and fragments within Portuguese words; overall, there is no unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: self at the end of a sentence or within a word
patterns.context: Strong responses to reflexive expressions itself / itself, itself (and self within a word); these occur in philosophical arguments, news headlines, and programming explanations, without requiring the same domain context.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: philosophy, news headlines, programming Q&A

patterns.name: Party labels in legal cases
patterns.context: Appears in case titles or case-name formats, identifying an appellant; nearby text includes party names, family relationships, or court case numbers.

patterns.name: Colon and formatted title boundaries
patterns.context: Colons after code repository file titles, and structured boundaries such as titles, line breaks, and separators in documents; this activation co-occurs with the specific code context below, so it is unclear whether it constitutes an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Parenthetical expression in a legal chemistry patent
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph discusses reactants and catalysts; the strong response is on itself, alongside a comma and conventional patent phrasing.

patterns.name: Concessive phrasing in philosophical arguments
patterns.context: Discusses beliefs, evidence, and audiences; activation falls on pronouns such as them, especially when they refer again to a previously mentioned group at the end of a sentence.

patterns.name: Compound boundary in a model name
patterns.context: A physics paper uses a hyphenated dimensional adjective and introduces the Ising and Potts models in parallel; activation centers on the number and hyphen.

patterns.name: Preposition boundaries in email fields and subject lines
patterns.context: A news headline follows email header fields; this segment also has a strong activation on itself, so it is unclear whether it shares the reflexive-expression pattern.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in a Portuguese verb
patterns.context: In an introduction to a Portuguese philosophy journal, activation falls on an in-word fragment of a verb or pronoun; no English trigger pattern can be reliably matched to other segments.

4_2317.description: 激活最明显地出现在 itself/self、法律案名中的 Appellant，以及文档边界符号；另有专利、哲学论述、物理术语、邮件标题和葡萄牙语词内片段等零散响应，整体缺乏统一触发规律。

patterns.name: 句末或词内的 self
patterns.trigger: «it»1 … «out»3 of … «it»1 is made «out»3 of … «it»1 is made «out»3 of; «in»2 «it»self9; «it»4«self»9; «variable»2 … «PA»3 its«self»9
patterns.context: 对反身表达 itself / itself、itself（以及词内 self）的强响应；分别出现在哲学论述、新闻标题和编程解释中，前后文并不要求同一领域。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：哲学、新闻标题、编程问答

patterns.name: 法律案件当事人标签
patterns.context: 出现在案件标题或案名格式中，标记上诉人；周围有当事人姓名、亲属关系或法院案件编号。

patterns.name: 冒号及格式化标题边界
patterns.context: 代码仓库文件标题后的冒号，以及文档中标题、换行和分隔线等结构化边界；此处触发与下述具体代码上下文共同出现，无法确认是独立模式。
patterns.domain: 代码仓库文本、结构化文档

patterns.name: 法律化学专利中的插入表达
patterns.trigger: « presence»1« of»2« an»2« am»1moxidation catalyst … « itself»10«,»4 may be utilized
patterns.context: 专利背景段落讨论反应物和催化剂；强响应落在 itself，伴随逗号及专利惯用表达。

patterns.name: 哲学论证中的让步措辞
patterns.trigger: « them»5 given … « are»1 mistaken … « fundamental»2«ist»1 … « by»2« them»9
patterns.context: 讨论信念、证据和受众；激活落在 them 一类代词上，特别是句末再次指代前述群体。

patterns.name: 模型名称中的复合词边界
patterns.context: 物理学论文中以连字符构成维数形容词，并列介绍 Ising 与 Potts 模型；激活集中于数字和连字符。

patterns.name: 邮件字段和标题中的介词边界
patterns.context: 邮件头部字段之后接新闻标题；本段另有 itself 强激活，故是否与反身表达模式相同不确定。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语动词词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语哲学刊物介绍中，激活落在动词或代词的词内片段，未见可与其他段可靠对应的英语触发模式。

en.concept: self, object pronouns, and structural boundaries
en.description: Primarily responds to self/itself and self-compounds, as well as the object pronoun them; there are also sporadic responses to delimiters, field markers, and legal case-heading formats in structured text.

patterns.name: self and its suffixes
patterns.context: self appears alone or in self-promotion, itself, self-healing, and itself; in these examples, activation is concentrated on self or the immediately following token.

patterns.name: Object use of them
patterns.context: The pronoun them functions as an object, referring to people, organizations, or things mentioned earlier; it is followed by a participle or prepositional phrase, or occurs after a verb.

patterns.name: Colons and structured markers
patterns.context: Activation occurs near delimiters, field markers, or Q&A labels in structured text such as code documentation or email headers; activation locations differ across markers.
patterns.domain: Github documentation, email, StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Legal case-heading format
patterns.context: A heading line composed of party names, labels for the litigants, and punctuation in a court-case citation.

4_2317.concept: self 与宾语代词及结构边界
4_2317.description: 主要响应 self/itself 及 self-复合词、宾语代词 them；另对结构化文本中的分隔符、字段标记及法律案件标题格式有零散响应。

patterns.name: self 及其后缀
patterns.context: self 单独出现或构成 self-promotion、itself、self-healing、itself；这些例子中激活集中在 self 或其后紧邻 token。
patterns.domain: 论坛、商务邮件、法律/技术讨论

patterns.name: them 的宾语用法
patterns.context: 代词 them 作宾语，指代前文提到的人、机构或事物；后接分词、介词短语，或处于动词后。

patterns.name: 冒号与结构化标记
patterns.context: 代码文档或邮件头等结构化文本中，分隔符、字段标记或问答标签附近出现激活；不同标记的激活位置不完全相同。
patterns.domain: Github 文档、邮件、StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 法律案件标题格式
patterns.context: 法院判例引文中当事人名称、诉讼双方标记及标点组成的标题行。

en.description: Main responses are to reflexive pronouns and their inflections, especially myself, itself, themselves, and herself. There are also a few activations on document markers/fields and them, distributed across different corpora and contexts.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun myself
patterns.context: Often follows a first-person subject pronoun, commonly in statements about doing something alone or acting independently; in the email subject line in [2], however, it occurs in the phrase “Protecting Itself,” as described in another pattern.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronouns itself/themselves/herself
patterns.context: Reflexive pronouns function as objects or emphasize independence; activations span several persons, numbers, and forms, often following a preposition or verb.
patterns.domain: Email, legal text, technical explanations, encyclopedic narratives

patterns.name: Document markers and file fields
patterns.context: Immediately adjacent to reStructuredText-style double-colon directives, field names, and document structure markers.

patterns.name: Group pronoun them
patterns.context: Refers to a previously mentioned team or organization, in “representing them for three seasons.”

4_2317.description: 主要响应反身代词及其词形变化，尤其 myself、itself、themselves、herself；另有少量对文档标记/字段和 them 的激活，分布于不同语料与语境。

patterns.name: 反身词 myself
patterns.context: 代词第一人称主语后，常见于陈述独自完成某事或独自行动；在 [2] 的邮件标题中则出现在“Protecting Itself”一词组里，见另一模式。

patterns.name: 反身词 itself/themselves/herself
patterns.context: 反身代词在句中作宾语或强调独立性；激活覆盖多种人称、数和词形，常位于介词或动词后。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文本、技术说明、百科叙述

patterns.name: 文档标记与文件字段
patterns.context: 紧邻 reStructuredText 风格的双点指令、字段名和文档结构标记。
patterns.domain: GitHub 文档/代码仓库文本

patterns.name: 群体代词 them
patterns.context: 指代前文的球队或组织，出现在“representing them for three seasons”中。

en.description: Primarily activates on reflexive pronouns themselves, especially itself; also includes themselves and myself. In context, they often combine with prepositions such as by/of to express being oneself or acting independently.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun itself
patterns.context: The reflexive pronoun functions as the object of a prepositional phrase or adverbial, expressing being alone, independently, or in itself; it is often preceded by by, of, or for.
patterns.domain: Patents, legal, academic, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun myself
patterns.context: The speaker uses the reflexive pronoun to refer to themself, often when describing doing something alone.

4_2317.description: 主要对反身代词本身激活，尤其是 itself；也包括 themselves、myself。上下文中常与 by/of 等介词搭配，表示自身或独立。

patterns.name: 反身代词 itself
patterns.context: 反身代词作介词短语或状语中的宾语，表达单独、独立或自身；前面常见 by、of、for。
patterns.domain: 专利、法律、学术与一般说明文

patterns.name: 反身代词 myself
patterns.context: 说话者以反身代词指向自身，常见于描述独自完成某事。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in reflexive or personal-action expressions, legal editorial language, and proper names in legal text. They also occur on ArXiv metadata template markers and the patent chemistry term am(m)oxidation; there is no single clear trigger spanning all text types.

patterns.name: Expressions emphasizing oneself / one's own actions
patterns.context: In legal or patent sentences, activation falls on reflexive pronouns, emphatic by-phrases, or expressions meaning in one's own name / personally carrying out an action; context often includes behalf, a plaintiff/appellant, or a party.

patterns.name: ours in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in the parenthetical editorial note “(Emphasis ours.)” within a court citation.

patterns.name: WATER NEIGHBORHOOD in a legal proper name
patterns.context: Appears in an uppercase legal proper name or institutional name following a case citation; no clear semantic connective condition is apparent.

patterns.name: ArXiv metadata and document-separator templates
patterns.context: Metadata, reference placeholders, and the beginning of an introduction in paper exports or structured text; triggers occur on template markers and nearby fields.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in am(m)oxidation
patterns.context: Appears in a patent background sentence describing reactions involving “ammonia and oxygen” and a “catalyst”; the activation falls within the word am(m)oxidation.

4_2317.description: 激活主要分布于法律文本的反身或亲自行为表达、判决编辑语及专名，也出现在ArXiv元数据模板标记和专利化学词am(m)oxidation；不存在贯穿各类文本的单一明确触发条件。

patterns.name: 自身／自身行为的强调表达
patterns.trigger: «themselves»、«itself»、«by« their» parent»、«by« itself»、«by« himself»、«by« himself» or« by» his» agent»
patterns.context: 在法律或专利句子中，激活落在反身代词、强调性 by 短语，或表示以自身名义／亲自实施行为的表达上；上下文常有 behalf、原告／上诉人或当事人。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 ours
patterns.context: 出现在括号内的判决引文编辑说明“(Emphasis ours.)”中。

patterns.name: 法律专名中的 WATER NEIGHBORHOOD
patterns.context: 出现在判例引注之后的大写法律专名或机构名称中；没有明显的语义连接词条件。

patterns.name: ArXiv元数据与文档分隔模板
patterns.context: 论文导出或结构化文本的元数据、参考文献占位符及其后的引言开头；触发分布在模板标记与邻近字段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv论文及其机器生成的元数据

patterns.name: am(m)oxidation中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“ammonia and oxygen”“catalyst”等反应描述的专利背景句中，激活切分落在 am(m)oxidation 词内。

en.description: Most passages activate on reflexive pronouns following by, including themselves, itself, myself, and himself, expressing that the subject acts personally, independently, or on its own; another passage activates on W in an uppercase legal header.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun themselves
patterns.context: Appears after the preposition by or the phrase on behalf of, referring to plural subjects doing something personally or independently; also occurs in constructions such as “by themselves or in combination” to indicate independent use.
patterns.domain: Academic, legal, medical, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun itself
patterns.context: by is followed by a reflexive pronoun referring to a singular or impersonal subject, indicating that the subject itself or alone is involved; it may also occur at the beginning of a sentence as a reference to prior text.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun myself
patterns.context: by is followed by the first-person singular reflexive pronoun, indicating that the speaker personally does something.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun himself
patterns.context: by is followed by the third-person singular reflexive pronoun, indicating that a person personally manages or acts.

patterns.name: Autonomous action expressed by themselves
patterns.context: After by, indicates that subjects organize, use, establish, or achieve a goal on their own, emphasizing autonomous completion rather than dependence on others.
patterns.domain: Astronomy hobbyist experience, patent description, business networking discussion

patterns.name: Uppercase word in a statute or case header
patterns.context: Embedded in a court-case citation and the uppercase heading “WATER NEIGHBORHOOD ASS”; unlike the reflexive-pronoun pattern, it may respond to uppercase formatting or header structure.

4_2317.description: 多数段落激活于 by 后的反身代词，涵盖 themselves、itself、myself、himself，表达主体亲自、独立或自行行动；另有一段激活大写法律页眉中的 W。

patterns.name: 反身代词 themselves
patterns.context: 出现在介词 by 或 on behalf of 之后，指复数主体亲自、独立地做某事；也出现在“by themselves or in combination”等表示独立使用的结构中。
patterns.domain: 学术、法律、医学及一般说明文

patterns.name: 反身代词 itself
patterns.context: by 后接单数或非人称主体的反身代词，表示该主体自身或单独发生；也可能在句首作为前文的回指。

patterns.name: 反身代词 myself
patterns.context: by 后接第一人称单数反身代词，表示说话者亲自完成某事。

patterns.name: 反身代词 himself
patterns.context: by 后接第三人称单数反身代词，表示个人亲自管理或行动。

patterns.name: 反身代词 themselves 的独立行动含义
patterns.context: by 后表示主体自行组织、使用、建立或达成目标，强调自主完成，而非依赖他人。
patterns.domain: 天文爱好者经验、专利说明、商业网络讨论

patterns.name: 法条或判例页眉中的大写词
patterns.context: 嵌在法院判例引用及大写标题“WATER NEIGHBORHOOD ASS”中；与反身代词模式不同，可能响应大写排版或页眉格式。

en.description: Most segments highlight reflexive pronouns after by (themselves, himself, myself), expressing that a subject acts alone or personally, or completes an action independently. Other activations occur on wills in religious text, academic footnote markers, and Vice in a signature, and are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Reflexive/emphatic pronoun yourself in a by-phrase
patterns.context: A reflexive pronoun immediately follows by, indicating acting alone, personally, or by the subject's own effort; it can also emphasize independent action.
patterns.domain: Legal, research training, medicine, personal narratives, historical narratives, and political commentary; varied prose styles

patterns.name: wills in religious contexts
patterns.context: The subject is he, and the text discusses the Holy Spirit acting according to its will; the segment also contains “by means of,” but no reflexive pronoun form.

patterns.name: Academic footnotes and layout markers
patterns.context: Footnote numbers, punctuation, and word-initial fragments near a conclusion are activated; no clearly coherent semantic trigger phrase is apparent.
patterns.domain: LaTeX/footnote formatting in ArXiv academic papers

patterns.name: Vice in a job title
patterns.context: The latter part of Vice in “Vice President” receives high activation; the surrounding text is an email signature, with no preceding reflexive-pronoun pattern.

4_2317.concept: 反身代词与主体自主行动
4_2317.description: 多数段落突出 by 后的反身代词（themselves、himself、myself），表达主体独自或亲自行动、独立完成。另有宗教文本中的 wills、论文脚注标记及署名中的 Vice，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: 反身/强调性代词 yourself 的 by 短语
patterns.context: 反身代词紧接在 by 后，表示独自、亲自或由主体自己完成；亦可强调独立行动。
patterns.domain: 法律、研究训练、医学、个人叙述、历史叙述及政论；段落文体各异

patterns.name: 宗教语境中的 wills
patterns.trigger: «wills»，重复出现在“where he wills, when he wills, on whom he wills”
patterns.context: 主语为 he，谈及圣灵按其意愿行动；该段也出现“by means of”，但没有反身代词形式。

patterns.name: 学术论文脚注与版面标记
patterns.context: 结论附近的脚注编号、标点与词首片段被激活；未见明显语义连贯的触发短语。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文的 LaTeX/脚注格式

patterns.name: 职务名称中的 Vice
patterns.context: “Vice President”中 Vice 的后半部分分词获得高激活；周围为邮件署名，未见前述反身代词模式。

en.concept: Reflexive pronouns and local word-form fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to the reflexive pronouns himself, themselves, and myself, especially in expressions describing acting personally or alone, often in constructions after by; it also shows one strong response to the internal fragment IM in the directory heading ANIMALS.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun himself
patterns.context: Indicates that someone personally performs an action or is alone in a state; often occurs after by, and may also appear in constructions such as farm by himself.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, encyclopedia narratives, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun themselves
patterns.context: A reflexive pronoun used as an object or object of a preposition, referring to a plural subject or organization; examples include “on behalf of themselves” and “by themselves”.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, patents, and medical explanations

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun myself
patterns.context: First-person reflexive pronoun indicating that the speaker carried out repairs or solved a problem; often follows by.

patterns.name: ANIMALS in a document directory
patterns.context: In an NIH document directory-style heading, ANIMALS is split into subword fragments, with activation concentrated on the internal fragment IM; semantically and syntactically, this differs from the reflexive-pronoun patterns in other passages.

4_2317.concept: 反身代词及局部词形片段
4_2317.description: 主要响应反身代词 himself、themselves、myself，尤其是表示亲自或独自行为、常见于 by 后的结构；另对目录标题 ANIMALS 的内部片段 IM 有一次强响应。

patterns.name: 反身代词 himself
patterns.context: 表示某人亲自实施行为，或独自处于某状态；多出现在 by 后，也可出现在 farm by himself 等结构中。
patterns.domain: 法律、百科叙述及一般说明文

patterns.name: 反身代词 themselves
patterns.context: 反身代词作宾语或介词宾语，指代复数主体或组织；可见于“on behalf of themselves”“by themselves”等结构。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、专利、医学说明

patterns.name: 反身代词 myself
patterns.context: 第一人称反身代词，表示自己完成维修或解决问题；常跟在 by 后。
patterns.domain: 个人经历叙述、论坛问答

patterns.name: 文档目录中的 ANIMALS
patterns.context: 在 NIH 文档目录式标题中，单词 ANIMALS 被分词切开，激活集中在内部片段 IM；语义及句法上与其他段落的反身代词模式不同。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要目录/标题

en.description: Activations mainly target reflexive pronouns myself, himself, and themselves, often emphasizing that a subject acts personally or alone. Isolated activations also occur on “ANIMALS” in an NIH title, a period after a formula, and the colloquial self-reference “its me jax.”

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun myself
patterns.context: Indicates that the speaker personally completes or participates in an action, or acts alone; often appears in “by myself,” including “both by myself.”
patterns.domain: Legal Q&A, forum posts, personal narratives

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun himself
patterns.context: Indicates that a male subject acts personally or is alone in a place; includes “either by himself” and “by himself.”
patterns.domain: Legal text, novel reviews, historical narratives

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun themselves
patterns.context: Indicates that a plural subject acts in its own interests; appears in “on behalf of themselves.”

patterns.name: Animal topic word
patterns.context: Appears in a section heading on animal protection following a section on human-subject protection.

patterns.name: Period after a formula
patterns.context: A sentence ends with a period after displaying a mathematical formula and continues by comparing the two sides.
patterns.domain: LaTeX mathematical text in academic papers

patterns.name: Self-reference phrase
patterns.context: Colloquial self-introduction or identity reference; does not contain the standard reflexive suffix “-self.”

4_2317.description: 主要对反身代词 myself、himself、themselves 激活，常用于强调主体亲自行动或独自行动；另有 NIH 标题中的“ANIMALS”、公式句点及口语自我指称“its me jax”等孤立激活。

patterns.name: 反身代词 myself
patterns.context: 句中表示说话者亲自完成某事、亲自参与或独自行动；多见于“by myself”，也有“both by myself”。
patterns.domain: 法律问答、论坛帖子、个人叙述

patterns.name: 反身代词 himself
patterns.context: 指男性主体亲自行动或独自处于某处；包括“either by himself”和“by himself”。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、小说评论、历史叙述

patterns.name: 反身代词 themselves
patterns.context: 指复数主体为自身利益采取行动；出现在“on behalf of themselves”。

patterns.name: 动物主题词
patterns.context: 出现在人类受试者保护之后的动物保护章节标题中。

patterns.name: 公式后的句点
patterns.context: 展示数学公式后，以句点结束句子并继续比较两边。
patterns.domain: 学术论文的 LaTeX 数学文本

patterns.name: 自我指称短语
patterns.context: 口语化自我介绍或身份指称；不含常规反身代词后缀“-self”。

en.concept: Reflexive pronouns and expressions of independent action
en.description: Primarily activates on the reflexive pronoun myself, often in by myself or when describing doing something alone; it also covers reflexive forms such as himself and themselves across persons and registers. There is also one variable x in a mathematical formula.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun myself
patterns.context: Usually indicates that the speaker does something alone, often in by myself; also appears in expressions such as “solve the problem by myself” and “write code myself”. Activation falls on the reflexive pronoun itself.
patterns.domain: Forums, personal narratives, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Reflexive forms in legal register
patterns.context: In formal legal sentences, reflexive pronouns refer to the defendant or a party mentioned earlier; examples include “by himself” and “on behalf of themselves”.

patterns.name: by himself indicating solitary action
patterns.context: Describes someone being somewhere or acting alone; the reflexive form refers to a person mentioned earlier. It shares the reflexive-pronoun construction with by myself, but differs in person and narrative perspective.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun indicating independent action in a generic sense
patterns.context: Refers generically to each person managing their own farm, with the reflexive pronoun referring to man; embedded in political discussion of allocation and management.

patterns.name: x in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: Appears in the LaTeX mathematical expressions A(x)R(x) and A(x), and is not part of the reflexive-pronoun pattern.

4_2317.concept: 反身代词及自主行动表达
4_2317.description: 主要激活反身代词 myself，常在 by myself 或表示独自完成事情时出现；也涵盖 himself、themselves 等不同人称和文体中的反身形式。另有一次数学公式中的变量 x。

patterns.name: 反身代词 myself
patterns.trigger: « myself»（[1]« myself»10、[2]« myself»10、[4]« myself»9、[9]« myself»8、[10]« myself»8）
patterns.context: 通常表示说话者独自完成某事，常见于 by myself；也出现在“解决问题 by myself”“自己写代码”等表达中。激活落在反身代词本身。
patterns.domain: 论坛、个人叙述、技术问答

patterns.name: 法律语体中的反身形式
patterns.context: 在正式法律句子中，反身代词指涉前文的 defendant 或案件当事人；分别见于“by himself”和“on behalf of themselves”。

patterns.name: by himself 表独自行动
patterns.context: 描述某人独自处于某地或行动；反身形式的前置介词 by 未标记。与 by myself 同属反身代词结构，但人称和叙述视角不同。

patterns.name: 反身代词泛指自主执行
patterns.context: 泛指每个人管理自己的农场，反身代词指涉泛指的 man；嵌在政治论述中的分配、管理表述。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 x
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学公式的函数表达式 A(x)R(x) 与 A(x) 中，并非反身代词模式。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on reflexive pronouns (myself, himself, themselves), especially expressions such as by myself/by himself that emphasize an actor acting personally or alone, or refer back to the actor; also occurs in legal documents concerning parties and in copyright contexts.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronouns emphasizing independent action
patterns.context: The reflexive pronoun refers back to the speaker and often combines with by to emphasize personally or independently doing something; passage 1 also includes “solved the issue by myself”.
patterns.domain: Forum questions and answers, personal accounts, forest management discussions, and private emails

patterns.name: Reflexive pronouns in legal register
patterns.context: In formal legal or copyright discussions, the reflexive pronoun refers back to the male subject in the sentence and combines with by or read by, respectively.

patterns.name: Emphasis on a party in legal filings
patterns.context: Appears in a case caption, indicating that the plaintiff brings a claim on behalf of himself and a group; does not require a by phrase.

patterns.name: by himself indicating independent action
patterns.context: by himself indicates that someone acts alone, with the pronoun referring to a person mentioned earlier; passage 8 is instead an ownership context in political discussion, “managed by himself”.

patterns.name: by himself indicating independent action (email context)
patterns.context: The sentence-final phrase all by himself emphasizes that someone does something alone, on his own schedule.

4_2317.description: 激活集中在反身代词（myself、himself、themselves）上，尤其是 by myself/by himself 等表达，强调主体亲自、独自行动或指回主体；也见于法律文书中的当事人及版权语境。

patterns.name: 反身代词强调独自完成
patterns.context: 反身代词指回说话者，常与 by 连用，强调亲自、独自做某事；段1还出现在“solved the issue by myself”中。
patterns.domain: 论坛求助与回答、个人经历、森林管理讨论、私人邮件

patterns.name: 法律语体中的反身代词
patterns.context: 正式法律或版权论述中，反身代词指回句中男性主体，分别与 by 或 read by 连用。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼文书中的当事人强调
patterns.context: 出现在诉讼标题中，表示原告代表自己及一个群体提出诉求；不要求 by 短语。

patterns.name: 独自行动的 by himself
patterns.context: by himself 表示某人独自行动，代词指向前文人物；段8则是政治论述中“由他自己管理”的所有权语境。

patterns.name: 独自行动的 by himself（邮件语境）
patterns.context: 句末短语 all by himself 强调某人独自按自己的时间安排做事。

en.description: Activations center on reflexive pronouns: himself is most prominent, with additional instances of yourself, themselves, and itself. These refer to people or things already mentioned in the sentence and often occur after prepositions such as by/for, expressing oneself, personally, or alone.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun himself
patterns.context: The reflexive pronoun occurs in a prepositional phrase or in the agent position, commonly in forms such as “by himself,” “for himself,” “do … by himself”; it also appears in “read by himself.”
patterns.domain: Novels, Q&A, legal text, expository writing, and argumentative prose

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun yourself
patterns.context: Second-person reflexive pronoun referring to the reader or questioner in context, indicating personally or independently completing something.
patterns.domain: Miscellaneous web text and StackExchange Q&A

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun themselves
patterns.context: Plural reflexive pronoun referring back to a previously mentioned group, appearing in the construction “on behalf of themselves.”

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun itself
patterns.context: Neuter singular reflexive pronoun referring back to a previously mentioned thing or concept.

4_2317.description: 激活集中于反身代词：himself 最突出，另有 yourself、themselves、itself；它们指向句中既有的人或事物，并常出现在 by/for 等介词之后，表达自身、亲自或独自。

patterns.name: 反身代词 himself
patterns.context: 反身代词出现在介词短语或动作执行者位置，常见形式如“by himself”“for himself”“do … by himself”；也出现于“read by himself”。
patterns.domain: 小说、问答、法律文本、说明文及论述文

patterns.name: 反身代词 yourself
patterns.context: 第二人称反身代词，指代上下文中的读者或提问者，表示亲自或独自完成某事。
patterns.domain: 杂乱网页文本及 StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 反身代词 themselves
patterns.context: 复数反身代词，回指前文的人群，出现在“on behalf of themselves”结构中。

patterns.name: 反身代词 itself
patterns.context: 中性单数反身代词，回指前文的事物或概念。

en.description: Primarily responds to the reflexive pronoun himself (often combined with by, but also appearing with for and read by), as well as myself; both refer back to the actor in the sentence. Passage 10 activates on the purposive construction “just so I can”, which does not clearly match the reflexive-pronoun pattern.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun himself
patterns.context: The reflexive pronoun occurs in a prepositional or verb phrase and refers back to the male subject in the sentence; examples include “by himself”, “for himself”, and “read by himself”.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, emails, encyclopedias, historical texts, and technical texts

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun myself
patterns.context: A reflexive pronoun following a first-person subject, indicating that the speaker does something themselves; this example is “by myself”.

patterns.name: so in a purpose/result phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the “just so I can …” construction to express purpose; no reflexive-pronoun trigger is evident.

4_2317.description: 主要响应反身代词 himself（多与 by 连用，也见 for、read by），另有 myself；两者均回指句中行动者。第10段则激活于目的结构“just so I can”，与反身代词模式不明显相同。

patterns.name: 反身代词 himself
patterns.context: 反身代词出现在介词或动词短语中，指回句中男性主语；包括“by himself”“for himself”“read by himself”等。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、邮件、百科、历史与技术文本

patterns.name: 反身代词 myself
patterns.context: 第一人称主语后的反身代词，表示自己完成某事；此例为“by myself”。

patterns.name: 目的/结果短语中的 so
patterns.context: 出现在“just so I can …”结构中，表达目的；未见反身代词触发。

en.description: Primarily responds to contexts involving reflexive or possessive forms meaning “oneself” or “one's own”, especially himself; also includes sporadic highlighted tokens and VICE in a list, which are difficult to group under the same trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun himself
patterns.context: The reflexive pronoun functions as an object of a preposition or as an adverbial, commonly in constructions such as “for himself”, “by himself”, “by himself / on his own”, and contrasts such as “not of himself but …”; a corresponding subject or possessive is present earlier.
patterns.domain: Narrative, legal documents, emails, and general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Possessive own
patterns.context: Appears in “on his own …” and “his own counsel”, indicating ownership or independence; activates in contexts related to oneself or one's own.

patterns.name: Other highlighted tokens in sentences
patterns.context: These highlighted words are scattered across different positions, with no clear shared local syntactic or semantic trigger; some may relate to formatting, legal texts, or heading layout.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal texts, emails, and formatted texts

patterns.name: VICE in a school name and title
patterns.context: Appears in all-caps, space-padded school directory or personnel-title formatting.

4_2317.description: 主要对反身/所有格形式表示“本人、自己或所属”的语境起反应，尤其是 himself；另有分散高亮词及名录中 VICE，难以归入同一触发模式。

patterns.name: 反身代词 himself
patterns.context: 反身代词作介词宾语或状语，常见结构为“for himself”“by himself”“by himself / on his own”，也出现在“not of himself but …”等对照中；前文已有相应主语或所有格。
patterns.domain: 叙事、法律文书、邮件及一般说明文

patterns.name: 所有格 own
patterns.context: 出现在“on his own …”“his own counsel”中，表示所属或自主性；与本人/所属相关的语境中激活。

patterns.name: 句中其他高亮 token
patterns.context: 这些高亮词分散于不同位置，没有明显统一的局部句法或语义触发条件；部分可能与格式、法律文本或标题排版有关。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律文本、邮件及排版文本

patterns.name: 校名头衔中的 VICE
patterns.context: 出现在全大写、空格填充的学校名录/人员头衔排版中。
patterns.domain: 书籍或名录式排版文本

en.description: Primarily responds to reflexive or possessive self-reference (himself, themselves, their/my own), particularly contrasts between oneself and others or the public in legal texts; also responds to personal reference in the forum phrase “for me”.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun himself
patterns.context: The reflexive pronoun occurs at the end of a sentence or in a prepositional phrase, indicating that someone acts personally or alone, or contrasting them with another person or an agent; it may also occur in contrasts such as “for himself rather than for the public interest”.
patterns.domain: Biographical narratives, historical narratives, and legal documents

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun themselves
patterns.context: In legal filings, refers to plaintiffs making a claim for themselves and a group; also appears in the structure “on behalf of themselves and all ...”.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun their own
patterns.context: In medical text, refers to the patients' own tumor; the trigger spans the phrase “their own tumor”.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun my own
patterns.context: In a political speech, refers to the speaker's own government, often in a context contrasting with the speaker's critical stance.

patterns.name: Reference to the user themself
patterns.context: In first-person explanations or questions, indicates that something applies to, is visible to, or needs to be handled by the speaker; no own or -self form appears.

4_2317.description: 主要响应反身或所有格自我指涉（himself、themselves、their/my own），尤见法律文本中的自身与他人/公众对照；也响应论坛中“for me”个人指涉。

patterns.name: 反身代词 himself
patterns.context: 反身代词处于句末或介词短语中，表示某人亲自、独自行动，或与他人/代理人形成对照；也可出现在“为其自身而非公众利益”的对照结构中。
patterns.domain: 传记叙述、历史叙述及法律文书

patterns.name: 反身代词 themselves
patterns.context: 法律诉讼文书中，指原告为其自身及某一群体提出主张；也出现在“on behalf of themselves and all ...”结构中。

patterns.name: 反身代词 their own
patterns.context: 医学文本中指患者自身的肿瘤；触发跨越“their own tumor”短语。

patterns.name: 反身代词 my own
patterns.context: 政治演说中，指说话者自己的政府，常带有与其批评立场相对照的语境。

patterns.name: 对用户自身的指涉
patterns.context: 第一人称个人说明或提问中，说明某事对发言者本人适用、可见或需要由其处理；没有出现 own 或 -self 形式。

en.description: Most activations fall on reflexive pronouns or the possessive own, indicating the subject itself, personal action, or ownership. Another stable pattern is the representative relationship expressed by “on behalf of” in legal and parliamentary texts. Some individual activations are unexplained by these patterns.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronouns and possessive own
patterns.context: Occurs in phrases expressing an action or right attributed to its holder, especially after verbs or prepositions, or before “own”; often refers to the subject itself, an action performed personally, or something owned by the subject.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, encyclopedic narratives, commentary, and public proceedings

patterns.name: behalf in representation or agency relationships
patterns.context: The fixed phrase “on behalf of” means representing a person or organization; it is followed by the beneficiary or represented party.

patterns.name: Segment activations not explained by the shared pattern
patterns.context: In [5], activation falls on the generic reader-reference “someone,” with no clear reflexive or agency structure. Although [9][10] contain “own,” their syntax and context differ from direct reflexive-pronoun usage, so the word alone does not establish a shared trigger pattern.
patterns.domain: Online comments, legal opinions, aviation encyclopedia

4_2317.description: 多数激活落在反身代词或“own”所有格，表示主体自身、本人行为或自身所有；另一稳定模式是法律及议会文本中的“on behalf of”代表关系。个别激活无法由此解释。

patterns.name: 反身代词及所有格 own
patterns.context: 出现在表示动作或权利归属的短语中，尤其是动词、介词之后，或“own”前；常指行为主体自身、本人实施，或自身拥有。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科叙述、评论及公共议事文本

patterns.name: 代表或代理关系中的 behalf
patterns.trigger: “on behalf of themselves”[1]；“on behalf of the PPE Group”[3]；“on behalf of itself”[7]
patterns.context: 固定搭配“on behalf of”，表示代表某人或某组织；后接受益或被代表的一方。

patterns.name: 无法由共同模式解释的段内激活
patterns.context: [5]中激活落在泛指读者的“someone”，没有明显反身或代理结构；[9][10]虽含“own”，但其句法和上下文与直接反身代词用法不同，不能仅凭这些词确定是同一触发模式。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、法律意见、航空百科

en.description: Primarily responds to reflexive pronouns and own emphasizing the subject themself, especially themselves, himself, and oneself; it also responds to the representative construction on behalf of and the generic referent in for someone. Trigger forms are scattered across legal, technical, encyclopedia, political, and online texts.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronouns oneself / himself
patterns.context: Reflexive pronouns occur after prepositions or verbs, often in constructions involving benefit of, represent, or for; not all reflexive-pronoun occurrences are equally strong, and specific activation points vary.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, encyclopedias, webpages, and general narrative

patterns.name: own / ownership of oneself
patterns.context: own follows a possessive determiner, emphasizing the subject's own propulsion or gravity.

patterns.name: on behalf of representation construction
patterns.context: The fixed phrase on behalf of indicates representation of a party; activation is concentrated on behalf and the following of.
patterns.domain: Legal litigation and European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Other reflexive uses of self / myself
patterns.context: The reflexive pronoun is a participant in constructions such as by myself or including himself, and is not necessarily at the strongest activation position.
patterns.domain: Forest management discussions and motorsports reporting

patterns.name: Specific for someone construction
patterns.context: someone follows specifically for and refers to a generic target audience; it has no clear connection to reflexive pronouns or own constructions.
patterns.domain: Hacker News Q&A titles and colloquial questions

4_2317.description: 主要响应反身代词及强调主体自身的 own，尤其是 themselves、himself、oneself；也响应 on behalf of 代表结构和 for someone 中的泛指对象。触发形式分散于法律、科技、百科、政治及网络文本。

patterns.name: 反身代词 oneself / himself
patterns.context: 反身代词出现在介词或动词后，常与 benefit of、represent、for 等结构相连；并非所有出现的反身代词都同等强，具体激活点各异。
patterns.domain: 法律、百科、网页与一般叙述

patterns.name: own / 自身所有
patterns.context: own 紧随物主限定词，用于强调主体自身的动力或引力。

patterns.name: on behalf of 代表结构
patterns.context: 固定短语 on behalf of，表示代表某一方；激活集中在 behalf 及其后的 of。
patterns.domain: 法律诉讼、欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: self / myself 的其他反身用法
patterns.context: 反身代词作为 by myself 或 including himself 一类结构中的参与者，不一定处于最强激活位置。
patterns.domain: 森林管理讨论、赛车报道

patterns.name: 特定的 for someone 结构
patterns.context: someone 位于 specifically for 之后，指泛指的目标受众；与反身代词或 own 结构无明显联系。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 问答标题与口语化提问

en.description: Most high activation occurs on reflexive/self expressions: oneself, himself, themselves, or possessive own; there are also isolated activations on it in an academic sentence and on numbers and punctuation in a Wikipedia table.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronouns oneself / himself
patterns.context: Occurs in phrases indicating that someone acts alone, in their own name, represents themselves, or runs something for themselves; also appears in impersonal possessive/reflexive constructions such as “own gravity”.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, historical narratives, biographies, and astrophysics; passages 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6

patterns.name: own followed by a noun
patterns.context: own is a possessive adjective followed by a noun, indicating one's own security or capability; activation is concentrated around own.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings and government procurement legal texts

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in a table
patterns.context: In cells and row/column markers in a Wikipedia career statistics table, activation falls on numbers, periods, and table symbols, with no clear semantic connection.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia table markup and structured data

patterns.name: Use of it in a sentence
patterns.context: In academic discussion, it refers to an earlier argument or implementation and appears in the phrase “going beyond it”; this differs from the reflexive-pronoun pattern.

4_2317.description: 多数高激活出现在反身/自身表达：oneself、himself、themselves，或所有格 own；但也有学术句中 it 和维基百科表格数字、标点的孤立激活。

patterns.name: 反身代词 oneself / himself
patterns.context: 在表示某人以自身名义、独自行动、代表自己或为自己经营的短语中；也出现在“自身引力”等非人称所有/反身结构。
patterns.domain: 法律、历史叙述、人物传记、天体物理；段1、2、3、4、5、6

patterns.name: own 后接名词
patterns.context: own 作为所有格形容词，后接名词，表示自身的安全或能力；激活集中在 own 附近。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、政府采购法律文本

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 维基百科生涯统计表格的单元格/行列标记中，激活落在数字、句点及表格符号，缺少明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 维基百科表格标记、结构化数据

patterns.name: it 的句中用法
patterns.context: 学术论述中，it 指代前文的论点或实现，并出现在“going beyond it”短语中；与反身代词模式不同。

en.description: Activation is distributed across various word forms and contexts: prominent self-reference involving own/self, representation involving behalf, the quantity qualifier at least, academic transition expressions, colloquial phrases, and copyright formatting; there is no single stable semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: Litigants/representation in legal documents
patterns.context: Lists plaintiffs and their representative capacity, especially lawsuits brought on behalf of minor children or groups; on behalf of is also used in a parliamentary speech attribution.

patterns.name: Emphatic use of possessive own
patterns.context: own is preceded by a possessive such as his/their and indicates a person's own use, domain, or tumor; it is not limited to a particular field.

patterns.name: Academic discussion of going beyond prior work
patterns.context: it refers to the previously mentioned work or method; the sentence discusses advancing the implementation based on it. Appears after a citation.

patterns.name: Independent pronoun himself
patterns.context: Discusses whether a defendant can represent himself in court; the pronoun highlights the legal issue of self-representation.

patterns.name: sorts / now in prepositional phrases
patterns.context: In a colloquial technical comment, appears respectively in “of sorts” and “for now”; the context discusses programming languages and tools.

patterns.name: Quantity phrase at least
patterns.context: Combines with partial to qualify the degree of drug resistance.

patterns.name: Copyright notice formatting
patterns.context: Footnote markers after the main text of a paper, followed by a copyright year and institutional statement.

4_2317.description: 激活分布于多种词形和语境：突出 own/self 等自身指涉，也见 behalf 代表关系、at least 数量限定、学术推进表达、口语短语及版权格式；没有单一稳定的语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的诉讼当事人/代表关系
patterns.trigger: « Plaintiff», « By»« their»« parent»« and»« next»« friend», « on»« behalf»« of»« themselves»
patterns.context: 列举原告及其代表身份，尤其是以未成年子女或群体名义提起诉讼；另有“on behalf of”用于议会发言署名。

patterns.name: 所有格 own 的强调用法
patterns.context: own 前接 his/their 等所有格，表示本人/自身的用途、领域或肿瘤；并非固定领域。

patterns.name: 学术论述中的超越既有工作
patterns.context: it 指代前述工作或方法，句中讨论在其基础上推进实现；引用文献后出现。

patterns.name: 独立代词 himself
patterns.context: 讨论被告能否代表自己出庭，代词突出自我代理这一法律问题。

patterns.name: 介词短语中的 sorts / now
patterns.context: 口语化技术评论中，分别出现在“of sorts”和“for now”；上下文谈编程语言与工具。

patterns.name: 数量短语 at least
patterns.context: 与 partial 连用，限定药物耐药程度。

patterns.name: 版权声明格式
patterns.context: 论文正文后的脚注标记及版权年份、机构声明。

en.description: Strong activations often fall on the reflexive pronouns myself/himself or the formal expression on behalf of. There is also a localized activation on beyond it in an academic context. The title, numbers, and layout highlights in segment 9 lack a clear shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: Reflexive pronoun myself
patterns.context: The speaker refers to themself, often using “by” or “myself” to indicate acting alone, or in formal prose to indicate acting personally; it can also occur in sentences such as “I can write it by myself.”
patterns.domain: Various styles, including legal, historical, parliamentary, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Acting on behalf of others
patterns.context: “On behalf of” is followed by the person, group, or organization being represented; the legal expression “on behalf of themselves” also occurs.
patterns.domain: Legal, parliamentary, business email, software copyright notices

patterns.name: Going beyond prior work
patterns.context: Describes advancing beyond prior research or methods in an academic paper; activation centers near “it.”

patterns.name: oneself in a place name
patterns.context: Describes a person spending the winter alone in a place; activation falls on “himself,” similar in form to myself in other segments.

patterns.name: Sporadic highlights in titles or text
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across paper titles, mathematical text formatting, and numeric fragments, with no stable association to the main pattern.

4_2317.description: 强激活多落在反身代词 myself/himself，或正式表述 on behalf of；另有学术语境中 beyond it 的局部激活。第9段的标题、数字与排版高亮缺少清晰共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 反身代词 myself
patterns.context: 说话者指向自身，常与 “by” 或 “myself” 表示独自行动，或在正式文体中表示本人；也可出现在 “I can write it by myself” 一类句子中。
patterns.domain: 法律、历史、议会、技术问答等多种文体

patterns.name: 代表他人行事
patterns.context: “on behalf of” 后接代表的个人、群体或组织；也出现 “on behalf of themselves” 的法律表述。
patterns.domain: 法律、议会、商务邮件、软件版权声明

patterns.name: 超越先前工作
patterns.context: 学术论文中描述在先前研究或方法基础上进一步推进；激活集中在 “it” 附近。

patterns.name: 地点名中的 oneself
patterns.context: 描述人物在某地独自过冬；激活在 “himself”，与其他段中的 myself 形态相近。

patterns.name: 标题或文本中的零散高亮
patterns.trigger: “Nonlinear Liquid Drop Model”及标题、数字和排版 token
patterns.context: 激活分散在论文题名、数学文本排版和数值片段中，未见与主要模式稳定关联的上下文。

en.description: Activation is scattered across pronouns, function words, legal terms, technical terms, medical terms, academic transition words, and forum formatting; there is no stable shared trigger or clear semantic pattern, and multiple highly activated words such as «it», «oneself», «someone», and «of» occur in different contexts.

patterns.name: it / pronouns and their continuation
patterns.context: Across several passages, activation falls on pronouns or function words; sometimes it is the pronoun itself, sometimes a preposition, and the contexts vary.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, technical discussions, scientific writing, book reviews, biographies, etc.

patterns.name: Party designations and procedural terms in legal texts
patterns.context: Legal contexts include litigants, a defendant's self-representation, or terms related to trial procedure.

patterns.name: Cross-platform/software discussions in technical texts
patterns.context: Discusses software tools, programming languages, or cross-platform work; activation is distributed across technical terms and neighboring words.

patterns.name: Drug-resistance expressions
patterns.context: Discusses resistance to chemotherapy drugs and the possibility of resistance in patients who have not been exposed to the drugs; strong activation falls on “ones”.

patterns.name: Argument transitions in scientific papers
patterns.context: Cites prior work and explains how an argument builds on or extends its implementation; strong activation falls on “it”.

patterns.name: References to readers in book reviews
patterns.context: Reviews practical advice and information in a book, and refers to readers who might need that information.

patterns.name: Business activity in a biographical narrative
patterns.context: Describes a person's profession and later running a business independently; strong activation falls on “himself”.

patterns.name: Formatting and version strings
patterns.context: Forum posts contain formatting fragments such as line breaks and separators, as well as software version numbers.

4_2317.description: 激活分散在代词、功能词、法律术语、技术词、医学词、学术衔接词及论坛格式等处；没有稳定共享的触发词或明确语义模式，且多个高激活词如 «it»、«oneself»、«someone»、«of» 语境各异。

patterns.name: it／代词及其延续
patterns.context: 多个段落中，激活落在代词或功能词上；有时是代词本身，有时是介词，且上下文各异。
patterns.domain: 法律、技术讨论、科学写作、书评、传记等

patterns.name: 法律文本中的当事人称谓与程序用语
patterns.context: 法律语境中出现诉讼当事人、被告自我代理或审判程序相关词语。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的跨平台／软件讨论
patterns.context: 围绕软件工具、编程语言或跨平台工作展开；激活分布在术语及邻近词上。

patterns.name: 药物耐药相关表达
patterns.context: 谈论化疗药物耐药及患者未接触药物也可能出现耐药；强激活落在“ones”。

patterns.name: 科学论文中的论述衔接
patterns.context: 引用先前工作并说明论点如何沿用或超越其实现；强激活落在“it”。

patterns.name: 书评中的读者指称
patterns.context: 评价书籍的实用建议与信息，并指称可能需要相关信息的读者。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的商业经营
patterns.context: 描述人物从事职业并后来自行经营业务；强激活落在“himself”。

patterns.name: 格式与版本字符串
patterns.context: 论坛帖子中出现换行、分隔线及软件版本号等格式片段。

en.description: Activation spans legal, parliamentary, research, software, email, and trade texts, with no stable single theme. Visible local phrasing patterns include speaking or signing on behalf of a party, formal institutions and professional expressions, and several domain-specific terms.

patterns.name: Legal parties and litigation language
patterns.context: Legal documents mention parties, agency relationships, or appeals/disputes; segment 1 also concerns “all Negro school age children”

patterns.name: Parliamentary sign-off representing a group
patterns.context: A legislator's signature at the end of a parliamentary speech indicates that they are speaking on behalf of a political group

patterns.name: Copyright/acknowledgment sign-off representing an organization or user group
patterns.context: Organizational representation in software project copyright or contributor statements

patterns.name: Names and link formatting in webpage titles
patterns.context: Tokenized personal names, project names, and URLs within Markdown link titles

patterns.name: EU security-of-supply phrasing in formal prose
patterns.context: Discusses EU security of supply and related measures

patterns.name: Conference quality and domain-expert phrasing in academia
patterns.context: Describes the scientific quality of a conference, invited experts, and their professional standing

patterns.name: Formal policy positions and action phrasing
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech expresses support and cites an established policy course

patterns.name: Natural gas market headline and introductory quotation phrase
patterns.context: An email uses a headline to introduce the U.S. natural gas market and lead into related information

patterns.name: Legal discussion of capacity for self-representation
patterns.context: Discusses whether a defendant is competent to represent themself and related court findings

patterns.name: Raw material supply, costs, and WTO rules
patterns.context: Discusses processors' supply needs, raw material sources, and international trade rules

4_2317.description: 激活片段跨越法律、议会、科研、软件、邮件及贸易文本，未显示稳定的单一主题；可见局部措辞模式包括代表某方发言/署名、正式机构与专业表达，以及若干特定领域术语。

patterns.name: 法律案件当事人和诉讼措辞
patterns.trigger: “on behalf of themselves”及“Defendant appeals”“scope of the arbitration clause”
patterns.context: 法律文书中出现当事人、代理关系或上诉/争议事项；第 1 段还涉及“all Negro school age children”

patterns.name: 代表团体发言署名
patterns.trigger: “on behalf of the [组名] Group”，如“on behalf of the PPE Group”“on behalf of the ALDE Group”
patterns.context: 议会发言末尾的议员署名，表明其代表某政治团体发言

patterns.name: 代表组织或用户群体的版权/致谢署名
patterns.context: 软件项目版权或贡献者说明中的组织代表关系

patterns.name: 网页标题中的人名及链接格式
patterns.trigger: “[Jeremy Daly & Paul Swail Serverless Chats #41]”及重复的“[Jeremy Daly Off By None]”
patterns.context: Markdown 链接标题内的人名分词、项目名和网址

patterns.name: 正式文体中的欧盟安全供应措辞
patterns.trigger: “security of supply”及“to strengthen the European Union's security of supply”
patterns.context: 讨论欧盟供应安全及相关措施

patterns.name: 学术会议质量与领域专家措辞
patterns.trigger: “highest level”“standard of excellence”“forefront of their fields”
patterns.context: 介绍会议科学内容质量、受邀专家及其专业地位

patterns.name: 正式政策表态与行动措辞
patterns.trigger: “fully support action by the European Union”及“in line with the approach”
patterns.context: 议会发言中表达支持并引用既定政策路线

patterns.name: 天然气市场标题及引述引入语
patterns.trigger: “Olympian Status for U.S. Gas Market”及“Just so you'll know”
patterns.context: 邮件以标题介绍美国天然气市场，并引出相关信息

patterns.name: 自我辩护能力的法律讨论
patterns.trigger: “competent to represent himself”及“representing oneself at trial”
patterns.context: 讨论被告能否胜任自我代理及相关法院判断

patterns.name: 原材料供应、成本与 WTO 规则
patterns.trigger: “regularity of supply”“lowest cost”“source of raw materials”及“essential for the WTO”
patterns.context: 讨论加工者的供应需求、原料来源与国际贸易规则

en.description: Activations fall mainly on still (in multiple contexts) and the proper-name fragment Bian; there are also tokenized fragments of conduits and purchases. Word meaning and style vary considerably across passages.

patterns.name: Fragment or word still
patterns.context: “still” as a standalone word in different syntactic structures; used both as an adverb meaning “continuing” and in truncated or continued sentences.
patterns.domain: Emails, Q&A, medical abstracts, sports, patents, and news text

patterns.name: Fragment Bian
patterns.context: A substring within a personal name or surname; contexts differ.

patterns.name: In-word fragment of conduits
patterns.context: In a metal exposure study, the complete word “conduits” is split into subword tokens.

patterns.name: Word fragments near numbers and units
patterns.context: “purchases” is split into multiple tokens, adjacent to electricity trade quantities and market codes.

4_2407.description: 激活主要落在 still（多种语境）和专名片段 Bian；另有 conduits、purchases 的分词片段。跨段词义与文体差异明显。

patterns.name: still 的片段或单词
patterns.context: “still”作为独立词，出现在不同句法结构中；既有“仍然/仍旧”的副词用法，也有被截断或续接的句子。
patterns.domain: 邮件、问答、医学摘要、体育、专利及新闻文字

patterns.name: Bian 的片段
patterns.context: 人名或姓氏内部的子串；上下文并不相同。
patterns.domain: 百科、网球新闻、天文学地址

patterns.name: conduits 的词内片段
patterns.context: 金属暴露研究中，完整词“conduits”被分词标记拆开。

patterns.name: 数字与单位附近的词片段
patterns.context: “purchases”被拆成多个 token，紧邻电力交易数量和市场代码。

en.concept: still and Bian character fragments, with sporadic vocabulary
en.description: The most consistent trigger is the word still (including split-token forms), along with the name fragment Bian. Other activations are sporadic, occurring in contexts involving fish, medical terminology, hockey statistics, and patent component descriptions, with no shared context.

patterns.name: still and its split-token fragments
patterns.context: The word still appears in a sentence, followed by a state, evaluation, or action description; in [1], it is split into «st»«ill» but remains recognizable as still.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including email, technical Q&A, medical abstracts, sports, patents, and news

patterns.name: Bian fragment in names
patterns.context: Appears as part of names: «Matt Bian»co, «Bian»ca, «Bian»chi; the unmarked portions complete the names.
patterns.domain: Band biographies, tennis news, academic author addresses

patterns.name: Fish-initial fish statement
patterns.context: Fish begins a sentence introducing the claim that fish transmit metal exposure.

patterns.name: Coronary disease terminology fragments
patterns.context: Terms related to acute coronary syndrome and antithrombotic therapy appear in a medical abstract.

patterns.name: Central nervous system tuberculosis terminology fragments
patterns.context: Title and abstract context about central nervous system tuberculosis in children.

patterns.name: Hockey game statistics and rankings
patterns.context: In descriptions of team records, goalie statistics, or special-teams rankings.

patterns.name: Component positioning and determination in patents
patterns.context: Patent text discussing whether a card is properly seated and noting that a system may still operate even if a component is not properly seated.

patterns.name: Contexts not explained by the patterns above
patterns.context: Fragments marked as «Lag», «E», «Astr», etc. in an electricity trading email, a Salesforce login failure message, and the astronomical address in [10]; these are not explained by still or Bian.
patterns.domain: Energy email, technical Q&A, astronomical address

4_2407.concept: still 与 Bian 字符片段及零散词汇
4_2407.description: 最一致的触发是词 still（含分词形式），另有姓名内片段 Bian；其余激活零散落在鱼类、医学术语、冰球统计和专利部件描述中，缺少共同语境。

patterns.name: still 及其分词片段
patterns.context: 单词 still 出现在句中，后接状态、评价或动作描述；在[1]中为分词切开的 «st»«ill»，仍可识别为 still。
patterns.domain: 邮件、技术问答、医学摘要、体育、专利及新闻等多种文体

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Bian 片段
patterns.context: 作为姓名的一部分出现：«Matt Bian»co、«Bian»ca、«Bian»chi；未标记的部分补全姓名。
patterns.domain: 乐队人物介绍、网球新闻、学术作者地址

patterns.name: Fish 开头的鱼类陈述
patterns.context: 句首 Fish，引出鱼类作为金属暴露传递媒介的陈述。
patterns.domain: NIH 摘要／环境健康研究

patterns.name: 冠脉疾病术语片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中出现急性冠脉综合征及抗血栓治疗相关术语。

patterns.name: 中枢神经系统结核术语片段
patterns.context: 儿童中枢神经系统结核的标题与摘要语境。

patterns.name: 冰球比赛统计与排名
patterns.context: 球队战绩、守门员数据或特殊球队排名的叙述中。

patterns.name: 专利中的部件定位与判定
patterns.context: 讨论卡片是否正确就位，以及系统即使部件未正确就位仍可能工作的专利说明。

patterns.name: 无法由上述模式解释的上下文
patterns.trigger: «purchases»附近的 «IC»«AP» 与 «Cal»；登录错误提示中的 «can't»；其余低强度标记
patterns.context: 电力交易邮件、Salesforce 登录故障提示，以及[10]的天文地址中标记的 «Lag»、«E»、«Astr» 等片段；不能由 still 或 Bian 解释。
patterns.domain: 能源邮件、技术问答、天文学地址

en.description: The strongest signal repeatedly occurs on still and on the Bian- string in names; other sporadic activations include conducts, trading terms and abbreviations in emails, and login prompts, which cannot be summarized by a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Lexical activation on still
patterns.context: Activation falls primarily on the word still itself, with variable meaning and syntactic position: meaning ‘still’, ‘yet’, or introducing an ongoing state.
patterns.domain: Email, Q&A, medical abstracts, news/sports text

patterns.name: Bianco/Bianca name fragments
patterns.context: Appears in name spellings such as Matt Bianco or Bianca; activation centers on the shared letter string within the names.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic band biography, astronomical address, tennis reporting

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in conducts
patterns.context: Subword segmentation forms conducts; the sentence describes fish as a medium through which metal exposure is transmitted to humans.

patterns.name: Rare word-internal fragments and garbled abbreviations
patterns.context: Activations occur across fragments related to purchasing, quantities, and electricity-market abbreviations or spellings in a procurement email; there is no clear shared meaning.

patterns.name: Local words in a login error message
patterns.context: Salesforce login failure and error-message context; aside from still, other marked fragments activate weakly.

patterns.name: Medical abbreviations and still in abstract phrasing
patterns.context: In tuberculosis or cardiovascular disease abstracts, describes a problem that persists or a treatment plan that remains controversial.

patterns.name: Bianchi fragment in an address
patterns.context: Appears as a surname fragment in a mailing address for an astronomical institution, not as a use of still.

4_2407.concept: still 与 Bian- 字符串
4_2407.description: 最强信号反复落在 still，也反复落在 Bian- 这段人名拼写；另有 conducts、邮件中的交易词/缩写及登录提示等零散激活，无法用单一语义概括。

patterns.name: still 的词汇激活
patterns.context: 激活主要落在 still 这个词本身，语义和句法位置不固定：表示仍然、尚未，或引出持续状态。
patterns.domain: 邮件、问答、医学摘要、新闻/体育文本

patterns.name: Bianco/Bianca 姓名片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名拼写片段中：Matt Bianco 或 Bianca；激活集中于名字内部的共同字母串。
patterns.domain: 百科乐队人物介绍、天文地址、网球报道

patterns.name: conducts 的词内片段
patterns.context: 词内分段构成 conducts；句中指鱼是金属暴露传给人类的媒介。

patterns.name: 稀有词内片段与乱码式缩写
patterns.context: 激活分布在采购邮件中的购买、数量及电力市场缩写或拼写片段；没有清楚共同语义。

patterns.name: 登录错误提示中的局部词
patterns.context: Salesforce 登录失败及错误提示语境；除 still 外，其他所标片段激活较弱。

patterns.name: 医学缩写与摘要句式中的 still
patterns.context: 在结核病或心血管疾病摘要中，描述问题仍存在或治疗方案仍有争议。

patterns.name: 地址中的 Bianchi 片段
patterns.context: 作为天文机构邮寄地址中的姓氏拼写片段出现，并非 still 用法。

en.description: Activations are distributed across numeric fragments, Russian letters, sentence-initial abbreviations, medical terms, tokenized proper names, and sentence patterns with “still”; several passages show only sporadic tokens and do not fit a stable pattern.

patterns.name: Numeric tokens in large numbers/numerical expressions
patterns.context: Part of a numeric string; includes integers, decimals/numeric notation, and expressions with numbers adjacent to units or symbols

patterns.name: Russian Cyrillic fragments
patterns.context: When Russian words are split into subword tokens, activations concentrate on “д” and several in-word fragments

patterns.name: Sentence-/word-initial Hadn't
patterns.context: Sentence-initial contraction “Hadn't,” followed by “really thought about that”

patterns.name: enlargement in medical terminology
patterns.context: Title of a case report related to gingival inflammation; the marker covers the term and adjacent hyphenated word-forming fragments

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of the name Bianchi
patterns.context: Appears in proper names as “E. Bianchi” in an astronomy address and “Bianca” referring to a tennis figure; not all matching fragments activate
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, astronomy paper addresses, sports news

patterns.name: still in emails
patterns.context: The “I am still …” structure, followed by predicates such as lacking or seeking

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic triggers
patterns.context: Occur respectively in texts about fish and metal exposure, math problems, addresses/units, entertainment, and tennis, with no stable shared context
patterns.domain: Research, math, emails, web text, etc.

4_2407.description: 激活分散于数字片段、俄语字母、句首缩写、医学词、专名分词及“still”句式；若干段仅见零散 token，无法归入稳定模式。

patterns.name: 高数字/数值表达中的数字 token
patterns.context: 数字字符串的一部分；包括整数、小数/数值记法，以及数字与单位或符号相邻的表达
patterns.domain: 数学题、天文地址/论文文本

patterns.name: 俄语西里尔字母片段
patterns.trigger: «д»10；同一俄语单词“Въздействие”中的其他字母也被标记
patterns.context: 俄语词被拆成子词 token 时，激活集中在“д”及词内若干片段

patterns.name: 句首/词首的 Hadn't
patterns.context: 句首的缩写“Hadn't”，后接“really thought about that”

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 enlargement
patterns.context: 牙龈炎症相关病例报告标题；标记覆盖术语及其邻近的连字符构词片段

patterns.name: 人名 Bianchi 的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名中，分别为天文学地址里的“E. Bianchi”和网球人物“Bianca”；并非所有同形片段都激活
patterns.domain: 百科、天文论文地址、体育新闻

patterns.name: 邮件中的 still
patterns.context: “I am still …”结构，后接短缺/寻找等谓语

patterns.name: 未能解释的零散触发
patterns.context: 分别处于鱼类与金属暴露、数学题、地址/单位、娱乐及网球文本中，缺少稳定共同上下文
patterns.domain: 科研、数学、邮件、网络文本等

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across several subword fragments, numbers, Cyrillic letters, and formatting boundaries; the only clear recurrence is still. The rest occur in distinct contexts such as medical terminology, scientific vocabulary, email formatting, and proper names, making them difficult to group under a unified semantic or stylistic feature.

patterns.name: English sentence-final abbreviation and space
patterns.context: Activation centers on the initial word Had and the following n’t fragment; the sentence ends with a period and a space. Similar subword-fragment activation also occurs in still.

patterns.name: Medical noun enlargement
patterns.context: Activation falls on the complete medical term enlargement in a specialized medical case report; the preceding text describes nonspecific inflammatory gingival enlargement.

patterns.name: Mathematical digit string
patterns.context: A digit string appears in a math problem asking “to the nearest integer?”; activation mainly falls on the digit prefix after a space.

patterns.name: Russian word-internal fragment
patterns.context: Activation occurs on д within a Russian Cyrillic word form; several weaker letter-fragment activations also occur nearby in the same word.

patterns.name: conduits in scientific text
patterns.context: When stating that fish are a route for transmission of metal exposure, activation centers on the latter part of conduits and the adjacent words known and of.
patterns.domain: Public health or environmental science abstract

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in still
patterns.context: In first-person English sentences, still follows am; both examples strongly activate on still, but differ in subsequent meaning and corpus source.

patterns.name: Medical phrase support computer
patterns.context: A compound noun phrase in medical literature about cancer pain management; activation falls on support and extends to adjacent words.

patterns.name: Email reply format and last
patterns.context: The email begins with a recipient salutation and colon, followed after a blank line by first-person text; activation is distributed around the line break, indentation, and last.

patterns.name: Bian name fragment
patterns.context: The name Matt Bianco appears in a band-member account; strong activation falls on the surname fragment Bian, while nearby proper-name fragments are weaker.

4_2407.description: 强激活分散于若干词片段、数字、俄文字母及格式边界；唯一重复较明确的是 still。其余分别落在医学术语、科学词汇、邮件格式和专名等不同上下文，难以归为统一语义或文体特征。

patterns.name: 英文句末缩写与空格
patterns.context: 激活集中在句首词 Had 以及紧随其后的 n’t 片段；句子以句号和空格收尾。相似的词片段激活也见于 still。

patterns.name: 医学名词 enlargement
patterns.context: 专业医学病例报告中，激活落在完整医学术语 enlargement；前文描述非特异性炎症性牙龈增生。

patterns.name: 数学数字字符串
patterns.context: 数字字符串出现在“to the nearest integer?”的数学题目中；激活主要落在空格后的数字前缀。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 俄语西里尔字母词形中，激活位于 д；同一词内周围还有多个较弱的字母片段激活。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的 conduits
patterns.context: 陈述鱼类是金属暴露传播途径时，激活集中在 conduits 的后半词片段及相邻的 known、of。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生或环境科学摘要

patterns.name: still 的词内片段
patterns.context: 第一人称英文句子中，am 后出现 still；两个例子均在 still 上强激活，但后续语义和语料来源不同。

patterns.name: 医学短语 support computer
patterns.context: 癌痛管理相关医学文献中的复合名词短语，激活落在 support，并延伸至相邻词。

patterns.name: 邮件回复格式与 last
patterns.context: 邮件以收件人称呼和冒号开头，空行后是第一人称正文；激活分布在换行、缩进及 last 附近。

patterns.name: 人名片段 Bian
patterns.context: 乐队成员叙述中的人名 Matt Bianco；强激活落在姓氏 Bian 片段，周边其他专名片段较弱。

en.description: Activations concentrate on uppercase, structured court-of-appeals headings and adjacent case information; they also cover various Github code and configuration fragments, all with clear specialized syntax or formatting markers.

patterns.name: Court of appeals heading
patterns.context: Court name in uppercase and centered, often with spaces, line breaks, and an unpublished marker; passage 4 also contains “IN THE COURT OF APPEALS”

patterns.name: Build variables and compiler configuration
patterns.context: Makefile-style variable assignments, command substitution, and compiler options

patterns.name: C header files and license comments
patterns.context: Comments, license statements, and header imports at the start of C/C++ source files

patterns.name: YAML workflow and GitHub Actions configuration
patterns.context: Indented automation workflow steps and command blocks

patterns.name: Helm template conditionals and include
patterns.context: Template expressions enclosed in Kubernetes/Helm configuration text

patterns.name: Court hearing location and date information
patterns.context: After the court heading, lists case information such as region, location, panel, and date

patterns.name: Fragments of other circuit court headings
patterns.context: All-uppercase fragments of court names and locations, but not in the aforementioned Fourth Circuit format

4_2407.concept: 结构化文档与代码标记
4_2407.description: 激活集中于大写、结构化的法院上诉法院抬头及相邻案件信息；另覆盖多种 Github 代码与配置片段，均含明显的专用语法或格式标记。

patterns.name: 法院上诉庭抬头
patterns.trigger: “COURT OF APPEALS”中“OF”为最强触发（9–10）；常伴随“UNITED STATES”“FOURTH CIRCUIT”
patterns.context: 法院名称以大写、居中排版，常有空格、换行及未公布标记；第4段也有“IN THE COURT OF APPEALS”

patterns.name: 构建变量与编译配置
patterns.context: Makefile 风格的变量赋值、命令替换和编译选项

patterns.name: C 头文件与许可证注释
patterns.context: C/C++ 源文件开头的注释、许可证声明和头文件引用

patterns.name: YAML 工作流与 GitHub Actions 配置
patterns.context: 以缩进组织的自动化工作流步骤和命令块

patterns.name: Helm 模板条件与 include
patterns.context: 模板表达式包裹在 Kubernetes/Helm 配置文本中

patterns.name: 法院开庭地点与日期信息
patterns.context: 法院抬头后列出地区、地点、合议庭和日期等案件信息

patterns.name: 其他巡回法院抬头残片
patterns.context: 法院名称及地点的全大写抬头片段，但并非前述第四巡回法院格式

en.description: Strong activations often occur on APPEALS in uppercase court headings, parts of code strings or URLs, and murm (murmur) in a case report; these patterns span genres and are difficult to group as a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: APPEALS in court names
patterns.context: Appears in uppercase court headings, usually in conjunction with UNITED STATES COURT OF; may be preceded or followed by a circuit court name.

patterns.name: String constants in code
patterns.context: In code or code snippets, activations concentrate on specific substrings of string contents or URLs; languages, frameworks, and uses vary.

patterns.name: Heart murmur in a medical examination
patterns.context: Physical examination narrative describing an aortic systolic murmur, with a grading notation nearby.

4_2407.description: 强激活多落在大写法院抬头的 APPEALS、代码字符串或 URL 的局部，以及病例中的 murm（杂音）；这些模式跨文体，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 法院名称中的 APPEALS
patterns.context: 出现在大写的法院抬头中，通常与 UNITED STATES COURT OF 连用；前后可能包含巡回法院名称。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院判决抬头

patterns.name: 代码中的字符串常量
patterns.context: 代码或代码片段中，激活集中在字符串内容或 URL 的特定子串；语言、框架和用途各异。

patterns.name: 医学检查中的心脏杂音
patterns.context: 体格检查叙述中描述主动脉收缩期杂音，且附近出现分级记号。

en.description: All passages mark prior; a common structure is prior to, indicating before an event or time point. Prior also modifies past experience, code, or treatment. The prior marked in passage 5 is not visible in the available context, so its specific collocation cannot be determined.

patterns.name: prior temporal marker
patterns.context: In phrases indicating temporal order, past experience, or conditions of applicability, followed by to (e.g., prior to) or a noun (e.g., prior education, prior code, prior CABG). This salient token appears in all passages.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: medical research, grant descriptions, technical Q&A, business emails, etc.

patterns.name: prior to introducing a temporal reference
patterns.context: prior combines with to to refer to before an event, time point, or procedure; includes prior to use, prior to each treatment fraction, prior to H-DR, prior to testing, prior to target date, etc.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, grant text, business emails

patterns.name: prior + past experience or object
patterns.context: prior directly modifies a noun, indicating previous education/consulting, code, or CABG; also appears in the table field Prior RT treatment.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and tables, technical Q&A

4_2407.description: 全部片段都标出 prior；常见结构是 prior to，表示某事件或时间点之前，另有 prior 修饰既往经历、代码或治疗。第5段标记的 prior 未显示在可见上下文中，无法判断具体搭配。

patterns.name: prior 时间标记
patterns.context: 在表示时间先后、既往经历或适用条件的短语中，后接 to（如 prior to）或名词（如 prior education、prior code、prior CABG）。这一醒目 token 出现在全部片段。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；医学研究、资助描述、技术问答及商务邮件等

patterns.name: prior to 引出时间参照
patterns.context: prior 与 to 连用，指某事件、时间点或操作之前；包括 prior to use、prior to each treatment fraction、prior to H-DR、prior to testing、prior to target date 等。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、资助文本、商务邮件

patterns.name: prior + 既往经历或对象
patterns.context: prior 直接修饰名词，表示先前已有的教育/咨询、代码，或既往 CABG；也见于表格字段 Prior RT treatment。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与表格、技术问答

en.description: Activations are distributed across Japan national-project phrases, Enc encryption-related word forms, medical terminology, Center following a quotation mark, patent prior/section phrases, and the title Diagram; no single semantic pattern sufficiently explains them.

patterns.name: National project name following country name Japan
patterns.context: Japan is immediately followed by national/National, then a national pathway name or national team project; capitalization varies.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia article titles or lead sections

patterns.name: Enc encryption-related identifiers
patterns.context: Enc appears in Encryption, configuration-style identifiers, or encryption standard names; contexts concern TLS/encryption configuration.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical logs, software documentation, and C# code

patterns.name: Medical immunohistochemistry terminology
patterns.context: Ki67 in the context of assessment of colorectal cancer and normal colonic mucosa.

patterns.name: Institution name after quotation mark in a citation
patterns.context: An opening quotation mark is followed by Center for Advanced MR Technology; preceding text introduces an NIH-funded project and research institution.

patterns.name: prior in patent priority wording
patterns.context: Patent background text citing U.S. statutory provisions and the benefit of priority from a provisional application.

patterns.name: Prior Art in a patent section heading
patterns.context: The section heading “Description of the Prior Art,” preceded by “Field of the Invention.”

patterns.name: Diagram in a question title
patterns.context: Basic Memory Model is followed by Diagram; the title discusses a Java Node class.

4_2407.description: 激活分散于 Japan 国家项目短语、Enc 加密词形、医学术语、引号后的 Center、专利 prior/章节词组及标题 Diagram；无法由单一语义模式充分解释。

patterns.name: Japan 国名后接国家项目名
patterns.trigger: «Japan»10« National»6« Route»3« 114»2；«Japan»10« national»8« ice»6« hockey»5« team»5
patterns.context: Japan 后紧接 national/ National，再接国家级路线名称或国家队项目；大小写可变。

patterns.name: Enc 加密相关标识符
patterns.context: Enc 出现在 Encryption、配置类标识符或加密标准名称中；上下文涉及 TLS/加密配置。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术日志、软件文档及 C# 代码

patterns.name: 医学免疫组化术语
patterns.context: Ki67 与结直肠癌及正常结肠黏膜的评估语境。

patterns.name: 引文中引号后的机构名称
patterns.context: 引号开启后接 Center for Advanced MR Technology；前文是 NIH 资助项目与研究机构介绍。

patterns.name: 专利优先权措辞中的 prior
patterns.context: 专利背景文本援引美国法条及临时申请优先权利益。

patterns.name: 专利章节标题中的 Prior Art
patterns.context: “Description of the Prior Art”章节标题，前有“Field of the Invention”。

patterns.name: 问题标题中的 Diagram
patterns.context: Basic Memory Model 后接 Diagram，标题讨论 Java Node 类。

en.description: Activations often fall on expressions related to loss, decline, absence, or avoidance; they also appear in descriptions of technical processes, changes in intensity, and en in code paths. The feature spans domains and trigger words are not consistent.

patterns.name: Loss, attenuation, or reduction
patterns.context: Describes reductions in signals, power, computational waste, or yield; sometimes explicitly involves restoring losses or reducing loss.
patterns.domain: Patent technology, computer systems, economic commentary

patterns.name: Negation, lack, or avoidance
patterns.context: Appears in expressions describing the absence of an outcome, avoidance of delay/disadvantages, or effects caused by a missing factor.
patterns.domain: Aviation operations, monitoring patents, neuroscience papers

patterns.name: Process and condition descriptions in technical documents
patterns.context: Technical descriptions of the operating state, location, or processing of equipment, components, or signals; trigger words differ, so it is uncertain whether these form a common pattern.
patterns.domain: Circuit and RF patents, gas turbine patents, monitoring patents

patterns.name: Local triggers in proper names or formatted strings
patterns.context: The language code en in a code property-file path; its semantic relation to other passages is unclear.

patterns.name: “Strengthening/weakening” and effect relations
patterns.context: Describes synaptic changes or signal strength; the wording involves changes in intensity, but contexts and trigger locations do not fully match.

4_2407.description: 激活常落在损失、下降、缺失或避免相关表达，也见于技术过程描述、强度变化及代码路径中的 en；跨领域且触发词不统一。

patterns.name: 损失、衰减或减少
patterns.context: 描述信号、功率、计算浪费或产量减少；有时明确涉及使损失回升或减少损失。
patterns.domain: 专利技术、计算机系统、经济评论

patterns.name: 否定或缺乏、避免某事
patterns.context: 出现在描述缺乏某种结果、避免延误/弊端，或某因素缺失所造成影响的表达中。
patterns.domain: 航空运营、监控专利、神经科学论文

patterns.name: 技术文档中的过程与条件描述
patterns.context: 技术说明涉及设备、部件或信号的工作状态、位置或处理过程；触发词并不相同，是否构成共同模式不确定。
patterns.domain: 电路与射频专利、燃气轮机专利、监控专利

patterns.name: 专名或格式化字符串中的局部触发
patterns.context: 代码中属性文件路径的语言代码 en；与其他段的语义关联不明显。

patterns.name: “强化/减弱”及效果关系
patterns.context: 描述突触变化或信号强度；词面涉及强度变化，但语境和触发位置并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 神经科学论文、信号传输专利

en.description: Activations often fall on -ing forms (e.g., machining, fitting, diverting, cycling, adopting, netting); recovery, without, and interaction also occur in contexts involving medical processes, ventilation condition comparisons, and molecular interactions, respectively.

patterns.name: Words ending in -ting/-ting nominalizations
patterns.context: Triggers mainly fall within English verbs in -ing form or related word forms; some activations cover the vicinity of the stem-suffix boundary rather than the entire word.
patterns.domain: Patents, popular science commentary, sports, travel, and business emails, etc.

patterns.name: Recovery-related word
patterns.context: Appears in a description of the recovery process after transplantation, following transplant and preceding process.

patterns.name: Negation word
patterns.context: In a list of CPAP ventilation conditions, contrasted with whether PSV is used.

patterns.name: Abstract relational word interaction
patterns.context: Describes interaction between urea and UreR and associated conformational changes.

4_2407.concept: 英语词内局部模式，可能偏向 -ing
4_2407.description: 激活常落在 -ing 词形（如 machining、fitting、diverting、cycling、adopting、netting）；另见 recovery、without、interaction，分别处于医学过程、通气条件对照和分子相互作用语境。

patterns.name: 词尾 -ting/-ting 名词化
patterns.context: 触发点主要落在英语动词的 -ing 形式或相关词形内部；有的激活范围覆盖词根与后缀边界附近，而非完整词。
patterns.domain: 专利、科普评论、体育、旅游及商务邮件等

patterns.name: 恢复过程相关词
patterns.context: 出现在移植后恢复过程的描述中，紧接 transplant，后接 process。

patterns.name: 否定词
patterns.context: 在 CPAP 通气条件列表中，与是否使用 PSV 的对照形成语境。

patterns.name: interaction 抽象关系词
patterns.context: 描述尿素与 UreR 之间的相互作用及相关构象变化。

en.description: Activations mainly occur near “ing” in various words, including gerunds, participles, and derived words, without consistent semantics or domains; one additional activation occurs on “Bank” in “Banking,” which cannot be explained by the same positional pattern.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in -ing/-ising forms
patterns.context: The target fragment is embedded in verbs, gerunds, or derived words ending in -ing; word meanings and syntactic functions vary, and the trigger position may be near a participial or derivational suffix.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain academic, encyclopedic, forum, and technical texts

patterns.name: Banking lexical item
patterns.context: Appears in a Wikipedia category label modifying “games”; it does not contain an -ing suffix here.

4_2407.concept: 英语 ing 词形片段
4_2407.description: 激活主要落在多种词中的「ing」附近，涵盖动名词、分词及派生词，语义和领域并不统一；另有一次出现在“Banking”的“Bank”部分，无法由同一位置规律解释。

patterns.name: -ing/-ising 派生形式中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 目标片段嵌在以 -ing 结尾的动词、动名词或派生词中；具体词义与句法功能多样，触发位置可能靠近分词/派生后缀
patterns.domain: 跨领域的学术、百科、论坛及技术文本

patterns.name: Banking 词项
patterns.context: 出现在 Wikipedia 分类标签中，修饰“games”；此处不含 -ing 词尾
patterns.domain: 百科分类／历史纸牌游戏

en.description: Activations mainly occur on word-final or in-word fragments across word types, especially -ing, -ability, and -ance; there are also isolated cases such as chargebacks, aerique, and Brocken. Other markers are distributed and lack a unified semantic or contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Words with the suffix -ing
patterns.context: Activations fall on the endings or internal fragments of -ing forms; meanings and grammatical functions vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Medical, patent, military, web, and forum texts, among other genres

patterns.name: Words with the suffix -ability
patterns.context: Activations fall on the abstract-noun suffix -ability, in contexts concerning portability and drive capability, respectively.

patterns.name: Words with the suffix -ance
patterns.context: Activations fall on the noun ending -ance, which denotes a property or state.

patterns.name: Plural word with the suffix -backs
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the end of the compound noun chargebacks; this is a single example.

patterns.name: In-word fragment -ique
patterns.context: Appears only in a username or nickname fragment; local context is insufficient to determine its semantic function.

patterns.name: In-word fragment -oken
patterns.context: Activation falls on the final fragment of the proper name Brocken; no clear relation to other highly activated word forms can be established.

patterns.name: Mixed activations on various word-final or in-word fragments
patterns.context: These fragments occur sporadically in individual passages, with no consistent affix, part-of-speech, or semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Business emails, medicine, patents, forums, encyclopedias, literature

4_2407.description: 主要激活于多类词的词尾或词内片段，尤其是-ing、-ability、-ance；另有 chargebacks、aerique、Brocken 等孤例。其余标记分散，缺乏统一语义或上下文规律。

patterns.name: 带后缀 -ing 的词
patterns.context: 激活落在 -ing 形式的词尾或词内片段；词义与语法功能差异较大。
patterns.domain: 医疗、专利、军事、网络、论坛等多种文体

patterns.name: 带后缀 -ability 的词
patterns.context: 激活落在抽象名词后缀 -ability，分别出现在可移植性和驱动能力语境。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、电子工程专利

patterns.name: 带后缀 -ance 的词
patterns.context: 激活落在表示性质或状态的名词词尾 -ance。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、电子工程专利

patterns.name: 带后缀 -backs 的复数词
patterns.context: 激活出现在复合名词 chargebacks 的词尾；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 词内片段 -ique
patterns.context: 只在用户名或昵称片段中出现，局部上下文不足以判定语义功能。

patterns.name: 词内片段 -oken
patterns.context: 激活落在专名 Brocken 的词尾片段；与其他高激活词形难以建立明确关系。

patterns.name: 多种词尾或词内片段的混合激活
patterns.trigger: « which»、« software»、« for»、« Q»、« Ref»、« de»、« card»、« company»、« axis»、« opening»、« caches»、« templates»、« drawbacks»、« MOSFET»、« reflections»
patterns.context: 这些片段在单段中零散出现，未显示一致的词缀、词性或语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、医疗、专利、论坛、百科、文学

en.description: Activations often fall on following morphemes in split words, as well as on mathematical digit fragments, business organizations and service-related words, of in legal language, and several sporadic lexical items; these span domains without a unified, stable meaning.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal participial suffixes
patterns.context: Activation falls on following morphemes in split words, especially -ing, -ed, and -ability; the trigger word occurs within a sentence rather than in a fixed sentence-initial position.
patterns.domain: Patents, legal, business, technical, and general expository text

patterns.name: Digit and number-sequence fragments
patterns.context: In mathematical sequences or expressions, numbers are split into multiple tokens; activation falls on particular digit fragments or punctuation.

patterns.name: Business entities, organizations, or service-related words
