patterns.context: Concerns companies, organizations, customer service, or public relations; activation centers on organization names, related nouns, and local tokens in phrases.

patterns.name: Preposition of in legal text
patterns.context: Occurs in fixed noun phrases or citation structures in legal judgments, statutes, or accounts of legal facts.

patterns.name: Other local lexical items
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different sentence structure and topic, with no clear shared contextual condition; activation falls on the word itself or its split fragments.

4_2407.description: 激活常落在拆分词的后续词素上，也有数学数字片段、商业机构与服务词、法律语句中的 of，以及若干零散词项；这些现象跨领域，未见统一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 词尾或词内分词后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在拆分词的后续词素上，尤其是 -ing、-ed、-ability 等；触发词处于句中而非固定句首位置。
patterns.domain: 专利、法律、商业、技术及一般说明文

patterns.name: 数字与数字序列片段
patterns.context: 数学题的数列或算式中，数字被拆分成多个 token；激活落在特定数字片段或标点上。

patterns.name: 商业实体、机构或服务相关词
patterns.context: 涉及公司、机构、客户服务或公共关系；激活集中于机构名称、相关名词及短语中的局部 token。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的介词 of
patterns.context: 出现在法律判决、法条或法律事实叙述中的固定名词短语或引用结构里。

patterns.name: 其他局部词项
patterns.context: 各自出现在不同句式与主题中，缺少共同的明显上下文条件；激活落在词语本身或其拆分片段。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to word forms containing ing and their subword fragments across domains; a few activations also occur at word endings, punctuation, and line breaks, sporadically and without a unified explanation.

patterns.name: -ing progressive/gerund forms and derivatives
patterns.context: Activations fall within words spelled with -ing, often progressive verb forms, gerunds, or related nouns; sometimes they cross subword boundaries.
patterns.domain: Multidomain text, including programming, medicine, statistics, music, and sports

patterns.name: ing at word endings and subword boundaries
patterns.context: In a few cases, activations fall on word-final fragments or across word/subword segmentation boundaries; insufficient evidence confirms these share the -ing pattern.

patterns.name: Tokens adjacent to quotation marks or punctuation
patterns.context: Activations occur on quotation marks, punctuation, or line-break markers; these positions may simply relate to the tokenization boundaries of neighboring words.

4_2407.concept: 对 ing 词形的敏感性
4_2407.description: 主要对含 ing 的词形及其子词片段敏感，跨领域出现；另有少数词尾、标点和换行位置激活，零散且未能统一解释。

patterns.name: -ing 进行体/动名词及派生词
patterns.context: 激活落在拼写含 -ing 的词内部，常见于动词进行形式、动名词或相关名词；有时跨子词边界。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本，包括编程、医学、统计、音乐与体育

patterns.name: 词尾与子词边界上的 ing
patterns.context: 少数情况下激活落在词尾片段或跨词/子词切分处，不足以确认与 -ing 模式相同。

patterns.name: 引号或标点邻接的 token
patterns.context: 激活出现在引号、标点或换行标记上；这些位置也可能只是与邻近词的分词边界有关。

en.description: The most stable pattern is activation on the -ing suffix in split words, found in general, academic, and technical texts; there are also digit fragments in mathematical sequences and scattered activations on function words, common words, and punctuation, without a unified context.

patterns.name: English -ing verb forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on the latter part of -ing forms split into multiple tokens, especially the -ing suffix; words may occur in sentences, headings, or technical documents.
patterns.domain: General English, academic, programming, and technical texts

patterns.name: Digit fragments in numbers and sequences
patterns.context: Occurs in math sequence problems, with activation on digit tokens inside or at the end of multi-digit numbers; there is also one extremely strong «1» in the same passage.

patterns.name: Sporadic prepositions, function words, and punctuation
patterns.context: Outside the primary -ing suffix pattern, individual function words, common words, or punctuation also activate weakly, with no consistent sentence structure or word meaning.

4_2407.description: 最稳定模式是激活拆分词中的 -ing 词尾，见一般、学术及技术文本；另有数学数列中的数字片段，以及若干分散的功能词、普通词和标点激活，缺少统一上下文。

patterns.name: 英语动词 -ing 形式
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分成多个 token 的 -ing 形式后半部分，尤其是词尾 -ing；词可处于句中、标题或技术文档中。
patterns.domain: 一般英语、学术、编程与技术文本

patterns.name: 数字与数列中的数字片段
patterns.context: 出现在数学数列题中，激活落在多位数内部或末尾的数字 token；同段也有一个极强的 «1»。

patterns.name: 零散的介词、功能词及标点
patterns.trigger: « with»、« benefit»、« definitely»、« in»、« Research»、« on»、« to»、« about»、« for»、« ↵»、«,”»
patterns.context: 在主要 -ing 词尾模式以外，个别功能词、普通词或标点也有较弱激活，所在句式与词义不统一。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言与标点

en.description: The strongest activations repeatedly fall on fragments of reconstitution and various -ing endings; weaker activations are scattered across medical outcome terms, of, letter fragments, and numbers. Cross-domain consistency is limited, and some activations are unexplained.

patterns.name: Ending of “reconstitution”
patterns.context: The trigger is the latter part of the word reconstitution, appearing in contexts of immune reconstitution or drug reconstitution; there is also a weaker repeat on the same word
patterns.domain: HIV clinical research, antibody formulation methods

patterns.name: Participial ending -ing
patterns.context: Activations occur on several words ending in -ing, including transfusing, blocking, spiking, decision-making, escaping, and graying; surrounding semantics and domains vary
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, public health, literary criticism, patent background

patterns.name: Specific internal or final letter fragments
patterns.context: Markers cover internal word fragments, abbreviation fragments, or number fragments, with no consistent semantic condition
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, math problems, credit-card discussions

patterns.name: Preposition of
patterns.context: Markers occur on the common preposition of in HIV disease, an intracranial surgery title, and prepositional phrases in sentences
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, medical titles, forum discussions

patterns.name: Clinical process or outcome terms
patterns.context: Low-to-moderate activations mark words describing associations, treatment, change, and outcomes in clinical studies; it is unclear whether this is independent of character or suffix patterns

patterns.name: Proper nouns and definite articles
patterns.context: A few weak activations fall on numbers or common function words, with no clear specialized condition in the surrounding context

4_2407.concept: 词形片段，尤以词尾为主
4_2407.description: 最强激活反复落在 reconstitution 的分片及多种 -ing 词尾；另有弱激活分散于医学结果词、of、字母片段和数字。跨领域一致性有限，部分激活无法解释。

patterns.name: “reconstitution”词尾
patterns.context: 触发点是单词 reconstitution 的后半部分，出现在免疫重建或药物复溶的语境中；另有同一词的较弱重复
patterns.domain: HIV 临床研究、抗体制剂方法

patterns.name: 分词词尾 -ing
patterns.context: 激活出现在多种以 -ing 结尾的词中，包括 transfusing、blocking、spiking、decision-making、escaping、graying；周边语义和领域各异
patterns.domain: 生物医学、公共卫生、小说评论、专利背景

patterns.name: 单词内部或末尾的特定字母片段
patterns.context: 标记覆盖单词内部片段、缩写片段或数字片段，未见统一语义条件
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、数学题、信用卡讨论

patterns.name: 介词 of
patterns.context: 标记出现在普通介词 of 上，分别处于 HIV disease、intracranial 手术标题及句子中的介词结构
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、医学标题、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 临床过程或结果词
patterns.trigger: « associated»1、« treated»3、« increased»3、« reduced»1、« effectively»2、« therapeutic»3、« improves»2、« survival»1
patterns.context: 低到中等强度地标记临床研究中描述关联、治疗、变化与结果的词；是否独立于字符或词尾模式不清楚

patterns.name: 专名与定冠词
patterns.context: 少数弱激活落在编号或常见功能词上，周边语境没有明确的专门条件

en.concept: Math problem structure and prompt cues
en.description: Strong activations center on line breaks separating math exercises and on prompts for evaluation, arithmetic, and sequence problems; a few subword-fragment activations also occur in forum programming jargon, employee advocacy discussions, and iOS file-system documentation.

patterns.name: Line breaks in math exercises
patterns.context: Line breaks separate math problems, answers, or formulas; activation markers sometimes fall on the line break itself rather than on mathematical words.

patterns.name: Arithmetic problem prompts
patterns.context: Introduces numerical operations, comparisons, or combination problems, followed by negative numbers, decimals, fractions, or other numeric expressions.

patterns.name: Sequence problem phrasing
patterns.context: Asks for a term or the next term based on a given sequence or general term; often accompanied by a list of numbers and line breaks.

patterns.name: Polynomial function evaluation problems
patterns.context: Defines a polynomial function with variables, then asks for its value after substitution; context includes formulas and problem line breaks.

patterns.name: Programming terms in programmer jargon
patterns.context: The words appear in the sentence “Program[m]ing in balance with Yin and Yan :-)”.

patterns.name: Word fragments related to employee advocacy
patterns.context: Occurs in a discussion of employee sharing, employee advocacy, and its effectiveness; activation falls on internal word fragments.

patterns.name: Word fragments in iOS file-system documentation
patterns.context: A link or title mentions the iOS file system and development guide; activation falls on fragments within technical terms.

4_2407.concept: 数学题结构与题干提示
4_2407.description: 强激活集中于数学练习题的题目分隔换行及求值、算术和数列题干；另有少量词内片段激活，见于论坛编程用语、员工倡导讨论和 iOS 文件系统文档。

patterns.name: 数学练习题中的换行
patterns.trigger: «↵»；常出现在数字或算式之后、下一道题干之前
patterns.context: 换行符作为数学题目、答案或公式的分隔；激活标记有时落在换行本身，而非数学词语上

patterns.name: 算术题的题干短语
patterns.context: 引出数值运算、比较或合并题，后接负数、小数、分数或其他数字表达式

patterns.name: 数列题的求项措辞
patterns.trigger: “What is the s'th term of”, “What is the x'th term of”, “What is next in”, “What comes next”
patterns.context: 要求根据给出的数列或通项求某一项、下一项；常伴随数字列表和换行

patterns.name: 多项式函数求值题
patterns.context: 先定义含变量的多项式函数，再要求代入求值；上下文包含公式与题目换行

patterns.name: 程序员行话中的编程词
patterns.context: 词语出现在“Program[m]ing in balance with Yin and Yan :-)”这一句中

patterns.name: 员工倡导相关的词语片段
patterns.context: 出现在员工分享、员工倡导及其实施效果的讨论中；激活落在词内部片段

patterns.name: iOS 文件系统文档中的词语片段
patterns.context: 链接或标题提及 iOS 文件系统与开发指南；激活落在技术术语的词内片段
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答/文档引用

en.description: Activations are distributed across internal letter fragments, domain terminology, and fixed phrases: these include analytical methods, descrambling, legal language, ROC statistics, article rewriting, re-equipping, mathematical symbols and number fragments, and rugby classifications. The examples show no obvious unified semantics.

patterns.name: Letter sequence MS
patterns.context: Occurs in the hybrid analytical method name “hybrid LBA/LCMS”; the marker is a letter fragment embedded in a word or abbreviation.

patterns.name: Letter sequence scrambl
patterns.context: Describes the descrambling step required before decoding in an LTE physical-channel decoding pipeline.

patterns.name: Legal formula the clerk of
patterns.context: A court instructs the clerk to enter judgment if no motion for reconsideration is filed; activations focus on words in a fixed legal expression.

patterns.name: Statistical term ROC
patterns.context: Appears in statistical analysis of diagnostic thresholds and normal/abnormal distinctions, as part of ROC curve analysis.

patterns.name: Internal word fragment re-writing
patterns.context: Discusses rewriting articles for website content production and search rankings; activation falls on an internal fragment of “rewriting.”

patterns.name: Internal fragments in re-equipping and switch over
patterns.context: Describes re-equipping system components and software switching between operating frequencies.

patterns.name: Symbol and number fragments in math problems
patterns.context: Algebraic expressions, sequence problems, and line breaks between problems and answers; no consistent mathematical semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: New Zealand rugby classification terms
patterns.context: References or category lists in Wikipedia biographies, especially rugby player categories.

4_2407.description: 激活分布于词内字母片段、领域术语和固定短语：包括分析方法、去扰码、法律用语、ROC统计、文章改写、重新装备、数学符号数字及橄榄球分类。各例没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: 字母串 MS
patterns.context: 出现在混合分析方法名称“hybrid LBA/LCMS”中；标记的是嵌在词或缩写中的字母片段。

patterns.name: 字母串 scrambl
patterns.context: LTE 物理信道解码流程中，描述解码前所需的去扰码步骤。

patterns.name: 法律套语 the clerk of
patterns.context: 法院指示书记员在未提出复审动议时录入判决；激活集中在法律固定表达中的词。

patterns.name: 统计术语 ROC
patterns.context: 诊断阈值及正常/异常区分的统计分析语境，组成 ROC curve analysis。

patterns.name: 词内 re-writing
patterns.context: 讨论用于网站内容生产与搜索排名的文章改写；激活落在“rewriting”的词内片段。

patterns.name: 词内 re-equipping 与 switch over
patterns.context: 描述系统组件重新装备，以及不同工作频率间的软件切换。

patterns.name: 数学题中的符号与数字片段
patterns.context: 代数表达式、数列题及题目/答案换行处；未见统一的数学语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 新西兰橄榄球分类词
patterns.context: 维基百科人物条目的参考文献或分类列表，尤其是橄榄球运动员类别。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、体育人物分类

en.concept: Local word forms and formatting fragments in English text
en.description: Activations are scattered across word-internal fragments, prepositions, line breaks, and numbers; local patterns involve English collocations, legal and mathematical texts, technical terms, and a few suffixes or category terms, with no single stable meaning.

patterns.name: Local collocations of English prepositions of/in/for
patterns.context: These words occur in prepositional positions within noun phrases, dates, or fixed expressions; sometimes activation covers only part of a word or adjacent space.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, legal texts, interview reporting, and scientific texts

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in technical terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in compound terms such as bioanalytical method validation; activation falls on internal parts of terms and does not necessarily cover whole words.
patterns.domain: Bioanalysis, drug regulation, and scientific abstracts

patterns.name: Procedural language in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in a heading-like phrase in a ruling or judgment record; «for» also fits the preposition pattern.

patterns.name: Review and adjudication phrasing in legal judgments
patterns.context: In a U.S. Court of Federal Claims procedural context, activation centers on prepositions and word-internal fragments of procedural terms.

patterns.name: Sequences and positional expressions in math problems
patterns.context: A number-sequence problem uses line breaks to separate the prompt and asks for the next term or the nth term; activations include line breaks, digit fragments, and ordinal-expression fragments.

patterns.name: Descrambling terminology in LTE communications
patterns.context: Appears in a technical sentence explaining descrambling and decoding of LTE physical-channel coding bits.

patterns.name: Word ending -osis
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of metamorphosis, used once in a narrative sentence describing change and once in an entomological research question.
patterns.domain: Fictional narrative and entomology research abstract

patterns.name: New Zealand rugby category phrase
patterns.context: Appears in a category label in a Wikipedia biography about New Zealand rugby players and related positions.

patterns.name: Isolated word fragments and title words
patterns.context: Occurs in the name Global CRO Council Closed Forum and its event description; activations are scattered, with no stable specific trigger condition shared with the other passages.

patterns.name: Local fragments in numeric and symbolic sequences
patterns.context: Intermixed with polynomial expressions and problems asking for a specific term in a sequence; these activation fragments do not themselves form a clear, consistent mathematical term.

4_2407.concept: 英语文本中的局部词形与格式片段
4_2407.description: 激活分散于词内片段、介词、换行和数字；局部模式涉及英语搭配、法律与数学文本、专业术语及少数词尾或分类词，未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 英语介词 of/in/for 的局部搭配
patterns.trigger: « of»、« in»、« for»；如“the 23rd «of» August”“the role «of» blood proteins”“motion «for» review”
patterns.context: 这些词出现在名词、日期或固定短语中的介词位置；有时激活仅覆盖词的一部分或紧邻空格。
patterns.domain: 多领域英语散文、法律文本、访谈报道及科研文本

patterns.name: 专业术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在生物分析方法验证等复合术语中，激活落在术语内部片段，不一定是完整词。
patterns.domain: 生物分析、药物监管与科研摘要

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序用语
patterns.context: 出现在裁定或判决记录的标题式短语中；其中«for»也符合介词模式。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的审查及裁判措辞
patterns.context: 联邦索赔法院程序语境，激活集中于介词及程序词的词内片段。

patterns.name: 数学题中的序列及位置表达
patterns.context: 数字序列题以换行分隔题目，要求预测后续项或求第n项；激活包含换行、数字片段及序数表达片段。

patterns.name: LTE通信中的解扰术语
patterns.context: 在说明LTE物理信道编码位解扰、解码的技术句中出现。

patterns.name: 词尾 -osis
patterns.context: 激活落在 metamorphosis 的词尾；分别用于叙事中描述变化的句子和昆虫发育科研题目。
patterns.domain: 小说叙事与昆虫学研究摘要

patterns.name: 新西兰橄榄球分类词组
patterns.context: 出现在维基百科人物条目的分类标签中，主题为新西兰橄榄球运动员及相关位置。
patterns.domain: 维基百科体育人物分类

patterns.name: 孤立的词形片段及标题词
patterns.context: 出现在 Global CRO Council Closed Forum 的名称及其举办说明中；激活片段分散，未见与其他段稳定共享的具体触发条件。
patterns.domain: 生物分析行业会议摘要

patterns.name: 数值与符号序列中的局部片段
patterns.trigger: «l»、«'t»，以及相邻的数字、逗号和负号
patterns.context: 与多项式表达式及求数列特定项的题目混排；这些激活片段本身不构成清晰一致的数学术语。

en.concept: Data collection sections in medical papers
en.description: The most consistent trigger is the medical paper section heading “Data collection,” often accompanied by ethics approval, informed consent, or research methods; sporadic triggers also include questionnaire options, clinical data-collection periods, LTE descrambling, and legal interview statements.

patterns.name: Data collection section heading
patterns.context: Appears as a paper section heading, often followed by a section number or separator; preceding text sometimes discusses ethics approval, informed consent, or research methods

patterns.name: Ethics approval and informed consent
patterns.context: Describes study approval and participant consent, often adjacent to the “Data collection” heading, although the heading itself also occurs across multiple passages

patterns.name: Search strategy and literature retrieval
patterns.context: Describes how a review or study searched the literature, gray literature, and conference abstracts; “Data collection” also appears in the passage
patterns.domain: Systematic reviews or medical research methods

patterns.name: Questionnaire scale options for degree of limitation
patterns.context: Lists questionnaire response options in increasing order of degree; followed by the “Data collection” heading

patterns.name: Data-collection period in medical research
patterns.context: Specifies the period covered by clinical study data collection

patterns.name: Data-stream descrambling step
patterns.context: In LTE communications, descrambling is performed after scrambling and before decoding

patterns.name: Disclosure of a minor’s interview statement
patterns.context: A legal account describes a child’s statements during an interview, with no obvious connection to data collection or medical research

4_2407.concept: 医学论文的数据收集小节
4_2407.description: 最稳定的触发是医学论文小节标题“Data collection”，常伴随伦理审批、知情同意或研究方法；另有问卷选项、临床数据收集时间、LTE解扰及法律访谈陈述等零散触发。

patterns.name: 数据收集小节标题
patterns.context: 作为论文小节标题，常接章节编号或分隔符；有时标题前文讨论伦理审批、知情同意或研究方法

patterns.name: 伦理审批与知情同意
patterns.context: 描述研究获批、参与者同意等伦理事项；往往紧邻“Data collection”标题，但该标题本身也在多段中出现

patterns.name: 搜索策略与文献检索
patterns.context: 描述综述或研究如何检索文献、灰色文献及会议摘要；段内也出现“Data collection”
patterns.domain: 系统综述或医学研究方法

patterns.name: 问卷量表的限制程度选项
patterns.trigger: “Limiting a little bit”“Moderately limiting”“Limiting quite a bit”“Extremely limiting”
patterns.context: 列出按程度递增的问卷回答选项；其后出现“Data collection”标题

patterns.name: 医学研究中的数据收集期
patterns.context: 说明临床研究数据收集所覆盖的时间范围

patterns.name: 数据流解扰步骤
patterns.context: LTE通信中，数据流经扰码后、解码前需要执行解扰
patterns.domain: 专利背景／无线通信技术

patterns.name: 未成年人访谈披露
patterns.context: 法律叙述中描述儿童在访谈中的陈述，与数据收集或医学研究无明显联系

en.concept: Research ethics and data collection context
en.description: Primarily responds to the “Data collection” heading in papers and nearby statements about ethics approval, ethics committees, and informed consent; it also responds weakly to quantities involving “of” or date phrases in several nonacademic texts, which cannot be fully unified with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Data collection heading
patterns.context: A paper subsection heading, often following a paragraph on ethics approval, informed consent, or research methods; occasional capitalization variant: “Data« collection»9”.

patterns.name: Ethics committees and research approval
patterns.context: Medical research describes approval by an ethics committee, research approval, or ethics clearance, often accompanied by participant consent.

patterns.name: Informed consent and participant information
patterns.context: Describes participants or their parents/caregivers receiving information and agreeing to participate; may also mention that refusal to participate carries no penalty.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research methods and ethics statements

patterns.name: Research institution and data-protection approval
patterns.context: States that a study received permission from a data-protection authority or participating center, within the context of research approval and data collection.

patterns.name: Committee votes and quantity expressions
patterns.context: “of” links a quantity to a whole; passage 2 concerns senators voting on a judiciary committee, while passage 5 concerns customer/platform quantities.

patterns.name: Nonstandard of phrases
patterns.context: Occurs in semantically awkward fragments and date expressions in interview or performance announcements; difficult to relate to the academic ethics topic.

4_2407.concept: 研究伦理与数据收集语境
4_2407.description: 主要响应论文中的“Data collection”标题及其邻近的伦理审批、伦理委员会和知情同意表述；另对若干非学术文本里的“of”数量或日期短语有较弱响应，无法完全统一解释。

patterns.name: 数据收集标题
patterns.context: 作为论文小节标题，常跟在伦理审批、知情同意或研究方法段落之后；偶见大小写变体“Data« collection»9”。

patterns.name: 伦理委员会与研究审批
patterns.context: 医学研究中说明伦理委员会批准、研究获批或取得伦理许可，常伴随参与者同意。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文伦理声明

patterns.name: 知情同意与参与者信息
patterns.trigger: “informed consent”“signed an informed consent form”“gave their informed consent”
patterns.context: 描述受试者或其父母/照护者收到信息并同意参与；也可能提到拒绝参与不受处罚。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究方法与伦理声明

patterns.name: 研究机构与数据保护审批
patterns.context: 说明研究获数据保护机构或参与中心许可，置于研究审批及数据收集语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文审批说明

patterns.name: 委员会投票与数量表达
patterns.trigger: “5 of the 6 senators voted yes”；另有“2 of”“4 of”
patterns.context: “of”连接数量与整体；第2段是参议员在司法委员会投票，第5段是客户/平台数量表达。

patterns.name: 非标准 of 短语
patterns.context: 分别出现在语义不通顺的片段及访谈/演出发布信息中的日期表达；难以与学术伦理主题对应。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the “Data collection” heading in paper methods sections and its formatting markers; also responds to adjacent research ethics language, including ethics approval, informed consent, and voluntary participation, as well as literature searches, recruitment, interviews, and questionnaire administration. There are also a one-off scale phrase and an unrelated noisy passage.

patterns.name: Research ethics approval body
patterns.context: Describes approval by an ethics committee, data-protection body, or other institution, often alongside the study protocol and participant consent

patterns.name: Participant informed consent and voluntary participation
patterns.context: States that participants (sometimes including parents/caregivers) gave informed consent, participated voluntarily, or could decline without penalty; often listed alongside ethics approval
patterns.domain: Methods and ethics statements in medical and social research

patterns.name: Data collection heading and formatting
patterns.context: Appears as a section or subsection heading in a paper’s methods section; the heading itself activates strongly regardless of the specific research content that follows

patterns.name: Data collection methods and retrieval
patterns.context: Explains how literature was searched or research material was collected, possibly following a Data collection section heading

patterns.name: Participant recruitment and survey administration
patterns.context: Describes participant recruitment, questionnaire completion, interviews, or research-center procedures; adjacent to ethics and consent statements, though consent terms are not explicit every time
patterns.domain: Methods in medical and public health research

patterns.name: limiting in scale options
patterns.context: Appears as an option describing degree of limitation in a rating scale

patterns.name: Incidental fragmented noisy text
patterns.context: Lacks a coherent research ethics or data collection context and appears concatenated, corrupted, or random

4_2407.description: 主要对论文方法部分的“Data collection”标题及其格式标记强烈响应；也响应伦理审批、知情同意和自愿参与等相邻研究伦理表述，以及资料检索、招募、访谈和问卷实施。另有单次量表措辞及一段无关噪声文本。

patterns.name: 研究伦理审批机构
patterns.trigger: «Ethics»、«Committee»、«Research»；“approved by the … Ethics Committee”“obtaining approval from”“ethical permission”
patterns.context: 描述研究获伦理委员会、数据保护机构或其他机构批准，常与研究方案、参与者同意相邻

patterns.name: 参与者知情同意与自愿参与
patterns.trigger: “informed consent”“signed an informed consent statement/form”“gave their informed consent”“voluntary”“Refusal to participate”
patterns.context: 说明参与者（有时包括家长/照护者）知情同意、自愿参加或拒绝参加不受惩罚；常与伦理审批并列
patterns.domain: 医学及社会研究方法与伦理说明

patterns.name: Data collection 标题及其排版
patterns.trigger: «Data»« collection»，以及标题后的“{#…}”、换行和分隔线
patterns.context: 出现在论文方法部分的章节标题或小节标题处；无论其后具体研究内容为何，标题词本身均有强激活
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文结构标记

patterns.name: 资料收集方法与检索
patterns.trigger: “hand-search reference lists”“grey literature search”“search of conference abstracts”“data collection method”“participant observation”
patterns.context: 说明如何检索文献或收集研究资料，可能出现在 Data collection 小节标题之后

patterns.name: 研究对象招募及调查实施
patterns.trigger: “invited to participate”“All participants”“answering the questionnaire”“interview”“all participating centers”
patterns.context: 交代招募参与者、问卷作答、访谈或研究中心执行情况；与伦理同意叙述相邻但并非每次都明确出现同意词
patterns.domain: 医学及公共卫生研究方法

patterns.name: 量表选项中的 limiting
patterns.trigger: “Limiting a little bit”“Moderately limiting”“Limiting quite a bit”“Extremely limiting”
patterns.context: 作为程度量表中描述限制程度的选项出现

patterns.name: 偶然的破碎噪声文本
patterns.context: 缺乏连贯研究伦理或 data collection 语境，呈现拼接、损坏或随机文本

en.description: Primarily responds to the “Data collection” subsection heading following research explanations such as ethics approval and informed consent; it also appears in search methods, Wikipedia novel categories, and a few sports terms and garbled texts, with unclear connections between the latter cases and the main pattern.

patterns.name: Data collection heading
patterns.context: A research-methods or paper subsection heading, often following sections on ethics approval, informed consent, or research permission; may include a section number and divider line.

patterns.name: Ethics approval and informed consent
patterns.context: Describes approval by an ethics committee or relevant institution, as well as participant consent or research permission; often adjacent to the Data collection heading.

patterns.name: Novel category listings
patterns.context: Wikipedia entries end with category labels listing a novel’s year, country, genre, or series.

patterns.name: Research search methods
patterns.context: Describes literature searches, manual searches of references, or contacting manufacturers to gather information.
patterns.domain: Medical systematic reviews or research protocols

patterns.name: Football derby terminology
patterns.context: “derby” refers to a match or rivalry between teams, appearing in the context of a football club description.

patterns.name: Anomalous or garbled text
patterns.context: The sentence is disorganized and contains placeholder or unrelated word strings, making stable trigger conditions difficult to determine from local context.

patterns.name: Novel entry body text and link fragments
patterns.context: A fragment remaining from a Wikipedia novel entry, containing a book title or category link but not resembling a complete category list.

4_2407.description: 主要响应论文中伦理审批、知情同意等研究说明后出现的“Data collection”小节标题；也见于检索方法、维基百科小说分类，以及少量体育词汇和杂乱文本，后几类与主模式联系不明。

patterns.name: Data collection 标题
patterns.context: 作为研究方法或论文小节标题，常出现在伦理审批、知情同意或研究许可段落之后，并可能带有节编号及分隔线

patterns.name: 伦理审批与知情同意
patterns.context: 描述研究获伦理委员会或相关机构批准，以及参与者同意或研究许可；经常紧邻 Data collection 标题

patterns.name: 小说分类目录
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾以分类标签列出小说年份、国别、类型或系列归属

patterns.name: 研究检索方法
patterns.context: 说明文献检索、手工检索参考文献或联系制造商等资料搜集方法
patterns.domain: 医学系统综述或研究方案

patterns.name: 足球德比词汇
patterns.context: “derby”指球队间的比赛或竞争，出现在足球俱乐部介绍语境中

patterns.name: 异常或乱码式文本
patterns.context: 语句杂乱、含占位或无关词串，无法从局部上下文明确判断稳定触发条件

patterns.name: 小说条目正文与链接碎片
patterns.context: 维基百科小说条目残留片段，含书名或分类链接，但不像完整分类列表

en.description: Activations occur mainly on “of” and the noun phrases that follow it across multiple genres; there is also the temporal/comparative expression “difference on the ... postoperative day” in medical abstracts, and TO in formatted legal headings. The that in the first passage has no clear corresponding pattern.

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase / noun phrase boundary after “of”
patterns.context: “of” is followed by a noun or noun phrase; activation often falls on of, and sometimes on the following element. Examples include “of some vegetables,” “of the phone,” “of the dynamics,” “of the interview,” “of the 6 senators,” “of the Red Death,” “of Appellate Procedure,” and “of less than 10%.”
patterns.domain: Narrative, academic, legal, technical, and forum texts across domains

patterns.name: Comparative contrast phrase in medical results
patterns.context: Medical abstracts report between-group differences and postoperative time points; activation occurs in result descriptions such as “difference on the ... postoperative day.”

patterns.name: Relational word “that”
patterns.context: That introduces or connects a subsequent relation in a sentence; nearby text includes irregular corpus text such as “is to an ... in ...”.

patterns.name: Preposition after government or legislative counts
patterns.context: In reporting on legislative progress, indicates vote counts or member composition.

patterns.name: Formatted citations in legal documents
patterns.context: In all-caps court citation rules and procedural titles, activations focus on the formatted prepositions TO and OF.

4_2407.description: 主要激活于“of”及其后名词短语，跨多种文体；另有医学摘要中“difference on the ... postoperative day”的时间/比较表达，以及法律格式标题中的TO。第1段的that缺乏清晰对应模式。

patterns.name: “of”后的介词短语/名词短语边界
patterns.context: “of”后接名词或名词短语，激活常落在 of，也有时落在紧随其后的成分；包含“of some vegetables”“of the phone”“of the dynamics”“of the interview”“of the 6 senators”“of the Red Death”“of Appellate Procedure”“of less than 10%”等。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的叙述、学术、法律、技术及论坛文本

patterns.name: 医学结果中的比较转折短语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中报告组间差异及术后时间点；激活位于“difference on the ... postoperative day”一类结果描述中。

patterns.name: 关系词“that”
patterns.context: 句中以 that 引出或连接后续关系，附近有“is to an ... in ...”等不规则语料文本。

patterns.name: 政务/立法编号后的介词
patterns.context: 立法进展报道中，表示投票人数或成员构成。
patterns.domain: 政治新闻或社交媒体式帖子

patterns.name: 法律文书中的格式化引用
patterns.context: 全大写的法院引用规则标题与程序名称中，激活集中在格式化的介词 TO、OF。

en.concept: Bias toward the preposition “of” and relational expressions
en.description: The most stable signal is “of” across domains, often connecting quantities, owned objects, or research projects. Sporadic activations also occur on “in” and various domain-specific words, abbreviations, and project terminology; the overall pattern is not uniform.

patterns.name: Relational “of”
patterns.context: Connects elements in expressions of quantity, proportion, possession, or noun phrases; the semantics and syntax on either side are not fixed
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including patents, news, encyclopedias, and research papers

patterns.name: “in” and its following relation
patterns.context: Appears in prepositional phrases expressing scope, location, or a relation

patterns.name: Abbreviation “EP”
patterns.context: Appears as an uppercase abbreviation in the string “SOEP”

patterns.name: Lexical item “practice”
patterns.context: Appears in the noun phrase “metaphysical practice”
patterns.domain: Pile-CC prose discussing Western thought or culture

en.concept: The phrase “take on” and its semantics
en.description: Primarily responds to the phrase “take on”: it is used both to express a view of a problem or event and to refer to an interpretation of a song, role, or story. Two other fragments are triggered sporadically and are difficult to fit into the main pattern.

patterns.name: “take on” expressing a view or evaluation
patterns.context: “take on” expresses a view, interpretation, or evaluation of an issue, event, or object, often followed by this, the problem, or an event
patterns.domain: Online discussions, Q&A, and reviews; covers [1], [2], [5]

patterns.name: “take on” meaning interpretation or adaptation
patterns.context: Refers to an interpretation, portrayal, or adaptation of a song, role, or story, rather than a general opinion
patterns.domain: Music, theater, and literary criticism; covers [6], [7], [9], [10]

patterns.name: Opinion usage embedded in a music-recommendation context
patterns.context: A music-store clerk offers a view of or recommendation for an album selected for a customer
patterns.domain: Music consumption and album reviews; covers [8]

patterns.name: Sporadic triggers in mixed text
patterns.context: Activations fall on sporadic common words or local subword fragments, with no clear semantic conditions matching the uses of “take on”
patterns.domain: Garbled or concatenated text, news-commentary fragments; covers [3], [4]

4_2407.description: 主要响应短语“take on”：既用于表达对问题或事件的看法，也用于指对歌曲、角色、故事的演绎；另有两个片段仅见零散触发，难以归入主模式。

patterns.name: “take on”表达观点或评价
patterns.context: “take on”表示对问题、事件或对象的看法、解读或评价，后面常跟 this、the problem、某个事件等
patterns.domain: 网络讨论、问答、评论；覆盖 [1]、[2]、[5]

patterns.name: “take on”表示演绎或改编
patterns.context: 表示对歌曲、角色或故事的演绎、诠释或改编，而非一般观点

patterns.name: 观点用法嵌在音乐推荐语境
patterns.trigger: “their« take»1« on»9 some of the albums”
patterns.context: 音乐店员为顾客挑选的专辑提供看法或推荐
patterns.domain: 音乐消费与专辑评论；覆盖 [8]

patterns.name: 混杂文本中的零散触发
patterns.context: 激活落在零散常见词或局部词片段上，未见与“take on”用法相同的清晰语义条件
patterns.domain: 乱码或拼接文本、新闻评论片段；覆盖 [3]、[4]

en.description: Activations are most concentrated on take on (expressing a view or evaluation), but also occur on the prepositions on, of, to, and between, as well as various terms and function words in academic and technical texts; these patterns cannot be fully explained by a single clear semantic account.

patterns.name: Presenting or introducing a view
patterns.context: Often appears when offering an interpretation, comment, or alternative perspective, commonly in the phrase “take on” followed by an issue or topic; it can also appear in “a … take on an app.”
patterns.domain: Q&A, forum comments, technology product discussions

patterns.name: Selection of a mathematical object or branch
patterns.context: After a mathematical formula, indicates which branch to take; this example concerns a branch of the square root.

patterns.name: Preposition on in a noun phrase
patterns.context: The preposition on introduces the subject of a ruling or the object being restricted; its form matches highly activated locations in take on, but its semantics differ.

patterns.name: Relational words such as of / to in academic prose
patterns.context: Appears in noun phrases or technical expressions in mathematical or physics texts; no local construction matching take on is evident.

patterns.name: Academic introductions and structural descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces paper organization, definitions, or constructions; activations are distributed across continuous technical exposition rather than a single salient phrase.

patterns.name: Various words in garbled text
patterns.context: Fragments are broken, concatenated, or apparently noisy; activations fall on various function and content words, making shared conditions difficult to identify.

patterns.name: Suffixes or participles in technical compounds
patterns.context: Appears in noun phrases such as “rulemaking process,” without showing a clear trigger condition shared with other patterns.

patterns.name: Morphemes and common words in technical terminology
patterns.context: In discussions such as those of concatenative language, activations span word endings, nouns, and prepositions, with no clear local pattern.

patterns.name: Local words in technical descriptions
patterns.context: Patent background paragraphs describing modules, performance, and limitations; multiple related terms and common words are marked.

4_2407.concept: 偏向介词关系与 take on
4_2407.description: 激活最集中于 take on（提出看法或评价），但也分布在介词 on、of、to、between，以及学术、技术文本中的多种术语和功能词；这些模式无法由单一明确语义完全解释。

patterns.name: 评价或介绍一种看法
patterns.trigger: « take»…« on»（如 “take on the problem”“take on this”）
patterns.context: 在提出解释、评论或另一种视角时，常见于短语 “take on” 后接问题或主题；也可出现在 “a … take on an app” 中。
patterns.domain: 问答、论坛评论、科技产品讨论

patterns.name: 数学对象的选取或分支
patterns.context: 数学公式之后，说明取哪个分支；此例是平方根的分支。

patterns.name: 名词短语中的介词 on
patterns.trigger: « on»，如 “headline on this ruling”“limits on”“limit on”
patterns.context: 介词 on 引出所涉及的裁决或受限对象；形式上与 take on 的高激活位置相同，但语义并不一致。

patterns.name: 学术行文中的 of / to 等关系词
patterns.context: 出现在数学或物理学术文本的名词短语或技术表达中；未见与 take on 相同的局部句式。

patterns.name: 学术导言与结构描述
patterns.context: 介绍论文安排、定义或构造，激活分布在连续技术叙述中，而非单一显著短语。

patterns.name: 杂乱文本中的多种词语
patterns.trigger: « family»、« that»、« to»、« in»、« has»、« as»、« read»、« of»、« practice»、« work»、« EP»
patterns.context: 片段语句破碎、拼接或疑似噪声；激活落在多种功能词和内容词上，难以确定共同条件。

patterns.name: 技术复合词中的词尾或分词
patterns.context: 出现在 “rulemaking process” 一类名词短语中，未显示与其他模式明确共享的触发条件。

patterns.name: 技术术语中的词素及普通词
patterns.context: 在 concatenative language 等技术讨论中，激活跨词尾、名词和介词分布，局部规律不明确。

patterns.name: 技术描述中的局部词语
patterns.context: 描述模块、性能与限制的专利背景段落，多个相关术语和普通词都被标记。

en.concept: Preposition collocations and local word features
en.description: The most prominent clues are on/of, especially after noun phrases followed by this or theorem; there are also local patterns involving rulemaking, search terms, extension, and spatial tests, along with various sporadic words. Overall, the activations span domains and are not fully unified.

patterns.name: of/on in on this / of theorem collocations
patterns.context: The preposition on or of is strongly marked after a noun or phrase and before complements such as this/theorem; contexts are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, commentary, math papers, and general prose

patterns.name: rulemaking
patterns.context: Making combines with rule in rulemaking, referring to rules or regulatory processes.

patterns.name: Search-related terms
patterns.context: Describes search resources, references, and gray-literature searches in a systematic review; activations occur at different positions in Search/search/searching.

patterns.name: Extension in a paper
patterns.context: Introduces an extension of a theorem in a math paper, with of between the noun and theorem.

patterns.name: Spatial cognition and testing
patterns.context: Describes children’s understanding of spatial terms and spatial tests using figures; of is marked in the test name.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous local words
patterns.context: Only sporadic words or subword fragments are marked in each passage, with no stable and clear common semantic condition.

4_2407.concept: 介词搭配及词语局部特征
4_2407.description: 激活最突出的线索是 on/of，尤其出现在名词短语后接 this 或 theorem 时；另有 rulemaking、检索词、extension 与空间测试等局部模式，以及多种零散词语，整体跨领域且不完全统一。

patterns.name: on this / of theorem 搭配中的 of/on
patterns.context: 在名词或短语之后、后接 this/theorem 等补足成分时，介词 on 或 of 被强烈标记；语境不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、评论、数学论文及一般散文

patterns.name: rulemaking
patterns.context: making 与 rule 构成 rulemaking，讨论规则或监管流程。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、能源监管邮件

patterns.name: search 相关词语
patterns.context: 系统综述中描述检索资源、参考文献及灰色文献搜索；激活分布在 Search/search/searching 的不同位置。

patterns.name: 论文中的扩展
patterns.context: 数学论文引入定理的扩展，of 位于名词与定理之间。

patterns.name: 空间认知与测试
patterns.context: 描述儿童对空间术语的理解及图形空间测试；of 在测试名称中被标记。

patterns.name: 杂项局部词语
patterns.context: 各段只有零散词语或子词被标记，未呈现稳定且明确的共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页散文、编程讨论、问答

en.description: Activations primarily occur on on in the phrase “take on,” followed by to in “will to”; other activations include ix in remix, Division of, modification of, and sporadic participles and quotation marks, with no unified semantic theme apparent.

patterns.name: The phrase “take on”
patterns.context: On immediately follows take in the phrase; it can mean presenting a view or solution, or refer to an interpretation of a work. Paragraphs [2] and [3] are followed by “another take on”; paragraph [4] is followed by a music work title.

patterns.name: The “will to” construction
patterns.context: The noun will is followed by infinitive to, expressing willingness or resolve; the following verbs are live and cut, respectively.

patterns.name: ix in a compound or term
patterns.context: In a music context, remix is split into multiple tokens, with activation concentrated on ix; the word is followed by album.

patterns.name: Division in a physics institution address
patterns.context: Division of appears in an address or institutional affiliation, followed by a discipline name.

patterns.name: Modification in academic writing
patterns.context: A mathematics paper describes modifying a condition or construction, with nearby terms such as forcing and models.

patterns.name: Specific lexical fragments and punctuation
patterns.context: Isolated participle fragments or quotation marks appear in English text; the context does not show a clear connection to other patterns.

4_2407.concept: 英语短语中的关系词片段
4_2407.description: 主要激活于 “take on” 短语中的 on，其次见于 “will to” 的 to；另有 remix 的 ix、Division of、modification of，以及零散分词和引号标点，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 短语 “take on”
patterns.context: 短语中 take 后紧接 on；可表示提出一种观点/解法，也可指某作品的演绎版本。段[2]、[3]后接 “another take on”，段[4]后接音乐作品名。
patterns.domain: 问答、论坛讨论、音乐评论

patterns.name: “will to”结构
patterns.context: 名词 will 后接不定式 to，表示意愿或决心；后续动词分别为 live、cut。

patterns.name: 复合词或术语中的 ix
patterns.context: 在音乐语境中，remix 被拆成多个 token，激活集中于 ix；词后接 album。

patterns.name: 物理机构地址中的 Division
patterns.context: 地址或机构署名中出现 Division of，后接学科名称。

patterns.name: 学术写作中的修改
patterns.context: 数学论文中描述对某个条件或构造进行修改，周围有 forcing、models 等术语。

patterns.name: 特定词汇片段与标点
patterns.context: 孤立出现于英文文本中的分词片段或引号标点；上下文未显示与其他模式的明确联系。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on frequent English prepositions and their phrase-continuation positions, especially on, of, and to; there are also Portuguese de, other function words, and a small number of within-word fragments and abbreviation activations.

patterns.name: On in English prepositional phrases
patterns.context: The preposition on appears before noun or verb phrases, as in “crackdown on scareware,” “limit on the mass,” “take on this,” and “take on 'Nothing in Return'.”
patterns.domain: English text including news, academic writing, forums, and music reviews

patterns.name: Preposition of
patterns.context: Of introduces possession, a part, or a complement, as in “Review of Some Previous Results,” “round of interaction,” and “branch of the square root”; it also appears in song-review phrases.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, reviews, and general English text

patterns.name: Preposition to
patterns.context: To introduces an object or complement, as in “corrections to the effective potential”; it also appears sporadically in more disorganized text.
patterns.domain: Physics papers and general English text

patterns.name: Preposition de
patterns.context: In Portuguese, de connects nominal elements, as in “resposta de erro” and “resposta de redirecionamento”; broader sequences of short words are ambiguous.

patterns.name: Common English function words and phrase continuation
patterns.context: Frequent function words that syntactically connect preceding and following phrases; fragment 3 is concatenated, disorganized text, making stable conditions difficult to confirm.
patterns.domain: General English and concatenated web text

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in technical compounds and abbreviations
patterns.context: Appears in split fragments of words such as scareware and scammers, or in proper names and abbreviations; may reflect secondary morphological activation rather than an independent semantic pattern.

4_2407.concept: 常见介词与短语连接词
4_2407.description: 激活主要落在英语高频介词及其短语续接位置，尤以 on、of、to 为主；另有葡萄牙语 de、其他功能词，以及少量词内分片和缩写激活。

patterns.name: 英语介词短语中的 on
patterns.context: 介词 on 出现在名词或动词短语之前，如“crackdown on scareware”“limit on the mass”“take on this”“take on 'Nothing in Return'”。
patterns.domain: 新闻、学术、论坛、音乐评论等英语文本

patterns.name: 介词 of
patterns.context: of 引出所属、部分或补足语，如“Review of Some Previous Results”“round of interaction”“branch of the square root”；也出现在歌曲评论短语中。
patterns.domain: 学术、评论及一般英语文本

patterns.name: 介词 to
patterns.context: to 引出对象或补语，如“corrections to the effective potential”；还在较杂乱文本中零星出现。
patterns.domain: 物理学术文本及一般英语文本

patterns.name: 介词 de
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中 de 连接名词成分，如“resposta de erro”“resposta de redirecionamento”；更广泛的短词序列含混。

patterns.name: 英语常见功能词及短语续接
patterns.context: 在句法上承接前后短语的高频功能词；片段3为混乱拼接文本，难以确认稳定条件。
patterns.domain: 一般英语及网页拼接文本

patterns.name: 技术性复合词与缩写内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 scareware、scammers 等词的分词片段，或专名、缩写中；可能是次级的词形激活，而非独立语义模式。
patterns.domain: 网络诈骗报道、数学/计算机学术文本

en.description: Activations primarily fall on the prepositions of and on and adjacent phrases, especially the name “Battle of,” the expression “take on,” and noun + of constructions; paper-structure cues and wording in scam reports also appear, while triggers in disorganized text are difficult to interpret.

patterns.name: Position and continuation of “of” phrases
patterns.context: Activations often fall on the prepositions of or on, especially when followed by a noun, title, or phrase; they are not limited to these two prepositions.

patterns.name: Battle names formed with “Battle of”
patterns.context: Battle is followed by of and then a specific place or battle name; this occurs in both titles and body text.
patterns.domain: Historical and literary catalogs, encyclopedia text

patterns.name: “take on” expressing a view or response
patterns.context: take on is followed by an issue or demonstrative pronoun, expressing a view or a way of handling something.

patterns.name: Structural descriptions of paragraphs or articles
patterns.context: A section heading or organizational cue introduces a review, results, or subsequent structure.

patterns.name: Of and its modifying relation in a noun phrase
patterns.context: A noun is followed by of, which introduces its object or content; the sentence discusses LED light-intensity adjustment.

patterns.name: “crack down on” in scam reporting
patterns.context: crack down on is followed by scamware and scammers, describing law-enforcement action; the same paragraph also contains a quotation of a phone-scam conversation.

patterns.name: Mixed text without a clear coherent trigger
patterns.context: The text itself is semantically disorganized, with markers scattered across unrelated words, making stable local conditions difficult to determine.

4_2407.description: 激活主要落在介词 of、on 及相邻短语中，尤其见于“Battle of”名称、“take on”表达和名词+of结构；另见论文结构提示与诈骗报道措辞，杂乱文本中的触发较难解释。

patterns.name: 短语“of”的位置与延续
patterns.context: 激活常落在介词 of 或 on 上，尤其是其后接名词、标题或短语时；但不只限于这两种介词。

patterns.name: 以“Battle of”构成的战役名称
patterns.context: Battle 后接 of，再接具体地点或战役名称；标题和正文中均出现。
patterns.domain: 历史、文学目录及百科文本

patterns.name: “take on”表达观点或回应
patterns.context: take on 后接问题或指示性代词，表示提出一种看法或处理某事。

patterns.name: 段落或文章的结构性说明
patterns.context: 以章节标题或组织结构提示引出回顾、结果或后续安排。

patterns.name: 名词短语中的 of 与修饰关系
patterns.context: 名词后接 of 引出其对象或内容，句子讨论 LED 光强调整。

patterns.name: 诈骗报道中的“crack down on”
patterns.context: crack down on 后接诈骗软件及诈骗者，描述执法行动；同段另有电话诈骗对话引文。

patterns.name: 无明显连贯触发的混杂文本
patterns.context: 文本本身语义杂乱，标记散布于不相连的词语，难以确定稳定局部条件。
patterns.domain: 来源不明或拼接式文本

en.description: The most prominent common clue is the preposition of, often in of the noun phrases but also in other of structures; there is also on in take on and on our way, as well as fragment activations in ABSTRACT, which may not belong to the same pattern.

patterns.name: Article in the fixed phrase “of the”
patterns.context: `of` is followed by a noun or noun phrase, often before `the`; however, in some passages `of` is not followed by `the`, so the trigger should not be limited to the fixed phrase `of the`
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patents, and other genres

patterns.name: on in phrasal verbs or prepositional structures
patterns.context: `take on` is followed by a discussion topic or work; both examples show strong activation on `on` in the phrase

patterns.name: on in noisy text
patterns.context: In noisy or strongly concatenated informal text, `on` appears in the structure `on our way`

patterns.name: Visible token boundary markers
patterns.context: Activations fall on the split-marked fragments of `ABSTRACT`; this may involve tokenization rather than a stable semantic trigger

4_2407.description: 最显著的共同线索是介词 of，常见于 of the 名词短语，但也见于其他 of 结构；另有 take on、on our way 中的 on，以及 ABSTRACT 的分片激活，未必属于同一模式。

patterns.name: 固定短语“of the”中的冠词
patterns.trigger: `of»10`，尤其是 `of the` 中的 `of`；第6段为 `of the square root`，第7段为 `of interaction`，第8段为 `of Becker-Stark type`
patterns.context: `of` 后接名词或名词短语，常处于 `the` 之前；但部分段落中 `of` 后不是 `the`，因此不宜将触发条件限定为固定的 `of the`
patterns.domain: 跨学术论文、专利及其他文体

patterns.name: 短语动词或介词结构中的 on
patterns.context: `take on` 后接讨论对象或作品；两例均表现为短语中 `on` 的强激活

patterns.name: 散乱文本中的 on
patterns.context: 噪声或拼接感较强的非正式文本中，`on` 出现在 `on our way` 结构里

patterns.name: 可见 token 边界符号
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分标记的 `ABSTRACT` 各片段上；可能涉及 token 切分，而非稳定的语义触发

en.description: Primarily sensitive to connectors and their following complements in English, especially “of” and “on,” often in academic or technical expressions and news collocations; also shows sporadic responses to within-word Spanish fragments and Q&A formatting. Segment 10 is semantically anomalous and difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Nominal complements after “of”
patterns.context: “of” connects a preceding noun, verb, or nominalized expression to a following noun phrase, especially in paper titles, theorem statements, and patent descriptions of relations or objects.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patent text, and technical descriptions

patterns.name: “on” introducing a topic or object
patterns.context: The preposition “on” introduces a discussion topic, issue, or target of pressure; it appears in both the adjacent phrase “take on” and news reporting’s “crackdown on.”

patterns.name: “to” in English collocations
patterns.context: Appears in common prepositional or infinitive constructions, such as “response to,” “measures … to pressure,” and “way to …”; triggers are not limited to a single syntactic function.
patterns.domain: News, English prose, and mixed text

patterns.name: Spanish words of the “-ción” type
patterns.context: Markers occur within Spanish words such as “sentimiento,” “industria,” and “acuerdo”; the highlighted fragments are not complete words.
patterns.domain: Spanish speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Colon and introduction of a following answer
patterns.context: A colon and line break appear after a code snippet, introducing an answer or view: “A:↵ Here’s another take …”.

patterns.name: Sporadic words in strange, low-coherence text
patterns.context: The sentences are semantically disorganized, and activations fall on common words and prepositional constructions; they may relate to the “of” pattern, but context is insufficient to determine this.
patterns.domain: Low-coherence or anomalous text in Pile-CC

4_2407.description: 主要对英语中连接成分及其后续补语敏感，尤其是“of”和“on”，常见于学术或技术表达与新闻搭配；另对西班牙语词内片段及问答格式有零散响应。第10段语义异常，难以归因。

patterns.name: 短语“of”后的名词性补语
patterns.context: “of”连接前面的名词、动词或名词化表达与后续名词短语，尤其是论文标题、定理陈述、专利描述中的关系或对象。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利文本及技术说明

patterns.name: “on”引出主题或对象
patterns.context: 介词“on”引出讨论主题、问题或施压对象；既有短语中相邻的“take on”，也有新闻报道中的“crackdown on”。

patterns.name: 英语搭配中的“to”
patterns.context: 出现在常见介词或不定式搭配中，如“response to”“measures … to pressure”“way to …”；触发并不局限于单一句法功能。
patterns.domain: 新闻、英语散文及混杂文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语词尾“-ción”类词
patterns.context: 标记落在西班牙语词内部，如“sentimiento”“industria”“acuerdo”；高亮片段并非完整词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会西班牙语发言

patterns.name: 冒号及其后的回答引入
patterns.context: 代码片段后出现冒号和换行，随后引出回答或观点：“A:↵ Here’s another take …”。

patterns.name: 怪异、低连贯度文本中的零散词
patterns.context: 句子语义混乱，激活落在普通词及介词搭配上；可能与“of”模式有关，但上下文不足以确定。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 中低连贯度或异常文本

en.description: Activations often occur on “of” and nearby noun phrases, especially expressions in academic text connecting definitions, modifications, extensions, results, or research topics; they also appear sporadically in general technical, patent, and news contexts, with no uniform syntactic or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Phrases/nouns after “of”
patterns.context: “of” immediately precedes a title or noun phrase, connecting it as a complement; it often appears in titles, section introductions, definitions, or results statements in academic papers.
patterns.domain: Primarily ArXiv academic text, also PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Extensions, effects, or topics involving “on”
patterns.context: Across different syntactic structures, activations appear in phrases about manipulating an object, an affected object, or a research topic; these do not fully match the common “of” usage in segment 1.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, PubMed abstracts, physics papers

patterns.name: Expressions of general improvement or enforcement action
patterns.context: Activations fall on expressions involving an object being improved or targeted; the context is not an academic paper’s section or results introduction.

patterns.name: Academic constructions with no unified trigger condition
patterns.context: Activations occur in paper-structure introductions, descriptions of mathematical inequalities, and theorem generalizations, but the snippets alone do not reveal a shared fine-grained semantic condition.

4_2407.concept: 名词短语中的关系连接表达
4_2407.description: 激活多出现在“of”及其邻近的名词短语中，尤其是学术文本里连接定义、修改、扩展、结果或研究主题的表达；也零散见于一般技术、专利和新闻语境，具体句法与语义条件并不统一。

patterns.name: “of”后的短语/名词
patterns.trigger: «of»，常见于“conclusions”“Review of Some Previous Results”“modification of”“inequality of”“Test of”“definition of”“extension of”
patterns.context: “of”紧接标题或名词短语，连接其补足语；常处于学术论文的标题、章节介绍、定义或结果陈述中。
patterns.domain: 以 ArXiv 学术文本为主，也见于 PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 带“on”的延伸、影响或主题
patterns.trigger: “flip« of» the phone”“Effects« on» spatial term comprehension”“sector« of» perturbations”“extension of this work”
patterns.context: 在不同句法结构中，激活出现在关于对象操作、影响对象或研究主题的短语中；与第1段中常见的“of”用法并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、PubMed 摘要、物理学论文

patterns.name: 一般改进或打击行动的表达
patterns.trigger: “improvement« of» these systems”“crack«down»« on» scareware scammers”
patterns.context: 激活落在涉及改进对象或打击对象的表达中；上下文并非学术论文的章节或结果介绍。

patterns.name: 未见统一触发条件的学术句式
patterns.trigger: «of»出现在“paper”“organized as follows”“on a … type”“extension of …”等附近
patterns.context: 论文结构介绍、数学不等式描述、定理推广等句式中均有激活，但仅凭片段无法确定共同的细粒度语义条件。

en.description: Activations primarily occur on “on/of” introducing a related object in noun phrases, especially “X on Y” and “X of Y”; other local activations include quotation marks, line breaks, section headings, within-word fragments, abstract labels, and sporadic academic vocabulary.

patterns.name: On at a phrase boundary
patterns.context: Appears after a verb or noun phrase, introducing an object, topic, or scope, as in “crackdown on scareware scammers,” “limit on the mass,” and “take on the problem.”

patterns.name: Of in noun phrases
patterns.context: Of follows a noun or quantity expression, connecting possession, content, property, or part and whole, as in “Review of,” “inequality of,” “renewal of,” “variation of,” “adjustment of,” and “one of.”
patterns.domain: Academic papers, project abstracts, technical text

patterns.name: Quotations and discourse markers
patterns.context: Quotation marks, sentence-final punctuation, and line breaks are marked; answer labels in Q&A also appear. The trigger may relate to boundary/format tokens, but its exact function is unclear.

patterns.name: Review in a title
patterns.context: In the section title “ A Short Review of Some Previous Results,” Review and the adjacent space and of are all activated; this may be a local pattern for titles or a specific phrase.

patterns.name: Technical nouns and compound fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on within-word fragments of scareware/scammers and LLVM, with insufficient evidence to confirm whether they relate to other patterns.

patterns.name: Proper-name or abbreviation fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across character fragments of ABSTRACT at the beginning of an abstract, possibly reflecting an all-caps abstract label or subword segmentation.

patterns.name: Quantity/project identifier
patterns.context: The numeral 2 is marked in “Project 2 of this Program Project”; this is a single instance, so it is unclear whether the trigger is the identifier itself or the local format.

patterns.name: Unclear local lexical activations
patterns.context: These words are activated individually in their respective contexts, with no salient shared semantics or stable syntactic conditions.

4_2407.description: 主要激活于名词短语中引出关联对象的“on/of”，尤其是“X on Y”和“X of Y”；另有引号、换行、章节标题、词内片段、摘要标签及零散学术词汇的局部激活。

patterns.name: 短语边界处的 on
patterns.context: 出现在动词或名词短语之后，引出对象、主题或作用范围，如“crackdown on scareware scammers”“limit on the mass”“take on the problem”。

patterns.name: 名词短语中的 of
patterns.context: of 位于名词或数量表达之后，连接所属、内容、性质或部分与整体，如“Review of”“inequality of”“renewal of”“variation of”“adjustment of”“one of”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、项目摘要、技术文本

patterns.name: 引述与篇章标记
patterns.context: 引号、句末标点和换行处被标记；也出现在问答中的回答标签。触发或许与边界/格式 token 有关，具体作用不明。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Review
patterns.context: 章节标题“ A Short Review of Some Previous Results”中，Review 及相邻空格和 of 均有激活；可能是标题或特定短语的局部模式。

patterns.name: 技术名词及复合词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 scareware/scammers 及 LLVM 的词内片段上，缺少足够证据确认是否与其他模式相关。
patterns.domain: 反诈骗新闻、软件技术讨论

patterns.name: 专名或缩写片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在摘要开头的 ABSTRACT 字符片段上，可能反映全大写摘要标签或子词切分。

patterns.name: 数量/项目编号
patterns.context: 在“Project 2 of this Program Project”中，数字2被标记；仅单例，无法确定是编号本身还是局部格式所致。

patterns.name: 不明的局部词汇激活
patterns.context: 这些词在各自语境中单独激活，没有显著共同语义或稳定句法条件。

en.description: The most prominent activations are on of and on in noun-following prepositional phrases, as well as crackdown on in news; there are also paper-structure terms, patent processes and adjustment terminology, music reviews, and expressions of opinion. Passages also contain scattered function words and noisy text, which cannot be reduced to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: of in prepositional phrases
patterns.context: Activates after a noun or noun phrase when followed by a nominal element, as in “Review of Some Previous Results,” “improvement of these systems,” “extension of Theorem,” and “version of 'Earthquake'.”

patterns.name: on in prepositional phrases
patterns.context: The preposition on introduces an object, topic, medium, or affected party, as in “intensity of light emitted…（上下文中的…）,” “take on 'Nothing…',” “take on this,” and “crackdown on media outlets.”

patterns.name: to expressing direction or purpose
patterns.context: to introduces an infinitive or directional element; however, [4] is clearly garbled, so the triggering context is unstable.

patterns.name: Method- or process-related terms
patterns.context: Patent background describes the processing of partitioned objects and resource costs.

patterns.name: Structural expressions in organized academic articles
patterns.context: Table of contents or section organization, review of prior work, and introduction of what follows.

patterns.name: Common words in disjointed web text
patterns.context: Words are embedded in semantically incoherent, possibly concatenated or noisy text, making a consistent semantic trigger difficult to identify.

patterns.name: crackdown in fraud and law-enforcement reporting
patterns.context: crackdown combines with on in a fixed phrase reporting law enforcement or government pressure; [1] also includes a phone-scam quote.

patterns.name: LED adjustment context
patterns.context: A patent describes adjustment of the reference channel and LED light intensity.

patterns.name: Evaluation or interpretation in music reviews
patterns.context: Reviews a band, song version, and evaluation or interpretation of a work.

patterns.name: take on expressing an opinion
patterns.context: The colloquial expression “a take on this” introduces a view of an event.

patterns.name: Government response to an inquiry and measures
patterns.context: “response to a parliamentary inquiry” introduces a government response and subsequent measures.

patterns.name: General of/for collocations
patterns.context: The relative-clause structure “the fastest growing φ for which…” in a math paper, as well as “extension of Theorem.”

patterns.name: General weak function words and collocations
patterns.context: Noun phrases and surrounding prepositions, articles, or function words in different genres; these sporadic triggers are insufficient to identify a narrower shared semantic pattern.

4_2407.description: 激活最突出的是名词后介词短语中的 of、on，以及新闻中的 crackdown on；另见论文结构词、专利过程与调节术语、音乐评论和观点表达。各段还夹杂零散功能词及噪声文本，无法归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 介词短语中的 of
patterns.context: 在名词或名词短语之后、后接名词性成分时激活，如“Review of Some Previous Results”“improvement of these systems”“extension of Theorem”“version of 'Earthquake'”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利、音乐评论

patterns.name: 介词短语中的 on
patterns.context: 介词 on 引出对象、主题、媒介或受影响者，如“intensity of light emitted…（上下文中的…）”“take on 'Nothing…'”“take on this”“crackdown on media outlets”。
patterns.domain: 专利、评论、论坛讨论、新闻

patterns.name: 方向或目的的 to
patterns.context: to 引出动词不定式或方向性成分；但[4]语句明显杂乱，触发语境不稳定。

patterns.name: 方法或过程相关词
patterns.context: 专利背景中描述被划分对象的处理及资源成本。

patterns.name: 组织化学术文章的结构表达
patterns.context: 论文目录或章节安排、回顾先行工作及介绍后续内容。

patterns.name: 散乱网页文本中的常见词
patterns.context: 词语嵌在语义不连贯、疑似拼接或噪声文本中，难以确定一致的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 诈骗及执法报道中的 crackdown
patterns.context: crackdown 与 on 构成固定搭配，报道执法或政府施压；[1]还出现电话诈骗引语。

patterns.name: LED 调节语境
patterns.context: 专利说明参考通道及 LED 光强的调节。

patterns.name: 音乐评论中的评价或解读
patterns.context: 评论乐队、歌曲版本及对作品的评价或诠释。

patterns.name: 意见或评价的 take on
patterns.context: 口语化表达“a take on this”，引出对事件的看法。

patterns.name: 政府回应调查及措施
patterns.context: “response to a parliamentary inquiry”引出政府回应及后续措施。

patterns.name: 通用的 of/for 搭配
patterns.context: 数学论文中“the fastest growing φ for which…”的关系从句结构，另有“extension of Theorem”。

patterns.name: 通用的弱功能词及搭配
patterns.context: 不同文体中名词短语及其周围的介词、冠词或功能词；这些零散触发不足以归成更窄的共同语义模式。

en.description: Activations often fall on English relational words such as on, of, and to and on word-final s, and also occur on within-word Spanish fragments; sporadic formatting triggers include quotation marks, titles, punctuation, and abstract fields, while triggers in corrupted text are difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Preposition on and following noun phrase
patterns.context: On is followed by a noun phrase denoting a discussion subject, constraint, or issue; activations mostly fall on on, occasionally extending to adjacent words.

patterns.name: Relational word of
patterns.context: Of connects a noun to its possessor, content, or modifier; it appears in titles and ordinary noun phrases.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and general explanatory text

patterns.name: Preposition to and its collocations
patterns.context: To appears in infinitives or prepositional phrases; its collocations and meanings differ across corpora.
patterns.domain: Forums, academic papers, noisy or corrupted text

patterns.name: English plural or third-person suffix s
patterns.context: Activations fall on the word-final s subword in plural nouns or verb forms, rather than on fixed vocabulary.

patterns.name: Within-word Spanish fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal subword fragments of Spanish words; no clear syntactic environment matching the English trigger patterns is apparent.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in corrupted text
patterns.context: Fragments occur in text with incoherent semantics and spelling, making stable syntactic or semantic conditions difficult to identify.
patterns.domain: Apparently corrupted, concatenated, or noisy text

patterns.name: Quotation marks and question punctuation
patterns.context: Activations fall on quotation marks and question marks in a quoted scam conversation; this does not recur in other paragraphs.

patterns.name: Titles and structural markers
patterns.context: Activations occur near section numbering, whitespace, or Markdown heading markers.

patterns.name: Colon and line break
patterns.context: Activations fall on the colon and adjacent line break in Q&A text.

patterns.name: AB/CT fragments in abstract fields
patterns.context: Activations occur on the initial and final subword fragments of ABSTRACT, followed by the abstract text.

4_2407.description: 激活常落在英语 on、of、to 等关系词及 s 词尾上，也见于西班牙语词内片段；另有引号、标题、标点和摘要字段等零散格式触发，损坏文本中的触发难以解释。

patterns.name: 介词 on 与后续名词短语
patterns.trigger: «on»，常见于“on scareware scammers”“limit on the mass”“take on the problem”等
patterns.context: on 后接讨论对象、限制或问题等名词短语；激活多落在 on，偶尔扩展到相邻词。
patterns.domain: 新闻、学术论文、问答文本

patterns.name: 关系词 of
patterns.trigger: «of»，包括“of Some Previous Results”“of the second Higgs particle”等
patterns.context: of 连接名词与其所属、内容或限定成分；出现于标题和普通名词短语中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及一般说明文本

patterns.name: 介词 to 及其搭配
patterns.trigger: «to»，如“to add”“to the effective potential”“to an Brow… in an various craft”
patterns.context: to 出现在不定式或介词短语中；不同语料中搭配和含义并不相同。
patterns.domain: 论坛、学术论文、噪声或损坏文本

patterns.name: 英语复数或第三人称词尾 s
patterns.context: 激活落在词尾 s 子词上，涉及复数名词或动词形式，而非固定词汇。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在西班牙语词语的内部子词片段；未见明显与英语触发模式相同的句法环境。

patterns.name: 破损文本中的词内片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在语义和拼写不连贯的文本中，难以归结为稳定句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 疑似损坏、拼接或噪声文本

patterns.name: 引号及问句标点
patterns.context: 激活落在诈骗对话的引号和问号标点上，未在其他段落重复出现。

patterns.name: 标题及结构标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在章节编号、空白字符或 Markdown 标题标记附近。

patterns.name: 冒号与换行
patterns.context: 激活落在问答文本中的冒号和紧邻换行处。

patterns.name: 摘要字段内的 AB/CT 片段
patterns.context: 激活分别出现在 ABSTRACT 的首尾子词片段，之后接摘要正文。

en.concept: English function words and phrase boundaries
en.description: Activations are dominated by the English prepositions of and for, often in academic or formal noun phrases; there are also sporadic responses to on, at, line breaks, and title formatting. Additional markers occur on discrete vocabulary items without a unified explanation.

patterns.name: Preposition for
patterns.context: Appears in academic text to connect research objects, purposes, relations, or modifiers; sometimes adjacent to mathematical or statistical terms. In passage 9, the marker is only the initial «F», which may correspond to the first letter of fertility.
patterns.domain: Math, physics, and biomedical papers; occasionally other texts

patterns.name: Preposition of
patterns.context: Occurs frequently in noun phrases, connecting concepts, possession, composition, or categories; activation often falls at phrase-structural boundaries, especially in paper titles, terminology, and formal descriptions.
patterns.domain: Papers, technical descriptions, titles, and general formal text

patterns.name: Preposition on
patterns.context: Appears in continuous English phrases to indicate an object, topic, or locative relation; passage 1 uses “crackdown on,” and passage 2 uses “on our way.”

patterns.name: Preposition at
patterns.context: Introduces a location, followed by Fort Hood.

patterns.name: Paragraph and heading structure markers
patterns.context: Appear near template descriptions or section headings; these may be formatting tokens rather than semantic word triggers.

patterns.name: Diverse and hard-to-connect vocabulary
patterns.context: These markers occur in different syntactic positions and show no stable shared semantics or contextual conditions; some may simply co-occur with prepositions or heading structures.
patterns.domain: News, garbled text, technical and academic text, general narrative

4_2407.concept: 英语功能词及短语边界
4_2407.description: 激活以英语介词 of 和 for 为主，常见于学术或正式名词短语；也零星响应 on、at 及换行、标题格式。另有多处离散词汇标记，缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: 介词 for
patterns.context: 出现在学术文本中，连接研究对象、目的、关系或修饰成分；有时紧邻数学或统计术语。第9段的标记仅为词首 «F»，可能对应 fertility 的首字母。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、生物医学论文；偶见其他文本

patterns.name: 介词 of
patterns.context: 大量出现在名词短语中，连接概念、所属、组成或类别；触发位置常位于短语结构边界，尤其在论文标题、术语和正式说明中。
patterns.domain: 论文、技术说明、标题及一般正式文本

patterns.name: 介词 on
patterns.context: 出现在连续的英语短语中，表示对象、主题或位置关系；第1段用于“crackdown on”，第2段用于“on our way”。

patterns.name: 介词 at
patterns.context: 引出地点，后接 Fort Hood。

patterns.name: 段落与标题结构标记
patterns.context: 出现在模板说明或章节标题附近；这些可能是格式 token，而非语义词触发。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、学术论文排版

patterns.name: 多样且难以连贯的词汇
patterns.context: 这些标记分布于不同句法位置，彼此未显示稳定的共同语义或上下文条件；部分可能只是与介词或标题结构共现。
patterns.domain: 新闻、乱码式文本、技术与学术文本、一般叙述

en.description: Activates primarily when “study” denotes a research activity in NIH research applications; it also activates on the fixed phrase “basis” in business emails, “them both” in personal narratives, and “cell” in two biomedical contexts. See also statements about the prospects of immunotherapy.

patterns.name: “study” in research proposals
patterns.context: Statements of research plans or aims; “study” denotes a research activity in the sentence.

patterns.name: Phrase-final use of “basis”
patterns.context: Appears at the end of a sentence or phrase in a fixed expression; preceding text may discuss fee calculations or scheduling rules.

patterns.name: “both” and emotional expression
patterns.context: The speaker expresses affection for both and mentions sadness as a father.

patterns.name: Red blood cells and deformability
patterns.context: Discusses red blood cell deformability and blood rheology.

patterns.name: Vascular smooth muscle cells
patterns.context: Introduces vascular smooth muscle cells and their function.

patterns.name: Unexplained research-abstract wording
patterns.context: Discusses the prospects and rationale for cancer immunotherapy; the “study” wording from the research-proposal sentences above is absent.

4_2552.description: 主要在NIH研究申请中“study”作为研究活动出现时激活；另对商务邮件固定短语“basis”、个人叙述“them both”及两种生物医学语境中的“cell”激活。另见免疫治疗前景表述。

patterns.name: 研究方案中的“study”
patterns.context: 研究计划或目标的陈述；“study”在句中作为研究活动出现。

patterns.name: “basis”结尾用法
patterns.context: 在固定短语中作为句尾或短语结尾出现；前文可涉及费用计算或安排规则。

patterns.name: “both”及情感表达
patterns.context: 说话者表达对两者的喜爱，并提及作为父亲的悲伤。

patterns.name: 红细胞与变形能力
patterns.context: 讨论红细胞的变形能力及血液流变学。

patterns.name: 血管平滑肌细胞
patterns.context: 介绍血管平滑肌细胞及其功能。

patterns.name: 未解释的研究摘要措辞
patterns.context: 讨论癌症免疫治疗的前景与依据；未见上述研究方案句式中的“study”。

en.description: The strongest shared pattern is study in research-plan contexts, especially phrases such as “The proposed study”; it also activates on distinct terms such as both, cell, and basis, and their local collocations.

patterns.name: study in research proposals
patterns.context: In NIH research-plan abstracts, appears in expressions such as “The proposal/proposed study…” or “The proposed research is planned to study…”

patterns.name: proposal / study in introductory sentences
patterns.context: The sentence begins with “The proposal” or “The proposed study” to introduce research content; adjacent to the main pattern, though study is not always strongly activated

patterns.name: Emotional expression involving both
patterns.context: “I love them both” is followed by a statement that the father is saddened by both

patterns.name: Term for red blood cell deformability
patterns.context: In medical abstracts, refers to red blood cell deformability and related hemorheology

patterns.name: Basis for commercial electricity costs
patterns.context: In “On that basis,” following calculations of electricity prices and power costs

patterns.name: Booking principle in commercial aviation
patterns.context: In “first come, first served basis,” describing aircraft use or booking rules

patterns.name: Vascular smooth muscle cell terminology
patterns.context: A cell-type name appears in biomedical text

4_2552.description: 最强共同模式是研究计划语境中的 study，尤其是“The proposed study”等句式；此外还激活于 both、cell 和 basis 等彼此不同的词项及其局部搭配。

patterns.name: 研究方案中 study 的启动
patterns.context: 在 NIH 研究计划摘要中，出现在“The proposal/proposed study…”或“The proposed research is planned to study…”一类表述里
patterns.domain: NIH 资助申请、研究计划

patterns.name: 基础句式中的 proposal / study
patterns.context: 句首以“The proposal”或“The proposed study”引入研究内容；与主模式相邻，但 study 并非都标记为强激活
patterns.domain: NIH 资助申请、研究计划

patterns.name: 两者兼具的情感表达
patterns.context: “I love them both”之后接父亲因两者而悲伤的表述

patterns.name: 红细胞变形能力术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要里，指红细胞的变形能力及相关血液流变学

patterns.name: 商业电力成本的依据
patterns.context: 在“On that basis”中承接电价与电力成本的计算

patterns.name: 商业航空的预订原则
patterns.context: 在“first come, first served basis”中，描述飞机使用或预订规则

patterns.name: 血管平滑肌细胞术语
patterns.context: 生物医学文本中出现细胞类型名称

en.concept: Mixed triggers from common terms and domain-specific terms
en.description: Activation is concentrated on study in NIH research plans, basis in emails, and cell in biomedical text; there are also two isolated cases, promise and state. No single semantic or syntactic trigger is consistent across passages.

patterns.name: study in research plans
patterns.context: Appears in statements of aims or research content in NIH research plans, often in collocations such as “to study” or “proposed study”; [1]–[4] all contain “study,” with the strongest trigger tokens in [3] and [4].

patterns.name: basis and its collocations
patterns.context: Appears in phrases stating a rationale, condition, or computational basis; [5] has “On that basis,” [8] has “basis,” and [9] has “on that basis.”

patterns.name: Cell-related terms
patterns.context: Cell terms appear in biomedical terminology; [6] has “Red cell,” and [7] has “muscle cell.”

patterns.name: promise
patterns.context: “promise” appears in a statement about the potential of cancer immunotherapy; no matching trigger is observed outside this passage.

patterns.name: state
patterns.context: Appears in the compound term “solid-state fermentation,” modifying the fermentation method; no matching trigger is observed outside this passage.

4_2552.concept: 常见词项与领域词的混合触发
4_2552.description: 激活集中在 NIH 研究计划中的 study、邮件里的 basis，以及生物医学文本中的 cell；另有 promise 和 state 两个孤例。跨段没有一致的单一语义或句法触发。

patterns.name: 研究计划中的 study
patterns.context: 出现在 NIH 研究计划的目的或研究内容表述中，常见搭配是 “to study” 或 “proposed study”；[1]–[4] 均有 “study”，而 [3]、[4] 的触发 token 最强。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、研究计划

patterns.name: basis 及其搭配
patterns.context: 出现在说明依据、条件或计算基础的短语中；[5] 为 “On that basis”，[8] 为 “basis”，[9] 为 “on that basis”。

patterns.name: 细胞相关词语
patterns.context: 细胞词语出现在生物医学术语中；[6] 为 “Red cell”，[7] 为 “muscle cell”。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 研究摘要

patterns.name: promise
patterns.context: “promise” 位于关于癌症免疫疗法潜力的陈述中；除该段外未见相同触发。

patterns.name: state
patterns.context: 出现在 “solid-state fermentation” 这一复合术语中，修饰发酵方式；除该段外未见相同触发。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、微生物与发酵

en.concept: High-frequency word triggers in research text
en.description: Activation is concentrated on study in research-plan contexts and cell in biomedical contexts; promise and state in solid-state also show high activation, without a confirmed shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: study in research plans
patterns.context: Appears in statements of research plans or aims, often in structures such as “The proposed study …” or “To study …”; activation centers on the word study.

patterns.name: Cells and cell-related terms
patterns.context: Appears in cell and biomedical research contexts; activation falls on cell, either as a word or as a component of a compound.

patterns.name: Specific high-activation words or phrases
patterns.context: Appear respectively in an evaluative sentence about cancer immunotherapy and in a paper title about solid-state fermentation of pectinase; beyond the words themselves, no shared context is apparent.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research projects; microbiology paper abstracts

4_2552.concept: 研究文本中的高频词触发
4_2552.description: 激活主要落在研究计划语境的 study，以及生物医学语境中的 cell；另有 promise 和 solid-state 中的 state 两处高激活，缺少可确认的共同语义模式。

patterns.name: 研究计划中的 study
patterns.context: 出现在研究计划或目标的陈述中，常见结构为“The proposed study …”或“To study …”；触发点集中在 study 一词。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 的研究项目摘要

patterns.name: 细胞及细胞相关术语
patterns.context: 出现在细胞、生物医学研究语境中；激活落在 cell 上，或落在其组成词 cell 上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与项目描述

patterns.name: 特定高频词或短语
patterns.context: 分别出现在癌症免疫治疗的评价性句子、果胶酶固态发酵的论文题名中；除词面触发外，看不出共同语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究项目；微生物学论文摘要

en.concept: Formal text introducing a topic at the beginning of a sentence
en.description: Primarily responds to formal research-abstract phrasing beginning with “The study” or “The proposed study,” covering research goals, plans, and biomedical topics; also appears at the beginnings of academic abstracts, Wikipedia titles, and proper names in emails.

patterns.name: Research or project statements
patterns.context: A sentence begins with The followed by study/proposal, then describes research goals, plans, or questions to be tested; “study” is especially prominent.

patterns.name: Introducing a research topic with study of
patterns.context: A fixed sentence-initial structure is followed by a research subject or field; topics include human chromosomes, self-tolerance, and MHC restriction.

patterns.name: Other academic abstract openings
patterns.context: A sentence begins with The introducing a statement, followed by an academic topic and explanatory content, but without the study construction above.

patterns.name: Entry titles and name-initial text
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of proper names, accompanied by line breaks in entry titles or the beginnings of email bodies; differs from the research-abstract pattern.

4_2552.concept: 正式文本的句首主题引入
4_2552.description: 主要响应以“The study”或“The proposed study”开头的正式研究摘要措辞，涵盖研究目标、计划及生物医学主题；另见学术摘要开头，以及维基百科标题和邮件中的专名开头。

patterns.name: 研究或课题表述
patterns.trigger: “The proposed study”“The proposal is to study”“The study proposed to determine”
patterns.context: 句首以 The 引出 study/proposal，随后说明研究目标、计划或待检验的问题；“study”尤其显著。

patterns.name: 以 study of 引入研究主题
patterns.context: 句首固定结构后接研究对象或领域；主题包括人类染色体、自身耐受和 MHC 限制。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文或研究计划

patterns.name: 其他学术摘要开头
patterns.trigger: “The promise of cancer immunotherapy is based upon”
patterns.context: 句首用 The 引出陈述，接学术性主题与解释性内容，但不含上述 study 固定结构。

patterns.name: 条目标题及人名开头
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的专名 token 上，并伴随条目标题换行或邮件正文开头；与研究摘要模式不同。
patterns.domain: 维基百科条目、电子邮件

en.concept: Biomedical cell vocabulary with sporadic triggers
en.description: Primarily responds to cell and vascular terminology in biomedical contexts, especially sentence-initial medical statements; additional sporadic triggers include cancer immunotherapy, ApoE genetics, ethical argumentation, expressions of sadness, code error messages, and political proper nouns.

patterns.name: cell in cell names
patterns.context: cell appears in cell types or biomedical terms, often with nearby modifiers; paragraph 10 contains “Red cell deformability”.

patterns.name: Vascular terminology
patterns.context: Technical descriptions of blood vessels, vessel walls, and their cells; some trigger words are split into subword fragments.

patterns.name: The as an article
patterns.context: Begins a sentence with The; seen in several paper-like statements, but cell is not prominent in every paragraph containing The.
patterns.domain: Medical papers and general expository prose

patterns.name: Subword cell in technical terms
patterns.context: cell appears as a complete word or as part of a technical compound, not limited to vascular cells.

patterns.name: Immunotherapy and cancer
patterns.context: Statements about cancer immunotherapy; activation also falls on the initial “The” and several subsequent common words. This differs from the cell pattern.

patterns.name: Specific genetic variant name
patterns.context: Mentions the E4 allele of ApoE at the beginning of an incomplete sentence.

patterns.name: basis in ethical argumentation
patterns.context: Discusses utilitarianism, sentience-based positions, and environmental concern; basis means grounds or foundation.

patterns.name: Emotion word sad
