patterns.context: A father talks about his love for two people and his sadness about the current situation.

patterns.name: Permission term in a Thai error message
patterns.context: Code maps a database error to a Thai message; activation includes an English error identifier and Thai character fragments.
patterns.domain: Software code, error handling, and Thai localization

patterns.name: Proper noun Obamacons
patterns.context: The short title or phrase “The rise of the Obamacons”, followed by a line break and a new sentence.
patterns.domain: Political commentary or general article title

4_2552.concept: 生物医学细胞词汇，兼有零散触发
4_2552.description: 主要对生物医学语境中的 cell 及血管相关术语反应，尤其是句首医学陈述；另有癌症免疫治疗、ApoE遗传学、伦理论证、悲伤表达、代码错误消息和政治专名等零散触发。

patterns.name: 细胞名称中的 cell
patterns.context: cell 出现在细胞类型或生物医学术语中，附近常有修饰语；第10段为“Red cell deformability”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、血管与血液学

patterns.name: 血管相关术语
patterns.context: 关于血管、血管壁及其细胞的专业描述；部分触发词被切分为子词。

patterns.name: 冠词 The
patterns.context: 句首以 The 开始；见于若干论文式陈述，但不是所有含 The 的段落都突出 cell。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及一般说明文

patterns.name: 专业词中的子词 cell
patterns.context: cell 作为完整词或专业复合术语组成部分出现，不限于血管相关细胞。

patterns.name: 免疫治疗与癌症
patterns.context: 癌症免疫治疗的陈述，触发也落在句首“The”及后续多个普通词上；与 cell 模式不同。

patterns.name: 特定遗传变体名称
patterns.context: 提及 ApoE 的 E4 等位基因，位于未完句的开头。

patterns.name: 伦理论证中的 basis
patterns.context: 讨论效用主义、感知能力立场与环境关怀，basis 表示论据或基础。

patterns.name: 情绪词 sad
patterns.context: 父亲谈及对两人的爱及在当前处境中的悲伤。

patterns.name: 泰语错误消息中的权限词
patterns.context: 代码映射数据库错误到泰语消息；激活包括英文错误标识和泰语字符片段。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、错误处理与泰语本地化

patterns.name: 专名 Obamacons
patterns.context: 短标题或短语“The rise of the Obamacons”，随后换行并开始新句。
patterns.domain: 政治评论或一般文章标题

en.concept: Academic paper structure markers and proper-noun fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to the Introduction heading/anchor “intro” and its section formatting; it also responds to front-matter bibliographic metadata and LaTeX math markup. Other triggers include proper-name fragments such as CAPRISA and medical E4, as well as title words from quantum physics and astrophysics.

patterns.name: Introduction heading anchor
patterns.context: The Introduction section heading in academic documents and its Markdown-style underline; the heading anchor contains intro.

patterns.name: Academic bibliographic metadata and reference fields
patterns.context: Front-matter metadata or bibliography entries, often adjacent to the title and section text.
patterns.domain: ArXiv documents and YAML/Markdown-style front matter

patterns.name: Annotations and environment syntax in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: LaTeX formulas, norms, inequalities, and section labels in mathematical papers or proofs.

patterns.name: High response to the intro section anchor
patterns.context: Appears as part of a sec:... anchor or equation label; this substring repeatedly triggers across multiple paper excerpts.

patterns.name: Letter sequence in the name CAPRISA
patterns.context: Proper-name abbreviation for a clinical trials unit within an organization’s full name.

patterns.name: T letter and split medical terms
patterns.context: Disease names AIDS/Tuberculosis appear together, with words split into subword tokens.

patterns.name: APOE allele name
patterns.context: E4 denotes an ApoE gene variant, followed by allele and protein names.

patterns.name: Quantum reactivity title phrase
patterns.context: Quantum Reactivity appears in a paper’s title metadata, near terms such as many-body states.

patterns.name: Netzer and AGN astrophysics title
patterns.context: A bibliographic paper title and its abstract-like title wording about active galactic nuclei and dust.

4_2552.concept: 学术论文结构标记与专名片段
4_2552.description: 主要响应论文 Introduction 标题/锚点“intro”及其章节格式，也响应论文前置书目元数据和 LaTeX 数学标记；另有 CAPRISA、医学 E4 等专名片段及量子、天体物理标题词。

patterns.name: Introduction 标题锚点
patterns.context: 学术文档中 Introduction 章节标题及其 Markdown 风格下划线；标题锚点含 intro。

patterns.name: 学术文献元数据与书目字段
patterns.context: 论文前置元数据区或书目文件条目，常紧邻标题与章节正文。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文档、YAML/Markdown 风格前置区

patterns.name: 数学公式中的标注与环境语法
patterns.context: 数学论文正文或证明中出现 LaTeX 公式、范数、不等式及章节标签。

patterns.name: 章节锚点 intro 的高响应
patterns.context: 作为 sec:... 锚点或公式标签的一部分出现；该子串在多个论文片段中反复触发。
patterns.domain: 学术论文交叉引用与章节标记

patterns.name: CAPRISA 名称中的字母序列
patterns.context: 机构全称中临床试验单位的专名缩写。

patterns.name: T 字母及医学词拆分
patterns.context: AIDS/Tuberculosis 并列疾病名称中，词被分成子词 token。
patterns.domain: NIH 医学研究机构名称

patterns.name: APOE 等位基因名称
patterns.context: 以 E4 指称 ApoE 基因变体，后接 allele 与蛋白名称。

patterns.name: 量子反应性标题短语
patterns.context: 论文元数据标题中出现 Quantum Reactivity，附近有多体态等术语。

patterns.name: Netzer 与 AGN 天体物理标题
patterns.context: 论文书目标题及其关于活动星系核、尘埃的摘要式标题语句。

en.description: Activation occurs in various proper nouns, identifiers, and structured strings: percentages, monetary amounts, legal risk terms, mathematical terminology and formulas, and class paths and constants in code. Movie names and biographical names and dates also appear. The excerpts have no clear unified semantics.

patterns.name: Percentage statistics
patterns.context: Percentages occur near discussion of website traffic statistics; numbers, percent signs, and surrounding metric expressions may trigger together.

patterns.name: Legal disclaimers and risk wording
patterns.context: Website terms or disclaimers describe liability and risks that may result from using information or trading products.

patterns.name: Ideals and set notation in mathematics
patterns.context: Discusses ideals satisfying the Fubini property and mathematical examples, alongside LaTeX notation.

patterns.name: Monetary amounts and monthly pricing
patterns.context: A dollar amount is followed by a per-month pricing expression; truncated context leaves the specific item unclear.

patterns.name: Component and object class names
patterns.context: Explains when to use a class and compares class names in a framework; activation centers on namespace fragments in class names.

patterns.name: PHP framework namespace code
patterns.context: A PHP controller implementation example contains namespaces, class names, and backslash separators.

patterns.name: Film figures’ names and work descriptions
patterns.context: In a film description, directors’, actors’, and characters’ names appear as proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Film reviews or film reference text

patterns.name: Operating-system constant identifiers
patterns.context: Go code lists address-family constants from the syscall package and their hexadecimal values.

patterns.name: Names and birth/death dates
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry opens with a name, followed by a birth date in parentheses.

patterns.name: PHP class paths and model documentation
patterns.context: Laravel-style class names, interface paths, and return-type comments appear in code documentation.

4_2552.description: 激活出现在多种专名、标识符和结构化字符串中：百分比、金额、法律风险词、数学术语与公式，以及代码中的类路径、常量；另见电影姓名和人物传记姓名日期。各段缺少统一的明确语义。

patterns.name: 百分比统计指标
patterns.context: 百分比紧邻网站流量统计的讨论；数字、百分号及其周围的指标表达可能共同触发。

patterns.name: 法律免责声明与风险措辞
patterns.context: 网站条款或免责声明中，说明使用信息、交易产品可能带来的责任和风险。
patterns.domain: 金融交易网站法律文本

patterns.name: 数学中的理想与集合记号
patterns.context: 讨论满足 Fubini 性质的理想及其数学例子，伴随 LaTeX 数学符号。

patterns.name: 金额和月度计价
patterns.context: 美元金额后接按月计价表达；截断上下文使具体对象不明。

patterns.name: 组件与对象类名
patterns.context: 说明何时使用某个类，并比较框架中的类名；激活集中于类名中的命名空间片段。

patterns.name: PHP框架命名空间代码
patterns.context: PHP控制器实现示例中，出现命名空间、类名及反斜线分隔符。

patterns.name: 影视人物姓名与作品介绍
patterns.context: 电影介绍中，导演、演员和角色姓名以专名形式出现。

patterns.name: 操作系统常量标识符
patterns.context: Go代码中，列举 syscall 包的地址族常量及其十六进制值。

patterns.name: 人名与生卒日期
patterns.context: 百科条目以姓名开篇，随后给出括号中的出生日期。

patterns.name: PHP类路径与模型文档
patterns.context: Laravel风格的类名、接口路径和返回类型注释出现在代码文档中。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on uppercase BI and the word-initial fragment Municip-, and also appears in uppercase block formatting, line-break whitespace, and email-header numbers. These forms are spread across different domains and cannot be explained by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: BI subword
patterns.context: BI appears as an independent uppercase abbreviation or word-initial fragment; its meaning varies by context and may refer to BI in research or business, or be part of a word tokenized into subwords.
patterns.domain: Medical research, business emails, online discussions, etc.

patterns.name: Municipalities subword
patterns.context: Municip- is the initial substring of municipalities or municipality, appearing in place names, organizations, and discussions of municipal services.

patterns.name: Uppercase block-formatted text
patterns.context: Uppercase words are split into multiple tokens; there is no clear shared lexical trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Historical book headings, academic conference notices

patterns.name: Line-break or whitespace formatting
patterns.context: Weak activation appears near blank lines, indentation, or line breaks; other patterns co-occur in several excerpts, making its independence hard to determine.

patterns.name: Split numbers and formatted dates
patterns.context: Date and time numbers in email headers are split into tokens; seen only in this email-format excerpt.

4_2552.concept: 特定词首片段与排版形式
4_2552.description: 激活主要落在大写 BI 与 Municip- 词首片段，也见于大写分块排版、换行空白及邮件头数字；这些形式分散于不同领域，不能由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: BI 子词
patterns.context: BI 作为独立大写缩写或词首片段出现；含义随语境变化，可能指研究或商业中的 BI，也可能是被分词成子词的词的一部分。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、商业邮件、网络讨论等

patterns.name: Municipalities 子词
patterns.context: Municip- 作为 municipalities 或 municipality 的词首子串，出现在地名、机构及讨论市政服务的语境中。
patterns.domain: 新闻、邮件、百科、网络讨论

patterns.name: 大写分块的排版文本
patterns.context: 大写词被拆成多个 token；没有明显的共同词义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 历史书籍题头、学术会议通知

patterns.name: 换行或空白排版
patterns.context: 空行、缩进或换行附近出现较弱激活；在若干段中伴随其他模式，难以确定其独立性。
patterns.domain: 邮件、书籍排版、网页文本

patterns.name: 拆分数字与格式化日期
patterns.context: 邮件头中的日期和时间数字被拆分为 token；仅见于该邮件格式片段。

en.description: The strongest and recurring trigger is DEVELOPMENT in various capitalization and tokenization forms, often in ENRON_DEVELOPMENT email or organization identifiers, and also in body text and legal organization names. Sporadic activation also appears for Metropolitan, OP/DOT in addresses, ed in Forwarded, and email-format tokens.

patterns.name: DEVELOPMENT string
patterns.context: Any continuous spelling of DEVELOPMENT triggers, regardless of capitalization or tokenization; it may occur in an organization name, email address/username, ordinary body text, or a subject heading.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, emails and forwarded email headers, news/subject summaries, personal résumés

patterns.name: Tokenized spelling of METROPOLITAN
patterns.context: The organization name Metropolitan Development Commission in a court case title; it occurs with Development in an organization name, but activation primarily falls on the Development string.

patterns.name: Substring in COMOPAQ email address
patterns.context: OP appears in the COMOPAQ spelling between the email username and domain; this is an isolated local trigger, not a DEVELOPMENT string.

patterns.name: DOT tokenization in an address
patterns.context: DOT is split and marked in an anti-spam address format using square brackets; activation is weaker than the main DEVELOPMENT pattern.
patterns.domain: Email addresses in StackExchange support replies

patterns.name: ED tokenization in a forwarding marker
patterns.context: Forwarded in an email forwarding header is split into two tokens, with only ed marked; activation is weaker.

patterns.name: Introducer and header formatting
patterns.context: Line breaks and time fields near email headers or forwarding blocks show sporadic low-level activation; these positions are also adjacent to DEVELOPMENT email identifiers, so independent triggering cannot be confirmed.

4_2552.concept: DEVELOPMENT 字符串及邮件标识
4_2552.description: 最强且反复的触发是 DEVELOPMENT 的各种大小写与分词写法，常出现在 ENRON_DEVELOPMENT 邮箱/机构标识，也见正文及法律机构名。另有零星的 Metropolitan、地址中的 OP/DOT、Forwarded 的 ed 和邮件格式 token 激活。

patterns.name: DEVELOPMENT 字符串
patterns.context: 不论大小写和 token 切分，只要出现 DEVELOPMENT 的连续拼写；可处于机构名、邮箱/用户名、普通正文或主题标题中。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、邮件及邮件转发头、新闻/主题摘要、个人履历

patterns.name: METROPOLITAN 的分词拼写
patterns.context: 法庭案件标题中的机构名称 Metropolitan Development Commission；与 Development 同在机构名中，但神经元激活主要落在 Development 字符串上。

patterns.name: COMOPAQ 邮箱地址内的子串
patterns.context: 邮箱用户名和域名之间、COMOPAQ 拼写中出现 OP；这是孤立的局部触发，不是 DEVELOPMENT 字符串。

patterns.name: 地址中 DOT 的切分
patterns.context: 以方括号括住的反垃圾邮件地址写法中，DOT 被拆分并标记；强度低于 DEVELOPMENT 主模式。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 支持回复中的邮箱地址

patterns.name: ED 在转发标记中的切分
patterns.context: 邮件转发头的 Forwarded 被分成两个 token，只有 ed 被标记，强度较低。

patterns.name: 引导符及头部格式
patterns.context: 邮件头或转发块附近的换行、时间字段有零星低强度激活；这些位置同时邻接 DEVELOPMENT 邮箱标识，无法确认是独立触发。

en.description: Primarily responds to split word fragments beginning with uppercase PE in English, including PEake, PEARLS, PEACE, and PE Teacher; local activation also appears in Polish, numbers, Craft, and sporadic body words, which do not all fit a single rule.

patterns.name: PE English spelling fragments
patterns.context: Uppercase words are split into tokens; they appear in titles or occupational descriptions following names.

patterns.name: PEAK name spelling fragment
patterns.context: An uppercase name is split into multiple tokens, forming the surname PEake.

patterns.name: PEARL internal word fragment
patterns.context: In uppercase or title-style formatting, PE is followed by AR to form pearls; the word may also continue across a line break.

patterns.name: PEACE internal word fragment
patterns.context: The uppercase word PEACE in a chapter heading is split, preceded by LONG.

patterns.name: PEACE semantically related spelling
patterns.context: Uppercase PEACE is split in a sentence for emphasis; the following text describes the meaning of Islam as peace.

patterns.name: Shared prefix in PEAKE / PEARLS / PEACE
patterns.context: Activation centers on word fragments beginning with PE in uppercase English strings; the continuations and meanings vary.

patterns.name: Other letter fragments and split numbers
patterns.context: Stronger activation falls on an internal fragment of a Polish word or on historical contents-page numbers; neither has a clear correspondence to the PE fragments.

patterns.name: Token in the form Craft
patterns.context: Craft is marked on its own in the ordinary proper name Craft Arts; Craft Partners shows only weaker activation elsewhere.

patterns.name: Special word fragments and names
patterns.context: Fragment 1 also shows several sporadic activations without a consistent orthographic or semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Residual weak activations
patterns.context: Words or fragments scattered through general prose; available examples do not support a shared trigger condition.

4_2552.description: 主要响应大写英文中以 PE 开始的拆分词片段，涵盖 PEake、PEARLS、PEACE、PE Teacher；也有波兰语、数字、Craft 及零散正文词的局部激活，不能完全归入同一规则。

patterns.name: PE 英文拼写片段
patterns.context: 大写单词被拆分成 token；出现在标题或姓名后的职业说明中。
patterns.domain: 书籍标题、学校人员简介

patterns.name: PEAK 姓名拼写片段
patterns.context: 大写姓名被拆分为多个 token，构成姓氏 PEake。
patterns.domain: 电影宣传或人物署名文本

patterns.name: PEARL 词内片段
patterns.context: 大写或标题式排版中，PE 后续接 AR，组成 pearls；也可能跨行续接。

patterns.name: PEACE 词内片段
patterns.context: 章节标题中的大写单词 PEACE 被拆分，前接 LONG。

patterns.name: PEACE 语义相关拼写
patterns.context: 句中大写强调的 PEACE 被拆分，后文将 Islam 的含义说成 peace。
patterns.domain: 网络评论或政治宗教论述

patterns.name: PEAKE / PEARLS / PEACE 的共享前缀
patterns.context: 激活集中于大写英文串中以 PE 开始的词片段；具体后续词和含义不一。

patterns.name: 其他字母片段与数字拆分
patterns.context: 较强激活落在波兰语单词内部片段或历史目录数字上；与 PE 片段无明确对应。
patterns.domain: 欧盟立法文本、历史书籍目录

patterns.name: Craft 词形中的 token
patterns.context: 普通英文专名 Craft Arts 中，Craft 被单独标记；另处 Craft Partners 仅较弱激活。

patterns.name: 特殊词片段及姓名
patterns.context: 片段 1 还出现若干零散激活，未形成一致的词形或语义模式。
patterns.domain: 电影相关文本、人物署名

patterns.name: 余项弱激活
patterns.context: 一般正文中散在的词或词片段，难以从现有样例归纳为共同触发条件。

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: they include the Hungarian signature “szerző,” English started, code-formatting parameters, URL strings, musical performance, physical mass/z, the proof marker FIN, and the company name ILLINOIS; no shared semantics or stable syntactic conditions are evident.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in Hungarian speaker signatures
patterns.context: In European Parliament records, appears as part of a speaker signature, followed by a period and speech or a name; activation is distributed across tokenized subword fragments.

patterns.name: started in English narrative
patterns.context: Appears in an English prose sentence describing a celestial body beginning its cyclical motion again.

patterns.name: Numeric format output in code
patterns.context: Python code writes a number with a format string containing a precision parameter; the strongest trigger is z in the format specifier.

patterns.name: Technology product suffix in a URL
patterns.context: Appears in an ICO-related product/service string in a URL path, adjacent to hyphens and other URL fragments.

patterns.name: Ensemble performance in music terminology
patterns.context: Repeatedly appears in patent background descriptions discussing the effects of ensemble performance, musical passages, and timbre.

patterns.name: Particle-physics mass distribution
patterns.context: A figure caption describes the invariant-mass distribution of selected data samples.

patterns.name: z in theoretical physics formulas
patterns.context: Appears as a variable parameter in mathematical expressions for the partonic cross section.

patterns.name: Proof marker FIN
patterns.context: Appears among typesetting proof terms such as “CORRECTED,” “PROOF,” and “FINAL,” and is part of page-version/proof information.

patterns.name: ILLINOIS in a company name
patterns.context: Appears as part of an entity name in a list of company names, state names, and addresses.

4_2552.description: 激活模式分散：包括匈牙利语署名“szerző”、英文 started、代码格式参数、网址词串、音乐 performance、物理 mass/z、校样 FIN及公司名 ILLINOIS；未见共同语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语人名署名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 欧盟议会记录中，作为发言人署名的一部分，后接句点及发言内容或名字；激活分布在被拆分的子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 匈牙利语政治议会文本

patterns.name: 英文叙事中的 started
patterns.context: 出现在英文散文句中，描述星体重新开始其循环运动。

patterns.name: 代码中的数字格式化输出
patterns.context: Python 代码以格式字符串写出包含精度参数的数值；最强触发位于格式说明符中的 z。

patterns.name: 网址中的科技产品词尾
patterns.context: 出现在网址路径中的 ICO 相关产品/服务词串，邻接短横线及其他 URL 片段。

patterns.name: 音乐编曲术语 ensemble performance
patterns.context: 反复出现在讨论合奏表演效果、音乐段落与音色的专利背景描述中。

patterns.name: 粒子物理质量分布
patterns.context: 图注中描述所选数据样本的粒子不变质量分布。

patterns.name: 理论物理公式中的 z
patterns.context: 出现在 partonic cross section 的数学表达式中，作为变量参数。

patterns.name: 校样标记 FIN
patterns.context: 夹在“CORRECTED”“PROOF”“FINAL”等排版校样字样之间，属于页面版本/校样信息。

patterns.name: 公司名中的 ILLINOIS
patterns.context: 出现在公司名称、州名及地址式列表中，作为实体名称的一部分。

en.description: Activation is distributed across patent operation descriptions, mathematical physics formulas, corporate news and emails, literary quotations, and numeric records. No stable cross-domain lexical or syntactic trigger is evident; activation appears more tied to local words, symbols, and formatting in each excerpt.

patterns.name: Touch-operation descriptions in patents
patterns.context: Activation appears when describing fingers touching buttons, swipe gestures on touchscreens, and device structures; the specific words also include common function words.

patterns.name: Feed supply and mounting structures in patents
patterns.context: Patent sentences describe bag feeding and a rotary dispensing-spout mounting mechanism; “spout” is split into multiple fragments.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and variable formatting
patterns.context: The body of a mathematical paper introduces measures and variables, followed by a LaTeX math environment; activation covers formula symbols and some text.

patterns.name: Symbols and formatting in physics formulas
patterns.context: The body shifts to a formula for a partonic cross section, with variables, subscripts and superscripts, and an alignment environment in LaTeX.

patterns.name: Variables and special functions in formulas
patterns.context: Symbols, functions, and parentheses in a LaTeX formula; similar to the adjacent physics formula, but this is a separate formula excerpt.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical or theoretical physics papers

patterns.name: Corporate news headlines and workforce reductions
patterns.context: A news-style headline and body mention oil fields, a company, and workforce reductions in the UK; activation falls on proper nouns, topic words, and common words.

patterns.name: Repeated calls and celestial imagery in literary narration
patterns.context: The quotation repeatedly urges someone to continue, then shifts to narration describing celestial bodies resuming their eternal motion.

patterns.name: Email quoted header and amount
patterns.context: After confirming in the email body, a fee amount appears, followed by the quoted original email header and sender information.

patterns.name: Scheduling and signature in an email
patterns.context: An informal email discusses a purchase and Monday/Tuesday arrangements, followed by a signature; it also contains punctuation and word fragments.

patterns.name: Comma-separated ascending numeric records
patterns.context: Multiline comma-separated numeric records with roughly ascending values, with carriage returns and line feeds between lines.

4_2552.description: 激活分布于专利操作描述、数学物理公式、企业新闻与邮件、文学引语及数字记录；未见跨领域稳定的词义或句法触发，更多是各段局部词语、符号与格式。

patterns.name: 专利中的触摸操作表述
patterns.trigger: « touched»、« the»、« performed»、« within»、« operating region»、« provided»
patterns.context: 描述手指触碰按钮、触摸屏上的滑动操作及设备结构时激活；具体词语还包括常见功能词。

patterns.name: 专利中的供料与安装结构
patterns.trigger: « by»、« it»、« a pouch»、« sequentially»、« provided»、« spout»、« installation»、« heads»
patterns.context: 专利句子描述袋体供料和旋转式出液口安装机构；「spout」被拆分成多个片段。

patterns.name: 数学公式与变量排版
patterns.trigger: « ensure»、« comes»、« a»、« measure»、« psi»、« z»、« _»、« ,»
patterns.context: 数学论文正文引出测度与变量，紧接 LaTeX 数学环境；激活覆盖公式符号及部分文字。

patterns.name: 物理学公式中的符号与排版
patterns.trigger: « DIS»、« given»、« sigma»、« I»、« (»、« z»、« q»、« mu»、« R»
patterns.context: 正文转入 partonic cross section 的公式，LaTeX 中含变量、上下标及对齐环境。

patterns.name: 公式中的变量与特殊函数
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式的符号、函数与括号；与相邻物理公式类似，但此段是独立公式片段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学或理论物理论文

patterns.name: 企业新闻标题与人员缩减
patterns.trigger: « wells»、« offshore»、« Red»、« UK»、« Workforce»、« reduce»、« based»
patterns.context: 新闻式标题和正文提及油田、公司及英国员工缩减；激活落在专名、主题词和常见词上。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的新闻剪报

patterns.name: 文学叙述中的重复呼喊与星体意象
patterns.context: 引语中反复催促继续，随后转为叙事，描写星体重新开始永恒运行。

patterns.name: 邮件引用头与金额
patterns.trigger: « Sure»、« cost»、« $»、« 100»、« Original»、« Message»、« From:»、« Sent»
patterns.context: 邮件正文确认后出现费用金额，并转入原始邮件的引用头和发件人信息。

patterns.name: 邮件中的日期安排与签名
patterns.trigger: « for»、« one»、« don't»、« buy»、« Monday»、« Tuesday»、« COOL»、« Veselack»
patterns.context: 口语邮件讨论购买及周一、周二安排，随后出现署名；也包含标点和词片段。

patterns.name: 逗号分隔的递增数字记录
patterns.context: 多行逗号分隔数字记录，数值大致递增，行间有回车和换行。

en.description: Activation is distributed across unrelated corpora: mathematical formulas, code identifiers, monetary amounts and percentage figures, citation years, as well as names, legal terms, and Italian subword fragments. There is no single stable semantic or register pattern.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula structures
patterns.context: Activates on variables, subscripts, Greek letters, formula markers, and adjacent LaTeX math formatting structures in mathematical papers.

patterns.name: Identifiers and numeric scaling in code
patterns.context: Activates when variable or function names and scaling/multiplication or division operations appear in code comments or calls; especially near identifiers such as XRGL and the MAX constant.

patterns.name: Monetary amounts
patterns.context: In biographical narratives, weak activation occurs when a currency symbol and grouped digits form an amount; activation in the passage is concentrated mainly on the numeric fragments.

patterns.name: Numeric ratios and decimal values
patterns.context: In photography explanations, digits or words expressing ratios activate when describing changes in light levels and proportions; a similar activation appears on half in “half-baked idea.”
patterns.domain: HackerNews photography discussion and online comments

patterns.name: Year numbers in citations
patterns.context: Year numbers and adjacent citation markers activate in astrophysics paper references.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments in names
patterns.context: Several fragments activate when Turkish names and place names are split into subwords; there is no evidence that they are used as ordinary words.

patterns.name: Fragments in legal-document terms
patterns.context: Partial subword fragments of terms related to application forms, nominal lessees, and leases activate in rental applications and transaction narratives.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Italian words
patterns.context: In continuous Italian parliamentary text, common function words and tokenized within-word fragments activate; no specific syntactic or policy-content condition is evident.

4_2552.description: 激活分布于多种不相连语料：数学公式、代码标识符、金额和比例数字、引文年份，以及姓名、法律词语和意大利语词片；没有单一稳定的语义或语域模式。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式结构
patterns.context: 在数学论文中，变量、下标、希腊字母、公式标记及其邻近的 LaTeX 数学排版结构中激活。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与数值缩放
patterns.context: 代码注释或调用中出现变量名、函数名及缩放/乘除运算时激活；尤其是 XRGL 一类标识符和 MAX 常量附近。

patterns.name: 金额数字
patterns.context: 人物传记类叙述中，货币符号和分组数字构成金额时有弱激活；该段强度主要集中在数字片段。

patterns.name: 数字比例与小数值
patterns.context: 摄影解释中描述光量变化及比例时，数字或表示比例的词语激活；另有“half-baked idea”中的 half 出现相似激活。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 摄影讨论及网络评论

patterns.name: 引文中的年份数字
patterns.context: 天体物理论文的文献引用中，年份数字及邻近引文标记激活。

patterns.name: 姓名中的特定词片
patterns.context: 土耳其人名及地名被切分成多个子词时，若干词片激活；未见其作为普通词语使用的证据。

patterns.name: 法律文书词语中的词片
patterns.context: 租赁申请与交易叙述中，申请表、名义承租人及租约相关词语的部分词片激活。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内词片
patterns.context: 连续意大利语议会文本中，常见功能词及被切分的词内片段出现激活；未显示特定句法或政策内容条件。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语议会文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across heterogeneous corpora, often falling on internal tokens in number strings, proper nouns, or terminology; it also appears around line-break formatting, Portuguese technical words, and pornographic category labels. No single stable semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric fields
patterns.context: Activation falls on part of a number string, often in amounts, years, lists, integers or identifiers in code; surrounding text types vary.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, parliamentary texts, code, business emails, etc.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in proper nouns and rare words
patterns.context: Activation occurs in names, terminology, or identifiers split into multiple tokens, especially rare internal fragments; contextual conditions are unstable.

patterns.name: Local fragments in English vocabulary
patterns.context: Sporadic occurrences in narrative or pornographic text, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition; “filled” in paragraph 5 occurs in the expression “filled with a burning desire”.
patterns.domain: Literary narrative, pornographic text, sports reporting

patterns.name: Portuguese technical expressions and code identifiers
patterns.context: Around SMTP/SSL configuration instructions and code variables, activation centers on internal fragments of Portuguese words and protocol identifiers.

patterns.name: Explicit line breaks and indentation formatting
patterns.context: A few paragraphs show activation near line breaks, sometimes followed by numbering or large aligned spaces; not all line breaks trigger.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, parliamentary lists, code, email formatting

patterns.name: Sexual vocabulary and category labels in pornographic text
patterns.context: Appears in adult-video-style descriptions and their category labels; “Teens” in the labels shows strong activation.

4_2552.description: 激活分散在异质语料中，常落于数字串、专名或术语的内部 token，也见换行排版、葡萄牙语技术词及色情分类标签；未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字与数值字段
patterns.context: 激活落在数字串的一部分，常见于金额、年份、列表、代码中的整数或编号；周围文本类型不固定。
patterns.domain: 百科、议会文本、代码、商务邮件等

patterns.name: 专名与罕见词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在被拆分为多个 token 的名称、术语或标识符中，尤其是词内罕见片段；上下文条件不稳定。
patterns.domain: 百科、体育报道、代码、邮件

patterns.name: 英语词汇中的局部片段
patterns.context: 零散出现在叙述或色情文本中，没有一致的语义或句法条件；第5段的“filled”处于“filled with a burning desire”表达中。
patterns.domain: 文学叙述、色情文本、体育报道

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语技术表达及代码标识符
patterns.context: 在 SMTP/SSL 配置说明及代码变量周围，激活集中于葡萄牙语词内部片段和协议标识符片段。

patterns.name: 显式换行与缩进排版
patterns.trigger: “↵”以及其后的空白或缩进区域
patterns.context: 少数段落的换行附近有激活，且换行后可能出现序号或大段对齐空格；并非所有换行都触发。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、议会列表、代码、邮件格式

patterns.name: 色情文本中的性词汇与分类标签
patterns.context: 出现在成人视频式描述及其分类标签中；标签中的“Teens”有很强激活。

en.concept: Structured strings of numbers and punctuation
en.description: Primarily responds to punctuation-separated numeric strings, dollar amounts with thousands separators, and structured numeric fields; also appears in page numbers and code identifiers. A few names, email formats, and word fragments are not explained by this pattern.

patterns.name: Dense sequences of numbers, punctuation, and separators
patterns.context: Numbers are separated by punctuation, often appearing consecutively as lists, coordinates, timestamps, or structured fields.
patterns.domain: Code, data, numeric lists, and general text

patterns.name: Currency amounts and thousands separators
patterns.context: A dollar sign is followed by a comma-separated amount, often with decimals or price- and cost-related context.

patterns.name: Numbers interleaved with proper names/spelling fragments
patterns.context: Numbers, parentheses, or quotation marks are adjacent to tokenized words or proper names; activation is not fully explained by numeric formatting.

patterns.name: Numeric literals and digit-containing strings in code
patterns.context: Numbers appear in arrays/key-value data or database connection strings, mixed with letters, quotation marks, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Directory-style page numbers and numbering
patterns.context: Numbers appear in book indexes or entry layouts, aligned with places, institution names, and spaces.

patterns.name: Capitalized words and numeric fields in code identifiers
patterns.context: Short numbers or symbols occur within camel-case identifiers and dotted property chains.

patterns.name: Numeric price expressions in ordinary narrative
patterns.context: Amounts are embedded in natural-language sentences about purchases, valuations, or fair prices.

4_2552.concept: 数字与标点的结构化串
4_2552.description: 主要响应标点分隔的数字串、带千位逗号的美元金额及结构化数字字段；也见于页码和代码标识符。少数姓名、邮件格式与词语片段难以由此解释。

patterns.name: 数字、标点与分隔符密集序列
patterns.context: 数字被标点分隔，常以列表、坐标、时间戳或结构化字段形式连续出现。
patterns.domain: 代码、数据、数字列表及一般文本

patterns.name: 货币金额与千位分隔
patterns.context: 美元符号后跟带逗号的金额，常有小数或价格、成本等语义上下文。

patterns.name: 数字与专名/拼写片段交错
patterns.trigger: 数字列表中的「(uvodne izjave)」及其附近数字；「Veselack」等被拆分的姓名片段
patterns.context: 数字、括号或引号与拆分后的词语、专名相邻；激活模式不完全由数字格式解释。

patterns.name: 代码中的数字字面量与带数字的字符串
patterns.context: 数字出现在数组/键值数据或数据库连接字符串中，混有字母、引号及标点。

patterns.name: 目录式页码及编号
patterns.context: 数字位于书籍索引或条目排版中，与地点、机构名称和空格对齐。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的大写词与数字字段
patterns.context: 驼峰式标识符和点号属性链中夹有短数字或符号。

patterns.name: 普通叙述中的数字化价格表达
patterns.context: 金额嵌在关于购买、估价或公平价格的自然语言句子中。

en.concept: Sensitive to formatting and subword boundaries
en.description: Activations are distributed across code and structured lists, proper names and subword boundaries, email signatures and abbreviations, colloquial Portuguese, teen word forms, product quantities, and date scheduling; there is no single semantic trigger, and the feature may favor formatting, word-form fragments, and proper names.

patterns.name: Structured tables, lists, and fields
patterns.context: In code declarations or line-by-line tables, rankings, and numbered data, types/fields, labels, or values appear consecutively in a fixed format.
patterns.domain: Code, sports league records, numerical data

patterns.name: Proper names and case/tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Proper names, brands, personal names, or words cross tokenizer subword boundaries; activation falls on subwords within names.

patterns.name: Price/U... in software fields and identifiers
patterns.context: Compound identifiers appear in code properties or comments, especially field names such as `Price`, `Unit`, and `UPD`.
patterns.domain: Github code and Japanese-English mixed comments

patterns.name: English abbreviations and email signatures/addresses
patterns.context: At the end of email bodies or in address-book-style signatures, abbreviations, email domains, names, and organizations appear next to one another.

patterns.name: Colloquial Portuguese expressions and word segmentation
patterns.context: Portuguese sentences discuss the word `fixe` and its usage, with colloquial expressions and subword segmentation.

patterns.name: Adult content and teen/Teens word forms
patterns.context: Texts about adult website categories or young performers/music include teen-related words and variants in capitalization or subword segmentation.

patterns.name: Quantity and product shipment expressions
patterns.context: In news reports about product manufacturing and shipment forecasts, quantity phrases appear next to pluralized model names.

patterns.name: Dates, weekdays, and scheduling
patterns.context: Emails compare or schedule matters for different dates and time slots.

4_2552.description: 激活分散于代码与结构化列表、专名和子词边界、邮件签名及缩写、葡语口语、teen词形、产品数量和日期安排；没有单一语义触发条件，可能偏向格式/词形片段与专名。

patterns.name: 结构化表格、列表与字段
patterns.trigger: `struct Animal *const`、`static const ... {`、`Division Two West`、`champions`、`2001–02`、重复的逗号分隔数字和换行
patterns.context: 在代码声明或按行排列的表格、榜单、编号数据中，类型/字段、标签或数值以固定格式连续出现。
patterns.domain: 代码、体育联赛记录、数字数据

patterns.name: 专名与大小写/分词边界
patterns.trigger: `Virgin Films`、`Veselack`、`Bentley`、`Rochester`、`Teen`、`Athlon 64s`，以及片段中的大小写和词内切分
patterns.context: 专名、品牌、人名或词语跨 tokenizer 子词边界出现；激活落在名称内部的子词上。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、邮件、新闻、百科

patterns.name: 软件字段与标识符中的 Price/U...
patterns.context: 代码属性或注释中出现复合标识符，尤其含 `Price`、`Unit`、`UPD` 等字段名。
patterns.domain: Github 代码及日英混合注释

patterns.name: 英语缩写与邮件签名/地址
patterns.context: 邮件正文末尾或通讯录式签名中，缩写、邮箱域、姓名和组织名相邻。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语口语表达与词形切分
patterns.context: 葡语句子讨论 `fixe` 一词及其用法，出现口语表达和子词切分。

patterns.name: 成人内容与 teen/Teens 词形
patterns.context: 涉及成人网站分类或年轻艺人/音乐的文本中，出现 teen 相关词及其大小写或子词变体。
patterns.domain: 网页成人内容、娱乐宣传

patterns.name: 数量及产品出货表达
patterns.context: 新闻报道产品生产、出货预期时，数量短语与型号复数相邻。

patterns.name: 日期、星期与时间安排
patterns.context: 邮件中比较或安排不同日期、时段的事项。

en.description: Primarily activates on digit groups following commas in amounts and occasional decimal places; also activates on email fragments in email headers and within-word fragments in multilingual parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Commas and following digit groups in amounts
patterns.context: A monetary amount is nearby, commonly in the form $number,number; activation is concentrated on the comma and following digit group, occasionally extending to the decimal portion of the amount.
patterns.domain: Narratives involving amounts in legal, patent, news, and other texts

patterns.name: E in email addresses or email fields
patterns.context: Appears in address fields in email headers, between names and company information; the same address string is split into several highly activated fragments.

patterns.name: Word endings and inflectional fragments in European Parliament corpora
patterns.context: Across texts in different European languages, activation falls on within-word fragments split by tokenization; the specific words and positions vary across passages.

4_2552.description: 主要对金额逗号后的数字组及偶见小数位激活；另对邮件头中的邮箱片段，以及多语种议会文本中若干词内片段激活。

patterns.name: 金额中的逗号及其后的数字组
patterns.trigger: 数字金额中逗号后的数字，如 «,»10«000»；也包括金额末尾的 «.»17
patterns.context: 附近出现货币金额，常见形式为 $数字,数字，激活集中在逗号及后续数字组，偶尔延伸到金额小数部分。
patterns.domain: 法律、专利、新闻等含金额的叙述

patterns.name: 邮件地址或邮箱字段中的 E
patterns.context: 出现在邮件头的地址字段及姓名、公司信息之间；同一地址字符串被拆分成多个高激活片段。

patterns.name: 欧洲议会语料中的多语种词尾与词形片段
patterns.trigger: 葡萄牙语 «ce»3«iro»10；斯洛伐克语 «len»5«i»6«ami»10；拉脱维亚语 «ie»7«š»4«anu»9
patterns.context: 在不同欧洲语言文本中，激活落在被分词切开的词内片段；各段的具体词语和位置并不相同。

en.concept: Local word fragments in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations span news, legal and financial material, engineering, code, multilingual text, and glossary entries, often falling on proper names, intraword subword fragments, numbers, or structured identifiers; there is no consistent semantic, language, or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within proper names or common words; these examples show no unified meaning or fixed position.
patterns.domain: Different genres, including news, Wikipedia, email, and glossary entries

patterns.name: Financial figures and amounts
patterns.context: Appears in company financial statements or text about stock buybacks, involving amounts, years, and financial terminology.

patterns.name: Structured fields and symbols
patterns.context: Near local parameter declarations and macro-like identifiers in code, and near equations; activation concentrates on identifier fragments and operators.

patterns.name: Distribution, control, and constraints
patterns.context: Technical descriptions of vehicle power distribution and clutch control discuss force distribution and control conditions.

patterns.name: Intraword fragments in Hungarian
patterns.context: Fragments occur inside concatenated Hungarian word forms; no single meaning explains them.

patterns.name: Colloquial Portuguese expressions
patterns.context: When Portuguese examples list colloquial expressions found through search, activation hits fragments within words.

patterns.name: List and category entries
patterns.context: Proper names, titles, and category items are listed one by one in lists or disambiguation entries.

patterns.name: Proper names in police reports
patterns.context: In a news account of police searching for villagers, the fragment occurs within a place name; it has no clear connection to policing semantics.

patterns.name: Garbled or nonstandard spelling fragments
patterns.context: Colloquial spellings, variants, or text noise occur together; activation falls within non-English word forms.

4_2552.concept: 异质文本中的局部词片段
4_2552.description: 激活跨新闻、法律财务、工程、代码、多语种和词条文本，常落在专名、词内子词片段、数字或结构化标识符上；没有一致的语义、语种或句法模式。

patterns.name: 专名内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或普通词内部的子词片段；这些例子看不出统一词义或固定位置。
patterns.domain: 新闻、Wikipedia、邮件、词条等不同文体

patterns.name: 财务数值与金额
patterns.context: 出现在公司财务报表或股票回购相关文字中，涉及金额、年份和财务术语。
patterns.domain: 财经报道、法律/证券材料

patterns.name: 结构化字段与符号
patterns.context: 代码中局部参数声明和宏式标识符、算式附近；激活集中在标识符片段和运算符。

patterns.name: 分布、控制与限定
patterns.context: 汽车驱动力分配及离合器控制的技术描述中，涉及力的分配和控制条件。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在连写的匈牙利语词形内部；无法由单一词义解释。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本（匈牙利语）

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语口语表达
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语例句列举搜索到的口语表达时，激活命中词内片段。

patterns.name: 名单与分类条目
patterns.trigger: «Big»、«Earl»、«Raiders»，以及 «Golden Time» 条目中的词片段
patterns.context: 列表或消歧义条目中，专名、标题和分类项被逐项列出。

patterns.name: 警务报道中的专名
patterns.context: 警察搜寻村民的新闻叙述中，片段位于地名内部；与警务语义本身无明显联系。

patterns.name: 乱码或非标准拼写片段
patterns.context: 口语拼写、变体或文本噪声并存，激活落在非英语词形内部。

en.concept: Subword fragments, numbers, and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activation is scattered across within-word fragments, numbers, and punctuation boundaries, and also occurs in code identifiers and several domain-specific terms. The examples span multilingual, patent, legal, financial, and code text, and cannot be explained by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Within-word suffixes or morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within longer words, often at word endings or stems spanning tokenization boundaries; it does not depend on a particular meaning.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, political speeches, patent literature

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric grouping
patterns.context: Digits, years, and fragments of patent numbers are marked as split tokens; they often appear mixed with punctuation or alphanumeric strings.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and structured fields
patterns.context: Identifiers, property names, and compound field names appear in code or code-like text; code line breaks and indentation are prominent.

patterns.name: Repeated periods and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: Activation occurs near periods, commas, line breaks, and other punctuation boundaries, often around numbers, abbreviations, lists, or formatted content.

patterns.name: Automotive terms for drive and distribution
patterns.context: Patent sentences about vehicle powertrains describe driving force, drive wheels, clutches, and force distribution.

patterns.name: Capitalized names in court-document headings
patterns.context: Names and institution names in court or administrative agency headings are split into fragments; the page also contains case numbers and line breaks.

patterns.name: Currency amounts and financial figures
patterns.context: Amounts, financial figures, and their decimal portions appear as segmented numbers, accompanied by rupees, periods, or company financial narratives.

patterns.name: Real estate transaction amounts
patterns.context: Narratives describe the sale of real estate by a trustee and its sale price, including names, dates, and monetary figures.

patterns.name: Portuguese inflectional fragments
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary speeches, within-word fragments fall near inflected forms or word endings.

patterns.name: Music track titles and Spanish phrases
patterns.context: An album track listing contains a quoted Spanish song title, with diacritics and within-word tokenization.

4_2552.concept: 词片段、数字与格式边界
4_2552.description: 激活分散在词内片段、数字及标点边界，也出现在代码标识符和若干特定领域词汇中。包含多语种、专利、法律、财务及代码文本，无法由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 词内后缀或词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长单词内部的子词片段，常见于跨分词边界的词尾或词干部分；并不依赖特定语义。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本、政治演讲、专利文献

patterns.name: 数字及数字分组
patterns.context: 数字、年份、专利号中的数字片段被切分标记；常与标点或字母数字混排。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与结构化字段
patterns.context: 代码或类似代码的文本中，标识符、属性名及复合字段名出现时；代码换行和缩进明显。

patterns.name: 重复句点与标点边界
patterns.context: 句点、逗号、换行等标点边界附近激活，常出现在数字、缩写、列表或格式化内容周围。

patterns.name: 英语驱动与分配相关词汇
patterns.context: 车辆动力系统中描述驱动力、驱动轮、离合器及力分配的专利句子。

patterns.name: 法庭文件标题中的大写名称
patterns.context: 法院或行政机构标题中，姓名、机构名称等大写词被拆成片段；页面还带有案件编号和排版换行。

patterns.name: 货币金额与财务数字

patterns.context: In “Notable people” lists, names are followed by occupation or rank categories; activation is distributed across name and description fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments in category links at page endings
patterns.context: Encyclopedia page category links following career statistics and references, including place names and nationality categories.

4_2552.concept: 碎片化文本中的局部模式
4_2552.description: 激活分布于多语种词片段、姓名与类别标签，以及数字串、公式符号和数学小数中；也见于论文术语、书籍目录和百科列表，未显出单一稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词内片段
patterns.context: 立陶宛语议会发言，触发点嵌在姓名、党团和普通词的分词片段中

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语句子中的词内片段，谈及地区发展、旅游和相关威胁

patterns.name: 数字与数字分组格式
patterns.context: 激活散布在长数字、带逗号的数字、算式和小数等数字串内部；分别见收入统计及数学题

patterns.name: 数学题中的小数数位
patterns.context: 数字串出现在令变量取值、四则运算或询问舍入结果的数学练习中

patterns.name: 数学物理中的数字与单位符号
patterns.context: 图表文字中温度角度及数值曲线标签附近的碎片化符号和数字

patterns.name: 物理术语及引文中的词片段
patterns.context: 讨论2DM由物理波函数导出所需约束，并提到N-representability及相关学者引文

patterns.name: 目录式人名条目与数字
patterns.context: 书籍目录中以大写书名、人名或作品名配合页码排列的条目

patterns.name: 人物类别及姓名词片段
patterns.context: “Notable people”列表中人名后附职业或军衔类别，激活分散在姓名及描述词片段上

patterns.name: 分类页尾的词片段
patterns.context: 生涯统计与参考资料之后的百科页面分类链接，包含地名和国籍类别

en.description: Activations are sporadic: some occur on the letter a, the fragment “ore,” unsubscribe wording, and structured-data fields; others occur on numbers, punctuation, line breaks, and ordinary subword fragments that are difficult to unify.

patterns.name: Encoding of the vowel a
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across a in different words; segment 1 also contains numbers and commas, which cannot be explained on their own, but multiple instances of a are marked

patterns.name: Suffix or internal fragment “ore”
patterns.context: An internal word fragment in a personal name or bibliographic identifier; the marked position may correspond to a letter fragment rather than a complete word

patterns.name: Email unsubscribe wording
patterns.context: Appears in an E*TRADE email’s unsubscribe notice

patterns.name: Field markers in structured text
patterns.context: In JSON-style key-value data, activations fall on quotation marks and fragments of field names

patterns.name: Number and punctuation formatting
patterns.context: Income amounts and numeric separators in a demographic paragraph; based on this segment alone, it is unclear whether numbers, separators, or local formatting are responsible

patterns.name: Isolated internal word fragments and whitespace/line breaks
patterns.context: Sporadic activations in varied sentence forms, with no consistent semantic or grammatical condition
patterns.domain: Dream interpretation text, forum dialogue, email body

patterns.name: Medical terms and citation identifiers
patterns.context: Appears near paper citations or medical terms; activations in ordinary text do not form a clear, consistent trigger condition

4_2552.description: 激活分布零散：部分落在字母a、片段“ore”、退订措辞和结构化数据字段上；另有数字标点、换行及普通词片段等难以统一解释的激活。

patterns.name: 元音字母 a 的编码
patterns.trigger: «»3 处均为单独的 a，例如“median income”“search tools”“more and more”“data”中的 a
patterns.context: 激活散布在不同词中的 a 上；段 1 中还出现了数字与逗号，不能单独解释该段，但多个 a 被标记

patterns.name: 后缀或词内片段“ore”
patterns.context: 出现在人名或文献标识符中的词内片段；标记位置可能对应字母片段，而非完整词
patterns.domain: 新闻、医学文献、专利背景

patterns.name: 邮箱退订措辞
patterns.context: 出现在 E*TRADE 邮件的退订说明中
patterns.domain: 电子邮件营销/隐私政策

patterns.name: 结构化文本中的字段标记
patterns.context: JSON 样式的键值数据中，激活落在引号及字段名片段上

patterns.name: 数字与标点格式
patterns.context: 人口统计段落中的收入金额与数字分隔符；无法仅凭此段确定是数字、分隔符还是局部格式触发

patterns.name: 孤立的词内片段与空白/换行
patterns.context: 多种不同句式中零散激活，缺少一致的语义或语法条件
patterns.domain: 释梦文本、论坛对话、邮件正文

patterns.name: 医学术语及引文标识符
patterns.context: 出现在论文引文或医学术语附近；与普通文本中的激活不形成清晰一致的触发条件

en.description: Activations are heterogeneous: numbers, amounts, scale, and financial data; references to profit, failure, responsibility, and assets; and triggers from formulas, ordinary internal word fragments, and French parliamentary vocabulary. They do not reduce to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Professional identity, role, or responsibility
patterns.context: Concerns the responsibilities, identity, assets, or properties of a person, company, owner, or mathematical object; the trigger may not be a whole word and may instead be an internal subword fragment.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary discussion, energy market email, mathematics paper

patterns.name: Quantities, amounts, and descriptions of scale
patterns.context: Numbers, ranges, ratios, or amounts appear in measurements, comparisons, statistics, or financial statements; [9] particularly concerns account balances and large cash figures.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, business news, economic and energy reporting, financial emails, forum posts

patterns.name: Assessments of success, failure, and benefit
patterns.context: Discusses whether an initiative or company failed or was unprofitable, or refers to profits and pricing goals; [6] concerns merger valuation and long-term profitability.
patterns.domain: Forum business commentary, business reporting, energy market documents

patterns.name: Specific internal substrings with no stable contextual category
patterns.context: Activations sometimes fall on internal fragments of ordinary words or formulas, whose meanings and local contexts vary; these examples alone do not establish a unified lexical trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, scientific papers, and mathematical typesetting

patterns.name: Political and social issues in French parliamentary text
patterns.context: French parliamentary speeches mention New York, acts of courage, and employment; activations are scattered across internal word fragments, with no clear connection to other patterns.

4_2552.description: 激活分布较杂：数字、金额、规模与财务数据；盈利、失败和责任/资产相关表述；另有公式、普通词内片段及法语议会词汇触发，难归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 职业身份、角色或责任
patterns.context: 围绕个人、公司、业主或数学对象的职责、身份、资产或性质展开；触发位置未必是完整词，也可能是词内子词片段。
patterns.domain: 议会讨论、能源市场邮件、数学论文

patterns.name: 数量、金额与规模描述
patterns.context: 数字、数值范围、比例或金额出现在测量、比较、统计或财务陈述中；[9]尤其是账户余额及大额现金数字。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、商业新闻、经济能源报道、财务邮件、论坛帖子

patterns.name: 成功、失败与效益评价
patterns.trigger:
[3] « failed»、«fin»«anc»10ially« inefficient»、«un»prof«itable»
[6] «profit»«ability»、«a real»
[7] «Pro»fit»9 from« correct»« pricing»
patterns.context: 讨论倡议或企业是否失败、无利可图，或利润和定价目标；[6]涉及并购估值及长期盈利能力。
patterns.domain: 论坛商业评论、商业报道、能源市场文件

patterns.name: 特定词内子串触发，无法由上下文稳定归类
patterns.trigger:
[1] «ar»位于«zac»zną（波兰语“开始”词形内部）
[2] «over»、«range»、«rate»
[5] «filtered»中的词内部分及«for»
[8] 数学公式中的«{»及«\»«in»
[10] «courage»及«consac»
patterns.context: 激活有时落在普通词或公式的内部片段，词义和局部语境并不一致；单靠这些例子无法确认统一的词法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本、科学论文及数学排版

patterns.name: 法语议会中的政治与社会议题
patterns.trigger: [10] «New»« York»、«per»«d»re« la» vie、«act»es très« courage»ux、«cons»ac«rée» à l' empl«oi»
patterns.context: 法语议会发言，提及纽约、勇敢行为及就业主题；触发分散在词内片段，和其他模式的联系不清楚。

en.description: Activations most prominently fall on Profit, Stake, and monetary amounts/numbers and units; other sporadic patterns involve code identifiers, Lithuanian word fragments, headlines, and colloquial words. Overall, the pattern favors intraword segmentation and numbers, but domains and triggers are not unified.

patterns.name: Character fragments in Profit
patterns.context: Substrings within English text words or across tokens; activation centers on Profit and capitalization or tokenization variants of Stake.

patterns.name: Grouping of monetary figures
patterns.context: When digits and thousands separators are adjacent to currency units in financial amounts; activation falls on numeric fragments and Million/billion.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantified values such as percentages
patterns.context: Near numbers and units in percentages, growth rates, or financial values; not necessarily large amounts.

patterns.name: Intraword boundaries and case segmentation
patterns.context: Some English words are split into multiple tokens, with activation distributed across intraword fragments or adjacent words; these examples have no consistent semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Activation appears near identifiers, code indentation, or punctuation in Go code snippets.

patterns.name: Lithuanian word endings and parliamentary formulae
patterns.context: In Lithuanian speeches, segmented word-form fragments and the formula “representing ... group” activate.

patterns.name: Capitalized word fragments in headlines
patterns.context: In English title-case text, activation falls on segmented headline word fragments; this occurs alongside monetary headlines, but a single trigger cannot be established.

patterns.name: Colloquial words in accounts of competition experience
patterns.context: The latter part of the colloquial word “stoked” in a first-person quotation; the same passage also mentions sponsorships, challenges, contests, and competition.

patterns.name: Time and business-word fragments in news sentences
patterns.context: In business performance news, fragments near quarters, sales, and company/product names show moderate activation, but no stable specific meaning pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Residual amount and profitability fragments
patterns.context: Multiple word fragments activate in business narratives about company revenue, long-term profitability, cash, and valuation.

4_2552.description: 激活最突出地落在 Profit、Stake 及金额数字/单位上；另见代码标识符、立陶宛语词片段、标题和口语词等分散模式。整体偏向词内分段与数字，但领域和触发并不统一。

patterns.name: Profit 的字符片段
patterns.context: 英语正文中的单词内部或跨 token 子串；激活集中于 Profit，以及 Stake 的大小写或分词变体。

patterns.name: 金额数字分组
patterns.context: 财务金额中数字与千位分隔符、金额单位相邻时；激活落在数字片段及 Million/billion 上。
patterns.domain: 邮件账户余额、商业新闻

patterns.name: 数字及百分比等量化数值
patterns.context: 百分比、增长率或财务数值的数字和单位附近；不一定是大额金额。
patterns.domain: 加密货币说明、商业新闻

patterns.name: 词内边界与大小写分段
patterns.context: 若干英语词被分成多个 token，激活分布在词内片段或相邻词上；这些例子没有一致的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与格式符号
patterns.context: Go 代码片段中，标识符、代码行缩进或标点附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 立陶宛语词尾及议会套语
patterns.context: 立陶宛语发言中，分词后的词形片段及“代表……党团”套语附近有激活。

patterns.name: 标题中的大写词片段
patterns.context: 英文标题式大小写文本中，激活落在被拆分的标题词片段；与金额标题同时出现，但不能确定是单一触发。

patterns.name: 竞赛经历叙述中的口语词
patterns.context: 第一人称引语中口语词“stoked”的后半部分；同段还提及 sponsorships、challenges、contests 和 competition。
patterns.domain: 网页报道、赛事相关内容

patterns.name: 新闻句中的时间与业务词片段
patterns.context: 企业业绩新闻句中，季度、销售及公司/产品名称附近有中等激活，但未见稳定的具体词义模式。

patterns.name: 残余金额与盈利能力词片段
patterns.context: 谈及公司营收、长期盈利能力、现金及估值的商业叙述中，多个词片段有激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across proper names and compound-word fragments, numbers, and cross-lingual internal subwords, spanning institutional lists, paper measurements, amounts, song charts, legal dates, medical terms, and parliamentary text. Trigger conditions vary, with no stable semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Names and internal word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of proper names or compound words; they may also cover tokenized fragments of common words, without consistent meaning or position conditions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal and medical texts, and corporate lists

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric fields
patterns.context: Numbers occur in measurement resolution, account amounts, chart rankings/years, or legal dates, with varied forms and meanings.
patterns.domain: Papers, business emails, encyclopedias, legal texts

patterns.name: Internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on internal fragments of cross-lingual word forms rather than stable whole words; surrounding contexts differ markedly.
patterns.domain: Online dialogue, parliamentary speeches, and informal webpages

patterns.name: Spectral processing and measurement descriptions
patterns.context: Values, units, and terms for processing/comparison appear in descriptions of spectral resolution.

patterns.name: Parliamentary names and speech formulas
patterns.context: Activations occur on Lithuanian names and tokenized internal fragments in parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: Polish word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on internal fragments in continuous Polish text about list management and doctors; although the Lithuanian segment is also from parliamentary corpora, the fragments differ.

patterns.name: Song chart narrative
patterns.context: In accounts of songs’ chart positions and dates in the United States and United Kingdom, activations mix numbers with ordinary word fragments.

patterns.name: Legal institution names and dates
patterns.context: An institution name appears in a statement of disputed facts alongside a specific date; it is unclear whether the name or date drives the activation.

patterns.name: Venture capital firms in a list
patterns.context: A list of companies/investment firms contains several strongly activated fragments, but multiple adjacent firm names are not marked consistently.

4_2552.description: 激活分散于专名和复合词片段、数字及跨语言词内子词：涵盖机构名单、论文测量、金额、歌曲榜单、法律日期、医学术语和议会文本。各片段触发条件不统一，尚无稳定语义或句法规律。

patterns.name: 名称与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或复合词的词内片段上；也可能覆盖常见词的分词片段，缺少一致的词义或位置条件。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、医学及企业名单

patterns.name: 数字及数值字段
patterns.context: 数字出现在测量分辨率、账目金额、榜单排名/年份或法律日期中，形式和语义各异。
patterns.domain: 论文、商业邮件、百科、法律文本

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于跨语言词形的内部片段，而非稳定的完整词；相关片段周围语境差异明显。
patterns.domain: 网络对话、议会发言及非正式网页

patterns.name: 语谱处理与测量表述
patterns.context: 数值、单位及处理/比较用语出现在光谱分辨率描述中。

patterns.name: 议会姓名与发言公式
patterns.context: 激活为立陶宛语人名和议会发言中被切分的词内片段。

patterns.name: 波兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在波兰语连续文本的词内片段，内容涉及名单管理和医生；与立陶宛语段虽同属议会语料，但片段并不相同。

patterns.name: 歌曲榜单叙述
patterns.context: 歌曲在美国和英国榜单的名次及日期叙述中，激活混合数字与普通词片段。

patterns.name: 法律机构名称与日期
patterns.context: 机构名称在争议事实陈述中出现，伴随具体日期；不能确定激活是由专名还是日期驱动。

patterns.name: 名单中的风险投资机构
patterns.context: 企业/投资机构名称组成的名单，部分片段强激活，但相邻多种机构名并未一致标记。
patterns.domain: 百科条目中的组织名单

en.concept: Local features of internal fragments and proper names
en.description: Responses are scattered across internal subwords, proper names, and numeric formats, including multilingual word fragments, medical terms, brand and work names, and a few evaluative words; there is no stable, unified semantic or syntactic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Internal character fragments and proper-name subwords
patterns.context: Activations fall on characters or subword fragments within words, often in proper names, foreign words, or technical terms; the surrounding words need not activate.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, papers, and proper names

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric formats
patterns.context: Numbers, numeric formats, or specific strings adjacent to numbers and punctuation activate; samples are sparse, and USA is not a number, so a unified trigger condition is uncertain.

patterns.name: Local activations on rare or salient words
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across emphatic, evaluative, or relatively rare words, with no stable syntactic position or semantic category.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in foreign-language words
patterns.context: In Swedish and Lithuanian parliamentary speeches, activations concentrate on internal word fragments, affixes, or hyphens rather than activating whole words uniformly.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in biomedical terms
patterns.context: Appears in specialist contexts such as the scientific name of mistletoe and immunostaining methods; some activations correspond to internal term fragments, while others fall on institution or place names.

patterns.name: Brand, work, and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activations often occur in brand, television program, company, or competition names, and may cover only part of a proper name.
patterns.domain: Commercial, entertainment, and sports web text

patterns.name: Data retrieval and database names
patterns.context: When the data query tool Genevestigator is mentioned, its name is split into multiple high-response subwords.

4_2552.concept: 词内片段与专名局部特征
4_2552.description: 响应分散于词内子词、专名和数字格式：包括多语种词片段、医学术语、品牌作品名及少数评价词；没有稳定统一的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内字符片段与专名子词
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的字符或子词片段上；常见于专名、外语词或技术术语，周围词本身未必激活。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本、论文与专名

patterns.name: 数字及数字格式
patterns.context: 数字、数值格式或夹在数字与标点附近的特定字符串会激活；样本较少，且USA并非数字，不能确定是统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 少见或显著词的局部激活
patterns.context: 激活分散在强调、评价或相对少见的词上，未显示稳定的句法位置或语义类别。
patterns.domain: 学术、评论及娱乐网页文本

patterns.name: 外语词内部片段
patterns.context: 在瑞典语和立陶宛语议会发言中，激活集中于词内片段、词缀或连字符；不是整词均匀激活。

patterns.name: 生物医学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在槲寄生学名及免疫染色方法等专业语境；部分激活对应术语内部片段，部分落在机构或地点名称。

patterns.name: 品牌、作品名与专名片段
patterns.context: 激活常出现在品牌、影视节目、公司或竞赛名称中，且可能只覆盖专名的一部分。
patterns.domain: 网页商业、娱乐与体育文本

patterns.name: 数据检索与数据库名称
patterns.context: 在提及数据集查询工具 Genevestigator 时，名称被拆分成多个高响应子词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学数据资源介绍

en.description: Activations often fall on numbers and units, split English word fragments, and line-break boundaries; formulas, amount formatting, and Russian word-form-to-abbreviation mappings also occur. Activations on ordinary semantic words are scattered across topics, and trigger patterns are uncertain.

patterns.name: Values, units, and numeric strings
patterns.context: Numbers occur alongside decimals, units, currencies, fractions, or magnitude notation, especially when numbers are split across multiple tokens; however, not all numeric strings trigger activation.
patterns.domain: Scientific text, math problems, news, and commercial text

patterns.name: Internal English word fragments or boundary fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on word fragments split by the tokenizer, often internal suffixes, proper names, or word-initial fragments; they appear in varied contexts, with no stable meaning-based condition.

patterns.name: Russian word forms and parenthetical abbreviations
patterns.context: Russian place names or adjectives appear alongside Latin-letter abbreviations in parentheses, with this format repeated across multiple list entries.
patterns.domain: Github vocabulary lists or bilingual mappings

patterns.name: Continuous tokenization and whitespace boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur near line breaks or split words, often alongside English fragment activations; line breaks alone can also activate.

patterns.name: Formula operators and mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In variable assignments and fractions, minus signs, variables, and numbers interleave; it is unclear whether a specific mathematical symbol alone triggers activation.

patterns.name: Irregular amount formatting
patterns.context: Commercial promotional copy mixes amounts, units, and capitalization splits; this overlaps with the numeric pattern but has distinctive advertising formatting.

patterns.name: Possible general English subwords or phrase fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across ordinary English words and phrases in contexts involving Google, application statistics, and energy trading, with no shared semantic condition.

4_2552.description: 激活多落在数字与单位、被拆分的英文词片段及换行边界；另见公式、金额排版和俄语词形—缩写映射。普通语义词上的激活跨主题分散，触发规律不确定。

patterns.name: 数值、单位与数字串
patterns.context: 数字与小数、单位、货币、分数或量级记法相邻，尤其数字被拆成多个 token；但触发并非所有数字串。
patterns.domain: 科学文本、数学题、新闻与商业文本

patterns.name: 英文词内部或词边界片段
patterns.trigger: « st»«oked»、« sur»«pr»«ised»、« Hell»；以及«et»«nies»、« cov»«eted»、«R»、« B»«illion»、« Rec»«overed»、« lov»«able»
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词器拆开的词片段上，常见于词中后缀、专名或词首片段；分布在不同语境，未见稳定词义条件。

patterns.name: 俄语词形及括号缩写
patterns.context: 俄语地名或形容词与括号中的拉丁字母缩写并列，多个行项目重复出现该格式。

patterns.name: 连续分词与空格边界
patterns.context: 换行附近或词被切分处出现激活，常与英文片段激活共现；单独换行也有激活。

patterns.name: 公式运算符与数学表达式
patterns.context: 变量赋值和分数式中，负号、变量及数字串交错；无法确定是否由特定数学符号单独触发。

patterns.name: 不规则金额格式
patterns.context: 商业宣传文案中金额、单位和大小写拆分混杂；与数值模式重叠，但有独特的广告排版。

patterns.name: 疑似一般英文子词或短语片段
patterns.trigger: «make»« sense»、« door»、« information»；« The»、« average»、« user»；« oil»、« natural»« gas»
patterns.context: 激活分散在普通英文词及短语中，所处语义分别涉及Google、应用统计、能源贸易，未见共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛、科技统计、能源新闻

en.description: Activations occur mainly on the word-final ish in bullish and the fit fragment in profit/profitability; there are also isolated intraword activations on numeric units, Japanese and Swedish word fragments, stoked, and Beats. Pattern 4 has no clear correspondence.

patterns.name: English word-final fragment -ish
patterns.context: Activation centers on the segmented word-final ish in the adjective bullish; contexts include economic commentary and stock-market assessments.

patterns.name: Profit fragment in profitability
patterns.context: Activation falls on the segmented fragment fit in Profit/Profitability, involving profit metrics or profit pricing; [9] contrasts profit with growth, while [8] discusses pricing targets.

patterns.name: Numbers and intraword subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across numbers/units, English affixes, or specific subword fragments within Japanese word forms, with no common semantics or stable contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Astronomy papers, economic news, Japanese-language Q&A

patterns.name: Scandinavian language fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs in Swedish word fragments such as språ(k), in sentences discussing language use; the pattern appears only once.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations near proper names or brands
patterns.context: Activations fall separately on an intraword fragment in stoked and a fragment in the brand name Beats, amid esports/sponsorship and Apple acquisition news; no stable shared semantics are evident.

patterns.name: Market term bull and intraword fragments
patterns.context: The same market-assessment word bullish appears in contexts about economic growth and stock trends; activation favors the suffix ish rather than the whole word.

4_2552.concept: 不稳定的词内子词片段激活
4_2552.description: 主要激活于 bullish 的词尾 ish 和 profit/profitability 中的 fit 片段；另有数字单位、日语和瑞典语词片段、stoked 与 Beats 等孤立词内激活。第4段无清楚对应模式。

patterns.name: 英文词尾片段 -ish
patterns.context: 激活集中在拆分出的词尾 ish，出现在 bullish 形容词中；语境分别是经济评论和股票行情判断。

patterns.name: profitability 内的 profit 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Profit/Profitability 的分词片段 fit，涉及利润指标或利润定价；[9] 中 profit 与 growth 对比，[8] 中讨论定价目标。

patterns.name: 数字及词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于数字/单位、英语词缀或日语词形内部的特定子词片段，未见共同语义或稳定上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 天文学论文、经济新闻、日语语言问答

patterns.name: 斯堪的纳维亚语词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在瑞典语词语 språ(k) 等片段中，句子讨论语言使用；模式仅见一次。

patterns.name: 专名或品牌附近的零散激活
patterns.context: 激活分别落在 stoked 的词内片段及 Beats 品牌名称片段，周围是电竞/赞助和苹果收购新闻；未显示稳定的共同语义。

patterns.name: 行情术语 bull 与词内片段
patterns.context: 同一行情判断词 bullish 在经济增长和股票趋势语境出现，具体激活偏向词尾 ish，而非完整词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple domains: numbers in mathematics and scientific text, French and Swedish internal subword fragments, medical terms and data retrieval terms, and indentation, line breaks, and identifier fragments in code. No single trigger pattern spans all segments.

patterns.name: Numbers and mathematical symbol sequences
patterns.context: Variable assignments, fractions, arithmetic expressions, or answer values in math problems; activations often fall on number fragments rather than surrounding English instructions.

patterns.name: Numeric formats and measurement units
patterns.context: Numeric precision, measurement units, or technical parameters occur together; the same segment also concerns spectral resolution and signal-to-noise ratio.

patterns.name: Years and investment returns
patterns.context: Considers hypothetically buying Apple stock in different years; activations concentrate on year numbers and near the tokenized form of “bought”.

patterns.name: French word forms and accented characters
patterns.context: In continuous French text, words are split into subword fragments with spaces or accented characters; activations fall on several internal word fragments.

patterns.name: Swedish word forms and character fragments
patterns.context: Swedish parliamentary text has words split into subword fragments, some containing characters such as å and ä; activations are scattered across internal word fragments.

patterns.name: Tumor and mistletoe terminology
patterns.context: Abstracts concern Viscum album extracts, tumor cells, and antitumor activity; activations also occur within the tokenized Latin scientific name.

patterns.name: Data retrieval terms
patterns.context: Introduces tools and websites for searching, organizing, and querying biomedical datasets; activations occur on both general search terms and fragments of the name Gene Investigator.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, biomedical reviews or introductions

patterns.name: C++ code formatting and type names
patterns.context: In C++ class declarations, activations occur near line breaks, indentation, tabs, comments, and split identifiers; the strongest activations include indentation tabs.

4_2552.description: 激活分散于多种领域：数学及科学文本中的数字，法语和瑞典语词内子词片段，医学术语与数据检索词，以及代码中的缩进、换行和标识符片段。未见贯穿所有段的单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 数字与数学符号序列
patterns.context: 数学题中的变量赋值、分数、算术表达式或选项数值；激活常落在数字片段上，而非周围的英文指令。

patterns.name: 数字格式与量化单位
patterns.context: 数字精度、测量单位或技术参数相邻出现；同一段还涉及光谱分辨率和信噪比。

patterns.name: 年份和投资回报
patterns.context: 回顾若在不同年份购买 Apple 股票的假设；激活集中在年份数字及分词形式的“bought”附近。

patterns.name: 法语词形与重音字符
patterns.context: 法语连续文本中，词被拆成带空格或重音字符的子词片段；激活落在若干词内片段。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形与字符片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本，词语以子词片段拆分，部分片段含 å、ä 等字符；激活散布在词内片段。

patterns.name: 肿瘤与槲寄生术语
patterns.context: 槲寄生（Viscum album）提取物与肿瘤细胞、抗肿瘤活性相关的摘要语境；激活也出现在被拆开的拉丁学名中。

patterns.name: 数据检索相关词
patterns.context: 介绍搜索、整理和查询生物医学数据集及相关网站；激活既出现在一般检索词，也出现在 Gene Investigator 名称片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central，生物医学综述或介绍

patterns.name: C++代码排版与类型名
patterns.context: C++ 类声明中，换行、缩进、制表符、注释和拆分的标识符附近出现激活；最强处包括缩进制表符。

en.description: Activations span multiple domains: astronomical quantities and units, split capitalized proper names, Italian word fragments, book titles, mathematical numbers and expressions, and data retrieval names. No clear common feature is apparent; the activations may favor local character or tokenization fragments rather than a unified meaning.

patterns.name: Astrophysical quantities and symbols
patterns.context: In astrophysical text, numbers, units, or astronomical symbols occur in expressions of mass, luminosity, wavelength, resolution, and similar quantities; marked locations vary across segments.

patterns.name: Identifiers composed of uppercase letters and numbers
patterns.context: Company, product, or drug names are split into uppercase-letter fragments near numbers, punctuation, or ordinary commercial text; this may reflect responses to tokenized name fragments.

patterns.name: Italian suffixes or internal fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Italian text, words are split into multiple subwords, with activations on internal or final fragments; no single semantic word class is apparent.

patterns.name: Chapter headings and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Book-like chapter listings contain proper names, place names, and dash-separated entries; several marked words are tokenized fragments.

patterns.name: Values and operators in math problems
patterns.context: Numbers, minus signs, equals signs, and fractions interleave in arithmetic problems or algebraic expressions; activations span multiple numeric fragments, with no stable single mathematical operation.

patterns.name: Data retrieval and query vocabulary
patterns.context: When dataset search, organization, or query tools are described, the name GeneInvestigator is split and marked; other related words are only sparsely marked.

4_2552.description: 激活分布在多类领域：天文量与单位、拆分的大写专名、意大利语词片段、书籍标题、数学数字运算式及数据检索名称。共同特征不明确，似偏向局部字形或分词片段，而非统一语义。

patterns.name: 天体物理量与符号
patterns.context: 天体物理文本中，数字、单位或天文符号出现在质量、光度、波长、分辨率等量的表达里；不同片段中受激位置并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 大写字母与数字构成的标识
patterns.context: 企业、产品或药品名称被拆分为大写字母片段，邻近数字、标点或普通商业文本；可能是对分词后的名称片段响应。
patterns.domain: 企业新闻稿、商业/药品文本

patterns.name: 意大利语词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 意大利语连续正文中，词被切分成多个子词，激活落在词内或词尾片段；没有明显的单一语义词类。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语议会文本

patterns.name: 章节标题与专名片段
patterns.context: 书籍章节目录式标题，含专名、地名及破折号分隔的条目；若干被标记词是分词片段。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 历史叙事/章节标题

patterns.name: 数学题中的数值与运算符
patterns.context: 算术题或代数表达式中，数字、负号、等号及分数部分交错出现；激活分布在多个数值片段，未见稳定的单一数学操作。

patterns.name: 数据检索与查询词汇
patterns.context: 描述数据集搜索、整理或查询工具时，名称 GeneInvestigator 被拆分标记；其余相关词仅少量标记。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on numbers and their fine-grained fragments, especially decimals, years, percentages, measurements, and fractions; additional local patterns include astronomical units, financial terms and company names, Dutch word fragments, and mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Fine-grained numeric fragments in numbers and decimals
patterns.context: Numbers occur in decimals, percentages, years, statistics, measurements, or mathematical fractions; they often appear alongside other digits, punctuation, or units.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, financial news, math problems, and general numeric text

patterns.name: Astronomical and physical unit symbols
patterns.context: Symbols are embedded in astronomical or astrophysical quantities, units, and LaTeX mathematical notation, such as 「0.«02»1«Å»」 and 「37.«3»1« »2«M»1«pc»」.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in company names
patterns.context: Letter fragments form company, product, or institution names, often appearing with stock, acquisition, or IPO contexts; some names are split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Economic and business indicator terms
patterns.context: Concerns investment, company finances, growth, hiring, or IPOs; some triggers are indicator terms or financial language rather than numbers.

patterns.name: Dutch word-form fragments
patterns.context: Trigger fragments occur within continuous Dutch text and span tokenized word forms, such as 「g«even»」「voorwa«arden»」「ver«oor»」.

patterns.name: Variables and operator fragments in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Variables, equals signs, minus signs, and large integers occur in fraction expressions and common-denominator problems; numeric fragments also match the numeric pattern.

4_2552.description: 激活主要落在数字及其细粒度片段上，尤其是小数、年份、百分比、测量值和分数；另有天文单位、财经词与公司名、荷兰语词片段，以及数学符号等局部模式。

patterns.name: 数字与小数中的细粒度数字片段
patterns.context: 数字出现在小数、百分比、年份、统计量、测量值或数学分数中；常见于相邻数字、标点或单位之间。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、财经新闻、数学题及一般数字文本

patterns.name: 天文与物理单位符号
patterns.context: 符号嵌在天文学或天体物理量、单位及 LaTeX 数学记号中，如「0.«02»1«Å»」和「37.«3»1« »2«M»1«pc»」。

patterns.name: 公司名称中的字母片段
patterns.context: 字母片段构成公司、产品或机构名称，常与股票、收购或 IPO 等语境共现；部分名称被分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 经济与商业指标词
patterns.context: 围绕投资、公司财务、增长、招聘或上市讨论；部分触发是指标词或财经用语本身，而非数字。
patterns.domain: 财经新闻与 HackerNews 讨论

patterns.name: 荷兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在荷兰语连续文本中，并跨越被分词切开的词形，例如「g«even»」「voorwa«arden»」「ver«oor»」。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量与运算片段
patterns.context: 变量、等号、负号和大整数出现在分数表达式与求公分母题目中；数字片段也符合数字模式。

en.description: Activations are distributed across numbers and scientific notation, formulas, and English function words; they also cover Lithuanian and Swedish subword fragments and football proper names. Overall, there is no stable single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers, dimensions, and formatted values
patterns.context: Numbers embedded in measurements, years, astronomical quantities, formulas, or math problems; often accompanied by punctuation, units, or LaTeX formatting.
patterns.domain: Scientific text, investment discussions, math problems

patterns.name: Astronomical and physical quantity symbols
patterns.context: Numbers and scientific symbols interleave in expressions of celestial observations, star formation, galaxies, or astronomical mass and luminosity.

patterns.name: Relational and function words in sentences
patterns.context: Connects noun phrases, prepositional phrases, or clauses in continuous English prose; not a fixed individual word.
patterns.domain: Papers, forum discussions, and academic prose

patterns.name: English intraword segmentation and word-form continuation
patterns.context: English words are split into multiple subword tokens, with activation falling on intraword fragments and adjacent words.

patterns.name: Lithuanian parliamentary titles and endings
patterns.context: In Lithuanian parliamentary speeches, names, party-group titles, and inflectional endings are split into subwords.

patterns.name: Swedish word-form fragments
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary text, common grammatical words, endings, and intraword fragments activate after segmentation.

patterns.name: Football player and club proper names
patterns.context: Names, teams, or places in biographies and club-career sections.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical expressions and operators
patterns.context: Variables, equations, and arithmetic expressions alternate, with values presented as text problems.

4_2552.description: 激活分散在数字与科学记号、公式及英文功能词中，也覆盖立陶宛语和瑞典语的子词片段、足球专名；整体没有稳定的单一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 数字、量纲与格式化数值
patterns.context: 数字嵌在测量值、年份、天文量、公式或数学题中；常伴随标点、单位或 LaTeX 格式
patterns.domain: 科学文本、投资讨论、数学题

patterns.name: 天文与物理量符号
patterns.context: 天体观测、恒星形成、星系或天文质量与光度的表达式中，数字和科学符号交错出现

patterns.name: 句中关系词和功能词
patterns.trigger: “« of»”“« for»”“« our»”“« from»”“« any»”“« given»”“« that»”“« the»”
patterns.context: 英文连续行文中连接名词短语、介词结构或从句；并非固定单一词项
patterns.domain: 论文、论坛讨论与学术论述

patterns.name: 英语词内拆分与词形延续
patterns.context: 英语词被切成多个子词 token，激活落在词内片段及其相邻词上

patterns.name: 立陶宛语议会称谓与词尾
patterns.context: 立陶宛语议会发言中，人名、党团称谓及屈折词尾被拆分成子词

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，常见语法词、词尾和词内片段分词激活

patterns.name: 足球运动员与俱乐部专名
patterns.context: 人物简介及俱乐部生涯段落中的姓名、球队或地名
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 体育条目

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学表达式与运算符
patterns.context: 变量、等式和算术表达式交替出现，且数值以文本题目形式给出

en.concept: Heterogeneous text fragments and numeric symbols
en.description: Activations span domains and forms: numbers and measurement expressions, formula/table symbols, URL video IDs, Dutch word fragments, and words and proper names in economic, investment, technology strategy, biomedical data retrieval, and paper acknowledgments. There is no single stable semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Numbers and measurement units/symbols
patterns.context: Numbers occur in measurements, astronomical distances and luminosities, economic growth rates, or years; some activations fall on the numbers themselves, while others fall on adjacent units or formatting symbols.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, economic news, forum commentary, and other domains

patterns.name: Table and mathematical typesetting symbols
patterns.context: Symbols occur in table headings or formula-like formatting with multiple columns of variables, mass indicators, and references.

patterns.name: Video IDs in YouTube links
patterns.context: Located within a video identifier in a YouTube URL, with characters marked in sequence; these are not ordinary body-text words.

patterns.name: Economic growth and hiring prospects
patterns.context: Discusses current-quarter economic growth expectations and economists’ views on hiring.

patterns.name: Internal Dutch word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered within tokenized Dutch words concerning fair competition, new member states, and institutional arrangements; no clear corresponding English semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Investment optimization and missed buying opportunities
patterns.context: A forum post reflects on how it is impossible to optimize every trade, using the timing of Apple stock purchases as an example.

patterns.name: Long-term trends and strategic rationale
patterns.context: Discusses the long-term trend toward more manufacturers making custom chips and the strategic significance of Google acting early.

patterns.name: Data retrieval and genomics resource names
patterns.context: Describes a search tool for querying and organizing datasets and names a genomics resource.

patterns.name: Acknowledgments and funding-agency abbreviations
patterns.context: Appears in paper acknowledgments, institution names, and funding-program abbreviations; abbreviations may be proper names split into subwords.

4_2552.concept: 异质文本片段与数字符号
4_2552.description: 激活分布跨领域且形态多样：包括数字及计量表达、公式/表格符号、URL 视频 ID、荷兰语词片段，以及经济、投资、科技战略、生物数据检索和论文致谢中的词语与专名。没有单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字与计量单位/符号
patterns.context: 数字嵌在测量、天文距离与光度、经济增长率或年份等数值表达中；部分激活落在数字自身，部分落在相邻单位或格式符号上。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、经济新闻、论坛评论等多领域文本

patterns.name: 表格与数学排版符号
patterns.context: 符号出现在包含多列变量、质量指标和参考文献的表格标题或公式化排版中。

patterns.name: YouTube 链接中的视频 ID
patterns.trigger: «J»«F»«pr»«j»«6»«v»«37»«Q»，以及后续链接中相似的字符序列
patterns.context: 位于 YouTube URL 的视频标识符内，字符被逐段标记；并非普通正文词语。

patterns.name: 经济增长与招聘前景
patterns.context: 讨论当季经济增长预期及经济学家对招聘的看法。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在被切分的荷兰语词内部，涉及公平竞争、新成员国及制度安排；未见明确对应的英文语义模式。

patterns.name: 投资最大化与错过买入时机
patterns.context: 论坛发言反思不可能在每笔交易中都做到最优，并以苹果股票买入时间为例。

patterns.name: 长期趋势与战略理由

en.concept: Local importance expressions and structured symbols
en.description: Primarily responds to the Swedish parliamentary-text emphasis words “viktigt/viktig,” especially “är viktigt” and subsequent explanations; it also responds independently to astronomical spectral values, solar-mass table headers, and JSON key structure.

patterns.name: Swedish “important” word forms
