patterns.name: Numbers and units in astronomical spectra
patterns.context: Values are adjacent to the Å wavelength unit in spectral processing descriptions; the same passage also includes signal-to-noise ratio, resolution, and HARPS.

patterns.name: Solar-mass notation in astronomical tables
patterns.context: A table header uses solar masses as the unit, with masses and their differences listed nearby.

patterns.name: JSON device-reading key names

4_2552.concept: 局部重要性表达及结构化符号

patterns.name: 瑞典语“重要”词形

patterns.name: 天文光谱中的数字与单位

Apart from local terms in each passage, no unified semantic or stylistic trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Connecting-rod terminology in patents

patterns.name: Quantitative wording in medical diagnosis

patterns.name: Baseball team names

patterns.name: Cell differentiation and microenvironmental signals

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and numerical values in heterogeneous text

en.description: Activations are scattered across the beginnings of proper names, technical word fragments, numerical expressions, and biomedical terminology; a few instances involve baseball headlines and people named in emails. Some triggers may be subword fragments rather than stable semantic categories, and the architecture segment remains difficult to explain.

patterns.name: First word of a place or institution name
patterns.context: The beginning of names in proper nouns or headlines, especially place, institution, or brand names; some names are split across adjacent tokens.
patterns.domain: Sports headlines, product listings, news, or general explanatory prose

patterns.name: Root or intraword fragment in a technical term
patterns.context: Occurs within longer technical words or compound names; activation may fall on an initial fragment rather than the complete word.

patterns.name: Quantity, measurement, or statistical expression
patterns.context: Numbers or measurement expressions occur in headlines, scores, or technical parameters; current examples are scattered and show no consistent format.

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology and diagnostic context
patterns.context: In medical or biological text, terms occur in descriptions of disease diagnosis, cell differentiation, or testing technologies.

patterns.name: Baseball-related expressions
patterns.context: Headlines and reports related to teams, tickets, or game conditions; activation falls on sports-related terms or proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: Political figure names or titles
patterns.context: Emails and their subject lines mention assistant titles, names, or forms of address, near project briefing content.

patterns.name: Sentence-internal function words with no stable pattern

4_2839.description: 激活分散于专名开头、技术词片段、数字表达及生物医学术语；少数实例涉及棒球标题和邮件人名。部分触发可能是词片段而非稳定语义类别，建筑段仍难解释。

patterns.context: 仅在各自特定句子中出现，未见共同的局部句法或语义条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across subword fragments, proper nouns, titles, and technical or medical terms. The clearest repeated cues are “Visual” and “reciprocating”; most others occur in isolated contexts and are difficult to group under a single meaning.

patterns.name: The in-word fragment “Visual”
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the longer word Visualization; also occurs in a module name in code comments.
patterns.domain: Medical imaging titles, GitHub code comments

patterns.name: The in-word fragment “reciprocating”
patterns.context: Appears in technical contexts describing reciprocating pistons or pumps; activation falls on a split word fragment.

patterns.name: Baseball team names and event text
patterns.context: Proper nouns and years in team names, scores, or event titles; activation positions are not consistent.

patterns.name: Fungal genus “Clausenomyces”
patterns.context: The genus name is split into multiple subword fragments that recur.

patterns.name: Prominent formatting in titles or keywords
patterns.context: A title word or year receives activation in a paragraph-opening heading or event title; its relation to other trigger patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: Left ventricle and cardiomyopathy terminology
patterns.context: A medical paper title describes left ventricular rotation and cardiomyopathy; activation concentrates on terminology and quantitative words.

patterns.name: Stem cell differentiation
patterns.context: Paper text describes stem cells maintaining an undifferentiated state and beginning to differentiate after receiving signals.

patterns.name: Comment separators and toolkit names in code
patterns.context: Comment blocks, separators, and module names at the top of code files.

4_2839.description: 激活分散于拆分词片段、专名、标题和技术或医学术语；较明确的重复线索是“Visual”与“reciprocating”，其余多为孤立语境，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 词内片段“Visual”
patterns.context: 在较长单词 Visualization 的词首出现；也见于代码注释中的模块名。
patterns.domain: 医学影像标题、GitHub 代码注释

patterns.name: “reciprocating”词内片段

patterns.name: 棒球队名与赛事文本

en.concept: reciproc root and sporadic word-form patterns
en.description: Most passages trigger on the “reciproc” root across different meanings and word forms, including mechanical reciprocation, mutual relations, and membrane-reactor terminology; there are also activations in a sports headline and within the proper name “Claussenomyces.”

patterns.name: reciproc root
patterns.context: The root appears in complete words or compound terms; it can refer to mechanical reciprocating motion, mutual relations or reactions, or the name of a membrane bioreactor.
patterns.domain: Patents, medical papers, forums, public-policy articles

patterns.name: Plural/doubles forms in event names
patterns.context: Sports team names, ticket listings, or event headlines; activations are scattered across names and event-related words, with no clear shared local root.

patterns.name: Subword fragment within a proper name
patterns.context: These fragments consecutively form the proper name “Claussenomyces”; the context consists of isolated encyclopedia entry headings and repeated entries.

4_2839.description: 多数段落在不同语义和词形中触发“reciproc”词根，涵盖机械往复、相互关系及膜反应器术语；另有体育标题和“Claussenomyces”专名内部片段激活。

patterns.name: reciproc 词根

en.description: Activations concentrate in DM Mathematics symbolic-operation text: expansion, polynomial products, differentiation, and rearrangement into a specified form. They also cover expressions, powers, coefficients, and short answer fragments in these tasks; it is difficult to fully distinguish activation to local expressions from activation to instructions.

patterns.name: Expand-expression instructions
patterns.context: An instruction to expand a product or polynomial appears near variables with powers, coefficients, or products; both the instruction words and nearby expressions may contribute to activation.

patterns.name: Differentiation instructions and variable definitions
patterns.context: Requests differentiation with respect to a given variable or a specified-order derivative, typically adjacent to polynomials and variable names; activation may also fall near derivative expressions.

patterns.name: Rearrangement into a specified form
patterns.context: Requests rewriting a variable expression into a specified form, often with a subtask such as “and give” a coefficient.

patterns.name: Polynomial products and expansion-result fragments
patterns.context: Local expressions from product or polynomial calculations; some activations occur outside instructions, in answers or problems, and may not be triggered by a specific instruction.

patterns.name: Isolated activations near short answers and line breaks
patterns.context: Near short expressions or answers at the start of a passage or after a line break, with insufficient context to identify a distinct semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics problem and answer fragments

4_2839.description: 激活集中于 DM 数学符号运算语料：展开、多项式乘积、求导及重排成指定形式，也覆盖这些任务中的算式、幂、系数和短答案片段；难以将局部算式激活与指令触发完全区分。

patterns.name: 展开代数式指令

patterns.name: 求导指令及变量说明

patterns.name: 重排成指定形式

patterns.name: 多项式乘积与展开结果片段

patterns.name: 短答案及换行附近的孤立激活

patterns.domain: 网页元数据或发布信息

patterns.name: 美国上诉法院案头信息
patterns.context: 当事人、案号、法院与判决日期构成的法律案件标题。

patterns.name: 药物相互作用与监测
patterns.context: 讨论药物开始或停用后，对患者进行临床监测。

patterns.name: 生理实验标题
patterns.context: 以标题式短语描述离体动物器官的实验研究。

patterns.name: 人物履历列表
patterns.context: 以姓名、职位、机构及简短身份说明组成条目。

patterns.name: 高产临床检测语境
patterns.context: 描述检测站点选择及快速识别的应用场景。

en.concept: certiorari procedural marker in legal text
en.description: The strongest recurring trigger is certiorari in legal text (petition, grant, or denial), especially in U.S. case titles and procedural records. Other localized triggers include the legal phrase well settled, the name Sherman, El Khairy in a medical citation, and Judge Graham in a judge disambiguation entry.

patterns.name: Certiorari terminology
patterns.context: In Supreme Court case titles, procedural histories, or judicial opinions, certiorari appears as a petition, grant, or denial; the word triggers strongly regardless of capitalization.
patterns.domain: U.S. judicial opinions and case records

patterns.name: settled in legal opinions
patterns.context: In legal reasoning, “well settled” introduces an established rule of law.

patterns.name: The name Sherman
patterns.context: The name Sherman appears in criminal case fact summaries, especially near references to defendants, accomplices, and charges.

patterns.name: The cited name El Khairy
patterns.context: The author surname El Khairy appears in a biomedical paper’s reference citation.

patterns.name: Judge Graham entry
patterns.context: A person disambiguation entry lists a judge’s name; the same passage also mentions other judges and court positions.

4_2839.concept: 法律文本中的 certiorari 程序标记
4_2839.description: 最强而反复的触发是法律文本中的 certiorari（申请、受理或拒绝），尤其出现在美国案件标题和程序记录。另有法律固定语 well settled、Sherman 人名、医学引用中的 El Khairy，以及法官消歧词条中的 Judge Graham 等局部触发。

patterns.name: Certiorari 术语
patterns.context: 最高法院案件标题、程序经过或司法意见中，出现 certiorari 的申请、批准或拒绝；该词无论大小写均强烈触发。
patterns.domain: 美国司法判决与案件记录

patterns.name: 法律判决中的 settled
patterns.context: 法律论证中以“well settled”引出已确立的法律规则。

patterns.name: Sherman 人名
patterns.context: 刑事案件事实叙述中出现 Sherman 姓名，尤其与被告、共犯及指控相邻。

patterns.name: El Khairy 引文姓名
patterns.context: 医学论文的参考文献标记中出现作者姓氏 El Khairy。

patterns.name: Graham 法官词条
patterns.context: 人物消歧条目中列出法官姓名；同段还出现多位法官及法院职务。

en.description: Responds to proper nouns and components of institutional names across domains, and often appears in structured lists, titles, statutes, tables, and news summaries. Legal opinions, corporate and institutional names, and research organizations all trigger; no single stable word sense is evident.

patterns.name: Military legal provisions and charge lists
patterns.context: Military justice opinions list charges, offenses, specifications, and provisions of the Uniform Code of Military Justice, often with line breaks and section numbers.

patterns.name: Generic terms in institutional or organizational names
patterns.context: A type of institution or name component in proper nouns, such as a company, research institution, religious organization, record label, or bank; some triggers occur at the end or within a name.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain proper nouns, including encyclopedia, research, email, and legal text

patterns.name: Legal proceedings and judgment language
patterns.context: Civil litigation describes judgments, motions, liability, or bankruptcy provisions, commonly in court opinions.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw, civil opinions and bankruptcy law

patterns.name: Place names and numbered records in tables
patterns.context: List entries separated by tabs and line breaks, with a numeric identifier following a place name or category.
patterns.domain: Tables or administrative data in Enron emails

patterns.name: Place-related religious organizations and practices
patterns.context: Introduces Buddhist or Taoist institutions, branches, or practices in a particular place.

patterns.name: Methods-section heading in research papers
patterns.context: A paper transitions from earlier material to materials and methods, experimental design, and descriptions of research institutions.

patterns.name: News-style business contract reporting
patterns.context: Company news or email summaries report contract awards or agreements, interspersed with company and place names.
patterns.domain: Business news summaries in Enron emails

patterns.name: Record production information in encyclopedia entries
patterns.context: A musician or album entry describes an album’s release region, record label, and producer.

patterns.name: Companies and positions in legal text
patterns.context: Case background describes a deceased person’s or party’s company ownership, position, and other corporate relationships.

patterns.name: Resource project news in Enron emails
patterns.context: Reports that an environmental organization has filed a lawsuit over an oil and gas project, then shifts to other business news.

4_2839.concept: 专名与结构化文本标记
4_2839.description: 响应跨领域的专名与机构名称成分，也常出现在结构化列举、标题、条文、表格和新闻摘要中；法律判决、企业机构名、科研组织等均有触发，未见单一稳定词义。

patterns.name: Military 法律条文与罪名列举
patterns.context: 军事司法判决中列出指控、罪名、规格及《统一军事司法法典》条款，常伴随换行和条款编号。

patterns.name: 机构或组织名称中的泛称词
patterns.context: 专名中的机构类型或名称组成部分，如公司、研究机构、宗教组织、唱片公司或银行；部分触发位于名称末尾或名称内部。
patterns.domain: 跨领域专名，包括百科、科研、邮件和法律文本

patterns.name: 法律程序与判决表达
patterns.context: 民事诉讼叙述判决、动议、责任或破产法条款，常见于法院裁判文本。

patterns.name: 表格中的地名与编号记录
patterns.context: 以制表符和换行分隔的清单条目，地名或类别后接数字识别码。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的表格或行政数据

patterns.name: 地点相关的宗教组织与实践
patterns.context: 介绍某地的佛教、道教机构、分支或实践。

patterns.name: 科研论文的方法部分标题
patterns.context: 论文从前文转入材料与方法、实验设计及研究机构介绍。

patterns.name: 新闻式商业合同报道
patterns.context: 公司新闻或邮件摘要报道授予合同、达成协议，夹杂公司与地点名称。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的商业新闻摘要

patterns.name: 百科条目中的唱片制作信息
patterns.context: 音乐人或专辑条目叙述专辑发行地区、唱片公司和制作人。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的企业与职务叙述
patterns.context: 案件背景介绍死者或当事人的公司所有权、职务及其他企业关系。

patterns.name: Enron 邮件中的资源项目新闻
patterns.context: 报道环保组织针对油气项目提起诉讼，随后转入其他商业新闻。

en.concept: judge titles in U.S. judicial documents
en.description: Responds primarily to Judge and to court positions, institutions, and opinion formats in U.S. legal contexts, especially judge titles. A few isolated word fragments also occur: Helicobacter, theorised, and Geophysics.

patterns.name: Judge titles
patterns.context: Judge is the core trigger after a judge’s name or within a title; preceding titles and judicial role names vary.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, legal documents, and judge biographies; passage [3] also contains an adjacent academic-position context

patterns.name: Judicial institutions and legal-document formats
patterns.context: Occurs in fixed formats such as U.S. judicial institutions, judge signatures, or opinion headings; in some passages this pattern co-occurs with the “Judge” title.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal documents and judiciary-related biographies

patterns.name: Helicobacter name fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls within the bacterial genus name Helicobacter, in a paper title about a new species; it has no clear relation to the judicial theme.

patterns.name: Ending of theorised
patterns.context: Triggered at the ending of the British English verb theorised, in an abstract sentence about galaxy clusters and star formation; it has no clear relation to the judicial theme.

patterns.name: Geophysics position-word ending
patterns.context: Activation occurs in the middle and at the end of Geophysics, in a person’s academic biography and position list; this is not an explicit judicial context.
patterns.domain: Scientific institutions and academic positions in biographies

4_2839.concept: 美国司法文书中的法官头衔
4_2839.description: 主要响应美国司法语境中的 Judge 及法院职务、机构和判决文书格式，尤其是法官头衔；另有少数孤立词片段：Helicobacter、theorised、Geophysics。

patterns.name: 法官头衔
patterns.context: 法官姓名之后或职务称谓中，Judge 是核心触发词；前置头衔与司法职务名称有所不同。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律文书及法官传记；段 [3] 也出现相邻的学术职务语境

patterns.name: 司法机构与法律文书格式
patterns.context: 出现在美国司法机关、法官署名或判决标题等固定格式中；本模式在部分段落与“Judge”头衔同时出现。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书及司法相关传记

patterns.name: Helicobacter 学名片段
patterns.context: 触发落在细菌属名 Helicobacter 的词内，位于研究新物种的论文标题中；与司法主题无明显关系。

patterns.name: theorised 词尾
patterns.context: 触发于英国英语动词 theorised 的词尾，出现在关于星系团及恒星形成的摘要句中；与司法主题无明显关系。

patterns.name: 地球物理职务词尾
patterns.context: Geophysics 一词中部及词尾出现激活，处于人物学术履历和职务列表里；并非明确的法官语境。
patterns.domain: 人物传记中的科学机构与学术职务

en.concept: -ist endings in theorist and occupational nouns
en.description: Strong responses primarily occur on theor- and word-form fragments such as -ist/-ised, covering theorists, theorizing, and various occupational titles; there are also weak academic suffixes and several local activations with no obvious pattern.

patterns.name: theorist/theoretical word forms
patterns.context: The theor root combines with endings such as -ist/-ised to refer to a theorist or someone proposing a theory; it can be used in personal titles or to describe proposing a theory.

patterns.name: -ist in occupational names
patterns.context: Occupation or identity nouns ending in -ist; activation falls on the suffix fragment and is especially evident in biographies, titles, or lists of professions.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographies, institutional profiles, occupational titles

patterns.name: Mixed or adjacent morphology
patterns.context: Words with endings such as -ic/-ive/-ly occur in academic prose, but activation is weaker; this may relate to the dominant suffix pattern or may simply be adjacent co-occurrence.

patterns.name: Scientific contexts not covered by the patterns above
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur in scientific or medical text, but their relation to explicit theor/occupational -ist triggers is unclear.

patterns.name: Local word fragments not covered by the patterns above
patterns.context: Local word-fragment activations occur without a stable surrounding suffix or semantic pattern.

4_2839.concept: 理论家及职业名词的-ist词尾
4_2839.description: 主要对 theor- 与 -ist/-ised 等词形片段强烈响应，涵盖理论家、理论化及多类职业称谓；另有弱的学术词尾和若干无明显规律的局部激活。

patterns.name: theorist/theoretical 词形
patterns.context: 词根 theor 与 -ist/-ised 等词尾组合，指理论家或提出理论；可用于人物称谓，也可用于描述提出某理论。
patterns.domain: 哲学、学术论文、人物传记

patterns.name: 职业名称中的 -ist
patterns.context: 职业或身份名词以 -ist 结尾；激活落在词尾片段，人物简介、职衔或职业列表中尤明显。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、机构履历、职业称谓

patterns.name: 混合或邻近形态
patterns.context: 学术散文中出现带有 -ic/-ive/-ly 等词尾的词，但激活较弱，可能与主导的词尾形态规律有关，亦可能只是邻近共现。

patterns.name: 未能归入上述模式的科学语境
patterns.context: 科研或医学文本中有零散激活，但与明确的 theor/职业 -ist 词尾触发关系不清楚。

patterns.name: 未能归入上述模式的局部词片
patterns.context: 局部词片激活，周围上下文未显示稳定的词尾或语义模式。

en.description: The most stable cue is the ending of theorised/theorized in academic contexts; other activations are scattered across the endings of professional or disciplinary names, company names and legal abbreviations, letters in opinion headings, and patent plural endings. They do not form a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Ending of theorised/theorized
patterns.context: Activation falls on the endings of theorise/theorize and their past participles; contexts involve views, mechanisms, or phenomena being proposed or given a theoretical explanation.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, including physics, philosophy, and astrophysics

patterns.name: Endings of professions and disciplines
patterns.context: Activation occurs near endings of words denoting professional identities, disciplines, or research fields; they do not all share the same morphology or fixed meaning.
patterns.domain: Medical history, biographies, and academic introductions

patterns.name: Endings and punctuation in company names
patterns.context: Activation is located at the ends of company names or abbreviations in legal text, often near capital letters, periods, or plural markers.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in opinion headings
patterns.context: Activation falls on individual letters in all-caps headings; available examples are insufficient to determine whether there is a stable meaning.

patterns.name: Plural endings of patent-related words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the plural ending of patent, in a business and intellectual-property promotional context.

4_2839.description: 最稳定的线索是学术语境中 theorised/theorized 的词尾；其余激活零散落在专业或学科名称词尾、公司与法律缩写、判决标题字母及专利复数词尾，无法归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: theorised/theorized 的词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 theorise/theorize 及其过去分词的词尾；上下文涉及观点、机制或现象被提出或形成理论解释。
patterns.domain: 学术写作，涵盖物理、哲学、天体物理

patterns.name: 职业与学科名称词尾
patterns.context: 激活出现在表示专业身份、学科或研究领域的词尾附近；并非都属于同一词形或固定语义。
patterns.domain: 医学史、传记与学术介绍

patterns.name: 公司名称中的词尾及标点
patterns.context: 激活位于公司名称或法律文本缩写中的词尾，周围常有大写字母、句点或复数标记。

patterns.name: 判决标题中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在全大写标题中单个字母位置；现有例子不足以判断是否有稳定语义。

patterns.name: 专利相关词的复数词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在专利一词的复数词尾，处于商业与知识产权宣传语境。

en.concept: Recognition of English word endings and format subwords
en.description: Activations most clearly fall on the endings of theorised/theorized and repeatedly on the period in the abbreviation Gen.; there are also theory titles, formatting markers, legal titles, and subwords in several names or URLs, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: Past participle form theorised
patterns.context: Describes a viewpoint, version, or astrophysical process that was theorized; activation falls on the ending subword.

patterns.name: Past participle form theorized
patterns.context: Describes a physical process that was theorized; activation falls on the ending subword.

patterns.name: Military rank abbreviation Gen.
patterns.context: Appears before a person's name as a rank abbreviation, or in the Gen. No. format of a legal document; the period token activates especially strongly.
patterns.domain: News narratives, legal documents, email, film materials

patterns.name: Theory term in a paper title
patterns.context: Occurs in a paper or section heading as part of the name of an academic theory.

patterns.name: Morpheme in a web URL
patterns.context: Occurs within the word “chemists” in a news-link URL.

patterns.name: Formatting punctuation in a legal citation
patterns.context: Occurs in formatted text in a legal case title or party list.

patterns.name: Court title
patterns.context: Occurs in the court name “Supreme Court of Nevada”.

patterns.name: Quotation marker
patterns.context: Occurs at the start of lines in quoted email text, including repeated quotation markers.

patterns.name: LaTeX/Markdown section marker
patterns.context: A section heading marker in paper text, composed of braces and an anchor.

patterns.name: Specific subword in a person's name
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented fragments of a person's name or surname; these fragments occur in academic citations, officers' names, legal personnel names, and cast lists.
patterns.domain: Academic citations, news, legal documents, film materials

4_2839.concept: 英语词尾及格式子词识别
4_2839.description: 激活最明显地落在 theorised/theorized 的词尾，并多次出现在 Gen. 缩写的句点；另有理论标题、格式标记、法律称谓及若干姓名或 URL 子词，缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: theorised 的分词形式
patterns.context: 描述某种观点、版本或天体物理过程曾被理论化；激活落在词尾子词上。

patterns.name: theorized 的分词形式
patterns.context: 描述某一物理过程曾被理论化；激活落在词尾子词上。

patterns.name: Gen. 军衔缩写
patterns.context: 出现在人名之前，作为军衔缩写，或出现在法律文书的 Gen. No. 格式中；句点 token 激活尤其强。
patterns.domain: 新闻叙述、法律文书、邮件、影视资料

patterns.name: 论文标题中的理论术语
patterns.context: 位于论文标题或小节标题中，作为学术理论名称的一部分。

patterns.name: 网页 URL 中的词素
patterns.context: 出现在新闻链接 URL 的单词“chemists”内部。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的格式标点
patterns.context: 位于法律案例标题或当事人列表的格式化文本中。

patterns.name: 法庭称谓
patterns.context: 出现在法院名称“Supreme Court of Nevada”中。

patterns.name: 引文标记
patterns.context: 出现在邮件引用文本的行首，包括连续的引用标记。

patterns.name: LaTeX/Markdown 小节标记
patterns.context: 论文正文中以花括号和锚点构成的小节标题标记。

patterns.name: 人名中的特定子词
patterns.context: 激活落在人名或姓氏的分词片段上；这些片段分别出现在学术引用、军官姓名、法律人员姓名和演员表中。
patterns.domain: 学术引文、新闻、法律文书、影视资料

en.description: The clearest pattern is the ending of theorized/theorised; it also responds to the military abbreviation Gen. and to punctuation such as periods and commas. Other activations mostly occur in scattered subwords within proper nouns, conjunctions, and isolated words, and are difficult to group; 9 has no clear correspondence.

patterns.name: Participial suffix in theorised
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the -ized/-ised ending after theor-; the word can occur in passive constructions or academic statements with that-clauses.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, philosophical discussion, encyclopedia history

patterns.name: Periods and abbreviation punctuation
patterns.context: Periods often follow initials, titles, or legal citations; commas occur after names, titles, or coordinated elements. Sometimes the activation marker falls on the punctuation token.

patterns.name: Gen. abbreviation
patterns.context: Gen. is an abbreviation for a military rank or formal title, usually before a person’s name; it also occurs in narratives mentioning generals.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, military-related narratives, film and television cast lists

patterns.name: Subwords within proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls within subwords of proper nouns or common words, with meanings unrelated to theorised or punctuation patterns.
patterns.domain: Legal case titles, name lists, news headlines

patterns.name: Conjunctions in lists and titles
patterns.context: Activation follows conjunctions such as and and of in titles or fixed names.

patterns.name: Scattered high-frequency words and symbols
patterns.context: These activations occur in different syntactic environments, with no clear shared local condition in the current sample.
patterns.domain: Academic text, email, encyclopedia prose, etc.

4_2839.concept: 理论化词尾与缩写标点
4_2839.description: 最清楚的模式是 theorized/theorised 的词尾；另对 Gen. 军衔缩写及句点、逗号等标点有反应。其余多为分散的专名内部子词、连接词和零散词，难以归并；9 无清晰对应。

patterns.name: theorised 的分词后缀
patterns.context: 激活集中在 theor- 后接的 -ized/-ised 词尾；词可出现在被动或带 that 从句的学术陈述中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、哲学论述、百科历史

patterns.name: 句号与缩写标点
patterns.context: 句点常紧跟姓名首字母缩写、头衔或法律引注；逗号出现于姓名、称谓或并列成分之后。激活标记有时落在标点 token。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、人物介绍、叙述性文字

patterns.name: Gen. 缩写
patterns.context: Gen. 作为军衔或正式称谓缩写，通常出现在人名之前；也见于提及将领的叙述。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、军事相关叙述、影视人物表

patterns.name: 专名内部的词尾或子词
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或普通词的内部子词，语义与 theorised 或标点模式并不一致。
patterns.domain: 法律案件标题、人物名单、新闻标题

patterns.name: 列表及标题中的连接成分
patterns.trigger: Cast« and»4 characters、« Supreme» Court« of» Nevada
patterns.context: 标题或固定名称中的 and、of 等连接词后出现激活。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、法律判决标题

patterns.name: 零散高频词与符号
patterns.trigger: « time»、« have»、« long»、« sent»、«>»、« small»、« discovered»
patterns.context: 这些激活分布于不同句法环境，当前样本中没有明确共享的局部条件。
patterns.domain: 学术文本、邮件、百科叙述等

en.description: Activations commonly occur in people's names, occupational titles, and formal identity descriptions, and also prominently on the period in the abbreviation Gen.; playwright category terms and Fortran/Cython technical words also occur, so the pattern cannot be reduced to a single semantic mode.

patterns.name: Period after the abbreviation Gen.
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the abbreviation Gen. in military ranks, names, or legal citations; it is often followed by a person's name, but may also be followed by a line break or an institution name.

patterns.name: Person names in occupational or identity titles
patterns.context: Occurs in biographies, job titles, or occupational descriptions, with activation on parts of the title or occupation word; no specific domain is required.
patterns.domain: News, institutional reports, legal, medical history

patterns.name: Gen. citation format in legal citations
patterns.context: In citations in state laws or voter guides, the abbreviation and following institution name form a formal citation.

patterns.name: Playwright category labels
patterns.context: In encyclopedia category lists, the word refers to playwrights and often appears alongside categories such as American, women, or century.

patterns.name: Fortran/Cython technical terms
patterns.context: Discusses calling Fortran routines from Python/Cython and related web resources; activation falls on technical term fragments.

4_2839.description: 激活常见于人名、职业称谓及正式身份介绍，也显著落在 Gen. 缩写的句点；另见剧作家分类词和 Fortran/Cython 技术词，无法归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 缩写 Gen. 后的句点
patterns.context: 激活集中在军事军衔、人名或法律引文中的缩写 Gen.；其后常接人名，也可能换行或继续机构名称。

patterns.name: 职业或身份称谓中的人物名称
patterns.context: 出现在人物介绍、职务称谓或职业描述中，激活落在称谓或职业词的组成部分；不要求特定领域。
patterns.domain: 新闻、机构报告、法律、医学史

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 Gen. 引用格式
patterns.context: 州法或选民指南的引文中，缩写与后续机构名称构成正式引用。

patterns.name: 剧作家类别标签
patterns.context: 百科分类列表中，词语指称剧作家，常与美国、女性或世纪等分类条件并列。

patterns.name: Fortran/Cython 技术词
patterns.context: 讨论从 Python/Cython 调用 Fortran 例程及相关网页资源；激活落在技术术语片段。

en.description: The most stable cue is the abbreviation “Gen.”, found in military-rank descriptions and various documents. Occupational suffixes and legal titles also activate, but trigger locations vary, and some local word instances cannot be explained consistently.

patterns.name: Military-rank abbreviation Gen.
patterns.context: Appears before a name or military rank, or in the titles and quotations of legal documents; usually abbreviated, often followed by a name or position
patterns.domain: Military narratives, legal cases, cast lists, and quotations

patterns.name: Occupational and title suffixes
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of a person’s identity, occupation, or formal position; trigger locations are inconsistent and may reflect suffix morphology or a local pattern related to titles
patterns.domain: Research projects, academic biographies, news commentary, and hospital narratives

patterns.name: Legal case titles and formal forms of address
patterns.context: Lists of parties, case numbers, and court names in legal cases; this pattern overlaps with the abbreviation “Gen.”

patterns.name: Gen. Sam Worden cast listings
patterns.context: Military-rank abbreviation before a character name in a cast list
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, film and television cast lists

patterns.name: Nearby words around particular names or quotations
patterns.context: Local neighboring words vary across passages, with no common condition supported by the examples
patterns.domain: Emails, project applications, historical narratives, and scientific papers

4_2839.description: 最稳定的线索是缩写“Gen.”，见于军衔叙述与多种文书；另有职业词尾及法律标题周边激活，但触发位置不一，部分局部词例无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 军衔缩写 Gen.
patterns.trigger: “Gen.”，尤其是“Gen”后接句点；强激活落在缩写内部或其后，如 “Gen«.»10” 和 “Gen«.»9”
patterns.context: 出现在人名或军衔前，或法律文书的标题、引文中；多为缩写形式，常接姓名或职务
patterns.domain: 军事叙述、法律判例、演员表及引文

patterns.name: 职业与头衔词尾
patterns.context: 出现于人物身份、职业或正式职务的描述中；但触发位置并不一致，可能是词尾形态或与头衔相关的局部模式
patterns.domain: 科研项目、学术简介、新闻评论、医院叙述

patterns.name: 法律案件标题与正式称谓
patterns.context: 法律判例中的当事人列举、案件编号和法院名称；本模式与“Gen.”缩写重叠

patterns.name: Gen. Sam Worden演员表
patterns.context: 演员表中角色名之前的军衔缩写

patterns.name: 特定姓名或引文邻近词
patterns.context: 各段局部邻近词各异，未形成可由样例支持的共同条件
patterns.domain: 邮件、项目申请、历史叙述、科学论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across punctuation boundaries, intraword subwords, proper names, and formal noun phrases; legal boilerplate, committee names, lists, exercise counts, and medical brain-region terminology also occur. No stable, unified semantic trigger is evident across the passages.

patterns.name: Quotation mark/angle bracket closing delimiters
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on punctuation or quotation-mark tokens; they often occur at the boundaries of citations, quotations, abbreviations, or list items, with no fixed surrounding words.

patterns.name: Intraword continuation in proper names or terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of proper names, compounds, or technical terms, often at the end or inside a word; word classes and meanings vary widely.

patterns.name: Prepositions/connectives in noun phrases
patterns.context: Connecting elements in longer noun phrases such as institution, committee, service, or research-project names; the same kinds of function words activate in different contexts.
patterns.domain: Energy news, research administration and grant text

patterns.name: Institution and committee names
patterns.context: Occurs in a series of formal organization or committee names, with activation tending toward words and subwords within the names.

patterns.name: Legal procedural language
patterns.context: Procedural expressions in court decisions or case narratives; the words form conventional legal-document phrasing.

patterns.name: Judicial ruling statements in citations
patterns.context: Legal reasoning that describes a standard of review and upholds a lower court ruling.

patterns.name: Quantity and noun repetition
patterns.context: In a conversation about training frequency, numbers and plural nouns recur to describe the number of practices relative to a competitor.

patterns.name: Subword in academic medical terminology
patterns.context: An intraword fragment in an anatomical brain-region name, appearing in a list of brain regions.

patterns.name: Colloquial threats and historical joking in emails
patterns.context: A colloquial threat is followed by joking about Civil War figures and monuments; activation positions include quotation boundaries and name/word-ending fragments.

patterns.name: Cast lists of people and works
patterns.context: Actors and characters are listed in the “actor as character” format; activation involves names and rank abbreviations.

patterns.name: Awards and annual lists
patterns.context: Honors, personal titles, and list descriptions organized by year; activation falls on years, quantities, or intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Energy industry terminology
patterns.context: Industry noun phrases in reports about energy services and power-distribution companies, with activation on ordinary words and intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Research grant application terminology
patterns.context: “Pilot Intervention and Services Research Grants” in a project name is segmented into multiple subword fragments.

4_2839.description: 激活分散于标点边界、词内子词、专名及正式名词短语；另见法律套语、委员会名称、名单、练习次数和医学脑区术语。各段未显示稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 引号/尖括号结束符
patterns.context: 激活集中在标点或引号 token；常位于引文、引语、缩写或列举条目边界，周围词语不固定。

patterns.name: 专名或术语的词内续接
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、复合词或专业术语的子词片段上，常处于词尾或词内；词类和语义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 历史/人物、奖项、影视、体育、医学

patterns.name: 名词短语中的介词/连接词
patterns.context: 在机构、委员会、服务或研究项目等较长名词短语中连接成分；同一类功能词在不同语境均有激活。
patterns.domain: 能源新闻、科研行政与资助文本

patterns.name: 机构与委员会名称
patterns.context: 出现在一连串正式组织或委员会名称中，激活偏向名称中的词及其子词。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目/机构行政文本

patterns.name: 法律程序用语
patterns.context: 法院判决或案件叙述中的程序性表达，词语组成法律文书惯用句式。

patterns.name: 引文中的司法裁判表述
patterns.context: 描述审查标准及维持下级法院裁决的法律论证语句。

patterns.name: 数量与名词复现
patterns.context: 围绕训练次数的对话中，数字与复数名词反复出现，描述落后于竞争者的练习次数。

patterns.name: 学术医学术语子词
patterns.context: 解剖学脑区名称的词内片段，出现在脑区清单中。

patterns.name: 邮件中的口语威胁与历史调侃
patterns.context: 先有口语化威胁，再转入关于南北战争人物与纪念碑的调侃；激活位置包括引文边界和人名/词尾。

patterns.name: 人物与作品演职员表
patterns.context: 演员与角色以“演员 as 角色”的格式排列，激活涉及姓名和军衔缩写。

patterns.name: 奖项与年度名单
patterns.context: 按年份列出的荣誉、人物称号及榜单描述，激活落在年份、数量或词内片段。

patterns.name: 能源行业用语
patterns.context: 能源服务与配电公司相关报道中的行业名词短语，激活于普通词和词内片段。

patterns.name: 科研资助申请术语
patterns.context: 项目名称中的“Pilot Intervention and Services Research Grants”被切分成多个子词片段。

en.description: Activation is scattered across text from many domains, mainly on subword fragments or boundaries within English words. Common forms include medical, technical, and proper-name terms, but there is no stable semantic theme; email quotation markers also activate.

patterns.name: -ic fragments within or at word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation often falls within English words split by BPE, especially on word-final or internal fragments; not all fragments can be traced to the same word or meaning.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments in proper names, book titles, or quotations
patterns.context: Appears in split spellings of proper names, headings, book titles, or common words; activation locations are not fixed and semantic relationships are weak.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, legal citations, technical bibliographies, email quotations, and web text

patterns.name: Medical and biomedical subword fragments
patterns.context: Located in terms such as cell types, research projects, and medical roles, usually as within-word subwords rather than standalone concepts.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers and research funding applications

patterns.name: Helper in code comments
patterns.context: Code comments describe helper methods; activation is on a word fragment within an identifier.

patterns.name: Formatting symbols and quotation markers
patterns.context: Appears at the start of lines in quoted email text, unrelated to the body’s semantics.

4_2839.description: 激活分散在多领域文本中，主要落于英文词的子词片段或边界；常见医学、技术及专名词形，但无稳定语义主题，邮件引用符号也有激活。

patterns.name: 词内或词边界处的 -ic 片段
patterns.trigger: «ic»，另有«Inter»vention、«gr»oup 等可能相邻的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在被 BPE 拆分的英文词内部，尤见于词尾或词中片段；并非所有片段都能归结为同一个词或语义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语文本及代码

patterns.name: 专名、书名或引文中的拼写片段
patterns.context: 在专名、标题、书名或普通词的拆分拼写中出现；激活位置不固定，语义关系弱。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、法律引证、技术书目、邮件引文及网页文本

patterns.name: 医学与生物医学专业词片段
patterns.context: 位于细胞类型、研究项目、医学角色等术语中，通常是词内子词而非独立概念。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及研究资助申请

patterns.name: 代码注释中的 Helper
patterns.context: 代码注释描述辅助方法，激活的是标识符中的词片段。

patterns.name: 格式符号与引用标记
patterns.context: 出现在邮件引用文本的行首，与正文语义无关。

en.description: Activations fall on suffixes or internal morphemes in a range of English words, including occupational titles, strategy expressions, and vocabulary related to entertainment, projects, businesses, venues, and book titles; these uses have no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Word ending in an occupational or identity term
patterns.context: Activation concentrates within English compounds or derivatives describing religious figures, especially the ending “yman”; the preceding text mentions British clergyman or Bishop, Hume's relatives, and playwright.

patterns.name: Multi-pronged expression
patterns.context: Occurs in a phrase describing a multifaceted, branching strategy; activation falls on the latter part of “pronged” and the adjacent noun.

patterns.name: Entertainment suffix -tainment
patterns.context: Occurs in a noun describing a WWE event as sports entertainment, with activation concentrated on the suffix portion of entertainment.

patterns.name: Suffixes -vention / -ants in an institution name
patterns.context: Occurs in the NIH grant-project name “Pilot Intervention and Services Research Grants”, with activation covering morpheme fragments in the project name.

patterns.name: Final word in a business name
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the business name “Waterfront Seafood Grill”; nearby business names also contain company suffixes or trade-name markers.
patterns.domain: Business and trade-name lists in legal documents

patterns.name: Venue word ending -ues
patterns.context: Occurs in the plural venue noun in the headline “Outdoor Concert Venues Worth a Summer Road Trip”.

patterns.name: Word ending related to a book title
patterns.context: Occurs in the reference link “Scholastic 39 Clues books page”, where the book series name and publisher name are segmented and activated.

4_2839.description: 激活落在多种英文词的后缀或内部词素上：涵盖职业称谓、策略表达，以及娱乐、项目、商号、场所和书名词汇；这些用法缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: 职业或身份词的词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中在描述宗教人士的英文复合词或派生词内部，尤其是词尾“yman”；前文提及 British clergyman 或 Bishop、Hume 的亲属与 playwright。

patterns.name: 多管齐下表达
patterns.context: 出现在表示采取多方面、分支式策略的短语中；激活落在“pronged”后半及相邻名词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、教育、公共卫生

patterns.name: 娱乐词尾 -tainment
patterns.context: 出现在描述 WWE 赛事属于体育娱乐的名词中，激活集中于 entertainment 的后缀部分。

patterns.name: 机构名称中的词尾 -vention / -ants
patterns.context: 出现在 NIH 资助项目名称“Pilot Intervention and Services Research Grants”中，激活覆盖项目名称里的词素片段。

patterns.name: 店铺名称末尾词
patterns.context: 出现在商业名称“Waterfront Seafood Grill”末尾，其他相邻店名也包含公司后缀或商号标记。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的企业、商号列表

patterns.name: 场所词尾 -ues
patterns.context: 出现在标题“Outdoor Concert Venues Worth a Summer Road Trip”中的复数场所名词。

patterns.name: 书名相关词尾
patterns.context: 出现在参考链接“Scholastic 39 Clues books page”中，书名系列与出版方名称被切分激活。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on within-word fragments split by tokenization or on subwords in proper names, often in academic bibliography titles, institution names, book titles, and common words. The fragment in “Principle” recurs, but other triggers are scattered, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Word-final or internal fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls within proper names, compounds, or words split by tokenization, often on a word-final or subword fragment; there is no obvious shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Legal entity names, news commentary, technical literature, sports reporting, book titles, and more

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in Principle
patterns.context: Appears in “Principle”; instances occur in a TCP/IP book title, a mathematics paper title, and references to a fundamental theorem in mathematical literature.
patterns.domain: Technical bibliographies, mathematics papers, and academic discussion

patterns.name: Truncated word fragments in academic titles or bibliographies
patterns.context: Highlights fall on subwords in technical terms or scholars’ names, near references or paper titles; overlaps with the “Principle” pattern.
patterns.domain: Computer networking and mathematical academic texts

patterns.name: Grants in administrative or institutional names
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the NIH funding project name “Pilot Intervention and Services Research Grants”.

patterns.name: Review Committee in an institutional committee name
patterns.context: Appears in the formal name of a clinical research review body, followed by the abbreviation CCRRC.

patterns.name: Occupational title in literary text
patterns.context: The word “British clergyman” activates internally, describing the historical figure Morgan Godwyn; it is not obviously connected to the other patterns.

patterns.name: Morphological fragment -ing
patterns.context: Activation is on the latter part of the verb “Unraveling” in a book title, especially the suffix ing; the passage also contains the split form “Lobsters”.
patterns.domain: Book title quoted in a HackerNews comment

4_2839.description: 激活主要落在被分词切开的词内部片段或专名子词，常见于学术书目标题、机构名称、书名及普通词；“Principle”片段重复出现，但其余触发分散，未见稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 专名中的词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、复合词或被分词切开的单词内部，常是词尾或子词片段；没有明显统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 法律实体名、新闻评论、技术文献、体育报道、书名等

patterns.name: Principle 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Principle”一词中；分别位于 TCP/IP 书名、数学论文标题及数学文献中对基本定理的称呼。
patterns.domain: 技术书目、数学论文及学术论述

patterns.name: 学术标题或书目中的截断词片段
patterns.context: 高亮落在技术术语或学者姓名的子词片段中，且处于参考书目或论文标题附近；与“Principle”模式重叠。
patterns.domain: 计算机网络与数学学术文本

patterns.name: 行政或机构名称中的 Grants
patterns.context: 出现在 NIH 资助项目名称“Pilot Intervention and Services Research Grants”中，位于申请项目名称末尾。

patterns.name: 机构委员会名称中的 Review Committee
patterns.context: 出现在临床研究审查机构的正式名称中，后接缩写 CCRRC。
patterns.domain: NIH 临床研究行政文本

patterns.name: 文学文本中的职业称谓
patterns.context: “British clergyman”一词内部被激活，描述历史人物 Morgan Godwyn；不显然与其他模式相连。
patterns.domain: 历史叙述或古典非虚构文本

patterns.name: 词尾 ing 的形态片段
patterns.context: 激活位于书名中动词“Unraveling”的后半部分，尤其是词尾 ing；段内还有被拆分的“Lobsters”。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论中的书名引用

en.description: Activations span code comments, word endings and internal fragments, proper-name lists, research and medical text, and historical entries, distributed across different word classes and punctuation; no stable semantic or syntactic pattern accounts for all passages.

patterns.name: Helper identifier
patterns.context: Helper appears as a class or method description in a code comment, or as part of a code identifier; PascalCase identifiers also appear in the code

patterns.name: Suffix -ity
patterns.context: Embedded in a word-ending formative element, occurring in medical papers or marketing text; not always an independent word

patterns.name: Intraword fragments and proper/technical names
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented technical words, abbreviations, or terminology fragments, with no unified semantic trigger condition

patterns.name: Small words, punctuation, and name fragments
patterns.context: In lists of company, trade, or legal party names, activation is distributed across fragments, punctuation, and words

patterns.name: Ordinary words and discourse fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across explanations of diffusion models, marketing arguments, clinical outcome descriptions, and public-health conference reports, with no shared explicit lexical or syntactic condition

patterns.name: Historical/religious word fragments and numbers
patterns.context: Activations occur on local fragments of biblical figures, church-history terminology, and years/numbers

4_2839.description: 激活跨代码注释、词尾与词内片段、专名清单、科研及医学文本和历史条目，且散布于不同词类与标点；未发现能覆盖所有段的稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: Helper 标识符

patterns.name: 后缀 -ity
patterns.context: 嵌在词尾构词成分中，出现在医学论文或营销文本里；并非总是独立单词

patterns.name: 词内碎片与专名/技术名词
patterns.context: 激活落在拆分的技术词、缩写或术语片段上，未显示统一的语义触发条件

patterns.name: 小词、标点与名称片段
patterns.context: 公司、商号或法律当事人名称的列举中，激活分布于碎片、标点和词语
patterns.domain: 法律文书/商家名称清单

patterns.name: 普通词与篇章片段
patterns.context: 激活散布在扩散模型解释、营销论述、临床结果描述和公共卫生会议报道中，未见共同的明确词法或句法条件
patterns.domain: 科研论文、营销文本、公共卫生报道

patterns.name: 历史/宗教词片段与数字
patterns.context: 激活出现在圣经人物、教会史术语和年份/数字的局部片段中
patterns.domain: 维基百科历史与宗教条目

en.concept: Helper spelling fragment and word fragments
en.description: The most prominent cue is the Helper spelling fragment, found in code comments, object names, and citations of paper authors. Other activations fall within or at the ends of various unrelated words, with no consistent semantic or contextual pattern.

patterns.name: helper string
patterns.context: Activation centers on the Helper spelling fragment in code identifiers or text; in code, it often occurs in descriptions of a Helper object/method.
patterns.domain: Scala, PHP code, and academic paper author citations

patterns.name: Within-word or word-final fragments
patterns.context: Trigger locations are scattered, often falling within or at the end of longer words; there is no stable shared semantic or syntactic context.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, code, forums, legal texts, academic papers, and sports text

4_2839.concept: Helper 拼写片段及词语片段
4_2839.description: 最突出的线索是 Helper 拼写片段，见于代码注释、对象名及论文作者引文；其余激活落在多种互不相关词语的内部或词尾，未显出一致的语义或上下文模式。

patterns.name: helper 字符串
patterns.context: 激活集中在代码标识符或文本中的 Helper 拼写片段；代码中常见于 Helper object/method 的说明。
patterns.domain: Scala、PHP 代码及学术论文引用姓名

patterns.name: 词语内部或词尾片段
patterns.context: 触发位置分散，常落在较长单词的词内或词尾；没有稳定的共同语义或句法环境。
patterns.domain: 百科、代码、论坛、法律、学术论文及体育文本

en.description: Activations primarily fall within words containing the letter sequence ed, often in the suffix -ed but also in other positions; in addition, felony in legal contexts and the encyclopedia subheading Controversy recur locally, but they do not form a single word-meaning pattern.

patterns.name: -ed string in the middle or at the end of a word
patterns.context: Activation falls within complete words, often on the suffix -ed, and also on ed letter sequences in the middle or at the end of words; there is no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, including encyclopedias, legal text, email, sports coverage, and code licenses

patterns.name: felony in legal contexts
patterns.context: In descriptions of criminal cases or statutes, activation falls on the initial fragment of felony; it appears in both legal passages.

patterns.name: controversy in a heading or subheading
patterns.context: Appears as a subheading in an encyclopedia entry, followed by a line break and body text.

4_2839.concept: 英文词内 ed 字符串
4_2839.description: 激活主要落在包含 ed 字母序列的词内，常见于词尾 -ed，也见于其他位置；此外，法律语境中的 felony 与百科小标题 Controversy 有局部重复，但无法解释为单一词义模式。

patterns.name: 单词中部或末尾的 -ed 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在完整单词内部，常见于词尾 -ed，也出现于词中或词尾的 ed 字母序列；没有一致的词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，包括百科、法律文本、邮件、体育报道和代码许可证

patterns.name: 法律语境中的 felony
patterns.context: 刑事案件或法规描述中，激活落在 felony 的词首片段；两段法律材料均出现。

patterns.name: 标题或小标题中的 controversy
patterns.context: 百科条目中作为小标题出现，后接换行及正文。

en.concept: Local fragments in long words, skewed toward legal documents
en.description: The clearest signal is court-martial in military rulings. There are also scattered activations on legal and procedural headings, institution names, and fragments within various long words; meanings and domains vary, and a few activations fall on punctuation or layout.

patterns.name: court-martial language in rulings
patterns.context: Describes a case or defendant in military appellate rulings, often near court, appellant, convicted, and similar terms; ial within the word is especially prominent.

patterns.name: ial / ial-like endings within long words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of different long or compound words, with no stable shared meaning; examples include loanwords, proper names, and common words.

patterns.name: Procedural vocabulary in uppercase headings
patterns.context: Within-word fragments activate in all-caps rule, procedure, or document headings.

patterns.name: Support-related words in headings or institution names
patterns.context: Local fragments in office, child, support, and enforcement are marked in all-caps headings in court citations or institution names.

patterns.name: Ruling summaries and document formatting
patterns.context: Near summary headings, judge signatures, or divider lines in rulings; activation falls on heading words or punctuation and whitespace formatting fragments.

patterns.name: Punctuation and layout in formal legal documents
patterns.context: Scattered activations appear near names, colons, conjunctions, or indentation whitespace in ruling text, with no consistent semantic trigger.

4_2839.concept: 长词局部片段，偏法律文书
4_2839.description: 最明确的信号是军事判决中的 court-martial；另有法律与操作标题、机构名及多种长词内部片段的零散激活，词义和领域并不一致，少量激活落在标点或版式上。

patterns.name: court-martial 判决用语
patterns.context: 军事上诉判决叙述案件或被告，常与 court、appellant、convicted 等相邻；该词内部的 ial 特别突出。

patterns.name: 长词内部的 ial / ial 类结尾
patterns.context: 激活落在不同长词或复合词的内部片段，未见稳定共同词义；包括外来词、专名及普通词。

patterns.name: 大写标题中的程序性词汇
patterns.context: 全大写的规则、程序或文件标题中，词内片段激活。
patterns.domain: 法律标题、业务操作文件

patterns.name: 标题或机构名称中的支持相关词
patterns.context: 法院引用或机构名称的全大写标题中，office、child、support、enforcement 的局部片段被标记。
patterns.domain: 法律引用、行政机构名称

patterns.name: 判决摘要及文书格式
patterns.context: 判决书的摘要标题、法官署名或分隔线附近；激活落在标题词或标点、空白格式片段上。

patterns.name: 正式法律文书中的标点与版式
patterns.context: 判决正文的人名、冒号、连接词或缩进空白附近出现零散激活，未显示统一语义触发条件。

en.description: Primarily triggers on the Fraud root, especially in consumer fraud legal texts; also occurs in legal or proper-name forms such as mechanic, accident, and felony, as well as landmark category words and several isolated word forms, with no unified semantic rule.

patterns.name: Fraud root and legal names
patterns.context: In legal contexts, especially names of consumer fraud acts or descriptions of causes of action; “ud” within the root is prominently marked.

patterns.name: Mechanic root
patterns.context: Appears in the database field name “SessionField=mechanic” or the place name “Mechanic Street”; triggering is not tied to a single domain.
patterns.domain: Web code, place names, and descriptions of historic districts

patterns.name: Industry/institution words in entity names
patterns.context: In lists of multiple proper names or historic landmarks, the marked token often falls on the category word in an entity name; unmarked words of the same type also suggest this pattern is unstable.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries for place names and historic landmarks

patterns.name: Accident root
patterns.context: Near legal-service keywords such as lawyers, personal injury, wrongful death, and car accidents; the same passage also contains the fraud root.

patterns.name: Repeated Legend word form
patterns.context: The same string is repeated consecutively, each occurrence adjacent to a different tokenization boundary; the surrounding text discusses Korean law and cannabis, but its relationship to the word is unclear.

patterns.name: Court trial terminology
patterns.context: A military court case discusses whether defense counsel’s comments were improper; the trigger may favor a term ending, with only one example as evidence.

patterns.name: Rapid progress and congratulations
patterns.context: In a forum comment about rapid progress on an open-source project, appears in the abbreviation “congrats” used to congratulate the team; may simply be a local word-form trigger.

patterns.name: Felony ending
patterns.context: In a criminal case narrative describing the charges and felony level, the mark falls on the ending of felony; the same passage also includes charged, counts, and forgery.

4_2839.description: 主要触发 Fraud 词根，尤其是消费者欺诈法律文本；另见 mechanic、accident、felony 等法律或专名词形，以及地标类别词和若干孤立词形，尚无统一语义规则。

patterns.name: Fraud 词根及法律名称
patterns.trigger: “Fra«ud»9”，以及相邻的“Consumer Fraud and Deceptive … Practices/Act”
patterns.context: 在法律语境中，尤其是消费者欺诈法案名称或诉因描述中；词根内部的“ud”被重点标记。

patterns.name: Mechanic 词根
patterns.context: 出现在数据库字段名“SessionField=mechanic”或地名“Mechanic Street”中；触发并不依赖单一领域。
patterns.domain: 网页代码、地名与历史街区描述

patterns.name: 实体名称中的行业/机构词
patterns.context: 多个专名或历史地标的并列清单中，标记常落在实体名称的类别词上；未标记的同类词也提示此模式并不稳定。
patterns.domain: 百科地名与历史地标条目

patterns.name: Accident 词根
patterns.context: 与律师、个人伤害、错误死亡、车祸等法律服务关键词相邻；同段还出现 fraud 词根。

patterns.name: Legend 重复词形
patterns.context: 同一字符串连续重复，分别紧邻不同分词边界；周围文本谈及韩国法律与大麻，但与该词的关系不明。

patterns.name: 法庭审理术语
patterns.context: 军事法庭判例中讨论辩护律师评论是否不当；该触发可能偏向术语词尾，证据仅一例。

patterns.name: 快速进展与祝贺
patterns.context: 开源项目进展很快的论坛评论中，出现在对团队表示祝贺的缩写“congrats”里；可能只是局部词形触发。

patterns.name: Felony 词尾
patterns.context: 刑事案件叙述被告获控罪名及罪级时，标记落在 felony 的词尾；同段亦有 charged、counts、forgery。

en.description: Primarily responds to abbreviations and citation punctuation in legal rulings and case citations, especially Services, Ass’n, and case names with v. It also responds sporadically to judicial procedure terms. One fragment in congratulations activates in an online comment, which cannot be explained by the legal pattern.

patterns.name: Services abbreviations in judicial opinions
patterns.context: Appears at the end of institution or organization names, usually as an abbreviation of Services, followed by a period, comma, or citation punctuation; not every ordinary plural s triggers.

patterns.name: Ass’n abbreviation in organization names
patterns.context: Abbreviation of Association in organization names; the apostrophe and n are each marked, often near legal citation punctuation.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings, organization names, and citations

patterns.name: v. marker in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in case names, usually followed by a court or institution name; activation centers on the period rather than v itself.

patterns.name: Fine-grained punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Commas, periods, parentheses, and apostrophes within citations, abbreviations, or case names; often adjacent to court or institution abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Legal rulings and formal legal citations

patterns.name: Citations and procedural terminology in legal style
patterns.context: Describes procedure, standards of review, legal claims, or case rules in judicial discussion; these words are marked only in individual passages, with no single stable trigger word.

patterns.name: grats in congratulations
patterns.context: Expresses congratulations on a team release or project progress in an informal comment; activation falls on a split fragment of congratulations.

4_2839.concept: 法律引文与机构名称格式
4_2839.description: 主要响应法律判决与判例引文中的缩写、引文标点，尤其 Services、Ass’n 和案名 v.；也零星响应司法程序词语。另有一次网络评论中 congratulations 的片段激活，无法与法律模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 司法意见中的 Services 缩写
patterns.trigger: «s»10 或 «s»9，常见于 “Human Serv«s».”、“Legal Serv«s».”、“Technical Serv«s».”
patterns.context: 出现在机构或组织名称末尾，通常是 Services 的缩写，后接句点、逗号或引文标点；并非所有普通复数 s 都触发。

patterns.name: 协会名称缩写 Ass’n
patterns.context: 组织名称中的 Association 缩写，撇号和 n 分别被标记；名称附近常有法律引文标点。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、组织名称及引文

patterns.name: 法律引文中的 v. 标记
patterns.trigger: “v«.»5/6”，即案件双方名称之间的 v. 句点
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称中，通常随后是法院或机构名称；激活集中于句点而非 v 本身。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的精细标点
patterns.context: 引文、缩写或案名内部的逗号、句点、括号和撇号；常与法院、机构缩写相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律判决及正式法律引文

patterns.name: 法律文体中的引文与程序术语
patterns.trigger: “« motion»”、“« review»”、“« must»”、“« cases»”、“« under»”、“« framework»”等
patterns.context: 司法论述中描述程序、审查标准、法律主张或判例规则；这些词只在个别段落被标记，未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 祝贺语中的 grats
patterns.context: 非正式评论中对团队发布或项目进展表示祝贺；激活落在 congratulations 的拆分片段上。

en.description: Activations are scattered across legal citations and institutional abbreviations, technical and medical word fragments, parentheses, and line breaks; a few word fragments in forum and sports texts also activate. The common pattern is weak and difficult to explain with a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Apostrophe and letter n in abbreviations
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on n after an apostrophe in abbreviations, especially Ass’n for an association; the apostrophe also activates

patterns.name: Periods in legal documents
patterns.context: Appears at periods in case citations, initials in names, or place-name abbreviations

patterns.name: Specific word fragments in legal terms
patterns.context: Abbreviations, word fragments, and their boundaries in names of legal bodies or litigation divisions
patterns.domain: Legal documents and government legal department directories

patterns.name: Word endings or fragments -ation / -ography in technical terms
patterns.context: Morphemic fragments within technical or scientific terms; the two contexts differ

patterns.name: Other within-word fragment activations
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within ordinary words; existing examples are insufficient to establish shared conditions
patterns.domain: Sports and entertainment reporting, legal discussion

patterns.name: Sentence-initial exclamation mark
patterns.context: Appears in Hacker News comments as punctuation after an expression of praise

patterns.name: Marked line break
patterns.context: Appears at paragraph or legal-document formatting line breaks; not all line breaks activate

patterns.name: English parentheses
patterns.context: Parentheses enclose abbreviations or terms, such as (MR) and (cryo-EM)

patterns.name: Adverb fragment in sports reporting
patterns.context: In the phrase go all out, in a sports and entertainment reporting context

patterns.name: Different word fragments in legal vocabulary
patterns.context: In descriptions of legal arguments or legal standards, activations are scattered across several content words

patterns.name: Biomedical terms and markers
patterns.context: Medical imaging terms such as MRI/FLAIR and adjacent words

patterns.name: Text positions that do not fit the patterns above
patterns.context: Several sporadic word fragments activate in forum comments, without a stable shared trigger condition

4_2839.description: 激活分散在法律引注与机构缩写、技术和医学词片、括号及换行等处；少量论坛和体育文本中的词片也激活。共同规律较弱，难以由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 缩写中的撇号与字母 n
patterns.context: 激活集中在缩写中撇号后的 n，尤其是表示协会的 Ass’n；同时撇号也有激活

patterns.name: 法律文书中的句点
patterns.context: 出现在判例引注、姓名首字母或地名缩写的句点处

patterns.name: 法律专用词中的特定词片
patterns.context: 法律机关或诉讼部门名称中的缩写、词片及其边界
patterns.domain: 法律文书及政府法律部门名录

patterns.name: 技术术语的词尾或词片 -ation / -ography
patterns.context: 技术或科学术语内部的词素片段；两处语境不同

patterns.name: 其他词内词片激活
patterns.context: 激活落在普通词内部的一段子词片，现有例子不足以确定共同条件
patterns.domain: 体育娱乐报道、法律论述

patterns.name: 句首感叹号
patterns.context: 出现在 Hacker News 评论中，作为称赞语气后的标点

patterns.name: 标记性换行符
patterns.context: 出现在文本段落或法律文件排版换行处；并非所有换行都激活

patterns.name: 英文括号
patterns.context: 括号包围缩写或术语，例如 (MR) 与 (cryo-EM)

patterns.name: 体育报道中的副词片段
patterns.context: 短语 go all out 中，体育娱乐报道语境

patterns.name: 法律词汇中的不同词片
patterns.context: 法律论证或法律标准的叙述，激活分散在若干内容词上

patterns.name: 生物医学术语与标记
patterns.context: MRI/FLAIR 等医学影像术语及其相邻词

patterns.name: 不符合上述规律的文本位置
patterns.context: 论坛评论中多个零散词片被激活，无法归入稳定的共同触发条件

en.description: Activations cover various unrelated text features: legal cases, court-document formatting, scientific abbreviations, legal headings, word endings in online congratulations, and expressions in film reviews; no unified trigger pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: Legal cases and court citations
patterns.context: Court-procedure terms, case names, and volume/page information appear in legal opinions, decisions, or citations; often within sentences or near references.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Legal document signatures and court formatting
patterns.context: Formatted areas of court documents, such as headings, dates, and clerk signatures.

patterns.name: Proper-name abbreviations and classification markers in research
patterns.context: Technical terms, abbreviations, or closing markers inside parentheses appear in specialized texts.

patterns.name: All-caps formatting in quotations or paragraph headings
patterns.context: An all-caps heading in legal material introduces an analysis paragraph and is followed by a section number.

patterns.name: ‘grats’ in congratulations
patterns.context: Expresses congratulations in informal online comments, often next to praise for a team or product; activations concentrate on the ending fragment.

patterns.name: Moral dilemma in film reviews
patterns.context: Discusses a film’s plot and how far a character would go to protect others.

4_2839.description: 激活覆盖多种不相同文本特征：法律判例、法院文书格式、科研缩写、法律标题、网络祝贺语词尾及影评表达；未见能解释全部段落的统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律案件与法院引证
patterns.context: 法律意见书、判决或引证中出现法院程序术语、判例名及卷页信息；常见于句中或引用附近。

patterns.name: 法律文书署名和法院格式
patterns.trigger: “UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS”“TENTH CIRCUIT”“Clerk of Court”
patterns.context: 法院文件的抬头、日期、书记员署名等格式化区域。

patterns.name: 科研中的专名缩写与分类标记
patterns.context: 专业文本中出现技术术语、缩写或括号内的缩写闭合标记。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与遗传学论文

patterns.name: 引述或段落标题的全大写格式
patterns.context: 法律材料中以全大写标题引出分析段落，并接章节编号。

patterns.name: 祝贺语中的 ‘grats’
patterns.context: 非正式网络评论中表达祝贺，常紧邻团队或产品称赞；激活集中在词尾片段。

patterns.name: 影评中的道德两难
patterns.context: 讨论电影剧情及人物为保护他人会做到何种程度时。

en.description: The most stable pattern is ANALYSIS in legal-document headings. Other activations include the final n in legal citation abbreviations, v. in case titles, and analysis and parentheses in a medical title. Triggers may also involve layout or punctuation features.

patterns.name: ANALYSIS heading in legal documents
patterns.context: Section heading in a legal opinion or ruling, often uppercase and on a separate line, with page breaks, indentation, or line breaks; may also appear in a table of contents.
patterns.domain: U.S. court rulings, legal opinions, and their tables of contents

patterns.name: Letter n in legal documents
patterns.context: In possessive abbreviations or organization names, n after an apostrophe is a high-activation point; it appears in legal citations and attorney lists.

patterns.name: v. marker in ruling text
patterns.context: Adversarial case marker between party names; this instance appears in the title on the first page of a ruling.

patterns.name: IS in a medical paper
patterns.context: Appears in a research project title, as part of the phrase “functional analysis”; not a legal section heading.

patterns.name: H in the abbreviation CGH
patterns.context: The closing parenthesis of the genomic hybridization abbreviation CGH is also highlighted; the same sentence discusses DNA copy-number changes.

4_2839.concept: 法律文书分析标题（兼有标点模式）
4_2839.description: 最稳定的模式是法律文书标题中的 ANALYSIS；另有法律引文缩写的词尾 n、案件标题 v.，以及医学题名中的 analysis 和 CGH 括号。触发可能兼有版式或标点特征。

patterns.name: 法律文书的 ANALYSIS 标题
patterns.context: 法律意见或判决中的章节标题，常为大写、独立成行，并伴随分页、缩进或换行；也可出现在目录标题中。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律意见及其目录

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 n 字母
patterns.context: 缩写所有格或组织名称时，撇号后的 n 是高激活点；法律引文、律师名单中均有出现。

patterns.name: 判决正文的 v. 标记
patterns.context: 案件当事人名称之间的对抗式案件标记；此例位于判决首页标题中。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的 IS
patterns.context: 出现在研究项目题名中，属于 “functional analysis” 一词；并非法律章节标题。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究项目标题

patterns.name: CGH 缩写的 H
patterns.context: 基因组比较杂交缩写 CGH 的右括号也高亮；同句还谈 DNA 拷贝数变化。

en.concept: Proper names and terminology boundary fragments
en.description: Activations often fall on the endings of proper names, abbreviations, or terms, especially Year in award names, the legal institution abbreviation Ass'n, and film titles; also occurs in scientific abbreviation parentheses and a few domain-specific terms, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Award name or award category
patterns.context: Appears in biographies or entertainment news describing a person receiving a specific award; activation concentrates on Year at the end of the award name.

patterns.name: Abbreviated association suffix in a proper name
patterns.context: An organization name ends with the abbreviation Ass'n for Association; activation falls on the n at the end of the abbreviation.

patterns.name: Film titles or final words in titles
patterns.context: When films and their years, genres, or titles are listed consecutively, activation occurs within or at the end of a title.
patterns.domain: Film databases, film and television descriptions

patterns.name: CGH technical abbreviation
patterns.context: In descriptions of genomic copy-number changes and experimental methods, the closing position of the abbreviation CGH inside parentheses activates strongly.

patterns.name: Final word in an epoch compound
patterns.context: In a scientific paper, spectra follows a hyphenated term; activation falls on the final subword of epoch.

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis in cryo-EM
patterns.context: When a research plan describes a technical method, the right parenthesis of the abbreviation activates.

patterns.name: End of a word in quotation marks
patterns.context: An email discusses the usage of a word; activation occurs on the initial part of the quoted word. The context is truncated, so evidence for the pattern is limited.

4_2839.description: 激活多落在专名、缩写或术语的末尾，尤其是奖项 Year、法律机构缩写 Ass'n，以及电影片名；另见科学缩写括号与少数领域术语，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 奖项名称或奖项类别
patterns.trigger: «the»3 Woonsocket Call«.»1 In« 2004»1 Travis won« the»1 Rhode« Island»2 Press« Association»3« award»3« for»1« "»1Sports« Story»1 Of« The»1« Year»10"；«won»2 Breakthrough Video« of»1« the»1« Year»9
patterns.context: 出现在人物简介或娱乐新闻中，描述某人获得具体奖项；激活集中在奖项名称末尾的 Year。

patterns.name: 专名中的缩写协会后缀
patterns.context: 组织名称以 Association 的缩写 Ass'n 收尾，激活落在缩写末尾的 n。
patterns.domain: 法律判例引文、机构名称

patterns.name: 电影片名或片名末尾词
patterns.trigger: Deadly Weapons (1974), horror« films»3 Demented (1980) and To All a Good«night»2 (1980), the« comedy»1 National L«amp»3«oon»9's Movie Mad«ness»4
patterns.context: 在连续列举电影及年份、类型或片名时，激活片名内部或末尾的词。

patterns.name: CGH 技术缩写
patterns.context: 在基因组拷贝数变化和实验方法描述中，强烈激活括号内缩写 CGH 的闭合位置。
patterns.domain: 癌症基因组学、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: epoch 复合词中的末尾词
patterns.context: 科学论文中连字符构成的术语后接 spectra，激活 epoch 的末尾子词。
patterns.domain: 天文学或天体物理学论文

patterns.name: cryo-EM 括号闭合
patterns.context: 研究计划描述技术方法时，激活缩写括号的右括号。

patterns.name: 引号内词语的末尾
patterns.context: 邮件讨论某词的用法，激活引号内词语的起始部分；上下文截断，模式证据有限。

en.concept: Boundary markers and word-final subword fragments
en.description: Strongly activates mainly on right parentheses after abbreviations or imaging terms in medical texts; also activates on word-final subword fragments in “Congrats” and “ideas” in Hacker News, with the latter two more scattered in semantics and context.

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis after biomedical abbreviation
patterns.context: An abbreviation or term is given in parentheses and ends with a right parenthesis; activation concentrates on the right-parenthesis token. In most instances, it is preceded by a medical/biological term and its expanded or abbreviated form.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, research abstracts; [8][9] are imaging terms

patterns.name: Word ending in congratulations
patterns.context: Appears in informal HackerNews comments; the full word is “Congrats”, following an address or product evaluation. Activation falls on a word-final subword fragment.

patterns.name: Word ending for opinions or ideas
patterns.context: In discussion of whether an initiative succeeded and possible solutions, falls on the word-final subword fragment in the plural noun “ideas”.

4_2839.concept: 边界符及词尾子词片段
4_2839.description: 主要对医学文本中括号缩写或影像术语后的右括号强烈激活；另对HackerNews中“Congrats”和“ideas”的词尾子词片段激活，后两者语义和语境较分散。

patterns.name: 生物医学缩写闭括号
patterns.context: 缩写或术语在括号中给出、以右括号结束；激活集中在右括号 token。多数实例中前面是医学/生物术语及其缩写展开或缩写本身。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、研究摘要；[8][9]为影像学术语

patterns.name: 祝贺语中的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在非正式 HackerNews 评论中，完整词为“Congrats”，位于称呼或产品评价之后。激活落在词尾子词片段。

patterns.name: 观点或想法的词尾
patterns.context: 在讨论倡议是否成功及其可能方案时，落在复数名词“ideas”的词尾子词片段。

en.concept: Sensitive to terminology and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activations often fall on abbreviations, suffixes of split words, or boundaries in legal headings and formatting; they also occur sporadically on carried out, performed, reviews, and report. Semantics and domains are not uniform.

patterns.name: Internal boundaries in abbreviations or terms
patterns.context: Components of scientific abbreviations or split uppercase words in legal headings; marked positions are not always whole words and do not always occur at the same character boundary

patterns.name: Ending of a specific abbreviation
patterns.context: Punctuation following the MS abbreviation in the HPLC-MS analytical method name

patterns.name: Within-word suffix
patterns.context: In a HackerNews sentence, concerns is split and activation strongly falls on the ending; seen only once so far

patterns.name: Formatting boundaries and heading markers
patterns.context: Periods after legal case citations, uppercase text in legal document or section headings, and positions near paragraph or heading boundaries

patterns.name: Ending of a statistical report title
patterns.context: In the fixed legal context of presentence investigation report, activation falls on report

patterns.name: Analytical verb phrase
patterns.context: When describing topological analysis of the electron localization function, activation concentrates on out in carried out; isolated from other patterns

patterns.name: Expressions related to conducting or performing
patterns.context: Mentions whole-genome sequencing to be performed on CNV carriers; activation falls on performed

patterns.name: Expressions related to review or examination
patterns.context: In a passage reviewing a legal standard, describes the court reviewing a motion; activation falls on reviews

patterns.name: Imaging examination expressions
patterns.context: Describes ultrasound or magnetic resonance imaging examinations; activation falls on performed

4_2839.description: 激活多落在缩写、拆分词的后缀或法律标题及格式边界，也零星出现在 carried out、performed、reviews、report 等处；语义和领域不统一。

patterns.name: 缩写或术语内部边界
patterns.trigger: 激活常落在缩写、词语或标题的分段内部，如 «(»2CGH«)»10、«(»2WGS«)»10、«(»3GC«-»1MS«)»9、«(»3H«PLC»2«-»2MS«)»9、«ANAL«YS»1«IS»10
patterns.context: 科学缩写的构成部分，或法律标题中的被拆分大写词；标注位置并不总是完整词，也不总在相同字符边界

patterns.name: 特定缩写末尾
patterns.context: HPLC-MS 分析方法名称中，MS 缩写后出现的标点

patterns.name: 词语内部后缀
patterns.context: HackerNews 句子中的 concerns 被拆分，强激活落在词尾；目前只见一次

patterns.name: 格式边界与标题标记
patterns.context: 法律判例引注后的句号、法律文书标题或章节标题中的大写文字，以及段落或标题边界附近

patterns.name: 统计报告标题词尾
patterns.context: presentence investigation report 这一固定法律语境中，激活落在 report

patterns.name: 分析动词短语
patterns.context: 描述对电子局域函数开展拓扑分析时，激活集中在 carried out 的 out；孤立于其他模式

patterns.name: 进行或执行相关表达
patterns.context: 提及将对 CNV 携带者进行全基因组测序，激活落在 performed

patterns.name: 检查或审查相关表达
patterns.context: 法律标准审查段落中描述法院审理动议，激活落在 reviews

patterns.name: 成像检查表达
patterns.context: 描述超声或磁共振成像检查，激活落在 performed

en.description: Prominent activation cues include “carried out” in academic research, genomic research terminology and abbreviations, and a few financial nouns and within-word fragments in internet text; these cues span domains and vary in form.

patterns.name: carried out in past-participle phrases
patterns.context: Appears in passive or perfect constructions about research or analysis, preceded by is/been/first, etc., and followed by the research subject, method, or a for construction

patterns.name: Measurement and characterization terms
patterns.context: Describes phenotypic measurements of CNV carriers, existing cohorts, and follow-up studies

patterns.name: Genomic testing method abbreviations
patterns.context: Describes methods for detecting DNA copy-number changes; activation centers on the end of the method abbreviation

patterns.name: Homologous recombination abbreviation
patterns.context: First defines a biological term abbreviation in an introduction

patterns.name: Plural financial product nouns
patterns.context: Listed alongside stocks, bonds, insurance policies, and annuities as items not covered by the FDIC

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in colloquial internet spelling
patterns.context: Embedded in informal HackerNews comment text, appearing as within-word subword fragments; no clear shared semantic condition

patterns.name: Startup-related suffixes and evaluative expressions
patterns.context: Personal accounts discuss starting a business and use evaluative adjectives to describe the reading experience

4_2839.description: 激活较突出的线索包括学术研究中的“carried out”、基因组研究术语与缩写，以及少量金融名词和互联网文本中的词内片段；这些线索跨领域且形态不一。

patterns.name: 过去分词短语中的 carried out
patterns.trigger: “carried out”，尤以 out 激活最强
patterns.context: 出现在研究或分析的被动/完成式表达中，前接 is/been/first 等，后接研究对象、方法或 for 结构

patterns.name: 测量与表征相关词语
patterns.context: 描述 CNV 携带者的表型测量、既有队列及后续研究

patterns.name: 基因组检测方法缩写
patterns.trigger: “comparative genomic hybridization (CGH)”及“CGH”的结束括号 token
patterns.context: 描述 DNA 拷贝数变化的检测方法；激活集中在方法缩写的末尾

patterns.name: 同源重组缩写
patterns.context: 引言中首次定义生物学术语缩写

patterns.name: 复数金融产品名词
patterns.context: 与 stocks、bonds、insurance policies、annuities 并列，列举不受 FDIC 保障的项目

patterns.name: 口语化互联网拼写中的词尾
patterns.context: 嵌在 HackerNews 评论的非正式文本中，表现为词内子词片段，未见清晰共同语义条件

patterns.name: 创业词尾及评价性表达
patterns.context: 个人经验分享中谈创业，并以评价性形容词描述阅读体验

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the technical abbreviations MR and EM inside parentheses, as well as closing parentheses and apostrophes in legal proper names; two WGS abbreviation contexts show no similar marker and remain unexplained.

patterns.name: Right parenthesis
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on closing parentheses; the first passage also contains an abbreviation enclosed in parentheses

patterns.name: MR in measurement technique abbreviations
patterns.context: In medical imaging or research methods texts, MR abbreviates magnetic resonance; MR inside parentheses is marked
patterns.domain: Medical and biomedical abstracts, research plans

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis for the EM abbreviation
patterns.context: An abbreviation is introduced in parentheses after a microscopy method name; the EM inside the parentheses activates, rather than the word microscopy itself

patterns.name: Apostrophe in a legal name
patterns.context: The possessive/abbreviating apostrophe in the proper name “Port of Boston Marine Terminal Ass'n”

4_2839.description: 激活主要落在括号内的技术缩写 MR、EM，另有闭合括号及法律专名中的撇号；两段 WGS 缩写上下文未见同类标记，无法解释。

patterns.name: 右括号
patterns.context: 激活集中在括号闭合符号；第1段还出现括号包围的缩写

patterns.name: 测量技术缩写中的 MR
patterns.context: 医学成像或研究方法文本中，MR 作为 magnetic resonance 的缩写，括号内的 MR 被标记
patterns.domain: 医学与生物医学摘要、研究计划

patterns.name: EM 缩写的闭合括号
patterns.context: 显微镜方法名称后以括号引入缩写，激活括号内的 EM，而不是显微镜一词本身

patterns.name: 法律名称中的撇号
patterns.context: 专名“Port of Boston Marine Terminal Ass'n”中的所有格／缩写撇号

en.description: Primarily responds to uppercase technical abbreviations in parentheses after full method or term names in biomedical and related research texts, especially genomics, testing, microscopy, and mass spectrometry abbreviations; also responds to biological terminology abbreviations such as HR and EMT.

patterns.name: Sequencing technology abbreviations and method names
patterns.context: Abbreviations usually appear in parentheses after the full name of a method or technology, often alongside descriptions of research methods such as will be performed, identified by, using, or screening.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, genomics, experimental methods, and computational research prose

patterns.name: Structural biology abbreviation cryo-EM
patterns.context: When a research proposal describes characterizing a complex using microscopy, the EM abbreviation in parentheses activates most strongly.

patterns.name: Homologous recombination abbreviation HR
patterns.context: A parenthetical abbreviation follows the first mention of Homologous recombination, followed by an explanation of its biological role.

4_2839.description: 主要响应生物医学与相关研究文本中方法或术语全称后括号里的大写技术缩写，尤其是基因组、检测、显微成像及质谱缩写；也响应 HR、EMT 等生物学术语缩写。

patterns.name: 测序技术缩写与方法名
patterns.context: 缩写通常出现在方法或技术全称之后的括号中，常伴随 will be performed、identified by、using、screening 等研究方法描述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、基因组学、实验方法及计算研究文体

patterns.name: 结构生物学缩写 cryo-EM
patterns.context: 在提出研究方案、描述用显微成像表征复合物时，括号内缩写 EM 激活最强。

patterns.name: 同源重组缩写 HR
patterns.context: 首次引入 Homologous recombination 后给出括号缩写，随后说明其生物学作用。

en.description: Activations concentrate on technical or domain abbreviations inside parentheses and their boundary markers, commonly abbreviations such as WGS, HR, CGH, NGS, and HT following their full names; also occurs in method descriptions and narration after parentheses.

patterns.name: Sequencing technology abbreviations
patterns.context: Technical abbreviations in parentheses, often following their full names; locally, there is also the sequence “« will»3« be»2« performed»6”
patterns.domain: Genomics, medical research, and patent background; also prediction-screening contexts

patterns.name: Parenthetical abbreviation markers in text
patterns.context: Abbreviations, method names, or domain terms introduced or closed by parentheses in body text; not limited to biomedicine, and often follows the full name of an abbreviation
patterns.domain: Paper introductions, research project texts, and patents

patterns.name: Method descriptions after parenthetical abbreviations
patterns.context: After a parenthetical abbreviation, the text continues by describing its role, properties, or applications; specific wording varies across passages
patterns.domain: Research papers, project applications, and patent technical descriptions

4_2839.description: 激活集中在括号内的技术或领域缩写及其边界标记，常见于全称后给出WGS、HR、CGH、NGS、HT等缩写；也见于方法说明和括号后的叙述。

patterns.name: 测序技术名称缩写
patterns.context: 括号中的技术缩写，常出现在全称之后；局部也有连续的“« will»3« be»2« performed»6”
patterns.domain: 基因组学、医学研究及专利背景；另有预测筛选语境

patterns.name: 文中括号缩写标记
patterns.context: 正文中以括号引出或结束缩写、方法名或领域术语；并非只限生物医学，常伴随缩写前的全称
patterns.domain: 论文引言、科研项目文本及专利

patterns.name: 括号内缩写后的方法叙述
patterns.context: 括号缩写之后继续介绍其作用、性质或应用；不同段落中的具体用词不完全一致
patterns.domain: 科研论文、项目申请与专利技术说明

en.description: Most passages activate on technical abbreviations in parentheses, such as HR, WGS, CGH, HTM, EM, and NGS, often after a full name or technical explanation. Other activations occur on a comparison word, 0, and a question mark in a math problem, and on a time point and unit in an experimental description.

patterns.name: Abbreviations or short forms in parentheses
patterns.context: Abbreviations in parentheses following the full name of a technical term; activation falls within or at the end of the abbreviation. The abbreviations vary in length, and marked positions inside or outside the parentheses are not identical across examples.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, genomics, microscopy, patent technology text

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in a math problem
patterns.context: A short multiple-choice question asks “Which is the closest to 0?”; activation falls on the comparison target, number, and question mark, rather than biomedical terminology.
