patterns.name: Time points and units
patterns.context: Time points and the unit hour are marked when describing nucleotide coverage in an experiment or change over time; the same passage also has activations related to abbreviations in parentheses.
patterns.domain: Experimental results or supplementary material in biomedical papers

4_2839.description: 多数段落在括号中的专业缩写处激活，如HR、WGS、CGH、HTM、EM、NGS，常位于全称或技术说明之后；另见数学题的比较词、0与问号，以及一段实验描述中的时间点和单位。

patterns.name: 括号中的缩写或简称
patterns.context: 技术或术语全称之后，以括号形式出现的缩写；激活集中在缩写内部或末尾。各例缩写长度、括号内外标记位置不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 生物医学科研、基因组学、显微成像、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 简短选择题提问“Which is the closest to 0?”，激活落在比较对象、数值及问号上，而非生物医学术语。

patterns.name: 时间点与时间单位
patterns.context: 在描述实验核苷酸覆盖或随时间变化时，时间点及小时单位被标记；但同段还有括号缩写相关激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的实验结果或补充材料说明

en.description: Primarily responds to parenthetical abbreviations for methods, technologies, or instruments in scientific texts, especially near right parentheses; also occurs with abbreviations such as WGS and HT, as well as a few split term endings and instrument-name fragments.

patterns.name: Method abbreviations in parentheses
patterns.context: In scientific texts introducing research methods, technologies, or instruments, activations concentrate on and near the right parenthesis; abbreviations are often explained earlier.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, genomics, microscopy, and research project descriptions

patterns.name: Sequencing method abbreviations
patterns.context: At the first mention of whole-genome sequencing or when it appears as part of a research workflow; activation is near the parentheses and abbreviation.

patterns.name: High-throughput screening abbreviation
patterns.context: Introduces high-throughput screening in a predictive study, with the English abbreviation in parentheses.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research combining computational and experimental methods

patterns.name: Word boundaries within instrument names
patterns.context: An instrument name is split into multiple tokens in a patent or research equipment description, followed by an abbreviation in parentheses.
patterns.domain: Electron microscopy instruments and patent background

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in scientific terms
patterns.context: When a longer term is split, a final fragment appears in a phenotype measurement or prototype screening context; not fully consistent with the parenthetical abbreviation pattern.

4_2839.description: 主要响应科学文本中方法、技术或仪器缩写的括号标注，尤其是右括号附近；也见于 WGS、HT 等缩写，以及少数被拆分的术语词尾和仪器名片段。

patterns.name: 括号中的方法缩写
patterns.trigger: 「(」后接方法全称或描述，再以「)」引出大写缩写，如「(」HR「)」、「(」CGH「)」、「(」HTM「)」
patterns.context: 科学文本中介绍研究方法、技术或仪器时，激活集中在右括号及其附近；缩写常由前文解释。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、基因组学、显微成像与科研项目描述

patterns.name: 测序方法缩写
patterns.context: 全基因组测序首次出现或作为研究流程的一环；激活在括号及缩写附近。
patterns.domain: 基因组学、遗传学研究计划

patterns.name: 高通量筛选缩写
patterns.context: 预测研究中介绍高通量筛选，括号标出英文缩写。
patterns.domain: 计算与实验结合的生物医学研究

patterns.name: 仪器名称内部的词语边界
patterns.context: 专利或科研设备描述中，仪器名被拆分为多个 token，随后以括号给出缩写。
patterns.domain: 电子显微镜仪器与专利背景

patterns.name: 科学术语的词尾片段
patterns.context: 较长术语被拆分时，词尾片段出现在表型测量或原型筛选语境中；与括号缩写模式不完全相同。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to boundary markers around terms, abbreviations, and proper names, especially closing parentheses and hyphens. Also appears in cohort names, URL title paths, and document section formatting, suggesting a general tendency to detect boundaries and separators in structured text.

patterns.name: End markers for terms or abbreviations
patterns.context: At the first definition, closing parenthesis, or compound-term separator of a scientific term or abbreviation; activation is concentrated near term boundaries

patterns.name: Cohort and survey study names
patterns.context: Sequences of names for longitudinal surveys, cohorts, or child research projects
patterns.domain: Social science, public health data catalogs

patterns.name: Hyphens and path fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Web link paths connect title words with hyphens and contain URLs mixing words and punctuation

patterns.name: Document titles and section separators
patterns.context: Section headings, anchors, and separators in Markdown or web dumps

4_2839.description: 主要对术语、缩写及专名的边界标记（尤其括号闭合、连字符）敏感；也出现在队列名称、URL标题路径和文档章节格式中，整体偏向识别结构化文本中的边界与分隔。

patterns.name: 术语或缩写结束标记
patterns.trigger: 缩写或专名末尾的右括号，如“(WGS)”中的“)”（10）、“(CGH)”中的“)”（10）、“(EM)”中的“)”（10）、“(HR)”中的“)”（9）、“(NGS)”中的“)”（9）；另有“cry-o-EM”中的连字符（9）
patterns.context: 科学术语或缩写在首次定义、括号闭合或复合术语分隔处；激活集中在术语边界附近
patterns.domain: 生物医学、遗传学、科研文本

patterns.name: 队列与调查研究名称
patterns.context: 成串出现的纵向调查、队列或儿童研究项目名称
patterns.domain: 社会科学、公共卫生数据目录

patterns.name: URL中的连字符与路径片段
patterns.trigger: URL中的“-”，如“Economic-History-At-what-point-did-the-US-”和“the-rise-of-functional-programming-f-scala-haskell-and”（连字符强度最高为9）
patterns.context: 网页链接路径将标题词以连字符连接，包含单词与标点混合的URL

patterns.name: 文档标题与章节分隔
patterns.context: Markdown或网页转储中的章节标题、锚点和分隔符

en.concept: English content-word triggers with inconsistent semantics
en.description: Strong activation appears across multiple content words: fit (meaning either model fitting or capacity to hold), signature, currency, Significance, and infinity. Apart from fit, there is no clear shared semantics or stable context.

patterns.name: fit and model fitting
patterns.context: Discusses fitting difficulties, curve fitting, or whether a method calls fit in relation to models, algorithms, or data; the trigger word appears in different syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: StackExchange: machine learning, data analysis, software libraries

patterns.name: fit meaning capacity to hold
patterns.context: Indicates whether a value can fit within a finite bit width, not model fitting.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases with signature
patterns.context: Appears in “signature model” (a flagship model) and “clinical signature” (clinical characteristics); the meanings differ by context.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC product copy; NIH biomedical text

patterns.name: currency
patterns.context: Asks about the data type for currency in Kotlin; the word occurs in a title-style question.

patterns.name: Significance as a title word
patterns.context: “Significance” appears at the beginning of a title, followed by a topic about proton tunneling.

patterns.name: infinity norm phrase
patterns.context: Appears in the mathematical term “squared infinity norm.”

4_2863.concept: 英文内容词触发，语义不统一
4_2863.description: 强激活跨多种内容词出现：fit（含拟合与容量容纳义）、signature、currency、Significance、infinity；除 fit 外没有明显统一语义或稳定语境。

patterns.name: fit及拟合
patterns.context: 围绕模型、算法或数据讨论拟合困难、曲线拟合，或某方法是否调用 fit；触发词在不同句法位置均出现。
patterns.domain: StackExchange：机器学习、数据分析、软件库

patterns.name: fit 作容量容纳义
patterns.context: 表示某个数值能否容纳在有限位宽中，非模型拟合义。

patterns.name: signature 固定搭配
patterns.context: 分别出现在“signature model”（标志性型号）和“clinical signature”（临床特征）中；语境义不同。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 产品文案；NIH 生物医学文本

patterns.name: currency
patterns.context: 询问 Kotlin 中货币的数据类型；该词处于标题式问题中。

patterns.name: Significance 标题词
patterns.context: 标题开头的“Significance”，后接质子隧穿主题。

patterns.name: infinity norm 短语
patterns.context: 出现在“squared infinity norm”这一数学术语中。

en.description: The strongest and most recurring trigger is fit/fitting, especially in technical Q&A discussing fitting or compatibility; isolated high activations also occur for infinity, currency, signature, Significance, and other terms, spanning a broad range of meanings with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: “fit” in questions
patterns.context: StackExchange question titles or bodies discuss fitting or compatibility; activation is strong when fit appears explicitly. Nearby terms may involve SVMs, processing requirements, curves, or ColumnTransformer

patterns.name: Squared infinity norm
patterns.context: Asks about the expected squared infinity norm of a vector; also a StackExchange question, but with no occurrence of fit

patterns.name: The string “signature”
patterns.context: One instance describes a musician’s signature guitar, another the clinical features of botulinum neurotoxin; both are nouns, unrelated in meaning to “fitting”

patterns.name: Currency type
patterns.context: Asks about the data type for currency in Kotlin; no fit occurs

patterns.name: Whether a value fits
patterns.context: Discusses whether an integer representing a time difference can fit in two digits; here fit means capacity compatibility, not curve or model fitting

patterns.name: Significance in a title
patterns.context: A StackExchange question title asks about the meaning/significance of proton tunneling; no fit occurs

4_2863.description: 最强且反复的触发是 fit/fitting，尤其技术问答中讨论拟合或适配；另有 infinity、currency、signature、Significance 等孤立高激活，语义跨度大，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: 问句中的“fit”
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题标题或正文讨论拟合、适配；明确出现 fit 时激活强，邻近词可涉及 SVM、处理需求、曲线、ColumnTransformer

patterns.name: 平方无穷范数
patterns.context: 询问向量的期望平方无穷范数；同为 StackExchange 问题，但未见 fit

patterns.name: 字符串“signature”
patterns.context: 一次描述乐手的标志性吉他，一次描述肉毒神经毒素的临床特征；均为名词用法，语义与“拟合”无关
patterns.domain: 商品宣传文案；生物医学文本

patterns.name: 货币类型
patterns.context: 询问 Kotlin 中货币的数据类型；未见 fit

patterns.name: 限定值可容纳
patterns.context: 讨论时间差的整数能否装进两位；这里 fit 表示容量适配，而非曲线或模型拟合

patterns.name: 标题中的显著性
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题标题询问质子隧穿的意义/显著性；未见 fit

en.concept: Polysemous fit and other lexical triggers
en.description: Most snippets activate around fit/fit in and contexts involving model fitting, compatibility, or fitting into a space; isolated lexical patterns also occur for signature, infinity, and currency.

patterns.name: fit / fit in and compatibility
patterns.context: Questions or explanations discuss model fitting, whether algorithm requirements are compatible, Transformer method calls, or whether a number fits into a limited number of digits; activation occurs adjacent to fit.
patterns.domain: StackExchange: machine learning, parallel algorithms, curve fitting, software frameworks, data representation

patterns.name: Signature style / feature
patterns.context: Signature refers to a signature-model guitar or characteristic style, or to clinical features of a toxin; meanings differ, but the trigger word is the same.

patterns.name: Infinity in mathematical contexts
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of norms or sequences tending to infinity; both instances use mathematical terminology.

patterns.name: Currency type
patterns.context: Asks about the currency data type in Kotlin; activation falls on currency.

patterns.name: Time difference in minutes
patterns.context: Describes a datetime difference as an integer number of minutes that must fit into two digits; high activation on it may reflect a local fragment feature and cannot be clearly distinguished from fit in.

4_2863.concept: 多义词 fit 及其他词汇触发
4_2863.description: 多数片段在 fit／fit in 及其模型拟合、兼容、装入语境中激活；另有 signature、infinity 和 currency 等孤立词汇模式。

patterns.name: fit／fit in 及适配
patterns.context: 问题或说明中讨论模型拟合、算法需求是否适配、Transformer 方法调用，或数值能否装入有限位数；激活紧邻 fit。
patterns.domain: StackExchange：机器学习、并行算法、曲线拟合、软件框架、数据表示

patterns.name: signature 风格／特征
patterns.context: signature 指吉他型号的签名款/标志性风格，或毒素的临床特征；词义不同但触发词相同。

patterns.name: infinity 数学语境
patterns.context: 出现在范数或趋于无穷的序列讨论中；两处均为数学术语。

patterns.name: currency 类型
patterns.context: 询问 Kotlin 中货币数据类型；激活落在 currency。

patterns.name: 时间差分钟表示
patterns.context: 描述 datetime 差值以分钟整数表示，并需装入两位；it 的高激活可能属于局部片段特征，无法与 fit in 明确区分。

en.concept: Triggers from terms such as fit, signature, and infinity
en.description: Strong responses are distributed across fit in StackExchange titles/questions, signature in noun phrases across different fields, and infinity in mathematical contexts; there is also one instance of fit meaning that a value can fit within a number of bits. The commonality is weak and mainly reflects specific lexical triggers.

patterns.name: fit in StackExchange question titles
patterns.context: “fit” appears in StackExchange question titles or technical descriptions asking how to fit a model, curve, or algorithm, or why an object does not call fit; nearby wording often includes “Why,” “how to,” or “curve.”
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A covering machine learning, programming, and data analysis

patterns.name: The word signature
patterns.context: The term occurs in noun phrases referring to characteristics, a hallmark, or a style: clinical characteristics, product style, or gene expression characteristics; it is not limited to one field.

patterns.name: Near infinity
patterns.context: Mathematical contexts discussing the infinity norm or the behavior of a sequence at infinity.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science Q&A

patterns.name: Describing whether a value can fit
patterns.context: Used as a verb to describe whether a value or data can fit in a finite number of bits; not model fitting.

4_2863.description: 强响应分布在 StackExchange 标题/问题中的 fit、不同领域名词短语中的 signature，以及数学语境的 infinity；另有一次 fit 表示数值可装入位数。共同点较弱，主要是特定词项触发。

patterns.name: StackExchange 问题标题中的 fit
patterns.context: “fit”出现在 StackExchange 问题标题或技术问题描述中，询问如何拟合模型、曲线或算法，或某个对象为何不调用 fit；前后常有 “Why”“how to”“curve”等表述。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答，涉及机器学习、编程和数据分析

patterns.name: signature 一词
patterns.context: 术语出现在名词短语中，指特征、标志或风格：临床特征、产品风格或基因表达特征；不是固定单一领域。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文摘要与音乐/乐器介绍

patterns.name: infinity 附近
patterns.context: 数学语境中讨论无穷范数或序列在无穷处的行为。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学问答

patterns.name: 描述数值能否 fit
patterns.context: 作为动词，描述数值或数据能否装入有限位数的表示中；并非拟合模型。

en.concept: The term signature and Q&A text
en.description: The most consistent trigger is the term “signature,” whose meaning varies by context; a few StackExchange Q&A passages and mathematical phrases also activate, possibly due to Q&A format or other local features.

patterns.name: The term signature
patterns.context: The term itself is a stable trigger; it appears in different collocations and syntactic positions and does not require a fixed meaning or fixed surrounding context.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including biomedicine, patents, music product descriptions, and mathematics and programming Q&A

patterns.name: StackExchange Q&A format
patterns.context: Q&A-style posts or titles that begin with Q: or have a question title followed by a line break; this pattern occurs in passages without an obvious signature term.

patterns.name: Mathematical terminology snippets
patterns.context: Short mathematical question text about vector norms and random variables; unrelated to the term signature.

patterns.name: Patent material description
patterns.context: Describes fiber structures and forming an identifying feature with metal fibers; also contains the term signature.

patterns.name: Medical research and clinical descriptions
patterns.context: Signature describes disease features, genetic events, prognostic tools, or trauma types; it also appears in contexts involving botulinum toxin and tumor stem cells.

patterns.name: Product / style description
patterns.context: Introduces Mark Tremonti’s guitar design and musical style.

4_2863.description: 最一致的触发因素是词项“signature”，其含义随语境变化；另有少数 StackExchange 问答文本及数学词组激活，可能来自问答格式或其他局部特征。

patterns.name: signature 词项
patterns.trigger: “signature”，包括“clinical signature”“signature model”“signature style”“a signature formed”“gene expression signature”“signature genetic events”“gene signature”“with signature”“signature injury”
patterns.context: 词项本身是稳定触发点；出现在不同搭配和句法位置，不要求固定含义或固定前后文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利、音乐产品介绍、数学与编程问答等多种文体

patterns.name: StackExchange 问答格式
patterns.trigger: “Q:”及其后的换行符；问题开头如“Why are SVMs hard to fit?”和“Function Which Returns…”
patterns.context: 问答式帖子或标题，开头有 Q: 或问题标题与换行；此模式见于没有明显 signature 词项的段落。

patterns.name: 数学术语片段
patterns.context: 短数学问题文本，围绕向量范数及随机变量；与 signature 词项无关。

patterns.name: 专利材料描述
patterns.context: 描述纤维结构及用金属纤维形成识别特征；同时含有 signature 词项。

patterns.name: 医学科研与临床描述
patterns.trigger: “clinical signature”“gene expression signature”“signature genetic events”“70-gene MammaPrint signature”“signature injury”
patterns.context: signature 用于描述疾病特征、遗传事件、预后工具或创伤类型；也出现于肉毒毒素与肿瘤干细胞语境。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究与临床文本

patterns.name: 商品/风格介绍
patterns.context: 介绍 Mark Tremonti 的吉他设计与音乐风格。

en.description: The most stable local cue is the ending -zed, found in fuzzed, analyzed, catalyzed, razed, and decolourized. There is also activation on signature, technical/mathematical terms, and occasional split fragments of long words; sources and semantics vary widely.

patterns.name: The -zed ending
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in past participles or adjectives spelled with the ending zed; stems and meanings vary widely.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including technology discussions, structured data, academic papers, legal texts, and narrative writing

patterns.name: signature and nearby contexts
patterns.context: Appears in “clinical signature,” referring to clinical characteristics, and “signature model”/“signature style,” referring to a musician’s style or a product model; nearby unmarked parts of the same word may also activate.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts; music and product descriptions

patterns.name: Integer and mathematics question formats
patterns.context: Code/data-structure key-value fragments or math expressions posed in Q&A format; includes technical terms and structured symbols.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and code snippets

patterns.name: Subword fragments in organ terms or proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of split long words; the former is a medical term, while the latter is the name Mark Tremonti. Their relation to other patterns is unclear.

4_2863.concept: 含 -zed 词尾及若干词汇偶发响应
4_2863.description: 最稳定的局部线索是词尾 -zed，见 fuzzed、analyzed、catalyzed、razed、decolourized。另有 signature、技术/数学术语及少数拆分长词片段激活；来源和语义跨度较大。

patterns.name: 词尾 -zed
patterns.context: 激活集中在拼写以 zed 结尾的过去分词或形容词中；词干和语义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括科技讨论、结构化数据、学术论文、法律及叙述性文章

patterns.name: signature 及相邻语境
patterns.context: 分别出现在临床特征表述“clinical signature”和音乐家风格、型号表述“signature model”“signature style”中；未标记的同词相邻部分也可能有激活。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要；音乐与产品介绍

patterns.name: 整数与数学问题格式
patterns.context: 代码/数据结构键值片段，或以问答形式提出数学表达式；包含技术术语与结构化符号。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及代码片段

patterns.name: 器官或专名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的长词片段上；前者为医学术语，后者为人名 Mark Tremonti，是否与其他模式有关不明确。

en.concept: Split word endings in scientific terminology
en.description: High activation often falls on the endings of split words, especially -zed in hydrolyzed, catalyzed, and analyzed; there are also responses to scientific terms such as thermonuclear, homonuclear, decolourized, PTFE names, and ferritin.

patterns.name: Hydrolysis and related enzymatic processes
patterns.context: Verbs are split into tokens, especially in past participles or academic prose; hydrolyzed occurs in descriptions of chemical conversion, polymer/drug or membrane-protein processing; catalyzed occurs in enzymatic reactions; analyzed occurs in results analysis.
patterns.domain: Biochemistry, medicinal chemistry, materials science, experimental papers

patterns.name: Homonnuclear molecule-related terms
patterns.context: Describes homonuclear molecules and their infrared activity in an astrophysical context; activation falls on the latter part of the split word.

patterns.name: Thermonuclear explosion terminology
patterns.context: Describes thermonuclear explosions as a possible origin of hydrogen-free supernovae in accreting or merging systems; activation falls on the latter part of the split word.

patterns.name: Decolorization treatment
patterns.context: In an experimental method involving H₂O₂ treatment of a polysaccharide sample, the latter part of the past participle activates strongly.

patterns.name: Fluoropolymer names
patterns.context: Patent background on electrodes, membranes, and copolymer compositions; the PTFE name is split, and hydrolyzed also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Ferritin-related terms
patterns.context: Biochemical research on the release of non-heme, non-ferritin iron in liver microsomes; activation falls within the split word ferritin.

4_2863.concept: 科学术语中的拆分词尾
4_2863.description: 高激活常落在拆分词的词尾，尤以 -zed 的 hydrolyzed、catalyzed、analyzed 为主；另对 thermonuclear、homonuclear、decolourized、PTFE名称及 ferritin 等科学术语有反应。

patterns.name: hydrolysis及其相关酶促过程
patterns.context: 动词被拆分为 token，尤其在过去分词或论文叙述中；hydrolyzed出现在化学转化、聚合物/药物或膜蛋白处理中，catalyzed出现在酶促反应中，analyzed出现在结果分析中。
patterns.domain: 生物化学、药物化学、材料科学、实验论文

patterns.name: 同核分子相关术语
patterns.context: 天体物理语境中描述同核分子及其红外活性；激活落在拆分词的后半部分。

patterns.name: 热核爆炸术语
patterns.context: 描述无氢超新星可能起源于吸积或并合系统的热核爆炸；激活落在拆分词的后半部分。

patterns.name: 脱色处理
patterns.context: 多糖样品经H₂O₂处理的实验方法中，过去分词后半部分强激活。
patterns.domain: 生物材料/多糖研究摘要

patterns.name: 含氟聚合物名称
patterns.context: 电极、膜及共聚物组成的专利背景；PTFE名称被切分，且同段也出现hydrolyzed。

patterns.name: 铁蛋白相关词项
patterns.context: 肝微粒体中非血红素、非铁蛋白铁释放的生化研究；激活落在拆分的ferritin词内。

en.description: Activation is scattered across heterogeneous corpora: some falls on the letter sequence th, while other instances involve the km distance unit, HTML form markup, and submitted in research-data or creative-work contexts. There is no unified semantic pattern covering all examples.

patterns.name: Unicode character sequence th in scientific papers
patterns.context: Activation falls within words containing the letter sequence th, often appearing as a standalone subword fragment; nearby words and semantics vary widely across examples.
patterns.domain: Mostly ArXiv or biomedical research texts; also NIH records

patterns.name: Distance unit km with a comma
patterns.context: Geographic entries give distances between two places in kilometers; values and nearby place names vary.

patterns.name: HTML form tag attributes
patterns.context: File-input and submit-button tags in an HTML form, followed by PHP file-submission handling code.

patterns.name: Biology data submission term
patterns.context: A sentence states that raw sequencing data have been submitted to the NCBI SRA database.

patterns.name: submitted in a congratulatory message
patterns.context: A congratulatory message to participants mentions that they submitted their entries.

4_2863.description: 激活分散在异质语料中：部分落在 th 字母片段，另有 km 距离单位、HTML 表单标记，以及科研数据或作品语境中的 submitted；没有覆盖全部例子的统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 科学论文中的 Unicode 字符 th
patterns.trigger: «th»9（见 “therm«onuclear»” 所在词跨 token 分段处、「70 «th»ousand」、「(«as»th«ma»)」及 «th»ias）
patterns.context: 激活落在含 th 字母序列的词内，且常以独立子词片段出现；各例中附近的词和语义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 多为 ArXiv 或医学科研文本；也有 NIH 记录

patterns.name: 带逗号的距离单位 km
patterns.trigger: «km»4，前面是距离数值、后面常接地名方位或地点
patterns.context: 地理条目按公里给出两个地点间的距离；数值和周边地点名各异。

patterns.name: HTML 表单标签属性
patterns.context: HTML 表单中的文件输入与提交按钮标签，后接 PHP 文件提交处理代码。

patterns.name: 生物学数据提交词
patterns.context: 句中说明原始测序数据已提交至 NCBI SRA 数据库。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 祝贺语中的 submitted
patterns.context: 面向参赛者的祝贺文字中，提及大家提交了参赛作品。

en.description: The most stable feature is the ordinal suffix “th” after numbers, appearing across dates, rankings, and mathematical indexing; several passages also contain calendar dates, while a few involve physics/mathematical symbols or sports rankings.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: The ordinal suffix after a number, especially in dates, rankings, or mathematical indices; activation is concentrated on th itself, not the corresponding number.
patterns.domain: Email, academic papers, Q&A, sports commentary, IRC

patterns.name: Dates and scheduling information
patterns.context: Calendar dates, event dates, or deadlines; often accompanied by weekdays, months, years, times, and scheduling terms such as deadline and Date.
patterns.domain: Corporate email, conference notices, event invitations, academic CVs

patterns.name: The kth/jth object in mathematics or physics
patterns.context: A symbol or variable with an ordinal suffix refers to an indexed object, measurement interval, or repeated trial; a natural-language date context is not required.

patterns.name: Places and rankings
patterns.context: Describes rankings or placements in sports discussions; in addition to 4th, top 10 may also be a related ranking expression.

patterns.name: Date fields in formatted records
patterns.context: Date fields in metadata lists containing authors, dates, titles, and similar information.
patterns.domain: Academic paper author information or CVs

4_2863.description: 最稳定特征是数字后的序数后缀“th”，跨日期、排名及数学编号出现；多段还含日程日期，少数为物理/数学符号或体育名次语境。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 数字之后的序数后缀，尤其日期、排名或数学指标中的序数；激活集中在 th 本身，而非对应的数字。
patterns.domain: 邮件、学术论文、问答、体育评论、IRC

patterns.name: 日期与日程信息
patterns.context: 日历日期、活动日期或截止日期；常伴随星期、月份、年份、时间及 deadline、Date 等日程词。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、会议通知、活动邀请、学术履历

patterns.name: 数学或物理中的第 k/j 个对象
patterns.context: 符号或变量加序数后缀，指某个编号对象、测量区间或重复试验；不要求自然语言日期语境。

patterns.name: 名次与排名
patterns.context: 体育讨论中描述排名或名次；除 4th 外，top 10 也可能是相关的排名表达。

patterns.name: 格式化记录中的日期字段
patterns.context: 作者、日期、标题等元数据列表中的日期字段。
patterns.domain: 学术论文作者信息或履历

en.concept: Numbers, proper names, and structured text fragments
en.description: Activation is scattered across numbers and their subwords, proper-name fragments, hardware models, code fields, and table symbols; there are also sporadic common function words and quoted text. No unified semantics or stable syntactic trigger conditions are apparent across corpora.

patterns.name: Numbers and unit/identifier formats
patterns.context: Numbers occur in parameters, serial numbers, floors, dates, or technical specifications with units; in many cases, activation falls on subword fragments of numbers.
patterns.domain: Technical documentation, astronomy papers, hardware tables, encyclopedias, event names

patterns.name: Proper names and internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation often falls on proper names, author surnames, institution names, or their split fragments, with no unified word meaning or syntactic environment.

patterns.name: Hardware models and product names
patterns.context: Occurs in processor specification tables or code class names, often alongside generation, model, process node, or structured fields.

patterns.name: Short function words and common collocations
patterns.context: Occasional activation in continuous text, including grammatical function words and common collocations; no stable local syntactic condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Email, academic papers, encyclopedias, and medical web text

patterns.name: Structured code and table symbols
patterns.context: Occurs in semicolon-separated record-like data or code structures such as class definitions and field declarations.

patterns.name: Quoted words and quotation marks
patterns.context: Words are quoted in a sentence explaining the symbolic meaning of floor numbers; activation also appears on scattered word fragments and numbers.

patterns.name: Medical event titles and ordinal numbers
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated in a formal event title following website information; the title includes an ordinal and title-style capitalization.

4_2863.concept: 数字、专名与结构化文本片段
4_2863.description: 激活分散于数字及其子词、专名片段、硬件型号、代码字段与表格符号；另有零散普通功能词和引号内文本。不同语料中未见统一语义或稳定句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字与单位、编号格式
patterns.context: 数字出现在参数、序号、楼层、日期或带单位的技术规格中；多处激活落在数字的子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 技术文档、天文学论文、硬件表格、百科、活动名称

patterns.name: 专名和词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在专有名词、作者姓氏、机构名或其分词片段上，且没有统一的词义或句法环境。
patterns.domain: 邮件、学术论文及参考文献

patterns.name: 硬件型号与产品名
patterns.context: 出现在处理器规格表或代码类名中，常与代际、型号、制程或结构化字段并列。

patterns.name: 短功能词及常见搭配
patterns.context: 在连续文本中偶有激活，包含普通语法功能词和常见搭配；未见稳定的局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、学术论文、百科及医学网页文本

patterns.name: 结构化代码与表格符号
patterns.context: 出现在分号分隔的类似记录数据，或类定义、字段声明等代码结构内。

patterns.name: 引号内词语与引号标点
patterns.context: 词语被引号标出，且处于解释楼层数字寓意的句子中；同时激活散落在词内分片和数字上。

patterns.name: 医学活动标题与序数词
patterns.context: 激活集中在网站信息后的正式活动标题，包含序数词和标题式大小写。

en.concept: Mixed features of subword fragments and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activation is scattered across common English words, internal word substrings, code and markup syntax, proper names and numbers, and newline boundaries; there is no stable single semantic or domain theme, and some behavior may reflect subword fragments and formatting.

patterns.name: Split suffixes or internal word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments inside complete words or identifiers, rather than on stable whole words; some fragments may be word endings near tokenization boundaries.
patterns.domain: Mixed text including code, names, and URLs; segments 1, 5, and 10

patterns.name: English word forms and common phrases
patterns.context: Occurs in natural English sentences, involving demonstratives, common words, word endings, or letters in abbreviations; collocations vary across segments.

patterns.name: Technical terms and code syntax
patterns.context: Embedded in JavaScript event-handler code or patent technical prose, involving window resizing, image sensors, and frequency limits.

patterns.name: Specific internal substrings and terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in biomedical sentences describing mechanisms of interaction between labels; trigger locations include term endings and complete terms.

patterns.name: Fragments near proper names, dates, and values
patterns.context: Located in descriptions of drug transaction timelines and journal impact-factor rankings; words are adjacent to numbers/ordinals but lack a shared semantic theme.

patterns.name: List formatting and newline characters
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the end of code or at newline positions in author-address lists, possibly reflecting formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: MVC-related terminology
patterns.context: In sentences discussing micro-views, macro-view, and typical MVC, activation falls on several common function words.

patterns.name: Name and place fragments
patterns.context: Names, cities, or countries in author and institutional address text; trigger fragments do not form a consistent type of proper name.

patterns.name: XML/configuration field fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in XML attributes, paths, and string content; markers fall on tag names or domain fragments.

4_2863.concept: 词片段与格式边界混合特征
4_2863.description: 激活分散于英语常见词、词内子串、代码与标记语法、专名数字及换行边界；未见稳定的单一语义或领域主题，部分表现可能来自分词片段与格式。

patterns.name: 拆分后缀或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词或标识符内部的子词片段上，而非稳定的完整词；部分片段可能是分词边界附近的词尾。
patterns.domain: 代码、姓名、网址等混合文本；段1、5、10

patterns.name: 英语词形与常见短语
patterns.context: 出现在自然英语句子中，涉及指示词、常见词、词尾或缩写中的字母；各段中的搭配并不一致。

patterns.name: 技术术语及代码语法
patterns.context: 嵌在 JavaScript 事件处理代码或专利技术叙述中，涉及窗口调整大小、图像传感器和频率限制。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 代码、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 特定词内子串与术语
patterns.context: 出现在描述标签相互作用机制的生物医学句子中，触发位置包括术语词尾及完整术语。

patterns.name: 专名、日期及数值附近片段
patterns.context: 位于药物交易时间线、期刊影响因子排名等叙述中，词语与数字/序数相邻，但缺少共同语义主题。

patterns.name: 列表格式与换行符
patterns.context: 激活出现在代码末尾或作者地址列表中的换行位置，可能反映格式边界。

patterns.name: MVC相关用语
patterns.context: 谈论 micro-views、macro-view 及典型 MVC 的句子中，激活落在若干常见功能词上。

patterns.name: 人名及地名片段
patterns.context: 作者及其机构所在地的姓名、城市或国家文本；触发片段不构成一致的专名类型。

patterns.name: XML/配置字段片段
patterns.context: 出现在 XML 属性、路径和字符串内容中，标记落在标签名或域名片段上。

en.description: Activation spans numbers, the ordinal suffix th, and quantity/statistical expressions; it also appears sporadically in medical symptoms, chemical patent structures, molecular mechanisms, person classifications, and place-name entries. No stable semantic pattern unifies all the terms.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: Follows a number to form an ordinal, commonly in years, grade levels, percentiles, or dates; it may also be split into a separate token.

patterns.name: Numbers and numeric formats
patterns.context: Numbers appear in formats such as ages/years, percentages, statistics, and chemical patent numbers; some are adjacent to th, %, or punctuation.

patterns.name: Quantity and measurement expressions
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across expressions of quantities, proportions, ranges, and statistical comparisons, with no fixed phrase shared across all passages.

patterns.name: Disease and clinical symptom terms
patterns.context: Appears in passages about aging, functional decline, patient test data, platelet counts, or bleeding/bruising symptoms; some terms are split by tokenization.

patterns.name: Lower values or declining outcomes
patterns.context: Describes lower cholesterol/smoking rates after an intervention, a statistical significance threshold, or slowed functional decline.
patterns.domain: Medical research abstracts and statistical reports

patterns.name: Patent chemical structures and group descriptions
patterns.context: Superscript numbers in chemical formulas, substituents, and descriptions of ring systems; numbers interleave with punctuation and structural names.

patterns.name: Label interactions and crowding mechanisms
patterns.context: Explains interactions between labels and molecular crowding mechanisms.

patterns.name: Person classifications and alumni entries
patterns.context: An encyclopedia category list names people, university affiliations, and alumni status.

patterns.name: Place names and their components
patterns.context: An encyclopedia disambiguation page lists names of cities, rivers, communities, townships, and villages; activation often falls on split fragments of the names.

4_2863.concept: 数字与结构化文本片段
4_2863.description: 激活覆盖数字、序数后缀th及数量/统计表达，也散见于医学症状、化学专利结构、分子机制、人物分类和地名条目；未发现能统一解释所有词项的稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 数字后表示序数，常见于年份、年级、百分位或日期；也可能被拆分为独立 token。
patterns.domain: 科研论文、专利、百科条目

patterns.name: 数字与数值格式
patterns.context: 数字出现在年龄/年份、百分数、统计量、化学专利编号等格式中；部分数字与 th、% 或标点相邻。

patterns.name: 数量及计量表达
patterns.trigger: «of»、«in»、«for»、«to»、«the» 等功能词，以及 “«25»«%»”“«10» three”“«less»« than»”
patterns.context: 激活分布在数量、比例、范围、统计比较等表达中，未见这些词在所有段落中组成固定短语。

patterns.name: 疾病与临床症状词
patterns.context: 谈论衰老、功能下降、患者检验数据、血小板计数或出血/瘀伤症状时出现；若干词被分词切开。

patterns.name: 较低数值或下降结果
patterns.context: 描述干预后较低的胆固醇/吸烟率、统计显著性门槛，或功能衰退减缓。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要与统计报告

patterns.name: 专利化学结构与基团表述
patterns.context: 化学式中的上标编号、取代基和环系结构描述；数字与标点、结构名称交错。
patterns.domain: 专利背景/化学专利文本

patterns.name: 标签相互作用与拥挤机制
patterns.context: 解释标签之间相互作用及分子拥挤机制。

patterns.name: 人物分类与校友条目
patterns.context: 百科分类列表中列出人物、大学关联和校友身份。

patterns.name: 地名及地名组成部分
patterns.context: 百科消歧页面列出城市、河流、社群、乡镇和村庄等名称；激活常落在被拆分的名称片段上。

en.description: Primarily responds to the th suffix in ordinal expressions and the up to structure indicating a quantity limit; the former occurs in dates, rankings, editions, and grades, while the latter occurs in quantity limits in technical text.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: The -th suffix in ordinal numbers or words; occurs in dates, editions, rankings, and grade expressions
patterns.domain: Competitions, dates, academic and patent texts

patterns.name: up to quantity structure
patterns.context: Indicates an upper bound or maximum quantity, followed by a number, quantity phrase, or quantified object

4_2863.description: 主要响应序数表达中的 th 后缀，以及表示数量上限的 up to 结构；前者见于日期、名次、届次和年级，后者见于技术文本中的数量限定。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 序数数字或词语的 -th 后缀；出现在日期、届次、名次、年级等表达中
patterns.domain: 赛事、日期、学术与专利文本

patterns.name: up to 数量结构
patterns.trigger: «up»« to»，以及后续数量，如 «up»« to»10« three»、«up»« to»9
patterns.context: 表示上限或最大数量，后接数词、数量短语或量化对象
patterns.domain: 专利、科研项目、技术说明

en.description: Activation is sporadic: it includes the ordinal suffix th, dimension d and variable n in formulas, number fragments, the formal negation yet, How would questions, and various subword fragments and common function words. Apart from a few local forms, there is no unified trigger across passages.

patterns.name: Word-final or stem fragment “th”
patterns.context: A word ending that marks an ordinal after a number; high activation falls on th.

patterns.name: Superscript or exponent d after a number
patterns.context: In a mathematical formula, d follows R in superscript position and denotes dimension.

patterns.name: th in an ordinal
patterns.context: An ordinal suffix after a number, appearing in a grade-level expression.

patterns.name: Number fragments in numbers or identifiers
patterns.context: A fragment within a digit string is marked; one instance is an address/identifier and another is the day in a date.

patterns.name: n in mathematical notation
patterns.context: n serves as an exponent or integer variable within a string of formula symbols.

patterns.name: Negation word yet
patterns.context: In the relatively formal negative expression “not as yet”.

patterns.name: would in questions
patterns.context: Challenges or follows up with “How would …?”; [5] also emphasizes testing methods.

patterns.name: Intra-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within different words or symbols; there is no obvious shared context, and most occur in only one passage.
patterns.domain: Patents, historical entries, paper metadata, and mathematics papers

patterns.name: Common function words and phrase fragments in sentences
patterns.context: Several high-frequency function words and words in phrases are sporadically marked in ordinary sentences or technical prose; there is no stable visible semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Comments, historical narration, patents, and abstracts

4_2863.description: 激活分布零散：包括序数词 th、公式中的维数 d 与变量 n、数字片段、正式否定表达 yet、How would 疑问句，以及多种词内子词和普通功能词。除少数局部形式外，跨段缺乏统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 词尾或词干片段「th」
patterns.context: 数字后表示序数的词尾；高激活落在 th 上。

patterns.name: 数字后的上标或指数 d
patterns.context: 数学公式中，d 紧跟在 R 的上标位置，表示维数。

patterns.name: 序数词中的 th
patterns.context: 数字后的序数词尾，出现在年级表述中。

patterns.name: 数字或标识符中的数字片段
patterns.context: 数字串内部的片段被标记；一个是地址/编号，一个是日期中的日。

patterns.name: 数学符号中的 n
patterns.context: 以 n 作为指数或整数变量，位于公式符号串中。

patterns.name: 否定词 yet
patterns.context: 在「not as yet」这一较正式的否定表达中。

patterns.name: 疑问句中的 would
patterns.context: 以「How would …?」提出质疑或追问；[5] 还强调测试方法。

patterns.name: 词内分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同词或符号内部的子词片段；没有明显共同语境，且多数只出现于单一段落。
patterns.domain: 专利、历史条目、论文元数据及数学论文

patterns.name: 句中常用功能词和短语片段
patterns.context: 在普通句子或技术行文中，若干高频功能词及短语中的词被零散标记；没有稳定可见的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 评论、历史叙述、专利及摘要

en.concept: Ordinal suffix and heterogeneous text patterns
en.description: Primarily activates on the ordinal suffix th and expressions involving years, grades, and dates; additional local patterns include a paper rank title, copyright templates, medical results and fifth-grade research, military narration, and colloquial rhetorical questions.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: A number is directly followed by th, commonly forming dates, grades, years, or ordinals; activation falls on the suffix th
patterns.domain: Papers, medical abstracts, promotional copy, encyclopedias, and general text

patterns.name: rank in a title or proper name
patterns.context: higher appears next to rank in a paper title or filename

patterns.name: Copyright declaration template words
patterns.context: License and copyright declarations in comments at the beginning of source files; activation spans multiple template words

patterns.name: Low values and reduction-result statements
patterns.context: Describes a reduced metric in an intervention group compared with a control group or previous data, accompanied by comparisons and results wording

patterns.name: School-grade participants
patterns.context: Recruitment or description of fifth-grade students in a school study, involving consent to participate and research aims

patterns.name: Specific historical date format
patterns.context: An observation date composed of a day, ordinal suffix, and month

patterns.name: Military equipment and action words
patterns.context: Describes an aircraft and its close flyby over a warship; this segment does not show the preceding ordinal or title pattern

patterns.name: Function words in rhetorical questions
patterns.context: Informal dialogue asks how replacing the battery would solve the problem and expresses doubt in a hedging tone

4_2863.concept: 序数后缀与异质文本模式
4_2863.description: 主要对序数 th 后缀及其所在的年份、年级、日期等表达激活；另有论文 rank 标题、版权模板、医学结果与五年级研究、军事叙述及口语反问等局部模式。

patterns.name: 序数后缀 th
patterns.context: 数字后直接接 th，常构成日期、年级、年度或序数；激活落在后缀 th 上
patterns.domain: 论文、医学摘要、宣传文案、百科及一般文本

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的 rank
patterns.context: higher 与 rank 相邻，出现在论文标题或文件名中

patterns.name: 版权声明模板词
patterns.trigger: « *»3 @license«↵»2« *»2 Copyright« (»1c«)»1« 2012»2 VM«ware»2,« Inc»2«.»3 All Rights« Reserved»4
patterns.context: 源代码文件开头的注释式许可证与版权声明，激活覆盖多个模板词

patterns.name: 低值及降低结果表述
patterns.trigger: « lower»、« lower»3« prevalence»、« lower»2 mean total cholesterol
patterns.context: 描述干预组相较对照或既往数据的降低指标，并伴随比较、结果表述

patterns.name: 学校年级受试者
patterns.context: 学校研究招募或描述五年级学生，涉及同意参与及研究目的

patterns.name: 特定历史日期格式
patterns.context: 日、序数后缀和月份组成的观测日期

patterns.name: 军事装备及动作词
patterns.trigger: «24»2« that»3 bu«z»1«zed»9« the»1 USS Donald Cook
patterns.context: 描述军机及其对军舰的近距离飞越；该片段未呈现前述序数或标题模式

patterns.name: 反问句中的功能词
patterns.trigger: How« would»6« that»9 help? Not doub«ting»2 you
patterns.context: 口语化对话中询问电池更换如何解决问题，并以缓和语气表达怀疑

en.concept: Ordinal suffix th and miscellaneous text triggers
en.description: The most stable pattern is ordinal suffix th after a number, seen in grade levels, centuries, editions, years, and military unit numbers. Other activations are scattered across metadata, academic and technical terms, biographies, military narratives, software reviews, and promotional copy, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: The ordinal suffix th follows a number, especially for grade levels, centuries, editions, years, or military unit numbers.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, encyclopedias, patents, historical texts, and event descriptions

patterns.name: Paper metadata and title fragments
patterns.context: Structured metadata for papers or preprints, reference filenames, and titles; punctuation, line breaks, and title-word fragments also occur.

patterns.name: Results of school intervention studies
patterns.context: Describes health indicators or smoking among students at intervention schools and compares them with grade-level or control data.

patterns.name: Names and identity descriptions in biographies
patterns.context: The opening of a biography introduces a person’s name, nationality, profession, and influence.

patterns.name: Authors and technical terms in paper citations
patterns.context: A paper or patent background cites work on computer architecture; activations also occur on names and technical terms.

patterns.name: Aircraft and nicknames in military narratives
patterns.context: Describes aerial combat, aircraft damage, military nicknames, and unit numbers.

patterns.name: Software development complaints and common function words
patterns.context: Informally criticizes rewriting software, former developers leaving, and technical debt; activation falls on multiple words and subword fragments.

patterns.name: Worker migration and East–West business narratives
patterns.context: Discusses industrial workers being drawn abroad and economic activity and industrial espionage, then turns to East–West business development.

patterns.name: Biographical sketches and military-history bibliographies
patterns.context: A short biography and school information are followed by a military history book title or bibliographic text.

patterns.name: Event packages and conference promotions
patterns.context: Uses uppercase package titles and a conference name to promote a conference, dinner, and entertainment arrangements.

4_2863.concept: 序数后缀 th 及杂项文本触发
4_2863.description: 最稳定的模式是数字后的序数后缀 th，见年级、世纪、届次、年度和部队编号。其余激活分散于元数据、学术与技术词、传记、军事叙述、软件评论及宣传文案，未显示统一语义。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 数字后接序数词后缀 th，尤其用于年级、世纪、届次、年度或军队单位编号。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、百科、专利、历史与活动介绍

patterns.name: 论文元数据与标题片段
patterns.context: 论文或预印本的结构化元数据、参考文献文件名及标题；同时出现标点、换行和标题词片段。

patterns.name: 学校干预研究结果
patterns.trigger: “« lower»1 mean total cholesterol values in« girls»2« attending»3« the»2 intervention schools”, “« lower»1 prevalence of smoking”
patterns.context: 描述干预学校学生的健康指标或吸烟情况，并与年级或对照数据比较。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的姓名与身份描述
patterns.context: 人物传记开头介绍姓名、国籍、职业及其影响力。

patterns.name: 论文引文中的作者与技术术语
patterns.trigger: “Wol«fe»2”, “« Chan»1«in»6”, ““Exec«uting»1 Comp«ressed»1« Programs»1 on An Emb«ed»2«ded»3 R«ISC»1 Architecture”
patterns.context: 论文或专利背景部分引用计算机体系结构方面的论文；姓名和技术术语中也有激活。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、计算机学术引文

patterns.name: 军史叙述中的战机与绰号
patterns.trigger: “Chinese« pilot»1 who seriously« damaged»2« the»2 F-86«E»1« of»2”, “‘B«ones»1«»1’”, “« of»3« the»2 335«th»9 FIS”
patterns.context: 叙述空战、飞机受损、军人绰号及部队编号。

patterns.name: 软件开发抱怨及常见功能词
patterns.trigger: “hip«ster»1”, “«that»1 wrote your« backend»1”, “left« for»3 green«er»1« past»1ures”, “won«'t»5« even»9« try»1« to»1 guess the amount« of»2”
patterns.context: 口语化地批评重写软件、前任开发者离职和技术债；激活落在多个词及词片段上。

patterns.name: 工人迁移与东西方商业叙述
patterns.context: 讨论工业工人被吸引出国及经济、工业间谍活动，随后转入东西方商业发展。

patterns.name: 人物简介及军事史书目
patterns.context: 短传与学校信息之后接军事史书名或书目式文字。
patterns.domain: 网络人物简介、书目文字

patterns.name: 活动套餐与会议宣传
patterns.context: 以大写套餐标题和会议名称宣传会议、晚餐及娱乐安排。

en.concept: Numerical and formatting fragments in scientific text
en.description: Primarily responds to comparative thresholds, ranges, and unit expressions near numbers, and also to the ordinal suffix “th”; sporadic activations also occur in statistical terminology, methodological phrasing, and fixed phrases.

patterns.name: Threshold and numerical range expressions
patterns.context: Activations cluster around numerical expressions of comparative thresholds, bounds, or limits; numbers are split into multiple tokens, with units or following nouns immediately after them.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patents, medical statistics, and mathematical explanations

patterns.name: Ordinal suffixes in ordinal numbers
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinals formed from numbers, indicating conference editions, months, or sequence numbers; activation falls on the ordinal suffix.
patterns.domain: Technical references, forum names, mathematical/financial explanations

patterns.name: Magnitude or unit fragments in measurement units
patterns.context: A physical unit follows a number or magnitude expression; activation falls on the unit word or one of its components.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments in statistical terminology
patterns.context: The term appears in explanations of methods, statistical results, or analytical workflows, without clear dependence on a numerical threshold.

patterns.name: Method- or operation-related phrasing
patterns.context: Occurs when introducing methods for applying materials or describing computer program execution; its relationship to the main numerical formatting pattern is unclear.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections, computer architecture papers

patterns.name: Phrase fragments in fixed terminology
patterns.context: Occurs as part of the fixed term “fit-for-purpose validation,” without clear numerical or ordinal conditions.

4_2863.concept: 科学文本中的数值与格式片段
4_2863.description: 主要响应数字附近的比较阈值、范围和单位表达，也响应序数词后缀“th”；另见统计术语、方法措辞及固定短语中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 阈值和数值范围表达
patterns.context: 激活集中在比较阈值、上下界或限制范围的数值表述中；数字被拆成多个 token，单位或后续名词紧随其后。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利、医学统计及数学说明

patterns.name: 序数词中的序数后缀
patterns.context: 出现在数字构成的序数词中，表示论文届次、月份或序号；激活落在序数后缀上。
patterns.domain: 技术参考文献、论坛名称、数学/金融说明

patterns.name: 度量单位中的数量级或单位片段
patterns.context: 数字或数量级表达后接物理单位；激活落在单位词或其组成部分上。

patterns.name: 统计术语中的词形片段
patterns.context: 术语处于方法、统计结果或分析流程的说明中，未明显依赖数值阈值。

patterns.name: 方法/操作相关措辞
patterns.context: 在介绍材料应用方法或计算机程序执行时出现；与主要数值格式模式关系不明。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、计算机体系结构论文

patterns.name: 固定术语中的短语片段
patterns.context: 作为“fit-for-purpose validation”固定术语的一部分出现，未见明确数值或序数条件。
patterns.domain: 生物分析方法与监管术语

en.description: Primarily responds to suffixes in ordinal numbers, with th after numbers being the most stable; it also responds to ordinal suffixes such as st and nd. Ordinals occur in varied contexts including years, dates, editions, centuries, months, and grade levels, with no obvious restriction by domain or genre.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: A number and th form an ordinal, followed by nouns such as season, Annual, century, or month, or appearing in dates.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, patent documents, forum mathematics content, conference promotions, academic papers, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: Other ordinal suffixes
patterns.context: Ordinal number forms, especially dates; example 3 also contains the ordinal 21st.

patterns.name: Month names in numeric dates
patterns.context: Ordinal dates are written as “ordinal number + of + month” or “ordinal number + month”; not all ordinal instances use the same format.

4_2863.description: 主要响应序数数字中的后缀，尤以数字后的 th 最稳定；也响应 st、nd 等序数后缀。序数用于年份、日期、届次、世纪、月份和年级等多种语境，领域与文体不构成明显限制。

patterns.name: 序数后缀 th
patterns.context: 数字与 th 构成序数，后接 season、Annual、century、month、日期等名词，或出现在日期中。
patterns.domain: 百科、专利文献、论坛数学内容、会议宣传、学术论文及医学摘要

patterns.name: 其他序数后缀
patterns.context: 数字序数形式，尤其是月份日期；第 3 段还有 21st 这一序数。
patterns.domain: 论坛数学内容、数学论文

patterns.name: 数字日期中的月份名
patterns.context: 序数日期写作“数字序数 + of + 月份”或“数字序数 + 月份”，并非所有序数实例都采用同一格式。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、天文学论文、数学论文

en.description: The most stable feature is the ordinal suffix th (across all segments), with occasional st and nd; commonly found in dates, centuries, sequence numbers, and medical location expressions. Several local word activations do not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: The ordinal suffix th is highlighted on its own; the number can indicate a date, month, century, rank, or sequence number, often followed by a noun or date element.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; paper citations, medicine, astronomical observations, history, finance, email, and dates in mathematical literature

patterns.name: Other ordinal suffixes
patterns.context: Numerical ordinals ending in st or nd; as with the th pattern, they indicate order or dates.
patterns.domain: Financial text, dates in mathematical papers

patterns.name: Date/sequence expressions around th
patterns.context: The ordinal is embedded in expressions for date ranges, days of gestation, or anatomical locations; adjacent function words also activate in addition to the suffix.

patterns.name: Century expressions with th century
patterns.context: The ordinal suffix th is followed by century to indicate a century; preceded by a definite article or century-related context.

patterns.name: Ordinal months/dates and date phrasing
patterns.context: An ordinal number is combined with a month name, or of introduces the month; expresses an observation date or paper submission date.
patterns.domain: Astronomical observation records, history of mathematical papers

patterns.name: Local accompanying activations that do not fit the ordinal pattern
patterns.context: These words are highlighted in their respective contexts, but have no clear connection to the shared pattern of ordinal suffixes th/st/nd; they may be local co-activations or independent activations.
patterns.domain: Patent citations, historical narratives, financial formulas, mathematical notation

4_2863.description: 最稳定的特征是序数数字后缀 th（覆盖全部段），少数出现 st、nd；常见于日期、世纪、序号及医学位置表达。另有若干无法由此模式解释的局部词语激活。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 序数数字后缀 th 被单独标出；数字可表示日期、月份、世纪、排名或序号，后面常接名词或日期成分。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；论文引文、医学、天文观测、历史、金融、邮件及数学文献日期

patterns.name: 其他序数后缀
patterns.context: 数字序数后缀以 st 或 nd 结尾；与 th 模式相同，表示次序或日期。
patterns.domain: 金融文本、数学论文日期

patterns.name: th 前后的日期/序号表达
patterns.trigger: 如“on»1« the»1 11«th»10 through 14«th»6« day»2« of»2 gestation”“between« the»1 5«th»9 and 6«th»6 vertebra”
patterns.context: 序数词嵌在日期范围、孕期日数或解剖位置等表达中；除后缀外，相邻功能词也有激活。

patterns.name: th century 世纪表达
patterns.context: 序数后缀 th 后接 century，表示世纪；前有定冠词或世纪主题语境。

patterns.name: 序数月份/日期与日期措辞
patterns.trigger: “25«th»8« November»1”“20«th»9« April»2”“12«th»9« of»4« May»3”“2«nd»7« of»5« June»2”
patterns.context: 序数数字与月份名称组合，或用 of 引出月份；表达观测日期或论文提交日期。
patterns.domain: 天文学观测记录、数学论文史

patterns.name: 不符合序数模式的局部伴随激活
patterns.trigger: “« workers»1”“« preventing»1« this»1”“returns« of»3« your»2”“«{»2G«}_»1«2»2”“« Compressed»2« Programs»2”
patterns.context: 这些词在各自语境中被标记，但与序数后缀 th/st/nd 的共同模式没有清楚联系；可能是局部伴随或独立激活。
patterns.domain: 专利引文、历史叙述、金融公式、数学符号

en.concept: Ordinal suffix th (with sporadic word fragments)
en.description: The most stable pattern is ordinal suffix th after a number, covering dates, editions, centuries, percentiles, and positions across domains. Other sporadic activations include intra-word fragments, function words, and unit abbreviations, with no unified context.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: Ordinal suffix th follows a number, especially in dates, centuries, conference editions, or measurement positions; it is often followed by a noun
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text: conference promotions, medicine, patents, emails, encyclopedias, astronomy

patterns.name: Internal segmentation in references and proper names
patterns.context: Fragments within words are marked in references, paper titles, or proper names; the current examples have no clear semantic connection to ordinal th

patterns.name: Conference and event language
patterns.context: Event promotions or conference names; also contains the ordinal “20«th»”

patterns.name: Quantity, unit, and percentage formats
patterns.context: Values are adjacent to units or abbreviations and concern metrics such as efficiency or birth weight; these coexist with the ordinal pattern but occur at different positions

patterns.name: Grammatical function words and phrase fragments
patterns.context: Ordinary prepositions, articles, or phrase elements are marked in different syntactic positions; apart from a few date structures, no unified semantic condition is apparent

patterns.name: Word-final or internal abbreviation fragments
patterns.context: Marks fall at the ends or within words across heterogeneous vocabulary, with no stable shared context

patterns.name: Fragments near capitalization or punctuation
patterns.context: Marks appear in proper names, abbreviations, or positions adjacent to punctuation; no shared semantic trigger is apparent

4_2863.concept: 序数后缀 th（兼有零散词片段）
4_2863.description: 最稳定的模式是数字后的序数后缀 th，涵盖各领域的日期、届次、世纪、百分位与位置。另有词内片段、功能词、单位缩写等零散激活，缺乏统一上下文。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 数字后接序数后缀 th，尤其是日期、世纪、会议届次或测量位置中的序数；后续常接名词
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：会议宣传、医学、专利、邮件、百科、天文

patterns.name: 文献引用及专名内部切分
patterns.context: 参考文献、论文题名或专名中，词的内部片段被标记；当前例子与序数 th 无明显语义联系

patterns.name: 会议及活动用语
patterns.context: 活动宣传或会议名称；同时含有“20«th»”这一序数

patterns.name: 数量、单位与百分数格式
patterns.context: 数值与单位或缩写相邻，涉及效率、出生体重等指标；与序数模式并存但触发位置不同

patterns.name: 语法功能词及短语片段
patterns.trigger: “« to»”“« for»”“« on»”“« after»”“« the»”“« into»”“« between»”
patterns.context: 普通介词、冠词或短语成分在不同句法位置被标记；除少数日期结构外，未见统一语义条件
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文及科技文本

patterns.name: 词尾或缩写内部片段
patterns.context: 标记落在完整词的词尾或内部，分布于异质词汇，未显示稳定的共同上下文

patterns.name: 大小写或标点附近片段
patterns.context: 标记出现在专名、缩写或标点相邻位置；目前看不出共同语义触发条件

en.description: Primarily responds to ordinal suffixes st (especially 1st) and th after English numbers, appearing widely in dates, editions, and academic numbering. Additional accompanying patterns include medical paper titles, patient grouping, and date/number formats; some fragments are not adequately explained by the ordinal pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix st
patterns.context: Functions as an ordinal suffix, usually following a number; especially 1st, but also appears in 21st.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including academic papers, medical texts, legal records, patents, and event promotions

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: Functions as an ordinal suffix after a number, indicating dates, order, or editions, such as 12th, dates near 31st, and 25th.
patterns.domain: Academic history, education, patents, and conference materials

patterns.name: Patient section formatting in medical papers
patterns.context: Occurs in section headings, patient subheadings, or Markdown/HTML-style heading markers; nearby text often mentions patient counts, study groups, and case criteria.

patterns.name: Group and treatment descriptions in medical research
patterns.context: Describes patient or subject groups, medication regimens, and study participants; the trigger is not always adjacent to an ordinal.

patterns.name: Journal/conference formatting in English citations
patterns.context: Located in references or conference names, often alongside volume and issue numbers, edition numbers, and publication information; co-occurs here with 25th.

patterns.name: Local formatting cues in numbers and dates
patterns.context: Occurs near number formats such as dates and amounts; activation may be driven by an adjacent ordinal spelling or numerical text structure, but these fragments themselves are not clear ordinals.

4_2863.description: 主要响应英文数字后的序数词后缀 st（尤其 1st）及 th，并广泛出现在日期、届数和学术编号中。另有医学论文标题、患者分组，以及日期/数字格式等伴随模式；个别片段无法由序数词模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 st
patterns.context: 作为序数词后缀，通常跟在数字后；尤其是 1st，也出现在 21st。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学文本、法律记录、专利、活动宣传等多种文体

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 作为序数词后缀，跟在数字后，表示日期、次序或届数，如 12th、31st 附近的日期以及 25th。
patterns.domain: 学术史、教育、专利与会议资料

patterns.name: 医学论文的患者章节格式
patterns.context: 出现在论文分节标题、患者小标题或 Markdown/HTML 风格的标题标记中；附近常有患者数量、研究分组与病例标准。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的分组与治疗描述
patterns.context: 描述患者或受试者分组、用药方案及研究对象；触发词本身并不总与序数词相邻。

patterns.name: 英文文献引用中的期刊/会议格式
patterns.context: 位于参考文献或会议名称中，常与卷期、届数及出版信息并列；此处与 25th 同现。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术中的文献引用

patterns.name: 数字和日期中的局部格式线索
patterns.context: 日期、金额等数字格式附近出现；激活可能由相邻序数写法或数字文本结构带动，但这些片段本身不是明确序数词。
patterns.domain: 活动信息、法律庭审记录

en.description: Primarily responds to ordinal suffixes after numbers (rd, st, nd, th), often in dates, centuries, generations, conference editions, and postoperative days; a few word fragments, punctuation marks, numeric formats, and common function words also activate, with weaker regularity.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix rd
patterns.context: The suffix rd follows an ordinal number; common in centuries, generations, conference editions, dates, definition numbers, and ranges of postoperative days in medical text.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patent background, medical literature

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix st
patterns.context: An ordinal suffix after a number, appearing in expressions for centuries, dates, and hospital numbers.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix nd
patterns.context: An ordinal suffix after a date number; here it occurs in a month-and-date expression.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix th
patterns.context: An ordinal suffix after a number, mainly for dates; it also appears in postoperative day expressions such as “24th”.

patterns.name: Mixed formats involving word endings, numbers, and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation falls on a digit fragment in a postal address, a comma, or a decimal digit rather than an ordinal format; the given contexts show no clear semantic connection to the other patterns.

patterns.name: Fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation marks occur on word-initial or formatting-separator fragments; local context is insufficient to determine whether they belong to the ordinal pattern.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, wireless communications papers, document markup

patterns.name: Common function words in phrases
patterns.context: These words occur across multiple passages, but activation is weak and contexts vary, so they do not form a stable trigger pattern on their own.

4_2863.description: 主要响应数字后的序数后缀（rd、st、nd、th），多见于日期、世纪、代次、会议届数及术后日数；另有少量词片段、标点、数字格式和常见功能词激活，规律较弱。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 rd
patterns.context: 序数词数字后出现 rd 后缀；常见于世纪、代次、会议届数、日期、定义编号，也见于医学文本中的术后日数范围。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利背景、医学文献

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 st
patterns.context: 数字后的序数词后缀，出现在世纪、日期、医院编号等表达中。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 nd
patterns.context: 日期数字后的序数词后缀；此处出现在月份日期中。

patterns.name: 序数词后缀 th
patterns.context: 数字后的序数词后缀，主要用于日期，也出现在“24th”等术后日数表达中。

patterns.name: 词尾与数字/标点的混合格式
patterns.context: 激活落在地址邮编的数字片段、逗号或小数数位等非序数格式；在给定上下文中未显示与其他模式的明确语义联系。
patterns.domain: 论文元数据、医学结果报告

patterns.name: 词语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活标记落在词首或格式分隔线等片段上，局部上下文不足以确定其是否属于序数模式。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、无线通信论文、文档标记

patterns.name: 短语中的常见功能词
patterns.trigger: « of»、« to»、« in»、« the»、« on» 等
patterns.context: 这些词散见于多个段落，但激活较弱且上下文多样，不能单独归纳为稳定触发模式。

en.description: Primarily activates on the ordinal suffixes rd and th after numbers, covering paper numbering, dates, cases, and race placements. Sporadic activations also occur in technical quantity expressions, percentages, months and years, and intraword fragments, with uncertain connections.

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix -rd
patterns.context: Occurs after a number to form an ordinal; segments mostly contain 23rd, including forms such as 23rd/23rd race.
patterns.domain: Papers, medicine, scientific text, and sports reporting

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix -th
patterns.context: Occurs after a number to form an ordinal such as a date or placement, e.g. 25th, 12th, and 20th.
patterns.domain: Dates, application deadlines, observation records, and sports reporting

patterns.name: Numerical expressions of magnitude or range
patterns.context: In technical descriptions, numbers combine with units or magnitudes to describe parameters such as angles and frequencies.

patterns.name: Percentage and decimal expressions
patterns.context: Numbers represent proportions or percentage statistics, especially prevalence statements below 1%.

patterns.name: Months and years in dates
patterns.context: A month and year follow an ordinal date to record when an observation occurred.

patterns.name: Word fragments in English words
patterns.context: These fragments occur in names, anatomical terms, or ordinary words; no stable shared contextual condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Academic, medical, and application announcement texts

en.description: All snippets contain a number followed by an ordinal suffix (such as th or rd), with the suffix marked separately; contexts include conference citations, medical percentiles and anatomical numbering, case counts, and protein arrangement numbering.

patterns.name: Numbers with ordinal suffixes

4_2863.description: 所有片段均在数字序数的“th”处激活，涵盖日期、世纪、届次及医学中的肋骨、百分位、术后日等；邻近名词偶有较弱激活。

patterns.name: Irish proper nouns and category endings

patterns.name: Common function words in philosophical discussion
patterns.context: In philosophical argumentative prose, activation falls on common words such as articles, prepositions, pronouns, and discourse-related nouns.

en.description: Primarily activates on point phrases meaning up to a particular stage, appearing in history, news, commentary, and online discussion; there are also isolated activations on of in years and dates, as yet constructions, academic citations, proper-name segmentation, and fragments in patent illustrations.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase as yet

patterns.name: Local fragments at corpus or marker boundaries

patterns.name: 邻接词或短语的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些词分别处于不同句法和语义环境，缺少共同的明确局部搭配
patterns.domain: 小说、专利、医学论文、网络文章

en.concept: Century classification and formatting cues (with sporadic subword features)
en.description: Primarily activates on century dates, ordinals, and category labels in Wikipedia biographical categories; other sporadic patterns include name endings, negation in commentary, immune-signaling descriptions, LaTeX angles, and historical place names.

patterns.name: Century dates and ordinal formatting
patterns.context: Historical dates or century classifications, especially “19th-century” and “20th-century,” where a number, ordinal suffix, hyphen, and century occur consecutively.

patterns.name: Biographical category-list formatting
patterns.context: Wikipedia category entries consecutively list people’s birth and death years, occupations, nationalities, genders, and other labels; some category terms are also activated.

patterns.name: Specific fragments in French word endings or names
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the surname De Vries; this is the strongest activation, near a discussion of research results in a paper.

patterns.name: Negation, degree, and opinion expressions
patterns.context: First-person commentary expresses negation, degree, or a current view; activation is distributed across multiple function words and phrases.

patterns.name: Description of cell-signaling mechanisms
patterns.context: Discusses how antigen binding triggers assembly of intracellular signaling complexes and explicitly states that the mechanism is not yet understood.

patterns.name: Angle values and degree symbols
patterns.context: Mathematical typesetting uses LaTeX degree symbols to report geometric angles or astronomical parameters.

patterns.name: Historical geographic and country names
patterns.context: A historical account introduces the Low Countries and their ancient inhabitants; activation is concentrated on word-ending/subword fragments, without clear evidence of a shared whole-word trigger.

4_2863.concept: 世纪分类与格式线索（兼有零散子词特征）
4_2863.description: 主要激活于维基百科人物分类中的世纪年代、序数和类别标签；另见姓名词尾、议论中的否定表达、免疫信号描述、LaTeX角度及历史地名等零散模式。

patterns.name: 世纪年代及序数格式
patterns.context: 历史年代或世纪分类；尤其是“19th-century”“20th-century”，数字与序数后缀、连字符及 century 连续出现。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物分类、历史说明

patterns.name: 人物分类列表格式
patterns.trigger: “Category:”“births”“deaths”，以及“French male painters”“Russian sculptors”等类别名称
patterns.context: Wikipedia 分类条目中连续列出人物出生、逝世年份及职业、国籍、性别等标签；激活也落在部分类别词上。

patterns.name: 法语词尾或姓名中的特定片段
patterns.context: 出现在姓氏 De Vries 的词尾；该处为最强激活，附近是论文引述研究结果。

patterns.name: 否定、程度与观点表达
patterns.context: 第一人称议论中表达否定、程度或当前看法；激活分散在多个功能词和短语中。

patterns.name: 细胞信号机制描述
patterns.context: 讨论抗原结合如何引发细胞内信号复合物组装，并明确表示机制尚未理解。

patterns.name: 角度数值与度数符号
patterns.context: 数学排版中以 LaTeX 度数符号报告几何角度或天体参数。

patterns.name: 历史地理名称与国家名
patterns.context: 历史叙述中介绍低地国家及其古代居民；激活集中在词尾/子词片段，缺乏统一的完整词触发证据。

en.description: Primarily concentrated on “ordinal-century” labels in Wikipedia biographical categories; additional sporadic activations include place names, nationality and occupation categories, prepositions and articles, and words and subwords in papers and poetry.

patterns.name: Century category labels
patterns.context: Wikipedia biography pages consecutively list people categories organized by century; century ordinals and century are especially prominent

patterns.name: Morphemes at the end of place names
patterns.context: A place name appears in railway-station or person-origin categories; activation falls on an internal fragment of the name

patterns.name: Prepositions and articles in category phrases
patterns.context: Prepositions and articles combine with following proper names in category labels; fragments activate sporadically, usually less strongly than the main trigger

patterns.name: English function words and syntactic connectives
patterns.context: Common question, contrast, or purpose-statement structures in continuous prose; activation is distributed across function and content words

patterns.name: Incidental subword fragments in proper names or word endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on proper names, split word endings, or word-internal fragments, with no stable shared context
patterns.domain: Poetry, biographical categories, and other texts

patterns.name: Occupation and nationality categories for people
patterns.context: Wikipedia biography entries list people using categories such as nationality, occupation, and gender; there are sporadic activations beyond the century labels

patterns.name: Musician categories
patterns.context: Activations occur near music genres, instrumentalists, or singing identities in categories related to musicians or singers

patterns.name: Argument structure in papers
patterns.context: Academic prose discussing ontology, categories, causality, or related issues, with statements of purpose and contrast

patterns.name: Questions and turns in poetic lines
patterns.context: Lines in a poetry section shift from a question to a statement

4_2863.concept: 维基百科世纪人物分类
4_2863.description: 主要集中于维基百科人物分类中“序数词-世纪”标签；另有地名、国籍职业类别、介词冠词，以及论文和诗歌中的零散词语与子词激活。

patterns.name: 世纪类别标签
patterns.context: 维基百科人物页面连续列出按世纪划分的人物类别；世纪序数词及 century 尤其突出

patterns.name: 地名末尾的词素
patterns.trigger: 地名中的分词片段，如“B«iele»…«feld»”“N«ien»…«burg»”“Ponte de L«ima»”
patterns.context: 地名出现在铁路站点或人物来源分类中，激活落在地名内部片段

patterns.name: 类别短语中的介词与冠词
patterns.trigger: “«in» Lower Saxony”“«of» Portugal”“«of» California”“«of» the French Revolution”“«of» Edinburgh”
patterns.context: 分类标签中介词、冠词与后续专名组合出现；片段中零散激活，强度通常低于主要触发

patterns.name: 英语功能词及句法连接词
patterns.trigger: “«What» then?”、“«the» aim «of» this paper «is» to show”等
patterns.context: 连续散文中常见的疑问、转折或目的陈述结构；激活分散在功能词和内容词上

patterns.name: 专名或词尾中的偶然子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、拆分后的词尾或普通词内部，未见稳定共同上下文

patterns.name: 人物职业与国籍分类
patterns.trigger: “«American» psychiatrists”“«French» translators”“Italian opera singers”“Portuguese male writers”等
patterns.context: 维基百科人物条目以国籍、职业、性别等类别标签列举人物；除世纪标签外也有零散激活

patterns.name: 音乐家类别
patterns.context: 音乐家或歌手相关分类列表中，音乐流派、乐器演奏者或歌唱身份附近出现激活

patterns.name: 论文中的论证结构
patterns.trigger: “«aim» of this paper is to show”以及“«however»”
patterns.context: 讨论本体论、范畴或因果等问题的学术散文，出现论文目的陈述及转折

patterns.name: 诗句中的疑问转折
patterns.context: 诗歌章节中的诗行，以疑问句转入陈述

en.concept: Local word forms and subword boundaries
en.description: Activations span several types of local forms: ordinal centuries and numbers, Wikipedia category labels, split place names and proper nouns, English function words and word endings, as well as medical terminology, poetry, and filenames; there is no single semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Ordinal centuries and hyphens
patterns.context: Ordinal century terms and century ranges, commonly found in biographical category headings; can also activate in year/period expressions in body text.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia categories, historical or academic texts

patterns.name: Colons and demonyms in category headings
patterns.context: In Category headings, a colon is followed by a demonym, a people category, or a related entry; category labels recur in this form.

patterns.name: Word fragments at the ends of place names
patterns.context: Place names are split at subword boundaries, especially on syllables or letter fragments within or at the end of a place name; trigger positions vary.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, papers, forums, or historical prose

patterns.name: Number fragments in identifiers and years
patterns.context: Numbers occur in centuries, years, dates, or identifiers, often near ordinals, dates, or historical narratives.

patterns.name: English conjunctions and common phrases
patterns.context: Function words or phrase fragments such as then, in, of, and against in ordinary English phrases, with varying semantics and syntactic positions.

patterns.name: English plural or derivational endings
patterns.context: Noun endings or derivational suffixes are tokenized separately, commonly in people-category nouns, but also in body text.

patterns.name: Fragments of proper nouns and abbreviations
patterns.context: Proper nouns, company names, personal names, or abbreviations are split into multiple tokens; trigger fragments have no stable shared meaning.

patterns.name: Biomedical experimental and formulation contexts
patterns.context: Biomedical content about animal experiment materials, vaccines, or diarrhea prevention; activation falls on terms or adjacent ordinary words.

patterns.name: Local words in poetry
patterns.context: Local tokens in poetry titles, lines, or formatted text; no stable poetry-specific trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Filenames and command-style text in forums
patterns.context: Filename/path-like strings in forum text, including before, numbers, hyphens, and extensions.

patterns.name: Time expressions in academic introductions
patterns.context: Introductions begin with a year and recount research history, activating the year and temporal connective expressions.

4_2863.description: 激活分布在多类局部形式：世纪序数与数字、维基百科分类标签、被拆分的地名和专名、英语功能词及词尾，也见医学术语、诗歌和文件名；没有单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 序数世纪与连字符
patterns.context: 世纪序数词及世纪范围，常见于人物分类标题；也可激活在正文中的年份/时期表达。
patterns.domain: 维基百科分类、历史或学术文本

patterns.name: 分类标题中的冒号与国别形容词
patterns.context: Category 标题中冒号后接国别、人物类别或相关条目；类别标签形式重复出现。

patterns.name: 地名末尾的分词片段
patterns.context: 地名被分词边界拆开，尤其是地名内部或末尾的音节/字母片段；触发位置并不统一。
patterns.domain: 百科、论文、论坛或历史散文

patterns.name: 编号与年份中的数字片段
patterns.context: 数字出现在世纪、年份、日期或编号中；常与序数、日期或历史叙述相邻。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、学术论文、历史文本

patterns.name: 英文连接词及常见短语
patterns.context: 普通英语短语中的 then、in、of、against 等功能词或搭配片段，语义与句法位置各异。
patterns.domain: 诗歌、学术论文、医学论文

patterns.name: 英文复数或派生词尾
patterns.context: 名词词尾或派生后缀被单独分词，常见于人物类别名词，也见于正文。
patterns.domain: 维基百科分类、学术文本

patterns.name: 专名与缩写的碎片
patterns.context: 专名、公司名、姓名或缩写被拆成多个 token；触发片段没有稳定的共同语义。
patterns.domain: 论文、诗歌标题、医学论文

patterns.name: 生物医学实验与制剂语境
patterns.context: 动物实验材料、疫苗或腹泻预防等生物医学内容，激活落在术语或相邻普通词上。

patterns.name: 诗歌文本中的局部词语
patterns.context: 诗歌标题、诗行或排版文本中的局部 token；未显示出稳定的诗歌专属触发特征。

patterns.name: 论坛文件名与命令样式文本
patterns.context: 论坛文本中的文件名/路径样式字符串，含 before、数字、连字符及扩展名。

patterns.name: 学术引言中的时间表达
patterns.context: 引言中以年份开篇并叙述研究发展史，激活年份及时间连接表达。

en.concept: Local markers in time and numerical text
en.description: Patterns are distributed: they include numbers and units, month/minute time points, mathematical negation, figure labels, geographic proper names, and temporal references. Some examples highlight decimal places, parentheses, or punctuation; there is no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: Question after a number
patterns.context: The sentence contains the question word “What,” followed by “then?”; other nearby activations include “the”

patterns.name: Units and reagent volumes in experimental procedures
patterns.context: In experimental methods, measurement units, reagent names, and experimental conditions occur adjacently

patterns.name: Minute-value intervals
patterns.context: “min” follows a sequence of time intervals and corresponding measurements, and may be followed by a comma or sentence-final punctuation

patterns.name: Survival-plot axes and months
patterns.context: When describing a survival-probability plot, axis labels and survival months occur adjacently

patterns.name: Directions and straits in geographic proper names
patterns.context: In geographic descriptions, proper names of islands, bays, and straits occur in accounts of terrain

patterns.name: Fully negative phrase in a mathematical argument
patterns.context: The answer begins with “A:” and discusses whether a function is defined at a point; activation highlights “at all”

patterns.name: Decimal interval endpoint and closing square bracket
patterns.context: A sequence of numbers in an array- or table-like format contains decimals and a closing square bracket; activation favors decimal-place digits and “]”

patterns.name: Follow-up months and years
patterns.context: Post-treatment follow-up time points are expressed in months or years and often co-occur with patient data

patterns.name: Minute time points and decimal measurements
patterns.context: Compares decimal measurements for two groups and indicates the minute time point in parentheses

patterns.name: Temporal references and commas
patterns.context: Narrates the time point when an event occurred; activation falls separately on “point” and “then”

4_2863.concept: 时间与数值文本中的局部标记
4_2863.description: 模式分散：涵盖数字与单位、月份/分钟时间点、数学否定表达、图表标签、地理专名及时间指示语。部分例子突出小数位、括号或标点，未见单一稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字后问句
patterns.context: 句中出现疑问词“What”，后接“then?”；其余相邻激活包括“the”

patterns.name: 实验步骤中的单位与试剂体积
patterns.trigger: mL of 1x…500 *μ*L of 1x FACS permeabilizing solution；激活集中在“of”“View”“temperature”“L”等
patterns.context: 实验方法描述中，计量单位、试剂名称和实验条件相邻出现

patterns.name: 分钟数值区间
patterns.context: 一连串时间区间及对应测量值后出现“min”，并可能跟随逗号或句末标点
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要，结果数据

patterns.name: 生存图表坐标轴及月份
patterns.context: 描述生存概率图表时，坐标轴标签和生存月份相邻
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文图表说明

patterns.name: 地理专名中的方位与海峡
patterns.trigger: southern end of Auckland Island…Carnley Harbour or the Adams Straits
patterns.context: 地理描述中，岛屿、港湾和海峡专名出现在地形叙述里

patterns.name: 数学论证中的全否定短语
patterns.context: 答复以“A:”开头，讨论函数在某点是否有定义；激活突出“at all”

patterns.name: 小数区间端点与右方括号
patterns.context: 数组或表格样式的数值序列，包含小数和闭合方括号；激活偏向小数位数字及“]”

patterns.name: 随访月份与年限
patterns.trigger: before, 3 and 24 months after treatment；2-year follow-up
patterns.context: 治疗后随访时间点以月或年表示，且常与患者数据同现
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要，临床随访

patterns.name: 分钟时间点及小数测量值
patterns.context: 比较两组小数测量结果，并在括号中标明分钟时间点
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文数值结果

patterns.name: 时间指示语与逗号
patterns.context: 叙述事件发生的时间节点；激活分别落在“point”和“then”

en.concept: Numbers, time, and boundary fragments in mixed contexts
en.description: Activations are distributed across numbers and units, time expressions, punctuation/subword fragments, and frequent function words, appearing in medical, technical, chronological, literary, and academic texts; trigger positions and semantics vary, making it difficult to reduce them to a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers, measurements, and units
patterns.context: Values are embedded in measurement, statistical results, coordinate/parameter, or year formats; activation is distributed across numbers, units, and neighboring words, with different specific positions in each passage
patterns.domain: Medical papers, technical data, chronologies, academic papers

patterns.name: Temporal order and time expressions
patterns.context: Time words or ordinal suffixes appear in temporal anchoring, sequence, or date expressions in narration; especially evident in passages 5, 6, 7, and 10
patterns.domain: Forum text, news commentary, chronologies, literature, academic papers

patterns.name: Tokenization boundaries and word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation sometimes covers only part of a word or subword fragments across word boundaries, without showing stable lexical-semantic conditions
patterns.domain: Mixed corpora; including code/file names, academic text, proper names, and formatted text

patterns.name: Frequent function words and syntactic connections
patterns.context: These words are marked in prepositional phrases, modifier structures, or inter-sentence connections; contexts and the words’ syntactic roles are not fully consistent

patterns.name: Word endings, abbreviations, and formatting punctuation
patterns.context: Markers often occur near decimals, parentheses, citations, abbreviations, or line-break formatting, making them difficult to attribute to a single semantic trigger
patterns.domain: Medical papers, technical lists, literature citations, web and formatted text

patterns.name: Chapter headings and literary constructions
patterns.context: Headings or poetic lines contain chapter markers, articles/prepositions, and follow-up questions; irregular word-internal fragment activations also occur

patterns.name: Abstract categories in philosophical discussion
patterns.context: Conceptual discussion of space, time, causality, quantity, patterns, and ontological levels; activation falls on multiple common words

patterns.name: Medical experimental procedure descriptions
patterns.context: Describes sample processing volumes, times, temperatures, and steps for flow cytometry

patterns.name: Medical cohort statistics
patterns.context: Reports patient counts, demographics, means, and disease duration; activation covers nouns and function words in statistical sentences

patterns.name: Proper names and ordinals in historical chronologies
patterns.context: Lists historical figures and birth/death years by date; ordinal suffixes, month dates, and internal fragments of proper names all activate

patterns.name: Code/file-name fragments
patterns.context: Hyphens, extensions, and internal character fragments in file names or similar identifiers activate; semantic conditions are unclear

patterns.name: Numeric vectors and correctness labels
