patterns.context: Repeated lists of decimal coordinates/parameters are followed by a “correct” judgment; highlights concentrate on numbers, punctuation, and closing brackets

patterns.name: Temporal transitions in nuclear-program narratives
patterns.context: Discusses nuclear-program timelines and breakthrough timing, linking events with time phrases and past-perfect or hypothetical narration

patterns.name: Time and model relationships in academic discussion
patterns.context: Introduces a model’s year of proposal, subsequent research, and space–time scale relationships; time expressions co-occur with academic terminology

4_2863.concept: 混合上下文中的数字、时间与边界片段
4_2863.description: 激活分布于数字与单位、时间表达、标点/子词片段及高频功能词，并出现在医学、技术、年表、文学和学术文本中；各段触发位置与语义不统一，难以归结为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数字、测量值与单位
patterns.context: 数值嵌在测量、统计结果、坐标/参数或年份等格式中；激活位置分散于数值、单位和邻接词，具体落点各段不同
patterns.domain: 医学论文、技术数据、年表、学术论文

patterns.name: 时间顺序与时间表达
patterns.context: 时间词或序数后缀出现在叙述的时间定位、先后关系或日期表达中；段5、6、7、10尤为明显
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、新闻评论、年表、文学、学术论文

patterns.name: 分词边界与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活有时只覆盖完整词的一部分或跨词边界的子词片段，未显示稳定的词义条件
patterns.domain: 混合语料；含代码/文件名、学术文本、专名与排版文本

patterns.name: 高频功能词与句法连接
patterns.context: 这些词在介词短语、限定结构或句间连接中被标记；上下文与词本身的句法作用不完全一致

patterns.name: 词尾、缩写与格式标点
patterns.context: 标记常邻接小数、括号、引用、缩写或换行排版，难以归为单一语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 医学论文、技术列表、文献引用、网页与排版文本

patterns.name: 章节标题与文学句式
patterns.trigger: “CHAPTER I«.» THE BRIDAL« OF»« THE» WH«ITE»”“What« then»?”
patterns.context: 标题或诗歌行中出现章节标记、冠词/介词及承接问句；同时有不规则词内片段激活
patterns.domain: 古典文学/诗歌与书籍排版

patterns.name: 哲学论述中的抽象范畴
patterns.trigger: “« for» space and time”“« other» categories”“« aim» of”
patterns.context: 讨论空间、时间、因果、数量、模式及本体论层级的概念性论述；激活落在多个常用词上

patterns.name: 医学实验操作描述
patterns.context: 流式细胞术样本处理的体积、时间、温度及操作步骤描述

patterns.name: 医疗队列统计描述
patterns.context: 报告患者人数、人口学信息、均值和病程；激活覆盖统计句中的名词与功能词

patterns.name: 历史年表专名与序数
patterns.context: 按日期列出历史人物与生卒年份，序数后缀、月份日期及专名内部片段均有激活

patterns.name: 代码/文件名片段
patterns.context: 文件名或类似文件标识符中，连字符、扩展名和内部字符片段被激活；语义条件不明

patterns.name: 数值向量与正确性标签
patterns.context: 重复的小数坐标/参数列表后附有“correct”判断；高亮集中在数字、标点和闭括号

patterns.name: 核计划叙述中的时间转折
patterns.context: 讨论核计划时间表与突破时间时，以时间短语和过去完成/假设叙述串联事件

patterns.name: 学术论述中的时间与模型关系
patterns.context: 介绍模型的提出年份、后续研究及空间—时间尺度关系；时间表达与学术术语同现

en.description: Activations are distributed across scientific notation, number-and-unit formats, chart axes, time-point phrases, and various prose function words; there is no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers/letters after a period
patterns.context: In formats such as decimals, temperatures, and scientific measurement units, punctuation or unit symbols are adjacent to numbers and letters; activation falls on digits, unit characters, or formatting symbols.
patterns.domain: Scientific text, data lists, code, or formatted text

patterns.name: axis and its coordinate descriptions
patterns.context: In chart or physical-geometry contexts, axis is linked to coordinate symbols such as x, y, and z, or describes the variables represented by the axes.

patterns.name: Time-point phrase that point
patterns.context: that point refers to a time or stage in a narrative, often followed by a description of a later state or event.

patterns.name: Spaces before short words and continuations such as that/then
patterns.context: Triggers are distributed across common words, often a preceding space together with a short word; no consistent local syntactic condition can be inferred.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, academic texts, and narration

patterns.name: Hyphens and unit names adjacent to numbers
patterns.context: A hyphen connects a number to a letter string, or a coordinate term to axis; the mechanism may involve subword tokenization or formatting patterns.

patterns.name: Degree and argumentation words in academic discussion
patterns.context: Common function words in exposition, comparison, or statements of a paper’s purpose; activation does not consistently correspond to a semantic category.

patterns.name: Time and degree words in literary narration
patterns.context: Words expressing not yet, distance, or a subsequent state when narrating changes in a person or idea.

patterns.name: Statistical and cohort terminology in medical texts
patterns.context: Academic medical expressions concerning research results, cohort studies, and statistical significance; partly overlaps with general academic vocabulary patterns.

4_2863.concept: 混合的格式与常用词片段
4_2863.description: 激活分布于科学符号、数字与单位格式、图表坐标轴、时间节点短语及多种散文功能词；没有单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 点号后的数字/字母数字格式
patterns.context: 小数、温度、科学计量单位等格式中，标点或单位符号与数字、字母相邻；激活落在数字、单位字符或格式符号上。
patterns.domain: 科学文本、数据列表、代码或排版文本

patterns.name: axis 及其坐标描述
patterns.context: 图表或物理几何语境中，axis 与 x、y、z 等坐标符号相连，或描述坐标轴所表示的变量。

patterns.name: that point 的时间节点短语
patterns.context: that point 指叙述中的某个时间或进程节点，常接续对之后状态或事件的描述。

patterns.name: 短词前的空格与 that/then 等续接词
patterns.trigger: « in»2；« for»2；« other»1；« on»2；« up»4；« yet»9；« then»8
patterns.context: 触发分散在普通词语中，常为前置空格连同短词；没有一致的局部句法条件可归纳。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、学术文本与叙事

patterns.name: 数字邻接的连字符与单位名
patterns.context: 连字符连接数字与字母串，或坐标术语与 axis；具体机制可能是词片切分或格式模式。

patterns.name: 学术论述中的程度与论证词
patterns.trigger: « however»3«,»5；« aim»1« of»9« this»6« paper»2；« for»3；« also»2
patterns.context: 论述、比较或论文目的表达中的常见功能词；激活并非稳定对应某个语义类别。

patterns.name: 文学叙事中的时间及程度词
patterns.context: 叙述人物或观念变化时，表示尚未、距离或后续状态的词语。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的统计与队列措辞
patterns.context: 研究结果、队列研究及统计显著性等学术医学表达；与一般学术词汇模式部分重合。

en.concept: Local word fragments and formatting markers
en.description: Activations are scattered across common English words, time expressions, numbers and punctuation, units, and intraword fragments. Temporal sequence expressions recur somewhat, but do not explain the numerical, proper-noun, and technical fragments; some triggers may simply reflect local token forms.

patterns.name: Specific short words or suffix fragments
patterns.context: Trigger positions and collocations vary; some are words themselves, while others appear to be subword fragments within words or units. No shared syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and formatted values
patterns.context: Numbers or symbols appear in structures such as concentrations, coordinate arrays, dates, and astronomical redshifts; activation often covers only part of a numerical expression.

patterns.name: English intraword fragments and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words or on fragments of proper nouns such as personal names and titles, without depending on consistent semantics or word forms.

patterns.name: Temporal and sequential expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions of temporal order, time spans, or narrative progression; some activations fall only on general prepositions or adverbs.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, political commentary, narrative text

patterns.name: Structural units or geometric terms in technical text
patterns.context: Local fragments in units, symbols, or geometric descriptions; the same term does not occur in every technical segment.

patterns.name: Tokenization or word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on parts of longer words, with varying forms and meanings.
patterns.domain: News commentary, medical papers, literature, and astronomy abstracts

4_2863.concept: 局部词片段与格式标记
4_2863.description: 激活散布于常见英语词、时间表达、数字与标点、单位及单词内部片段。时间顺序表达略有复现，但不足以解释数值、专名和技术片段；部分触发可能只是局部 token 形式。

patterns.name: 特定短词或后缀片段
patterns.context: 触发位置和搭配不统一；有些是词本身，有些似乎是词或单位中的子词片段，暂无共同句法条件

patterns.name: 数字、标点及格式化数值
patterns.context: 数字或符号嵌在浓度、坐标数组、日期、天文红移等结构中；激活常只覆盖数值的一部分

patterns.name: 英文词内片段与专名
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部或人名、职衔等专名片段，不依赖一致语义或词形
patterns.domain: 论坛、实验论文、人物年表

patterns.name: 时间与先后关系表达
patterns.trigger: «before»、«at that point»、«By then»、«time»、«same time period»、«at that moment»、«yet»
patterns.context: 出现在时间顺序、时间段或叙述进展的表达中；部分只激活通用介词或副词
patterns.domain: 科学论文、政治评论、叙事文本

patterns.name: 技术文本中的结构性单位或几何术语
patterns.context: 单位、符号或几何描述中的局部片段；并非每段技术文本都出现同一术语
patterns.domain: 生物医学与物理学论文

patterns.name: 分词或词形片段
patterns.context: 激活位于较长单词的一部分，词形和含义各异
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、医学论文、文学及天文学摘要

en.description: Activations span multiple local patterns: time phrases and decimals, mathematical and measurement notation, specific technical proper names, paper constructions, and several sporadic word fragments; they cross domains and have no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: then followed by punctuation
patterns.context: “By then,” occurs at the beginning or within a sentence, with a comma immediately after then; activation mainly falls on then.

patterns.name: at in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Describes a function’s value at a point or its being undefined, with at adjacent to a mathematical variable; at is also activated in “not at all necessary” in the same passage.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase at all
patterns.context: In the negative construction not at all, all activates most strongly.

patterns.name: L in concentration and volume units
patterns.context: Measurement units in experimental methods, especially L in mL or μL; also includes experimental notation for hours, temperature, and gas ratios.

patterns.name: Trailing 0 in decimals
patterns.context: Values in an array end in a decimal point and trailing 0; activation concentrates on 0 and also appears in adjacent value lists.

patterns.name: Fractional days in a time range
patterns.context: Development time is labeled in days, with fractional dates indicating observation times or time ranges; activation falls on decimal digits.

patterns.name: Expression of the same time period
patterns.context: The opening phrase During the same time period is followed by a comma and introduces a concurrent comparison or additional observation.

patterns.name: Name 3rd Generation Partnership Project
patterns.context: Ordinal and proper name in a telecommunications standards name; also includes the abbreviation 3GPP and standards terms LTE and UMTS.

patterns.name: Ordinal numbers in years
patterns.context: When listing years, 13, 14, and 15 appear, followed by discussion of technological development and the timing of a highly enriched uranium breakthrough; no clear shared local trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Month dates and file-name fragments
patterns.context: Fragments resembling dates, text file names, or paths; activation is distributed across before, hyphens, ops, txt, and other positions, making a stable pattern difficult to determine.

patterns.name: Word ending near a reference marker
patterns.context: A table citation and literature marker are followed by the author surname De Vries; the strongest activation is on ries within the surname.

patterns.name: lateral in a directional compound
patterns.context: When describing the spatial distribution of tissue or a brain region, lateral occurs in the directional compound ventral-lateral.

patterns.name: Noun duration and ordinary determiners
patterns.context: A medical record mentions disease duration; nearby are also a sentence-final parenthesis and paragraph break, with weak and dispersed activation.

patterns.name: Multiple heterogeneous short words or markers
patterns.context: Appear separately in nuclear-proliferation discussion, medical experimental procedures, and telecommunications patents; trigger words and contexts have no evident shared condition.

4_2863.description: 激活分布在多种局部模式：时间短语与小数、数学和计量记法、特定技术专名，以及论文句式和若干零散词片；跨领域且触发条件不统一。

patterns.name: “then”后接标点
patterns.context: “By then,”处于句首或句中，then后紧跟逗号；激活主要落在 then。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 at
patterns.context: 描述函数在某点的取值或未定义，at 紧邻数学变量；另有该段“not at all necessary”中的 at 激活。

patterns.name: at all 固定搭配
patterns.context: 否定结构 not at all 中，all 激活最强。

patterns.name: 浓度与体积单位中的 L
patterns.context: 实验方法中的计量单位，尤其 mL 或 μL 中的 L；另有小时、温度和气体比例等实验记法。

patterns.name: 小数末尾的 0
patterns.context: 数组中的数值以小数点和末尾 0 结尾；激活集中在 0，也出现于相邻的数值列表。

patterns.name: 时间范围中的小数日
patterns.context: 以 day 标记发育时间，并用带小数的日期表示观察时点或时间范围；激活落在小数数字。

patterns.name: 同一时间段的表述
patterns.context: 句首短语 During the same time period 后接逗号，用于引入同期对照或补充观察。

patterns.name: 3rd Generation Partnership Project 名称
patterns.trigger: 3«rd»4« generation»9« partnership»1« project»5；3«rd»4« Generation»9 Partnership« Project»3
patterns.context: 电信标准名称中的序数词和专名；另有缩写 3GPP 及 LTE、UMTS 等标准术语。

patterns.name: 年份中的序数数字
patterns.context: 按年份列举时出现 13、14、15，之后讨论技术发展和浓缩铀突破时间；未见清楚的共同局部触发条件。

patterns.name: 月份日期与文件名碎片
patterns.context: 类似日期、文本文件名或路径的碎片；激活分散在 before、连字符、ops、txt 等位置，难以确定稳定模式。

patterns.name: 参考文献标记附近的词尾
patterns.context: 表格引用和文献标记之后接作者姓氏 De Vries；最强激活出现在姓氏内部的 ries。

patterns.name: 方位复合词中的 lateral
patterns.context: 描述组织或脑区空间分布时，lateral 位于复合方位词 ventral-lateral 中。

patterns.name: 名词 duration 与普通限定词
patterns.context: 医学记录中提及病程 duration；附近还出现句末括号和段落换行，激活较弱且分散。

patterns.name: 多个异质的短词或标记
patterns.trigger: « that»3« point»6；«unk»1；« from»2；« of»6；« have»5；« may»1、« of»6
patterns.context: 分别出现在核扩散论述、医学实验步骤和电信专利中，触发词与上下文没有明显统一条件。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、实验方法、专利

en.concept: Heterogeneous text structures and subword fragments
en.description: Activations span numerical and punctuation formats, scientific measurements, mathematical notation, and technical word fragments, as well as discourse connectives, philosophical discussion, communications terminology, catalog proper nouns, and filenames; no single stable semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Numerical and decimal formats
patterns.context: Numbers, decimal values, ranges, or measurement units, especially structures separated by punctuation; activation may fall on numbers, punctuation, or adjacent units.
patterns.domain: Numerical values in mixed corpora, tables, scientific measurements, and technical data

patterns.name: Inter-sentence contrast and demonstrative expressions
patterns.context: Discourse connectives or demonstratives appear in contexts of inter-sentence contrast, addition, categorization, or reference; activations are scattered across these common function words and neighboring words.

patterns.name: Word endings or internal fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Long technical words, proper nouns, or abbreviations are split into subword tokens; activation concentrates on intraword fragments or endings, with no unified semantic condition apparent.
patterns.domain: Medicine, bibliographic catalogs, and general technical texts

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and variable notation
patterns.context: Variables, subscripts, square brackets, and commas form formulas or numerical vectors.

patterns.name: Biomedical experiments and research descriptions
patterns.context: Medical research describes cells, experimental conditions, observations, or clinical presentations; activation does not consistently fall on the same biomedical term.

patterns.name: Wireless communications terminology
patterns.context: Descriptions of communications systems involving multiple devices, base stations, and links; activation occurs on general technical terms and multiword phrases.

patterns.name: Abstract concepts in philosophical discussion
patterns.context: Abstract argument discussing categories, causality, quantity, and ontological levels.

patterns.name: Proper nouns in catalog layouts and headings
patterns.context: Capitalized catalog entries, names, or book titles appear alongside page numbers and line-break formatting.
patterns.domain: Novel tables of contents or book text

patterns.name: Filenames and tokenized strings
patterns.context: Isolated filenames or file-path-like alphanumeric strings containing hyphens, numbers, and extensions.

4_2863.concept: 异质文本结构与子词片段
4_2863.description: 激活分布于数字与标点格式、科学计量、数学记号及专业词片段，也见于篇章连接词、哲学论述、通信术语、目录专名和文件名；未见稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字与小数格式
patterns.context: 数字、带小数的数值、范围或测量单位，尤其是由标点分隔的结构；激活可落在数字、标点或相邻单位上。
patterns.domain: 混合语料中的数值、表格、科学计量与技术数据

patterns.name: 句间转折与指示表达
patterns.context: 篇章连接或指示性词语出现在句间对比、补充、归类或回指的语境中；激活分散在这些常见功能词及邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 学术论文与论述性文本

patterns.name: 专业词中的词尾或内部片段
patterns.context: 较长专业词、专名或缩写被拆分为子词 token；激活集中在词内片段或词尾，未显示统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 医学、书目目录及一般专业文本

patterns.name: 数学符号与变量记号
patterns.context: 变量、下标、方括号及逗号等组成公式或数值向量。

patterns.name: 生物医学实验与研究描述
patterns.context: 医学研究中描述细胞、实验条件、观察结果或临床表现；激活并非稳定落在同一生物医学术语上。

patterns.name: 无线通信术语
patterns.trigger: “wireless multiple-access communication systems”、“base stations”、“forward and reverse links”
patterns.context: 通信系统描述多个设备、基站及链路；激活出现在一般技术术语及多词短语中。

patterns.name: 哲学论述中的抽象概念
patterns.context: 讨论范畴、因果、数量及本体论层级的抽象论证。

patterns.name: 目录排版与标题中的专名
patterns.trigger: “LAURENCE BRADDON”、“THOMASINE BONAVENTURA”、“THE MURDER OF NEVILL NORWAY”
patterns.context: 大写目录条目、姓名或书名与页码、换行排版相邻。

patterns.name: 文件名与标记化字符串
patterns.context: 孤立文件名或类似文件路径的混合字母数字字符串，包含连字符、数字和扩展名。

en.description: The most prominent shared pattern is a strong response to the Greek-letter term delta (including hyphenated compounds) in text across multiple domains. Two isolated high activations—dot in a URL and successively in a patent context about paper feeding—do not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: Greek-letter delta terms
patterns.context: delta appears as a standalone word or term prefix, followed by items such as numbers, virus, hedging, or receptor; capitalization varies.
patterns.domain: Technical texts across biomedicine, geography, finance, engineering, and other fields

patterns.name: Hyphenated delta compounds
patterns.context: delta forms a term with a following word via a hyphen, such as delta-10 endotoxin or delta-doping; activation is concentrated on delta.

patterns.name: dot substring in URLs
patterns.context: dot appears after a slash in a URL path, especially in hardware-related domain links; it has no clear semantic connection to delta terms.

patterns.name: successively in an automatic paper-feeding description
patterns.context: A patent sentence describes paper being fed successively into a device; delta is not marked in this passage.

4_2898.description: 最显著的共同模式是在多领域文本中对希腊字母词项 delta（含连字符复合词）强烈响应；另有网址中的 dot 和专利送纸语境中的 successively 两个孤立高激活，无法归入该模式。

patterns.name: 希腊字母 delta 词项
patterns.context: 出现 delta 作为独立词或词项前缀，后接数字、virus、hedging、receptor 等；大小写不一。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、地理、金融、工程等多领域技术文本

patterns.name: delta 连字符复合词
patterns.context: delta 与后续词通过连字符组成术语，如 delta-10 endotoxin、delta-doping；激活集中在 delta。

patterns.name: 网址中的 dot 子串
patterns.context: URL 路径中的 slash 后出现 dot，尤其域名硬件相关链接；与 delta 词项无明显语义关联。

patterns.name: 自动送纸描述中的 successively
patterns.context: 专利句子描述纸张连续送入设备内部；本段未标记 delta。

en.description: Primarily responds to delta as a Greek letter name and its technical compounds, such as delta 60%, delta virus, river delta, delta hedging, delta-doping, delta-endotoxin, and delta receptor; also appears in dot in URLs and successively in patent procedures.

patterns.name: Greek letter delta
patterns.context: Delta as a Greek letter name, appearing in technical terms, chemical/biological labels, or compounds; capitalization varies, and it may be followed by a number, hyphen, or noun.
patterns.domain: Technical texts in biomedicine, virology, geography, physics, patents, and other fields

patterns.name: dot in URLs
patterns.context: A domain component in a URL, appearing in the address hardware.slashdot.org.

patterns.name: successively in patent procedures
patterns.context: Describes paper being fed continuously into a device.

4_2898.description: 主要对作为希腊字母名称的 delta 及其专业复合形式起反应，如 delta 60%、delta virus、river delta、delta hedging、delta-doping、delta-endotoxin、delta receptor；另见 URL 中 dot 和专利流程中的 successively。

patterns.name: 希腊字母 delta
patterns.context: delta 作为希腊字母名称，出现在专业术语、化学/生物标签或复合词中；大小写不一，后可接数字、连字符或名词。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、病毒学、地理、物理、专利等专业文本

patterns.name: 网址中的 dot
patterns.context: URL 中的域名组成部分，出现在 hardware.slashdot.org 这一网址里。

patterns.name: 专利流程中的 successively
patterns.context: 描述纸张被连续送入设备内部的动作过程。

en.description: Nearly all segments activate on lowercase Greek letter delta, often as part of a scientific term or symbol; also includes the initial part of the place name Delta and slash in the URL slashdot.org, which may be morphological or incidental triggers.

patterns.name: Greek letter delta and adjacent terms
patterns.context: Delta as part of a term or as an independent scientific symbol, followed by a biological name, chemical name, physical structure, or mathematical concept; occasionally followed by a number.
patterns.domain: Biomedical, physics, financial mathematics, and patent/technology texts

patterns.name: delta substring within a word
patterns.context: The capitalized place name Delta appears in a geographical description; the activation annotation falls on the initial delta.

patterns.name: slash substring in a URL
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the slash portion of the URL domain slashdot.org, with no apparent semantic connection to the surrounding news headline “Foxconn to employ 1 Million Robots”.

4_2898.concept: delta 字符串及科学符号
4_2898.description: 几乎所有段都激活于小写希腊字母 delta，常作为科学术语或符号的一部分；另有地名 Delta 的词首，以及网址 slashdot.org 中的 slash，可能是词形或偶然触发。

patterns.name: 希腊字母 delta 及其相邻术语
patterns.context: delta 作为术语的一部分或独立科学符号，后接生物学名称、化学名称、物理结构或数学概念；个别情况下后接数字。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、物理、金融数学及专利科技文本

patterns.name: 词内的 delta 子串
patterns.context: 首字母大写的地名 Delta 出现在地理描述中；激活标注落在词首 delta。

patterns.name: 网址中的 slash 子串
patterns.context: 激活出现在网址域名 slashdot.org 的 slash 部分，与周围“Foxconn to employ 1 Million Robots”新闻标题无明显语义联系。

en.concept: Greek letter delta and its terms
en.description: Primarily sensitive to the Greek letter delta and its technical compounds, covering time steps, molecular biology, financial hedging, semiconductor doping, and toxin naming; it also matches river deltas. Other activations involve split subwords and material-name fragments that cannot be explained by delta.

patterns.name: Greek letter delta (including mathematical variables)
patterns.context: delta appears as a Greek letter or technical symbol, often adjacent to a following noun, a hyphenated compound, or mathematical notation; in several passages the delta token is marked on its own.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: mathematics, finance, semiconductors, geography, pharmacology, and toxicology

patterns.name: Expressions related to delta time
patterns.context: delta denotes a time step or time quantity; it appears in time delta for game-motion updates and in questions about duration-format conversions.
patterns.domain: StackExchange; game development and programming Q&A

patterns.name: delta in molecular biology
patterns.context: delta is part of a biological term or symbol involving mRNA/sequences, steroids, and receptor-mediated synaptic effects; it is sometimes followed by a number or hyphen.

patterns.name: River delta in geography
patterns.context: delta is an ordinary geographical landform term referring to a delta formed by a river.

patterns.name: Greek-letter name split across adjacent tokens
patterns.context: Activation falls on split string fragments: in passage 4, the delta in timedelta is split into « timed» and «elta»; passage 8 contains multiple subword fragments of the material name Nanocrystal/Metal-Organic Framework, with no clear delta.
patterns.domain: Variables and format strings in programming Q&A; biomedical material names

patterns.name: Semiconductor delta-doping
patterns.context: delta is part of the specialized term delta-doping, describing Si doping density.

patterns.name: Financial options delta hedging
patterns.context: delta is used in a hedging argument in a Black–Scholes context.

patterns.name: Chemical/toxicological delta-endotoxin
patterns.context: delta is a Greek-letter modifier in toxin names such as beta-exotoxin.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections; toxins and toxicology

4_2898.concept: 希腊字母 delta 及其术语
4_2898.description: 主要对希腊字母 delta 及其专业复合词敏感，涵盖时间步长、分子生物学、金融对冲、半导体掺杂和毒素命名；也命中河流三角洲。另有拆分子词激活及材料名称片段，无法由 delta 解释。

patterns.name: 希腊字母 delta（含数学变量）
patterns.trigger: « delta»；也包括 « delta» hedging argument、« delta»-d«oping»、« delta»-endotoxin
patterns.context: delta 作为希腊字母或专业符号出现，常与后续名词、连字符复合词或数学记号相邻；在若干段中独立标记 delta token。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；数学、金融、半导体、地理、药理、毒理

patterns.name: delta time 相关表达
patterns.trigger: « delta» in « delta»10；« delta» time（原文中分为 time« delta»）
patterns.context: delta 表示时间步长或时间量；出现在游戏运动更新的 time delta、时长格式转换问题中。

patterns.name: 分子生物学中的 delta
patterns.trigger: « delta» 60%；« delta» 5-3 beta-«hydroxy»；mu-« and»…« delta» receptor-mediated LTD
patterns.context: delta 是生物学名词或符号的一部分，涉及 mRNA/序列、甾体以及受体介导的突触效应；有时后接数字或连字符。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 地理地貌中的河流三角洲
patterns.trigger: « delta» formed by the Sevier River
patterns.context: delta 是普通地理地貌名词，指河流形成的三角洲。

patterns.name: 希腊字母名称被拆分到相邻 token
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的字符串片段中：第4段的 timedelta 拼写中，delta 字样被拆成 « timed» 与 «elta»；第8段则是材料名称 Nanocrystal/Metal-Organic Framework 的多个子词片段，并未出现明显的 delta。
patterns.domain: 编程问答中的变量/格式字符串；生物医学材料名称

patterns.name: 半导体 delta 掺杂
patterns.context: delta 与 doping 连成专门术语 delta-doping，描述 Si 掺杂密度。

patterns.name: 金融期权 delta 对冲
patterns.context: delta 用于 Black–Scholes 语境中的对冲论证。

patterns.name: 化学/毒理学 delta-endotoxin
patterns.context: delta 是 beta-exotoxin 等毒素名称旁的希腊字母修饰语。

en.description: Primarily responds to delta and related fragments: especially delta/deltaTime for time steps in game code, also appearing in filter parameters and technical doping terms; there are also isolated activations on timed, nanocrystal fragments, Now, and URL slash.

patterns.name: delta time step
patterns.context: In game development or code, denotes a time interval/time step, often related to movement, time, position, or time-format conversion.

patterns.name: delta time variable
patterns.context: The code variable name deltaTime, passed to functions such as update, denotes the time between frames.

patterns.name: delta numerical parameter
patterns.context: The numerical parameter delta2 in a filter formula; its specific meaning depends on the algorithm context.

patterns.name: delta doping
patterns.context: In materials or biochemistry terminology, delta is linked to doping or a chemical name as part of a technical term.
patterns.domain: ArXiv materials science and PubMed biomedical abstracts

patterns.name: delta string in tokenization
patterns.context: Activation falls on a segmented word fragment; timedelta relates to a time interval, while the nanocrystal fragment has no apparent semantic connection.

patterns.name: Now phrase
patterns.context: Now appears in a phrase or headline with no apparent connection to the delta theme.

patterns.name: slash in URLs
patterns.context: The path portion of a news-link URL.

4_2898.description: 主要响应 delta 及相关片段：尤其是游戏代码中表示时间步长的 delta/deltaTime，也见于滤波参数和专业掺杂术语；另有 timed、纳米晶体片段、Now 与 URL slash 等孤立激活。

patterns.name: delta 时间步长
patterns.context: 游戏开发或代码语境中，作为时间间隔/时间步长出现，常与 movement、time、position 或转换时间格式相关。

patterns.name: delta 时间变量
patterns.context: 代码中的变量名 deltaTime，传入 update 等函数，表示帧间时间。

patterns.name: delta 数值参数
patterns.context: 滤波器公式中的 delta2 数值参数；具体含义由算法上下文限定。

patterns.name: delta 掺杂
patterns.context: 材料或生物化学术语中，delta 与 doping 或化学名称相连，作为专业词的一部分。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 材料科学、PubMed 生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 分词中的 delta 字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词片段上；timedelta 与时间间隔相关，而纳米晶体片段并无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: Now 短语
patterns.context: Now 出现在短语或标题中，与 delta 主题无明显关系。

patterns.name: URL 中的 slash
patterns.context: 新闻链接 URL 的路径部分。

en.concept: Load lexical form and varied local patterns
en.description: The most consistent lexical signal is capitalized Load (including Load followed by different suffixes), but other activations are scattered across Japanese honorific expressions, news headlines, email attachment wording, code-documentation fields, and Spanish names; no unified semantic or stylistic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or standalone Load stem
patterns.context: Capitalized Load is followed by different suffixes or boundaries, such as «Load»er, «Load» Class, «Load»-and, and «Load»Students; activation is mainly on Load.
patterns.domain: Code, product copy, and general English

patterns.name: Honorific expressions in Japanese emails
patterns.context: Automated replies or customer-service notices explain that an email address is for sending only, cannot receive replies, and should be used for inquiries.

patterns.name: Determiner and store topic in a headline
patterns.context: A news-link headline with the structure “X is not the only online store.”

patterns.name: Attachment note in email body
patterns.context: After a brief all-caps opening, the message says that the attachment contains the final materials.

patterns.name: Package metadata in documentation comments
patterns.context: In a multiline code documentation comment, the @package or @subpackage field introduces the package name and configuration class.

patterns.name: Fragments in personal and place names
patterns.context: The Spanish name colonia Díaz appears repeatedly in an encyclopedia entry title and its opening text.

patterns.name: Quantity and robots in a news headline
patterns.context: A headline reports that Foxconn will hire a large number of robots, followed by a news link.

4_2898.concept: Load 词面及多种局部模式
4_2898.description: 最一致的词面信号是大小写 Load（含 Load 后接不同后缀），但其余激活分散于日语敬语、新闻标题、邮件附件措辞、代码文档字段及西语人名等局部片段；未见统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 句首或独立的 Load 词干
patterns.context: 大小写 Load 后接不同后缀或边界：如 «Load»er、«Load» Class、«Load»-and、«Load»Students；激活主要落在 Load 上。
patterns.domain: 代码、产品文案及一般英语

patterns.name: 日语邮件中的敬语表达
patterns.context: 自动回复或客服通知，说明邮箱仅用于发送、不能接收回复及咨询。

patterns.name: 标题中的限定词与商店话题
patterns.context: 新闻链接标题，句式为“某某并非唯一的线上商店”。

patterns.name: 邮件正文中的附件说明
patterns.context: 全大写简短开场后，说明附件包含最终材料。

patterns.name: 文档注释中的 package 元数据
patterns.context: 多行代码文档注释里，@package 或 @subpackage 字段介绍包名和配置类。

patterns.name: 人名与地点名中的片段
patterns.context: 西语姓名 colonia Díaz 在百科条目标题与正文开头重复出现。

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的数量与机器人
patterns.context: 标题报道富士康将雇用大量机器人，后接新闻链接。

en.description: High activations mainly fall on Load in code identifiers, the generic closing symbol >, and At; another occurs on vulnerable in a vulnerability description. The remaining code and paper contexts differ substantially, so a shared trigger mechanism cannot be confirmed.

patterns.name: Load prefix in Load/loading terms
patterns.context: Appears in identifiers or compounds such as LoadAllTilesAction, Config Load Class, and WebFont Loader; it is not a complete word in ordinary sentences.
patterns.domain: Code identifiers, class names, and file descriptions

patterns.name: Generic type closing symbol
patterns.context: Appears after a generic type declaration or type parameter, as in tuple<Integer,Real>, Set<Student>, List<Integer>, and Class<T>.

patterns.name: At prefix
patterns.context: At precedes an Atom Feed metadata description or appears in the sentence-initial phrase “At the same time”.

patterns.name: Other local tokens in code
patterns.context: Appears near local algorithm variables; activation is weaker and absent from other passages.

patterns.name: vulnerable in a vulnerability report
patterns.context: Describes an overlooked code review and vulnerabilities that remain; the word is split into subwords.

patterns.name: Other code fragments without a clear shared trigger
patterns.context: Embedded in different code structures; the excerpts provided do not establish a unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Paper fragments without a clear shared trigger
patterns.context: In biomedical paper text, At introduces a time or contrast context; its shared mechanism with the other high-activation fragments is unclear.

4_2898.concept: 代码结构与 Load 词首
4_2898.description: 高激活主要落在代码标识符中的 Load、泛型闭合符 > 及 At；另有漏洞描述中的 vulnerable。其余代码与论文语境差异较大，无法确认共享触发机制。

patterns.name: Load/加载词首 Load
patterns.context: 出现在标识符或复合词中，如 LoadAllTilesAction、Config Load Class、WebFont Loader；并非普通句子里的完整词
patterns.domain: 代码标识符、类名与文件说明

patterns.name: 泛型类型闭合符
patterns.context: 出现在泛型类型声明或类型参数之后，如 tuple<Integer,Real>、Set<Student>、List<Integer>、Class<T>

patterns.name: At 词首
patterns.context: At 后接 Atom Feed 元数据描述，或句首“At the same time”

patterns.name: 其他代码中的局部 token
patterns.context: 出现在算法局部变量附近；触发较弱且未见于其他段

patterns.name: 漏洞报道中的 vulnerable
patterns.context: 描述代码审查遗漏和仍存在的漏洞，词被拆分为子词

patterns.name: 未见明确共同触发的其他代码片段
patterns.context: 各自嵌于不同代码结构中，无法从所给片段确认统一触发条件

patterns.name: 未见明确共同触发的论文片段
patterns.context: 医学论文正文中 At 引出时间或转折语境；与其他高激活片段的共同机制不明

en.description: The most stable cue is “>” in HTML/XML closing tags. Activations also occur in type angle brackets, HTML attributes and text, code comment headers, and code in multiple languages; there is also an isolated medical word-initial “Un”.

patterns.name: At closing HTML/XML tags
patterns.context: In HTML/CSS examples or Android XML, the closing-tag angle bracket “>” is often a strong trigger; many nearby markup-syntax tokens are unmarked.
patterns.domain: Web code, StackExchange examples, Android XML

patterns.name: C/C++ pointer type closing symbol
patterns.context: At the closing position of type-parameter or pointer-type angle-bracket expressions; these examples are not ordinary HTML tags.
patterns.domain: Python/C++ mixed code; Java generic code

patterns.name: Word-initial Un- and biomedical terminology
patterns.context: A medical term at the beginning of an abstract sentence, with the complete phrase “Unilateral agenesis”; there is no clear code or markup-syntax condition.

patterns.name: Specific HTML attributes and text fragments
patterns.context: Activation appears near HTML attributes, article titles, or option text; trigger locations are scattered, with no single shared local token.

patterns.name: Code comments and file-header metadata
patterns.context: Appears in comments, license headers, author/copyright information, or API documentation blocks; activation spans multiple comment formats.

patterns.name: Other markup symbols in code and configuration
patterns.context: Scattered activations also appear in ordinary code or configuration content, distributed across identifiers, attributes, and numeric values without forming a stable subpattern.

4_2898.description: 最稳定的线索是 HTML/XML 结束标签的“>”，另在类型尖括号、HTML 属性与文本、代码注释头及多种语言代码中有激活；还包括孤立的医学词首“Un”。

patterns.name: 闭合 HTML/XML 标签处
patterns.context: HTML、CSS 示例片段或 Android XML 中，结束标签的尖括号“>”常是强触发点；附近也有不少未标记的标记语法 token。
patterns.domain: 网页代码、StackExchange 示例、Android XML

patterns.name: C/C++ 指针类型闭合符
patterns.context: 类型参数或指针类型尖括号表达式的闭合位置；例子并非普通 HTML 标签。
patterns.domain: Python/C++ 混合代码、Java 泛型代码

patterns.name: 词首 Un- 与生物医学术语
patterns.context: 摘要句首的医学术语，完整词为“Unilateral agenesis”；没有明显代码或标记语法条件。

patterns.name: 特定 HTML 属性及文本片段
patterns.context: HTML 属性、文章标题或选项文本附近激活；触发位置分散，未见共同的单一局部 token。

patterns.name: 代码注释与文件头元数据
patterns.context: 注释、许可证头、作者/版权信息或 API 文档块中出现；激活跨越多种注释格式。

patterns.name: 代码与配置中的其他标记符号
patterns.context: 普通代码或配置内容中也有零散激活，触发点分布在标识符、属性和数值等位置，未形成稳定子模式。

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on within-word subword fragments in multilingual European Parliament texts, especially Polish, Slovenian, and Latvian; they also cover English prose fragments and technical filename suffixes. Triggers depend on language and tokenization boundaries, with no single stable word meaning apparent.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Latvian
patterns.context: Appears in continuous Latvian prose, with words split into multiple tokens; commas, periods, and other punctuation also occur.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Slovenian
patterns.context: Appears in continuous Slovenian prose, often alongside vocabulary about parliament, member states, and committees.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in Polish
patterns.context: Appears in Polish parliamentary prose or meeting records; some passages include speaker labels, agenda items, and line-break formatting.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Polish parliamentary speeches and meeting records

patterns.name: English word fragments and tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Appears in continuous English prose sentences and punctuation; there is no parliamentary formatting here.

patterns.name: Filename-extension style
patterns.context: Short sequences of dot-separated file extensions, with prefixes such as «har», «vm», and «ac».

4_2898.concept: 多语种词片段/分词特征
4_2898.description: 强激活主要落在多语种欧洲议会文本的词内子词片段，尤其波兰语、斯洛文尼亚语和拉脱维亚语；也覆盖英语散文词片段及技术文件后缀。触发受语言与分词边界影响，未见单一稳定词义。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内片段
patterns.trigger: 如 «ņ», «ā», «ē», «ī», «ū» 等带变音符号的字母片段，以及 «p»、«z» 等相邻子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在拉脱维亚语连续正文中，词被拆成多个 token；同时有逗号、句号等标点

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词内片段
patterns.trigger: 如 «č»、«ž»、«š» 及 «član»、«držav»、«vpraš» 等拆分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在斯洛文尼亚语连续正文中，常与议会、成员国、委员会等词汇共现
patterns.domain: EuroParl，斯洛文尼亚语议会发言

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.trigger: 如 «Deleg»、«jest»、«ności»、«Przewod»、«punk»、«sprawoz»，以及波兰语变音字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语议会正文或会议记录中；部分段落有发言人标签、议程和换行格式
patterns.domain: EuroParl，波兰语议会发言与会议记录

patterns.name: 英语词片段与分词边界
patterns.context: 英语叙述句中出现连续正文及标点；此处没有议会格式
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 历史传记/叙述散文

patterns.name: 文件扩展名样式
patterns.context: 短小的点分隔文件后缀序列；前缀为 «har»、«vm»、«ac» 等片段
patterns.domain: ArXiv 文本或技术性文件名

en.description: Activations are scattered across internal fragments of proper nouns, foreign words, and transliterations; they also occur in the .html extension, the relational verb relates, the title-final word Ballads, and letters within cremation. There is no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in proper nouns/loanwords
patterns.context: Activation falls on within-word fragments of proper nouns, foreign words, or transliterations; word forms are often marked as split, and need not share a language or affix.

patterns.name: Word-final forms in album/song titles
patterns.context: Appears in discography or song-title lists arranged by year; activation marks a plural word at the end of a complete title.

patterns.name: Webpage file extension in URL paths
patterns.context: A webpage address path ends in .html, with activation concentrated on the extension and period.

patterns.name: Relational verb in noun phrases
patterns.context: When describing an entity's relationship to a country or discussing how a topic relates to some content, the verb relates is followed by to introducing the object of the relationship.

patterns.name: Syllable fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Activation appears on local letter/syllable fragments within personal names, country names, or Latin honorific phrases, without a consistent semantic or syntactic environment.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries about people and companies; academic terminology

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in cremation
patterns.context: Appears in an account of ancient Egyptian beliefs about the soul's passage and taboos around cremation; activation marks a single-letter fragment within the word.

4_2898.concept: 词内片段与特殊字符串
4_2898.description: 激活分散于专名、外语或转写词的内部片段，也见于 .html 扩展名、关系动词 relates、标题词尾 Ballads 和 cremation 的词内字母；没有稳定的共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 专名/外来词的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、外语或转写词的词内片段；词形常被拆分标注，未必是同一语言或同一词缀。
patterns.domain: 多语种政治文本、百科条目

patterns.name: 专辑/歌曲名中的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在按年份罗列的唱片或歌曲标题中，激活完整标题末尾的复数词。

patterns.name: URL 路径中的网页文件扩展名
patterns.context: 网页地址路径末尾出现 .html，激活集中在扩展名及句点。

patterns.name: 名词短语中的关系词
patterns.context: 在描述实体与国家的关联，或讨论某议题与某内容的关联时，动词 relates 后接 to 引出关系对象。
patterns.domain: 学术规范说明、政治邮件

patterns.name: 专名中的音节片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在人名、国名或拉丁荣誉短语内部的局部字母/音节，缺少一致的语义或句法环境。
patterns.domain: 百科人物与企业条目、学术用语

patterns.name: cremation 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于古埃及迁魂观念及火葬禁忌的叙述中，激活词中部的单字母片段。

en.description: Activations broadly fall on letters or subword fragments within words across multiple languages; they also occur in place names, personal names, word endings, titles, English prose, and code identifiers. The positions are morphologically similar, but no stable semantic or grammatical trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Within-word subwords/grapheme fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on characters or subword fragments inside words, often with surrounding unmarked characters; it occurs across languages and styles.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, encyclopedias, code, and papers

patterns.name: Slavic case endings and place-name suffixes
patterns.context: Embedded in Slavic place names, personal names, or inflected words; the activated fragment may correspond to a stem, place-name suffix, or inflectional ending.
patterns.domain: Russian, Czech, and other Slavic-language texts

patterns.name: Inflectional and derivational word fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated at word endings or near internal morphological boundaries, involving inflection, derivation, or word-form variation across languages; the specific fragments show no unified grammatical function.
patterns.domain: Latvian, Spanish, and other European languages

patterns.name: Internal fragments in titles, bibliographies, and proper nouns
patterns.context: In lists, titles, or bibliographic text, activation falls on internal fragments of proper nouns or common words and on word endings; no syntactic context is required.

patterns.name: Local fragments in common English words
patterns.context: In English prose, a segment inside a common short or longer word is marked; the same fragment may recur in a passage, but there is no stable semantic category.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: In code lines, fragments inside identifiers, parentheses, or separators activate, particularly in underscore-separated names and function names.

patterns.name: Surname letter fragments in cited references
patterns.context: In recommended citation formats for papers, internal fragments near author names, diacritics, or hyphens activate.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual within-word fragments in EuroParl text
patterns.context: In Russian, Czech, Latvian, and Spanish parliamentary passages, activation falls inside multilingual words; the specific fragments vary substantially across passages.

4_2898.description: 激活广泛落在多语种词内部的字母或子词片段，也见于地名、人名、词尾、标题、英语散文和代码标识符；位置形态相似，但尚无稳定语义或语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内部子词/字素片段
patterns.trigger: 多个拉丁字母或非拉丁字母词被拆成带激活的短片段，如「«ž»2«d»4«ém»2」「«Prec.í»…」中的「«í»」「Trub«chev»」「«resh»ape」
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的字符或子词片段，常伴随周围未标记字符；跨语言和文体出现。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本、百科、代码与论文

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语格尾与地名后缀
patterns.context: 嵌在斯拉夫语地名、人名或形态变化词中；激活片段可能对应词干、地名后缀或屈折词尾。
patterns.domain: 俄语/捷克语等斯拉夫语文本

patterns.name: 词尾屈折及派生片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于词尾或词内形态边界附近，涉及不同语言的屈折、派生或词形变化；具体片段未显示统一的语法功能。
patterns.domain: 拉脱维亚语、西班牙语及其他欧洲语言

patterns.name: 标题、书目与专名中的内部片段
patterns.context: 列表、标题或书目文字中，专名、普通词的内部片段及词尾被激活；不要求句法上下文。
patterns.domain: 音乐唱片目录、网页标题

patterns.name: 英语常见词中的局部片段
patterns.context: 英语散文中，常见短词或较长词内部的一段被标记；同一片段在文中可重复，但缺少稳定的语义类别。

patterns.name: 代码标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 代码行中，标识符、括号或分隔符内部的片段激活，尤其可见于下划线分隔名称和函数名。

patterns.name: 引用文献中的姓氏字母片段
patterns.context: 论文推荐引用格式中，作者姓名、变音符号或连字符附近的内部片段被激活。

patterns.name: EuroParl 文本中跨语种词内片段
patterns.context: 议会文本的俄语、捷克语、拉脱维亚语和西班牙语片段中，激活位于多语种词内部；各段具体片段差异较大。

en.description: Activations often fall on within-word fragments or compound identifiers split by tokenization, including inflectional endings in multiple languages, English morphological fragments, code names, and URL strings; fragment forms and meanings vary widely, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Slavic place-name endings
patterns.context: Polish place names are split into multiple subword tokens in a sentence, with activation on the final part of the name; the context describes its administrative location.

patterns.name: Baltic-language word-form fragments
patterns.context: In non-English text, including Latvian, Danish, and Czech, activation falls on split word endings or inflectional/derivational fragments; the specific triggering fragments vary.

patterns.name: English compounds or morphological fragments
patterns.context: When English common words or historical proper names are tokenized into subwords, activation falls on an internal fragment; these examples share neither a common meaning nor a fixed position.

patterns.name: CheckBox in code identifiers
patterns.context: A camel-case component name is segmented, and the two activated fragments together form a recurring identifier.

patterns.name: groupNames code identifier
patterns.context: The final fragment of a compound identifier in a Java code comment; the body of the same segment also repeatedly mentions group names, but activation concentrates on the code identifier.

patterns.name: handydv in webpage URLs
patterns.context: A proper-name or string fragment segmented in a URL path; its meaning cannot be determined from context.

patterns.name: within-word fragment of English anguish
patterns.context: A word meaning distress is segmented in a literary sentence; activation concentrates on an internal fragment of anguish.

4_2898.description: 激活多落在被分词拆开的词内片段或复合标识符上，包括多语种屈折词尾、英文构词片段、代码名称及 URL 字符串；片段形态和语义差异很大，尚无统一词义模式。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语地名的词尾
patterns.context: 波兰地名在句中被拆分成多个子词 token，激活落在地名末尾部分；上下文在介绍其行政区位。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科地理条目

patterns.name: 波罗的海语系的词形分片
patterns.trigger: 「Angl…」不适用；实际触发为「s」「t」等语素片段，如「Kop…ēj…ās」末尾「ās」，以及「An…lig…gender」末尾
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语、丹麦语和捷克语等非英语文本中，激活落在拆分后的词尾或屈折/派生片段；具体触发片段并不一致。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会多语种议事文本

patterns.name: 英语复合词或构词片段
patterns.context: 英文普通词或历史专名被子词 token 化时，激活落在词内片段；这些例子没有共同的词义或固定位置。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 CheckBox
patterns.context: 驼峰式组件名被分片，两个激活片段共同组成重复出现的标识符。

patterns.name: 代码标识符 groupNames
patterns.context: Java 代码注释中的复合标识符末尾片段；同段正文也反复出现 group names，但激活集中在代码标识符。

patterns.name: 网页 URL 中的 handydv
patterns.context: URL 路径里被拆分的专名或字符串片段，无法从上下文确定其语义。

patterns.name: 英文 anguish 词内片段
patterns.context: 文学句子中表示痛苦的词被拆分；激活集中在 anguish 的词内片段。

en.description: Activations mainly correspond to local subword fragments within words or across tokens, often in unusual tokenization, split spellings, or code identifiers. The specific fragments span medicine, law, literature, foreign languages, and code; a few activations also involve numeric and punctuation formats, with no unified semantic theme apparent.

patterns.name: Nonlexical split subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on word-form fragments within words or across tokens, especially where subword boundaries are unnatural or a word is displayed as split; it occurs with different meanings and syntactic contexts.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including medicine, law, poetry, and code

patterns.name: cast-rate string
patterns.context: Located in medical passages about cast-rate; both occurrences refer to castration or castration levels.
patterns.domain: Prostate cancer and hormone therapy texts

patterns.name: Strongly split code identifier fragments
patterns.context: A component of the PHP function name str_len, near substr, variables, parentheses, and other code syntax.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in encoding anomalies or foreign words
patterns.context: Activation appears in clearly split/tokenized Czech text, without a semantic condition shared with the other passages.

patterns.name: Local fragments in numbers and citation punctuation
patterns.context: In legal material, numbers appear in case numbers or case citations; activation covers only local numeric/formatting tokens.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in poetry
patterns.context: Activation falls inside words split across poetic lines, with no consistent poetic or lexical trigger condition apparent.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in literary narrative and religious poetry
patterns.context: Activation occurs inside split English words; narrative or prayer contexts are not shared conditions.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in game-marketing terms
patterns.context: Discusses game machines attracting and retaining players; activation is concentrated on split word-form fragments rather than an explicit gaming concept.

4_2898.description: 激活主要对应词内或跨 token 的局部子词片段，常在分词异常、拼写拆分或代码标识符中出现；具体片段跨医学、法律、文学、外语与代码，另有少数数字和标点格式激活，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 非词汇性拆分子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部或跨 token 的词形片段上，尤其是子词边界不自然、词被拆分显示时；不同词义和句法环境均可出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括医学、法律、诗歌、代码

patterns.name: cast-rate 字符串
patterns.context: 位于 cast-rate 相关医学表述中；两处均指去势或去势水平。
patterns.domain: 前列腺癌及激素治疗医学文本

patterns.name: 强拆分的代码标识符片段
patterns.context: PHP 函数名 str_len 的组成部分，邻近 substr、变量和括号等代码语法。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 PHP 代码

patterns.name: 编码异常或外语词内片段
patterns.trigger: «ť»，位于 «i»«š»«ť»（文本中为“let i št”一带）；另有拆开的捷克语词形
patterns.context: 激活出现在明显分词/字符拆分的捷克语文本中，缺乏与其他段相同的语义条件。

patterns.name: 数字与引文标点的局部片段
patterns.trigger: «92»、«609»、«611» 等数字以及紧邻的引号、连字符或空格标记
patterns.context: 法律材料中，数字位于案号或判例引文；激活只覆盖局部数字/格式 token。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在诗行中被拆分的词内部，未见一致的诗意或词义触发条件。

patterns.name: 文学叙述与宗教诗文的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活处于被拆分的英语词内部，叙述或祈祷语境不构成共同条件。
patterns.domain: 十九世纪小说及宗教诗文

patterns.name: 游戏营销词的内部片段
patterns.trigger: «iv» 与 «capt»，位于 capt«iv»ate 和 captivate
patterns.context: 讨论游戏机器吸引并留住玩家；激活集中在拆分的词形片段，而非明确的游戏概念。

en.description: The clearest common feature is activation on within-word subword fragments, especially word endings; there are also attract-related recruitment contexts, sporadic function words, and formatting symbols. Most content words have no apparent semantic connection.

patterns.name: Final subwords at within-word splits
patterns.context: Strong activations concentrate on subword fragments split within words, often the latter half of a word; the fragments do not share a common meaning.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, including patents, news, email, legal, religious, and code texts

patterns.name: Attraction and recruitment
patterns.context: Used to describe attracting players or investment, near contexts involving recruitment or attraction effects such as captivate and rating upgrade.

patterns.name: Function words and ordinary continuations
patterns.context: A few activations fall on common grammatical words in varied syntactic positions, with no stable shared collocations observed.

patterns.name: Paragraphs, whitespace, and formatting symbols
patterns.context: Activations occur near page numbers, page breaks, whitespace, or control characters in legal materials, possibly related to formatting or tokenization.
patterns.domain: Legal documents and email text with control characters

patterns.name: General particles and auxiliary words
patterns.context: Appear sporadically in several sentences; there is insufficient evidence that these words themselves form a stable trigger condition.

patterns.name: Informative word-ending or stem fragments
patterns.context: Involves specific vocabulary related to resource market control, certification, or support; activation locations vary and may overlap with within-word segmentation patterns.

4_2898.description: 激活最明显的共同现象是落在被切分的词内子词片段上，尤其是词尾；另有attract招揽语境、零散功能词及格式符号激活。多数内容词彼此无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: 词内切分处的末尾子词
patterns.context: 强激活集中在词内部被拆分的子词片段上，常为词的后半段；片段本身并不对应同一种语义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，包括专利、新闻、邮件、法律、宗教文字和代码

patterns.name: 吸引与招揽
patterns.context: 用于描述吸引玩家或投资，且邻近 captivate、rating upgrade 等招揽或吸引效果的语境。
patterns.domain: 游戏行业专利、经济评论

patterns.name: 功能词及普通续接
patterns.context: 少数激活落在常见语法词上，分布在不同句法位置，未见稳定的共同搭配。

patterns.name: 段落、空白与格式符号
patterns.context: 法律材料的页码、分页符、空白或控制字符附近出现激活，可能与格式或分词有关。
patterns.domain: 法律文档及带控制符的邮件文本

patterns.name: 一般性助词和辅助词
patterns.context: 在若干句子中零散出现；没有足够证据表明这些词本身构成稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 评论、宗教文字、论坛文本

patterns.name: 富含信息的词尾或词干片段
patterns.context: 涉及资源市场控制、认证或支持等具体词汇；激活落点不一致，可能与词内切分模式交叠。

en.description: Activations often fall on within-word fragments split by tokenization, commonly in English word forms (enlist, enfeeble, enchanted, captivate), and also in medical terms, Slovenian, and code/HTML identifiers; contexts and domains vary widely.

patterns.name: English within-word fragments “en” and following letters
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter fragments split within words, including enlist(ees), enfeeble, and enchanted; no consistent syntactic position or meaning is required.
patterns.domain: English historical narratives, book prose, intellectual-history commentary; passages 1, 4, 8, 9

patterns.name: Within-word high-activation fragments across languages
patterns.context: The same pattern appears in tokenized fragments within words, but not in English “en” forms; a shared cause with the English pattern cannot be confirmed.

patterns.name: Within-word splits in medical terminology
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across subword fragments of neonatal craniofacial/neurological medical terms, especially encephalocele; the form resembles ordinary English within-word splits, but the terminology context is specialized.

patterns.name: Fragments in code identifiers and interface declarations
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments of identifiers, parameter names, or string key-value pairs in code; languages and code structures vary, with no single stable identifier apparent.
patterns.domain: C/C++, JavaScript, and PHP code; passages 3, 5, 6

patterns.name: HTML/CSS attribute fragments
patterns.context: Activation appears near webpage style or markup-language attributes and values, with some overlap with the code-identifier pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in “captivate” in game text
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on internal token splits in captivate; the context concerns attracting and retaining players. It can be viewed as an instance of the English within-word-fragment pattern, though this word appears explicitly only in this passage.

4_2898.description: 激活多落在被分词切开的词内片段，常见于英语词形（enlist、enfeeble、enchanted、captivate），也见于医学词、斯洛文尼亚语及代码/HTML标识符；语境和领域差异大。

patterns.name: 英语单词内部片段“en”及其后续字母
patterns.context: 激活落在单词内部被分词切开的字母片段上，包含 enlist(ees)、enfeeble、enchanted；不要求句法位置或语义一致。
patterns.domain: 英语历史叙述、书籍散文、思想史评论；段1、4、8、9

patterns.name: 词内高激活片段的跨语言出现
patterns.context: 同样出现在词内部的分词片段，但并非英语“en”词形；无法确认与英语模式同因。
patterns.domain: 斯洛文尼亚语议会文本；段7

patterns.name: 医学术语的词内切分
patterns.context: 激活散布在新生儿颅面/神经医学术语的子词片段中，尤其 encephalocele；与普通英语词内切分形式相似，但术语语境特殊。

patterns.name: 代码标识符及接口声明片段
patterns.context: 激活在代码中的标识符、参数名或字符串键值片段上；不同语言/代码结构，未见单一稳定标识符。

patterns.name: HTML/CSS属性片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在网页样式或标记语言属性和值附近，和代码标识符模式有一定重叠。

patterns.name: 游戏文本中的“captivate”词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于 captivate 的内部切分片段，语境谈吸引并留住玩家；可视为英语词内片段模式的一个实例，但只有此段明确呈现该词。

en.description: Activations span English, Portuguese, Polish, and code text, falling on segmented within-word fragments, endings, unusual names, and identifiers; semantic and stylistic variation is broad, making them difficult to group under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Affixes/subword boundaries within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of English words, often endings or segmented subwords; the full-word meaning is not fixed.

patterns.name: URL and technical identifier fragments
patterns.context: Occurs inside URLs, code variable names, or identifiers; the trigger position may correspond to a particular English substring.

patterns.name: Exception, validation, and variable fragments in code
patterns.context: In code or programming Q&A, activation concentrates on exception names, words describing the answerer, validation attributes, and identifier fragments.

patterns.name: Within-word Portuguese fragments
patterns.context: Activation lies near a subword or affix inside a Portuguese word.

patterns.name: Within-word Polish fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across multiple subword fragments in Polish words.

4_2898.description: 激活跨英语、葡萄牙语、波兰语及代码文本，落在被拆分的词内片段、词尾、异常名和标识符上；语义与文体差异很大，难以归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语单词内部的词缀/子词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在英语词语的内部片段上，常是词尾或被拆分的子词；完整语义不固定。

patterns.name: URL与技术标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在网址、代码变量名或标识符内部，触发位置可能对应特定英文子串。

patterns.name: 代码中的异常、验证与变量片段
patterns.context: 代码或编程问答中，激活集中于异常名、描述答题者的词、验证属性及标识符片段。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于葡萄牙语单词内部的子词或词缀附近。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在波兰语词语的多个子词片段中。

en.description: The most salient reproducible cue is the word-final fragment of endearing, found in two different genres. Other activations are scattered across English word-internal fragments, code identifiers, Italian word forms, and hyphens in titles. They lack shared semantics or stable context, so no unified trigger pattern can be confirmed.

patterns.name: English endearing word-final fragment
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the adjective endearing in two cases: describing a dog's loyalty as endearing and a comedy film as endearing.

patterns.name: English word-internal substrings or word-final fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on several English subword fragments within words; their meanings and syntactic positions vary, with no shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Physics papers; programming Q&A; Italian academic text; medical abstracts

patterns.name: Word-internal inflectional fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on fragments within code identifiers or Italian word forms; surrounding contexts vary widely.
patterns.domain: GitHub code; European Parliament Italian text

patterns.name: Hyphen in a Life Care title
patterns.context: Activations cluster on the hyphen and adjacent words in the compound End-of-Life.

4_2898.concept: endearing 词尾片段（其余零散）
4_2898.description: 最显著的可重复线索是 endearing 的词尾片段，见于两种不同文体。其余激活散落在英文词内片段、代码标识符、意大利语词形及标题连字符处，缺乏共同语义或稳定上下文，无法确证统一触发规律。

patterns.name: 英文 endearing 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在形容词 endearing 的词尾；分别描述狗的忠诚令人喜爱、喜剧片令人喜爱。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论；产品描述/电影文案

patterns.name: 英语词内子串或词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语单词内部的若干子词片段；词义和句法位置各异，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文；编程问答；意大利语学术文本；医学摘要

patterns.name: 词内词形变化片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在代码标识符或意大利语词形内部的片段；周围上下文差异很大。
patterns.domain: Github 代码；欧洲议会意大利语文本

patterns.name: Life Care 标题中的分词符
patterns.context: 激活集中在 End-of-Life 复合词的连字符及相邻词上。

en.description: Activations are distributed across code identifiers, substrings within English and Italian words, and numerical mathematical symbols; some code punctuation and line breaks also trigger. Word meaning, topic, and syntactic context vary widely, showing no unified semantic or domain preference.

patterns.name: Identifiers or member names in code
patterns.context: Appears in JavaScript/Java/C#-style code or type and method names, often within camel-case names or member calls; the specific triggering fragment varies across examples.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal substrings of ordinary English words, with varied meanings and syntactic contexts; often a tokenized fragment near a word ending.
patterns.domain: English prose, including papers, forums, and patents

patterns.name: Within-word Italian fragments
patterns.context: Activations appear on within-word fragments in continuous Italian text, especially in the middle or at the end of words; sentences discuss policy or parliamentary affairs.

patterns.name: Number and mathematical expression fragments
patterns.context: Activations appear near numbers and mathematical symbols such as minus signs or fractions; the segment also contains garbled problem text.

patterns.name: Special symbols and punctuation
patterns.context: Punctuation or line breaks occasionally activate in code and formatted text, but no stable cross-segment punctuation pattern is evident.

4_2898.description: 激活分散在代码标识符、英意词语内部子串及数字数学符号上；部分代码标点和换行也触发。词义、主题和句法环境差异很大，未显示统一语义或领域偏好。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符或成员名
patterns.trigger: 代码标识符内部的子串，如 «display»、«ID»«is»«play»、«get»、«url»
patterns.context: 出现在 JavaScript/Java/C# 风格代码或类型名、方法名中，常处于驼峰命名或成员调用内；不同例子中具体触发片段不完全相同。

patterns.name: 英语词内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英语词的内部子串上，词义与句法环境各异；常是分词或词尾附近片段。
patterns.domain: 论文、论坛及专利等英文散文

patterns.name: 意大利语词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在意大利语连续文本中的词内片段，尤其是词中或词尾；所在句子讨论政策或议会事务。

patterns.name: 数字与数学表达式片段
patterns.context: 数字、负号或分数等数学符号相邻处出现激活；段内还有乱码式题面文本。

patterns.name: 特殊符号与标点
patterns.context: 代码与格式化文本中，标点或换行符也有零星激活，但未见跨段稳定的标点模式。

en.description: Activations occur in code identifiers, technical compounds, mathematical numbers and symbols, and word-internal subword fragments across multiple languages and genres. Cross-domain consistency is weak, with no single stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Programming identifiers and code structures
patterns.context: Identifiers, properties, or method names in code snippets; some activations cluster within identifiers or on keywords in code statements.

patterns.name: Compound words in technical questions
patterns.context: Compound technical terms and camelCase identifiers in question titles about Django form and model relationships.

patterns.name: Numbers and symbolic expressions in math problems
patterns.context: Numbers, minus signs, and formula fragments in algebra problems, often adjacent to instructions or variable definitions; activations fall on component tokens in number strings.

patterns.name: Slovenian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple subword tokens, with activations on internal fragments rather than whole words.

patterns.name: Rhyme/word-internal fragments in classical poetry
patterns.context: English words in poetic lines are split into multiple subwords, with activations on internal fragments; no clear specific thematic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Rare word-internal fragments in historical text
patterns.context: Long words about religious positions in historical narratives are split, with activations concentrated on internal subword fragments.

4_2898.concept: 词内及复合 token 片段
4_2898.description: 激活出现在代码标识符、技术复合词、数学数字与符号，以及多种语言或文体中的词内子词片段。跨领域一致性较弱，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 编程标识符与代码结构
patterns.context: 代码片段中的标识符、属性或方法名；部分激活集中于标识符内部的词段，或代码语句中的关键字。

patterns.name: 技术问题中的复合词
patterns.context: 复合技术名词和驼峰式标识符，出现在关于 Django 表单与模型关系的问题标题中。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与符号表达
patterns.context: 代数题的数字、负号及公式片段，常与题目指令或变量定义相邻；激活落在数字串的组成 token 上。

patterns.name: 斯洛文尼亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 词语被分成多个子词 token，激活出现在词内片段而非单一完整词上。
patterns.domain: 斯洛文尼亚语政治文本

patterns.name: 古典诗歌中的押韵/词内片段
patterns.context: 诗行中的英语词被拆成多个子词，激活落在词内片段；未见明确的专属主题条件。

patterns.name: 历史文本中的稀有词内片段
patterns.context: 历史叙述中有关宗教立场的长词被拆分，激活集中在词内子词片段。

en.description: Activations often fall on within-word fragments, endings, or code identifiers, with additional mathematical numbers and forum-text fragments; triggers are distributed across contexts, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word suffixes and boundary continuations
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across internal word fragments or endings, often connected to unmarked prefixes, stems, or subsequent word fragments; they are not limited to any semantic or grammatical context.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including parliamentary records, medical papers, forums, and books

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax fragments
patterns.context: Appears on properties, identifiers, or import statements in code; activation falls on code words or their subword fragments.
patterns.domain: JavaScript/TypeScript code and Android/Java import statements

patterns.name: Numbers and mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Numbers appear in algebraic expressions or function-evaluation questions; the segments also contain ordinary variables and mathematical terminology.

patterns.name: Rare word forms or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments of longer words, with no stable, specific semantic trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Historical book text, Italian parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Editing and text-structure fragments
patterns.context: Appears near separators, quotations, or possible garbling in forum text, with no clear semantic relation.

4_2898.description: 激活多落在词内片段、词尾或代码标识符上，另有数学数字及论坛文本碎片；这些触发分散于不同语境，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 词内后缀与词界续接
patterns.context: 激活分布在词语的内部片段或词尾，常与未标记的前缀、词干或后续词片段相连；并不限于某种语义或语法环境。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括议会记录、医学论文、论坛和书籍

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法片段
patterns.context: 出现在代码中的属性、标识符或导入语句；激活落在代码词或其子词片段上。
patterns.domain: JavaScript/TypeScript 代码及 Android/Java 导入语句

patterns.name: 数字及数学表达式
patterns.context: 数字出现在代数表达式或函数求值问题中；同时段内也有普通变量和数学术语。

patterns.name: 稀有词形或专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词的内部片段，未见稳定的特定语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 历史书籍文本、意大利语议会发言

patterns.name: 编辑与文本结构碎片
patterns.context: 在论坛文本中出现在分隔线、引用或可能的乱码附近，未呈现明确语义关系。

en.description: Activations broadly fall on subword fragments within words across multiple languages, especially technical long words, stems, and inflectional fragments. They span parliamentary, medical, patent, web, and classical texts, with no stable theme or single semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual word-internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall within or at the ends of words in different languages, including diacritics, stems, and inflectional/derivational fragments; the fragments are not the same word.

patterns.name: Fragments within terminology
patterns.context: Activations occur within longer technical terms or compounds related to diverse topics such as phytochemistry, dentistry, game patents, and microbiology.

patterns.name: English word-final or inflectional fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on common English words, word endings, or internal fragments in contexts about symptom comparisons and sociohistorical narratives; no consistent semantic category is apparent.

4_2898.description: 激活广泛落在多语种及英语词内部的子词片段，尤其是专业长词、词干和屈折片段；覆盖议会、医学、专利、网页与古典文本，未见稳定主题或单一语义触发词。

patterns.name: 跨语言词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语言的词内部或词尾，包含带变音符号的字符、词干及屈折/派生片段；片段本身并非同一词。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本、翻译语料

patterns.name: 术语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在较长专业词或复合词内部，涉及植物化学、牙科、游戏专利和微生物学等不同主题。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利文本

patterns.name: 英语词尾或屈折片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语常见词、词尾或词内片段，语境分别为症状比较及社会历史叙述；未见一致的语义类别。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、古典非虚构文本

en.description: Activations primarily fall on fragments within specific words: thaumaturgy, nostromo, and neoadjuvant; there is also the Czech ending “aci” and an isolated “j”. Most examples are word forms or subword fragments, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Fragment within “thaumaturgy”
patterns.context: The rare word “thaumaturgy” appears after the separator “~~~”; contexts vary in topic.
patterns.domain: Hacker News comment and post excerpts

patterns.name: Fragment within “nostromo”
patterns.context: “nostromo” appears after the separator “~~~”, with no apparent semantic connection to the surrounding content.
patterns.domain: Hacker News comment and post excerpts

patterns.name: “oad” in neoadjuvant
patterns.context: Occurs within the word “neoadjuvant” in medical text concerning treatment, research, or patient background.

patterns.name: Czech word-ending fragment
patterns.context: “aci” occurs in the Czech word “nediskriminaci”, in a sentence about airline discrimination.

patterns.name: Isolated “j”
patterns.context: Appears after “=html” and a separator, with insufficient context to determine its function.
patterns.domain: Hacker News formatting or code fragment

4_2898.description: 激活主要落在特定词内部的片段：thaumaturgy、nostromo、neoadjuvant；另有捷克语词尾“aci”和孤立“j”。多数例子是词形或子词片段，语义主题不统一。

patterns.name: “thaumaturgy”内部片段
patterns.context: 在分隔线“~~~”后出现罕见词“thaumaturgy”；上下文主题各异。

patterns.name: “nostromo”内部片段
patterns.context: 在分隔线“~~~”后出现“nostromo”，周围内容与该词无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: neoadjuvant中的“oad”
patterns.context: 出现在医学文本中的“neoadjuvant”一词内，涉及治疗、研究或患者背景。

patterns.name: 捷克语词尾片段
patterns.context: “aci”位于捷克语“nediskriminaci”中，处在关于航空公司歧视的句子里。

patterns.name: 孤立的“j”
patterns.context: 位于“=html”及分隔线之后，缺少足够上下文判断其作用。

en.description: Activations mainly cluster on `om` and adjacent subword fragments, often embedded in usernames, proper names, or words; Polish word forms, line-break formatting boundaries, and punctuation also occur. The corpus topics vary widely, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: `om`-related subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations often fall on subwords or word fragments; these may occur in usernames, proper names, code identifiers, or ordinary words, with no shared semantic context.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, EuroParl, PubMed, GitHub; forum text, Polish, medical abstracts, and code

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Some fragments activate near comment separators, line breaks, or code-comment boundaries, but these markers are not shared across all fragments.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comment formatting, code, and documentation text

patterns.name: Letter fragments in Polish word forms
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous Polish word forms in text about commitments, legal obligations, and regulatory transposition; prominent examples include `zobowiązania` and `zobowiązań`.

patterns.name: Periods and punctuation
patterns.context: Occurs sporadically at sentence ends or in numbers and hyphenated structures, with no consistent local semantic condition; may overlap with subword or boundary patterns.
patterns.domain: Forum text, URLs, number strings, and code

4_2898.description: 激活主要集中于 `om` 及相邻子词片段，常嵌在用户名、专名或词内；另见波兰语词形、换行格式边界和标点。不同语料主题差异大，未呈现稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: `om` 相关子词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在单词内部的子词或词片段上；片段可位于用户名、专名、代码标识符或普通词中，未见统一语义上下文。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、EuroParl、PubMed、GitHub；论坛文本、波兰语、医学摘要和代码

patterns.name: 换行及格式边界
patterns.context: 部分片段在评论分隔符、换行或代码注释边界附近出现激活，但这些标记并非所有片段共有。
patterns.domain: HackerNews评论格式、代码与文档文本

patterns.name: 波兰语词形中的字母片段
patterns.trigger: `«ą»`，以及 `«ż»`、`«ę»`、`«ł»` 等相邻波兰语子词
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语连续词形中，文本讨论承诺、法律义务及法规转置；突出位置尤其包括 `zobowiązania`、`zobowiązań`。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，波兰语正式政治／法律文本

patterns.name: 句号和标点
patterns.context: 零散出现在句末、数字或连字符结构中，缺乏一致的局部语义条件，可能与子词或边界模式重叠。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、URL、数字串和代码

en.description: Activations primarily correspond to within-word subword fragments in multilingual text, often at endings, affixes, or within compounds; specific fragments occur in English, Swedish, German, Polish, Russian, and code, with no stable semantic or syntactic theme.

patterns.name: English word-ending and punctuation-boundary subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within segmented words, especially endings or identifier fragments; the semantic relation between the adjacent text and trigger fragment is unstable.
patterns.domain: English forums, children's-rhyme quotations, code configuration, and forum comments

patterns.name: Within-word Swedish fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs inside Swedish words, often around inflectional or affixal segmentation; there is no stable single meaning or grammatical function.

patterns.name: German morphological within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on internal fragments of German compounds or inflected words; meanings and surrounding sentences vary.

patterns.name: Within-word Polish fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls inside Polish words, possibly across morphological boundaries; only one segment is available, so the specific word class or meaning cannot be determined.

patterns.name: Within-word Russian fragments
patterns.context: Within-word letter/subword fragments in Russian text activate in request and response text.

4_2898.description: 激活主要对应多语文本中被切分的词内子词片段，常在词尾、词缀或复合词内部；具体片段跨英语、瑞典语、德语、波兰语、俄语及代码，未见稳定语义或句法主题。

patterns.name: 英文词尾与标点边界的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词内部，尤其是词尾或标识符片段；邻接文本与触发片段的语义关系不稳定。
patterns.domain: 英文论坛、儿童歌谣引文、代码配置及论坛评论

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于瑞典语词的内部，常见于形态变化或词缀切分；没有稳定的单一词义或语法功能。

patterns.name: 德语形态词内片段
patterns.context: 激活在德语复合词或屈折词的内部片段上，词义及其周围句子各不相同。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在波兰语词内部，可能跨越形态边界；仅有单段，无法确定具体词类或意义。

patterns.name: 俄语词内片段
patterns.context: 俄语文本中的词内字母／子词片段被激活，触发出现在请求与答复文字中。

en.description: Activations mostly fall on word-internal fragments in multilingual text, especially Slavic characters, syllables, and word endings. They also occur in inflected forms, Dutch word-internal fragments, URLs/code identifiers, and polite expressions. There is no consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Slavic word endings and inflectional morphemes
patterns.context: Activations cluster on characters, syllables, or morpheme boundaries within words, especially Polish and Russian words; no fixed vocabulary is involved.
patterns.domain: Slavic text, including parliamentary texts and Q&A

patterns.name: Inflected forms
patterns.context: Occurs within migration-related nouns formed with a definite suffix.

patterns.name: Dutch word-internal fragments
patterns.context: Word-internal substrings in ordinary Dutch sentences.

patterns.name: Segmentation of English compound identifiers or paths
patterns.context: Dot-separated code identifiers, filenames, and comment text; short fragments also occur in URLs and hyphenated compounds.
patterns.domain: Code comments, URLs, and news links

patterns.name: Polite correspondence expressions
patterns.context: Russian polite expressions or help-seeking contexts; paragraph 1 also explicitly discusses punctuation after a salutation.
patterns.domain: Russian correspondence/polite language in Q&A text

patterns.name: Fragments within music proper names
patterns.context: Occurs in band album and song titles, rather than general parliamentary contexts.
patterns.domain: Polish music articles on English Wikipedia

4_2898.description: 激活多落在多语文本中被拆分的词内片段，尤其是斯拉夫语字符、音节和词尾；也见于迁移词形、荷兰语词内片段、网址/代码标识符及礼貌用语。没有一致的语义主题。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词尾及屈折词素
patterns.trigger: 分词内部的斯拉夫语字符或词尾，如波兰语 «ą»«z»«anie»、«działalnością»，俄语 «п»«ис»«ы»«ва»«еш»«ь»，以及大量被拆分的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在词内部的字符、音节或词素边界附近，尤其是波兰语、俄语单词；并非某个固定词汇
patterns.domain: 斯拉夫语正文，含议会文本及问答

patterns.name: 迁移词形
patterns.context: 出现在句中以定冠后缀构成的迁移名词内部

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 普通荷兰语句子中的词内子串

patterns.name: 英语复合标识符或路径的分段
patterns.context: 句点分隔的代码标识符、文件名和注释文本；另有网址和连字符复合词中的短片段
patterns.domain: 代码注释、网址及新闻链接

patterns.name: 礼貌书信表达
patterns.context: 俄语礼貌表达或求助语境；第1段还明确讨论称呼后的标点
patterns.domain: 问答文本中的俄语书信/礼貌用语

patterns.name: 音乐专名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在乐队专辑歌曲名中，而非一般议会语境
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科中的波兰音乐条目

en.description: Activations span multiple languages and styles, often landing on subword fragments within segmented words; other examples include EU gender-equality vocabulary, Korean place names, repeated signature-like strings, and dot placeholders. No shared specific semantic or lexical condition is clear.

patterns.name: Cross-word fragments in Slavic-language text
patterns.context: Activations land on subword fragments marked as contextually segmented; they cover parts of complete word forms rather than a consistent prefix or suffix.
patterns.domain: Dutch, German, Russian, Polish, and other multilingual texts; philosophy, Q&A, and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Dutch gender-equality vocabulary
patterns.context: When discussing the European Commission, gender equality, and EU values, activations land on fragments within related words.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in East Asian place names
patterns.context: In Korean local administrative names and romanized place names, activations cluster on fragments within the names.
patterns.domain: English Wikipedia history and administrative-area articles

patterns.name: Suffixes in fictional species names
patterns.context: Appears in HackerNews quotations or comment blocks, within name/signature-like strings separated by newlines and markers; occurs twice identically.

patterns.name: Italian parliamentary word ending
patterns.context: Activation lies within the Italian adjective “contraddittori” (contradictory), in a sentence about wholly contradictory amendments.

patterns.name: Very long dot strings
patterns.context: Consecutive dot placeholders in digitized records or table fields, alongside fields such as dates, Moscow, and phone numbers.

4_2898.description: 激活横跨多语种与文体，常落在被切分的词内片段；另见欧盟性别平等词汇、韩国地名、重复署名式字符串及点号占位符。共同的具体语义或词法条件不明确。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语文本中的跨词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被上下文切分标注的词内片段；涉及完整词形的一部分，而非统一的词首或词尾。
patterns.domain: 荷兰语、德语、俄语、波兰语等多语种文本；哲学、问答及议会文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语性别平等词汇
patterns.context: 讨论欧盟委员会及性别平等、欧盟价值观时，激活落在相关词内部片段。

patterns.name: 东亚地名词内片段
patterns.context: 韩国地方行政区名称及地名罗马字写法中，激活集中于地名的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科历史与行政区条目

patterns.name: 虚构物种名词尾
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 引用或评论块中，位于由换行和标记分隔的名字/署名式字符串内；两次相同。

patterns.name: 意大利语议会词尾
patterns.context: 激活位于意大利语形容词“contraddittori”（矛盾的）内部，句子谈及全然矛盾的修正案。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语文本

patterns.name: 超长点号串
patterns.context: 数字化记录或表格字段中的连续点号占位符，伴随日期、莫斯科及电话号码等字段。
patterns.domain: 俄语结构化记录/数据转储

en.description: All passages contain sporadic activations on word-internal subword continuations or boundary fragments in English, Russian, Spanish, and Dutch, across web metadata, forums, lists, and academic text; there is no stable theme or semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Random word-boundary continuation in embedded fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall within split words or near text boundaries, often alongside HTML, encoding fragments, punctuation, line breaks, quotations, or language switches. These contexts vary widely, with no shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Web pages, code/metadata, forum text, academic text, and multilingual text

4_2898.description: 所有段落都出现零散的词内子词续写或边界碎片激活，涉及英语、俄语、西班牙语和荷兰语，横跨网页元数据、论坛、列表及学术文本；没有稳定的主题或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 嵌入式片段中的随机词边界续写
patterns.trigger: 分散触发的子词，如 «iar»、«виру»、«энам»、«ej»、«ise»、«зог»、«илир»、«an»，以及 «jozzas»
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词内部或文本边界附近，常与 HTML、编码碎片、标点、换行、引用或语言切换并存；这些上下文差异很大，未见统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 网页、代码/元数据、论坛文本、学术文本及多语种文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and styles, often landing on subword fragments within words; they also appear in punctuation, URLs, and code templates. Cyrillic in-word fragments are relatively concentrated, but no stable semantic theme recurs across passages.

patterns.name: Local activations within Cyrillic words
patterns.context: Activations land inside Russian or other Cyrillic words, without being limited to a particular meaning; the words shown concern viruses, addresses, cryptocurrency, forms of address, spelling, and search.

patterns.name: Portuguese word fragments
patterns.context: Activations land inside or at the ends of Portuguese words in sentences describing programming operations on graphic thickness.

patterns.name: English in-word fragments and word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur inside URLs, word fragments, and proper names in English webpages or comments, with no consistent position.
patterns.domain: English HackerNews quotations, links, and comments

patterns.name: Local fragments in mixed code and markup syntax
patterns.context: Activations appear on punctuation, ordinary words, or marked foreign-language fragments in HTML metadata, English technical text, code, or template syntax; they lack stable semantic connections.
patterns.domain: Web source code, technical documentation, C# Razor code, and mixed-language content

4_2898.concept: 词内子串及混合文本片段
4_2898.description: 激活分散于不同语言和文体，常落在词内部的子词片段，也见于标点、URL及代码模板。西里尔词内片段较集中，但未见跨段稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 西里尔文字母内的局部激活
patterns.trigger: 西里尔词内部被拆分并标记的字母或词片段，如 «в»1«и»4«ру»4«с»9«ы»7、а«д»3р«ес»3«а»4、к«рип»1«т»2«ов»5«ал»5«ют»4
patterns.context: 激活落在俄语或其他西里尔文本的词内，不限于特定词义；所给词涉及病毒、地址、加密货币、称呼、拼写及搜索等
patterns.domain: 俄语网页、问答及元数据

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词的内部或词尾，出现在描述编程处理图形厚度的句子中
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 英语词内片段及词边界
patterns.context: 英文网页或评论中的 URL、词语片段和专名内部出现激活，位置不统一
patterns.domain: 英文 HackerNews 引文、链接及评论

patterns.name: 混合代码与标记语法中的局部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 HTML 元数据、英文技术文字、代码或模板语法中的标点、普通词或被标记的外语词片段；彼此缺少稳定语义联系
patterns.domain: 网页源码、技术说明、C# Razor 代码及混合语言内容

en.concept: Multilingual subword fragments and technical text
