en.description: Activations often land on subword fragments within words across languages, as well as in technical text, code, and links; local patterns include Russian virus/search words, Swedish, and Polish. “throw an em” recurs in HN, alongside obituary fragments and username fragments. Overall trigger patterns are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Segmentation within Russian words
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across multiple subword fragments in Russian words; fragments 1, 3, and 9 are especially prominent, appearing in words about viruses and search, rather than reflecting a single fixed meaning.
patterns.domain: Russian text; forums and webpage metadata

patterns.name: Viruses and computer security
patterns.context: Contexts mention viruses, computer viruses, or virus attacks; activations land on fragments of Russian words for virus and near English virus.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, webpage keywords, Ubuntu IRC

patterns.name: Code and template markup
patterns.context: Activations occur near code, HTML metadata, template syntax, or command-line content; code snippets also contain ordinary words and Russian and Polish text.

patterns.name: throw an em in HN quotations
patterns.context: Appears after separators in two HackerNews quotations, with the same phrase and strongest activation on “em”; its relationship to the surrounding discussion is unclear.

patterns.name: Obituary word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in parentheses mentioning AMS Notices and mathematicians’ lifespans, forming a segmented spelling of obituary.

patterns.name: Swedish in-word fragment
patterns.context: Activation lies on a fragment within a Swedish word; the sentence concerns delayed testing and unmet conditions.

patterns.name: Polish character fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the interface link text “Zmień hasło” (change password); only the final fragment of the word is prominent.
patterns.domain: Polish in a StackExchange code template

patterns.name: Twitter username fragment
patterns.context: Located within the username joeytawadrous in a twitter.com link.

patterns.name: Search terms and fuzzy spelling
patterns.context: Russian “поиске” (search) and English fuzzy/fuzziness occur together in an ElasticSearch search question; it is unclear whether activation is driven by spelling or topic.

patterns.name: Unexplained sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: These activations appear in different comment sentences, with no shared semantics or stable trigger condition confirmable from the available context.

4_2898.concept: 多语种子词片段与技术文本
4_2898.description: 激活多落在跨语言词内子词片段及技术文本、代码和链接中；可见俄语与病毒/搜索词、瑞典语、波兰语等局部模式。HN 中重复出现“throw an em”，另有 obituary 片段和用户名片段。整体触发规律不统一。

patterns.name: 俄语词内切分
patterns.context: 激活散布在俄语词的多个子词片段中；片段1、3、9尤为明显，涉及病毒、搜索等词，并非单一固定词义。
patterns.domain: 俄语文本；论坛、网页元数据

patterns.name: 病毒及计算机安全
patterns.context: 出现病毒、电脑病毒或受病毒攻击等语境，激活落在俄语病毒词的片段及英语 virus 附近。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、网页关键词、Ubuntu IRC

patterns.name: 代码与模板标记
patterns.context: 激活邻近代码、HTML 元数据、模板语法或命令行内容；代码片段中也有普通词及俄语、波兰语文本。

patterns.name: HN 引文中的 throw an em
patterns.context: 在两段 HackerNews 引文分隔符之后出现，短语相同且“em”激活最强；与前后讨论主题关系不明。

patterns.name: 讣告词片段
patterns.context: 出现在提到 AMS Notices、数学家寿命的括号中，组成 obituary 的分段拼写。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于瑞典语词的内部片段，句子谈测试推迟及条件尚未满足。

patterns.name: 波兰语字符片段
patterns.context: 出现在界面链接文字“Zmień hasło”（更改密码）中，仅该词尾片段显著。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 代码模板中的波兰语

patterns.name: 推特用户名片段
patterns.context: 位于 twitter.com 链接中的用户名 joeytawadrous 内。

patterns.name: 搜索词与 fuzzy 拼写
patterns.context: 俄语“поиске”（搜索）和英语 fuzzy/fuzziness 同处 ElasticSearch 搜索问题中；是否触发于拼写或主题不确定。
patterns.domain: 俄语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 未明的零散词片段
patterns.context: 这些激活出现在不同评论句子中，缺乏可由现有上下文确认的共同语义或稳定触发条件。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on word-internal split fragments or line-break hyphenation in English, Swedish, and Portuguese. They occur in pronouns, medical terms, legal proper names, and forum vocabulary, with no stable semantic or domain theme.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment em in the English pronoun
patterns.context: Occurs in a HackerNews reply at the tokenization boundary in throw them; the high activation falls on the final fragment em of them.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment em in the English pronoun
patterns.context: Also occurs in throw them, followed by “This comes out of the Lori”; the sentence meaning differs from paragraph 2.

patterns.name: Incomplete word-final ise
patterns.context: Occurs in the sentence-initial fragment m«ise», corresponding to a word-internal fragment; the subsequent text in the same passage is “Spoiler alert”.

patterns.name: Incomplete word-final ise and following g
patterns.context: Occurs in the sentence-initial fragment m«ise»g, followed by “I should have replied”; the word boundary or truncation point is incomplete.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in goitre
patterns.context: Occurs in nodular goitre, describing nodular enlargement of the thyroid; high activation concentrates on the word-final split fragment.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in Supreme
patterns.context: Occurs in United States Supreme Court, split across a line with a hyphen; high activation falls on the final fragment of Supreme.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Brazilian Portuguese
patterns.context: A Portuguese title embedded in a URL is percent-encoded and split into multiple subwords; activations fall on word-internal fragments.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Swedish compounds
patterns.context: A compound in Swedish parliamentary text means water supply; surrounding words refer to infrastructure, maintenance, and purification.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in obscene
patterns.context: Occurs in a discussion of social platform moderation, as an example of content deemed offensive or indecent.

patterns.name: Cross Point segmentation fragment
patterns.context: Located before “Cross Point of note”, seemingly a segmentation boundary in a name or phrase; broader context includes a news link and a topic about the United States.

4_2898.description: 激活主要落在词内切分片段或跨行断词处，涉及英语、瑞典语和葡萄牙语；命中代词、医学词、法律专名及论坛词汇，未见稳定的语义或领域主题。

patterns.name: 英文代词 em 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 回复中，属于 throw them 的分词边界切分；高激活落在 them 的末段 em。

patterns.name: 英文代词 em 的词内片段
patterns.context: 同样出现在 throw them 中，后接“This comes out of the Lori”；具体句义与段2不同。

patterns.name: 不完整词尾 ise
patterns.context: 出现在句首残片 m«ise»，对应词内片段；同段后续文字为“Spoiler alert”。

patterns.name: 不完整词尾 ise 及后续 g
patterns.context: 出现在句首残片 m«ise»g，后接“I should have replied”；词界或截断位置不完整。

patterns.name: goitre 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 nodular goitre 一词中，描述甲状腺结节性肿大；高激活集中于词尾切分片段。

patterns.name: Supreme 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 United States Supreme Court 中，跨行且连字符断词；高激活落在 Supreme 的末段。

patterns.name: 巴西葡萄牙语中的词片段
patterns.context: URL 中嵌入的葡萄牙语标题被百分号编码并切成多个子词；激活落在词内片段。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 链接／葡萄牙语标题

patterns.name: 瑞典语复合词词片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，复合词意为供水；前后还有基础设施、维护和净化等词。

patterns.name: obscene 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在讨论社交平台审查时，作为被判定为冒犯性或不雅内容的例子。

patterns.name: Cross Point 分词片段
patterns.context: 位于 “Cross Point of note” 前，像是名字或短语的分词边界切分；更广上下文含新闻链接与美国话题。

en.description: Activations are scattered across in-word fragments or word endings in multiple languages, including English, Swedish, Dutch, Polish, and medical terminology; they also often occur in suspected split words or usernames after HackerNews separators. Trigger forms and semantics are inconsistent.

patterns.name: English word-final fragments
patterns.context: Activations land on short letter strings or word endings within words, often alongside tokenization markers, underscores, or sentence text; many examples occur after HackerNews separators.
patterns.domain: Multilingual natural text, online discussions, and code-mixed corpora

patterns.name: Word fragments in repeated webpage markers
patterns.context: Trigger fragments immediately follow separators such as “------” and often resemble split words or usernames; the ways they combine vary.
patterns.domain: HackerNews webpage excerpts and content between posts

patterns.name: Swedish in-word fragments
patterns.context: Appears within long Swedish words discussing infrastructure investment or water supply; the marked segment does not form a complete word.

patterns.name: Dutch in-word fragments
patterns.context: Appears within the word “zogenaamde” (so-called), near terms such as “de rede” from philosophical discussions.

patterns.name: Word ending in a Polish string
patterns.context: Located in a Polish UI action link, at the end of the word “hasło”; the context is Razor/HTML code.
patterns.domain: StackExchange, program code and localized UI text

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a medical term
patterns.context: Appears within the oncology term “neoplasia,” near references to AIDS-related cancers and a Zambian research project.

4_2898.description: 激活分散在多语种词语的词内片段或词尾，包括英文、瑞典语、荷兰语、波兰语及医学术语；另常见于 HackerNews 分隔线后的疑似拆分词或用户名。触发形式与语义不统一。

patterns.name: 英文词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内的短字母串或词尾，周围常有分词标记、下划线或句子文本；不少实例出现在 HackerNews 的分隔符后。
patterns.domain: 多语种自然文本、网页讨论与代码混合语料

patterns.name: 重复网页标记中的词片段
patterns.context: 触发片段紧接在「------」等分隔线后，常见形式像被拆开的词或用户名；各片段的拼接方式不一致。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 网页摘录及帖子间分隔内容

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语长词内部，讨论基础设施投资或供水；标记并不构成完整词。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在“zogenaamde”（所谓的）一词内部，邻近“de rede”等哲学讨论用语。

patterns.name: 波兰语字符串中的词尾
patterns.context: 位于波兰语 UI 操作链接文字中，是单词“hasło”的末尾；上下文为 Razor/HTML 代码。
patterns.domain: StackExchange，程序代码与本地化界面文本

patterns.name: 医学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在“neoplasia”肿瘤学术语内部，周围提及 AIDS 相关癌症与赞比亚研究项目。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要

en.description: Activations mainly land on subword fragments within segmented words, spanning English, Danish, and German; no reliable semantic theme is evident across languages or fragments, and an isolated numeric marker cannot be further explained.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activations cluster on subword fragments within English words, often after inserted separators; some fragments combine into complete words, such as «an»+«em» corresponding to throw an em, and «ise»+«g» corresponding to miseg.
patterns.domain: English text from HackerNews, FreeLaw, ArXiv, and other sources, across varied styles

patterns.name: Danish morphology and affix fragments
patterns.context: Multiple fragments within Danish words activate in continuous text, spanning stems, affixes, and word boundaries; no clear corresponding English context is evident.

patterns.name: German word fragment
patterns.context: A German word fragment appears after English context; activation lands on the fragment rather than the following English sentence.

patterns.name: Numeric marker
patterns.context: Appears only in symbolic/separator content in the final passage, followed by English word fragments «prop», «ion», and «yl»; its function cannot be determined from a single example.

4_2898.description: 激活主要落在被切分的词内部子词片段上，涵盖英语、丹麦语和德语；不同语种及片段间未见可靠语义主题，单例数字标记也无法进一步解释。

patterns.name: 英文单词内部的词片
patterns.context: 激活集中在英文词语内部的子词片段，常出现在人为插入的分隔符后；部分片段可拼成完整词，如 «an»+«em» 对应 throw an em，«ise»+«g» 对应 miseg。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、FreeLaw、ArXiv 等英文文本，文体不一

patterns.name: 丹麦语形态与词缀片段
patterns.context: 丹麦语连续文本中激活多个词内部片段，涉及词干、词缀及词边界，未见明显对应的英语语境。

patterns.name: 德语词片
patterns.context: 英文上下文后出现德语词片段；激活落在片段而非其后的英文句子。

patterns.name: 数字标记
patterns.context: 仅在末段的符号/分隔内容中出现，后接英语词片 «prop»、«ion»、«yl»；其作用无法从单例确定。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual in-word fragments, HackerNews profanity, proper names and common function words, as well as URLs, markup, and code; no unified semantics or reliable syntactic condition is evident across passages.

patterns.name: In-word Baltic/Nordic word endings
patterns.context: Activations land on fragments within non-English words, proper names, or technical terms rather than complete English words; fragment positions and meanings vary.
patterns.domain: Word forms in English technical text, as well as Danish, Polish, and medical terminology

patterns.name: HackerNews profanity/vulgar expressions
patterns.context: Online comments contain vulgar expressions or profanity; activations land on specific in-word substrings, often near comments separated by newlines.

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names and word forms
patterns.context: In legal narratives or forum text, activations land on parts of proper names, ordinary words, or phrases, with no stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Sparse function words and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Common function words or short syntactic fragments in long sentences also activate, without consistent specific syntactic or semantic context.

patterns.name: Mixed-language/code and markup content
patterns.context: Activations appear in URLs, HTML/C# code, formatting markup, and multilingual text; some land within non-English words.

4_2898.description: 激活分散在多语种词内部片段、HackerNews脏话、专名与普通虚词，以及URL、标记和代码等内容；各段间未见统一语义或可靠句法条件。

patterns.name: 词内波罗的海/北欧语词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在非英语或专名、技术词中的词内部片段，而非完整英语词；片段位置和词义不固定。
patterns.domain: 英语技术文本中的词形，以及丹麦语、波兰语、医学术语

patterns.name: HackerNews 脏话／粗俗表达
patterns.context: 论坛评论中出现粗俗用语或脏话表达；激活具体落在词内子串，附近常有换行分隔的评论。

patterns.name: 专名及词形内部片段
patterns.context: 法律叙述或论坛文字中，激活落在专名、普通词或词组的一部分，未见稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 稀疏功能词及句法片段
patterns.context: 长句中的常见虚词或短句法片段也有激活，缺乏一致的特定句法或语义上下文。

patterns.name: 混合语言／代码与标记内容
patterns.context: URL、HTML/C#代码、格式标记及多语种文本中出现激活；部分激活落在非英语词内部。

en.concept: Local word fragments and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activations mostly fall on short word-internal or word-final fragments: possessive s, fragments of vulgar expressions, and several word endings without an obvious shared semantic theme; angle brackets also occur in a data-center description. Overall, the feature appears responsive to local character fragments, tokenization, or formatting boundaries rather than a stable theme.

patterns.name: Special word-internal subword fragment “s”
patterns.context: Activations cluster on s forming a possessive immediately after an apostrophe or question mark; the boundary may be affected by tokenization.
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions, research funding text

patterns.name: Embedded vulgar word forms
patterns.context: Activations occur on word fragments or adjacent word fragments in vulgar expressions quoted on HackerNews; the full expressions are “throw an …” and “are bastards”.

patterns.name: Legal word-final fragment
patterns.context: In legal decisions, Supreme is split across a line, with activation on the word-final fragment.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in email addresses
patterns.context: Activations occur at the end of a name fragment in Enron email addresses, surrounded by recipient lists.

patterns.name: Fragment within a unit of measurement
patterns.context: In a telecommunications cable specification, the activation falls within “lineal”, denoting a unit of length.

patterns.name: Angle-bracket markers and availability status
patterns.context: Angle-bracket symbols occur in data-center deployment instructions, especially adjacent to PRIMARY, HA, and status information indicating unavailability; the trigger mechanism is unclear.

4_2898.concept: 局部词片段与格式边界
4_2898.description: 激活多落在词内或词尾的短片段：所有格 s、粗俗表达片段，以及若干无明显共同语义的词尾；另见数据中心说明中的尖括号。整体呈现对局部字符片段、分词或格式边界的反应，而非稳定主题。

patterns.name: 特殊词内子词片段“s”
patterns.trigger: 词尾或词内的 «s»（[1] ZAMDAPP«?»1«s»10；[4] Institute«?»1«s»9；[8] Panel«?»3«s»8）
patterns.context: 激活集中在紧接撇号或问号之后、构成所有格的 s；标记边界可能受分词影响。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目介绍、研究资助文本

patterns.name: 嵌入式粗俗词形
patterns.context: 激活出现在 HackerNews 引文中粗俗表达的词片段或相邻词片段，完整表达分别为“throw an …”及“are bastards”。

patterns.name: 法律词尾片段
patterns.context: 法律判决文本中，换行断开的 Supreme 被拆分，激活落在词尾片段。

patterns.name: 邮件地址内的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 Enron 邮件地址中的姓名片段末尾，周围是收件人列表。

patterns.name: 度量单位内部片段
patterns.context: 电信电缆规格说明里，激活落在“lineal”词内，表示长度单位。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、工程规格

patterns.name: 尖括号标记及可用状态
patterns.trigger: «>»4、«>»6、«>»8，见“have«>» the Observer”“from«>» the«>» PRIMARY”及“not«>» yet available”
patterns.context: 数据中心部署说明中出现尖括号符号，尤其与 PRIMARY、HA、尚不可用等状态信息相邻；触发机制不明。

en.description: Activations often land on short in-word or word-final fragments: English inflectional s, internal syllables in medical and Russian words, and code-identifier fragments; they also respond to throwanem in forums and mixed-text fragments. Trigger conditions are heterogeneous and difficult to reduce to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: English inflectional word-final s
patterns.context: Activations land on s marking English third-person singular verbs, plural nouns, or possession, usually at word endings; examples include word endings near newlines and punctuation.
patterns.domain: English prose, legal and biomedical papers, forum text

patterns.name: Internal syllable in a long medical word
patterns.context: Located within the rare medical adjective kyphoscoliotic; activation falls on the spelling syllable iotic rather than a word boundary.

patterns.name: syscall in a code identifier
patterns.context: The syscall function name in Go code is split into multiple subwords/tokens; activation lands on all inside the identifier.

patterns.name: Word-final syllable in a Russian word
patterns.context: A subword fragment of the Russian verb получает, with activation on a later syllable; the word occurs in a question.

patterns.name: Fragments in anomalous mixed text
patterns.context: Activations land on Latin-letter fragments whose word boundaries or meanings cannot be determined, surrounded by repository links, usernames, or garbled text.

patterns.name: Explicit throw string in a code block
patterns.context: A literal string appears after a forum post’s code fence or separator; em is the fragment near the highest activation, with weaker activation on the prefix throw/an.

4_2898.description: 激活多落在词内或词尾的短片段：英语屈折 s、医学及俄语词内部音节、代码标识符片段；另对论坛中的 throwanem 和混合文本碎片有响应。触发条件异质，难以归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 英文屈折词尾 s
patterns.trigger: 词尾或独立的 «s»：如 «is», «has», «s»（含撇号后的所有格 s）
patterns.context: 激活落在英语第三人称单数动词、复数名词或所有格标记的 s 上，位置多在词末；包括换行、标点附近的词尾。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、法律与生物医学论文、论坛文本

patterns.name: 长医学词中的内部音节
patterns.context: 位于罕见医学形容词 kyphoscoliotic 内部，激活落在拼写音节 iotic，而非词边界。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 syscall
patterns.context: Go 代码中 syscall 函数名被拆分成多个子词/token；激活在标识符内部的 all。

patterns.name: 俄语词中词尾音节
patterns.context: 俄语动词 получает 的分词片段，激活在词中偏后的音节；该词出现在问句中。

patterns.name: 异常混合文本中的碎片
patterns.context: 激活落在无法确定词界或词义的拉丁字母碎片中，周围是仓库链接、用户名或乱码式文本。

patterns.name: 代码块中显式的抛出字符串
patterns.context: 论坛帖子代码围栏或分隔线后出现的字面字符串；em 是最高激活附近的片段，前缀 throw/an 也有弱激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual in-word fragments, common English words, and code punctuation/identifiers; across forums, parliamentary texts, and Q&A, no stable semantic theme emerges, and some repeated phrases are difficult to explain.

patterns.name: In-word suffix or stem fragments
patterns.context: Activations land in the middle or at the end of complete words, often at boundaries involving affixes, tokenization, or morphological changes; no unified semantics is evident.
patterns.domain: Natural text in English, Portuguese, Swedish, Spanish, and other languages

patterns.name: Code and markup boundaries
patterns.context: Punctuation, tag boundaries, and adjacent text in code, HTML, or code examples.
patterns.domain: Go source code, PHP examples, technical Q&A

patterns.name: Local words in English phrases
patterns.context: Ordinary English words or phrases appear in forum discussions; some activations cluster on the fragment throw an em, without consistent semantics.

patterns.name: Product-name fragment in a question title
patterns.context: A question or forum title asks about alternatives; activation also lands within a proper name.

patterns.name: Cyrillic word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activations correspond to subword fragments within words in Russian Q&A text.

patterns.name: Loop and output example
patterns.context: Describes a generation loop and gives PHP code that outputs HTML.

patterns.name: System-call identifier
patterns.context: A syscall function declaration in runtime source code.

patterns.name: Difficult-to-classify word fragment in parliamentary text
patterns.context: A Portuguese sentence concerns Baltic strategy and recommendations.

patterns.name: Difficult-to-classify word fragment in educational text
patterns.context: Discussion of Spanish art education graduates and follow-up processes.

patterns.name: Phrase fragment in a legal discussion
patterns.context: A forum discussion of two laws and website terms, with a repeated throw-an-em string.

4_2898.description: 激活分散在多语词内片段、常见英语词及代码标点/标识符上；跨论坛、议会文本和问答，未显示稳定语义主题，部分重复短语也难以解释。

patterns.name: 词内后缀或词干片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词的中间或末尾，常与词缀、分词或形态变化交界；未见统一语义
patterns.domain: 英语、葡萄牙语、瑞典语、西班牙语等自然文本

patterns.name: 代码与标记边界
patterns.context: 代码、HTML 或代码示例中的标点、标签边界及相邻文本
patterns.domain: Go 源码、PHP 示例、技术问答

patterns.name: 英语短语中的局部词
patterns.context: 论坛讨论中出现普通英语词或短语，部分激活集中在 throw an em 这一片段，语义并不一致

patterns.name: 问句标题中的产品名片段
patterns.context: 问答或论坛标题中询问替代方案，激活还落在专名内部

patterns.name: 西里尔语词形片段
patterns.context: 俄语问答文本中，激活对应词内子词片段

patterns.name: 循环与输出示例
patterns.context: 描述生成循环并给出 PHP 输出 HTML 的代码

patterns.name: 系统调用标识符
patterns.context: runtime 源码中的 syscall 函数声明

patterns.name: 难以归入的议会文本词片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中涉及波罗的海战略及建议

patterns.name: 难以归入的教育文本词片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语艺术教育毕业生与跟进过程的论述

patterns.name: 法律讨论中的短语片段
patterns.context: 论坛讨论两项法律与网站条款，并出现重复的 throw-an-em 字符串

en.concept: Local punctuation and fragments in multilingual text
en.description: Activations are scattered across several kinds of text: symbol lists formed with commas and colons, English function words, in-word letter fragments, numbers and fractions in probability problems, and specific paper terminology, review punctuation, and repeated forum phrases; Spanish and Russian fragments also occur.

patterns.name: Item separators after commas
patterns.context: Comma-separated letter/symbol entries, often formatted as “letter: number” or similar lists; activations especially land near commas, colons, and item symbols.
patterns.domain: Symbol lists or data representations in math problems

patterns.name: Common function words in English text
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across common prepositions, conjunctions, and linking verbs in English prose or explanatory text; no single fixed collocation is evident.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, research descriptions, and math-problem text

patterns.name: Subword and letter fragments
patterns.context: Activations land on subword fragments or continuous letter strings within words; some examples are Spanish word forms, while others are artificially constructed letter sequences.
patterns.domain: Spanish academic text and letter strings in math probability problems

patterns.name: Probability answers composed of numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Fractional answers and adjacent numbers or symbols such as slashes; adjacent to a probability question about drawing letters without replacement.

patterns.name: ANOVA terminology formatting
patterns.context: The abbreviation ANOVA is followed by a colon and its English definition in line-broken paper text.

patterns.name: Review item numbering and punctuation
patterns.context: An institutional review description lists scoring criteria; activations occur near possessives, commas, and parenthesized numbering.
patterns.domain: Research funding or project review descriptions

patterns.name: Fixed phrase throw an em
patterns.context: The phrase “throw an em” recurs in forum text, with activations concentrated on the final em.

patterns.name: Russian word-form fragments
patterns.context: In Russian sentences, activations land on segmented fragments within Cyrillic words.

patterns.name: Complexity classes and formula titles
patterns.context: Activations occur near complexity classes, problem titles, and colons in a complexity-theory paper.

4_2898.concept: 多语文本中的局部标点与片段
4_2898.description: 激活分散在多类文本：逗号和冒号构成的符号清单、英文功能词、词内字母片段、概率题数字与分数，以及特定论文术语、评审标点和重复论坛短语；还覆盖西班牙语与俄语片段。

patterns.name: 逗号后的条目分隔
patterns.context: 逗号分隔的字母/符号条目，常呈现为“字母: 数字”或类似清单格式；激活尤其落在逗号、冒号及条目符号附近
patterns.domain: 数学题中的符号清单或数据表示

patterns.name: 英文文字中的常见功能词
patterns.context: 英文散文或说明文字中，触发分散在常见介词、连词和系动词上；未见固定的单一搭配
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、科研说明及数学题文字

patterns.name: 词内分词及字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内部的子词片段或连续字母串；部分例子是西班牙语词形，另一些是人为构造的字母序列
patterns.domain: 西班牙语学术文字及数学概率题中的字母串

patterns.name: 数字与标点构成的概率答案
patterns.context: 分数答案及其邻近的数字、斜线等符号；与无放回抽取字母的概率问答相邻

patterns.name: ANOVA术语排版
patterns.context: 缩写 ANOVA 后接冒号及其英文释义，出现在换行排版的论文内容中
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、统计术语

patterns.name: 评审条目编号与标点
patterns.context: 机构评审说明中，列举评分标准；激活出现在所有格、逗号和括号编号附近
patterns.domain: 科研资助或项目评审说明

patterns.name: 固定短语 throw an em
patterns.context: 短语“throw an em”在论坛文本中重复出现，激活集中于短语末尾的 em

patterns.name: 俄语词形片段
patterns.context: 俄语句子中，激活落在西里尔字母词语内部的分段片段

patterns.name: 复杂性类与公式标题
patterns.context: 复杂性理论论文中，复杂性类别、问题标题及其冒号附近出现激活

en.description: Activations cluster on several short letter fragments or word-internal fragments: Russian word-final «ся», Portuguese «gi», the mathematical letter sequence «sch», and sporadic spelling fragments in forum signatures/usernames; an isolated s also occurs in paper text. Contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: Slavic word ending «ся»
patterns.context: Within or at the end of Russian words, such as the ending of «получается», commonly found in reflexive verb forms.

patterns.name: Name spelling fragment «urycy»
patterns.context: Occurs in username- or signature-like text after a separator line in HackerNews text.

patterns.name: Name spelling fragment «anem»
patterns.context: Occurs in username- or signature-like text after a separator line in HackerNews text.

patterns.name: «ed» in a username
patterns.context: A spelling fragment like «called» in a username immediately following a separator line.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-internal «gi»
patterns.context: Within the Portuguese word «sugiro» in an expression of suggestion.

patterns.name: «sch» in a mathematical sequence
patterns.context: A sequence of letters in a probability problem; the same list also contains repeated letter combinations.

patterns.name: Anomalous subword fragment «s»
patterns.context: Activations fall near English/abbreviation boundaries: once after the author name «Shanchao», and once in «ZAMDAPP?s» after a project abbreviation; the local contexts differ.
patterns.domain: Paper author information and medical project descriptions

4_2898.description: 激活集中于若干短字母片段或词内片段：俄语词尾「ся」、葡语「gi」、数学字母序列「sch」，以及论坛签名/用户名中的零散拼写片段；另有论文文本中的孤立 s。各段语境差异较大。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词尾「ся」
patterns.context: 俄语词内部或词尾；如「получается」的词尾，常见于反身动词形式。

patterns.name: 人名拼写片段「urycy」
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 文本分隔线后的用户名或签名样式文本中。

patterns.name: 人名拼写片段「anem」
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 文本分隔线后的用户名或签名样式文本中。

patterns.name: 用户名中的「ed」
patterns.context: 分隔线后紧接着的用户名「called」式拼写片段。

patterns.name: 葡语词内「gi」
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语单词「sugiro」内部，位于建议表达中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语文本

patterns.name: 数学序列中的「sch」
patterns.context: 概率题中由字母构成的序列；同一串列里还出现重复字母组合。

patterns.name: 异常子词片段「s」
patterns.context: 激活落在英文/缩写边界附近：一处是作者名「Shanchao」后的标记，一处是项目缩写后的「ZAMDAPP?s」；局部上下文并不相同。
patterns.domain: 论文作者信息与医学项目描述

en.description: Activations are scattered across random letter strings, Swedish and Russian in-word fragments, miscellaneous forum strings, and paper terminology; the available examples show no stable semantic or formal rule that accounts for all passages.

patterns.name: Substrings in random letter strings
patterns.context: Appears in randomly concatenated letter strings, adjacent to a probability problem about drawing or arranging letters; activations land on letter fragments within the strings.

patterns.name: Swedish in-word fragments
patterns.context: Appears within Swedish parliamentary-text words or near word boundaries, involving speech, society, and media markets; the word forms are split into multiple fragments.

patterns.name: Russian word-form fragments
patterns.context: A continuous fragment within a Russian word, appearing in a sentence describing something as impossible or inapplicable.

patterns.name: Sporadic strings in technology forums
patterns.context: Activations land on URLs, usernames, or truncated English word fragments in forum posts; no clear shared semantics are evident.

patterns.name: Paper acknowledgments and statistical terminology
patterns.context: Near author-contribution statements and the statistical term “analysis of variance”; these triggers are scattered across ordinary English words and formula text.

4_2898.description: 激活分散于随机字母串、瑞典语和俄语词内片段、论坛杂项字符串及论文术语中；现有样本看不出能覆盖全部段落的稳定语义或形式规则。

patterns.name: 随机字母串中的子串
patterns.context: 出现在随机拼接的字母串中，紧邻关于从字母中抽取或排列的概率题；激活落在串内的字母片段上。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语议会文本的词内或词边界附近，涉及发言、社会与媒体市场；词形被拆成多个片段。

patterns.name: 俄语词形片段
patterns.context: 俄语词内连续片段，出现在描述某事无法实现或适用的句子中。

patterns.name: 科技论坛中的零散字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在论坛帖子中的网址、用户名或被截断的英文词片段；没有明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 论文致谢与统计术语
patterns.context: 论文作者贡献说明及统计术语“analysis of variance”附近；这些触发分散在普通英文词和公式文字中。

en.concept: Multilingual local fragments and formatting markers
en.description: Activations are scattered across academic formatting after colons and line breaks, it in technical Q&A, letter strings in math problems, and word-internal fragments in Spanish, Portuguese, Swedish, and English; signature-like strings after HackerNews comment separators also occur.

patterns.name: Formatting/output-start marker after a colon
patterns.context: A colon is immediately followed by a line break, formula/definition/explanation, or list content; the strongest trigger is a standalone colon.

patterns.name: Missing it and quoted phrase
patterns.context: In code or technical discussion, it occurs after found, followed by parentheses and text expressing openness.

patterns.name: Letter sequence in a probability problem
patterns.context: A probability problem about drawing letters lists letter strings and asks the probability of a particular sequence occurring.

patterns.name: Spanish word-internal fragment
patterns.context: In formal Spanish prose, the fragment occurs within the word acuerdo.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-internal fragment
patterns.context: In formal Portuguese parliamentary context, the fragment occurs within sugiro (I suggest).

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal fragment
patterns.context: In Swedish parliamentary text, the fragment occurs within the expression hålla anföranden (deliver speeches).

patterns.name: Username fragment after a comment separator
patterns.context: In comment text, occurs in the comment signature/username position separated by a line of hyphens.

patterns.name: Username fragment after a comment separator
patterns.context: In comment text, a username- or signature-like string appears after a separator line, followed by comment content.

patterns.name: English word-internal fragment
patterns.context: In English prose, the fragment falls within the word preceding hair; the surrounding text is literary narration in quotation form.

4_2898.concept: 多语种局部片段与格式标记
4_2898.description: 激活分散于冒号及换行后的学术版式、技术问答中的 it、数学字母串，以及西班牙语、葡萄牙语、瑞典语和英语词内片段；另见 HackerNews 评论分隔线后的署名样式字符串。

patterns.name: 冒号后的版式/输出起始标记
patterns.context: 冒号后紧接换行、公式/定义/说明或列表内容；最强触发是独立的冒号

patterns.name: 缺失的 it 与引号内短语
patterns.context: 在代码或技术讨论中，it 出现在 found 后，随后接括号及表达开放态度的文字

patterns.name: 概率题字母序列
patterns.context: 抽取字母的概率题中，列举字母串后询问某个序列出现的概率

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语正式散文中，片段出现在 acuerdo 一词内部
patterns.domain: 艺术教育/学术行政文字

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语正式议会语境中，片段出现在 sugiro（我建议）一词内部

patterns.name: 瑞典语词内片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语议会文本中，片段位于 hålla anföranden（发表演讲）表达内

patterns.name: 评论分隔线后的用户名片段
patterns.context: 评论区文本中，出现在由横线分隔的评论署名/用户名位置

patterns.name: 评论分隔线后的用户名片段
patterns.context: 评论区文本中，横线分隔后出现用户名或署名样式字符串，随后接评论内容

patterns.name: 英文词内片段
patterns.context: 英文散文中，片段落在 hair 前的词内部；周围是引用式文学叙述
